products.description_text: Acer palmatum 'Adrian's Compact' Dwarf Red 'Adrian's Compact' Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 'Adrian's Compact' is an upright red Japanese maple with a dense compact habit. The overall shape can be shrub-like, but typically 2 times taller than wide. 'Adrian's Compact' may reach 6-7 ft in height by 3-4 ft in width in 10 years. In the spring, 'Adrian's Compact' leafs out with a bright pink-red color that matures to dark red. The correct 'Adrian's Compact' has a very wide lobes on each leaf. 'Adrian's Compact' turns to a bright scarlet red in the fall. 'Adrian's Compact' is a great small Japanese maple for small compact places in your garden. Limited Quantities Available !! descriptions.preferred: Acer paxii Evergreen Japanese Maple Zones 7b-10 Acer paxii is an extremely rare maple from Yunan, China. This selection is evergreen in warmer climates, while semi-deciduous in colder climates. In these colder climates, you may get yellow and coral pink fall color later than other maples. New growth can be a beautiful coral pink with leaves that will remind you of Acer buergerianum. This evergreen is in fact a close relative to the trident maple, being grouped in section Pentaphylla. Acer paxii may reach 15-20 ft in 10 years. Give Acer paxii protection from the hot afternoon sun in warmer climates. This is a chance to get a really rare acer to add that bit of exclusivity to your garden. Limited Quantities Available !! As we have over a thousand cultivars of Japanese maples, we often do not have many of each cultivar. descriptions_zh.preferred: Acer paxii 金沙槭，适生区 7b-10。Acer paxii 是来自中国云南的极稀有槭树。在较温暖地区，该品种为常绿；在较冷地区则表现为半落叶。于这些较冷地区，其秋色可能较其他槭树来得更晚，可呈黄色和珊瑚粉色。新梢可显现美丽的珊瑚粉色，叶形会让人联想到 Acer buergerianum。该常绿种实际上与三角枫关系密切，同属 Pentaphylla 组。Acer paxii 在 10 年内可长至 15-20 英尺。在较温暖地区，建议避开午后烈日。若想为花园增添一份稀有性与独特性，这是一个值得收藏的罕见槭树品种。数量有限。

descriptions_zh.preferred: Acer pictum 日本枫，适生区 5-8。Acer pictum 是一种优美且适应性强的日本枫原种，原产于日本、中国及东亚部分地区的森林中。其树形圆整开展，通常随时间可长至 30-40 英尺高，在理想条件下偶可更大。叶片 5-7 裂，春季萌发时带古铜色调，夏季转为鲜绿色，秋季则呈现明亮的黄色和橙色。适合全日照至半阴环境，偏好排水良好、微酸性土壤，并需保持土壤湿润，是较大园林空间中可靠而雅致的选择。数量有限。

descriptions_zh.preferred: Acer pseudosieboldianum 日本枫，稀有日本枫，适生区 4b-9。Acer pseudosieboldianum 是一种极为出色的槭树，耐寒性强，且秋色优美。其绿色叶片在秋季会转为鲜亮的黄色、橙色和红色。Acer pseudosieboldianum 深受寒冷地区种植者以及所有见过其绚丽秋色的人喜爱。这里提供的是实生自根、未嫁接的 Acer pseudosieboldianum，因此理论上应具有更强的耐寒性。即使您并不处于寒冷地区，Acer pseudosieboldianum 依然会成长为优美的直立型乔木，并以出色的秋色带来惊喜。10 年内可长至约 12 英尺高。在较炎热地区，建议避开午后烈日，以获得最佳生长状态和秋季显色效果。此规格为 10 加仑容器苗，仅支持本地自提，因植株过大无法邮寄。MrMaple Nursery 位于北卡罗来纳州 East Flat Rock，请联系我们安排提货时间。数量有限。

descriptions.preferred: This plant is the red-tinged form of 'Shigitatsu sawa', but with the lobes of the leaves slightly longer and more deeply separated. The leaves are seven lobed, sometimes The margins are wavy and have large, coarse, and sharp teeth. As the buds first open, the inner bud scales and new leaves are maroon. When fully opened, the typical leaf has quite dark veins on a light yellow-green background. The entire leaf is strongly overtoned with pink and red, however, which is the striking feature of this cultivar. This color holds very well into the summer, when the whole leaf darkens somewhat and develops a strong green tone within. This triple variegation of green, yellow, and pink is quite striking. The patterning can persist all summer when the tree is partly shaded, but is lost in full sunlight, the leaves becoming light green. 'Aka shigitatsu sawa' is not as strong growing as its green counterpart. It becomes a somewhat bushy tall plant up to 4 m tall and 5 m or so wide. It is hardy but not easy to propagate and is rather rare in nurseries and collections. It makes a very interesting specimen plant because of the unusual color form and combination. The ancient Japanese meaning of the name 'Aka shigitatsu sawa' is "red snipes over a winter marsh." This cultivar has also been known under the names 'Beni shigitatsu sawa', 'Samari' and 'Samurai'. The Japanese characters for 'Beni shigitatsu sawa' are identical to those for 'Aka shigitatsu sawa', hence the names should be treated as synonymous. Confusion has been caused by applying the name 'Beni shigitatsu sawa' to one or two plants which are different from the above description. Archives, Corvallis point with the edges toothed. The leaves are 8-12 cm long and wide. The early season color is a very deep purple red or black red, depending on the light. Later in the summer, the leaves bronze somewhat, showing more green. Like other reds, when grown in shady conditions the red is not as intense in early summer. The petioles are 4-5 cm long and are a deep red. The branches are green. This strong, upright-growing maple reaches at least 5 m at maturity. It tends to widen into a broad-topped, short tree. It is a hardy cultivar for the garden landscape as the color contrasts slightly with other red forms, and it is a good choice among the larger-leaved cultivars.

sources.title: 赤鸭立泽 Acer Palmatum 'Aka Shigitatsu Sawa'
sources.description: 赤鸭立泽是以火热的秋色闻名的，在庭院中呈现引人注目的橙色或红色。春天迷人的乳白色叶子上带有一部分玫瑰粉，和绿色的叶脉互相衬托，更显春色柔和，色彩丰富使得小裂片掌状叶子具有很强的观赏性，纹理与 'Shigitatsu sawa' （鸭立泽）较为相似。夏天转变为带有粉色的绿色，一年三个生长季节都带有红色调。赤鸭立泽是一款 独特的、生长相当缓慢的 日本枫树 ， 非常适合小型景观的搭配， 成年树高约 3-4m 。

descriptions_zh.preferred: 本品种可视为 'Shigitatsu sawa' 的带红晕型，但叶裂片略长，分裂也更深。叶片通常 7 裂，有时边缘起伏，并具较大、粗而尖锐的锯齿。芽刚萌动时，内层芽鳞和新叶呈栗紫色。叶片完全展开后，典型叶面表现为浅黄绿色底色上具较深色叶脉；但整片叶又强烈覆有粉色和红色调，这是本品种最显著的特征。这种色彩能较好保持到夏季；入夏后整片叶颜色会略为加深，内部绿色调增强。绿色、黄色与粉色三重斑彩效果十分醒目。树体在半阴条件下，这种叶色斑纹可持续整个夏季；若处于全日照下，则会消失，叶片转为浅绿色。'Aka shigitatsu sawa' 的生长势不如其绿色对应品种，最终形成较灌丛状的大型植株，高可达 4 米，冠幅约 5 米。其耐寒，但繁殖不易，在苗圃和收藏中较为少见。因其不寻常的色型与配色组合，是非常有趣的孤植观赏品种。'Aka shigitatsu sawa' 这一名称的古日语含义为“冬日沼泽上方的红鹬”。本品种也曾以 'Beni shigitatsu sawa'、'Samari' 和 'Samurai' 等名称流通。'Beni shigitatsu sawa' 与 'Aka shigitatsu sawa' 的日文汉字写法相同，因此这两个名称应视为同物异名。曾有人将 'Beni shigitatsu sawa' 误用于一两株与上述描述不符的植株，因而造成混淆。档案资料（Corvallis）还提到：叶缘具锯齿，叶片长宽约 8-12 厘米。生长季早期叶色为很深的紫红色或黑红色，具体取决于光照；到夏季后期，叶色会略带古铜色并显出更多绿色。与其他红叶型一样，在遮阴条件下栽培时，其初夏红色不会那么浓烈。叶柄长 4-5 厘米，呈深红色；枝条为绿色。该品种生长强健、树形直立，成熟时至少可达 5 米高，并常扩展成宽顶的矮生小乔木。作为园林栽培品种，它耐寒，叶色与其他红叶型略有差异，在大叶型品种中是不错的选择。

rhs_zh.description: 灌丛状落叶小乔木，高约 4 米；叶片深裂，7 裂，长 4-6 厘米、宽 6-9 厘米，裂片先端渐尖，叶缘呈波状。嫩叶展开时呈深绯红色，随后显现深色叶脉、浅黄绿色底色，并覆有粉色与红色，这种独特的综合色彩可保持至夏季；之后叶色转为深绿色，秋季再转红。春季开不显著的红紫色花，之后可能结带翅的红色果实

descriptions.preferred: 铜芽羽衣又称红羽衣，是由矢野正善先生于 2003 年自 中岛农园得到而自行命名的品种，为实生的羽衣品种， 当时在日本九州地区仍是用「羽衣」来贩售它。在春天 有着美丽的红棕色到紫色光泽的叶子。 属掌状枫系极深裂的半矮种异型叶的品种。叶片有五片 羽毛状的小叶，裂片分离成为单叶，小叶呈细长圆型， 但每一小叶皆有叶柄样柄分别连到茎上，有细而规则的 锯齿缘，五片小叶通常在一个平面上，甚至小叶平整而 型态统一，叶片长约 5~6 公分，宽约 3 公分。叶柄都是 粉红色，嫩枝呈红棕色。

descriptions.preferred: 大叶羽团扇品种，由日本中 嶋 久夫先生于 1988 年在 日本神奈川县大 磯 町获得，具体出处不详，春天初 芽为黄绿色，叶尖偶有橙红色，叶面上有银白色的 绒毛，叶柄亦有毛，春叶为赤茶色，夏季转为深绿色， 但是新稍颜色为赤茶色，色彩对比明显，秋天会有 丰富的色彩，橙红色，红色，橙黄色和黄色，色彩斑斓。 生长健壮，可全日照，夏季午后适当遮阴，成年株 可达 3 米左右高度。

descriptions.preferred: palmatum-green This small palmatum is a member of the group of cultivars, such as the well-known 'Katsura', valuable for their brightspringfoliage. As the leavesemerge they are a striking orange gold with the margins shading into a deep pink. It is a more intense orange than that of 'Katsura', and the color contrasts well with the bright coral red petioles and shoots. The spring colors last for almost a month and turn to a deep, clear yellow, gradually becoming a light green. The fall color is shades of orange and yellow with reddish blushing, but not outstanding. The small mainly five-lobed, sometimes seven-lobed, leaves are usually longer than broad, 4-4.5 cm long and 3.5-4 cm wide, and divided up to three-quarters of the way to the leaf base. The lobes are ovate-triangular with pointed tips, about 3 cm long and 1.2 cm wide at the broadest point in the lower third, narrowing to 5-6 mm at the lobe junctions. The margins are clearly toothed. The leaf is smaller and less deeply divided than in 'Katsura'. The straight, slender, red petioles are 1.5-2 cm long. This delightful compact semidwarf tree was imdivided," "deeply divided," and "very deeply dino confusion with the natural subspecies, it would to which a cultivar belongs, and there would be fewer be placed in either of two groups. ported into the Netherlands from Japan in 1991 by Firma C. Esveld, Boskoop. It is proving to be slower growing than 'Katsura', but the spring coloring is more intense and longer lasting. Its height at maturity is unlikely to be more than 3 m, with a spread of about 1.5 m. The short, thin shoots make this cultivar difficult to propagate. The name 'Akane' means "the madder plant." Because of the color of the dye obtained from the madder plant, the name has also come to mean "the glowing evening sky," which describes perfectly the color of this cultivar in the spring.

sources.title: 茜Acer Palmatum 'Akane'
sources.description: 日系品种，由日本的司园艺推广，春叶色为橙黄色， 会有粉色的叶边及黄色的主叶脉，观赏效果佳，色彩 持久，可以一直保持到入夏，夏季变为黄绿色，秋季 为橙黄色或红色。生长速度稍慢，矮性，分支能力强， 午后需要遮阴，不喜酸雨，雨淋后容易出现黑色或者 灰色的斑点，矢野先生的"Book of Maples"上建议 不要从顶部浇水或者淋雨以防真菌滋生，成年株可达 1.8 米左右高度。

rhs.description: A compact, deciduous tree about 2-3m in height, the small, 5 to 7-lobed leaves emerge a striking orange-gold, the margins shading to a deep pink, gradually becoming a deep clear yellow in late spring, eventually light greenish-yellow later in summer, then turning pink and orange in autumn

care.cultivation: Grow in any moisture-retentive, well-drained soil in a sheltered position. Leaf colour is best in partial shade, although full sun can be tolerated if soil is reliably moist. Leaf scorch can be caused by lack of soil moisture or excessive exposure. See Japanese maples cultivation
care.pruning: Pruning group 1 , only from late autumn to mid-winter
care.propagation: Propagate by softwood cuttings, layering or by grafting . Plants grown from seed are unlikely to come true, but may still be garden worthy

resistance.pest: May be susceptible to aphids and scale insects , including horse chestnut scale
resistance.disease: May be susceptible to Verticillium wilt , Acer leaf scorch and honey fungus

descriptions_zh.preferred: palmatum-green 这个小型 palmatum 品种属于一类以亮丽春叶著称的栽培品种，与著名的 'Katsura' 同组。新叶展开时呈醒目的橙金色，叶缘渐染为深粉色。其橙色比 'Katsura' 更浓烈，并与鲜珊瑚红色的叶柄和新梢形成良好对比。春季叶色可维持近一个月，随后转为深而明净的黄色，再逐渐变为浅绿色。秋色为橙黄并带微红晕，但并不算特别突出。叶片较小，多为 5 裂，偶有 7 裂，通常长大于宽，长 4-4.5 厘米、宽 3.5-4 厘米，深裂达叶基约四分之三。裂片呈卵状三角形，先端尖，长约 3 厘米，在下部三分之一处最宽约 1.2 厘米，至裂片连接处收窄至 5-6 毫米。叶缘具明显锯齿。其叶片比 'Katsura' 更小，裂刻也较浅。叶柄直立、细长、红色，长 1.5-2 厘米。这是一个迷人的紧凑型半矮生小乔木；原文此处有 OCR 错乱，部分语意不清。1991 年由荷兰 Boskoop 的 Firma C. Esveld 自日本引入。现证明其生长速度慢于 'Katsura'，但春叶色彩更浓且持续时间更长。成熟后高度预计不超过 3 米，冠幅约 1.5 米。由于枝条短而细，该品种繁殖较困难。名称 'Akane' 意为“茜草”；又因茜草染料的颜色，这个名字也引申为“燃烧的晚霞”，十分贴切地描述了该品种春季的色彩。

rhs_zh.description: 紧凑型落叶小乔木，高约 2-3 米。小型叶片 5 至 7 裂，春季萌发时呈醒目的橙金色，叶缘渐染深粉色；至晚春逐渐转为深而明净的黄色，夏季后期则变为浅黄绿色，秋季再转为粉色和橙色。

attributes.suggested_uses: 城市/庭院花园，乡村/自然式花园，露台/容器植物，花境及花坛
attributes.hort_group_description: 本 palmatum 组的槭树叶片较小，呈掌状，边缘具粗锯齿。

care.cultivation: 宜栽于保水且排水良好的土壤中，并选择避风位置。半阴环境下叶色表现最佳；若土壤湿度稳定，也可耐全日照。土壤缺水或暴露过度都可能导致叶片焦边。参见 Japanese maples cultivation。
care.pruning: 修剪组 1，仅限晚秋至仲冬期间修剪。
care.propagation: 可通过嫩枝扦插、压条或嫁接繁殖。实生苗通常难以保持品种性状，但仍可能具有园艺观赏价值。

resistance.disease: 可能易感黄萎病、槭叶焦枯病和蜜环菌病

descriptions.preferred: The large leaves are very deeply divided into five to seven broadly ovateelliptic lobes, with very sharp tips and toothed margins. The early season color is a very deep purple-red becoming bronze-green in the summer. Like other reds, when grown in shady conditions it has a less intense color. The leafstalks are deep red and the branches green. This strong, uprightgrowing maple reaches at least 16 ft. (5 m) at maturity. It tends to widen into a broad-topped, short tree. It is both hardy and easy to grow. The name means "the crows at dawn."

attributes.suggested_uses: 城市/庭院花园、乡村/自然式花园、露台/容器栽培
attributes.hort_group_description: 此 matsumurae 组的槭树，叶片深裂约达叶片的四分之三，叶缘具粗齿，裂片狭长且先端尖。

care.cultivation: 宜栽于保水且排水良好的土壤中，并选择避风位置。半阴环境下叶色表现最佳；若土壤湿度稳定，也可耐全日照。土壤缺水或暴露过度都可能导致叶片焦边。参见 Japanese maples cultivation。
care.pruning: 修剪组 1，仅限晚秋至仲冬期间修剪。
care.propagation: 可通过嫩枝扦插、压条或嫁接繁殖。实生苗通常难以保持品种性状，但仍可能具有园艺观赏价值。

resistance.pest: 可能易受蚜虫和介壳虫侵害，包括七叶树介壳虫。
resistance.disease: 可能易感黄萎病、槭叶焦枯病和蜜环菌病

descriptions_zh.preferred: 叶片较大，深裂为 5 至 7 枚宽卵形至椭圆形裂片，先端极尖，边缘具锯齿。生长季早期叶色为极深的紫红色，夏季转为古铜绿色。与其他红叶类型一样，在遮阴条件下栽培时色彩浓度会减弱。叶柄深红，枝条绿色。这一强健、直立生长的枫树成熟时至少可达 16 英尺（5 米）。随着生长常扩展成宽顶、较矮的小乔木。其耐寒且容易栽培。名称意为“黎明时的乌鸦”。 另有一段可辨识内容为 Acer tschonoskii 的描述：这是一种优雅的小型蛇皮槭，原产日本，生于海拔约 4550-8125 英尺（1400-1500 米）的亚高山林地。植株可形成大型灌木或小乔木，高约 16-23 英尺（5-7 米），适合配置于混合景观中。叶片较小，近圆形，浅裂 5 裂，边缘具很粗的锯齿，先端短尖；叶面绿色，叶背带锈褐色毛。秋色为黄色至金黄色，有时略带粉色，但不算特别出众。该种是最容易栽培、最耐寒、适应性也较强的槭树之一，但不喜碱性土壤。 其后原文主要为耐寒分区图、苗圃名录、术语表、参考书目与索引，且 OCR 噪声较重，此处不作臆测性逐项展开。

descriptions.preferred: The leaves have a base color of rich green which is marked with white variegations. Some leaves are all white, while others have only a few white flecks. The main pattern is white or cream cut-in a portion of the green leaf. In these leaves, the variegated portion is curved or sickle-shaped. Often the green leaf is stippled with tiny specks of white, forming a solid pattern with the green showing through from beneath. The medium-sized leaf usually has five lobes. Each lobe generally is triangular-ovate, but all lobes are irregularly curved or sickle-shaped. As new leaves emerge, the variegation has a definite pink tone which soon changes to white or cream. This cultivar forms a tall shrub, reaching up to 16 ft. (5 m) high. It is not a rapid grower and should have some protection from the hot afternoon sun. Acer tschonoskii Tschonoski's maple This small graceful snakebark maple is native to Japan, growing in the subalpine mountain forests at elevations of 4550-8125 ft. (1400-1500 m) above sea level. It forms a large shrub or small tree up to 16-23 ft. (5-7 m) tall, and makes a pleasant choice in a mixed landscape. The small, round, shallowly five-lobed leaves have very coarsely toothed margins and shortly pointed tips. The leaves are green with rusty brown hairs beneath. Fall colors are yellow to gold, sometimes pink tinged, but not outstanding. This species is one of the easiest, hardiest, and most tolerant maple species to grow. It does not like alkaline soils. sources.title: 秋风锦 Acer Pictum 'Akikaze Nishiki'
sources.description: 秋风锦距今已经有 100多年的历史，最早记录可追溯到1882年，非常的耐热，是迄今为止最耐热的锦叶品种。秋风锦原本归属于元宝枫，之后矢野正善大师将其归为蝙蝠枫。在早春也是绿色和亮粉红色的，随后粉色部分会蜕变成奶油白。夏季白色部分还会适当反绿成浅白的绿色，然后原来绿色的部分会变成更深的绿色。秋季是橙红色。秋风锦的生长速度非常快，成年树高6-7米。

descriptions_zh.preferred: 叶片底色为浓绿色，并带有白色斑锦。有些叶片几乎全白，另一些则只有少量白色斑点。其主要斑纹类型为在绿色叶面上切入状分布的白色或奶油色区域，这些斑锦部分常呈弯曲或镰刀状。绿色部分常又密布细小白点，形成近乎连续的斑锦效果，而下层仍可透出绿色。中等大小的叶片通常为 5 裂；各裂片多呈三角状卵形，但整体常不规则弯曲或呈镰刀状。新叶展开时斑锦带有明显粉色调，不久即转为白色或奶油色。该品种可形成高大灌木，高可达 16 英尺（5 米）。其生长速度不快，宜避免午后烈日直晒。 随后可辨识内容转为 Acer tschonoskii（Tschonoski's maple）的描述：这是一种优雅的小型蛇皮槭，原产日本，生于海拔约 4550-8125 英尺（1400-1500 米）的亚高山林地。植株可形成大型灌木或小乔木，高约 16-23 英尺（5-7 米），适合用于混合景观配置。叶片较小、近圆形、浅裂 5 裂，边缘具粗锯齿，先端短尖；叶面绿色，叶背带锈褐色毛。秋色为黄色至金黄色，有时略带粉色，但并不十分突出。该种是较易栽培、耐寒性和适应性都较强的槭树之一，但不喜碱性土壤。 其后原文为耐寒分区图、苗圃来源、术语表、参考书目及索引，且 OCR 噪声极重，此处不作臆测性逐项翻译。

descriptions.preferred: This robust dwarf is similar in leaf and form to 'Sharp's Pygmy' with small deeply divided leaves of the Palmatum Group. Unlike 'Sharp's Pygmy', it has dark brown shoots. The small five-lobed, sometimes seven-lobed, leaves are 3.5-4.5 cm long and wide. The lobes are long, ovate-triangular and are divided up to three-quarters of the way to the leaf base. The margins are clearly but shallowly toothed. When they first appear, the young leaves are a pinky red, turning yellow green before becoming medium green for the summer. The fall color is a vivid orange red. 'Akita yatsubusa' is a reliable, hardy cultivar drizzle." The foliage is rather small considering the type of plant, and it is fairly closely spaced on short twigs. The bright green leaves have five or seven lobes, radiating outward in the star shape typical of Acer palmatum subsp. palmatum. Each lobe is ovate and terminates in an acuminate sharp point with an evenly toothed margin which tends to be attractively crinkled. In general the middle three lobes are much longer than the two or more lateral lobes. Each leaf measures 3-5 cm long and wide. The petioles and small twigs carry a dark red tone. Fall color is rather bright in the yellow-orange ranges. This semidwarf tree grows broadly as well as upright. It tends to be dense and twiggy and forms a low-growing background in the garden landscape.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这一强健的矮生品种在叶形与树形上都与 'Sharp's Pygmy' 相似，具有 palmatum 组那类小型、深裂叶。与 'Sharp's Pygmy' 不同的是，它的新梢为深褐色。叶片较小，通常 5 裂，有时 7 裂，长宽约 3.5-4.5 厘米。裂片狭长，呈卵状三角形，深裂可达叶基的四分之三；叶缘具清晰但较浅的锯齿。新叶初展时呈粉红偏红色，随后转为黄绿色，夏季则为中绿色；秋色鲜艳，为橙红色。'Akita yatsubusa' 是一个可靠且耐寒的品种。 后半段原文疑似为另一品种的描述，品名因 OCR 缺损而无法确认：其叶片相较植株类型而言偏小，着生于短枝上且排列较密。鲜绿色叶片具 5 或 7 裂，向外放射，呈 Acer palmatum subsp. palmatum 典型的星状。各裂片为卵形，先端渐尖锐利，边缘锯齿整齐，并常带有好看的微皱。通常中间 3 枚裂片明显长于两侧裂片。每片叶长宽约 3-5 厘米。叶柄与细枝带深红色调。秋色较明亮，偏黄橙色。这种半矮生小树既开展又直立，分枝细密，可在庭园中形成低矮的背景层。

descriptions.preferred: This maple is very similar to but smaller than the outstanding old Japanese cultivar 'Higasa yama' and is thought to be even more colorful as the buds open in the spring. The small five-lobed leaves are deeply divided and about the same size and shape as those of the popular variegate 'Butterfly'. 'Alpenweiss' forms a vase-shaped tree and is estimated to grow to 10 ft. (3 m) tall with a spread of about 4 ft. (1.3 m) in approximately 10 years. It is ideal for small gardens and container culture. The name means "white alpine."

sources.title: 白色阿尔卑斯 Acer Palmatum 'Alpenweiss'
sources.description: 脉斑叶品种， Alpenweiss 意为 " 白色的阿尔卑斯山 "， 由俄勒冈州的 Baltzer 苗圃培育 ，与日本杰出的老品种 日笠山（ Hi g asa yama ） 相比， 非常相似 ，春季叶芽展开时，其色彩更为绚烂。它的叶片分为五裂，开裂至叶片的四分之三 处 ，叶片大小与 蝴蝶（ Butterfly ） 相同。夏季叶色与日笠山相似，主要的叶脉呈浅绿色，叶脉边缘区域为中等至浓郁的绿色，叶缘则是由初夏的 浅粉色 转为奶白色 ， 秋季叶片为橙色至绯红色。树冠呈花瓶状 ， 成年树高大约3m 。

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这一槭树与著名的日本老品种 'Higasa yama' 十分相似，但株形更小，一般认为其春季芽体开放时色彩甚至更为丰富。其小型 5 裂叶深裂，大小和形状都与广受欢迎的斑叶品种 'Butterfly' 接近。'Alpenweiss' 形成花瓶状树形，估计约 10 年可长至 10 英尺（3 米）高，冠幅约 4 英尺（1.3 米）。非常适合小型庭园和容器栽培。其名称意为“白色高山”。

descriptions.preferred: The spring leaves are a delightful amber with a network of dark veins, the colors becoming darker through the summer. The large, deeply divided leaves have five to seven ovate lobes with long-pointed tips and fairly evenly toothed but slightly crumpled margins. descriptions.preferred: Acer P latanoides x A mplum 'Ample Surprise' 巨大的惊喜属于挪威槭和大叶槭的杂交品种，具有直立生长的特性，它浓密的树冠结构赋予它一种绘画般的外观。它的叶型非常具有特点，就像蝙蝠的翅膀一样， 一般为 5-7 裂，在春天先呈青铜色，然后变成深绿色，秋天变成红橙色。树皮随着年龄的增长会变成灰褐色。成年树高大约 4 米，冠幅大约 3 米，非常耐寒。

descriptions.preferred: Acer buergerianum 'Angyo Weeping' Rare Weeping Trident Maple Zones 5-9 'Angyo Weeping' is a recent selection of a trident from Japan that can reach 15-20 ft in height while cascading downward with long pendulous ornamental branches. 'Angyo Weeping' is extremely heat tolerant and vigorous. Fall colors are bright oranges to reds. 'Angyo Weeping' works great as either a focal point planting or a background planting. This maple is excellent for containers. The unique texture of 'Angyo Weeping' provides a lot of interest in the landscape, even in the winter. As this tree ages, it attains a nice exfoliating grey bark, providing even more interest in the winter garden. This Japanese trident maple received its name as it was found in the Angyo prefecture in Japan. 'Angyo Weeping' is an excellent addition to any garden. Limited Quantities Available !! rhs.description: A small, upright, slow-growing tree ultimately to about 3m in height and spread. The leaves have five, toothed, tapering lobes opening lime green, becoming yellow-green in summer with red-flushed edges and yellow-orange in autumn. Inconspicuous red flowers in spring are followed by red and green, winged fruit in autumn

attributes.suggested_uses: City/Courtyard Gardens, Cottage/Informal Garden, Patio/Container Plants
attributes.hort_group_description: Acers in this palmatum group have small, palm-shaped leaves with coarsely-toothed edges

care.cultivation: Grows best in slightly acidic, humus-rich, well-drained soil, but tolerates most soils if improved with well-rotted organic matter . Hot, dry air, cold wind and late frost may cause leaf scorching. Mulch in autumn to protect shallow roots from cold and drying out. See Japanese maple cultivation
care.pruning: Pruning group 1
care.propagation: Propagate by semi-hardwood cuttings or by layering

resistance.pest: May be susceptible to Acer gall mite, aphids , caterpillars and horse chestnut scale
resistance.disease: May be susceptible to Verticillium wilt , Acer leaf scorch and honey fungus

rhs_zh.description: 小型、直立、缓慢生长的树，最终高和冠幅约 3 米。叶具 5 个具齿尖裂片，初展时为青柠绿色，夏季转为黄绿色，叶缘带红晕，秋季呈黄橙色。春季开不显眼的红色花，秋季结红绿色翅果。

attributes.suggested_uses: 城市/庭院花园、乡村/自然式花园、露台/容器栽培
attributes.hort_group_description: 本 palmatum 组的槭树叶片较小，呈掌状，边缘具粗锯齿。

care.cultivation: 在微酸性、富含腐殖质且排水良好的土壤中生长最佳，但若加入充分腐熟的有机质改良，也能适应多数土壤。炎热干燥的空气、寒风和晚霜可能导致叶片焦枯。秋季覆 mulch，可保护浅根免受寒害和干燥。参见 Japanese maple cultivation。
care.pruning: 修剪第 1 组
care.propagation: 可采用半成熟枝扦插或压条繁殖。

resistance.pest: 可能易受槭瘿螨、蚜虫、毛虫和七叶树介壳虫危害
resistance.disease: 可能易感黄萎病、槭叶焦枯病和蜜环菌病

descriptions.preferred: This small to medium-sized tree or shrub has variegated leaves. It is very like 'Tennyo-no-hoshi' in leaf shape, variegation, and habit, and was suspected of being synonymous. However, it originated from Japan and has slightly smaller leaves and more compact growth. The light cream-green variegation around the leaf edges does not turn pink in the sun as readily as does that of 'Tennyo-no-hoshi'. 'Ao kanzashi' forms a densely branched upright tree, up to 4 m tall, the crown spreading out at the top in a similar fashion to 'Butterfly'. 'Ao kanzashi' has been known as 'Oa hanzashi'.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这是一种小型至中型乔木或灌木，具斑叶。其叶形、斑锦特征和株型都与 'Tennyo-no-hoshi' 非常相似，因此一度被怀疑为同物异名。但它起源于日本，叶片略小，生长更为紧凑。叶缘浅奶油绿色的斑锦在日照下不像 'Tennyo-no-hoshi' 那样容易转粉。'Ao kanzashi' 形成分枝密集的直立小乔木，高可达 4 米，树冠顶部开展，形态与 'Butterfly' 相似。'Ao kanzashi' 也曾以 'Oa hanzashi' 之名流传。

products.name: Acer palmatum 'Ao kanzashi' Variegated Japanese Maple
products.description_text: Acer palmatum 'Ao kanzashi' is a variegated Japanese maple with very small leaves. These small leaves have a light variegation along the edges of the leaves. At times in the spring these variegated edges can be a red color, but most of the year the edges are a creamy white or light green color. Fall color is an impressive orange and red. 10 Year Size: Height: 10-12 feet Width: 4-6 feet

descriptions.preferred: This cultivar, whose name means "green cascading," differs slightly in leaf form from many other green dissectums, but is similar to 'Kiri nishiki' and 'Sekimori'. 'Aoba shidare' is a synonym. The color of the leaves is a slight blue green, not the sharp green of 'Viridis'. Fall color is yellow. The seven-lobed leaves are of medium size and doubly dissected as in the typical dissectum. However, the secondary cuts are not as deep nor are the lobes as long as in the better-known forms of green dissectum. The many points of each leaf seem not as sharp, giving the whole leaf a more blunt appearance in outline. The leaves are differs in color.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 该品种名意为“绿色垂枝”，其叶形与许多其他绿色细裂型品种略有不同，但与 ‘Kiri nishiki’ 和 ‘Sekimori’ 相近。‘Aoba shidare’ 是其异名。叶色为略带蓝调的绿色，不同于 ‘Viridis’ 那种鲜明的绿色。秋色为黄色。叶片通常七裂，中等大小，且如典型 dissectum 类型一样为二回细裂。不过，其二次裂刻不如常见绿色细裂型品种那样深，裂片也没有那么长。每片叶的诸多尖端看起来不那么锐利，因此整体叶缘轮廓显得更为钝圆。叶片在颜色上也有所不同。

products.name: Acer palmatum 'Ao Shidare' Green Lace Leaf Japanese Maple
products.description_text: The name simply means green cascading which perfectly describes this great little tree. In spring the green color has a slightly blue tint that separates it from other green dissectums. At one time all green dissectums were probably called 'Ao shidare' but over time this cultivar became dominant and rightly so. Growth is very strong and pendulous. Ao shidare will tolerate full sun better than most green dissectum cultivars but could still benefit from some shade in hotter climates. Fall color is wonderful if not predictable, sometimes mostly yellow, other times mostly orange but usually a showy mix of both. 10 Year Size: Height: 3-6 Feet Width: 4-8 Feet

descriptions.preferred: This plant is quite similar to 'Shinobuga oka', except that it is more pendulous in habit and rarely grows taller than 2.5 m. The branches tend to droop and give a round bush effect, in contrast to the other members of the Linearilobum Group which tend to be upright. The deep green leaves are mostly seven lobed. The lobes are very long and narrow like a blade of grass, and about 3-5 mm wide and up to 8 cm long. They turn yellow in the fall, sometimes to a deep gold. Japan as 'Ao meshime-no-uchi shidare'.

rhs.description: A deciduous, upright Japanese maple, about 3-4m tall, of twiggy growth, with long slender usually 5-lobed bright but dark green leaves, sometimes 3 or 7 lobes to 9cm long, holds its colour through spring and summer then turns yellow in autumn; suited to bonsai training

attributes.suggested_uses: City/Courtyard Gardens, Cottage/Informal Garden, Flower borders and beds, Patio/Container Plants
attributes.hort_group_description: Acers in this linearilobum group have long, narrow, strap-like lobes, with lightly serrated edges

care.cultivation: Grow in any moisture-retentive, well-drained soil in a sheltered position. Leaf colour is best in partial shade, although full sun can be tolerated if soil is reliably moist. Leaf scorch can be caused by lack of soil moisture or excessive exposure. See Japanese maples cultivation
care.pruning: Pruning group 1 , only from late autumn to mid-winter
care.propagation: Propagate by softwood cuttings, layering or by grafting . Plants grown from seed are unlikely to come true, but may still be garden worthy

resistance.pest: May be susceptible to aphids and scale insects , including horse chestnut scale
resistance.disease: May be susceptible to Verticillium wilt , Acer leaf scorch and honey fungus

rhs_zh.description: 落叶性、直立型日本枫，株高约 3–4 米，枝条细密。叶片细长，通常为 5 裂，色泽明亮而偏深绿，有时为 3 裂或 7 裂，叶长可达 9 厘米；春夏季能较好保持叶色，秋季转黄。适合做盆景培养。

attributes.suggested_uses: 城市庭院花园、乡村风或自然式花园、花境与花坛、庭院容器栽培
attributes.hort_group_description: 此 linearilobum 组的槭树具有细长、带状的裂片，叶缘具浅锯齿。

care.cultivation: 宜栽于保水且排水良好的土壤中，并选择避风位置。半阴环境下叶色表现最佳；若土壤湿度稳定，也可耐全日照。土壤缺水或暴露过度都可能导致叶片焦边。参见 Japanese maples cultivation。
care.pruning: 修剪组 1，仅限晚秋至仲冬期间修剪。
care.propagation: 可通过嫩枝扦插、压条或嫁接繁殖。实生苗通常难以保持品种性状，但仍可能具有园艺观赏价值。

descriptions_zh.preferred: 该品种与 ‘Shinobuga oka’ 十分相似，但株形更为下垂，且高度很少超过 2.5 米。枝条倾向下垂，形成圆拱形灌丛效果；这与 Linearilobum Group 其他通常较直立的成员形成对比。叶片深绿色，多为七裂。裂片极长而狭，形如草叶，宽约 3–5 毫米，长可达 8 厘米。秋季转黄，有时呈深金黄色。在日本称作 ‘Ao meshime-no-uchi shidare’。

descriptions.preferred: This good, strong dwarf shrub has large seven-lobed leaves. In fact, the leaves are surprisingly large for a dwarf. Strong growth produces foliage 7 cm long and more than 11 cm wide. The long lobes radiate out well, with the leaf base somewhat truncate. The lobes are strongly ovate-lanceolate with long, tapering points, separated two-thirds of the way to the leaf base, and are well notched at the margins. Old wood inside the plant produces somewhat smaller leaves. The color of the foliage is strong green with bronzed edges and tips, and the texture is neither weak nor thin. Fall color is yellow with reddish hues but not outstanding. High fertility causes excessively long shoots, making for unbalanced plants. When grown with moderate moisture and fertility, the leaf nodes become more compressed along the shoots. This cultivar enjoys some popularity with bonsai enthusiasts and has been widely used for this purpose. It is also attractive in the right place as a dwarf in the landscape. 'Aoba jo' has been known under the names 'Aoba bo' and 'Aoba cho'. It has also been spelled 'Aoba joh'.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这是一种优良而健壮的矮生灌木，具大型七裂叶。事实上，就矮生品种而言，其叶片大得令人惊讶。生长旺盛时，叶长可达 7 厘米以上，叶宽可超过 11 厘米。细长的裂片向外舒展良好，叶基部略呈截形。裂片为明显的卵状披针形，先端长渐尖，裂至叶基约三分之二处，边缘具明显缺刻。植株内部老枝所生叶片则略小。叶色为浓绿色，叶缘与叶尖带古铜色，叶质不薄弱，也不纤细。秋色为带红调的黄色，但并不十分出众。肥力过高会导致新梢徒长，使株形失衡。在中等湿度和肥力条件下栽培时，枝条上的叶节会更为紧凑。该品种颇受盆景爱好者欢迎，并已广泛用于盆景栽培。在景观中，如配置得当，也是一种出色的矮生品种。‘Aoba jo’ 也曾以 ‘Aoba bo’ 和 ‘Aoba cho’ 之名流通，另也拼作 ‘Aoba joh’。

products.title: Acer palmatum 'Aoba jo' Japanese Maple
products.description_text: Acer palmatum 'Aoba jo' Beautiful Green Dwarf Japanese Maple Zones 5-8 ‘Aoba jo’ is a unique dwarf Japanese maple with tight internodes. Yes, the overall shape is very “Mikawa-like”. The leaves are less elongated than ‘Mikawa yatsubusa’, and are rounder. The leaves on ‘Aoba jo’ are less uniform, as some leaves are flat while other leaves may cup downward slightly. In the spring, ‘Aoba jo’ leafs out as a bronze, turning to bronze red-tipping by mid-spring on a brighter chartreuse leaf. By late spring the leaves mature to a dark green. In the fall, ‘Aoba jo’ turns to a bright yellow with orange to red highlights. ‘Aoba jo’ may reach 3-4 ft in height and width in 10 years. Give ‘Aoba jo’ protection from the hot afternoon sun for best growth. Limited Quantities Available !! As we have over a thousand cultivars of Japanese maples, we often do not have many of each cultivar. We recommend that you buy the Japanese maples you want immediately as we often sell out of certain selections. Photo by Agustin Coello-Vera

descriptions.preferred: The name means "yellow-green brocade," but this cultivar seems to be rather shy in its display of variegation. halfway to the leaf base. The variegations are creamy yellow and in small sections of the leaf. Occasionally, the light areas occupy almost the entire leaf. However, most leaves are not variegated. This plant eventually forms a short, broad tree of up to 3 m high. It is not a strong, vigorous grower or a bold plant in the garden landscape. No trace of the name 'Aocha nishiki' as an Acer palmatum cultivar can be found in the Japanese literature, so it is possible the true name may be 'Aoba nishiki', a very similar cultivar in Japan. There are much better similar variegated cultivars, such as the reliable 'Asahi zuru'. The cultivars 'Siecha' and 'Siecha nishiki' (misspelled 'Seika nishiki') are so similar that they are treated as synonymous to 'Aocha nishiki'.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 其名称意为“黄绿色锦”，但这一品种在斑锦表现上似乎相当含蓄。斑纹可延伸至接近叶片基部的一半处。斑色为奶油黄色，通常只分布在叶片的小块区域。偶尔浅色部分几乎占据整片叶，但多数叶片并不具斑。该植株最终会形成一株矮而开展的小乔木，高可达 3 米。其生长势不强，在园林景观中也不算十分醒目。日本文献中找不到将 'Aocha nishiki' 作为 Acer palmatum 品种名的记载，因此其真实名称有可能是日本中一个非常相似的品种 'Aoba nishiki'。与之相近但更优良的斑叶品种还有不少，例如性状稳定的 'Asahi zuru'。'Siecha' 与 'Siecha nishiki'（常误拼作 'Seika nishiki'）极为相似，因此通常被视为 'Aocha nishiki' 的同物异名。

products.title: Acer palmatum 'Aocha nishiki' Japanese Maple
products.description_text: Acer palmatum 'Aocha nishiki' Rare Aocha nishiki Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 Aocha nishiki is a beautiful green Japanese maple that leafs out with bright chartreuse green new growth with a red border which matures to a rich green. Summer flushes of new growth are chartreuse green as well. “Aocha” translates as a yellow-green color. “Nishiki” can often refer to having variegation. Every once in a while you might spot yellow speckled variegation show up on new growth of mature specimens of this Japanese maple but the primary feature is the red tipping on the new growth. For us, the beauty in this Japanese maple is the brilliant orange fall color. We highly recommend using this Japanese maple for fall color planting. Aocha nishiki will reach 8ft in height and width in 15 years. Limited Quantities Available !! As we have over a thousand cultivars of Japanese maples, we often do not have many of each cultivar. descriptions.preferred: Ao means "green" and yagi is the Japanese name of a coral species, so the name of this cultivar means "green coral." The bright pea-green color of the bark on twigs, small branches, and limbs is the outstanding feature of this cultivar and gives it its name. It is sometimes referred to as the green counterpart of 'Sango kaku'. The green foliage is typical palmatum type with fiveorseven-lobedleavesabout5cmlongandwide.Thelobes radiate outward, separate two-thirds of the way to the shoots. While this is an upright-growing tree, it is not quite as vigorous as 'Sango kaku'. It becomes a wide-topped tree reaching 6-8 m tall as it matures. The brilliance of the bark is surprising for a green tone. When planted near the contrasting 'Sango kaku', the effect is pleasing. The stem colors are most intense during the winter season. A snowfall enhances the beauty of this cultivar by emphasizing the bark color. 'Ukon' appears to be similar in leaf, color, habit, and size. Although it originated from a different clone than the one from which 'Aoyagi' originated—both names are found in old Japanese literature—no differences between the two cultivars have been observed, so it seems reasonabletoincludeitunder'Aoyagi'.'Aoyagi'canalsobefound misspelled 'Ao gaki'. 'Ukon' is sometimes called 'Ukon nishiki' or misspelled 'Yukon'.

descriptions_zh.preferred: Ao 的意思是“绿色”，yagi 是一种珊瑚的日文名称，因此这个品种名可理解为“绿色珊瑚”。该品种最突出的特征，也是名称来源，是其嫩枝、小枝和主枝上鲜亮的豌豆绿色树皮。它有时被称为 'Sango kaku' 的绿色对应品种。叶片为典型的 palmatum 型，绿色，通常 5 至 7 裂，叶长和叶宽约 5 cm。裂片向外辐射，分裂深度约达叶基部的三分之二。虽然这是一个直立生长的树形，但长势不如 'Sango kaku' 那样强健。成熟后树冠开展，顶部较宽，株高可达 6-8 m。其绿色调树皮的鲜明程度令人惊讶。若与形成对比的 'Sango kaku' 相邻种植，观赏效果很好。枝干颜色在冬季最为浓烈；降雪会进一步衬托树皮色彩，增强其美感。'Ukon' 在叶形、颜色、株型和大小上似乎与其相近。虽然它来源于与 'Aoyagi' 不同的克隆，且这两个名称都见于日本早期文献，但目前未观察到两者之间有差异，因此将其并入 'Aoyagi' 似乎是合理的。'Aoyagi' 也可见误写作 'Ao gaki'。'Ukon' 有时也被称为 'Ukon nishiki'，或误写作 'Yukon'。

rhs_zh.description: 落叶乔木，树形直立、树冠宽阔，株高约 8 米；树皮与枝条呈醒目的豌豆绿色，且在冬季色彩最为浓烈。叶鲜绿色，5 裂，长宽各约 5 厘米，叶缘具锯齿，先端渐尖至长而锐尖；秋季转为深黄色。春季开不显眼的小型紫红色花，下垂成簇；随后结带红晕的翅果。

descriptions.preferred: Normally,cultivarsof Acer palmatumarechosenforsome outstanding feature of the foliage. However, in this case, it is the interesting bark, hence the plant's alternative nameof 'RoughBarkMaple'.Thename'Arakawa'means "rough bark" and is also the name of a river outside Tokyo. The bark of the cultivar is quite roughened and corky,withlongitudinalcreasesandalsoshortcracksand irregularitiesacrossthesurface.Itisnotasdeeplyfissured as 'Nishiki gawa'. New propagates do not show this feature for three to five years, at which time the roughening beginsanddevelopsmorerapidlyeachyear.Othernames used for this cultivar are 'Ganseki momiji' and 'Nishiki sho'. The word nishiki usually indicates variegated foliage but, in this case, refers to the rough bark feature. The green foliage is typically palmatum in shape. The five or seven lobes are narrowly ovate, tapering gradually to a long, slender point. They radiate outward and are separated three-quarters of the way to the leaf base. The margins are double toothed. The leaves range from 4 to 7 cm long and 5-7 cm wide. The fall color is yellow gold. The red petioles are slender and 3-5 cm long. This vigorous, upright plant matures at over 8 m. Young plants can produce shoots more than 1 m long in a season. However, they also dwarf well for bonsai use This highly desirable dwarf shrub has bright red foliage varying from a brick red to a light purple red. It is difficult to describe except that it is a pleasant color and is showy. The larger, older leaves carry the darkest tones, while the new foliage is more bright red during growth. Under these colors is a base of strong green which often shows through along the midribs of the lobes and adds an interesting two-tone effect. As the plant goes into the heatofmidsummer,moreandmoregreenshowsthrough. Leaf size is fairly uniform, except that those on new vigorous shoots are the largest. Most leaves are 5-6 cm long and wide. The five or seven lobes are long-ovate with long tapering points and have well-serrated margins. The lobes join more than two-thirds of the way to the leaf base which is truncate. The petioles are short. Another unusual feature is that in a majority of leaves, the center lobe (usually the largest) is often shortened and only one-third to one-half the length of those on either side. Newer leaves often display this feature as well. Shortened center lobes are a characteristic of cultivars derived from witches'-brooms. The growth is fairly short, even under intense culture, and produces a round, dense, twiggy, shrubby plant. The leaves lie rather flat along the twigs. This shrub slowly reaches 1-1.5 m tall in 10 years. 'Aratama', whose name means "uncut gem," is among the most desirable shrubs for the small garden landscape because it is one of the few dwarfs not in the usual green colors. It takes full sunlight very well. cially attractive and noticeable, with yellow green veining on pastel shades of light orange-pink-red marbled background. This gradually changes through the summer to become red-veined on a purplish red background by late summer, with the undersurfaces becoming purplish green. In the fall, the colors of the leaves return to the orange-pink-red marbling with a deeper pink red spreading inward from the margins, while the network of veins remains yellow green. This cultivar also has attractive green young stems with fine, closely packed glaucous striations and lovely red fruits. The large fiveor seven-lobed, rarely nine-lobed, variegated leaves are very deeply cut and are 7-8.5 cm long and 5.5-7.5 cm wide. The lobes are narrowly ovate with narrow tail-like tips, 4-6 cm long and 1-1.5 cm wide at the broadest point about one-third to halfway, narrowing to 5-10 mm at the lobe junctions, less than 1 cm from the leaf base. The central lobe occasionally has a short truncated tip, similar to that found in many dwarf cultivars propagated from witches'-brooms. The lobes are widely spread with the small basal lobes angled backward and outward. The margins are coarsely double toothed, the teeth having very sharp-pointed tips. The strong pink to red petioles are 1.5-4 cm long and have swollen bases.

rhs_zh.description: 生长健壮、树形直立的落叶乔木，高约 4-5 米；植株在栽培 5 年后树皮会形成显著的粗糙木栓质表皮，且随树龄增长愈发明显。叶较小，掌状 5 裂，裂片细裂，绿色，秋季转为金黄色和橙色。

descriptions_zh.preferred: 通常，Acer palmatum 的栽培品种多因叶色或叶形的突出特征而被选育；但此品种的特色在于其颇具观赏性的树皮，因此又有“Rough Bark Maple”之称。‘Arakawa’意为“粗树皮”，同时也是东京郊外一条河流的名字。该品种的树皮明显粗糙并带木栓质，具有纵向皱裂，也有横向的短裂纹与不规则起伏，但裂纹不如 ‘Nishiki gawa’ 那样深。新繁殖植株通常需 3 至 5 年才会显现这一特征，之后粗糙化会逐年加快发展。此品种另有 ‘Ganseki momiji’ 与 ‘Nishiki sho’ 等别名。nishiki 一词通常表示斑叶，但在这里指的是粗树皮特征。其叶片为典型的 palmatum 类叶形，绿色。叶多为 5 或 7 裂，裂片狭卵形，渐尖成细长尖端，向外放射展开，分裂深度达叶基的约四分之三。叶缘为重锯齿。叶长 4 至 7 厘米，宽 5 至 7 厘米。秋色为金黄色。叶柄红色，细长，长 3 至 5 厘米。植株生长势强，直立，成熟后可超过 8 米。幼株单季新梢可生长超过 1 米。不过，它也很适合矮化用于盆景制作。 这一极受欢迎的矮生灌木叶色鲜红，色调介于砖红至浅紫红之间。其色彩难以准确描述，但整体观感柔和悦目且十分醒目。较大、较老的叶片颜色最深，而新叶在生长期则更为鲜亮偏红。这些红色之下带有较强的绿色底色，常沿裂片主脉显现，形成有趣的双色效果。至盛夏高温期，绿色会逐渐更多地显露出来。叶片大小相当整齐，仅强旺新梢上的叶片较大。多数叶片长宽约 5 至 6 厘米。叶多为 5 或 7 裂，裂片长卵形，先端长渐尖，叶缘具明显锯齿。裂片分离深度超过叶基的三分之二，叶基平截。叶柄较短。另一个不寻常之处是，多数叶片的中央裂片（通常最大）常明显缩短，仅为两侧裂片长度的三分之一至二分之一。新叶也常表现出这一特征。中央裂片缩短，是许多来源于丛生枝变异（witches'-brooms）品种的典型特征。其枝条生长较短，即使在强化栽培条件下也是如此，因此形成圆整、紧密、多小枝的灌木状株形。叶片较平展地贴生于枝条上。10 年后株高缓慢达到 1 至 1.5 米。‘Aratama’意为“未经切琢的宝石”，因其并非普通绿色系矮生品种，而被认为是小型庭园景观中极具价值的灌木之一；其对全日照的适应性也很好。 其叶色尤为醒目迷人，浅橙粉红至红色的大理石状底色上分布黄绿色叶脉。入夏后，这种色彩逐渐转变，到夏末成为紫红色底上带红色叶脉，叶背则转为紫绿色。秋季叶色又回到橙粉红红色的大理石纹效果，且更深的粉红红色自叶缘向内扩展，而脉网仍保持黄绿色。该品种还具有观赏性很强的绿色幼枝，枝表带细密的粉霜状条纹，并结有美丽的红色果实。叶片大型，具 5 或 7 裂，极少 9 裂，且为斑叶，分裂极深；叶长 7 至 8.5 厘米，宽 5.5 至 7.5 厘米。裂片狭卵形，先端狭长如尾状，裂片长 4 至 6 厘米，在约三分之一至二分之一处最宽，为 1 至 1.5 厘米，向下渐缩，到裂片结合处仅 5 至 10 毫米，该结合处距叶基不足 1 厘米。中央裂片偶尔具短平截先端，这一点与许多由丛生枝变异繁殖的矮生品种相似。各裂片开展较宽，基部小裂片向后外展。叶缘具粗大的重锯齿，齿端十分尖锐。叶柄粉红至红色，粗壮，长 1.5 至 4 厘米，基部膨大。

products.description_text: Acer palmatum 'Arakawa' 'Arakawa' Rough Bark Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 Arakawa is an upright green Japanese maple with a fantastic ruff and corky bark look to older growth. Arakawa can reach 10 ft in ten years maturing at 20 ft tall over time. Fall color is a bright orange-red. With the added winter interest of the corky bark, Arakawa is provides year-round interest to the garden and landscape. descriptions_zh.preferred: 荒皮系品种，以较早形成的粗糙木栓化树皮著称，冬季观赏性尤其突出。叶片为典型掌状叶，生长期以绿色为主，适合重视树皮质感与四季变化的庭院种植。
荒皮系品种，兼具粗糙树皮与柔和叶色观赏性。树皮会随树龄增长而逐渐木栓化开裂；春叶常带黄绿色调，随后转绿，秋季呈现温暖的黄色到橙色。

descriptions.preferred: This highly desirable dwarf shrub has small bright red foliage varying from brick-red in the older leaves to light purple-red in the new leaves. During the summer a green tinge often appears along the midribs, giving an interesting two-tone effect. The five to seven leaf lobes are long-ovate with long, tapering points and well-toothed margins. The moderately deeply divided leaves have flat bases, and the center lobes are often shortened. Originating as a witches' broom of 'Koi murasaki', this cultivar forms a round, dense, twiggy, shrubby plant with the leaves lying rather flat along the twigs. It Acer reaches 3-5 ft. (1-1.5 m) tall in 10 years and is suitable for the small garden landscape. It takes full sun very well. The name means "uncut gem."

sources.title: Aratama-Acer palmatum 'Aratama'
sources.description: "Aratama"— 荒玉是一款可爱的矮生的紧凑型日本枫树，自然成球的树型长势非常适合花园，阳台种植。成年树高约1.5米。 "Aratama"源自"Ko murasaki"，因其浓密、短而紧密的分枝而备受青睐。"Aratama"在日语中的意思是"未切割的宝石"。 春季早发叶，新叶为鲜红色到了春末逐渐变成酒红色，如果种植在遮荫处，为青铜绿色；夏季返绿，秋天橙红色。

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这种极受欢迎的矮生灌木，叶片较小，色泽鲜红，老叶呈砖红色，新叶呈浅紫红色。夏季时主脉附近常会泛出绿色，形成有趣的双色效果。叶片通常5至7裂，裂片为长卵形，先端细长渐尖，叶缘具明显锯齿。叶片中等偏深裂，叶基平展，中间裂片常较短。该品种源自 'Koi murasaki' 的丛生变异（witches' broom），植株呈圆形、紧密、枝条细密的灌木状，叶片较平展地贴伏于小枝上。10 年内可长至 3-5 英尺（1-1.5 米）高，适合小型庭园栽植。对全日照的耐受性很好。其名称意为“未经切琢的宝石”。

descriptions.preferred: Like other members of the 'Shigitatsu sawa' group of cultivars, 'Ariadne' has marbled leaves in contrasting colors to the network of veins. New growth is especially attractive with yellow-green veining on a light orange-pink-red marbled background. Leaf color gradually changes to become red-veined on a purplish-red background by late summer. In the fall, the veins are yellow-green on an orange-pinkred marbled background with a deeper pink-red Acer spreading inward from the margins. This cultivar Gregory. also has attractive green young stems with fine, closely packed glaucous striations and lovely red fruits. The large fiveto seven-lobed leaves are very deeply cut. The narrowly ovate lobes have tail-like tips and coarsely, sharply pointed toothed margins. 'Ariadne' matures to a shrub 10 ft. (3 m) tall and at least as wide. The name honors a granddaughter of D. M. van Gelderen, whose nursery introduced this plant.

sources.title: 女神/阿里阿德 Acer Palmatum 'Ariadne'
sources.description: 阿里阿德涅由荷兰埃斯维尔德苗圃引进，以科尔的女儿命名，简称为阿里阿德。阿里阿德涅是一款非常经典的脉叶品种，叶片上的叶脉清晰，结构像一个迷宫，在希腊神话中，女神阿里阿德涅恰好是迷宫的女主人，所以在国内也称它为女神。 初春时节，新叶是粉红色、橙色和黄色的，每片叶子都有明亮的绿色叶脉，叶子在夏季变为浅绿色，光照良好的条件下还会保留一部分粉色，与深绿色叶脉形成鲜明的对比，秋天整棵树上的叶子会变成火红色，然后在落叶前转变为红色。一般为 5-7 叶裂，叶裂较深，叶形是狭窄的卵状，叶边缘有比较明显且锋利的锯齿，成年树高约 3m 左右。 阿里阿德涅因其随着季节不断变化的色彩而备受赞誉，环境不同色彩表现差别较大，甚至在同一棵树上，由于光照条件不同，色彩层次也很鲜明。加之长势较好，在花园、庭院中经常扮演着非常重要的角色。作为抗性色彩兼优的品种，非常推荐，相信它必定会吸引所有人的注意。

descriptions_zh.preferred: 与 'Shigitatsu sawa' 品种群的其他成员一样，'Ariadne' 的叶片具有大理石般的斑纹，叶脉网络与叶面底色形成鲜明对比。新梢尤其美观，在浅橙粉红至红色的大理石纹底色上分布着黄绿色叶脉。到夏末，叶色逐渐变化为紫红色底上带红色叶脉。秋季时，叶脉呈黄绿色，底色为橙粉红色大理石纹，且有更深的粉红红色自叶缘向内扩展。该品种还具有迷人的绿色幼枝，其上有细密排列的粉白色条纹，并结有美丽的红色果实。叶片较大，通常为 5 至 7 裂，裂刻很深；裂片狭卵形，先端呈尾状，叶缘具粗而尖锐的锯齿。'Ariadne' 成熟后为灌木，高约 10 英尺（3 米），冠幅至少相当。其名称是为纪念 D. M. van Gelderen 的一位孙女，该植物由其苗圃引种推出。

descriptions.preferred: This upright form has is reported to be a seedling from the well-known 'Nomura'. Its leaf shape is more or less identical, which makes it very difficult to distinguish from 'Nomura'. The distinguishing feature is a slightly different tone of red. 'Ariake nomura' is a little more brown red in its spring color, a lighter purplish redbronze in late summer, and a bright crimson when the fall colors appear. It is not widely found in collections or nurseries.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 该直立型品种据称是著名品种 'Nomura' 的实生后代。其叶形与 'Nomura' 大体相同，因此极难区分。主要区别在于红色调略有不同。'Ariake nomura' 春季叶色略偏棕红，夏末转为较浅的紫红铜色，秋色出现时则为鲜亮的深绯红色。该品种在收藏和苗圃中并不常见。

descriptions.preferred: Asahi means "the dawn" or "rising sun" and zuru means "swan." Hence, the name of this cultivar can be interpreted as "the dawn swan." 'Asahi zuru' is among the dependable cultivars with sharply defined and clear variegation. The white portions have distinct and sharp margins, and the green portions are a rich green. The leaves vary considerably in markings on each plant. Some, especially the smaller leaves, are almost entirely white, while others are almost completely green with only one small patch of white. Some leaves have only minute flecks of white or pink. Solid green leaves occur Corvallis shaped lobes when containing white sections. The petioles range up to 6 cm long and vary from pink on some leaves to green on the normal-colored leaves. Twigs and small branches are dark green and do not have the pink striping often present in the similar 'Oridono nishiki'. This upright but spreading, round-headed tree grows rather fast as a young plant. As it becomes older, growth slows down and becomes more compact. It can reach 8 m high and 3-4 m wide. Multistemmed trees are quite striking in appearance. New growth occasionally is typically palmatum, but as the wood becomes two years old and older, the variegation develops well. This hardy form is desirable in many landscape situations. Afternoon shade helps prevent excessive leaf burn, as it does for all variegates. 'Asahi zuru' has been known under the alternative names of 'Asahi nomura' and 'Asahi beni zuru'. It has also been misspelled and misnamed 'Asahi juru', 'Asahi kaede', and 'Asaji'.

descriptions_zh.preferred: Asahi 意为“晨曦”或“朝阳”，zuru 意为“天鹅”。因此，这个品种名可理解为“晨曦之鹅”。'Asahi zuru' 是斑叶表现稳定可靠的品种之一，斑纹界线清晰鲜明。白色部分边缘分明锐利，绿色部分则为浓绿。每株植株上叶片的斑纹变化很大。有些叶片，尤其较小的叶片，几乎通体白色；而另一些则几乎全绿，仅带一小块白斑。有些叶片只带有极细小的白色或粉色斑点。也会出现全绿色叶片。带白色斑块的叶片裂片形态通常较为典型。叶柄最长可达 6 厘米，颜色因叶而异，有些为粉色，正常色叶片则为绿色。小枝和细枝为深绿色，不具有与其相似品种 'Oridono nishiki' 常见的粉色条纹。该树虽为直立型，但树冠开展、呈圆头状，幼龄时期生长较快；随着树龄增加，生长速度减缓，株形也更紧凑。可高达 8 米，冠幅 3-4 米。多干丛生植株观赏效果尤为出众。新梢有时起初表现为典型的 palmatum 型，但木质部达到两年生及以上时，斑叶特征会发展得更好。该品种耐寒，适合多种园林景观应用。与所有斑叶品种一样，下午适当遮阴有助于防止叶片过度焦边。'Asahi zuru' 也曾以别名 'Asahi nomura' 和 'Asahi beni zuru' 流通。它还曾被误拼或误称为 'Asahi juru'、'Asahi kaede' 和 'Asaji'。

'Asayake' is a selection by our good friend and former president of the American Conifer Society, Neil "Ramsey" Fusillo. The name 'Asayake' means "the colors of sunrise". Fall colors typically range from bright oranges to red. 'Asayake' is fairly heat tolerant. Typically grows to about 6-8 ft in height and 5-7 ft in width over 10 years. descriptions.preferred: This cultivar has dark black-red foliage when in its prime in the early season. It may bronze out with greenish undertones later in the season, especially in full sun. The leaf has five, or sometimes seven, lobes, widely separated, verynarrow,anddividedcompletelytothebase.Themidrib of each lobe is green. The lobes of leaves on mature Corvallis plant might be classed as a tall shrub rather than a small tree, reaching a height of 4 m. It is a very desirable form, contrasting with the more round-headed cultivars in the Linearilobum Group, such as 'Red Pygmy' and 'Villa Taranto'. 'Atrolineare' has been known under the names 'Akano-hichi gosan', 'Aka-no-shichi gosan', 'Aka shime-nouchi', 'Aome-no-udu, 'Blood Vein', 'Filifera Purpurea', 'Filiferum Purpureum', 'Linearilobum Atropurpureum', 'Linearilobum Purpureum', 'Linearilobum Rubrum', 'Pendulum Angustilobum', 'Pendulum Angustilobum Atropurpureum', 'Pendulum Atropurpureum', 'Purpureum Angustilobum', 'Scolopendrifolium Purpureum', and 'Scolopendrifolium Rubrum'. A number of slightly different red linearilobum clones are named as 'Angustilobum' and 'Angustilobum Purpureum' in several Dutch nurseries. This is confusing and misleading so, as there are alternative named cultivars as good as or better, such as 'Atrolineare', thesenames should be dropped.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 该品种在生长季早期状态最佳时，叶色呈深黑红色。季节后期可能转为带绿色底调的古铜色，尤其是在全日照条件下更为明显。叶片有 5 裂，有时 7 裂，裂片分离较大，极狭长，并一直深裂至叶基。每个裂片的中脉为绿色。Corvallis 栽培的成熟植株，其叶裂片可能会被归为 Linearilobum Group 中较高大的灌木状类型，而非小乔木，高度可达 4 m。它是一个非常优良的类型，与 Linearilobum Group 中冠形更圆的品种，如 'Red Pygmy' 和 'Villa Taranto'，形成鲜明对比。'Atrolineare' 还曾以 'Akano-hichi gosan'、'Aka-no-shichi gosan'、'Aka shime-nouchi'、'Aome-no-udu'、'Blood Vein'、'Filifera Purpurea'、'Filiferum Purpureum'、'Linearilobum Atropurpureum'、'Linearilobum Purpureum'、'Linearilobum Rubrum'、'Pendulum Angustilobum'、'Pendulum Angustilobum Atropurpureum'、'Pendulum Atropurpureum'、'Purpureum Angustilobum'、'Scolopendrifolium Purpureum' 及 'Scolopendrifolium Rubrum' 等名称流通。若干略有差异的红叶线裂型克隆，在一些荷兰苗圃中被命名为 'Angustilobum' 和 'Angustilobum Purpureum'。这种做法容易造成混淆和误导；既然已有像 'Atrolineare' 这样同样优秀甚至更优的正式命名品种，这些名称应予停用。

descriptions.preferred: The red tones of the leaves distinguish this cultivar as a form of Acer palmatum. The leaves have five or seven lobes and vary from 4 to10 cm long and wide. The lobes separate two-thirds to three-quarters of the way to the leaf base and are ovate to ovate-lanceolate with pointed tips Corvallis erly be named Acer palmatum f. atropurpureum. The original plant of this name was probably an excellent clone originating from the old nursery of Constant Wattez in Woudenberg, Netherlands (van Gelderen et al. 1994). It forms a well-branched tree 8-10 m tall. The leaves are mainly five lobed and a rich purple in the spring, which becomes deeper in early summer and turns to a brilliant scarlet in the fall. However, because many nurseries have used this name for any red-leaved seedling selection, it has become so diluted as to be meaningless. It is from such red seedlings that many outstanding cultivars have been selected, such as 'Shoj\ o'\, 'Nuresagi', and later 'Bloodgood' and 'Moonfire'. Propagators continue to select red seedlings with the aim of naming new cultivars. However, there are so many red-leaved cultivars named and marketed, there is a risk of more confusion and loading the market with even more "names." This should be avoided unless the new selection has outstanding or unusual desirable characteristics. 'Atropurpureum' has been called 'Blood Leaf'.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 该品种叶片的红色调表明它属于 Acer palmatum 的一个红叶类型。叶片具 5 或 7 个裂片，叶长和叶宽约 4-10 cm。裂片分裂深度约达叶基部的三分之二至四分之三，形状为卵形至卵状披针形，先端尖锐。Corvallis 的记载中指出，它早期可被命名为 Acer palmatum f. atropurpureum。这个名称最初对应的植株，很可能是一个优良克隆，来源于荷兰 Woudenberg 的 Constant Wattez 老苗圃（van Gelderen et al. 1994）。它可形成分枝良好的树形，高 8-10 m。叶片多为 5 裂，春季呈浓郁紫红色，初夏颜色加深，秋季转为鲜亮猩红色。然而，由于许多苗圃将该名称泛用于任何红叶实生选株，这一名称已被严重泛化，几乎失去实际意义。正是在这些红叶实生苗中，后来选出了许多优秀品种，如 'Shojo'、'Nuresagi'，以及更晚出现的 'Bloodgood' 和 'Moonfire'。繁殖者至今仍持续从红叶实生苗中筛选材料并试图命名新品种。然而，市场上已存在大量被命名和销售的红叶品种，继续如此只会带来更多混淆，并使市场充斥更多“名称”。除非新的选株具有非常突出的或不寻常的优良特性，否则应避免这样做。'Atropurpureum' 也曾被称作 'Blood Leaf'。

descriptions.preferred: This cultivar was imported into the Netherlands from Japan in 1970, and a few years later from there into the United States via Maplewood Nursery as 'Atropurpureum Superbum'. Because the mixture of Latin and English results in illegitimate names under the international nomenclatural rules, the name was changed to 'Attraction'. This cultivar is a seedling selection. Its color is deeper and holds better than the usual seedlings of The seven-lobed, occasionally five-lobed, leaves separate to within 2 cm or so of the leaf base. The lobes are long-ovate and the outer ends gradually taper to a sharp point. The inner third of the margin is rather smooth, while the outer two-thirds is sharply and regularly toothed. Leaf size ranges from 6 to 9 cm long and up to 11 cm wide. The stiff, red petioles are 4-5 cm long. The leaves are a deep purple red or maroon in color. Tones are brightest on new leaves and then become deeper in summer. The color, though not quite as deep as that of 'Bloodgood', holds almost as well, but burns in hot locations. The leaves turn a bright crimson in the fall.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 该品种于 1970 年自日本引入荷兰，数年后又由 Maplewood Nursery 从荷兰引入美国，最初名称为 'Atropurpureum Superbum'。由于拉丁文与英文混用，根据国际命名规则属于不合法名称，因此后改名为 'Attraction'。该品种为实生选育品种。其叶色比一般实生苗更深，且持色性更好。叶片通常 7 裂，偶有 5 裂，裂片可分离至距叶基约 2 厘米处。裂片为长卵形，外端渐尖成锐尖。叶缘内侧约三分之一较平滑，外侧约三分之二则具尖锐且整齐的锯齿。叶片长 6 至 9 厘米，宽可达 11 厘米。叶柄坚挺，为红色，长 4-5 厘米。叶色为深紫红或栗红色，新叶时期色泽最鲜明，入夏后颜色更深。其叶色虽不及 'Bloodgood' 那样深，但持色性几乎同样优秀，不过在炎热地区会发生焦叶。秋季叶片转为鲜亮的深红色。

products.title: Acer palmatum 'Attraction' Superbum Japanese Maple Tree
products.description_text: Acer palmatum 'Attraction' Rare “Superbum” Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 ‘Attraction’ is a bright red Japanese maple in the spring, maturing to deep maroon, then to a scarlet red in the fall. The overall habit is upright with a nice irregular symmetric form. According to Vertrees 4th edition, ‘Attraction’ is said to have been imported from Japan to the Netherlands in the 1970’s, eventually making its way to the United States via J.D. Vertrees himself. Since the imported name of “Atropurpureum Superbum” seemed silly as it was Latin for “a fabulous red form”, some began calling this tree ‘Superbum’, while others chose the name ‘Attraction’. Today you may find this tree under either name. This tree will grow to 12-15 ft within 15 years. Limited Quantities Available !! As we have over a thousand cultivars of Japanese maples, we often do not have many of each cultivar. We recommend that you buy the Japanese maples you want immediately as we often sell out of certain selections.

descriptions.preferred: The new foliage in the spring is not strongly variegated, being a rather uniform light green tone. However, the stronger variegation comes later in the fall. Small and indefinite markings of yellow or gold appear in the green background color. The variegation is not brilliant but discernible. However, the lack of "aureo" and "variegation" characteristics is disappointing. The leaves are five lobed with a truncate leaf base and good texture. They measure 5-6 cm long and about 6 cm wide. Each lobe is oblong, gradually terminating in a slender point. The lobes separate to within 1-2 cm of the leaf base. The margins are finely serrated on the outer half of the lobe. The petioles are firm, slightly reddish in color, and 2-3 cm long. This upright-growing tree does not get as tall as the species. Older trees are broadened at the top, not overly twiggy, and about 4 m high, but mature trees can reach 8 m. According to the literature, the name 'Aureo-variegatum' has been applied to more than one cultivar. One source considers it synonymous with 'Komon nishiki' (van Gelderen et al. 1994). Because 'Aureo-variegatum' is much larger and has deeper lobing, while 'Komon nishiki' grows to only 3 m, has lobes divided only up to two-thirds to the leaf base, and its variegation is more evident, these two are treated as separate cultivars here. 'Aureo-variegatum' has been known under the name 'Aureo-maculatum' and misspelled 'Aureum-variegatum'.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 春季新叶的斑锦性并不强，整体呈较均一的浅绿色调。然而，更明显的斑锦会在秋季后期出现。在绿色底色上可见小而不规则的黄色或金色斑纹。其斑锦并不十分鲜艳，但仍可辨识。不过，缺乏“aureo”和“variegation”应有的表现，多少令人失望。叶片为 5 裂，叶基平截，质地良好。叶长 5-6 厘米，宽约 6 厘米。各裂片为长圆形，逐渐收为细尖；裂片分离深度距叶基约 1-2 厘米。裂片外半部叶缘具细锯齿。叶柄坚挺，略带红色，长 2-3 厘米。该品种树形直立，但不如原种高大。老树顶部较开展，枝条不过分细密，高约 4 米，成熟植株可达 8 米。根据文献记载，名称 'Aureo-variegatum' 曾被用于不止一个品种。有资料将其视为 'Komon nishiki' 的异名（van Gelderen et al. 1994）。但由于 'Aureo-variegatum' 植株明显更大、裂刻更深，而 'Komon nishiki' 仅长至 3 米，裂片只分裂至接近叶基的三分之二处，且斑锦更为明显，因此这里将两者视为不同品种。'Aureo-variegatum' 也曾以 'Aureo-maculatum' 之名流传，并曾被误拼为 'Aureum-variegatum'。

descriptions.preferred: The distinctive yellow of this cultivar is quite dominant. However, there is an undertone of light green which becomes more noticeable in shady conditions. When the new foliage appears, the margins of the lobes have a slight tinge of rust-pink color which soon disappears. As the season progresses, the leaves age into a more pure light green, the "golden" tone softening. In plants grown at Maplewood, the yellow tones are even more pronounced as the second growth occurs in early August. This seasonal flush of growth is also more vigorous and quite often more branched. This cultivar does not have produces a display of bright yellow. The palmatum-type leaves are five lobed, sometimes seven lobed, and of medium size. The lobes extend outward, forming an almost circular leaf with a diameter of 5-6 cm. The margins are slightly toothed. The petioles are about 3 cm long. The petioles and shoots are bright red. The form of this plant is upright, bushy, and reaches up to 8 m at maturity. It tends toward a twiggy type of growth on older wood. It has also been known under the name 'Sunrise'.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 该品种最显著的特征是其鲜明的黄色，不过其中也带有浅绿色底调，在遮阴条件下会更加明显。新叶展开时，裂片边缘略带锈粉色，很快便会消退。随着季节推进，叶片逐渐转为更纯净的浅绿色，“金黄”调子随之变得柔和。在 Maplewood 栽培的植株上，8 月上旬第二次抽梢时黄色调会更加明显。这个季节性的生长高峰也更为旺盛，且往往分枝更多。该品种不会失去其黄色表现，而是能形成明亮的黄色观赏效果。叶片属 palmatum 型，通常 5 裂，有时 7 裂，中等大小。裂片向外展开，形成近圆形叶片，直径约 5-6 cm。叶缘略具锯齿。叶柄长约 3 cm。叶柄和新梢均为鲜红色。植株树形直立而浓密，成熟时可达 8 m。老枝上常表现出细密分枝的生长习性。它也曾以 'Sunrise' 这一名称流通。

descriptions.preferred: This green dissectum originated as a chance seedling in 1979, was propagated and introduced by Del's Japanese Maple Nursery, Eugene, Oregon, and registered in 1996. It differs from most green dissectums in being semi-erect, not the usual dome shape. The outstanding feature of this cultivar, as the name suggests, is that the medium green leaves turn a brilliant red in the fall. New growth is a light yellow green with pink edging, and makes an attractive contrast with the darker green older foliage. The large, very coarse, sevenor nine-lobed deeply divided leaves are 10-11 cm long and 11-13 cm wide. The lobes themselves are not as deeply divided as most laceabout 2 m high in 10 years, but spreads even wider.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这一绿色 dissectum 类型起源于 1979 年的一株偶发实生苗，由美国俄勒冈州尤金的 Del's Japanese Maple Nursery 繁殖并推广，于 1996 年完成登记。它与多数绿色 dissectum 品种不同之处在于株形为半直立，而非通常的圆拱形。正如其名称所示，该品种最突出的特点是中绿色叶片在秋季会转为鲜艳亮红色。新梢叶为浅黄绿色，边缘带粉色，与较深绿色的老叶形成悦目的对比。叶片较大、分裂很深，通常具 7 或 9 裂，质感较粗，长 10 至 11 厘米、宽 11 至 13 厘米。其裂片本身不像多数 laceleaf 类型那样分裂得极细。10 年后株高约 2 米，但冠幅扩展更宽。

descriptions.preferred: The outstanding feature of this interesting hybrid (A. × palmatum A. circinatum) introduced by Duncan and Davies Nursery of New Zealand is that the deep green summer foliage turns vivid shades of gold, orange, and red in the fall, even in New Zealand's mild climate. The seven- (or nine-) lobed medium-sized leaves of the Palmatum Group are divided halfway to three-quarters of the way to the leaf base and are 5-7.5 cm long and 6.5-9 cm wide. The broad oblong-ovate lobes are 2.5-3.5 cm long and 1.5-2 cm wide at the broadest point, narrowing slightly to 1-1.7 cm at the lobe junctions, which are 1.5-3.5 cm from the leaf base. The margins have large, coarse double teeth. The short pink red petioles are 2-2.5 cm long. This vigorous, upright grower has an estimated mature height of 6-8 m. 'Autumn Flame' was originally named 'Autumn Fire', but as there is a green dissectum already registered in that name, the cultivar name was changed to 'Autumn Flame'.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这一引人注目的杂交品种（A. × palmatum A. circinatum）由新西兰 Duncan and Davies Nursery 引入，其最突出的特点是：夏季深绿色叶片在秋季即使于新西兰温和气候下，也能转为鲜艳的金色、橙色与红色。其叶为 Palmatum Group 的中等大小叶片，具 7 裂（或 9 裂），分裂深度达叶基的二分之一至四分之三；叶长 5 至 7.5 厘米，宽 6.5 至 9 厘米。裂片宽长圆状卵形，长 2.5 至 3.5 厘米，在最宽处宽 1.5 至 2 厘米，向下略收窄，在裂片结合处宽 1 至 1.7 厘米；该结合处距叶基 1.5 至 3.5 厘米。叶缘具大而粗的重锯齿。叶柄短，粉红红色，长 2 至 2.5 厘米。植株生长势强，株形直立，预计成熟株高 6 至 8 米。‘Autumn Flame’ 最初命名为 ‘Autumn Fire’，但因该名称已被一个绿色 dissectum 品种登记使用，故后改名为 ‘Autumn Flame’。

descriptions.preferred: This Belgium cultivar is noted for its beautiful fall color display. The GLORY' typical, medium-sized leaves are deeply divided into five to seven lobes with coarsely toothed margins. Spring leaves are yellow-green with pink-red tinged margins, soon becoming medium green for summer, then turning brilliant crimson in the fall. 'Autumn Glory' forms a small broad upright-growing tree up to 20 ft. (6 m) tall.

sources.description: 非常著名的羽团扇品种，十九世纪 70 年代由 J.D.Vertrees 选育，和金隐Aureum为同代品种，秋月以叶色多变著称， 春叶为橙黄色和黄色，五月开始新抽稍为黄橙红色，与 绿色的老叶形成鲜明的对比，秋叶色彩丰富，有时候红 色，橙色，黄色会出现在同一张叶子上。长势偏慢，夏 季怕热，需要午后遮阴，直立生长，成年树可达 2 米， 在美国 Oregon 有树体达 4 米的秋月。

sources.name: Aureum Autumn Moon
sources.description: The Autumn Moon Japanese Maple is a stunning tree that offers year-round beauty with its unique foliage and striking form. This variety features large, rounded leaves with a beautiful blend of pale yellow and green tones in spring, which gradually change to vibrant shades of orange, gold, and red in the autumn, creating a fiery display of colour. The delicate, broad leaves and graceful branching make it a standout choice for adding texture and elegance to any landscape. Reaching a height of 3 to 4 meters, the Autumn Moon is an ideal choice for medium-sized gardens or as a specimen tree. Its vibrant autumn colour and attractive form make it a perfect focal point in your garden. Additionally, it is well-suited for container planting, making it a great choice for patios or smaller spaces. The Japanese Maple thrives in well-drained, slightly acidic soil and enjoys partial shade, making it relatively easy to care for. Once established, it is a low-maintenance tree that provides stunning seasonal changes and a unique look in your garden. At Herter Nursery, we carefully cultivate Autumn Moon Japanese Maples for sale to ensure strong, healthy growth. Shop today to bring the beauty and elegance of this exceptional tree into your landscape.

descriptions.preferred: 'Autumn Red' was selected in the Fratelli Gilardelli Nursery, near Milan, Italy, for its spectacular fall color. It forms a medium-sized shrub or small tree, reaching 4-5 cm tall. It is an upright form with an open crown. The newly emerging pink red leaves quickly turn a light greenish yellow with rose edging, and become a bright green through the summer. Then, as the name suggests, they turn a fiery red in the fall. The foliage can withstand full sun without damage. The large fiveor seven-lobed leaves, up to 10 cm long and 10-12 cm wide, are deeply divided to within 1 cm of the leaf base. The margins are coarsely but fairly evenly toothed. The petioles are bright red and up to 6 cm long.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 'Autumn Red' 由意大利米兰附近的 Fratelli Gilardelli Nursery 选育，以其极为出色的秋色著称。植株形成中型灌木或小乔木，高约 4-5 米。株形直立，树冠开展而疏朗。新叶初展时为粉红至红色，很快转为带玫瑰色叶缘的浅黄绿色，夏季则变为鲜绿色。随后如其名所示，秋季转为火焰般的鲜红色。叶片可在全日照下保持良好而不受灼伤。叶大，5 或 7 裂，长可达 10 厘米，宽 10-12 厘米，深裂至距叶基约 1 厘米处。叶缘具粗大而较整齐的锯齿。叶柄鲜红色，长可达 6 厘米。

descriptions.preferred: The name means "purple of the East," though Azuma could be an old name for Tokyo in this context. 'Toshi' has been used as an alternative name for this cultivar, but the descriptions in the Japanese literature do not seem to agree. Archives, Corvallis to a covering of fine pubescence which soon disappears. As midsummer arrives, the leaves alter to a deep green with a reddish cast to the surface. The undersides of the leaves develop a bright, shiny, smooth, green surface. The leaves are seven lobed, measuring 5-7 cm long with a spread of up to 9 cm. Each lobe separates widely from therest,islong,ovate-lanceolate,andhasdefinitetoothed margins. The petioles are a bright red most of the season. 'Azuma murasaki' is not a tall-growing cultivar. Early growth is fairly rapid but slows down as the years pass. The short tree form reaches 6 m high and becomes ratherround-toppedandabout5mwide.Outsideshoots take on a cascading form in time. The color tones of this choice tree contrast well with other red-leaved forms. It is different enough to make a good contrast in the garden landscape.

sources.title: 东紫 Acer Palmatum 'Azuma Murasaki'
sources.description: 这非比寻常的红色叶片是 "东紫"的区别性特征。整个叶片呈现出一种淡紫色色调，但它的底色却是绿色的。新叶为橙黄色，且有一种灰蒙蒙的质感，这是由于叶片覆盖着细腻的绒毛，不过随着叶片的成熟，这些绒毛会逐渐褪去。仲夏时节，叶片底色会转为深绿色，表面则覆盖着红色。各裂叶相互分离，且呈长卵状披针形，叶缘锯齿清晰。大部分时节，叶柄呈亮红色。 "东紫"并非高大的品种，它早期生长迅速，随后逐年减慢。株高可达6米，树冠相当圆润，冠幅可达5米。此时外侧的枝条具有垂性。如果将其与红色叶品种种在一起，可以呈现出明显的叶色对比。这个古老的品种名列于日本1882年的Sekihin Binran中。

products.description_text: Acer palmatum ‘Baby Ghost’ is the smallest of the “Ghost” series of reticulated Japanese maples. ‘Baby Ghost’ first leafs out with an amber color leaf that transitions to red. Leaves then fade to burgundy and ultimately to green which maintains throughout the summer. Fall color is orange-red. ‘Baby Ghost’ has excellent reticulated variegation in early spring, but that mostly fades for the duration of the summer. 10 Year Size: Height: 4-6 feet Width: 4-6 feet

descriptions.preferred: This highly desirable and interesting dwarf cultivar was the first dissectum witches'-broom to be discovered. It was found by Rick Rey of the Delaware Valley Agricultural School in the early 1980s and named by Edward Rodd of Raraflora Nursery, Kinterfield, Pennsylvania. The finely dissected leaves are half the size of normal dissectum leaves in the first year—3-5 cm long and wide —becoming smaller with age until reduced to the size of Like most witches'-brooms, it produces relatively vigorous shoots from the graft, 5-8 cm long, but slows down in subsequent years, attaining about 1 m tall and wide after 10 years. It eventually forms a small round, densely twigged shrub. Also, like most witches'-brooms, 'Baby Lace' is very sensitive to wind and needs protection for at least the first three to four years.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这一极具观赏价值且颇有特色的矮生品种，是最早被发现的 dissectum 类丛枝突变（witches'-broom）品种。20 世纪 80 年代初，由 Delaware Valley Agricultural School 的 Rick Rey 发现，并由宾夕法尼亚州 Kinterfield 的 Raraflora Nursery 的 Edward Rodd 命名。其细裂叶在第一年仅为普通 dissectum 叶片大小的一半，长宽约 3-5 厘米，随后会随树龄增长而进一步缩小。与多数丛枝突变品种相同，嫁接部位会抽生较旺盛的新梢，长约 5-8 厘米，但在后续年份生长会放缓；10 年后株高与冠幅约 1 米。最终形成圆整、小型、枝条极为密集的灌木。同样地，与多数丛枝突变品种一样，‘Baby Lace’ 对风非常敏感，至少在最初 3 至 4 年内需要避风保护。

descriptions.preferred: 'Baldsmith' is among the best of the newer dissectum introductions, bearing light, bright orange-red spring foliage. The leaves become paler and green-tinged in the center with pink-tinged margins as they develop. The combination of mature and new leaves through the summer gives a multicolored appearance of greens, pinks, and orange reds. In the fall, the leaves turn a bright yellow with orange hues. The medium-sized finely dissected fiveor seven-lobed leaves are 8-11 cm long and wide, the lower end narrowing to the width of the midrib for 1-1.5 cm down to the junction of the lobes with the petiole. The division of the sublobes, unlike many dissectums, does not quite reach the midrib. The sublobes have conspicuous, large, narrow, sharply pointed teeth. 'Baldsmith' has the usual mounded habit and vigor of most dissectums but has a distinctive appearance because of the very pendulous, finely dissected light This small-leaved slow-growing cultivar is similar to 'Beni komachi' but easier to grow, with deeper bright red foliage and not as dwarf a shrub at maturity. Like 'Corallinum' it looks its best in the spring and early summer, with intense pink red young leaves which become a deeper red. Thus, the summer color is an unusual mixture with the mature leaves red with dark red margins, and the bright pink red new leaves. The curved lobe tips add extra character to the tree. The small five-lobed deeply divided narrow leaves are up to 5.5 cm long and 3.5 cm wide, but usually smaller. The lobes are long, narrow, almost straplike, with long, narrow tips, deeply divided to at least three-quarters of the way to, and within 5-6 mm from, the leaf base. The center lobe is usually appreciably longer than the other lobes and often has a curved tip. The margins are irregularly and coarsely toothed. The purple-red petioles are slender and 1.5-2 cm long. This unusual and very desirable slow, upright grower eventually matures at 2-3 m high after 10-12 years and is usually wider than tall. It is ideal for small to medium-sized gardens.

sources.title: 巴尔德史密斯 Acer Palmatum 'Blad Smith'
sources.description: 它有着明亮而浅淡的橙红色新叶。随着新叶 的成熟，叶片中部加深为灰绿色色调，叶缘 则呈现粉红色色调。夏季新叶与老叶同时存 在，绿色、粉色、橙红色相互交错，呈现出 五彩斑斓的效果。秋季叶片则是带着橙色色 调的亮黄色。叶片呈细腻的羽毛状，具5-7裂， 叶片较大，裂叶下端变窄，几乎贴着裂叶中 脉。小裂叶与其他羽毛枫不同，它没有完全 裂至叶片中脉。小裂叶叶缘锯齿清晰，大而 狭长，叶尖锋利。它树形与寻常的羽毛枫一 样，呈土丘状，抗性强，但是它有一个与众 不同的特点。那就是它的裂叶独特、细腻， 叶色为浅橙红色，与绯红皇后的深红色叶片 非常不同。

descriptions_zh.preferred: 'Baldsmith' 是较新的 dissectum 类引种中最出色者之一，春季展叶呈浅而明亮的橙红色。叶片随后在中央渐变为较浅并带绿色调，叶缘带粉色。夏季成熟叶与新叶并存，形成绿色、粉色与橙红色交织的多彩观感。秋季叶色转为明亮的黄色并带橙色晕染。叶片中等大小，精细深裂，5 或 7 裂，长宽均为 8-11 厘米；叶片下部收窄，在裂片与叶柄连接处向下 1-1.5 厘米范围内几乎仅与中脉等宽。与许多 dissectum 品种不同，其次级裂片的分裂并未完全达到中脉。次级裂片具明显而较大的狭长锐尖锯齿。'Baldsmith' 具有多数 dissectum 品种常见的拱圆开展株形和长势，但因枝叶极为下垂、叶裂精细且色泽轻盈而别具风貌。该品种小叶、生长缓慢，与 'Beni komachi' 相似，但更易栽培，叶色为更深的鲜红色，成熟后灌木体量也不如后者那样矮小。与 'Corallinum' 一样，它在春季和初夏观赏效果最佳，新叶为浓艳的粉红至红色，随后转深红。因此夏季叶色呈现出不寻常的混合效果：成熟叶为红色并具深红叶缘，新叶则鲜粉红至红色。裂片先端弯曲，进一步增添树姿特色。叶片小，5 裂，深裂，裂片狭窄，最长可达 5.5 厘米、宽 3.5 厘米，通常更小。裂片细长狭窄，近带状，先端长而细，深裂至少达叶基的四分之三，距叶基仅 5-6 毫米。中央裂片通常明显长于其余裂片，且先端常呈弯曲。叶缘具不规则而较粗的锯齿。紫红色叶柄细长，长 1.5-2 厘米。该品种姿态独特、观赏价值很高，生长缓慢而直立，10-12 年后可达 2-3 米高，通常冠幅大于株高，非常适合小型至中型庭院。

care.cultivation: 宜栽培于湿润但排水良好的土壤中。夏季必要时应补充浇水。叶色在半阴环境下表现最佳，但也可耐全日照。土壤水分不足或暴晒过度都可能导致叶缘焦枯。参见日本枫树栽培资料。

descriptions.preferred: Slow-growing and compact, 'Barrier Bergman' has finely dissected leaves. Fall color is orange-red. This cultivar forms a dense moundshaped plant which is surprisingly hardy.

descriptions_zh.preferred: ‘Barrier Bergman’ 生长缓慢且株形紧凑，叶片细裂。鲜亮的粉红红色新叶与较老的紫红色至青铜红色叶片形成迷人对比。在半阴环境下栽培时，植株常会显现青铜绿色调。秋色为橙红色。该品种最终形成致密的圆丘状株形，且耐寒性出乎意料地好。

products.description_text: Acer palmatum dissectum 'Barrie Bergman' Exceptional Weeping Red Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 'Barrie Bergman’ is a nice weeping selection from the famous Raraflora Nursery. In the spring, ‘Barrie Bergman’ leafs out as a cherry-red to a bright purple-red. In the shade it loses this color quicker, turning to a green-red for the summer. Fall color on ‘Barrie Bergman’ is a bright orange to bright red. ‘Barrie Bergman’ has nice weeping and cascading shape reaching 4-5 ft in height by 5-6 ft in width in 10 years. descriptions.preferred: This Japanese cultivar is one of the bright pink-red spring color maples, similar to the popular 'Corallinum'. The new leaves emerge a deep pink-red, changing to orange-red with yellow veins and margins, and becoming medium green for the summer. Fall color is scarlet. The shoots and leafstalks are red. The small fiveto seven-lobed leaves are moderately deeply divided. 'Beni chidori' grows slowly to about 10 ft. (3 m) tall and is ideal for bonsai and container growing. The name means "red plover."

sources.title: 红千鸟 Acer Palmatum 'Beni Chidori'
sources.description: 小叶品种，具有非常典型的掌状叶，一般为 5 裂叶，叶裂较深，在日本盆景文化中扮演者非常重要的角色。 它属于春叶为亮粉色的枫树品种，与 'Beni tsukasa' （ 红司 ） 相似。春季，新叶萌发时为深粉色，随后逐渐变为橙红色，叶脉和叶缘则是清晰的黄色 ， 夏季叶色转为绿色，秋季则是绯红色 ， 叶柄和嫩枝为红色。它生长缓慢， 成年树高约为 3m 。

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这是一个日本品种，属于春季亮粉红至红色叶的日本枫类型之一，与广受欢迎的 'Corallinum' 相似。新叶萌发时为深粉红红色，随后转为橙红色，并带黄色叶脉和叶缘，夏季则变为中绿色。秋色为猩红色。新梢和叶柄为红色。叶片较小，5 至 7 裂，中度深裂。'Beni chidori' 生长缓慢，高约 10 英尺（3 米），非常适合盆景和容器栽培。其名称意为“红千鸟”。

descriptions.preferred: This American cultivar has medium-sized fiveto seven-lobed fanshaped leaves. The lobes are deeply divided with conspicuous coarse, sharp teeth on the crinkled margins. The new leaves are a bright pink-red, with contrasting lime-green midveins and stalks, becoming dark brown-red to purple-red for the summer. Fall color is an attractive blend of gold and crimson. This slow-growing broad shrubby tree makes a welcome addition to the garden landscape. The name means "red umbrella."

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这一美国品种具中等大小、5 至 7 裂的扇形叶。裂片深裂，皱褶叶缘上具显著、粗大而尖锐的锯齿。新叶呈鲜亮粉红红色，与之形成对比的是中脉和叶柄的青柠绿色；夏季叶色转为深褐红至紫红色。秋季叶色为金黄与深红的迷人混合。该品种生长缓慢，形成开展的灌木状小乔木，是园林景观中的优良补充。其名称意为“红伞”。

products.title: Acer palmatum 'Beni gasa' Red Japanese Maple
products.description_text: Acer palmatum 'Beni gasa' Red Japanese Maple Zones 6-9 ‘Beni gasa' leafs out in the spring with large serrated red matsumurae leaves. Chartreuse begins to infuse into the red , giving ‘Beni gasa’ some unique highlights. During the summer ‘Beni gasa’ turns to a dark red green with bronze highlights. New growth on ‘Beni gasa’ during the summer is a bright red. ‘Beni gasa’ is typically a bright orange for fall. ‘Beni gasa’ may reach 8 ft in height in 10 years. ‘Beni gasa’ translates as “Red Umbrella’. Limited Quantities Available !! As we have over a thousand cultivars of Japanese maples, we often do not have many of each cultivar. descriptions.preferred: 'Beni hime' is among the smallest dwarf shrubs with reddish foliage. The individual leaf is of the palmatum type, being mostly fine-pointed and star shaped. The short ited. New shoots are very short and often come out in an angular manner which eventually makes for a rather dense compact bush. As the growth thickens with age, there is a strong tendency to self-prune and die out inside. This cultivar has predominantly a reddish tone, pink red to rusty red, both rather light. Full sun increases the intensity of color. A greenish shade shadows it somewhat in midsummer. Fall colors will move into vibrant red tones. Like many very small-leaved dwarf maples and some of the smaller cultivars with reddish foliage, 'Beni hime' tends to show early spring damage from fungi on the new growth. This can happen as early as the breakingbud stage and on into fully developed new leaves. Diseases, such as Botrytis, can seriously affect the new leaves and terminal development. Good air circulation and full sun aid in prevention. Some fungicides help to suppress the disease. This small dwarf, while very delicate in overall appearance, is not as tender as one would assume. It does better in open situations with plenty of light and tends to weaken in a strong overstory of shade. Some plants attain a height and width of 1 m in 8-10 years. 'Beni hime' is ideally suited to container culture and bonsai. The name means "red dwarf."

descriptions_zh.preferred: 'Beni hime' 是叶色偏红的最小型矮生灌木之一。单叶属 palmatum 型，多呈细尖、星形。节间极短。新梢很短，且常以带棱角的方式抽生，最终形成相当致密紧凑的灌丛。随着植株老化、枝叶增密，内部枝条常有较强的自然疏除与枯死倾向。该品种整体以偏红色调为主，介于粉红至红色和锈红色之间，且颜色都较浅。全日照可增强叶色强度；盛夏时会略带绿色调。秋季叶色转为鲜艳的红色。与许多极小叶的矮生枫树及部分小型红叶品种一样，'Beni hime' 的新梢在早春易受真菌侵染而受损。这种情况可早在芽将萌动时发生，并持续到新叶完全展开阶段。灰霉病等病害会严重影响新叶与顶端生长。良好的空气流通和充足日照有助于预防，一些杀菌剂也有助于抑制病害。这个小型矮生品种虽然整体姿态十分纤细，但并不像外观所暗示的那样娇弱。它更适合光照充足、较开阔的环境，在上层树荫浓重处反而容易衰弱。有些植株在 8-10 年内可达到高、宽各 1 米。'Beni hime' 非常适合容器栽培和盆景。其名称意为“红姬”或“红色小矮株”。

products.title: Acer palmatum 'Beni hime' Japanese Maple
products.description_text: Acer palmatum 'Beni hime' Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 Acer palmatum 'Beni Hime' is a dwarf Japanese Maple prized for its compact size and vivid red foliage. Over a span of 10 years, it typically grows to about 3-4 ft in height and 2-3 ft in width. Its petite stature makes it perfect for small gardens, containers, or bonsai cultivation. The leaves are small and deeply lobed, displaying a striking red hue that remains vibrant throughout the season. In autumn, the foliage transforms into a brilliant scarlet before falling. 'Beni Hime' features a dense, rounded growth habit with a bushy, compact form, developing a charming mound-like shape. 'Beni hime' is a tree that can be very difficult to grow and is not for a beginner. One tip we can give is to make sure you have very good drainage for this tree. Limited Quantities Available !! descriptions.preferred: This cultivar, whose name means "red star," originated as a chance seedling in 1979 and was introduced by Del Loucks of Del's Japanese Maple Nursery, Eugene, Oregon, in 1992. The leaves emerge a bright red in the spring and turn green during the summer. A second growth of new red leaves creates splashes of red on a green background, which persists until the leaves turn yellow to orange in the fall. The small seven-lobed widespreading palmate leaves are 4.5-5.5 cm long and 6-7 cm wide. They are divided about two-thirds of the way to the leaf base. Each broadish lobe is 3-4 cm long and 1.2-1.5 cm wide at the broadest point in the middle, narrowing to 7-10 mm at the lobe junctions, and tapering to a short tail-like acuminate tip. There are numerous fine double teeth on the margins. The short, stiff petioles are about 1 cm long. -red This cultivar, whose name means "red mirror," is reportedly a seedling selection from 'Nomura'. In spring the leaves are orange red to purplish red, depending on location and shade cover. The leaf color is not the deep black red of many other red cultivars in the Matsumurae Group. The leaves have green undertones when grown in deep shade. The fall color is a bright crimson. The palmate leaves are divided into seven long, narrowly ovate lobes. The divisions reach almost to the leaf base. The leaves are 6-8 cm long and slightly wider, and the margins are double toothed. The petioles are 2-3 cm long Corvallis The effect of the winter shoot color of this cultivar has been described as spectacular. Like the ever popular 'Sango kaku', the color of the current winter shoot is a bright salmon red, but it is a deeper color and the color persists on the second-year shoots. It comes into leaf two weeks later than 'Sango kaku' and has a slightly slower growth. The medium-sized fiveor seven-lobed fresh green leaves, often with red-tinged edges, are divided twothirds to three-quarters of the way to the leaf base, and are 5.5-7 cm long and 6-8 cm wide. The lobes are ovatetriangular to broadly ovate with tail-like pointed tips, and regular double-toothed margins. They are 4-5 cm for winter color and for use as a focal point in the garden landscape, its foliage turns a lovely golden yellow in the fall, made even more attractive by the contrasting red shoots in the background. The name means "red bark."

descriptions_zh.preferred: 该段原文明显混入了多个品种条目，以下按可辨识内容做保守整理：其一，此品种名意为“红星”，1979 年源自一株偶发实生苗，1992 年由俄勒冈州 Eugene 的 Del's Japanese Maple Nursery 的 Del Loucks 引种。春季新叶鲜红，夏季转绿；其后再度抽发的红色新叶在绿色背景上形成红色斑点般的效果，并持续至秋季叶片转为黄色至橙色。叶片较小，掌状，7 裂，开展，长 4.5-5.5 厘米，宽 6-7 厘米，裂达叶基约三分之二处。每个较宽的裂片长 3-4 厘米，中部最宽处 1.2-1.5 厘米，在裂片连接处收窄至 7-10 毫米，先端渐尖呈短尾状；叶缘具众多细密重锯齿。叶柄短而硬，长约 1 厘米。其二，另一品种名意为“红镜”，据称为 ‘Nomura’ 的实生选种。春季叶色为橙红至紫红，具体色泽受种植地点与遮阴条件影响；其叶色不属于 Matsumurae Group 中许多红叶品种那种深近黑红色，在深阴环境下会带有绿色底调。秋色为鲜亮深红色。叶掌状，深裂成 7 个长而狭卵形裂片，裂片几乎深达叶基；叶长 6-8 厘米，宽略大于叶长，叶缘具重锯齿，叶柄长 2-3 厘米。其三，关于 Corvallis 的描述提到其冬季枝条色彩效果极为出色。与广受欢迎的 ‘Sango kaku’ 相似，当年生冬枝呈鲜亮鲑红色，但色泽更深，且二年生枝上仍能保持。其展叶时间比 ‘Sango kaku’ 晚约两周，生长速度也略慢。叶片中等大小，5 或 7 裂，初展时鲜绿色，叶缘常带红晕，裂达叶基约三分之二至四分之三处；叶长 5.5-7 厘米，宽 6-8 厘米。裂片为卵状三角形至宽卵形，先端尾状渐尖，叶缘具规则的重锯齿。除冬枝观赏价值外，秋季叶色会转为优美的金黄色，与背景中的红色枝条形成鲜明对比，因此也适合作为园林中的视觉焦点。原文末尾提到其名称意为“红皮”。

products.title: Acer palmatum 'Beni hoshi' Ruby Stars Japanese Maple
products.description_text: Acer palmatum 'Beni hoshi' Dwarf "Ruby Stars" Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 Introduced by Del Loucks in 1996, this unique upright dwarf is often sold as 'Beni Hoshi' which translates as 'Ruby Star' or 'Ruby Stars'. This selection leafs out with a full rounded amoenum leaf that is brighter red fading to a deeper maroon. During mid-summer this miniature selection is a peachy orange providing great contrast in the garden. Fall colors are bright yellow to orange. 'Beni hoshi' forms a unique upright dwarf that reaches 5 ft in height by 4 ft in width in 15 years. As leaves mature, they become more rounded and slightly twist giving an even more unique habit. 'Beni hoshi' is ideal for containers, conifer beds, rock gardens, fairy gardens, or simply small spaces in the landscape. Protection from the hot afternoon sun is recommended to get the full twist on each leaf. This tree deserves a place in any maple collection or garden. Limited Quantities Available !!
