rhs_zh.description: 直立、圆整的落叶灌木或小乔木，高和冠幅均可达 2.5 米。叶片裂片先端细尖，春季呈鲜艳红色，随后成熟为亮绿色，秋季再转为红色和橙色等色调。春季开小型红色花，入秋后可结翅果。

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这个品种以鲜艳的春叶著称。在展叶初期，新叶呈极为明亮的胭脂红色。它在短时间内色彩非常夺目，但持色性不如其他一些相关品种。'Deshojo' 在其余季节的基本叶色为悦目的浅绿色，边缘常带红铜色。'Deshojo' 存在不同选系，其中一些构成了颇具价值的栽培品种。叶片为典型 palmatum 形，裂片分离深度约达叶基的三分之二。通常为 5 裂，自中心向外放射，裂片强烈渐尖，叶缘具细锯齿。叶片长宽可达 5-6 厘米。细长叶柄最长约 4 厘米。该品种名称中的 shoj o 部分（意为“红脸猴”）容易引起混淆。'Shojo' 是红叶 palmatum 中一个古老的标准类型。上述 'Deshojo' 则是其他选育品种的基础。'Shin deshojo' 是较新的选系（shin 意为“新”或“较新”）。'Kondeshojo' 和 'Ima deshojo' 则是其他不同红色深浅的类型。这一类型株形直立，可形成较高大的灌木，高约 3 米，且宽度通常几乎与高度相当。作为小型庭园中的优良观赏配植植物，它在“新梢鲜艳”类型中占有突出的地位。其名称有时也会被误拼作 'Desyojo'。

descriptions.preferred: The new spring growth of 'Dissectum Nigrum' is its distinguishing characteristic. The new shoots and foliage are noticeably covered with fine silvery hairs which make the unfolding new growth look almost gray. It soon loses the pubescence and attains the rich, deep red color so typical of this cultivar. Unfortunately, there are many Each leaf has seven finely dissected lobes as long as 12 cm, and each lobe is deeply dissected from the edges to the midrib. The lobes tend to hang down, making the leaf about 10 cm wide in many cases, and giving the whole plant a feathery, cascading appearance so desirable in the Dissectum Group. As the name implies, this maple holds the deep red color much longer into midsummer than do many other red dissectum cultivars. However, it does not usually hold the rich reds quite as long as 'Crimson Queen' does. Planting in full sun or in partial shade affects the length of color retention. Partial shade prolongs the deep colors. In late summer the bronze or bronze green colors take over. In the fall, the rich, bright red tones become prominent. 'Dissectum Nigrum' is a vigorous dissectum with the typical pendulous growth habit. Large old specimens are 4-5 m high and at least as wide. This plant was one of the better red dissectums of the nursery trade, but has probably been overtaken by 'Crimson Queen' and 'Garnet'. It was originally imported from Japan into Europe and named 'Dissectum Nigrum', but renamed 'Ever Red' by Cascio when imported into the United States in 1965. Hence, it is better known there as 'Ever Red'. However, keeping the earlier name of 'Dissectum Nigrum' has priority and so this is the legitimate name. It has also been known under the names of 'Dissectum Atrosanguineum', 'Dissectum Ever Red', 'Nigrum Dissectum' and 'Pendulum Nigrum'. 'Dissectum Nigrum' has also been 'Dissectum Nigrum'. The silvery pubescence of spring growth identifies this cultivar from other similar forms. -green 'Eddisbury' is a reliable and desirable coral-bark maple, rather like the popular 'Sango kaku', with similar but slightly larger leaves. However, it does not grow as tall as 'Sango kaku' and the deeper bright red shoots and petioles contrast markedly with the deeper green leaves throughout the growing season. The foliage is typically palmatum type. The leaves are mainly seven lobed, ovate-acuminate, and tapering to a fine point. The leaf margins are regularly and evenly double toothed. Most leaves are 6-7 cm long and wide, and the slender bright red petioles are 3-5 cm long. Leaf color is a medium to dark green. New young leaves are a lighter yellow green with red-tinged tips and edges. As summer approaches, the foliage becomes a more uniform green, but a red tinge persists at the extreme tips ing feature is the coral-red winter shoots, the color persisting into the second and third year. 'Eddisbury' was a chance seedling spotted by a keen-eyed employee at the F. Morrey and Son Nursery in Cheshire, England, who was attracted by its brilliant red stems. The original plant was selected about 1970 and was, after thirty years, more than 3 m tall. It was named after the district in which the nursery is situated.

rhs.description: A small to medium-sized shrub with a dense, spreading habit that reaches a height of around 2.5m. The deeply-cut leaves emerge in spring covered with a silvery down and coloured a deep bronze to burgundy red, maturing to an olive green and bronze colour in summer before turning red in autumn. Small red flowers in spring are followed by winged fruits in autumn

rhs_zh.description: 一种小型至中型灌木，株型紧密而开展，高度约 2.5 米。深裂叶在春季萌发时覆有银色绒毛，叶色为深青铜色至酒红色；夏季成熟后转为橄榄绿色与铜色，秋季再转红。春季开小型红花，秋季结翅果。

descriptions_zh.preferred: 'Dissectum Nigrum' 的显著特征在于其春季新梢。新枝与新叶表面明显覆盖着细密的银色茸毛，使展开中的新生长几乎呈灰色。随后这些毛被很快脱落，叶色转为该品种典型的浓郁深红色。每片叶通常有 7 个精细裂片，裂片长可达 12 厘米，并且每个裂片又从边缘深裂至中脉。裂片常自然下垂，因此叶片宽度常约 10 厘米，使整株呈现 Dissectum Group 所珍视的羽毛状、瀑布式姿态。正如其名称所示，这一槭树在夏季中期之前能比许多其他红叶细裂品种更持久地保持深红色，但通常不如 'Crimson Queen' 保持鲜红色的时间那么长。全日照或半阴栽植都会影响保色时间，其中半阴环境更有利于延长深色表现。至夏末，叶色逐渐转为铜色或铜绿色；秋季则显现浓艳明亮的红色。'Dissectum Nigrum' 是生长旺健的细裂型品种，具典型的下垂生长习性。大型老株高可达 4-5 米，冠幅至少相当。该品种曾是苗圃贸易中较优秀的红叶细裂品种之一，但后来大概被 'Crimson Queen' 和 'Garnet' 超越。它最初由日本传入欧洲，并被命名为 'Dissectum Nigrum'；1965 年引入美国时，Cascio 将其重新命名为 'Ever Red'，因此在当地更常以 'Ever Red' 为人所知。不过，较早的名称 'Dissectum Nigrum' 具有优先权，因此这是其合法名称。它也曾以 'Dissectum Atrosanguineum'、'Dissectum Ever Red'、'Nigrum Dissectum' 和 'Pendulum Nigrum' 等名称流通。春季新生长上的银色茸毛，是将该品种与其他相似类型区分开的关键特征。 'Eddisbury' 是一个可靠且优良的珊瑚枝枫，与广受欢迎的 'Sango kaku' 颇为相似，但叶片略大。然而它的株高不及 'Sango kaku'，且更深、更鲜亮的红色新梢和叶柄，在整个生长季都与较深的绿色叶片形成鲜明对比。叶片为典型的 palmatum 型，多为 7 裂，裂片卵形渐尖，先端细尖。叶缘规则且均匀具重锯齿。多数叶片长宽均为 6-7 厘米，细长鲜红色叶柄长 3-5 厘米。叶色为中绿至深绿色。新叶较浅，呈黄绿色，并带红色叶尖和叶缘。随着夏季来临，叶色趋于更均一的绿色，但裂片最尖端仍保留一抹红晕。其最突出的观赏点是冬季珊瑚红色枝条，这种色彩可持续到第二年和第三年枝条上。'Eddisbury' 是英国 Cheshire 的 F. Morrey and Son Nursery 一名眼光敏锐的员工发现的实生变异，因其鲜亮红枝而被选出。原株约于 1970 年被选定，三十年后株高已超过 3 米。其名称取自苗圃所在地区。

descriptions.preferred: Acer palmatum dissectum 'Dr. Brown' Deep Red Dwarf Weeping Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 'Dr. Brown' has earned a degree in its beauty. Dr. Brown has a heavily ornamental leaf that often has more lobes that most other laceleafs. The color is a soft pinkish brown that has an overall look of unique shade of soft maroon. This laceleaf is unique and is a favorite among those who try this beauty out. Dr Brown can reach 4 ft in height by 5 ft in width in 10 years. The overall habit is cascading, forming a nice umbrella. In autumn, Dr Brown puts on a display of yellows, oranges and reds . Make sure to make this tree a focal point in your garden! descriptions.preferred: A reliable and desirable coral-bark maple with leaves similar to those of the popular 'Sango kaku', 'Eddisbury' does not grow as tall and its deeper bright red shoots and leafstalks contrast with the green leaves throughout the growing season. The medium-sized leaves are mainly seven-lobed, the lobes ovateacuminate, fine-tipped with evenly toothed margins. The slender leafstalks are bright red. New young leaves are a lighter yellow-green with redtinged tips and edges, becoming a more uniform green in the summer. The fall colors are yellow to gold with light red overtones. This sturdy, upright plant grows vigorously when young but rarely exceeds 13 ft. (4 m) tall. Its outstanding feature is the coral-red winter shoots, the color persisting into the second and third years. The name honors the district in northwestern England where this cultivar was selected.

rhs_zh.description: 落叶性、直立生长的“珊瑚枝”枫，高约 3 米，枝条与叶柄呈醒目的深珊瑚红色；嫩叶淡黄绿色，边缘带红晕，夏季转绿，秋季变为黄至金黄色，常带红晕。春季开不显眼的下垂簇生小花，花色紫红，之后结带红晕的翅果。

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这是一种稳定且很受欢迎的珊瑚枝枫，叶形与常见的 ‘Sango kaku’ 相似，但 ‘Eddisbury’ 不会长得那么高，其更深且鲜亮的红色新梢和叶柄在整个生长季都与绿色叶片形成鲜明对比。中等大小的叶片多为 7 裂，裂片卵形渐尖，先端细尖，叶缘锯齿均匀。细长的叶柄鲜红色。新叶初展时为较浅的黄绿色，叶尖和叶缘带红晕，夏季则转为较均匀的绿色。秋色由黄色至金黄色，并带淡红色调。植株健壮、直立，幼年生长旺盛，但高度很少超过 13 英尺（4 米）。其最突出的观赏点是冬季珊瑚红色枝条，而且这种色彩可持续到第二、第三年枝条上。其名称源自英格兰西北部一个选育出该品种的地区。

descriptions.preferred: A vigorous, fresh green laceleaf with a very low wide-spreading growth habit, 'Ellen' reaches about 3 ft. (1 m) tall in 10 years, with a spread of 8 ft. (2.5 m). The new leaves are yellow-green, becoming medium green in the summer, then turning clear yellow in the fall. The large sevento nine-lobed deeply dissected leaves are very variable in size. Each lobe is itself coarsely and deeply toothed. The stiff leafstalks are swollen and hooked at the base. The name honors a daughter-in-law of Dutch nurseryman D. M. van Gelderen, who selected this cultivar. 'Emerald Lace' Acer Gregory. Dissectum Group—green. This interesting cultivar is a much deeper green than most green dissectums, has lacy foliage, and is a fast grower. The fiveto seven-lobed leaves are yellow-green in the spring, darkening by midsummer, and then turning a bright burgundy red in the fall. The green leafstalks are slender but stiff. 'Emerald Lace' is vigorous growing and forms an irregular semiupright but spreading bush with long, pendulous branches. It reaches a height and spread of 10-13 ft. (3-4 m).

descriptions_zh.preferred: ‘Ellen’ 是一个生长强健、叶色清新的绿色线裂型品种，树形极矮而横向扩展。10 年生时高约 3 英尺（1 米），冠幅可达 8 英尺（2.5 米）。新叶黄绿色，夏季转为中绿色，秋季则变为明亮的黄色。大型叶片深裂，通常有 7 至 9 裂，裂片大小变化很大；每个裂片本身又具粗而深的锯齿。叶柄坚挺，基部膨大并略呈钩状。该品种名称是为荷兰苗圃家 D. M. van Gelderen 的一位儿媳而命名，他即为该品种的选育者。‘Emerald Lace’ Acer Gregory。Dissectum Group—green。这个有趣的品种比大多数绿色羽裂类日本枫叶色更深，叶姿细致如 lace，且生长迅速。叶片 5 至 7 裂，春季为黄绿色，至盛夏逐渐加深，秋季转为鲜亮的酒红色。绿色叶柄细长但坚挺。‘Emerald Lace’ 生长势强，形成不规则、半直立而开展的灌木状树形，枝条细长下垂。最终高度和冠幅可达 10 至 13 英尺（3 至 4 米）。

descriptions.preferred: 简称伍德，也可写作 "Elmwoodie" 或 "Elmwoodii" ，是一款直立生长的日本枫树，叶子深裂，有明显的的脉叶结构，成年株高 2-3 m 。春天的叶子呈淡绿色，还会带一点棕红色，阳光下形成一种不寻常而美丽的锈色，叶脉为深棕色。夏天浅绿和深绿交织在一起，呈现渐变的效果，秋天的色彩是金橙色，在寂寥萧瑟的庭院里是夺目的存在，但又和其他的景观充分融合，不显突兀。伍德在每个季节都有一树多色的表现，喜欢色彩层次丰富的朋友不容错过，相信它一定能够为你带来惊喜。

descriptions.preferred: This interesting cultivar was a chance seedling which David Sabo of Charlotte, North Carolina, grew and liked. He sent scion material to Del Loucks of Del's Japanese Maple Nursery, Eugene, Oregon, who propagated and named it. It is a much deeper green than the normal green dissectums, has lacy foliage, and is a fast grower with very pendulous branches. The foliage is yellow green when it first appears in the spring, darkening by midsummer, and then unexpectedly turning a bright burgundy red in the fall. The fiveor seven-lobed medium-sized leaves are 7-8 cm long and 8-9 cm wide, deeply dissected to the leaf base where the lobes narrow to the width of the midrib, less than 1 mm. The lobes and sublobes are well spread outward. The slender but stiff green petioles are 3-4 cm long. 'Emerald Lace' is a vigorous dissectum and forms an irregular semi-upright but spreading bush with long, pendulous branches. It reaches a height and spread of about 2 m in 10 years. This cultivar would make a pleasant contrast with other dissectums with its darker green foliage and different growth habit. 'Bloodgood', the reliable standard to which all newer red upright palmatums are compared. 'Emperor I' exceeds even 'Bloodgood' in leaf color retention and growth rate, and has the additional advantage of coming into leaf two weeks later—thus reducing the risk of damage by late spring frosts and cold drying winds. It also holds its color well in shade and is more versatile. The leaves are a deep purple red which is retained throughout the growing season until changing to a beautiful dark crimson in the fall. Because the leaves are thinner-textured than those of 'Bloodgood', they are more translucent and glow in the sunlight. The large fiveor seven-lobed leaves, which are 9-10 cm long and 10-13 cm wide, are divided two-thirds to three-quarters of the way to the leaf base. Each lobe is ovate with a long, pointed tip, 1.5-2 cm wide at the broadest point in the middle and narrowing to about 1 cm at the lobe junction. There are numerous fine small teeth along the margins. The strong dark red petioles are 3-5 cm long. 'Emperor I' is hardy and grows vigorously into an upright wide-crowned tree. It makes a good focal point for a large landscape. 'Red Emperor', which also originates from Red Maple Nursery, fits the above description and may be the same cultivar.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这个有趣的品种是一株偶然获得的实生苗，由北卡罗来纳州夏洛特的 David Sabo 栽培并看中。他将接穗材料寄给俄勒冈州尤金 Del's Japanese Maple Nursery 的 Del Loucks，后者将其繁殖并命名。它比常见的绿色羽裂类叶色深得多，叶形细致，生长迅速，枝条强烈下垂。春季初展叶时为黄绿色，至仲夏颜色加深，秋季则出人意料地转为鲜亮的酒红色。中等大小叶片通常 5 或 7 裂，长 7–8 厘米、宽 8–9 厘米，深裂直达叶基，裂片在基部收窄至接近主脉宽度，不足 1 毫米。裂片及次级裂片向外舒展良好。绿色叶柄细长但坚挺，长 3–4 厘米。‘Emerald Lace’ 是一个生长强健的羽裂型品种，形成不规则、半直立而开展的灌木，具细长下垂枝。10 年生时高和冠幅约 2 米。由于其较深的绿色叶色和不同的树形，它与其他羽裂类品种搭配时能形成宜人的对比。‘Bloodgood’ 是可靠的经典标准，所有较新的红叶直立掌叶型品种通常都以其作为比较基准。‘Emperor I’ 在叶色保持性和生长速度上甚至超过 ‘Bloodgood’，并且还有一个额外优点，即其展叶时间晚约两周，从而降低晚春霜冻和寒冷干风造成损伤的风险。它在半阴环境中也能较好保持叶色，因此适应性更强。叶片为深紫红色，整个生长季都能保持，直至秋季转为美丽的深绯红色。由于其叶片质地比 ‘Bloodgood’ 更薄，因此透光性更强，在阳光下有通透发亮的效果。大型叶片通常 5 或 7 裂，长 9–10 厘米、宽 10–13 厘米，裂达叶基的三分之二至四分之三。每个裂片呈卵形，先端细长尖锐，中部最宽处约 1.5–2 厘米，在裂片连接处收窄至约 1 厘米。叶缘具许多细小锯齿。深红色叶柄强健，长 3–5 厘米。‘Emperor I’ 耐寒且生长强健，形成直立、宽冠的小乔木。在大型景观中可作为极佳的视觉焦点。‘Red Emperor’ 同样出自 Red Maple Nursery，特征与上述描述相符，可能与其为同一品种。

care.pruning: 修剪第 1 组
care.propagation: 可采用嫁接或软枝扦插繁殖
care.cultivation: 宜栽培于湿润但排水良好的土壤中。夏季必要时应补充浇水。叶色在半阴环境下表现最佳，但也可耐全日照。土壤水分不足或暴晒过度都可能导致叶缘焦枯。参见日本枫树栽培资料。

products.name: Acer japonicum 'Emmett's Pumpkin' Full Moon Japanese Maple
products.description_text: ‘Emmett’s Pumpkin’ has some of the largest leaves of any Japanese Maple. New leaves in spring emerge yellow green with a bronze overlay. Later the bronze fades leaving the foliage light to medium green for summer. As the temperature cools, 'Emmett's Pumpkin' turns varying shades of orange and red. The combination of leaf shape and Fall color make 'Emmett's Pumpkin' one of the most aptly named Japanese Maple varieties there is. 10 Year Size: Height: 8-10 Feet Width: 5-7 Feet Spring Color: Yellow-Green Summer Color: Green Fall Color: Orange and Red Sun Tolerance: Partial Shade Planting: Elevated, Well Drained Soil

descriptions.preferred: 帝王 一号树体强健，是一个非常优秀的品种，由美国宾夕法尼亚州红枫苗圃的Richard P Wolff在 1976 年发现 ， 后来由美国俄勒冈的某位苗圃主命名并商业化推广。它的新叶萌发时间比 "血红"晚两周，因此得以避免早春的霜冻、低温以及寒风。它在遮阴条件下也能保持优良的叶色，因此其适应性更强。 整个生长季 帝王 一号的叶色均为深紫红色，秋季则变为美丽的深红色。与 "血红"相比，其叶片结构 比 "血红"纤薄，因此在阳光下呈现出半透明的质感，并泛着红光。叶片较大，具 有 5-7裂，且叶裂深。叶缘锯齿细密，叶柄短于叶片，呈暗红色。 帝王 一号抗性强，树形直立，冠幅宽广，可以作为大型景观的主树。

rhs.description: A large bushy deciduous shrub or small tree to 5m tall with 5-7-lobed, deep red-purple leaves, turning crimson in autumn. The leaves appear later than many other cultivars, reducing the risk of damage by spring frost

attributes.suggested_uses: City/Courtyard Gardens, Flower borders and beds, Cottage/Informal Garden, Low Maintenance, Architectural, Patio/Container Plants
attributes.hort_group_description: Acers in this amoenum group have large, palm-shaped leaves with finely-toothed edges

care.cultivation: Grow in a moist but well-drained soil. Water in summer if necessary. Leaf colour is best in partial shade, although full sun can be tolerated. Leaf scorch can be caused by lack of soil moisture or excessive exposure. See Japanese maple cultivation
care.pruning: Pruning group 1 , pruning if necessary only from late autumn to midwinter
care.propagation: Propagate by grafting , softwood cuttings or layering

resistance.pest: May be susceptible to Acer gall mite, aphids , caterpillars and horse chestnut scale
resistance.disease: May be susceptible to Verticillium wilt , Acer leaf scorch and honey fungus

products.title: Acer palmatum 'Emperor 1' Japanese Maple Tree
products.description_text: Acer palmatum 'Emperor 1' Red Emperor Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 ‘Emperor 1’ is one of our favorite red upright Japanese maples. Also known as 'Red Emperor', the early spring color of this Japanese maple comes out as an extremely deep maroon with a brilliant translucent sheen that gives the leaves a nice shiny look as the sunlight hits them. This 'Emperor 1' Japanese maple holds its rich, dark red foliage well throughout the summer months, and has a brilliant scarlet fall display. The underside of the leaf is a rich olive green. The 'Emperor 1' Japanese maple makes a beautiful dynamic to the shiny red tops as the leaves turn blowing in a light summer breeze. ‘Emperor 1’ is a vigorous growing red Japanese maple though it stays midsized overall at around 15 feet in height. Hardiness is another great quality of ‘Emperor 1’. This Red Emperor Japanese maple tree handles cold conditions extremely well and is also very heat tolerant in the late summer. With all of its wonderful attributes ‘Emperor 1’ makes a perfect choice for a mid-sized upright red Japanese maple. **10 GALLON TREE SHIPS WITHOUT POT DUE TO BOX SIZE CONSTRAINTS** Please note that your 10-gallon tree will arrive without a container. It ships immediately unless you request to hold. Be prepared for your 10 gallon tree without a container. Limited Quantities Available !! products.description_text: Acer palmatum dissectum 'English Lace' Upright Red Laceleaf Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 The holy grail of Japanese maples! 'English Lace' is a brand new laceleaf selection that is the tallest of any of the red dissectums. That's right, I said it gets upright growth and it is a laceleaf. It also gets some width with age. This selection leafs out in the early spring with a rich burgundy dissected leaf. This gives a soft appearance to a mid-sized tree. This selection grows upward reaching 10-12 ft in height by 15 ft in width in 15 years. Fall colors are bright oranges to reds. Like 'Seiryu' it is recommended to stake this selection for best upright growth. The size of the trees in the photo are large 7 gallons. Currently we have only 1 gallons available. products.name: Acer palmatum 'Englishtown' Dwarf Japanese Maple
products.description_text: Acer palmatum ‘Englishtown’ is an excellent, upright growing tree for tight spaces or smaller landscapes. ‘Englishtown’ is a dwarf Japanese maple that doesn’t typically have the same compact, shrubby habit of other dwarfs. ‘Englishtown’ will have a more tree like shape while remaining relatively small. ‘Englsihtown’ has dark red leaves in the spring that will usually keep their color very well into the summer. Fall color is a bright red. ‘Englishtown’ is a perfect Japanese maple for just about anyone due to its small stature and good color. 10 Year Size: Height: 4-6 feet Width: 3-4 feet

descriptions.preferred: 'Enkan' is a dwarf red strap-leaved maple from Japan, brought back to Europe in 1991 by Cor van Gelderen of earilobums. The medium-sized five-lobed leaves are divided almost to the base and are slightly broader than long, 7-8 cm long and 9-10 cm wide. The smaller basal lobes are almost at right angles to the petioles. In the mature leaf, the lobes are straplike with bluntly pointed or rounded tips, untoothed or barely toothed, and 2-4 mm wide. The lobes of leaves from vigorous young shoots are finely and sharply toothed, up to 1 cm wide in the middle, and lanceolate-ovate with pointed tips. The purple-red petioles are 2.5-3.5 cm long. 'Enkan' forms an upright tree of up to 3 m but not so wide, and is similar in habit to 'Koto-no-ito'.

sources.title: 燕焕 Acer Palmatum 'Enkan'
sources.description: "燕焕"由日本培育，其树形矮小，叶片为红色的线形叶。1991年荷兰Firma C.Esveld公司的Cor van Gelderen引进欧洲 ， 有时也称为 " Aekan les " 。它与另一个杰出的线叶品种 " 红色霹雳 （Red Pygmy）"非常相似，该品种同样由Firma C.Esveld公司发布。不过，"燕焕"的酒红色叶片在各种环境下表现都更为出色，即使在酷热的气候下也有不错的表现。它是线叶群中颜色最深的红色叶品种。其叶片中等， 通常为 5裂，叶裂几乎深基部 。春天是酒红色，夏季会适当返绿，秋天是明亮的大红色。 "燕焕"树形直立，株高可达3米，但冠幅不及3米，习性与绿色叶的"琴之系（Koto no ito）"相似 。

rhs.description: A small, upright, slow-growing tree ultimately to about 2m tall and 1.5m across. The wine-red leaves have five long, narrow, smooth-edged leaflets, and turn bright red in autumn. Inconspicuous green flowers in spring are followed by red and green, winged fruit in autumn

attributes.suggested_uses: City/Courtyard Gardens, Cottage/Informal Garden, Patio/Container Plants
attributes.hort_group_description: Acers in this linearilobum group have long, narrow, strap-like lobes, with lightly serrated edges

care.cultivation: Grows best in slightly acidic, humus-rich, well-drained soil, but tolerates most soils if improved with well-rotted organic matter . Hot, dry air, cold wind and late frost may cause leaf scorching. Mulch in autumn to protect shallow roots from cold and drying out. See Japanese maple cultivation
care.pruning: Pruning group 1
care.propagation: Propagate by semi-hardwood cuttings or by layering

resistance.pest: May be susceptible to Acer gall mite, aphids , caterpillars and horse chestnut scale
resistance.disease: May be susceptible to Verticillium wilt , Acer leaf scorch and honey fungus

descriptions_zh.preferred: 'Enkan' 是来自日本的一种矮性红叶细带叶槭，1991 年由 Cor van Gelderen 从日本带回欧洲。其叶片中等大小，5 裂，几乎深裂至叶基，长度略小于宽度，叶长 7-8 厘米、宽 9-10 厘米。较小的基部裂片与叶柄近乎成直角。成熟叶的裂片呈带状，先端钝尖或圆钝，边缘无齿或近无齿，宽 2-4 毫米。强旺幼枝上的叶片裂片则具细密而尖锐的锯齿，中部最宽可达 1 厘米，形状为披针状卵形，先端尖。紫红色叶柄长 2.5-3.5 厘米。'Enkan' 可形成直立树形，高可达 3 米，冠幅较窄，树姿与 'Koto-no-ito' 相似。

attributes.suggested_uses: 城市/庭院花园、乡村/自然式花园、露台/容器栽培
attributes.hort_group_description: 此 linearilobum 组的槭树具有细长、带状的裂片，叶缘具浅锯齿。

care.cultivation: 在微酸性、富含腐殖质且排水良好的土壤中生长最佳，但若加入充分腐熟的有机质改良，也能适应多数土壤。炎热干燥的空气、寒风和晚霜可能导致叶片焦枯。秋季覆 mulch，可保护浅根免受寒害和干燥。参见 Japanese maple cultivation。
care.pruning: 修剪第 1 组
care.propagation: 可采用半成熟枝扦插或压条繁殖。

resistance.pest: 可能易受槭瘿螨、蚜虫、毛虫和七叶树介壳虫危害
resistance.disease: 可能易感黄萎病、槭叶焦枯病和蜜环菌病

rhs_zh.description: 小型、直立、生长缓慢的树木，最终高约 2 米、冠幅约 1.5 米。酒红色叶片具 5 枚细长、狭窄、边缘平滑的裂片，秋季转为鲜红色。春季开不显眼的绿色小花，秋季随后结红绿色翅果。

descriptions.preferred: Acer platanoides 'Erectum' Columar Norway Maple Zones 4-7 Acer platanoides ‘Erectum’ is an upright, columnar form of the Norway maple known for its strong vertical habit and symmetrical shape. Its dark green leaves create a dense canopy that turns a striking golden-yellow in fall, making it an excellent choice for narrow spaces, entryways, or formal landscapes. Adaptable to a wide range of soils and urban conditions, it requires minimal maintenance and responds well to light pruning. In 10 years, it typically reaches 15–20 ft tall and 5 ft wide, maintaining its tidy, architectural form while providing year-round structure and seasonal interest. Acer platanoides does not ship to CT, ME, MA, and NH. Limited Quantities Available !! As we have over a thousand cultivars of Japanese maples, we often do not have many of each cultivar. We recommend that you buy the Japanese maples you want immediately as we often sell out of certain selections.

descriptions_zh.preferred: Acer platanoides 'Erectum' 柱形挪威槭，适生区 4-7。Acer platanoides ‘Erectum’ 是挪威槭的直立柱形品种，以强劲的纵向生长势和对称树形著称。其深绿色叶片形成致密树冠，秋季转为醒目的金黄色，是狭窄空间、入口区域或规则式景观中的优良选择。对多种土壤和城市环境适应性强，养护需求低，也适合轻度修剪。10 年内通常可长至 15-20 英尺高、约 5 英尺宽，始终保持整洁而富建筑感的树形，全年都有结构美感并兼具季相变化。Acer platanoides 不配送至 CT、ME、MA 和 NH。数量有限。

descriptions.preferred: 爱斯基摩日落 的名称 源自新西兰的一个地区 ，它 是约翰 · 威尔斯 (John Wills) 在他位于新西兰北岛东海岸埃斯克谷 (Esk Valley) 的花园里偶然发现的 。 爱斯基摩日落叶子比较大，在早春时绿色和粉红色融合，之后粉红色的部分变成了明亮的奶油色。 值得一提的是， 爱斯基摩日落枫树的叶子背面是明亮的紫红色， 这是非常独特的 。秋天的颜色是明亮的金黄色到橙色。 成年树高约 4 m 左右 ， 夏季午后建议遮阴。

Leaves emerge orange-pink in spring, and mature to deep green marbled with light pink, cream and tan; the pale leaf surfaces contrasting with deep reddish-purple undersides. In autumn, leaves take on bright yellows and oranges before dropping

descriptions.preferred: The outstanding feature of this strong upright cultivar is the flush of autumn colors—gold through orange red —in the otherwise rich green leaves throughout the growing season, hence the name. This culminates in quite exceptional fall coloring. The almost rounded sevenor nine-lobed leaves are 8-10 cm long and wide, and are divided over two-thirds of the way to the leaf base. The lower lobes point sideways to form an almost flat leaf base. Each lobe is broad-ovate with a short tail-like pointed tip and has coarsely serrated margins. The petioles are 2-3 cm long. 'Ever Autumn' was selected in the mid-1980s and named by Dan Heims, Terra Nova Nurseries, Canby, Oregon, from a seedling in his garden. 'Omure yama' is a possible parent among other Acer palmatum cultivars.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这个强健直立品种最突出的特征，是其在整个生长季中原本浓绿色叶片上呈现出的秋色预演，从金黄色到橙红色，因此得名。这种色彩最终在秋季发展为极其出色的叶色。近圆形叶通常具 7 或 9 裂，长宽 8-10 厘米，自叶基向上约三分之二处分裂。下部裂片平展向侧方伸出，使叶基近乎平直。各裂片宽卵形，先端具短尾状尖，边缘具粗锯齿。叶柄长 2-3 厘米。‘Ever Autumn’ 于 20 世纪 80 年代中期由俄勒冈州 Canby 的 Terra Nova Nurseries 的 Dan Heims 从自家庭院中的一株实生苗中选育并命名。其亲本之一可能是 Acer palmatum 栽培品种中的 ‘Omure yama’。

products.title: Acer palmatum x circinatum 'Ever Autumn' Japanese Maple
products.description_text: Acer palmatum x circinatum 'Ever Autumn' Rare Ever Autumn Maple Hybrid Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 Found as a chance seedling on 'Omureyama' by our good friend, Dan Heims of Taranova Nurseries, this 'Ever Autumn' Japanese maple hybrid has a red hue to the green foliage that gives the ever appearance of fall color. We believe this selection to be hybrid with Acer circinatum that is indigenous to the Pacific Northwest, even though 'Ever Autumn' handles full sun in Western North Carolina. We have a beautiful 'Ever Autumn' at our gardens at Maplewood Gardens that is always putting on a show. Fall color is a much brighter orange to red. We expect 'Ever Autumn' to reach 12-15 ft in 10 years. The 'Ever Autumn' available here were grafted directly from the original 'Ever Autumn' at the home of Dan Heims. Limited Quantities Available !! As we have over a thousand cultivars of Japanese maples, we often do not have many of each cultivar. We recommend that you buy Japanese maples you want immediately as we often sell out of certain selections.

descriptions.preferred: 春季的新枝与新叶是红色永恒的区别性特征。新片与新枝上均覆盖有细腻的银色绒毛，所以它们刚萌发时几乎是灰色的。随即绒毛褪去，展现出其典型的浓郁而深沉的红色叶片。不幸的是，许多标记为红色永恒的枫树并不是这个品种。这些枫树的新叶并没有银色的绒毛，也不像红色永恒的叶片会保持红色。 红色永恒叶片七裂，裂叶细腻，各裂叶再开裂至叶片中脉。其裂叶亦具垂性，使垂枝状的树势更为轻柔。顾名思义，该品种的深红色可以保持至仲夏时节，远长于多数红色羽毛枫，但是不如 "绯红皇后"。 不同的光照强度会影响其叶色表现，部分遮阴可以延长叶片的深红色。夏末，叶片会染上青铜色或青铜绿色，秋季则是浓郁的亮红色。红色永恒长势旺盛，是典型的的蘑菇状树形。成年大型主树的株高可达5米，冠幅至少5米宽。 红色永恒是贸易中相当优秀的红羽毛枫之一 ， 最初该品种是从日本进口到欧洲的，当时命名为 " Dissectum Nigrum " 。但是1965年，进口到美国时又被Cascio命名为 " Ever Red " 。 它的 常用名还有 " Nigrum Dissectum "," Dissectum Atrosanguineum " ， " Dissectum Ever Red " 以及 " Pendulum Nigrum " 。

sources.description: 春季的新枝与新叶是红色永恒的区别性特征。新片与新枝上均覆盖有细腻的银色绒毛，所以它们刚萌发时几乎是灰色的。随即绒毛褪去，展现出其典型的浓郁而深沉的红色叶片。不幸的是，许多标记为红色永恒的枫树并不是这个品种。这些枫树的新叶并没有银色的绒毛，也不像红色永恒的叶片会保持红色。 红色永恒叶片七裂，裂叶细腻，各裂叶再开裂至叶片中脉。其裂叶亦具垂性，使垂枝状的树势更为轻柔。顾名思义，该品种的深红色可以保持至仲夏时节，远长于多数红色羽毛枫，但是不如 "绯红皇后"。 不同的光照强度会影响其叶色表现，部分遮阴可以延长叶片的深红色。夏末，叶片会染上青铜色或青铜绿色，秋季则是浓郁的亮红色。红色永恒长势旺盛，是典型的的蘑菇状树形。成年大型主树的株高可达5米，冠幅至少5米宽。 红色永恒是贸易中相当优秀的红羽毛枫之一 ， 最初该品种是从日本进口到欧洲的，当时命名为 " Dissectum Nigrum " 。但是1965年，进口到美国时又被Cascio命名为 " Ever Red " 。 它的 常用名还有 " Nigrum Dissectum "," Dissectum Atrosanguineum " ， " Dissectum Ever Red " 以及 " Pendulum Nigrum " 。

Small red flowers in spring are followed by winged fruits in autumn

descriptions.preferred: This outstanding red dissectum has two unusual features. First, the leaves bunch up at intervals along the shoots, causing the yellowish young leaves to look like brush tips. Second, the seven-lobed deeply dissected red leaves are of two kinds. One has the lobes narrowing near the leaf base to little more than the width of the midrib, with the lobes themselves deeply incised. The other has broader, much less deeply divided lobules, sometimes little more than large teeth, the lobes 7-9 cm long and 1-1.5 cm wide. The margins have coarsely sharp-pointed double teeth. The broader-lobed leaves ing later in the season. The bunches of young yellow leaves against the darker bronze green older foliage have a pleasant multicolored effect. 'Felice' forms a bushy mound estimated to reach a height and spread of about 3 m at maturity. It arose as a chance seedling which was named and introduced by Firma C. Esveld, Boskoop, Netherlands.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这个出色的红叶 Dissectum 类型有两个不寻常的特征。第一，叶片会沿枝条间隔性簇生，使带黄色调的新叶看起来像刷子的尖端。第二，7 裂的深裂红叶分为两种类型。一种裂片在叶基附近收窄，宽度几乎只略宽于中脉，且裂片本身进一步深裂；另一种裂片较宽，次级裂刻浅得多，有时几乎只是较大的齿，裂片长 7-9 厘米、宽 1-1.5 厘米。叶缘具粗大而尖锐的重锯齿。较宽裂片的叶片在季节后期形成。黄色幼叶簇与较深的古铜绿色老叶形成宜人的综合色效果。‘Felice’ 成熟后形成浓密的圆丘状株形，估计高和幅均约 3 米。它来源于一株偶然出现的实生苗，由荷兰 Boskoop 的 Firma C. Esveld 命名并引入。

descriptions.preferred: This small maple is probably my favorite among the variegated dissectums. Its delicate texture and interesting color changes make it a conversation piece. The basic color is light green, almost yellow green in the spring. It darkens as the season progresses. Entirely overlaid on the basic color is a profusion of minute dots, specks, or flecks of pale gold or cream. The leaf shape is so distinct and the color so difficult to describe that personal inspection is necessary. In the fall, the leaves attain a rich gold which holds very well. The bark of the twigs and branches is a silvery green with definite white striping or elongated flecking. The leaves are dissected entirely to the leaf base. Each of the seven lobes is delicately and deeply dissected almost to the midrib. In turn, each lobule is again toothed, sectums. It is compact and makes a well-rounded, cascading plant 2 m high and 3 m wide. Tall staking during early growth of the plant or high grafting on a standard is desirable. The plant will then cascade as it matures. The original plant is believed to belong to Joel Spingarn of Baldwin, New York. It was a chance purchase by him of a young green dissectum which developed these characters. Spingarn named it 'Filigree'—a valid name and an excellent choice. Later a plant or two appeared in the West without proper nomenclature. It has been called'GreenFiligree'.Thename'SilverLace'wasattached to it but, according to Spingarn's records and history, this is a misnomer. 'Filigree' is a very desirable cultivar for landscapers as well as collectors. 'Fior d'Arancio' matsumurae -red The leaves of this cultivar are similar in shape and size to those of 'Wakehurst Pink', without the variegation and with chunkier, less hooked teeth on the margins of young leaves. The leaves emerge a bright orange red, becoming a bronze and copper red as they develop. They tend to green up easily when shaded. The contrast of orange-red young leaves on a background of coppergreen older leaves and possibly green-shaded leaves can produce an attractive multicolor effect. The large sevenlobed leaves are 10-11 cm long and 11-12 cm wide, and very prominent in young leaves. The stiff reddish bronze petioles are 4-7 cm long. This cultivar forms an upright rounded tree up to 5-6 m high. It originated at the Fratelli Gilardelli Nursery, near Milan, Italy. The name has been misspelled 'Fior d'Arangio'.

sources.description: 彗星是一款生长缓慢非常美丽的脉叶羽毛枫，叶裂很 深，叶型非常独特，非常适合小型花园或水景。'Filigree' 春天的叶子呈浅黄绿色，略带奶油色，带有沿着叶脉 的白色点状斑点，秋天的颜色橙黄或者橙红色，需要 保护免受烈日照射，成年树高约 1 米。

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这种小型槭树大概是我在斑叶羽裂类中最喜欢的品种。它质感细腻，叶色变化有趣，很适合作为引人谈论的观赏树。基础叶色为浅绿色，春季几乎接近黄绿色，随后随着季节推进而逐渐加深。在这一底色之上，密布着极细小的淡金色或乳白色点斑、斑点或细碎斑纹。其叶形极具特色，而颜色又难以准确描述，因此最好亲自观察。秋季叶片转为浓郁的金色，且观赏期保持较好。小枝和枝条树皮呈银绿色，并带有明显的白色条纹或细长斑纹。叶片深裂直达叶基。7 个主裂片中的每一裂片又几乎深裂至中脉；随后每个小裂片边缘再次具锯齿，呈典型 sectum 状。植株紧凑，形成圆整而下垂的树形，高约 2 米、宽约 3 米。幼年生长阶段宜设高支柱牵引，或高位嫁接于标准砧木上，成熟后便可形成优美的垂枝姿态。原始植株据信属于纽约州 Baldwin 的 Joel Spingarn。那是他偶然购得的一株年轻绿色羽裂型植株，后来表现出这些特征。Spingarn 将其命名为 ‘Filigree’；这是一个有效名称，而且非常贴切。后来西部地区曾出现一两株类似植株，但命名并不规范。它曾被称作 ‘Green Filigree’。‘Silver Lace’ 这一名称也曾被附会到它身上，但根据 Spingarn 的记录和历史，这属于误称。‘Filigree’ 是一个无论对景观设计者还是收藏者都极具价值的品种。‘Fior d'Arancio’ matsumurae -red。该品种叶形和叶片大小与 ‘Wakehurst Pink’ 相似，但没有斑锦，且幼叶叶缘齿更粗壮、钩状感较弱。叶片萌发时呈鲜亮的橙红色，随后发展为青铜红和铜红色。在遮荫条件下容易转绿。橙红色新叶与铜绿色老叶，甚至部分因遮荫而转绿的叶片形成对比，可产生迷人的多色效果。大型叶片通常 7 裂，长 10–11 厘米、宽 11–12 厘米，幼叶阶段尤为醒目。红铜色叶柄坚挺，长 4–7 厘米。该品种形成直立、圆整的小乔木，高可达 5–6 米。其起源于意大利米兰附近的 Fratelli Gilardelli Nursery。该名称曾被误拼为 ‘Fior d'Arangio’。

products.name: Acer palmatum 'Filigree' Reticulated Lace Leaf Japanese Maple
products.description_text: This is a very rare reticulated leaf form dissectum. The new leaves in spring are light green sometimes almost white with dark veins. A great plant for many parts of the world. Although very beautiful 'Filigree' is more of a collector plant in hotter climates as summers heat will really do a number on it around August, causing it to drop a large percentage of it's leaves. This is caused by heat and not lack of water. If you must try your luck with this plant in hotter climates please place in a cool shady spot. The growth habit is very pendulous and fall color is usually yellow to orange. 10 Year Size: Height: 3-6 Feet Width: 4-8 Feet

descriptions.preferred: Acer palmatum 'Fireball' Fireball Dwarf Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 'Fireball' is an interesting new red dwarf. It was found as a witches' broom near Cedarville, New Jersey, making this maple fairly cold tolerant. In the ground, 'Fireball' can withstand temperatures down to -15°F. In 15 years, this tree will reach 5 ft tall by 4 ft wide. Due to its small stature, this Japanese maple is ideal for fairy gardens, rail-road gardens, rock gardens, small conifer beds, and container planting. It leafs out a bright cherry red in the early spring, transforming to a deep maroon by mid-spring. All new growth on top is a bright cherry red overtop of this deep maroon. Some green-red tones appear by late spring, creating a wonderful contrast of colors. The name 'Fireball' is very fitting. In the fall, this Japanese maple will light up your yard when its leaves transform to a bright fire-engine red. Limited Quantities Available !! descriptions.preferred: This impressive and reliable cultivar is a vigorous, upright, well-branched shrub or small tree. It is similar to the popular, well-tried and tested 'Bloodgood', but the leaves are not as deeply divided and it has a deeper, more intense, red color which stays throughout the summer, even in hot, sunny conditions. The new leaves emerge a very bright pink red in the spring before turning a deep red. The upper surface retains its color well into late summer and does not burn in hot sun. The foliage becomes purple red suffused with green in early fall. The seven-lobed medium-sized leaves are divided to just over two-thirds of the way to the leaf base, with the small basal lobes at right angles to the petioles. The leaves are 7-9 cm long and 9-11 cm wide. The ovate lobes are 5-6 cm long and 2-2.5 cm broad at the widest point in the middle, narrowing to 1-1.5 cm at the lobe junctions. The junctions are 1.5-2.5 cm from the leaf base. The leaf margins are evenly and sharply double toothed. m after 30 years. 'Fireglow' was first selected and developed by the Fratelli Gilardelli Nursery, near Milan, Italy, under the code FGI. The name 'Fireglow' aptly describes the eye-catching effect when the leaves are backlit by the sun. A Dutch nursery later sold this same cultivar under the name 'Effigi', which has been misspelled as 'Effigy'.

It thrives in well-drained, slightly acidic soil and partial shade, making it easy to care for and adaptable to various climates. At Herter Nursery, we ensure that each Fireglow Japanese Maple is carefully cultivated for optimal growth, offering vibrant foliage and a robust, healthy structure. This tree’s large leaves and elegant form create a stunning visual impact in any garden, whether planted in the ground or as a potted tree. descriptions_zh.preferred: 这是一个表现出色且性状稳定的品种，生长势强，株形直立，分枝良好，可形成灌木或小乔木。它与广受欢迎、久经栽培检验的 'Bloodgood' 相似，但叶片裂刻不如后者深，且叶色更深、更浓烈，整个夏季都能保持鲜红色，即使在炎热、日照充足的条件下也是如此。春季新叶萌发时呈极鲜亮的粉红红色，随后转为深红色。叶片上表面可一直保持良好色泽至夏末，在烈日下也不易焦灼。初秋时叶色变为带绿色晕染的紫红色。叶片中等大小，通常 7 裂，裂片深达叶基约三分之二以上，基部较小的裂片与叶柄近成直角。叶长 7-9 厘米，宽 9-11 厘米。裂片卵形，长 5-6 厘米，中部最宽处 2-2.5 厘米，在裂片连接处收窄至 1-1.5 厘米；连接处距叶基 1.5-2.5 厘米。叶缘均匀且锐利地呈重锯齿。30 年后可达数米高。'Fireglow' 最早由意大利米兰附近的 Fratelli Gilardelli 苗圃以编号 FGI 选育并推广。'Fireglow' 这一名称恰当地描绘了叶片在阳光逆光照射下极为醒目的观赏效果。后来一家荷兰苗圃曾以 'Effigi' 之名销售同一品种，该名称又曾被误拼为 'Effigy'。

products.title: Acer palmatum 'Fireglow' Japanese Maple
products.description_text: Acer palmatum 'Fireglow' Excellent Bright Red 'Fireglow' Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 'Fireglow' is an excellent red upright Japanese maple tree that reaches 10-12 ft in 15 years. 'Fireglow' leafs out as a bright red, before maturing to a deep maroon for the summer. 'Fireglow' will get an orange-red glow to the back side of the leaf when grown in the sun, giving the tree a brighter appearance and making it glow, when looking up from below. 'Fireglow' turns to a brighter fiery red in the fall. The 'Fireglow' Japanese maple is an excellent heat tolerant red selection that can perform well in the South as well as the colder climates of the North. Being a smaller mid-sized tree, 'Fireglow' can provide color in the landscape while easily keeping a smaller stature than other comparable red upright Japanese maples trees. 'Fireglow' is one of the most desired Japanese maples.

descriptions.preferred: This plant arose from a witches'-broom growing on the ever-popular 'Sango kaku' and discovered by the late Ilo Sorenson from the Blue Mountains near Sydney, Australia. It has retained all the characteristics of its famous parent—the beautiful coral-red shoots and the five-lobed palmatum-type leaf shape, size, and coloring. The notable difference is that 'Fjellheim' is much bushier and shorter. Although in young plants, vigorous shoots may extend to 1.5 m, growth slows down with age. Hence, 'Fjellheim' forms a much more compact bush than 'Sango kaku'. For this reason, it was known under the illegitimate name 'Sango kaku Dwarf'. With its spectacular bark, the beautiful spring and fall coloring of the leaves, and its compact growth, this introduction is ideally suited for the small garden and as a container plant. and early summer foliage makes this maple quite different. The green tones of the foliage darken as summer progresses. The fall color is usually a good tone of yellow, occasionally tinged with orange. The leaves are of good texture and durable. There are seven lobes, sometimes five, which are deeply separated entirely to the leaf base. Each lobe is itself incised and toothed along the margins. However, the individual lobes are not as deeply pinnatifid as they are in most typical dissectums. The leaves measure up to 10 cm long and wide. The plant is very vigorous and has the typical pendulous habit of the Dissectum Group. It is desirable to Corvallis

descriptions_zh.preferred: 该植株来源于一枝生长在广受欢迎的 ‘Sango kaku’ 上的丛生变异枝（witches'-broom），由已故的 Ilo Sorenson 在澳大利亚悉尼附近的 Blue Mountains 发现。它保留了其著名亲本的全部特征，包括美丽的珊瑚红色新枝，以及掌叶型 5 裂叶的叶形、大小和色泽。显著区别在于，‘Fjellheim’ 的分枝更密，株形更矮。虽然幼株上的强旺新梢可延伸至 1.5 米，但随着植株老熟，生长速度会减缓。因此，‘Fjellheim’ 形成的灌木比 ‘Sango kaku’ 更为紧凑。这也是它曾以不合法名称 ‘Sango kaku Dwarf’ 流通的原因。凭借其醒目的枝干色彩、优美的春秋叶色以及紧凑株形，这一引种非常适合小庭园及容器栽培。其春末至初夏叶色使这株槭树显得颇为不同。叶片的绿色调随夏季推进而逐渐加深。秋色通常为良好的黄色，偶尔带橙色。叶片质地佳，耐观赏。叶片通常有 7 裂，有时为 5 裂，深裂直达叶基。每个裂片本身边缘又有缺刻和锯齿。不过，单个裂片并不像大多数典型羽裂类那样深度羽状裂开。叶片长宽均可达 10 厘米。植株生长非常强健，具 Dissectum Group 典型的下垂习性。它适合用于 Corvallis

descriptions.preferred: This medium-sized shrubby tree to 23 ft. (7 m) tall has stunning fall color. The leaves are a typical shape and size for the subspecies. Colored a glossy green, they contrast with clusters of red fruits from early summer onwards. Fall color is a fiery red. 'Flame' makes a fine specimen tree. It can also be used in a shrub border. Acer truncatum Purple-blow maple This species is very closely related to and quite similar to the painted maple, Acer pictum. Native to northern China, Manchuria, Siberia, North Korea, and the Japanese island of Sakhalin, it grows on the plains and lower mountain slopes at elevations of 330-2970 ft. (100-900 m) above sea level. This desirable maple grows into a large, wide-spreading bush or medium-sized tree 39-50 ft. (12-15 m) high. The bark is reputed to be the roughest and most deeply fissured of any maple. The attractive, deeply divided, glossy ivylike leaves are more deeply divided than those of the typical A. pictum, separating at least twothirds way toward the leaf base. The mediumsized leaves are mostly five-lobed often with a characteristically straight leaf base. Each triangular-ovate lobe has a long, slender, pointed tip. The center lobe may have one or a pair of broad, pointed teeth on the outer shoulder. The emerging leaves are an eye-catching red to purple shade, soon becoming glossy green for the summer, and turning to a brilliant shiny yelloworange in the fall with red and purple. The specific name means "truncated," referring to the often flat leaf base.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这是一种中等大小的灌木状小乔木，高可达 23 英尺（7 米），秋色极为出众。叶片形状和大小都属于该亚种的典型特征。叶色为有光泽的绿色，自初夏起与成簇的红色果实形成鲜明对比。秋季转为火焰般的红色。‘Flame’ 是极佳的标本树，也可用于灌木花境。Acer truncatum Purple-blow maple。该种与色木槭 Acer pictum 亲缘关系很近，整体也颇为相似。原产中国北部、满洲里地区、西伯利亚、朝鲜北部以及日本萨哈林岛，生长于海拔 330–2970 英尺（100–900 米）的平原及低山坡地。这个优良槭树种可生长为大型、开展的灌木，或中等大小乔木，高 39–50 英尺（12–15 米）。据称其树皮是所有槭树中最粗糙、纵裂最深者之一。其叶片美观，具光泽，形似常春藤，裂分比典型 A. pictum 更深，至少达到叶基方向的三分之二。中等大小叶片通常为 5 裂，且常具特征性的平直叶基。每个三角状卵形裂片都有细长尖锐的先端。中央裂片外侧肩部可能带有 1 枚或一对宽而尖的齿。新叶展开时呈醒目的红至紫色，很快在夏季转为有光泽的绿色；秋季则转为鲜亮闪耀的黄橙色，并带红色和紫色调。种加词意为“截形的”，指其叶基常呈平截状。

descriptions.preferred: The distinct yellowgreen foliage makes this cultivar worthwhile. The green tones of the large leaves darken as summer progresses. Fall color is yellow, occasionally tinged orange. The five to seven deeply separated lobes are incised and toothed along the margins but not as deeply cut to the midrib as in most dissectums. This plant is very vigorous and matures at 8 ft. (2.5 m) high and 10 ft. (3 m) wide. The name means "yellowish."

rhs.description: Spreading, shrubby tree to about 2m in height and 3m wide, with cascading branches and lacy, 7-lobed leaves deeply separated to the leaf base, the colour soft yellow-green in spring, the green tones becoming darker through summer followed by yellow autumn colour with orange tints

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这一品种的独特黄绿色叶色使其颇具栽培价值。随着夏季推进，大型叶片中的绿色调会逐渐加深。秋色为黄色，偶尔带橙色晕染。叶具 5 至 7 个深度分离的裂片，边缘具裂刻和锯齿，但不像多数 Dissectum 类型那样深切至中脉。植株生长非常旺盛，成熟时高约 8 英尺（2.5 米），幅约 10 英尺（3 米）。“其名意为‘微黄’。”

descriptions_zh.preferred: Acer tataricum 'GarAnn' Hot Wings ™ Tatarian Maple，植物专利号 PP #15,023，适生区 3-8。* 以 3 加仑种植袋发货 * Hot Wings™ 是鞑靼槭的一种优秀新选型。鞑靼槭耐寒性极强，同时也较耐偏碱性土壤，并可生长在海拔高达 7,500 英尺的地区。Hot Wings™ 的特别之处在于其树形更圆整、秋色更佳，而且翅果翅片可呈现更出色且更持久的红色。Hot Wings™ 春季叶片为绿色，并开出小簇白花。这些花随后发育为红色种子，这也是 Hot Wings™ 名称的由来。秋季时，Hot Wings™ 会同时呈现橙色、红色和黄色，在庭园中形成极具观赏性的季相景观。Hot Wings™ 在 10 年内可长至约 15-18 英尺高，树形圆整优美。很遗憾，此树无法寄送至缅因州、亚利桑那州或纽约州。数量有限！！由于我们拥有上千个日本枫品种，单个品种通常库存不多。建议您看到心仪的日本枫及时购买，因为部分选种经常很快售罄。

products.description_text: Acer tataricum 'GarAnn' Hot Wings ™ Tatarian Maple PP #15,023 Zones 3-8 * SHIPS IN 3 GALLON GROW BAG * Hot Wings™ is an excellent new form of Tatarian Maple. The Tatarian maple is extremely cold tolerant and also tolerant of more alkaline soils. It also can grow up to 7,500 ft in elevation. Where Hot Wings™ is different is that is has a better- rounded habit, better fall color, and superb longer lasting red color on the wings of the samaras (seeds). Hot Wings™ starts out in the spring with green leaves and small clusters of white flowers. These flowers develop into the red seeds that gives Hot Wings™ its name. In the fall, Hot Wings™ turns to oranges, reds, and yellows all at the same time, creating a display that you will enjoy in your garden. Hot Wings™ may reach 15-18 ft in height with a nice, rounded habit in 10 years. Unfortunately, we cannot ship this tree to Maine, Arizona or New York. Limited Quantities Available !! As we have over a thousand cultivars of Japanese maples, we often do not have many of each cultivar. We recommend that you buy the Japanese maples you want immediately as we often sell out of certain selections.

descriptions.preferred: The outstanding features of this cultivar are its color and vigor. The leaf color is the rich red orange of the gemstone garnet. When this maple is grown in shade, the leaves retain a greenish cast, but in a sunny location the garnet color develops well. It is a vigorous-growing form eventually attaining a height of 4 m or more. When very heavily fertilized, the plant sends out new shoots up to 1 m on young plants. In the landscape, however, the shoots are not as long, and the plant shapes itself well. It has the pendulous, spreading habit of dissectums, and as it matures forms a beautiful, cascading, mound-shaped specimen. The leaves are large for a dissectum, and the deep color holds well into the summer season. Well-fertilized young plants have leaf lobes up to 12 cm long, although most are shorter. Each of the seven lobes separates entirely to the leaf base. The side incisions on each lobe do not cut as deeply toward the midrib as do some other dissectums, and are not as delicate. The whole leaf appears a little coarser than that of most red dissectums. This plant originated with Guldemond of the Netherlands, who sold the stock plants and propagating rights to Le Faber and Company of Boskoop. Later, propagation rights were given to Hauenstein, Rafz CH, of Switzerland. It has become a popular cultivar with nursdwarf -green This name, which means "one's own style or manner," is certainly suitable for this cultivar. The foliage is most distinctive. The leaves appear small and delicate, although measurements show them to be larger than they look. The smaller leaves are 2-4 cm long and wide, while the larger leaves measure 6-8 cm long and 6-9 cm wide. These dimensions are misleading since the leaves are so long and slender that they appear much more delicate than indicated. Each leaf has three lobes, sometimes five, which separate entirely to the leaf base. The lobes almost form a T. They are elongate-lanceolate, narrow at the base, tapering to a narrow tip. While the lobe may measure 5-6 cm long, it does not exceed 1 cm in width. However, it is not as parallel-sided as cultivars in the Linearilobum Group. The margins are complex—deeply toothed to lobulate or combinations of both. The lobes do not lie flat but twist sideways, curl up or down, or become slightly sickle shaped. This variation occurs between leaves or even on the same leaf. The entire appearance of the foliage is rather disorganized, but it is attractive. The colors also vary. Basically the foliage is medium to light green. New foliage has a definite red overtone, which may persist around the margins. Some older foliage also assumes a red tone in full light. This compact dwarf tends to produce indefinite directions of the twigs, much as with the foliage. It is semiprostrate in habit but also has some shoots growing erect. The nodes on the twigs are very close together. Duncan and Davies Nursery of New Zealand raised this amazing dwarf cultivar. In spring the deeply divided leaves are delicate shades of pink to light cream, sparsely flecked with dark and medium green spots and small patches. The creamy areas turn a pale yellow green and the main veins become green as the leaf matures, but the attractive pink tones persist all through the summer. The fiveor seven-lobed leaves are divided almost to the leaf base, and are 7-10 cm long and 7-12 cm wide— surprisingly large for such a dwarf plant. The lobes are narrowly ovate with tail-like pointed tips, 5.5-9 cm long by 1.5-2.5 cm wide at the broadest point in the lower third, and narrowing to 3-8 mm wide at the lobe junctions which are 3-10 mm from the leaf base. The margins have large coarse double teeth. The slender pink petioles are 2.5-5 cm long. 'Geisha' is a slow-growing bushy dwarf, eventually reaching 1 m high and about the same spread. It is a distinct and very unusual cultivar, unlike any other dwarf and, as the pastel colors suggest, is somewhat delicate and needs protection and semishade. It makes a fine patio plant and is ideal for containers. 'Germaine's Gyration' dissectum -green This lace-leaved maple grows more vigorously than most dissectums, so that the cascading branches twist and undulate, giving rise to the "gyration" half of the name. It broadest point and is again divided into sublobes but not as deeply as in most dissectums. The sublobes are little more than large teeth reaching only about halfway to the midrib, and are themselves coarsely toothed. The dark green of the summer foliage changes to beautiful tones of yellow, orange, and red in the fall. Like most dissectums, this plant forms a cascading mushroomshaped mound, but it is much wider than tall.

rhs.description: Vigorous, deciduous shrubby tree about 4m tall with a cascading habit. Leaves with deeply dissected 7 lobes, are rich brownish-red throughout summer, slightly brighter in autumn. Small purplish spring flowers are followed by red fruits in summer

care.cultivation: Grow in any moisture-retentive, well-drained soil in a sheltered position. Leaf colour is best in full sun which can be tolerated if soil is reliably moist. Leaf scorch can be caused by lack of soil moisture or excessive exposure. Suits container cultivation but attention to watering is needed in dry spells during the growing season. See Japanese maples cultivation
care.pruning: Pruning group 1 , if necessary, from late autumn to midwinter only
care.propagation: Propagate by grafting or softwood cuttings

resistance.pest: May be susceptible to Acer gall mite, aphids , caterpillars and horse chestnut scale
resistance.disease: May be susceptible to Verticillium wilt , acer leaf scorch and honey fungus

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这个品种最突出的特点是叶色和长势。叶色为宝石石榴石般浓郁的红橙色。栽于阴处时，叶片会保留一些绿色调；在阳光充足的位置，则能更好地显现石榴石般的色泽。其生长势强，最终高度可达 4 米或更高。若施肥非常充足，幼株可抽生长达 1 米的新梢；但在园林种植环境中，枝条通常不会这么长，株形也更容易整齐成形。它具有 Dissectum 类型常见的下垂开展习性，随着植株成熟，会形成优美的瀑布状圆丘形树姿。对裂叶枫而言，其叶片偏大，且深色能良好保持到夏季。施肥充足的幼株，其叶裂片可长达 12 厘米，不过多数较短。7 个裂片均完全分裂至叶基。每个裂片两侧的次级裂刻不像某些其他 Dissectum 类型那样深切向中脉，因此整体不那么纤细，整片叶看起来也比大多数红叶裂叶型更粗犷一些。该品种源于荷兰的 Guldemond，后者将母株及繁殖权售予 Boskoop 的 Le Faber and Company，之后繁殖权又授予瑞士 Rafz CH 的 Hauenstein。该品种后来在苗圃业中广受欢迎。 “dwarf -green” 这一名称意为“自己的风格或方式”，确实很适合这个品种。其叶片极具特色。叶子看起来小巧而纤细，尽管实际测量显示比视觉感受稍大。较小的叶片长宽为 2-4 厘米，较大的叶片长 6-8 厘米、宽 6-9 厘米。不过这些尺寸具有误导性，因为叶片非常细长，看起来远比数字所示更精致。每片叶具 3 裂，有时 5 裂，均完全分裂至叶基，裂片几乎形成 T 字形。裂片为狭长披针形，基部狭窄，渐尖成细长尖端。单个裂片虽可长 5-6 厘米，但宽度不超过 1 厘米。不过，它并不像 Linearilobum Group 品种那样呈明显平行边。叶缘形态复杂，深锯齿至浅裂小裂片，或二者兼有。裂片并不平展，而会向侧面扭转、向上或向下卷曲，或略呈镰刀形。这种变化可能发生在不同叶片之间，甚至同一片叶上。整体叶貌较为不规则，但颇具观赏性。叶色也有变化，基本为中绿至浅绿色。新叶带有明显红色调，且这种红晕可能持续保留在叶缘；部分老叶在全光照下也会呈现红色调。这个紧凑的矮生品种，其小枝的生长方向也像叶片一样不定。株形半匍匐，但也会有部分枝条直立生长。枝条节间极短。该惊艳的矮生品种由新西兰 Duncan and Davies Nursery 育出。 春季时，其深裂叶呈柔和的粉色至浅奶油色，并零星点缀深绿和中绿色斑点及小斑块。随着叶片成熟，奶油色部分转为浅黄绿色，主脉变绿，但迷人的粉色调可持续整个夏季。叶通常具 5 或 7 裂，几乎分裂至叶基，长 7-10 厘米、宽 7-12 厘米，对于如此矮小的植株而言可谓相当大。裂片狭卵形，先端具尾状尖，长 5.5-9 厘米，在下部三分之一处最宽为 1.5-2.5 厘米，在裂片连接处收窄至 3-8 毫米宽，而这些连接处距叶基仅 3-10 毫米。叶缘具粗大的重锯齿。细长的粉色叶柄长 2.5-5 厘米。‘Geisha’ 是生长缓慢、丛生的矮生品种，最终高约 1 米，冠幅也大致相同。它是一个鲜明而极为特别的品种，与其他任何矮生品种都不同；从其柔和的综合色来看，它也稍显娇嫩，需要遮护和半阴环境。它是极佳的庭院植物，也非常适合容器栽培。 ‘Germaine's Gyration’：绿色裂叶型。这种线裂叶日本枫的生长势强于大多数 Dissectum 类型，因此其下垂的枝条会扭转并起伏波动，这也正是名称中 “gyration” 一词的由来。其叶片在最宽处再次分裂为次级裂片，但不像大多数 Dissectum 类型那样分裂得那么深。次级裂片几乎只是较大的齿，仅向中脉方向延伸约一半，并且本身也具粗锯齿。夏季叶色深绿，秋季转为优美的黄、橙、红综合色。与多数 Dissectum 类型一样，该品种形成瀑布状、蘑菇形圆丘株形，但横向开展明显大于高度。

descriptions.preferred: The small medium green to light green leaves have three to five very narrow lobes separated almost entirely to the base. The lobes are elongate-lanceolate, tapering to a narrow tip. They twist sideways, curl up or down, or become slightly sickle-shaped. The margins are complex—deeply toothed to lobulate or combinations of both. The entire appearance of the foliage is disorganized but attractive. New leaves have a red overtone, which may persist around the margins. This compact dwarf is semiprostrate in habit. It eventually reaches about 3 ft. (1 m) high and wide. The name means "one's own style or manner," aptly describing this cultivar's distinctive foliage.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 小型的中绿色至浅绿色叶片有三至五个极狭长的裂片，裂片几乎一直分裂到叶基。裂片呈细长披针形，先端渐尖。裂片会向侧面扭转、向上或向下卷曲，或略呈镰刀状。叶缘变化复杂，可为深锯齿、浅裂，或两者兼具。整体叶姿显得不规整，却颇具观赏性。新叶带有一层红色晕染，且这种红色有时会持续保留在叶缘。该品种为紧凑型矮生植株，株形半匍匐。最终高、宽约 3 英尺（1 米）。其名称意为“自己的风格或方式”，恰如其分地描述了该品种独特的叶态。

descriptions.preferred: In the spring, the deeply divided leaves are delicate shades of pink to light cream, sparsely flecked with dark green and medium green spots and small patches. The creamy areas turn a pale yellow-green and the main veins become green in the summer, but the Acer attractive pink tones persist. The medium-sized leaves are divided into five to seven narrowly ovate lobes with tail-like pointed tips and coarsely toothed margins. The leaves are intermediate in shape between palmate and straplike. The short, slender leafstalks are pink. 'Geisha' is a slowgrowing bushy tree, eventually reaching 8 ft. (2.5 m) tall. It is distinct, unusual, and somewhat delicate, needing protection and semishade. It makes a fine patio plant and is ideal for containers. The name means "young dancing girl." 'Germaine's Gyration' Dissectum Group—green. This laceleaf grows more vigorously than most dissectums, so the Acer long cascading branches twist and are wavy, giv- Harry ing rise to the "gyration" half of the name. The large, coarse sevento nine-lobed, dissected leaves are again cut into sublobes but not as deeply as in most dissectums. The sublobes themselves are coarsely toothed. The dark green summer foliage changes to a beautiful yellow, orange, and red in the fall. This plant forms a cascading mushroom-shaped mound, much wider than tall. The name honors Germaine Iseli of the famed Oregon nursery family.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 春季时，其深裂叶呈细腻的粉色至浅乳白色，上面稀疏散布深绿色和中绿色小斑点及小斑块。到夏季，乳白色部分会转为淡黄绿色，主脉变绿，但迷人的粉色调仍可持续。中等大小的叶片分为 5 至 7 个狭卵形裂片，裂片先端呈尾状渐尖，叶缘具粗锯齿。叶形介于掌状叶与带状叶之间。短而细的叶柄为粉色。'Geisha' 生长缓慢，株形丛生，最终可达 8 英尺（2.5 米）高。其性状鲜明、少见，且略显娇嫩，需加以保护并置于半阴环境。很适合作为庭院观赏植物，也非常适合容器栽培。其名称意为“年轻的舞女”。 'Germaine's Gyration' 属于 Dissectum Group，为绿色系。该羽裂叶品种的生长势强于多数 Dissectum 类型，长而下垂的枝条呈扭转和波浪状，因此名称中有 “gyration” 之意。叶片较大、质感较粗，具 7 至 9 个裂片，深裂后又再分裂成次级裂片，但裂刻不如多数 Dissectum 品种那样深；次级裂片本身也具粗锯齿。夏季叶色为深绿色，秋季转为美丽的黄色、橙色和红色。植株形成瀑布状、蘑菇形的堆状树冠，宽度远大于高度。其名称是为纪念著名俄勒冈苗圃家族成员 Germaine Iseli。

products.name: Acer palmatum 'Geisha' Variegated Japanese Maple
products.description_text: A dwarf pink variegated maple with irregularly shaped leaves originally from New Zealand, 'Geisha' is perfect for maple fanatics and casual gardeners alike. In spring leaves emerge a stunning pink often with green spots and sometimes with odd misshapen partially purple leaves. In summer the leaves change to green with cream markings. Fall color is orange. 'Geisha' requires protection from hot afternoon sun. 10 year size: Height: 8-10Feet Width: 6-8 Feet

descriptions.preferred: Acer palmatum 'Geisha Gone Wild' Pink Variegated Japanese Maple Zones 5 - 9 'Geisha Gone Wild' Japanese maple was found as a variegated sport off of 'Geisha'. 'Geisha Gone Wild' is a beauty that leafs out with bright pink margined variegation on a deeper red. By summer, in full sun in the south the leaf on 'Geisha Gone Wild' changes to a green with cream variegation. When given morning sun and afternoon shade, the spring pink and red coloration maintains for the longest amount of time. 'Geisha Gone Wild' will reach 7 ft in 10 years with a vase-like shape. Fall colors on the 'Geisha Gone Wild' Japanese maple are a hot pink to bright purples.

descriptions_zh.preferred: Acer palmatum 'Geisha Gone Wild' 粉色斑锦日本枫，适生分区 5-9。'Geisha Gone Wild' 是从 'Geisha' 上发现的一枝斑锦芽变。它展叶时非常美丽，深红色叶片上镶有鲜亮的粉色斑锦叶缘。到了夏季，在南方全日照条件下，'Geisha Gone Wild' 的叶片会转为绿色，并带有乳白色斑锦。若给予上午阳光、下午遮阴，其春季的粉色与红色叶色可维持更长时间。'Geisha Gone Wild' 在 10 年内可长至约 7 英尺，树形呈花瓶状。秋季叶色为亮粉色至鲜亮紫色。

products.title: Acer palmatum 'Geisha Gone Wild' Japanese Maple
products.description_text: Acer palmatum 'Geisha Gone Wild' Pink Variegated Japanese Maple Zones 5 - 9 'Geisha Gone Wild' Japanese maple was found as a variegated sport off of 'Geisha'. 'Geisha Gone Wild' is a beauty that leafs out with bright pink margined variegation on a deeper red. By summer, in full sun in the south the leaf on 'Geisha Gone Wild' changes to a green with cream variegation. When given morning sun and afternoon shade, the spring pink and red coloration maintains for the longest amount of time. 'Geisha Gone Wild' will reach 7 ft in 10 years with a vase-like shape. Fall colors on the 'Geisha Gone Wild' Japanese maple are a hot pink to bright purples.

descriptions.preferred: Acer palmatum dissectum 'Germaine's Gyration' Large Cascading Germaine's Gyration Contorted Laceleaf Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 ‘Germaine’s Gyration’ is an excellent pendulous dissectum that has an unusual twisting growth habit. This Japanese maple tree selection naturally contorts as it grows creating very intricate spirals. This unique effect is magnified by the lateral branching. ‘Germaine’s Gyration’ has a larger leaf than most laceleaf Japanese maples reaching 10 ft in height by 15 ft in width in 20 years. Early spring color is a light green which merges to bright shades of yellow and orange throughout the autumn months. This Japanese maple was named after Germaine Iseli and has also been known as "Contorta" because of its unique contorting habit. Germaine's Gyration is one of the quickest growing of the cascading laceleaf types. For those wanting a focal point with a true large specimen Japanese maple in the garden, this is a perfect tree for you. descriptions_zh.preferred: Acer palmatum dissectum 'Germaine's Gyration' 大型下垂型扭曲羽裂日本枫，适生分区 5-9。'Germaine's Gyration' 是一个极佳的下垂型羽裂日本枫，具有不同寻常的扭曲生长习性。该品种在生长过程中会自然扭转，形成非常复杂的螺旋结构，而其横向分枝又进一步强化了这种独特效果。'Germaine's Gyration' 的叶片比多数羽裂日本枫更大，20 年内可达 10 英尺高、15 英尺宽。早春叶色为浅绿色，到了秋季会转为明亮的黄色和橙色。这个日本枫以 Germaine Iseli 命名，也曾因其独特的扭曲习性而被称作“Contorta”。'Germaine's Gyration' 是下垂型羽裂品种中生长较快的一个。对于希望在花园中拥有真正大型标本级日本枫、作为视觉焦点的人来说，这是非常理想的选择。'Germaine's Gyration' 的主图为南卡罗来纳州 Spartanburg 的 Bill 和 Kristin Taylor 花园中的一株老株。**10 加仑植株因包装箱尺寸限制，将不连盆发货** 请注意，您的 10 加仑植株到货时将不带容器。除非您要求延迟发货，否则会立即发出。请提前为无容器的 10 加仑植株做好准备。数量有限！！由于我们拥有上千个日本枫品种，每个品种通常库存不多。我们建议您尽快购买心仪的日本枫，因为某些品种常常很快售罄。

descriptions.preferred: As the name implies this green dwarf forms a round ball. The thick brown shoots have very short internodes so the fully grown tree is no taller than 1.5 m and about as wide. The typically palmate five-lobed, sometimes sevenlobed, green leaves are up to 7 cm long and 7-8 cm wide, and are divided at least two-thirds of the way to the leaf base. The broad lobes are angled downwards and outward. Each lobe is ovate-triangular with a tail-like tip, 15 mm wide at the broadest point in the lower third, narrowing to 6-10 mm at the lobe junctions. The large angular double teeth uniformly arranged around the margins give the leaves an attractive feathery look. The leaves are the same shape and color as those of 'O|jishi' and turn yellow in the fall. 'Globosum' is thought to have This cultivar has the same stunning deep yellow-orange fall color as 'Ho\gyoku', with the leaves similar in shape but smaller in size. The summer color is a medium green. However, the growth habit is exactly the opposite, about one and a half times as wide as tall—4.5 m wide and 3 m tall—more like that of 'Shigure zome'. 'Golden Pond' has been growing at Firma C. Esveld in Boskoop, Netherlands, for 25 years and, after many years of observation, was named in 1996.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 顾名思义，这个绿色矮生品种会形成圆球状树形。其粗壮的褐色新梢节间极短，因此成株通常不高于 1.5 米，冠幅也大致相当。叶片典型为掌状 5 裂，偶有 7 裂，绿色，长可达 7 厘米、宽 7-8 厘米，至少裂至叶基的三分之二处。较宽的裂片向下并向外开展。每一裂片呈卵状三角形，先端具尾状尖，裂片下部最宽处约 15 毫米，在裂片连接处收窄至 6-10 毫米。叶缘整齐分布的大型角状重锯齿，使叶片呈现颇具观赏性的羽毛状质感。其叶形与叶色与 'O|jishi' 相同，秋季转黄。一般认为 'Globosum' 与之有关。该品种还具有与 'Ho\gyoku' 相同、极为出色的深黄橙色秋叶，叶形相似但更小。夏叶为中绿色。不过其生长习性恰好相反，冠幅约为株高的 1.5 倍，即宽约 4.5 米、高约 3 米，更接近 'Shigure zome'。'Golden Pond' 已在荷兰 Boskoop 的 Firma C. Esveld 苗圃栽培 25 年，经多年观察后，于 1996 年命名。

descriptions.preferred: 渐绿是一种直立的落叶灌木或小乔木，在春天美丽的浅 裂叶子呈现出柔和的石灰绿色，然后在夏天变成新鲜的 绿色。在秋天，叶子会变成鲜艳的橙色和红色。冬季可 观枝，树皮呈现浅绿色。成年树高约 2 米。

sources.title: 渐绿Acer Palmatum 'Going Green'
sources.description: 渐绿是一种直立的落叶灌木或小乔木，在春天美丽的浅 裂叶子呈现出柔和的石灰绿色，然后在夏天变成新鲜的 绿色。在秋天，叶子会变成鲜艳的橙色和红色。冬季可 观枝，树皮呈现浅绿色。成年树高约 2 米。

rhs.description: A small, rounded, bushy tree growing slowly to about 5m tall with luminous green stems. Leaves have seven long, pointed lobes, opening lime green in spring, maturing to bright green, then turning orange and red in autumn. Inconspicuous hanging clusters of small, green flowers are followed by red-flushed, winged seeds

attributes.suggested_uses: City/Courtyard Gardens, Cottage/Informal Garden, Wildlife Gardens

care.cultivation: Grow in any moisture-retentive, well-drained soil in a sheltered position. Leaf colour is best in partial shade, although full sun can be tolerated if soil is reliably moist. Leaf scorch can be caused by lack of soil moisture or excessive exposure. See Japanese maples cultivation
care.pruning: Pruning group 1 , only from late autumn to mid-winter
care.propagation: Propagate by softwood cuttings, layering or by grafting . Plants grown from seed are unlikely to come true, but may still be garden worthy

resistance.pest: May be susceptible to aphids and scale insects , including horse chestnut scale
resistance.disease: May be susceptible to Verticillium wilt , Acer leaf scorch and honey fungus

descriptions_zh.preferred: 渐绿是一种直立的落叶灌木或小乔木，在春天美丽的浅 裂叶子呈现出柔和的石灰绿色，然后在夏天变成新鲜的 绿色。在秋天，叶子会变成鲜艳的橙色和红色。冬季可 观枝，树皮呈现浅绿色。成年树高约 2 米。

care.cultivation: 宜栽于保水且排水良好的土壤中，并选择避风位置。半阴环境下叶色表现最佳；若土壤湿度稳定，也可耐全日照。土壤缺水或暴露过度都可能导致叶片焦边。参见 Japanese maples cultivation。
care.pruning: 修剪组 1，仅限晚秋至仲冬期间修剪。
care.propagation: 可通过嫩枝扦插、压条或嫁接繁殖。实生苗通常难以保持品种性状，但仍可能具有园艺观赏价值。

resistance.pest: 可能易受蚜虫和介壳虫侵害，包括七叶树介壳虫。
resistance.disease: 可能易感黄萎病、槭叶焦枯病和蜜环菌病

rhs_zh.description: 小型、圆整、浓密的灌木状乔木，生长缓慢，最终高约 5 米，枝条呈明亮绿色。叶片具 7 个细长尖裂片，春季萌发时为青柠绿色，随后转为鲜绿色，秋季变为橙色至红色。下垂成簇的小型绿色花不显眼，之后结带红晕的翅果。

attributes.suggested_uses: 城市/庭院花园、乡村/自然式花园、野生动物友好型花园

descriptions.preferred: 由流泉的实生苗选育而来，从叶型上来看，比较像是黄叶品种枫（金贵）和流泉的杂交品种，完美的继承了黄叶的特性和流泉枝垂的特性，春叶为橙黄色，色彩亮丽，夏季一定程度返绿，为黄绿色，但是新稍为橙黄色，秋天变为橙色或者红色，成长强健，抗性佳， 夏季午后需要适当遮阴 ，成年株可到2.5米左右高度。 黄金瀑布瀑布属于 枝 垂 系列 ，此系列有以下品种点击查看

products.title: Acer palmatum 'Golden Falls' Weeping Golden Japanese Maple
products.description_text: Acer palmatum 'Golden Falls' Rare Golden Weeping Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 'Golden Falls' is a brand new weeping selection of Japanese maple that has golden yellow foliage. This selection was found as a chance seedling from 'Ryusei'. Like its parent, it has a heavily weeping habit that will reach the height you stake it to, then cascade from that point. 'Golden Falls' will crawl across the ground creating a unique ground cover without being staked. The tree pictured is a 7 gallon, to show the shape and color of this unique tree. Give 'Golden Falls' morning sun with protection from the hot afternoon sun. Fall colors on 'Golden Falls' may be orange to red.

descriptions.preferred: This cultivar has the same stunning deep yellow-orange fall color as 'Ho¯gyoku', with the leaves similar in shape but Acer smaller. The summer color is a medium green. Gregory. POND' Olsen. Vertrees. Gregory. The growth habit is exactly opposite that of 'Ho¯gyoku', about one and a half times as wide as tall—141⁄2 ft. (4.5 m) wide and 10 ft. (3 m) tall.

rhs.description: A small tree up to 3m high and 4.5m wide, with finely toothed, medium-sized, seven-lobed leaves, which are mid-green, tinged with bronze in spring, and turn deep golden yellow in autumn, and tiny, purple-red flowers in small, pendent corymbs in spring followed by red-winged fruit in late summer

attributes.suggested_uses: Low Maintenance, Banks and Slopes, City/Courtyard Gardens, Cottage/Informal Garden, Flower borders and beds, Hedging/Screens
attributes.hort_group_description: Acers in this amoenum group have large, palm-shaped leaves with finely-toothed edges

care.cultivation: Grow in a place sheltered from cold drying winds and from late frosts, in light dappled shade or in sun but with shade at the hottest part of the day, in moist but well-drained neutral or acidic soil that does not dry out in summer or become waterlogged in winter, and protect roots with an open-textured organic mulch such as coarse bark; for more advice, see Japanese maple cultivation
care.pruning: Pruning group 1 (little or no pruning of trees and shrubs) and prune if necessary only from late autumn to midwinter
care.propagation: Propagate by grafting in late winter, or by budding in summer; semi-ripe cuttings, hardwood cuttings, or layering may also be successful

resistance.pest: May be susceptible to Acer gall mite, aphids , caterpillars and horse chestnut scale
resistance.disease: May be susceptible to Verticillium wilt , Acer leaf scorch and honey fungus

attributes.suggested_uses: 低养护，适合坡岸与斜坡，城市/庭院花园，乡村式/自然式花园，花境与花坛，绿篱/屏障栽植
attributes.hort_group_description: 此 amoenum 类群中的 Acer 品种具有大型掌状叶，叶缘具细锯齿。

care.cultivation: 宜栽植于避开寒冷干燥风和晚霜侵袭的位置，可处于明亮散射光下，或全日照但在一天中最炎热时段有适度遮阴。土壤以湿润但排水良好的中性或酸性土为宜，夏季不可过度干燥，冬季不可积水。根部可覆盖粗树皮等质地疏松的有机覆盖物以保护根系。更多建议可参见 Japanese maple cultivation。
care.pruning: 修剪组 1（树木和灌木几乎不修剪或仅少量修剪）；如确有必要，仅宜在晚秋至隆冬期间进行修剪。
care.propagation: 可于冬末进行嫁接繁殖，或于夏季芽接；半成熟枝扦插、硬枝扦插或压条繁殖有时也能成功。

descriptions_zh.preferred: 该品种具有与 'Ho¯gyoku' 同样惊艳的深黄橙色秋叶，叶形相似，但叶片更小。夏季叶色为中绿色。其生长习性与 'Ho¯gyoku' 恰好相反，冠幅约为株高的 1.5 倍，即宽 14 1/2 英尺（4.5 米）、高 10 英尺（3 米）。

descriptions.preferred: The basic color of the small leaves is a rich green with white variegation. The white ranges from completely covering the leaf to patches, streaks, or flecks. In the spring, the variegations emerge pink, turning to white, cream, and yellow. The name means "five-colored maple."

descriptions_zh.preferred: 小叶的基础叶色为浓绿色，并带有白色斑锦。白斑的表现从整片覆盖叶面，到斑块、条纹或细小斑点不等。春季新叶展现的斑锦先呈粉色，随后转为白色、乳白色和黄色。其名称意为“五色枫”。

descriptions.preferred: This beautiful little plant is the variegated form of the excellent dwarf 'Kotohime', and the name means "dwarf multicolored old harp." The basic color of the foliage is a rich green, with each leaf varying in the amount of variegation. Some are completely marked with tiny flecks and speckles; others are solid green. The markings are always minute, often overlapping, and are white, cream, light yellow, pink, and red. The individual tones are subdued, but the total effect is quite brilliant in the spring. The newest growth tips are often quite pink as they develop, but soon assume the normal variegation. As the summer approaches, the leaves take on a darker green color. They are quite small, measuring 2-3 cm long and wide. Each leaf has five lobes radiating outward and di- Archives, Corvallis The growth of the plant is very slow and stubby. The distance between pairs of leaf buds is very short, sometimes 5-10 mm and even less on side shoots. Leader shoots rarely grow more than 2-5 cm per season. Side branching is often profuse, thus making a very dense compact small plant. It is indeed a true dwarf selection of less than 1 m tall. This variegated cultivar is quite rare, even less well known than its green counterpart 'Kotohime'. It is quite difficult to propagate because of the lack of vegetative growth. Scions for grafting are extremely short, often offering less than 1 cm to work with. Grafting with threeto four-year-old wood is not as successful as with young wood.

sources.name: Goshiki Kotohime Variegated Japanese Maple
sources.description: “Goshiki Kotohime” has a basic leaf color of rich green, with each leaf varying in amount of variegation. Some are completely marked with tiny flecks of white, cream, light yellow, pink, and red. Very small foliage, very dense small plant. Dwarf tree growing to around1 meter, does well in containers or landscape.
sources.group: All Japanese Maples / Dwarf Japanese Maples / Variegated Leaf Japanese Maple
sources.usage_note: Private local archive only. Check japanesemaple.net rights before redistribution.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这是一株非常漂亮的小型植株，为优良矮生品种 'Kotohime' 的斑锦型，其名称意为“多彩的矮小古琴”。叶片底色为浓绿色，但每片叶上的斑锦程度各不相同：有些几乎布满细小斑点与碎斑，有些则为纯绿色。斑纹始终十分细微，常彼此重叠，颜色包括白色、乳白色、浅黄色、粉色和红色。单独看各色调较为柔和，但春季整体观感十分明丽。最新抽生的枝梢在展开时常带明显粉色，随后逐渐转为正常的斑锦状态。入夏后，叶色会变得更深绿。叶片很小，长宽均为 2-3 厘米。每片叶有 5 个向外放射的裂片，并深裂。植株生长极其缓慢且节间短缩。成对叶芽之间距离极短，有时仅 5-10 毫米，侧枝上甚至更短。主梢每季很少生长超过 2-5 厘米。侧枝分生常很旺盛，因此形成极为致密紧凑的小型植株。它确实是一个真正的矮生选系，高度不足 1 米。这一斑锦品种十分罕见，知名度甚至低于其绿色原种 'Kotohime'。由于营养生长不足，繁殖难度较高。用于嫁接的接穗极短，往往不足 1 厘米可供操作。使用 3 至 4 年生枝条嫁接的成功率不如嫩枝高。

Some are completely marked with tiny flecks of white, cream, light yellow, pink, and red. Very small foliage, very dense small plant. Dwarf tree growing to around1 meter, does well in containers or landscape.

descriptions.preferred: This variegated dissectum has a great variety of leaf colors. Leaves with the typical, uniform, dissected shape are various shades of green with dark red overtones. Other leaves have thin lobes twisted, curled, and almost tangled. These are deep red-green, heavily marked with pink. Still other leaves have strong white areas. All degrees of variations of the above may be present. The leaf size is usually smaller than that of most dissectums. Most leaves are 4-6 cm long and occasionally up to 8 cm. They appear narrower because the lobes tend to hold together. On uniform leaves the lobes separate entirely to the leaf base and are pinnately incised as they dareTricolor'and'BenishidareVariegated'isillegitimate under the international nomenclatural rules. The two plants are so like 'Goshiki shidare', which is a much older name, that it would seem best to treat these as synonyms.

rhs.description: A small, rounded, bushy tree growing slowly to about 1.5m in height. The 7 or 9 lobed, very dissected, lacy leaves have a basic leaf colour of purple-red to greenish red, variegated and streaked randomly pink or white, more intensely coloured when grown in shade, turning orange and yellow in autumn. Inconspicuous hanging clusters of small, green flowers are followed by red-flushed, winged seeds

attributes.suggested_uses: City/Courtyard Gardens, Cottage/Informal Garden, Flower borders and beds, Patio/Container Plants
attributes.hort_group_description: Acers in this dwarf group are compact and slow-growing, making them ideal for pots and containers

care.cultivation: Grow in any moisture-retentive, well-drained soil in a sheltered position. Leaf colour is best in partial shade, although full sun can be tolerated if soil is reliably moist. Leaf scorch can be caused by lack of soil moisture or excessive exposure. Suits container cultivation but attention to watering is needed in dry spells during the growing season. Suitable for bonsai cultivation . See Japanese maple cultivation
care.pruning: Very little to no pruning required. If necessary Pruning group 1 from late autumn to midwinter only
care.propagation: Propagate by layering in autumn, grafting in late winter or softwood cuttings

resistance.pest: May be susceptible to Acer gall mite, aphids , caterpillars and horse chestnut scale
resistance.disease: May be susceptible to Verticillium wilt , acer leaf scorch and honey fungus

attributes.suggested_uses: 城市庭院花园、乡村风或自然式花园、花境与花坛、庭院容器栽培
attributes.hort_group_description: 这一矮生类群的 Acer 株形紧凑、生长缓慢，因此非常适合盆栽和容器栽培。

care.propagation: 可于秋季行压条繁殖，于晚冬进行嫁接，或采用软枝扦插繁殖。
care.cultivation: 宜栽培于保水性好且排水良好的土壤中，种植位置应避风。叶色在半阴环境下表现最佳；若土壤湿度稳定充足，也可耐全日照。土壤缺水或暴晒过度会导致叶片焦枯。适合盆栽，但在生长季干旱时段需特别注意浇水。也适合制作盆景。参见 Japanese maple 栽培说明。
care.pruning: 几乎不需要修剪，或完全无需修剪。如有必要，仅可在晚秋至隆冬期间按修剪第 1 组进行修剪。

resistance.pest: 可能易受槭瘿螨、蚜虫、毛虫和七叶树介壳虫危害
resistance.disease: 可能易感 Verticillium wilt、槭树叶灼病和蜜环菌。

rhs_zh.description: 小型、圆整、丛生的灌木状小乔木，生长缓慢，株高约可达 1.5 米。叶 7 或 9 裂，裂刻极深、质感纤细如蕾丝，基本叶色为紫红至带绿色调的红色，并随机分布粉色或白色条斑；在半阴环境下色彩更为浓艳，秋季转为橙色和黄色。花小而不显著，绿色，成下垂簇生，随后结带红晕的翅果。

descriptions_zh.preferred: 该斑叶 dissectum 类型品种的叶色变化非常丰富。叶形典型且均匀、深裂的叶片，可呈不同深浅的绿色，并带有深红色晕染。另一些叶片则裂片细长，扭曲、卷曲，几乎纠结在一起；这类叶片呈深红绿色，并有大量粉色斑纹。还有一些叶片带有明显的白色区域。上述各种变异程度都可能同时出现。叶片通常比多数 dissectum 品种更小，多数长 4–6 厘米，偶尔可达 8 厘米。由于裂片往往聚拢，视觉上显得更狭长。在形态较整齐的叶片上，裂片完全分离至叶基，并呈羽状深裂。'Tricolor' 和 'Benishidare Variegated' 依据国际命名规则均属非法名。这两者与名称更早的 'Goshiki shidare' 极为相似，因此更适合作为其异名处理。

descriptions.preferred: Acer palmatum 'Grandma Ghost' Rare Ghost Japanese Maple Tree Zone 5-9 The leaf on 'Grandma Ghost' is elegant, yet complex, in its beauty. 'Grandma Ghost' leafs out with a bright creamy foliage with deep green reticulated veins in the early spring. This member of the Ghost series of Japanese maples is a maple that will grab attention in the garden. 'Grandma Ghost' can reach 8-10 ft in height and width with age. Fall color on 'Grandma Ghost' ranges from bright oranges to bright crimson reds. For best color and longest display of reticulated variegation, give 'Grandma Ghost' protection from the hot afternoon sun. This will allow 'Grandma Ghost' to shine and brighten those darker shady spots in the garden. Limited Quantities Available !! As we have over a thousand cultivars of Japanese maples, we often do not have many of each cultivar. We recommend that you buy the Japanese maples you want immediately as we often sell out of certain selections.

descriptions_zh.preferred: Acer palmatum 'Grandma Ghost' 稀有 Ghost 系列日本枫，适生分区 5-9。'Grandma Ghost' 的叶片优雅而富于变化，观赏性很高。早春展叶时，叶色呈明亮的乳白色，带有深绿色网脉。这一 Ghost 系列日本枫成员在花园中极具吸引力。随着树龄增长，'Grandma Ghost' 的高度和冠幅都可达 8-10 英尺。秋色从鲜亮橙色到明亮的深红色不等。若要获得最佳叶色以及最长时间的网脉斑纹观赏期，建议为 'Grandma Ghost' 避开炎热的午后强光。这样可以让它在花园较阴的区域中更加出彩、提亮环境。数量有限！！由于我们拥有上千个日本枫品种，每个品种通常库存不多。我们建议您尽快购买心仪的日本枫，因为某些品种常常很快售罄。

products.description_text: Grandma Ghost is a variegated upright growing japanese maple, with colors of green, white, and pink veins. Very attractive and unusual. Grows to about 8 ft tall and hardy to minus 20. Fall colors are very bold and bright reds. (see picture on the maple list page)

download_items.usage_note: Private local archive only. Check japanesemaple.net rights before redistribution.

descriptions.preferred: This unique selection is a weeping form, almost prostrate. It is best grown on a bank where it can cascade down to form a green mantle. Young plants should be staked to form a center stem from which the limbs can cascade. Each medium-sized leaf is a rich green with 9-11 lobes separated to the leaf base. The lower end of each lobe is very little wider than the midrib, then the lobe becomes broad but is deeply dissected to give the leaf a lacelike effect. Fall colors are a brilliant yellow-orange and crimson. -

sources.title: 绿色瀑布 Acer Japonicum 'Green Cascade'
sources.description: 绿色瀑布是美国培育的一种非常优秀的品种。它由已 故的俄勒冈育种家 Art Wright 选育，并于 1973 年注 册。20 世纪 50 年代晚期，该品种从"舞孔雀"自然 授粉的种子中选育出来。这个特殊的品种枝条细软下 垂，几乎要趴在地上。所以幼树需要用撑杆固定，使 枝条如瀑布般从上方倾泻而下。绿色瀑布的叶片为浓 绿色，有 9-11 裂，且完全开裂至叶片基部，每个裂叶 长 8-10cm，自叶柄处向外辐射分布。裂叶末端仅仅比 叶片中脉略宽，前端极为纤细的部分占裂叶总长的三 分之一，从这个位置开始裂叶逐渐变宽并继续分裂， 这种双重分裂的效果如蕾丝一般。绿色瀑布的秋色也 十分惊艳，交织出黄色、橘红和深红色。

rhs.description: A deciduous large shrub or small tree, with a cascading, weeping habit and rounded, deeply cut, 9-11 lobed rich green leaves to 10cm long, brilliantly coloured red, orange and yellow in autumn. Bears long stalked clusters of red-purple flowers in spring as the leaves open, followed by brownish-red winged fruits

attributes.suggested_uses: City/Courtyard Gardens, Cottage/Informal Garden

care.cultivation: Grow in fertile, moist but well-drained soil in sun or partial shade. See tree cultivation for further advice
care.pruning: Pruning group 1 , if necessary, from late autumn to midwinter only. Train leading shoot vertically when young to obtain a weeping habit
care.propagation: Propagate by layering in autumn, grafting in late winter or softwood cuttings in early summer

resistance.pest: May be susceptible to Acer gall mite, aphids , caterpillars and horse chestnut scale
resistance.disease: May be susceptible to Verticillium wilt , Acer leaf scorch and honey fungus

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这是一个独特的选育品种，具明显垂枝性，几乎呈匍匐状。最适合栽植于坡地，使枝条自然倾泻下垂，形成绿色帷幕。幼株应设支柱，培养出中心主干，再由其上长出的枝条向下垂瀑。每片中等大小的叶片为浓绿色，具 9-11 个裂片，裂刻深达叶基。每个裂片下部仅略宽于中脉，随后变宽，并再次深裂，令整片叶呈蕾丝状效果。秋季叶色转为鲜艳的黄橙色和猩红色。

attributes.suggested_uses: 城市或庭院花园、乡村风或自然式花园

resistance.pest: 可能易受槭瘿螨、蚜虫、毛虫和七叶树介壳虫危害
resistance.disease: 可能易感黄萎病、槭叶焦枯病和蜜环菌病

rhs_zh.description: 落叶性大型灌木或小乔木，株形下垂呈瀑布状，具深裂、近圆形的 9–11 裂浓绿色叶片，叶长可达 10 厘米，秋季转为鲜艳的红、橙、黄色。春季展叶时开红紫色花，成簇着生于长花梗上，随后结褐红色翅果。

care.cultivation: 宜栽培于肥沃、湿润但排水良好的土壤中，可处全日照或半阴环境。更多建议可参见乔木栽培说明。
care.pruning: 修剪分组 1；如有必要，仅可在晚秋至仲冬期间修剪。幼年期应将主枝向上牵引培养，以形成垂枝树形。
care.propagation: 可于秋季压条繁殖，晚冬嫁接，或于初夏进行软枝扦插。

products.description_text: Acer japonicum 'Green Cascade ' Weeping Full Moon Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 This interesting japonicum Japanese maple was found by Art Wright in 1973 and has become a very popular tree in the nursery trade for both leaf shape and form. In early spring, ‘Green Cascade’ has bright green foliage that compliments the heavily dissected leaf. This intricate leaf structure gives a very lacy delicate look to this very hardy easy to grow tree. The shape of 'Green Cascade' is very full and mounding as it reaches around 6 ft in height and similar in width. In the autumn, ‘Green Cascade’ Japanese maple explodes in the garden with flashes of deep reds and yellows and oranges. This is a great choice for container growing or small garden areas with the need for big time color. Acer japonicum 'Green Cascade' Full Moon Japanese maple will bring a peaceful lacy appeal to your garden while having all the great fall color Acer japonicums are famous for.

descriptions.preferred: As the name 'Green Globe' implies, this green dissectum from the Fratelli Gilardelli Nursery, near Milan, Italy, tends to form a rounded ball shape. It does not have the pendulous habit characteristic of most dissectums. The spring coloring of the emerging young leaves is attractive, the initial rose color turning to shades of creamy white and quickly becoming a fresh emerald green. This color is held throughout the summer until turning yellow in the fall. The shoots and petioles are an attractive medium green. The seven-lobed deeply dissected leaves are 7-9 cm long and 9-10 cm wide. The lobes are divided to the leaf base, narrowing to the widths of the midvein for approximately 1 cm to the base. The lobes themselves are fairly deeply incised to about 2-3 mm from the midvein. These sublobes have narrow toothed margins. The petioles are 2-3 cm long. This vigorous rounded cultivar is estimated to reach a height of 4-5 m at maturity, with a spread of 3-4 m. Because 'Green Globe' is rounded rather than cascading, the graft is low down on the understock, not as high as usual with dissectum cultivars. This plant has also been named 'Viridis Olandese'.

care.cultivation: Grow in any moisture-retentive, well-drained soil in a sheltered position. Leaf colour is best in partial shade, although full sun can be tolerated if soil is reliably moist. Leaf scorch can be caused by lack of soil moisture or excessive exposure. See Japanese maples cultivation
care.pruning: Pruning group 1 , only from late autumn to mid-winter
care.propagation: Propagate by softwood cuttings, layering or by grafting . Plants grown from seed are unlikely to come true, but may still be garden worthy

resistance.disease: May be susceptible to Verticillium wilt , Acer leaf scorch and honey fungus

rhs_zh.description: 落叶性小乔木，高、宽约 3 米，树形自然圆整。叶片细裂如羽毛，具 5 至 7 裂，春季萌发时呈粉铜色，夏季转绿，秋季变为金黄色至橙色。

descriptions_zh.preferred: 正如其名 'Green Globe' 所示，这一来自意大利米兰附近 Fratelli Gilardelli 苗圃的绿色线裂叶品种，倾向形成圆整的球状树形。它不具多数 dissectum 类品种典型的下垂习性。春季新叶初展时色彩迷人，最初的玫瑰色随后转为乳白色调，并很快变成清新的祖母绿色。整个夏季均能保持此色，秋季转黄。新梢和叶柄为颇具观赏性的中绿色。叶片 7 裂、深裂，长 7-9 厘米，宽 9-10 厘米。裂片一直分裂至叶基，靠近基部约 1 厘米处收窄至与中脉近似的宽度。各主裂片本身又深裂，距中脉仅约 2-3 毫米。这些次裂片边缘具细锯齿。叶柄长 2-3 厘米。该品种生长旺盛、树形圆整，估计成株高 4-5 米，冠幅 3-4 米。由于 'Green Globe' 为圆整树形而非瀑布状下垂，因此其嫁接位较低，不像一般 dissectum 品种那样接位较高。该品种另有名称 'Viridis Olandese'。

descriptions_zh.preferred: 'Green Hornet' 具细致如蕾丝般的裂叶，其特别之处在于它是少数秋色可呈出色红色的绿色 dissectum 品种。春叶绿色并带橙色晕，夏季转为清新的绿色，秋季则变为亮丽鲜红。夏季绿色叶丛与整个生长季不断抽生的橙晕绿色新梢形成鲜明对比。该品种早期生长势很强，枝条细长、边缘舒展并具下垂感，最终形成宽阔的蘑菇状树冠，高可达约 10 英尺（3 米）。 文段后半部分存在明显 OCR 串页与混排噪声，内容应混入了多个绿色系日本枫品种的描述，包含 'Green Lace'、'Green Mist'、'Green Star' 及绿色型 'Trompenburg' 等名称。可辨识的要点如下： 'Green Lace'：Dissectum Group 绿色系。因叶质细致、姿态优雅下垂且秋色优良而受欢迎。植株形成宽阔的蘑菇状树冠，高和冠幅约 10-13 英尺（3-4 米），可栽于全日照或半阴处。叶片深裂，裂片自身又几乎裂至中脉，次裂片具明显锯齿。新叶浅乳绿色，夏季转为浅祖母绿色，秋季为清澈明亮的金黄色。 'Green Mist'：Dissectum Group 绿色系。为优良的中型绿色线裂叶品种，叶形和生长习性与 'Waterfall' 相似，但秋色为橙红色，且耐寒性更佳。大型 7 裂叶几乎深裂至中脉，裂片狭长、先端尖，边缘锐利具锯齿。生长势强，形成瀑布状树冠，高约 10 英尺（3 米）。下垂叶丛带来柔和朦胧的观感，因此得名。 'Green Star'：绿色系品种。叶形和树姿与广受欢迎的 'Osakazuki' 相似，但秋叶不是转猩红色，而是转为明亮橙色。叶片中等大小，5 裂，裂刻中等偏深，叶缘细密整齐具锯齿。新叶黄绿色，并带有浅粉红至红色晕染，尤以叶缘更明显。 绿色型 'Trompenburg'：其 distinctive 叶形几乎与著名红叶品种 'Trompenburg' 完全一致，但叶色为浓绿色，且似乎不易日灼。新叶叶尖与叶缘带锈红色晕，随后很快消退。秋季叶色为橙黄。中等大小叶片有 7-9 个裂片，几乎呈完整圆周向外放射，分裂较深。每个裂片细长，边缘向下卷曲，呈半管状；坚挺的叶柄使叶片向外平展。该树生长旺盛，高可达约 26 英尺（8 米）。这种绿色型为园林应用提供了不同于红叶 'Trompenburg' 的选择，据称以荷兰鹿特丹的一座树木园命名。
