products.description_text: 'Green Hornet' is unusually fast growing for a lace leaf maple and because of this it can benefit greatly from pruning or training when young to get it started in the right direction. Shoots on newly grafted plants may grow 2 feet or more the first year. As the plant ages its vigorous growth becomes an asset creating a graceful plant with long arching branches. Spring growth is lime green sometimes with orange margins when placed in more sun, however at least partial shade is preferred in hotter climates. Fall color is stunning and bright red which is quite rare for green dissectums which usually display yellow to orange fall color. 10 Year Size: Height: 4-6 Feet Width: 7-9 Feet Spring Color: Lime Green Summer Color: Green Fall Color: Red Sun Tolerance: Partial Planting: Elevated, Well Drained Soil

descriptions.preferred: This desirable green dissectum has a fine leaf texture, graceful pendulous shape, and outstanding fall colors. It was selected and named by Fratelli Gilardelli Nursery, near Milan, Italy. This cultivar grows into a wide mushroom-shaped mound, 3-4 m tall and at least as broad. It can be planted in full sun or partial shade. The leaves are deeply dissected to the petiole junction, the lobes themselves divided to the midrib into sublobes. These are, in turn, strongly toothed. The new leaves emerge a light creamy green, becoming a light emerald green for the summer. In the fall, their color changes to a beautiful clear golden yellow. deeply dissected leaves are 8-9.5 cm long and 10-12 cm wide. Each lobe is 1-1.5 cm broad in the middle, narrowing sharply to the width of the midrib for 1-2 cm to the leaf base. The lobe is itself divided into sublobes almost to the midrib and has narrow, sharp-pointed, curved teeth. The slender petioles are 2-2.5 cm long. 'Green Mist' is vigorous and, like most dissectums, forms a cascading mound up to 3 m high. The color and delicate appearance of the pendulous foliage give it the soft misty look which gave rise to this cultivar's name. The plant was discovered by William H. Wolff and introduced by Red Maple Nursery, Media, Pennsylvania.

descriptions.preferred: This tall-growing tree has distinctive green foliage. The leaves are almost identical to those of the well-known red-leaved cultivar 'Trompenburg', which was selected at the arboretum of that name in Rotterdam, Netherlands. The difference is in the color, which is a dark, rich green with no lighter undertones. The dark green carries well into the summer and fall, and does not appear to show sunburn. The early spring foliage carries a shading of rusty red on the tips and edges of the new leaves, which disappears as the leaves mature. Fall colors produce orange and yellow tones. The leaves are hardy, of good texture, and measure 7 cm long and 10 cm wide. The seven or nine lobes radiate outward in almost a completely circular manner, and are Archives, Corvallis hold the leaf outward. This interesting, very vigorous tree reaches a full size of about 8 m. As with the red 'Trompenburg', the foliage texture and form of tree are quite desirable. The green form gives an added choice for the landscape. This cultivar originated in a large batch of seedlings grown from open-pollinated seed, harvested at Firma C. Esveld, Boskoop, Netherlands. It was propagated at Maplewood Nursery, named and registered in 1988. Its alternative name is 'Groene Trompenburg'.

rhs.description: A deciduous tree or shrub, up to 8m high, with large leaves deeply cut into narrow lobes, often with the edges rolled under. Leaves emerge lime green, tinted with red at the margins, and mature to green before turning yellow and orange in autumn

care.cultivation: Grow in moisture-retentive, well-drained, ideally slightly acidic soil, in a sheltered position with protection from drying winds. Thrives in part shade, as some sun is needed to develop the leaf colour, but will tolerate full sun if soil is reliably moist. Mulch in spring, especially when grown in containers , to improve moisture retention. See Japanese maples cultivation
care.pruning: Minimal pruning required; see pruning group 1 . Prune from late autumn to mid-winter only
care.propagation: Propagate by layering or grafting

resistance.pest: May be susceptible to Acer gall mite, aphids , caterpillars and horse chestnut scale

attributes.hort_group_description: 此 matsumurae 组的槭树，叶片深裂约达叶片的四分之三，叶缘具粗齿，裂片狭长且先端尖。
attributes.suggested_uses: 适合用于建筑景观、城市/庭院花园、乡村/自然式花园、花境与花坛，以及低维护栽培。

care.cultivation: 宜栽植于保水性好但排水良好的土壤中，最好为微酸性，并选择避风、可防止干燥风侵袭的位置。最适合半阴环境，因为叶色形成需要一定光照；若土壤能持续保持湿润，也可耐全日照。春季覆 mulch，尤其是盆栽时，可提高土壤保湿性。参见 Japanese maples cultivation。
care.pruning: 所需修剪极少；参见修剪第 1 组。仅可在晚秋至仲冬期间修剪。
care.propagation: 可采用压条或嫁接繁殖。

resistance.pest: 可能易受槭瘿螨、蚜虫、毛虫和七叶树介壳虫危害
resistance.disease: 可能易感黄萎病、槭叶焦枯病和蜜环菌病

rhs_zh.description: 落叶乔木或灌木，高可达 8 米；叶片较大，深裂成狭长裂片，叶缘常向下反卷。新叶展开时为青柠绿色，叶缘带红晕，后成熟为绿色，秋季转为黄色和橙色。

descriptions_zh.preferred: 该品种为高大型树木，叶色独特，为绿色。其叶片与著名红叶品种 'Trompenburg' 几乎完全相同；后者选育自荷兰鹿特丹同名树木园。二者差异主要在于叶色，本品种呈浓深的墨绿色，不带浅色底调。深绿色可良好保持至夏季和秋季，且似乎不易发生日灼。早春新叶的叶尖和叶缘带有锈红色晕染，随叶片成熟而消失。秋色表现为橙色和黄色调。叶片质地良好且较耐性，长约 7 厘米、宽约 10 厘米。7 或 9 个裂片几乎呈完整圆形向外辐射展开，叶姿外展。该品种生长势很强，成株约可达 8 米。与红叶的 'Trompenburg' 一样，其叶片质感和树形都很具观赏价值；绿色型为园林应用增加了新的选择。该品种源自一批开放授粉实生苗，种子采自荷兰 Boskoop 的 Firma C. Esveld。后由 Maplewood Nursery 繁殖，并于 1988 年命名登记。其别名为 'Groene Trompenburg'。

descriptions.preferred: The leaves of this useful small-leaved dwarf are deeply divided and have five narrow large-toothed lobes. The leaves are 3-4 cm long and 4-5 cm wide. The lobes are narrow-ovate with long pointed tips, 5-7 mm wide at the widest point, and divided to within 3-4 mm of the leaf base. The margins have relatively large coarse teeth. The threadlike short petioles are 1-1.5 cm long. The foliage is medium green with the leaf tips and outer margins tinged pink to red bronze. This cultivar is aptly named, growing into a very dense twiggy plant which hugs the ground. It reaches 0.6 m tall and 1-1.2 m wide.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这是一种很实用的小叶矮生品种，叶片深裂，具 5 枚狭长且具大齿的裂片。叶长 3-4 厘米，宽 4-5 厘米。裂片为狭卵形，先端长尖，最宽处约 5-7 毫米，分裂深达距叶基仅 3-4 毫米处。叶缘具较大而粗的锯齿。细线状的短叶柄长 1-1.5 厘米。叶色中绿，叶尖及外缘带粉色至红铜色晕染。这个品种名称十分贴切，植株生长极为致密，多细枝，紧贴地面展开。成熟时高约 0.6 米，幅宽 1-1.2 米。

products.title: Acer palmatum 'Groundcover' Dwarf Japanese Maple
products.description_text: Acer palmatum 'Groundcover' Rare Weeping Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 'Groundcover' is a slow growing dwarf Japanese maple that has deeply cut, claw-like leaves that are pink when they emerge, turning to green. The habit of 'Groundcover' is weeping, crawling across the ground. In 15 years, 'Groundcover' may reach 1-2 ft in height by 3-4 ft in width. Branches on 'Groundcover' become less flexible with age, so plant it far enough out of the walkway that you won't be brushing against an older speciemen. Extremely limited in quantity, so don't wait to purchase this one. Limited Quantities Available !! As we have over a thousand cultivars of Japanese maples, we often do not have many of each cultivar. descriptions_zh.preferred: 其叶片中等大小，极为罕见且辨识度很高，具 5 枚裂片，完全分裂至叶基，并几乎无叶柄，近乎直接着生于枝条上。裂片宽披针形，基部迅速收窄成柄状连接部，叶缘具粗锯齿。每片叶及各裂片所在平面各不相同，常呈扭转和弯曲状，因此整体外观非常羽毛状。叶色深绿，新叶初展时带粉色。秋色为浅黄与橙色的混合。该品种株形狭窄、致密、直立，生长缓慢，最终可达约 20 英尺（6 米）高。其名意为“日本天使的衣裳”。 'Hazeroino' 与 'Hagoromo' 相似，叶片同样近乎无叶柄，但带斑锦；不过其长势较弱，最终高度约 10 英尺（3 米）左右。 'Momenshide' 的叶片外观也很像 'Hagoromo'，叶小，几乎无叶柄（仅几毫米长），几乎直接附着在小枝上，但 'Momenshide' 植株更高。 'Harusame' 属矮生组中的绿色类型。春季叶片浅黄绿色，叶缘和叶尖略带古铜色。叶片中度深裂，具 3 至 5 枚向外放射的裂片；每枚裂片先端渐尖，叶缘有轻微锯齿。短叶柄纤细柔弱。春叶呈橙红色，尤其叶缘更明显，随后转为均匀的浅绿至黄绿色。在庭园中，植株最终可长至约 6.5 英尺（2 米）高；若盆栽则会更小。其名意为“花之锦缎”。 'Harusame' 尤其以秋色见长，红色叶面上常覆有黄褐色的朦胧斑驳。其余季节，较小的 5 至 7 裂叶通常呈浅绿色。裂片披针状卵形，中度深裂，叶缘具粗锯齿。植株形成直立、浓密的灌木状小乔木，通常高宽均不超过 10 英尺（3 米）左右。其名意为“春雨”。

products.title: Acer palmatum 'Hagoromo' Angel Feather Japanese Maple
products.description_text: Acer palmatum 'Hagoromo' Angel Feather Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 'Hagoromo' is a unique upright Japanese maple that gives the appearance of an upright laceleaf Japanese maple. The green leaves are heavily divided and graceful, almost feather-like. 'Hagoromo' turns to a bright fiery red in the fall. This selection from Japan can be found on records in Japan as early as 1782. 'Hagoromo' may reach 15 ft in height in 15 years. 'Hagoromo' is often referred to in the nursery trade as sessilifolium, but I prefer the tranlation of "hagoromo" which translates as "Angel Feather". Limited Quantities Available !! descriptions.preferred: This cultivar from Japan is considered a variegated form, since the foliage is quite variable. New leaves are a very pale yellow green or whitish green. The lightest tones are Corvallis leaf is rather thin. There are five or seven lobes, the pair of basal lobes extremely small when the leaf is seven lobed. The lobes separate almost to the leaf base. Each lobe is ovate-lanceolate with a long slender tip. The margins are finely serrated. The size varies from 5 to 7 cm long and up to 7 cm spread. This cultivar is a small-sized shrub up to about 3 m tall. It is hardy, not fast growing, and relatively easy to propagate. The name has been misspelled 'Hana otome'.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这个来自日本的品种通常被视为斑叶型，因为其叶色变化相当丰富。新叶为非常浅的黄绿色或灰白绿色。叶片较薄。叶有 5 裂或 7 裂；若为 7 裂，则基部一对裂片极小。裂片几乎分离至叶基。每个裂片为卵状披针形，先端细长。叶缘具细锯齿。叶长 5-7 厘米，展开宽度可达 7 厘米。该品种为小型灌木，高约可达 3 米。耐寒，生长不快，且较易繁殖。其名称曾被误写为 'Hana otome'。

descriptions.preferred: 花散里是一款比较少见的三角槭品种，叶型似三叉戟。 叶子在早春呈明亮的白色，远远看去会像白雪一样发光， 并带有深绿色的脉络。随着夏天的临近，叶子会逐渐返 绿。秋季，叶色是鲜红色到深栗色的过渡。 成年树高 可达 3-4 米，午后建议及时遮荫。

products.title: Acer buergerianum 'Hana chiru sato' Trident Maple
products.description_text: Acer buergerianum 'Hana chiru sato' Rare White Variegated Trident Maple Zones 5-9 'Hana chiru sato' leafs out in the early spring as a bright white trident maple that will light up like snow in the landscape. The leaf itself is a bright white with deep green veining. This gives it a ghost-like appearance for a trident maple. As the summer approaches, the green begins to fill the leaf as most new growth during the second flush is more orange. In the fall, 'Hana chiru sato' continues to put on a dynamic display of colors as it turns from bright reds to deep maroons. Hana chiru sato will reach about 10-15 ft in 15 years. Protection from the hot afternoon sun is recommended to retain this white reticulated variegation the longest. This name translates as "Village of Falling Flowers". descriptions.preferred: 由日本Tsukasa Maple司园艺的田中丰君于1999年选育并推广，花吹雪为限り锦(Kagiri nishiki)的一个枝变品种，Hana意为花，Fubuki意为暴风雪，被译为花吹雪。春叶为绿色配以粉色的条斑，一般分布于叶边及叶缘，粉色斑比非常大，如樱花散落般美丽，夏季粉色变为奶白色，秋天为橙红色。生长速度中等，午后需要适当遮阴，成年株可达2.5米左右。

sources.description: 由日本Tsukasa Maple司园艺的田中丰君于1999年选育并推广，花吹雪为限り锦(Kagiri nishiki)的一个枝变品种，Hana意为花，Fubuki意为暴风雪，被译为花吹雪。春叶为绿色配以粉色的条斑，一般分布于叶边及叶缘，粉色斑比非常大，如樱花散落般美丽，夏季粉色变为奶白色，秋天为橙红色。生长速度中等，午后需要适当遮阴，成年株可达2.5米左右。

descriptions.preferred: 花缠来自于外山锦，花缠的叶裂会比外山锦更细， 叶色更鲜艳美丽。到夏天，花缠仍然会留下红斑， 外山锦会全部转变成白斑。Hana 在日语中是花的意 思，而 matoi 则是" 纏 "意思，" 纏 "是江户时代消 防队的旗帜，在日本消防员被认为是英雄，其地位 与武士相似。这些" 纏 "上面带有很大的流苏，这 个名字来源于这棵树就像用鲜花装饰的旗帜。 在矢野正善先生的书中，他指出这个品种是有记录 以来最壮观的品种之一。如果你在阳光充足的地方 种植花缠，叶子会绽放出充满活力的深红色和亮眼 的粉红色。如果种植在偏阴影的地方，叶子将是橄 榄色，带有淡粉色的杂色。此外，粉红色在遮阴的 环境中持续时间更长。秋天，花缠是一种亮红色。

descriptions.preferred: This maple is one of the rarer dwarf forms and is also one of the smallest-leaved forms. Its name means "flower-viewing tapestry." The five-lobed, occasionally three-lobed, light yellow-green leaves vary from 1.5 to 2 cm long and wide. The edges and tips are lightly bronzed in the spring. The five points radiate out, and the lobes separate about two-thirds of the way to the leaf base. Each lobe sharply tapers to a point with margins lightly toothed. The petioles are very thin, delicate, and less than 1 cm long. The leaves appear in the spring with an orange-red tint, particularly along the margins, and later take on a uniform light to yellowish green. Occasionally, the leaves on older wood show minute pinpointing of light varie- Corvallis and can be expected to grow just a few centimeters per year. In the garden, plants generally grow 3-8 cm tall per year, but when force-fed they have produced shoots up to 12 cm long. The plant can eventually reach 2 m tall and wide. This maple is one of the real gems of the dwarf group. It is slightly delicate to grow and difficult to propagate.

rhs.description: A compact, bushy deciduous shrub or dwarf tree, to around 1.2m high, with a spreading habit and very small, lobed and pointed leaves, sometimes just 2cm across. Leaves emerge bright green and tinted red at the edges, and mature to green before turning bright orange and red in autumn

care.cultivation: Grow in moisture-retentive, well-drained, ideally slightly acidic soil, in a sheltered position with protection from drying winds. Thrives in part shade, as some sun is needed to develop the leaf colour, but will tolerate full sun if soil is reliably moist. Mulch in spring, especially when grown in containers , to improve moisture retention. See Japanese maples cultivation
care.pruning: Minimal pruning required; see pruning group 1 . Prune from late autumn to mid-winter only
care.propagation: Propagate by layering or grafting

resistance.pest: May be susceptible to Acer gall mite, aphids , caterpillars and horse chestnut scale
resistance.disease: May be susceptible to Verticillium wilt , Acer leaf scorch and honey fungus

attributes.hort_group_description: 这一矮生类群的 Acer 株形紧凑、生长缓慢，因此非常适合盆栽和容器栽培。
attributes.suggested_uses: 适合用于城市/庭院花园、乡村/自然式花园、花境与花坛、低维护栽培，以及露台/容器栽培。

care.cultivation: 宜栽植于保水性好但排水良好的土壤中，最好为微酸性，并选择避风、可防止干燥风侵袭的位置。最适合半阴环境，因为叶色形成需要一定光照；若土壤能持续保持湿润，也可耐全日照。春季覆 mulch，尤其是盆栽时，可提高土壤保湿性。参见 Japanese maples cultivation。
care.pruning: 所需修剪极少；参见修剪第 1 组。仅可在晚秋至仲冬期间修剪。
care.propagation: 可采用压条或嫁接繁殖。

resistance.disease: 可能易感黄萎病、槭叶焦枯病和蜜环菌病

rhs_zh.description: 紧凑、丛生的落叶灌木或矮生小乔木，高约 1.2 米，株形开展。叶片极小，具裂片且先端尖锐，有时叶幅仅 2 厘米。新叶鲜绿色，叶缘带红色晕染，成熟后转为绿色，秋季再转为鲜艳的橙色和红色。

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这一槭树是较为少见的矮生型之一，同时也是叶片最小的类型之一。其名称意为“赏花锦缎”。叶片 5 裂，偶见 3 裂，浅黄绿色，长宽约 1.5-2 厘米。春季叶缘和叶尖略带古铜色。5 个尖端向外放射，裂片分离约达叶基的三分之二。每个裂片渐尖，边缘具轻微锯齿。叶柄极细柔弱，长度不足 1 厘米。春季展叶时带橙红色调，尤其在叶缘更明显，随后转为均匀的浅绿色至黄绿色。偶尔老枝上的叶片会出现极细小的浅色斑点状斑锦。该品种生长极慢，每年通常只长几厘米。在庭园中，植株一般每年长高 3-8 厘米；若强势促长，也可抽生长达 12 厘米的新梢。最终植株可达高、宽各 2 米。它是矮生类群中的珍品之一，但栽培上稍显娇弱，繁殖也较困难。

descriptions.preferred: This shy variegate, whose name means "variegated flower garden," is beautiful when carefully grown. Heavy fertilization suppresses the variegations. The usually fivelobed leaves have a pale green base color and range from 3 to 6 cm in size. Variegations are mostly of the kiri fu (cut in) type with some additional irregular marking. Colors range from pink to cream, the pink being predominant when leaves first develop in the spring. Twigs also have faint pink markings in the young bark. The pink cultivar 'Karasu gawa' is more widely known. The lesser-known 'Hanazono nishiki' is not strong-growing and rarely exceeds much more than 2 m high.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这是一种较为含蓄的斑叶品种，其名称意为“花园锦”，在精心栽培下极具美感。施肥过重会抑制其斑纹表现。叶片通常为五裂，底色浅绿，叶片大小多在 3 至 6 厘米之间。斑纹主要属于 kiri fu（切入斑）类型，并伴有一些不规则斑驳。颜色从粉色到乳白色不等，其中春季新叶初展时以粉色最为明显。嫩枝树皮上也带有淡淡的粉色斑痕。粉色品种 'Karasu gawa' 更为人熟知。相较之下，较少见的 'Hanazono nishiki' 生长势不强，通常很少超过 2 米高。

descriptions.preferred: Acer palmatum 'Hanezu hagoromo' Orange Hagoromo Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 The "Orange Hagoromo" leafs out as a bright orange in the early spring. The leaves are heavily divided and look like feathers. Older nurserymen refer to this style of leaf as the "sessilifolium" style. This style of leaf gives an interesting and unique texture to a Japanese maple. By late spring it has matured to a bright neon yellow. By mid-summer the leaves have changed to a bright chartreuse green. During the fall, this selection turns bright orange to reds. 'Orange Hagoromo' is projected to reach 6 ft in height by 5 ft in width in 10 years. 'Orange Hagoromo' is also known as 'Hanezu' or 'Hanezu Hagoromo'. This tree is a beauty in the garden. Limited Quantities Available !! As we have over a thousand cultivars of Japanese maples, we often do not have many of each cultivar. descriptions.preferred: 'Harusame', whose name means "spring rain," is best known for its fall coloration, when the red color is dusted with yellowish brown markings of the sunago fu (sand-dusted) type of variegation. Most of the year, the Corvallis a character. In some years, there have been only two leaves on the whole tree so variegated. The fiveor seven-lobed leaves are of the Palmatum Group, with length and width about 5 cm. The lobes are lanceolate-ovate, divided two-thirds or more to the center, and coarsely toothed. The petioles are about 4 cm long. This plant makes an upright, bushy, small tree. It does not reach much more than 3 m tall and wide, and that after a considerable age. The name is sometimes misspelled 'Harasume' and 'Marusame'.

sources.title: 春雨Acer Palmatum 'Harusame'
sources.description: 小叶品种，原产于日本、中国和韩国，以其披针形 的卵形叶子、带齿的叶柄和丰富的秋天色彩而闻 名。在春天，鲜红的叶子展开并慢慢成熟为黄绿色， 可能会有少数的白色杂色叶子，然后在夏天变成浅 绿色，秋天变成红色和黄棕色调。成年树高大约为 3 米左右，非常耐寒。于 1822 年在 Sekihin Binran 上被首次提及，有时候会错误拼写成 Harusume 或 Marusame。

descriptions_zh.preferred: 'Harusame' 意为“春雨”，最著名的是其秋色：红色叶面上洒布着黄褐色的 sunago fu（砂撒斑）型斑纹。全年大部分时间里，这种斑锦并不明显，有些年份整株树上甚至只有两片叶子出现如此斑纹。叶片属 Palmatum Group，5 裂或 7 裂，长宽约 5 厘米。裂片为披针状卵形，分裂达叶片中心的三分之二以上，边缘具粗锯齿。叶柄长约 4 厘米。植株形成直立、丛生的小乔木，需相当年数后才不超过约 3 米高、3 米宽。其名称有时被误写为 'Harasume' 或 'Marusame'。

descriptions.preferred: Acer pseudosieboldianum 'Hasselkus' Rare Japanese Maple Tree Zones 4-9 'Hasselkus' is a pseudosieboldianum selection hybrid with Acer palmatum that was found and introduced by the great plantsman, Ed Hasselkus. Ed Hasselkus was a professor at the University of Wisconsin-Madison who became famous for his plant selections. 'Hasselkus' brings everything you love about Acer palmatum to colder climates. The fall color of 'Hasselkus' is a bright golden yellow to red. 'Hasselkus' may reach 8-10 ft in height in 10 years growing about 1 ft in height each year. This selection has been trademarked under another name, however, 'Hasselkus' is the correct cultivar name that gives credit to the person who introduced it. Limited Quantities Available !! As we have over a thousand cultivars of Japanese maples, we often do not have many of each cultivar. descriptions.preferred: other The leaf shape of this cultivar is almost identical to that of 'Hagoromo'. However, the primary difference is in the variegated coloration. The leaf is occasionally whiteflecked with cream-colored irregular spots. It is not a strong color variegation, nor does it appear on all the leaves. If the plant is too vigorous or too highly fertilized, the variegations are masked for a growth period or two. Every effort should be made to keep the plant in good vigor but not overstimulated. It is not as strong growing as the non-variegated forms 'Hagoromo' and 'Koshimino', and it eventually reaches a height of 3 m or so. The name has been misspelled as 'Hageriono'. Corvallis with deeply divided lobes. As the leaves develop and the lobes fill out, the color changes to a nondescript bronze purple, which turns to a brilliant orange red to scarlet in the fall. The large five-lobed leaves, up to 9-10 cm long and 10-11 cm wide, are divided almost three-quarters of the way to the leaf base. Each broad lobe is ovate with a pointed tip, up to 2.5 cm wide in the middle, narrowing to 1-1.2 cm at the lobe junctions. The margins have numerous fine-pointed double teeth. The stout, dark red petioles are up to 4 cm long. The plant forms an upright bushy tree, reaching about 5-6 m tall and wide at maturity.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 该品种的叶形与 'Hagoromo' 几乎完全相同，主要区别在于其斑叶着色。叶片偶尔会散布白色小斑点和乳白色不规则斑块。这种斑色并不强烈，也不会出现在所有叶片上。若植株生长过旺或施肥过重，斑纹会在一两个生长期内被掩盖。应尽量保持植株健壮，但避免过度刺激生长。其长势不如无斑叶类型 'Hagoromo' 和 'Koshimino'，最终高度约 3 米。其名称曾被误拼为 'Hageriono'。另有一段资料显示：该品种叶片裂片深裂；随着叶片发育、裂片逐渐展开，叶色转为较普通的紫铜色，秋季则变为鲜艳的橙红至猩红色。大型五裂叶长可达 9–10 厘米、宽 10–11 厘米，约分裂至叶基的四分之三处。每个宽裂片呈卵形，先端尖，中部宽可达 2.5 厘米，在裂片连接处收窄至 1–1.2 厘米。叶缘具许多细尖的重锯齿。粗壮的深红色叶柄长可达 4 厘米。植株形成直立、枝叶繁密的小乔木，成熟时高、宽约 5–6 米。

descriptions.preferred: Acer palmatum 'Hefner's Red' Hefners Red Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 'Hefner's Red' was found as a chance Japanese Maple seedling by Hefner's Nursery in North Carolina, 'Hefner's Red' is a red upright Japanese maple has proven its heat tolerance by holding this deep maroon color from the spring through the summer and into the early fall before turning to a brighter fiery red in the late autumn. The shape of 'Hefner's Red' is upright and dense. 'Hefner's Red' performs this amazing feat even in the deep south. 'Hefner's Red' Japanese maple will reach 12-15 ft in 20 years. 'Hefner's Red' is an excellent Japanese maple to provide color in the garden, even in a southwest exposure planting in the yard. Because of the deep maroon color, 'Hefner's Red' provides as a great accent in any landscape. 'Hefner's Red' Japanese maple is also an excellent heat tolerant tree to be used as a focal point planting. If you are looking for one the deepest red Japanese maple selections on the market, 'Hefner's Red' is the maple for you. These 10 gallon trees are for local pickup only, we cannot ship them because they are too big. The MrMaple Nursery is located in East Flat Rock, NC. Please contact us to arrange a pickup time.

descriptions.preferred: Probably a cross between Acer palmatum and A. circinatum, this cultivar has sevento nine-lobed circular leaves with broadly ovate lobes and pointed tips. The stiff stout leafstalks are red. The leaves are dark green during the summer, becoming green with bronze and purple tones in late summer. In the fall, this German cultivar comes into its own, turning an outstanding orange. It is very vigorous, densely branched, upright, wide-spreading, and reaching 16-20 ft. (5-6 m) tall and about as wide. The name means "autumn fire." 'Hessei' Acer Matsumurae Group—red. The seven-lobed, very deeply divided leaves are medium-sized. Each lobe is long and narrow with toothed margins. The leaves droop slightly and give the plant a ribbonlike effect. Leaf color from spring to early summer is a rich purple-red, changing later to greenish bronze. Fall color is a brilliant crimson. 'Hessei' is hardy and strong but not tall-standing, tending to spread, and reaching about 16 ft. (5 m) high and 13 ft. (4 m) wide.

sources.title: 秋火 Acer Circinatum 'Herbstfeuer'
sources.description: 秋火是在德国发现的鸡爪槭和藤槭的杂交品种， Herbstfeuer 这个名字的意思是 " 秋天的火 " 。它是由德国苗圃管理员 Andreas Bartel 偶然间发现的，在 1985 年被 Andreas Bartels 注册为 "Herbstfeuer" 。叶子中等大小，一般为 7-9 裂，裂片深至 1/2 处，叶型很圆润。秋火春夏叶子都为绿色，秋天是非常绚烂的橙色和红色，正如它的名字一样。成年树高大约 5 到 6 米。

descriptions_zh.preferred: 该品种很可能是 Acer palmatum 与 A. circinatum 的杂交后代，叶片近圆形，具 7 至 9 个裂片，裂片宽卵形，先端尖。坚硬粗壮的叶柄为红色。夏季叶色为深绿色，到夏末转为绿色并带青铜色和紫色调。到了秋季，这个德国品种才真正展现风采，转为十分出色的橙色。其生长势很强，分枝密，树形直立而开展，高约 16-20 英尺（5-6 米），冠幅也大致相当。其名称意为“秋火”。 'Hessei' 属 Acer Matsumurae Group，红叶型。叶片 7 裂，裂片极深，中等大小。每个裂片狭长，边缘具锯齿。叶片略下垂，使植株呈现带状飘垂感。春季至初夏叶色为浓郁的紫红色，随后转为带绿的青铜色。秋色为鲜艳的深红色。'Hessei' 性强健且耐寒，但不属于高耸直立型，较趋于开展生长，高约 16 英尺（5 米），宽约 13 英尺（4 米）。

products.name: Acer palmatum 'Herbstfeuer' Fast Growing Japanese Maple
products.description_text: Acer palmatum ‘Herbstfeuer’ is a fast, upright growing Japanese maple with large, round leaves. In German, the name means Autumn fire and 'Herbstfeuer' certainly lives up to its name with its fiery red and orange colors in the fall. In spring, the large rounded leaves, held on red petioles, appear very light green with a white pubescence before turning dark green for summer. The growth habit is decidedly upright when young, becoming more rounded with age. Though listed as a palmatum there is some speculation that this may be a palmatum - circinatum cross. 10 Year size: Height: 10-12 Feet Width: 4-6 Feet Our 1 Gallon and 3 Gallon sizes are available for shipping and in store pickup. Our larger sizes (7 Gallon and bigger) are only available for in store pickup.

descriptions.preferred: The deeply divided, red leaves of this form are usually comprised of seven lobes, long and narrow, and divided almost to the leaf base. Each lobe is elongate-lanceolate with toothed margins. The lobes are 8-9 cm long and held closely together, thus making the leaf appear longer than wide, although the spread is up to 7 cm. The leaves droop slightly and give the plant a ribbonlike effect. The m wide. Occasional pruning shapes it very well. 'Hessei' is a hardy cultivar with sturdy twigs and branches. It is not easy to propagate because it heals slowly after grafting. Other names under which it has been known are 'Atropurpureum Lacinatum', 'Elegans Atropurpureum', 'Elegans Purpureum', and 'Lacinatum Purpureum'. These are all illegitimate.

rhs.description: A deciduous shrub or small tree, to around 1.2m high, with a spreading habit and deeply cut leaves divided to the base into long narrow lobes. Leaves emerge strongly flushed with red, and deepen to olive green and purple-bronze over summer before turning bright red again in autumn

attributes.suggested_uses: City/Courtyard Gardens, Cottage/Informal Garden, Flower borders and beds, Low Maintenance, Patio/Container Plants
attributes.hort_group_description: Acers in this matsumurae group are deeply divided to around three quarters of the leaf with coarsely-toothed edges and narrow, pointed lobes

care.cultivation: Grow in moisture-retentive, well-drained, ideally slightly acidic soil, in a sheltered position with protection from drying winds. Thrives in part shade, as some sun is needed to develop the leaf colour, but will tolerate full sun if soil is reliably moist. Mulch in spring, especially when grown in containers , to improve moisture retention. See Japanese maples cultivation
care.pruning: Minimal pruning required; see pruning group 1 . Prune from late autumn to mid-winter only
care.propagation: Propagate by layering or grafting

resistance.pest: May be susceptible to Acer gall mite, aphids , caterpillars and horse chestnut scale
resistance.disease: May be susceptible to Verticillium wilt , Acer leaf scorch and honey fungus

attributes.hort_group_description: 此 matsumurae 组的槭树，叶片深裂约达叶片的四分之三，叶缘具粗齿，裂片狭长且先端尖。
attributes.suggested_uses: 适合用于城市/庭院花园、乡村/自然式花园、花境与花坛、低维护栽培，以及露台/容器栽培。

care.cultivation: 宜栽植于保水性好但排水良好的土壤中，最好为微酸性，并选择避风、可防止干燥风侵袭的位置。最适合半阴环境，因为叶色形成需要一定光照；若土壤能持续保持湿润，也可耐全日照。春季覆 mulch，尤其是盆栽时，可提高土壤保湿性。参见 Japanese maples cultivation。
care.pruning: 所需修剪极少；参见修剪第 1 组。仅可在晚秋至仲冬期间修剪。
care.propagation: 可采用压条或嫁接繁殖。

resistance.pest: 可能易受槭瘿螨、蚜虫、毛虫和七叶树介壳虫危害
resistance.disease: 可能易感黄萎病、槭叶焦枯病和蜜环菌病

rhs_zh.description: 落叶灌木或小乔木，高约 1.2 米，株形开展。叶片深裂至基部，形成细长裂片。新叶萌发时带有明显红晕，夏季逐渐转为橄榄绿色与紫铜色，秋季再度变为鲜红色。

descriptions_zh.preferred: 该类型的深裂红叶通常由七个裂片组成，裂片细长狭窄，几乎分裂至叶基。每个裂片呈细长披针形，叶缘具锯齿。裂片长 8–9 厘米，彼此靠拢，因此叶片视觉上显得长于宽，尽管展开宽度可达 7 厘米。叶片略下垂，使植株呈现出如带状般的效果。该品种宽度资料原文残缺。偶尔修剪即可很好地整形。'Hessei' 是一个耐寒性良好的品种，枝条与主枝都较为粗壮。其繁殖并不容易，因为嫁接后愈合较慢。它还曾以 'Atropurpureum Lacinatum'、'Elegans Atropurpureum'、'Elegans Purpureum' 和 'Lacinatum Purpureum' 等名称流传，但这些名称均为非法名。

descriptions.preferred: 绯司是一款直立生长的红叶品种，叶子的性状非常好看， 根据日本枫树大师矢野正善的说法，阳光下看这棵树是 红色系里最好看的。春夏在整个生长季节中大部分时间 都保持着明亮的红色，秋天会变成猩红色。成年树高约 3-4 米。

products.description_text: Acer palmatum 'Hi-no-tsukasa' Red Hi-no-tsukasa Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 This Japanese maple is an amazing red upright selection from Tsukasa Nursery in Japan. According to Masayoshi Yano, this is the best red Japanese maple when given sunlight. 'Hi-no-tsukasa' is not a deep maroon, but yet in morning sun holds that bright red spring color throughout most of the growing season. Fall color is a bright scarlet. 'Hi-no-tsukasa' forms mid-sized upright reaching 12-14ft in 20 years. Limited Quantities Available !! descriptions.preferred: This cultivar is one of the variegated forms that have unusually shaped leaves. It is found in maple lists from Japan since the early 1880s. Many names were applied as it worked its way round the world. These different names were probably used because of its different foliage traits at different times of the year. One widely used name in the United States is 'Roseo-marginatum', which unfortunately has also been used for 'Kagiri nishiki', a cultivar outstanding and beautiful in its own right. Other names, such as 'Cristatum Variegatum', have been applied to depict certain traits. I saw large specimen trees of 'Higasa yama' in the Netherlands and England. These mature (several decades old) plants strengthen my opinion on the veracity of this nomenclature. Most leaves range up to 6 cm long with an overall width of 5 cm. The average length is 3-4 cm. The leaves are divided two-thirds or more down to the obtuse leaf base. The seven lobes of each leaf are slender, elongate, Starting in the early spring, the buds unfold with leaflets 'Higasa yama'. Spring buds are spectacular as they unfold. Archives, Corvallis cially the broad band along each midrib. The borders of each of the seven divisions are cream colored, and the striping continues down toward the leaf base. This color is quite pale in early season and changes to a light creamy green as the season advances. For the first month or so the leaves also have strong pink tones on the margins overlying the cream color and lightly bordering the edges of the lobes. This undoubtedly gives rise to the confusing misnomer of 'Roseo-marginatum'. The pink color fades and disappears as the season progresses. In the fall, the cream color portions take on an orange to dark yellow and occasionally red tone. The growth on older wood is quite twiggy. The twigs are closely spaced, and the nodes are close together. For this reason, this cultivar is popular for bonsai. When suppressed in pots, it is quite dense and lends itself to shaping. As 'Shinn's #2', it is quite popular for bonsai in California. Under good growth conditions in the ground, however, long shoots occur up to 1 m long. The new leaves on these shoots are nearly always nontypical of the cultivar. Instead, they are regular palmate, flat, dark green, and most often have five lobes. They are up to 8 cm long. These new atypical shoots revert to the cultivar's typical shape and color by the second year and need not be pruned off. This reversion is a greater problem in Europe than it is in the United States (van Gelderen et al. 1994). The tree, which can be quite vigorous and have a narrow upright habit, reaches 7-8 m tall. It is a hardy plant which lend itself well to the garden landscape. The unique growth habit and foliage make it most attractive. Light shining through the variegated leaves gives a very unusual and pleasing effect. This cultivar name has been misspelled 'Hikasa yama' and 'Hisagayama'.

sources.title: 日笠山 Acer Palmatum 'Higasa Yama'
sources.description: 非常古老的日系品种，以 Mt.Higasa( 日本东笠山 ) 的名字命名，" Higasa "意为日笠、阳伞，" yama "则指的是山。春季的色彩可以说是首屈一指的， 春叶为淡粉色绿色的脉斑叶，粉色会快速蜕变为奶白色，春季新叶呈向上卷曲状， 被很多朋友戏称为 "鸡爪子槭"。 入夏后变成绿色，晚夏会抽二次新稍，新稍为绿色叶，第二年会出锦，秋叶为红色，相比较新日笠 ， 会保持较久的粉色效果，生长强健，抗性好， 每年的生长高度大约 30cm ， 形状非常密集和狭窄，分枝低，靠近地面 ， 成年株可达 4-5m 左右 的 高度。

descriptions_zh.preferred: 该品种属于斑叶型品种之一，且叶形异于常见类型。自 19 世纪 80 年代初起，它就已见于日本槭树名录中。随着传播到世界各地，它曾被赋予许多名称。这些不同名称很可能源于其在一年不同季节表现出的不同叶态。在美国，一个广泛使用的名称是 'Roseo-marginatum'，但遗憾的是，这个名称也曾被用于 'Kagiri nishiki'，而后者本身就是一个极为出色且美丽的品种。另一些名称如 'Cristatum Variegatum'，则是为了描述其某些特征而使用。我曾在荷兰和英国见过大型的 'Higasa yama' 成株，这些成熟植株（栽培数十年）更加印证了我对这一命名准确性的判断。大多数叶片长可达 6 厘米，整体宽约 5 厘米，平均长度为 3-4 厘米。叶片向下分裂达钝形叶基的三分之二以上。每片叶的 7 个裂片细长、延伸。早春时，芽体展开，露出 'Higasa yama' 的小叶；春芽展开时极为壮观，尤其是沿每条主脉分布的宽阔色带。7 个裂片的边缘均为乳白色，这种条纹一直延续至叶基附近。季初这种颜色很浅，随着生长季推进，转为浅奶油绿色。在最初约一个月内，叶缘还会叠加明显的粉红色调，轻覆于乳白色之上，并浅浅勾勒裂片边缘。这很可能正是其被误称为 'Roseo-marginatum' 的原因。随着季节推进，粉色逐渐褪去并消失。秋季时，乳白色部分会转为橙色至深黄色，偶尔也带红色调。老枝上的生长非常细密，小枝排列紧凑，节间很短。因此该品种很受盆景爱好者欢迎；盆栽控长条件下株形十分致密，便于造型。以 'Shinn's #2' 之名时，它在加利福尼亚也颇受盆景界欢迎。然而，在地栽且生长条件良好时，会抽生长达 1 米的长枝。这些长枝上的新叶几乎总是偏离该品种的典型特征，转而表现为普通掌状、平展、深绿色且多为 5 裂，长度可达 8 厘米。这类非典型新梢到第二年会恢复为该品种的典型叶形和叶色，因此不必修剪去除。据 van Gelderen 等人（1994）记载，这种返祖现象在欧洲比在美国更成问题。该树可生长得相当旺盛，树形狭窄直立，高可达 7-8 米。它是一个强健耐寒、很适合园林应用的品种。其独特的生长习性和叶色使其极具观赏性，光线透过斑叶时会产生非常独特而悦目的效果。该品种名也曾被误拼为 'Hikasa yama' 和 'Hisagayama'。

products.title: Acer palmatum 'Higasayama' Japanese Maple
products.description_text: Acer palmatum 'Higasayama' Pink Reticulated Variegated Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 ‘Higasayama’ is an amazing, upright variegated Japanese maple that is very vigorous. This is a very old Japanese cultivar that is under-used in the modern landscape. From our best interpretation, the name 'Higasa' refers to a Japanese umbrella, while 'yama' means mountain. ‘Higasayama’ has one of the most sensational spring shows with buds that unfurl in dramatic fashion. This tree really pops as the buds open up to reveal amazing shapes and colors. The leaf has a heavy green vein outlined by whites and accented by a hot pink edging. The fall colors are oranges to red. ‘Higasayama’ is a very fast grower with almost 1 foot of growth per year after getting established. The shape is very dense and narrow with low branching close to the ground. The height can reach up to 18 ft over time. ‘Higasayama’ grows well in filtered light and can handle full sun but you will notice more greening late in the summer. Typically trees from the greenhouse will be greener than ones leafing outside in the ground but this one doesn’t revert and will show more variegation. This is an amazing tree that jumps out of the landscape with bright colors and has a perfect shape for a specimen tree. The spring show is second to none. Limited Quantities Available !! As we have over a thousand cultivars of Japanese maples, we often do not have many of each cultivar. We recommend that you buy the Japanese maples you want immediately as we often sell out of certain selections.

descriptions.preferred: 'Hiu\ga yama' is reportedly a seedling selection of 'Nomura', one of the oldest known cultivars. The leaf lobes are longer and more slender than are those of 'Nomura' The color in the early season is a deep purple red which becomes less intense as the season progresses. By late summer it is greenish bronze-purple. The leaves are of growth habit rather erect. This cultivar is not widely grown, probably because it has no outstandingly different features from many other red cultivars. The name has been variously spelled 'Higugayama', 'Hiyu\gayama', and 'Hyugayama', while this cultivar has also been known under the name of 'Hinata yama'.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 'Hiu\ga yama' 据称是已知最古老品种之一 'Nomura' 的实生选种。其叶裂片比 'Nomura' 更长、更狭。生长季早期叶色为深紫红色，随后随季节推进而逐渐减淡；至夏末则转为带绿色调的青铜紫色。叶片着生姿态较为直立。该品种栽培并不广泛，可能因为与许多其他红叶品种相比，并无特别突出的差异特征。其名称还曾有多种拼写形式，如 'Higugayama'、'Hiyu\gayama' 和 'Hyugayama'，此外该品种也曾以 'Hinata yama' 之名流传。

products.title: Acer palmatum 'Hinata yama' Japanese Maple
products.description_text: ACER PALMATUM 'HINATA YAMA' Rare Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 'Hinata yama' was a tree introduced into the trade in 1923 by Tozuka Momiji En nursery in Japan. It earns its name "sunny mountain" from the first flush of spring, when its leaves emerge in deep crimson with a warm, coppery undertone. As the season progresses into summer, the foliage softens to rich green. Fall color showing a saturated crimson that rivals anything in the landscape. A member of the amoenum group, 'Hinata yama' carries the broader, deeply lobed leaves characteristic of its lineage. Reaching around 10 feet in 10 years, making it a well-suited specimen for smaller gardens. Best sited in partial shade, though it can handle some sun. Give it good drainage, keep it protected from harsh winds, and it will reward you with three seasons of genuine color. Limited Quantities Available !! As we have over a thousand cultivars of Japanese maples, we often do not have many of each cultivar. We recommend that you buy the Japanese maples you want immediately as we often sell out of certain selections.

descriptions.preferred: Surely this cultivar was selected for its rich, deep orange fall color. The Maplewood stock plant usually turned a bright pumpkin orange. The spring and summer foliage color is a deep, rich green. The leaves measure up to 6 cm long and 9 cm wide and are seven lobed and broadly palmate. They have a heavy texture and good substance. The lobes radiate out and are divided only up to about halfway to the leaf base. They are ovate-triangular with edges very finely serrated. The petioles are up to 4 cm long. This sturdy and hardy cultivar has thick and sometimes stubby new growth. The tree reaches 5-6 m with age and responds well to pruning and shaping. Although not widely distributed, it is a very worthwhile plant since most of the year it is an attractive rich green, followed by the unique orange of fall. The name, which means "a jewel," has been misspelled as 'Ho\gyuko'. The cultivar has been known under the name 'Yog saku'. The leaves generally lie in a flat plane, although the tips of the lobes tend to curve downward. They range from 2 to 3 cm long and 4 cm wide. Foliage on new vigorous shoots will average larger than this, but the old wood has uniformly small leaves. The lobes are mostly long and slender with a slightly broader mid area, gradually tapering to a fine point. The edges are faintly serrated. The general tone of the foliage is a pleasant light green without being weak. In each leaf of this base color there are variegated breaks of varying size and shape. Some leaves are totally colored with the variegation of pale cream green, while others may only have a portion of one lobe colored on the edge. The markings vary between these two extremes. The cream-green variegation is quite subtle, not garish, and may even have a faint tinge of pink on the borders in early spring as the leaves emerge. The overall appearance is a pastel tone. This neat-growing, upright, non-spreading, small shrub is somewhat twiggy, and under normal culture has short terminal shoots. It blends well with many types of companions and makes a good patio plant. This cultivar was spotted at Maplewood Nursery as a chance seedling from 'Kamagata'. The name means "the starstudded sky." 'Hupp's Dwarf' dwarf -green This choice green dwarf was a chance seedling which Barbara Hupp of Silverton, Oregon, first noted in a seedling bed. The seedling was moved to Maplewood Nursery in 1976 and observed for about 10 years. It seems similar in growth type to some of the other compact dwarfs, such as 'Kotohime', 'Mikawa yatsubusa', and 'Tsukomo', but appears more compact in habit than these cultivars and more vigorous than 'Tsukomo'. It is distinct enough to warrant its place in the range of dwarf cultivars. The foliage is a deep, rich green which holds well all season. The leaf has five long, slender lobes separated almost entirely to the leaf base. The leaves vary from 3 to 4 cm long and 1-3 cm wide, and are densely concentrated on the short annual growth of 1-4 cm per season. The lobes have sharp, slender points, and the edges are strongly toothed. greater growth rate. The twigs are quite brittle, and the minimal annual growth makes this cultivar difficult to propagate. It is ideal for bonsai.

care.cultivation: 宜栽于保水且排水良好的土壤中，并选择避风位置。半阴环境下叶色表现最佳；若土壤湿度稳定，也可耐全日照。土壤缺水或暴露过度都可能导致叶片焦边。参见 Japanese maples cultivation。

rhs_zh.description: 一种生长强健、直立的落叶乔木，约高 4 米；叶片大而革质，浓绿色，7 裂；新叶展开时为绿色并带红晕，秋季转为鲜黄色，并染有橙色和红色。

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这个品种显然是因其浓郁深橙的秋色而被选育出来的。Maplewood 的母株通常会转成明亮的南瓜橙色。春夏季叶色为深而浓的绿色。叶片最长可达 6 厘米、最宽 9 厘米，具 7 枚裂片，呈宽掌状。叶质厚实，质感良好。裂片向外放射，分裂深度仅约达叶基的一半。裂片呈卵状三角形，边缘具极细锯齿。叶柄最长可达 4 厘米。该品种健壮且耐寒，新梢粗壮，有时略显短粗。成熟后树高可达 5-6 米，并且对修剪整形反应良好。尽管流通并不广泛，但仍是非常值得栽培的品种，因为大部分季节里都保持迷人的浓绿色，随后在秋季呈现独特的橙色。其名称意为“宝玉”，曾被误拼为 'Ho\gyuko'。该品种也曾以 'Yog saku' 之名流传。 叶片通常平展于一个平面上，尽管裂片先端常略向下弯。叶片一般长 2-3 厘米、宽约 4 厘米。强旺新梢上的叶会比这个尺寸略大，而老枝上的叶则始终较小且整齐。裂片多为细长形，中部略宽，然后逐渐收尖。边缘有淡淡锯齿。整体叶色为悦目的浅绿色，但并不显得薄弱。在这种底色上，每片叶都有大小形状不一的斑锦破色。有些叶片几乎全部呈淡奶油绿色斑锦，另一些则可能只有某一裂片边缘的一小部分显色。斑纹变化介于两者之间。这种奶油绿色斑锦相当含蓄，不刺眼，早春新叶展开时，边缘甚至可能略带淡粉色。整体观感偏柔和粉彩。 植株生长整洁，直立，不横向扩展，属于小型灌木，枝条略多，在正常栽培条件下顶端新梢较短。它与许多伴栽植物都能很好搭配，也适合作为露台盆栽。该品种是在 Maplewood Nursery 发现的 'Kamagata' 偶发实生苗。其名称意为“繁星点点的天空”。 'Hupp's Dwarf' 是优良的绿色矮生品种。这个精选的绿色矮生品种最初是 Barbara Hupp（俄勒冈州 Silverton）在实生苗床中发现的偶发实生苗。该苗于 1976 年移至 Maplewood Nursery，并持续观察约 10 年。其生长类型与其他一些紧凑型矮生品种如 'Kotohime'、'Mikawa yatsubusa' 和 'Tsukomo' 相似，但株形似乎比这些品种更紧凑，且比 'Tsukomo' 更有生长势。它的特征足以使其在矮生品种中占有一席之地。 叶色深而浓绿，整个生长季保持良好。叶片具 5 枚细长裂片，几乎完全分裂至叶基。叶长 3-4 厘米，宽 1-3 厘米，密集着生于每年仅 1-4 厘米的短生长枝上。裂片先端尖细，叶缘锯齿明显。枝条较脆，而年生长量极小，使该品种繁殖较为困难。非常适合制作盆景。

descriptions.preferred: The small unusual five-lobed leaves are star-shaped. Each lobe varies in shape according to the degree of variegation and is mostly long and slender, slightly broader in the middle, and gradually tapering to a fine tip which tends to turn down. The margins are faintly toothed. Leaf color is a pleasant light green. In each leaf, there are variegated breaks of varying size and shape. Some leaves are totally pale cream green, others may only have one lobe variegated on the edge. The cream-green may be faintly pink-tinged in the spring. This neat-growing, upright, non-spreading, small shrub blends well with many types of companions and makes a good patio plant. The name means "star-studded sky." 'Hupp's Dwarf' Dwarf Group—green. A choice green dwarf similar to 'Kotohime', 'Mikawa yatsubusa', and 'Tsukomo', 'Hupp's Dwarf' is more compact than these and more vigorous than 'Tsukomo'. The foliage is a deep, rich green. The leaf has five long, slender, deeply divided lobes with sharp, slender points and with strongly toothed margins. The leaves are densely concentrated on the short annual growth. Because of its minimal annual growth, this cultivar is ideal for bonsai.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 其小型而特殊的 5 裂叶呈星形。每个裂片会随斑锦程度不同而形态有异，多数狭长，中部略宽，先端逐渐收尖，且常微微下垂。叶缘具浅锯齿。叶色为悦目的浅绿色。每片叶上都有大小和形状不一的斑锦断裂，有的叶片几乎整体呈浅奶油绿色，有的则仅某一个裂片边缘带斑。春季时，这种奶油绿色可能略带粉色晕染。该品种生长整齐，直立、不开展，为小型灌木，易与多种植物搭配，也适合作为庭院盆栽。其名称意为“繁星满天”。 'Hupp's Dwarf' 属 Dwarf Group，绿叶型。它是一个优良的绿色矮生品种，类似于 'Kotohime'、'Mikawa yatsubusa' 和 'Tsukomo'；但比这些品种更紧凑，也比 'Tsukomo' 生长更旺。叶色浓深而富有质感。叶片具 5 个狭长且深裂的裂片，先端尖细，叶缘具明显锯齿。叶片密集着生于每年短生枝上。由于年生长量极小，该品种非常适合制作盆景。

descriptions.preferred: The remarkable foliage has both starlike specks and sand-dusted white to cream variegations boldly covering the deep green base color in varying amounts from light dots to bold color slashes. In full shade, the markings are almost pure white. In sun, they are a light yellow to gold. Full exposure to hot sun, however, causes leaf damage. The leaves have five to seven broadly triangular shallow lobes This cultivar forms a compact medium-sized shrub up to 16 ft. (5 m) tall. When it is sited near a path, the unique foliage can be easily seen and appreciated. The name means "star leaf."

descriptions_zh.preferred: 其引人注目的叶片在深绿色底色上，分布有星状斑点以及仿佛撒砂般的白色至乳白色斑锦，斑纹多少不一，从细小点斑到大块醒目的色斑皆有。全阴环境下，斑纹几乎呈纯白色；在日照下则偏浅黄至金色。但若暴露于炎热烈日下，叶片会受灼伤。叶片具 5 至 7 个宽三角形浅裂片。该品种形成紧凑的中型灌木，高可达 16 英尺（5 米）。若栽植于小径旁，其独特叶色更易观赏。其名称意为“星叶”。

descriptions.preferred: Acer oliverianum ssp. oliverianum X 'Hot Sauce' Zones 6-9 Heatseekers Series™ AREA 51 COLLECTION™ PLANTS THAT ARE OUT OF THIS WORLD 'Hot Sauce' was found and selected from a batch of Acer oliverianum by our good friend and mentor, Masayoshi Yano, at World Maple Park in Uda, Japan. ’Hot Sauce’ is quite attractive for an Acer oliverianum, giving the red color of a ‘Bloodgood’ Japanese maple, but the heat tolerance of Acer oliverianum. The spring color of ‘Hot Sauce’ is a bright red, turning to deep red. To hold the best color and get the best vigor out of ‘Hot Sauce’ give it plenty of sunlight. During the latest part of summer, ‘Hot Sauce’ may turn greener. Fall color is bright oranges to red. ‘Hot Sauce’ makes a nice upright tree reaching 10-12 ft in height in 10 years. ‘Hot Sauce’ was given as a gift by Masayoshi Yano to Matt and Tim under the working code-name “Nakahara beni A’ . We received permission by Mr. Yano to call this tree ‘Hot Sauce’ and have added this tree to our Heatseekers Series™ of heat tolerant maples for the Southern Garden. 'Hot Sauce' is one of the most heat tolerant Japanese maples we produce. This heat tolerance allows gardeners the ability to bring more ornamental appeal to the southwest exposure in the southern garden. Gardeners in the South have been looking for this Japanese maple for years. This cultivar must be propagated by grafting onto Acer palmatum. Limited Quantities Available !! 'Hot Sauce' is one of the most heat tolerant Japanese maples we produce. This heat tolerance allows gardeners the ability to bring more ornamental appeal to the southwest exposure in the southern garden. Gardeners in the South have been looking for this Japanese maple for years. This cultivar must be propagated by grafting onto Acer palmatum. Limited Quantities Available !! rhs.description: A small, deciduous, vase-shaped tree about 3m tall, with a willow-like appearance, the long, slender, slightly incised 5-lobed purplish-red leaves, turn fiery orange and red in autumn

attributes.suggested_uses: City/Courtyard Gardens, Cottage/Informal Garden, Patio/Container Plants

care.cultivation: Grow in any moisture-retentive, well-drained soil in a sheltered position. Leaf colour is best in partial shade, although full sun can be tolerated if soil is reliably moist. Leaf scorch can be caused by lack of soil moisture or excessive exposure. See Japanese maples cultivation
care.pruning: Pruning group 1 , only from late autumn to mid-winter
care.propagation: Propagate by softwood cuttings, layering or by grafting . Plants grown from seed are unlikely to come true, but may still be garden worthy

resistance.pest: May be susceptible to aphids and scale insects , including horse chestnut scale
resistance.disease: May be susceptible to Verticillium wilt , Acer leaf scorch and honey fungus

attributes.suggested_uses: 城市/庭院花园、乡村/自然式花园、露台/容器栽培

care.cultivation: 宜栽于保水且排水良好的土壤中，并选择避风位置。半阴环境下叶色表现最佳；若土壤湿度稳定，也可耐全日照。土壤缺水或暴露过度都可能导致叶片焦边。参见 Japanese maples cultivation。
care.pruning: 修剪组 1，仅限晚秋至仲冬期间修剪。
care.propagation: 可通过嫩枝扦插、压条或嫁接繁殖。实生苗通常难以保持品种性状，但仍可能具有园艺观赏价值。

resistance.pest: 可能易受蚜虫和介壳虫侵害，包括七叶树介壳虫。
resistance.disease: 可能易感黄萎病、槭叶焦枯病和蜜环菌病

rhs_zh.description: 一株小型落叶乔木，高约 3 米，树形呈花瓶状，整体姿态似柳。叶片细长，具轻微缺刻的 5 裂，叶色紫红，秋季转为火焰般的橙红色。

descriptions.preferred: This tall-growing plant is one of the rough-bark cultivars. Ibo, one of the Japanese words for "warty," indicates the interesting character of the bark. The wartiness is rather lenticular oblong in shape and is slow to develop, appearing on third-year (or older) wood. It is very slow to coalesce, remaining separated for a few years, finally joining into larger roughened areas. It is not as showy as are some of the other cultivars with rough bark. The intermediate bark color is a good green. The leaves are from 3 to 8 cm long and wide, seven lobed, occasionally five lobed, and separated two-thirds of the way or so to the leaf base. The lobes are long-ovate with heavily toothed margins. The spring color is a good light green with bronze-tinged margins. Fall colors range from yellow orange to deep crimson. This fairly strong grower has the typical palmatum upright habit. The warty bark makes an interest point for the collector of unusual forms. The name has been misspelled 'Ebo nishiki' and 'Iibo nishiki'. Corvallis stands out from all others for its brilliance. Because the leaves are large, their colors are flamboyant. During the growing season, when the leaves are a pleasant green, the tree looks identical to 'O|sakazuki'. It is reported that they may have been sister seedlings when selected in the 1880s. These trees have very large leaves, measuring up to 12 cm long with a spread of 15 cm. The seven lobes are broadly ovate, shaping to a sharp point, and with the edges slightly toothed. The lobes are joined about halfway to the base, forming a broad and substantial leaf. The petioles are up to 7 cm long. The tree is upright and broad and, at maturity, is round-headed. It can attain a height of 7 m, although it is not usually seen this tall. With pruning, the tree shapes well and there need be no fear of keeping this type within bounds in the smaller plantings. It is of sturdy branch structure and not willowy. Japanese writers wisely suggest planting 'Ichigyo\ji' and 'O|sakazuki' near each other on a rise or hillside, or near a pond, to allow the full glory of the fall brilliance to be appreciated. The name 'Ichigyo\ji' has been misspelled 'Ichijoji' and 'Ighigyoji'.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这是一种高大生长型品种，属于粗皮类。Ibo 是日语中表示“疣状”的词之一，点出了该品种树皮的有趣特征。其疣状突起多呈长椭圆形皮孔状，形成较慢，通常出现在 3 年生或更老的枝条上。它们彼此融合的速度也很慢，往往先分散存在数年，之后才逐渐连成较大的粗糙斑块。与其他一些粗皮品种相比，它的表现并不算特别醒目。中间树皮颜色为良好的绿色。 叶片长宽约 3-8 厘米，多为 7 裂，偶有 5 裂，分裂深度约达叶基的三分之二。裂片长卵形，叶缘具明显粗锯齿。春叶为鲜浅绿色，叶缘带古铜色晕染。秋色从黄橙色到深绯红色不等。该品种生长势较强，具典型的 palmatum 直立株形。其疣状树皮对收集奇特类型的爱好者颇具吸引力。该名称曾被误拼为 'Ebo nishiki' 和 'Iibo nishiki'。 'Ichigyo\ji' 在众多品种中以其秋色的明艳程度尤为突出。由于叶片较大，其色彩表现极为华丽。生长季中，当叶片呈悦目的绿色时，这株树看起来与 'O|sakazuki' 几乎相同。据称二者可能是在 1880 年代被选出的姐妹实生苗。其叶片很大，最长可达 12 厘米，展开宽度可达 15 厘米。7 枚裂片呈宽卵形，先端尖锐，边缘略具锯齿。裂片约在叶基一半处相连，因此形成宽大而厚实的叶片。叶柄最长可达 7 厘米。树形直立而开展，成熟后呈圆头状。树高可达 7 米，尽管通常较少见到如此高大的个体。通过修剪可较好整形，因此在较小空间中栽植也不必担心失控。其枝条结构强健，不呈垂柔状。日本作者很有见地地建议将 'Ichigyo\ji' 与 'O|sakazuki' 相邻种植于坡地、山坡或池塘边，以便充分欣赏其秋季绚烂色彩。'Ichigyo\ji' 这一名称也曾被误拼为 'Ichijoji' 和 'Ighigyoji'。

products.name: Acer palmatum 'Ibo nishiki' Rough Bark Japanese Maple
products.description_text: This is another of the cork bark maples highly prized by bonsai enthusiast. 'Ibo nishiki' means "warty bark", however the fissures in the bark of this small tree do not appear as deep as in some other rough bark varieties such as 'Nishi gawa' or 'Arakawa'. This gives the bark of 'Ibo nishiki' a more subtle appearance. Like many other rough bark varieties it usually takes several years for the warty bark to start to appear. Fall color varies from year to year but is normally a beautiful mix of yellow, orange and even red. 10 Tear size: Height:12-14 Feet Width: 10-12 Feet

rhs.description: A deciduous hybrid maple (A. palmatum x A. pseudosieboldianum) about 3-4m tall with a wide, slight weeping habit. Mid-green, finely divided leaves, emerge in spring, a blush orange-red, quickly maturing to green, turning yellow, orange and red in autumn; bred to be a substitute for less hardy Japanese maples in harsh climate conditions

attributes.suggested_uses: City/Courtyard Gardens, Coastal, Cottage/Informal Garden

care.cultivation: Grow in fertile, moist but well-drained soil in sun or partial shade. See tree cultivation and Japanese maples cultivation for further advice
care.pruning: Pruning group 1 , if necessary, from late autumn to midwinter only
care.propagation: Propagate by grafting in late winter or softwood cuttings in early summer

resistance.pest: May be susceptible to Acer gall mite, aphids , caterpillars and horse chestnut scale
resistance.disease: May be susceptible to coral spot , Verticillium wilt , Acer leaf scorch and honey fungus

rhs_zh.description: 落叶杂交槭（A. palmatum × A. pseudosieboldianum），高约 3-4 米，株形宽展，略具下垂姿态。叶片中绿色，细裂，春季萌发时带橙红色晕染，随后很快转绿，秋季转为黄色、橙色和红色。该品种培育目的在于替代耐寒性较差的日本枫，在严酷气候条件下栽培。

attributes.suggested_uses: 城市/庭院花园、滨海花园、乡村/自然式花园

care.cultivation: 宜栽培于肥沃、湿润但排水良好的土壤中，环境以全日照或半阴为宜。更多栽培建议可参见树木栽培及日本枫树栽培资料。
care.pruning: 修剪组 1；如有需要，仅可在深秋至仲冬期间修剪。
care.propagation: 可于冬末采用嫁接繁殖，或于初夏进行软枝扦插繁殖。

descriptions.preferred: Except for its intense brilliant yellow or orange fall color, 'Ichigyo¯ji' re- - sembles the crimson-leaved 'Osakazuki'. During summer, the large seven-lobed leaves are a pleasant green. They are broadly ovate and sharppointed, with slightly toothed edges. The lobes are joined about halfway to the base. The tree is upright and broad and becomes round-headed, reaching a height of 23 ft. (7 m). Japanese writers - advise planting 'Ichigyo¯ji' and 'Osakazuki' near each other to allow the full glory of the fall brilliance to be appreciated. 'Ichigyo¯ji' is named after a temple.

sources.description: 一行寺是一款非常稀少的枫树品种，在市面上不常见。 春天金黄色，夏季会返绿，秋天一棵树上会出现金色、 橙色和猩红色。叶型和红灯笼很像，成年树高约 3-4 米。

rhs.description: A large, bushy shrub, or small spreading tree, with a rounded head to around 6m tall and wide. The large, 7-lobed green leaves, up to 15cm across, turn brilliant orange and yellow in autumn. Small red flowers borne in clusters in spring are followed by red fruits

descriptions.preferred: The colors of this dark-leaved variegate make it an unusual addition to the garden landscape. The large leaves Corvallis petioles are up to 5 cm long. The spring foliage is a rich red color, slightly on the orange side, and lasts into the summer. At this time, the feature for which this cultivar is named develops. The leaves become a rich purplish brown—a rather unique color—with tiny and irregular green spots, sometimes rather obscure, but resembling sprinkled sand. It is for this type of variegation, known as sunago fu (sanddusted), that the cultivar has been named. These colors intensify in late summer and fall. The midrib of each lobe remains a distinctly contrasting yellow green, while the leaves turn to yellows, oranges, and reds in the fall. This strong-growing tree remains upright but does not reach extreme heights. It probably matures at about 7-8 m high and forms a round-headed tree. The branches are sturdy and not willowy.

sources.title: 饭岛砂子 Acer Palmatum 'Iijima Sunago'
sources.description: 饭岛砂子 1882年 开始有记载 ， 春天新叶为茶红色覆 盖 有白色 小 绒毛， 随着时间的推移会逐渐变成浓郁的棕红色或者紫红色，并带有 微小的、不规则的金黄色沙点斑 ，就好似沙子洒落在叶面的感觉。饭岛砂子也正是因为这种特殊的 "沙尘"般的杂色而得名。 夏季红色变暗，金黄色沙点斑比例逐渐提升 。如果夏季在 遮阴 的情况下，会出现一定程度的返绿。 秋天为橙黄色或橙红色。生长速度中等，可全日照度夏，夏季午后适当遮阴为佳，成年株 高 可达 3米左右。

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这一深色叶斑锦品种的色彩组合使其成为庭园景观中相当独特的存在。叶片较大，叶柄最长可达 5 厘米。春季叶色为浓郁的红色，略偏橙调，并可持续到夏季。此时会出现该品种得名的特征：叶片转为浓厚的紫褐色，这是一种颇为独特的色彩，其上散布细小而不规则的绿色斑点，有时较不明显，但形似撒上的细砂。该品种正是因这种称为 sunago fu（砂撒斑）的斑锦而得名。到夏末和秋季，这些色彩会更加浓烈。每个裂片的主脉始终保持鲜明对比的黄绿色，而叶片在秋季又会转为黄色、橙色和红色。该树生长强健，树形直立，但不会长得过高，成熟时大概高 7-8 米，形成圆头树冠。枝条粗壮，不呈柔垂状。

products.title: Acer palmatum 'Iijima sunago' Japanese Maple
products.description_text: Acer palmatum 'Iijima sunago' Rare Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 'Iijima sunago' is a classic upright Japanese maple with amazing colors. This cultivar, which dates back to the 1800's in Japan, has stood the test of time. 'Iijima sunago' leafs out with some amazing colors of pink-red, maturing to mauve brick red with an emerald cast. Later a yellow green with a brick red to bronze cast. Fall color starts out as bright yellow, later becoming infused with orange. The colors on this tree are outstanding. This classic Japanese maple makes an excellent pair with 'Bloodgood', 'Crimson Queen', or 'Osakazuki' as it will have contrasting fall colors. 'Iijima sunago' may reach 10-12 ft in height in 10 years. Limited Quantities Available !! As we have over a thousand cultivars of Japanese maples, we often do not have many of each cultivar. We recommend that you buy the Japanese maples you want immediately as we often sell out of certain selections.

descriptions.preferred: Ikandi，发音为"eye candy"，非常甜蜜的名字。它 是从 Acer palmatum 'Alpenweiss'（白色阿尔卑斯）选育 出来的，而 Alpenweiss 来源于日笠山，所以 Ikandi 与日笠山很相似。在著名的《Japanese Maples》中 对 Alpenweiss 的介绍是：与日笠山相似但比它小， 颜色更加鲜艳。继承 Alpenweiss 并与日笠山隔代相 传 ,Ikandi 的春天的粉色更显著，更诱人。Ikandi 在 春天比其他枫树更早地出叶，叶子首先出现带有橙 色边缘的黄绿色，很快变成充满活力的鲑鱼粉红 色，带有绿色的叶脉。在叶脉周围出现绿色和白色 之前，'Ikandi 的叶子几乎完全变成粉红色。到夏天， 粉红色的杂色逐渐变成绿色和乳白色。秋天会变成 橙色到红色。需要注意的是，Ikandi 幼树颜色并不 饱满突出，随着树龄的增加，锦叶的表现会更加强烈。

sources.description: Ikandi，发音为"eye candy"，非常甜蜜的名字。它 是从 Acer palmatum 'Alpenweiss'（白色阿尔卑斯）选育 出来的，而 Alpenweiss 来源于日笠山，所以 Ikandi 与日笠山很相似。在著名的《Japanese Maples》中 对 Alpenweiss 的介绍是：与日笠山相似但比它小， 颜色更加鲜艳。继承 Alpenweiss 并与日笠山隔代相 传 ,Ikandi 的春天的粉色更显著，更诱人。Ikandi 在 春天比其他枫树更早地出叶，叶子首先出现带有橙 色边缘的黄绿色，很快变成充满活力的鲑鱼粉红 色，带有绿色的叶脉。在叶脉周围出现绿色和白色 之前，'Ikandi 的叶子几乎完全变成粉红色。到夏天， 粉红色的杂色逐渐变成绿色和乳白色。秋天会变成 橙色到红色。需要注意的是，Ikandi 幼树颜色并不 饱满突出，随着树龄的增加，锦叶的表现会更加强烈。

products.name: Acer palmatum 'Ikandi' Variegated Japanese Maple
products.description_text: Acer palmatum ‘Ikandi’ is an extremely variegated Japanese maple discovered as a chance seedling from Acer palmatum ‘Alpenweiss’ by Talon Buchholz. The leaves on ‘Ikandi emerge almost entirely pink before the green and white develop around the veins. The pink variegation fades to green and creamy white by summer time and eventually will turn orange to red in the fall. ‘Ikandi’ needs to be protected from the hot afternoon sun, but morning or dappled sun help to provide excellent color to the variegated leaves in the spring. Variegated leaves on ‘Ikandi’ develop more as it matures, so be patient with this one and you will reap the beautiful benefits in the long run. ‘Ikandi’ will grow into a small to medium sized tree that should only reach eight to ten feet tall at maturity. 10 Year Size: Height: 8-10 feet Width: 4-6 feet

descriptions.preferred: This outstanding dissectum differs from others of its type in its deep color and individual leaf shape. The leaves are large for a dissectum, with lobes up to 10 cm long. The basal lobes point backward. The entire sevenlobed leaf measures as much as 15 cm long and wide. Each lobe ends in a fine tip. The lobes measure less than 1 mm at the tip, broadening to 3 cm in the middle, and Corvallis of other dissectums. The bright red petioles are 4 cm long. The leaves develop a deep tone of purple red as they grow in the spring and retain the deep color all season. They do not bronze out in late season as do other reds. The tips may burn in hot, direct sun, especially if the plant becomes dry. Fall color is brilliant when it turns from purple red to a crimson tone. 'Inaba shidare' is the red counterpart of 'Palmatifidum'. For a dissectum, 'Inaba shidare' is a rather uprightgrowing form. Although it does cascade, it tends to be a little more erect in appearance. It is vigorous and sturdy. Thebranchesarenotof thefine,overlydelicatetypewhich is a weakness in some dissectums. Although not widely found in cultivation, it should become a popular garden landscape item when it is better known in the United States. It has been listed in Japan since the mid-1800s. It presents an interesting example of Japanese nomenclature. The Japanese observed that in the rain this plant looks a little like ine ("a rice plant"), an old form of which turned crimson in the fall. Thus, inaba is "rice plantlike leaf." Shidare means "cascading." Putting the two together, 'Inaba shidare' means "cascading ricelike leaf." The cultivars 'Red Select' and 'Select Red' are probably the same as 'Inaba shidare'. The name has been misspelled 'Anaba shidare' and 'Inabe shidare. Another name by which this cultivar has been known is 'Holland Select'. Corvallis pected in dissectums. The leaves are of a rich, deep purple red in the spring and early summer. As they mature, they turn a dark purple-tinged green tone. The veins are green when the leaves carry the purple colors. Bright red-crimson tones appear after fall frosts. It is one of the outstanding cultivars for fall color. The seven lobes are long, ovate-lanceolate, separated widely, and divided almost entirely to the leaf base. The leaves are up to 9 cm long on vigorous plants, and leaf spread is 12 cm. The edges are shallowly serrated. The reddish petioles are about 5 cm long. This hardy cultivar is vigorous without being leggy. The result is a tall, rounded shrub or tree, up to 10 m high and 5-6 m wide. The foliage is somewhat pendulous, but not with the cascading habit of the dissectums. This cultivar has been known under the names 'Dissectum Inazuma' and 'Pendulum Inazuma'.

sources.title: 稻叶枝垂 Acer Palmatum 'Inaba Shidare'
sources.description: 想要在花园里面获得难以置信的体验，请在你的群植搭配里面尝试一下稻叶枝垂。这种羽毛枫在其优美的枝干上有着非常精致的叶子。最早于1882年在《械品便览》里有记载。它在春天绽放出深紫红色的叶子，在夏天变成古铜色。当秋天到来时，由于昼夜温差使树叶呈现出明亮的火红色。和大多数羽毛枫一样，夏天需要及时遮荫，成年树高约2米。

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这一出色的细裂叶品种与同类不同之处，在于其深浓的叶色和独特的叶形。对细裂叶类而言，其叶片较大，裂片最长可达 10 厘米，基部裂片向后反卷。整张 7 裂叶的长和宽都可达 15 厘米。每个裂片末端都有细尖，裂片顶端宽不足 1 毫米，中部渐宽至 3 厘米，比其他细裂叶品种更宽厚。鲜红色叶柄长约 4 厘米。春季展叶时即呈深紫红色，整个生长季都能保持这种浓色，不会像其他红叶品种那样在季末转为古铜色。高温烈日下若植株偏干，叶尖可能会灼伤。秋色极为艳丽，由紫红转为深绯红色。'Inaba shidare' 可视为 'Palmatifidum' 的红叶对应品种。对细裂叶类型而言，'Inaba shidare' 算是较为直立的生长型，虽有下垂姿态，但整体观感略更挺立。它生长健壮、枝条结实，不像某些细裂叶品种那样枝条过于纤细脆弱。虽然目前栽培中尚不算常见，但随着在美国被更多认识，应会成为受欢迎的园林品种。该品种自 19 世纪中期起便见载于日本文献。其名称也体现了日本命名的趣味：日本人观察到此树在雨中略像 ine（“稻株”），而某种古老形式在秋季会转为深红色，因此 inaba 可理解为“似稻叶”；shidare 意为“垂枝”。合起来，'Inaba shidare' 即“垂枝稻叶”。'Red Select' 与 'Select Red' 很可能与 'Inaba shidare' 为同一品种。其名称曾被误写为 'Anaba shidare' 和 'Inabe shidare'，另一个曾用名是 'Holland Select'。另有资料记载，其叶片春季和初夏为浓郁深紫红色，成熟后转为带深紫调的绿色；在叶片仍带紫色时，叶脉呈绿色。经秋霜后会显现鲜亮的深红色，是秋色表现极其突出的品种之一。叶 7 裂，裂片长、呈卵状披针形，分离较开，几乎深裂至叶基。强壮枝上的叶片长可达 9 厘米，叶幅可达 12 厘米，边缘具浅锯齿。带红色的叶柄长约 5 厘米。该品种耐寒、长势强而不徒长，最终形成高大圆整的灌木或乔木，可高达 10 米、宽 5-6 米。叶片略带下垂感，但不具细裂叶类那种明显的垂枝瀑布状习性。该品种还曾以 'Dissectum Inazuma' 和 'Pendulum Inazuma' 之名流通。

products.title: Acer palmatum 'Inaba shidare' Japanese Maple
products.description_text: Acer palmatum dissectum 'Inaba shidare' Weeping Red Laceleaf Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 ‘Inaba shidare’ is an excellent weeping red Japanese maple. This red laceleaf Japanese maple cultivar is pendulous but with a very arching effect. The leaf is medium sized and leafs out with brilliant shades of deep burgundy and maroon. The fall color is a scarlet red. ‘Inaba shidare’ is a very vigorous grower. This weeping red Japanese maple tree grows great in full sun and can handle partial shade areas though the color maintains better with at least a 3-4 hours of sunlight. This laceleaf Japanese maple tree grows slightly wider than it does tall as it will reach 5 ft by 6 ft wide in about 10 years. This red laceleaf Japanese maple is very hardy and adapts well to almost any situation. Inaba shidare is an excellent patio plant and the growth lends itself well to large container growing. ‘Inaba shidare’ is one of the very best choices for a medium sized cascading red. The growth and shape make it the quintessential Japanese maple cultivar for any location. Limited Quantities Available !! As we have over a thousand cultivars of Japanese maples, we often do not have many of each cultivar. We recommend that you buy Japanese maples you want immediately as we often sell out of certain selections.

descriptions.preferred: The large leaves are of a rich, deep purple-red with green veins in the spring and early summer. As they mature, they become a dark purple with green tinges, eventually turning a stunning bright red-crimson in the fall. The deeply divided leaves have seven long, ovate-lanceolate, widely separated lobes with clearly toothed margins. This hardy cultivar is vigorous and forms a tall, rounded shrub or tree with cascading foliage, up to 33 ft. (10 m) high and 16-20 ft. (5-6 m) wide. The name means "thunderer."

rhs.description: A deciduous tree, up to around 10m high, with palmate leaves divided into long, tapering lobes. Leaves emerge bright reddish purple in spring, and develop to dark purple and olive green, before turning deep crimson in autumn. Winged seeds are also tinted red in autumn

attributes.hort_group_description: Acers in this matsumurae group are deeply divided to around three quarters of the leaf with coarsely-toothed edges and narrow, pointed lobes

care.cultivation: Grow in moisture-retentive, well-drained, ideally slightly acidic soil, in a sheltered position with protection from drying winds. Thrives in part shade, though some sun is needed to develop the leaf colour; will tolerate full sun if soil is reliably moist. Mulch in spring to improve moisture retention. See Japanese maples cultivation
care.pruning: Minimal pruning required; see pruning group 1 . Prune from late autumn to mid-winter only

care.cultivation: 宜栽植于保湿性好且排水良好的土壤中，最好为微酸性；选择避风、可防止干燥风侵袭的位置。半阴环境生长最佳，但为使叶色充分表现，仍需一定日照；若土壤能稳定保持湿润，也可耐全日照。春季覆 mulch 以提高土壤保湿性。参见日本枫栽培说明。

rhs_zh.description: 落叶乔木，高可达约 10 米。叶为掌状，深裂成长而渐尖的裂片。春季新叶鲜亮的红紫色，随后转为深紫并带橄榄绿色调，秋季变为深绯红色。具翅果在秋季也带红色。

descriptions_zh.preferred: 春季至初夏时，大型叶片呈浓郁的深紫红色，叶脉为绿色；随着叶片成熟，逐渐变为深紫色并带绿色调，最终在秋季转为惊艳的鲜亮深红色。叶片深裂，具 7 个狭长的卵状披针形裂片，裂片彼此分离较开，边缘有明显锯齿。该耐寒品种生长势强，形成高大、圆整的灌木或小乔木，枝叶有下垂感，高可达 33 英尺（10 米），冠幅 16 至 20 英尺（5 至 6 米）。其名称意为“雷鸣者”。

descriptions.preferred: Acer palmatum 'Incognito' Rare Incognito Dwarf Japanese Maple Tree Zones 5-9 'Incognito' is neato. It has a tighter denser habit with age, with twisted foliage that is reminiscent of 'Shishigashira' or other plants in the "Lion's Head Family" like 'Taro yama' or 'Angel the Prince'. The new growth in the spring is a light green with bronze highlights, turning to a darker shade of green for the summer. The twisted foliage gives a good texture. descriptions.preferred: The outstanding feature of this cultivar is the bright orange-pink young foliage, which becomes green with pink then bronzed edges and tips, and turning orange-red in the fall. This coloration, added to the pleated and rumpled leaf lobes, gives the plant a charm of its own. The orange-pink new growth overlying the older green leaves continues throughout the summer. The medium-sized seven-lobed leaves are deeply dissected. The lobes are also deeply dissected and have slender, hooked, sharply pointed teeth along the margins. The reddish leafstalks are long and slender. 'Irish Lace' grows into the typical dissectum cascading mound up to about 8 ft. (2.5 m) tall at maturity.

sources.description: 'Irish Lace' 爱尔兰蕾丝是一款美丽但罕见的垂枝品种。 叶型非常细，叶裂很深，春叶为明亮的樱桃红随着季 节的变化慢慢变成青铜绿色，秋天首先会变成亮黄色 然后变成橙红色。成年树高约 1-1.5 米。

descriptions_zh.preferred: 该品种最突出的特征是鲜亮的橙粉色新叶，随后转为绿色，叶缘与叶尖带粉色并渐呈古铜色，秋季再转为橙红色。这种色彩，再加上叶裂片具有褶皱、起伏的质感，使植株别具风韵。覆盖在较老绿色叶片之上的橙粉色新梢，整个夏季都会持续出现。中等大小的叶片通常为 7 裂，裂刻很深；各裂片也进一步深裂，叶缘具细长、内钩、尖锐的锯齿。叶柄带红色，细长。'Irish Lace' 成熟后形成典型的 dissectum 类下垂拱垂株形，高约 8 英尺（2.5 米）。

products.title: Acer palmatum 'Irish Lace' Japanese Maple
products.description_text: Acer palmatum dissectum 'Irish Lace' Irish Lace Dwarf Weeping Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 ‘Irish Lace’ is a beautiful, yet rare, weeping Japanese maple. The bright cherry-red new growth in the spring matures to a maroon, later developing in a bronze, then a green with bronze highlights for the summer. The cherry red new growth appears again in the summer during the second flush of growth starting this wonderful cycle of colors all over again. In the fall, ‘Irish Lace’ begins as a bright yellow later turning to a bold orange. ‘Irish Lace’ has a mounding and cascading habit similar to other laceleaf Japanese maples reaching 3-4 ft in height by 5-6 ft in width in 10 years. For best color on ‘Irish Lace’ giving morning-mid day sun with protection from the hot afternoon sun. Trees were potted from large liners to gallons in this spring and may not have completely filled out their pots. Limited Quantities Available !! As we have over a thousand cultivars of Japanese maples, we often do not have many of each cultivar. We recommend that you buy the Japanese maples you want immediately as we often sell out of certain selections.

descriptions.preferred: The small leaves of this cultivar are classed as five lobed. However, on many leaves two very small basal lobes appear and clasp above the petiole attachment. Usually these are very small or absent. The middle three lobes are quite large for the leaf, and the two basal lobes (when the leaf is five lobed) are tiny, giving the leaf almost a three-lobed appearance. The margins are prominently double serrated. The lobes are oblong and separated two-thirds of the way to the leaf base. They gradually taper to a sharp point. As the leaves mature, the margins often take on a wavy nature, and the points of the lobes curl slightly downward. Some leaves are quite convoluted. The leaves measure 4-5 cm long with a spread of 5-6 cm. The petioles are slender but stiff and are often almost as long as the leaf. The leaf color is a light to medium green, sometimes a yellowish green. The texture is firm but not thick. Fall colors are in the yellows and golds. Corvallis

descriptions.preferred: This plant is very similar to 'Bloodgood' in leaf and habit, except that it is slower growing and only reaches half its size. 'Italy Red' is very sturdy, tolerates wind and sun, and eventually forms a small upright tree up to 3 m tall. It is worth considering for gardens in which 'Bloodgood' would be too large. The original plant is growing at Mountain Maples Nursery, Laytonville, California, run by Don and Nancy Fiers, who obtained it from Maplewood Nursery. It is thought to have been received from an Italian source, hence its name. This cultivar has also been misspelled 'Haly Red'.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 该品种在叶形和树姿上与 'Bloodgood' 非常相似，但生长较慢，最终体量仅为后者的一半。'Italy Red' 树势非常健壮，耐风、耐晒，最终形成一株高约 3 米的小型直立乔木。对于 'Bloodgood' 过于高大的花园环境来说，它是一个值得考虑的替代品。原始母株生长于加利福尼亚州 Laytonville 的 Mountain Maples Nursery，该苗圃由 Don 和 Nancy Fiers 经营，他们是从 Maplewood Nursery 获得该品种的。据推测，它最初来自意大利，因此得名。该品种也曾被误拼为 'Haly Red'。

descriptions.preferred: This cultivar is very similar to 'Sango kaku' and possibly a seedling from it. It is known for its colorful winter shoots which are a lighter red than those of 'Sango kaku' on the upper exposed side and yellow orange on the lower sheltered side. Its leaves are typical of the Palmatum Group and, like those of the probable parent, emerge yellow green, becoming a light fresh green for the summer. The fall colors are said to be even better than those of 'Sango kaku' with yellow, gold, and crimson tones. 'Japanese Sunrise' is very tolerant of full sun and grows into an upright, wide, flat-topped tree, up to 7 m tall at maturity. smallish, and range from 3.5 to 5.5 cm long and from 3.5 to 4.5 cm wide. The lobes are ovate-elliptic, separated almost three-quarters of the way to the leaf base. The margins are clearly toothed. The petioles are not long, mostly 2-3 cm. As the young plant develops, the shoots are somewhat erect. Then, as the plant ages, the long slender branches tend to droop, weeping back to the ground in some cases. This characteristic results in a round-headed bush which is up to 3 m tall and at least as wide. The leaf nodes, which are spread far apart on the slender, pendulous shoots, form the cascading growth and give a very lacy appearance. As with many cascading forms with deeply divided leaves, the fall coloration is striking. Brilliant crimson appears as fall temperatures begin to drop. This maple is a nice addition to the larger rock garden. 'Jiro\ shidare' was imported from Japan. It is reportedly a selected seedling from Acer palmatum subsp. matsumurae, though this is disputed in Maples of the World.

sources.title: 日本日出 Acer Palmatum 'Japanese Sunrise'
sources.description: 由美国宾夕法尼亚州绿厦苗圃的苗圃主比利 ·施瓦兹(Bill Schwartz)育种并命名推广，与 珊瑚阁相似，可能 从珊瑚阁的种子实生选育而来，同样为观枝品种，枝干色彩更加出色，春天新叶为黄绿色，夏季颜色转深变为深绿色，秋季为亮黄色 到橙色 ，落叶枝干变为黄色 到 橙 红色 ，非常独特，色彩表现由光照程度决定，通常一边表现为黄色到橙色，另外一边为橙色到绯红色，新梢的色彩表现更为突出，生长快速，可全日照，但推荐夏季午后遮阴，成年株可达3.5米左右高度。

rhs.description: A broadly upright, deciduous tree about 5m tall, the winter stems a light shade of coral-red on the upper exposed sides, and yellow-orange on the lower sheltered sides. 5-lobed yellow-green leaves, often margined coppery-orange in spring, mature to fresh green in summer then display autumn colours of yellows, gold and reds

attributes.suggested_uses: City/Courtyard Gardens, Cottage/Informal Garden
attributes.hort_group_description: Acers in this palmatum group have small, palm-shaped leaves with coarsely-toothed edges

care.cultivation: Grow in any moisture-retentive, well-drained soil in a sheltered position. Leaf colour is best in partial shade, although full sun can be tolerated if soil is reliably moist. Leaf scorch can be caused by lack of soil moisture or excessive exposure. See Japanese maples cultivation
care.pruning: Pruning group 1 , only from late autumn to mid-winter
care.propagation: Propagate by softwood cuttings, layering or by grafting . Plants grown from seed are unlikely to come true, but may still be garden worthy

resistance.pest: May be susceptible to aphids and scale insects , including horse chestnut scale
resistance.disease: May be susceptible to Verticillium wilt , Acer leaf scorch and honey fungus

descriptions_zh.preferred: 该品种与 'Sango kaku' 非常相似，可能还是其实生苗后代。其最著名之处在于冬季枝条色彩丰富：枝条上部向阳面呈比 'Sango kaku' 更浅的红色，下部背风面则为黄橙色。叶片属于典型的 Palmatum Group 类型，和其推测亲本一样，春季萌发时为黄绿色，夏季转为清新的浅绿色。秋色据称比 'Sango kaku' 更佳，呈现黄色、金色和深红色调。'Japanese Sunrise' 对全日照耐受性很强，成熟后长成直立、开展、树冠较平的树形，高可达 7 米。叶片偏小，长约 3.5-5.5 厘米，宽约 3.5-4.5 厘米。裂片为卵状椭圆形，分裂深度接近叶基的四分之三。叶缘具明显锯齿。叶柄不长，多为 2-3 厘米。幼株生长时，新梢略直立；随着植株老化，细长枝条往往下垂，有时甚至垂拱至地面。此特性使其形成圆头状灌木树形，高约可达 3 米，冠幅至少相当。细长下垂枝上的叶节点间距较大，形成瀑布状生长效果，整体观感极为细致飘逸。与许多深裂叶的垂枝型品种一样，其秋色十分醒目，入秋气温下降时会转为鲜艳的深红色。此枫树很适合作为较大型岩石园中的配置植物。'Jiro\ shidare' 由日本引入。据称它是 Acer palmatum subsp. matsumurae 的选育实生苗，但这一说法在《Maples of the World》中有争议。

attributes.suggested_uses: 城市或庭院花园、乡村风或自然式花园
attributes.hort_group_description: 本 palmatum 组的槭树叶片较小，呈掌状，边缘具粗锯齿。

care.cultivation: 宜栽于保水且排水良好的土壤中，并选择避风位置。半阴环境下叶色表现最佳；若土壤湿度稳定，也可耐全日照。土壤缺水或暴露过度都可能导致叶片焦边。参见 Japanese maples cultivation。
care.pruning: 修剪组 1，仅限晚秋至仲冬期间修剪。
care.propagation: 可通过嫩枝扦插、压条或嫁接繁殖。实生苗通常难以保持品种性状，但仍可能具有园艺观赏价值。

resistance.pest: 可能易受蚜虫和介壳虫侵害，包括七叶树介壳虫。
resistance.disease: 可能易感黄萎病、槭叶焦枯病和蜜环菌病

rhs_zh.description: 广直立型落叶乔木，高约 5 米。冬季枝条在上方受光面呈浅珊瑚红色，在下方较受遮蔽的一侧则呈黄橙色。叶片 5 裂，黄绿色，春季常有铜橙色叶缘；夏季转为清新绿色，秋季则呈现黄色、金色和红色。

products.description_text: Acer palmatum 'Japanese Sunrise' Rare Multicolor Coral Bark Winter Interest Japanese Maple Zones 6-9 In the spring, ‘Japanese Sunrise’ has small bright green leaves. In the fall, these leaves turn bright yellow. The feature that grabs everyone’s attention on ‘Japanese Sunrise’ is the bark. On one side of the tree, the bark will be yellow to orange, while on the other side the color of the bark will be orange to coral red. Often as you look up a tree, the bark will be brighter on the newest growth. The multitude of color on the bark is difficult to photograph, but dynamic in the landscape and garden. It is said to have same color in the bark as one of the most beautiful sunsets in Japan. ‘Japanese Sunrise’ has a nice upright shape typically reaching 10-12 ft in 10 years. Limited Quantities Available !! As we have over a thousand cultivars of Japanese maples, we often do not have many of each cultivar. descriptions.preferred: 由宾夕法尼亚州Green Mansions 苗圃的比利 · 施瓦兹发现的突变品种，并以比利施瓦兹的妈妈的名字命名。春天新叶为豆沙红色，夏季变为紫红色或青铜色，夏季的二次新稍和春叶一样，新老叶色彩对比明显，秋叶为橙色或者火红色。一般为 5-7 裂，叶裂深至基部，有明显的锯齿状边缘，生长速度较慢，矮生性，枝叶繁密，成年株可达 1.3m 左右高度。

products.title: Acer palmatum 'Jerre Schwartz' Dwarf Japanese Maple
products.description_text: Acer palmatum 'Jerre Schwartz' Jerre Schwartz Dwarf Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 'Jerre Schwartz' was found as witches' broom mutation by the famous Billy Schwartz. It is named after his mother, Jerre. This selection leafs out as a bright pink-red fading to a light green by mid-summer. The secondary flush of growth returns to a bright pink-red creating a dynamic contrast over the light green leaves. Fall colors are a bright oranges to fiery reds. Because of its witches' broom nature, it is extremely dense in habit. 'Jerre Schwartz' reaches 6 ft in height by 4 ft in width in 15 years making it a great Japanese maple for small spaces. It is ideal for conifer beds, rock gardens, miniature rail-road gardens, fairy gardens, and container growing.

'Jiro shidare' was named after Jiro Kobayashi by Kobayashi Maple Nursery in Japan. "Shidare" refers to the weeping habit of this Japanese maple. This was the parent plant to Acer palmatum 'Ryusen'. rhs.description: A small, slow-growing, upright tree, ultimately reaching 3m in height and spread. The fan-like foliage has 11 short lobes, opens pale orange in spring, turns lime green for summer and orange-red in autumn. Tiny, purple-red flowers in spring are followed by conspicuous, red, winged fruit held above the foliage in late summer

attributes.suggested_uses: City/Courtyard Gardens, Cottage/Informal Garden, Patio/Container Plants

care.cultivation: Grows best in slightly acidic, humus-rich, well-drained soil, but tolerates most soils if improved with well-rotted organic matter . Hot, dry air, cold wind and late frost may cause leaf scorching. Mulch in autumn to protect shallow roots from cold and drying out. See Japanese maple cultivation
care.pruning: Pruning group 1
care.propagation: Propagate by semi-hardwood cuttings or by layering

resistance.pest: May be susceptible to Acer gall mite, aphids , caterpillars and horse chestnut scale
resistance.disease: May be susceptible to Verticillium wilt , Acer leaf scorch and honey fungus

care.cultivation: 在微酸性、富含腐殖质且排水良好的土壤中生长最佳，但若加入充分腐熟的有机质改良，也能适应多数土壤。炎热干燥的空气、寒风和晚霜可能导致叶片焦枯。秋季覆 mulch，可保护浅根免受寒害和干燥。参见 Japanese maple cultivation。
care.pruning: 修剪第 1 组
care.propagation: 可采用半成熟枝扦插或压条繁殖。

resistance.pest: 可能易受槭瘿螨、蚜虫、毛虫和七叶树介壳虫危害
resistance.disease: 可能易感黄萎病、槭叶焦枯病和蜜环菌病

rhs_zh.description: 小型、慢生、直立的乔木，最终高和冠幅可达 3 米。叶片呈扇形，具 11 个短裂片，春季新叶展开时为淡橙色，夏季转为酸橙绿色，秋季变为橙红色。春季开细小的紫红色花，晚夏结出显著的红色带翅果，果实高举于叶幕之上。

products.title: Acer shirasawanum 'Jordan' Golden Full Moon Japanese Maple
products.description_text: Acer shirasawanum 'Jordan' Jordan Golden Full Moon Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 Acer shirasawanum ‘Jordan’ is a superb yellow cultivar that can brighten any garden. This exciting new selection has better color and more vigor than several of its golden predecessors. It was found by Fratelli Gilardelli of Gilardelli Nursery in Italy and was named after his son. ‘Jordan’ may boast the brightest yellow shades of all Japanese maple cultivars in early spring. This bright yellow coloration is often outlined with a light border of red. Autumn colors are amazing shades or deep maroon and orange. ‘Jordan’ is listed as an Acer shirasawanum but may actually be an Acer shirasawanum x palmatum hybrid. This would explain its vigor and heat tolerance. ‘Jordan’ will typically reach 10-12 ft in 15 years. We recommend late day shade for the best colors. This is certainly a Japanese maple that brings the 'wow' factor for color and texture. We recommend ‘Jordan’ as the perfect tree to contrast deep maroons or to be used as a focal point planting. You may need sunglasses in the early spring for all the bright neon yellow color ‘Jordan’ will shine in your garden. Trees were potted from large liners to gallons in this spring and may not have completely filled out their pots. Limited Quantities Available !! As we have over a thousand cultivars of Japanese maples, we often do not have many of each cultivar. We recommend that you buy the Japanese maples you want immediately as we often sell out of certain selections.

descriptions.preferred: 十二单衣最早的记载可以追溯到 1911年，它是白泽槭中叶子最小的品种之一。叶片大小仅有4-7cm，叶裂为11裂，叶裂深度不超过叶片的三分之一，非常圆润可爱。十二单衣在春天是浅绿色的，秋叶为明亮的橙色，翅果在秋季同样会转为橙色。它的长势并不快，成年树高大约3米左右。在矢野正善老先生的书上写到十二单衣和小苍山属于异名同木。

products.title: Acer shirasawanum 'Junihitoe' Full Moon Japanese Maple
products.description_text: Acer shirasawanum 'Junihitoe' Rare Full Moon Japanese Maple Tree Zones 5-9 'Junihitoe' is a showy Japanese maple selection with extremely rounded green foliage. When looking at this foliage, its easy to see where this type of maple is often referred to as a "full moon" Japanese maple. These green leaves turn to a bright orange in the fall. Also known under the name 'Junihitoye', this older Japanese maple selection is listed in Japanese literature as early as the 1800's. The habit of 'Junihitoe' is slow growing often multi-stemmed. In 20 years, 'Junihitoe' may reach 8-12 ft in height. Photos by Ed Shinn. Used with permission. Limited Quantities Available !! As we have over a thousand cultivars of Japanese maples, we often do not have many of each cultivar. We recommend that you buy the Japanese maples you want immediately as we often sell out of certain selections.
