descriptions.preferred: This strange-leafed small compact upright dwarf grows to about 2 ft. (60 cm) in five years or so. It resembles a dwarf form of 'Wabito' with similar dark green leaves. These are small and very deeply divided into fine narrow almost straplike lobes. The often red-tinged margins are unevenly and bluntly toothed and crinkled. The name means "hippopotamus", a play on the name of the English nursery from where it originated.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这是一个叶形奇特的小型、紧凑、直立性矮生品种，约 5 年可长至 2 英尺（60 厘米）左右。它类似于 'Wabito' 的矮化型，叶色同样为深绿色。叶片较小，分裂极深，裂成纤细狭长、近似带状的裂片。常带红晕的叶缘具不规则而钝的齿，并略呈皱褶。其名称意为“河马”，是对其起源英国苗圃名称的双关。

descriptions.preferred: Acer palmatum 'Kaga kujaku' Rare Kaga kujaku Budding Peacock Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 In Japan, it is not unusual for the best gardens to have their own maple selections chosen for specific traits that can be only found in that particular garden. 'Kaga kujaku' is one of these selections. This Japanese maple was selected from the wild as a seedling from yama-momiji, also known as Acer palmatum ssp. matsumurae. The original Japanese maple tree resides in a well-known garden in the Ishikawa Prefecture of Japan. This Japanese maple selection brings an authentic Japanese style to the landscape. 'Kaga kujaku' unfolds in the spring with large heavily divided bright pink-red leaves. The leaves turn to a rich green by early summer. Mid-summer flushes return to a bright pink-red growth making a beautiful contrast with the deep green background. Autumn colors range from bright oranges to red. 'Kaga kujaku' will reach about 10-12 ft in 15 years. More information on this cultivar can be found in Yano's Book for Maples. Limited Quantities Available !! As we have over a thousand cultivars of Japanese maples, we often do not have many of each cultivar. We recommend that you buy Japanese maples you want immediately as we often sell out of certain selections.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 该优良品种最突出的特征，是其以黄色斑锦为主，而非常见斑叶品种那样以白色斑锦为主。叶片深裂，形成 5 至 7 枚放射状裂片。每个裂片细长卵形，先端渐尖且较长，叶缘具细锯齿。斑锦在浓绿色叶底上呈现多种不规则图案，可表现为零星不规则浅色小点、小型浅色斑块，或较大的整片浅色区域。有时浅色仅占裂片的一半；也会出现全绿色叶，偶尔可见纯黄色叶。该品种树势较强、耐寒，但生长缓慢，株型直立，最终可形成高约 13 英尺（4 米）的小乔木。其名称意为“薄纱”。 'Acer palmatum 'Kagiri nishiki'' 亦有记载：该品种属斑叶类。每片小叶以及其 5 至 7 个裂片的形态略有变化。典型裂片为细长卵形，先端渐尖成锐点。叶缘具不规则细锯齿，部分仅轻微缺刻。裂片在不同程度上略呈镰刀形，这与斑锦程度有关。叶柄纤细并带粉色。叶面为带蓝调的深绿色，而非明亮绿色。各裂片边缘有宽窄不一的浅奶油色镶边。春季斑纹常带粉红或玫瑰色晕染，夏季转为奶油色，秋季则变为鲜艳的玫瑰深红色。植株生长较为疏朗但直立，高可达 26 英尺（8 米）。与 'Butterfly' 相比，其叶面斑纹中玫瑰色更重，且叶缘锯齿不如后者深。

descriptions.preferred: The cultivar name 'Roseo-marginatum' is a synonym of 'Kagiri nishiki'. Unfortunately, confusion exists because the name 'Roseo-marginatum' has been applied to other quite different cultivars, especially 'Higasa yama'. The leaves are five lobed, sometimes seven lobed. Each lobe is a different shape, and each leaf varies. The typical lobe is elongate-ovate, tapering to a sharp point. Edges are slightly and inconsistently toothed, while some are lightly notched. The lobes are sickle shaped to varying degrees, depending upon the amount of variegation in with a bluish cast, never bright green. White margins on all the lobes are present in varying widths, up to and including one-half the width of the lobe. Blended with, or suffused over, all this are markings of pink or rose colors. In the spring, the rose markings are quite distinct. As the summer advances, the rose becomes indistinct and the markings remain cream. The rose and cream areas change into a vivid rose-crimson in the fall. The plant is somewhat open growing but upright and can reach 8 m high or more as it matures. I saw several 50-year-old specimens of this cultivar in Europe which were round-topped, upsweeping small trees of 4-5 m high. 'Kagiri nishiki' does not grow as twiggy as 'Butterfly'. It has a more upright growth habit, more rose in the leaf markings, and its leaf margins are not toothed as deeply as are those of 'Butterfly'. Other names which have been used for this cultivar are 'Pinkedge', 'Rosa-marginalis', 'Rosa-variegata', 'Roseo-pictum', 'Roseo-tricolor', and 'Roseo-variegatum'. The name has also been misspelled 'Kagari nishiki'.

rhs.description: A deciduous tree, up to around 6m high, with 5-lobed, slightly grey-green leaves with narrow cream margins that are flushed with pink in spring, and turn reddish-pink in autumn

attributes.suggested_uses: Architectural, Low Maintenance
attributes.hort_group_description: Acers in this palmatum group have small, palm-shaped leaves with coarsely-toothed edges

descriptions_zh.preferred: 品种名 'Roseo-marginatum' 是 'Kagiri nishiki' 的异名。遗憾的是，这个名称曾被误用于其他差异很大的品种，尤其是 'Higasa yama'，因此存在混淆。叶片通常为五裂，有时七裂。每个裂片形状都不完全相同，每片叶也各有差异。典型裂片为长卵形，先端渐尖。叶缘有轻微且不规则的锯齿，部分叶片则仅有浅缺刻。裂片呈不同程度的镰刀形，具体程度取决于斑锦多少。叶底色为绿色并带蓝绿色调，绝不会是鲜绿色。所有裂片边缘都有白色镶边，宽窄不一，最宽可达裂片宽度的一半。其上又混有或晕染着粉色或玫瑰色斑纹。春季时，玫瑰色斑纹相当鲜明；随着夏季推进，玫瑰色逐渐变淡，斑纹则呈乳白色。到了秋季，这些粉色和乳白色区域会转为鲜艳的玫瑰深红色。植株株形较疏朗但直立，成熟后可高达 8 米或更高。我曾在欧洲见过数株 50 年生的该品种标本，均为圆头、枝条上扬的小乔木，高约 4 至 5 米。'Kagiri nishiki' 的枝条不如 'Butterfly' 那样细密，其生长习性更直立，叶片斑纹中的粉色更多，而且叶缘锯齿也没有 'Butterfly' 那么深。曾用于该品种的其他名称还有 'Pinkedge'、'Rosa-marginalis'、'Rosa-variegata'、'Roseo-pictum'、'Roseo-tricolor' 和 'Roseo-variegatum'。该名称也曾被误拼写为 'Kagari nishiki'。

The lobes are falcate or downward-curved at the tip, curve gently upward at the sides to form a trough shape, and tend to twist slightly, giving the entire plant a lacy delicate look. Each lobe is long and narrow, about 5-7 mm wide at the base and rarely as much as 10 mm in the middle, tapering gradually to a sharp point. The margins are toothed. The lobes separate outward like extended fingers and join only about 1 cm from the base of the leaf. The petioles are very thin but stiff, 2-3 cm long, and are green with one side red. As the leaves unfold in the spring, the edges are strongly tinted with red to rusty red. The early summer foliage becomes a bright, light green. The fall colors are brilliant in shades of yellow and orange, with an occasional touch of red. The leaves remain on the plant well into late fall and thus extend the color period. The shoots are thin and delicate looking but quite durable. Of a bright green color, they grow up to 25 cm long on young plants. descriptions_zh.preferred: 这是一个外观极为纤细秀雅的矮生选育品种。不过，它实际上非常耐久且耐寒。原文此处有明显 OCR 缺损。于 Corvallis 观察到，有些叶片仅有三裂，裂片间距很大，侧裂片几乎呈直角展开。裂片呈镰形，或先端向下弯曲，边缘再轻微向上卷起，形成槽状，并常略有扭转，使整株呈现蕾丝般细致轻盈的观感。每个裂片都细长狭窄，基部宽约 5 至 7 毫米，中部很少宽至 10 毫米，并逐渐收尖。叶缘具锯齿。裂片像伸开的手指一样向外分离，仅在距叶基约 1 厘米处相连。叶柄极细但坚挺，长 2 至 3 厘米，绿色，单侧带红色。春季展叶时，叶缘明显染成红色至锈红色。初夏叶色转为明亮的浅绿色。秋色鲜艳，以黄色和橙色为主，偶带一点红色。叶片能在植株上保留到深秋，因此观色期较长。新梢细而秀气，但相当坚韧，呈鲜绿色，在幼株上可长达 25 厘米。不过第二次生长期会形成大量侧枝，枝条十分纤细如蕾丝，原文至此中断。

descriptions.preferred: This cultivar arose from a witches'-broom of Acer palmatum f. atropurpureum. It was discovered and named by Joseph Stupka of Stupka Nursery in Poulski, Pennsylvania. 'Kandy Kitchen' forms a compact rounded shrub reaching up to 2 m tall and wide. It is ideal for containers, and is similar in growth, leaf shape, color, and size to 'Elizabeth', another witches'-broom. The lobes appear to be slightly narrower with longer tail-like tips. The new leaves form a bright pink-red bunch at the end of the shoots, contrasting with the purple red of the mature leaves throughout the summer. When shaded, the leaves become a bronze green. The fall color is a very bright scarlet red. to about 6 cm long and about 7 cm broad. Each lobe is oblong-ovate, separated about two-thirds of the way to the leaf base, and acuminate. The margins of the lobes are serrated and sometimes irregularly but slightly curled. The petioles are dark in color and 3-4 cm long. The spring foliage is reddish, changing to a greenish red in midsummer. The whitish variegations range from indistinct to very bold and sometimes have a pink overtone. When distinct, the light markings will cut in and occupy a large section of the lobe. These variegations are yellowish in midseason. Fall color becomes predominantly crimson in tone. 'Kara ori nishiki' is not a largegrowing plant, but matures as a tall bush up to 4 m high. It is not a vigorous cultivar and grows rather slowly.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 该品种源自 Acer palmatum f. atropurpureum 的一处扫帚枝变异，由宾夕法尼亚州 Poulski 的 Stupka Nursery 的 Joseph Stupka 发现并命名。'Kandy Kitchen' 形成紧凑、圆整的灌木状株形，高和冠幅均可达约 2 米。非常适合容器栽培，在生长势、叶形、叶色和大小方面与另一扫帚枝品种 'Elizabeth' 相似，但其裂片略更狭长，先端拖尾状更明显。新叶在枝梢顶端聚成鲜亮的粉红红色叶丛，与整个夏季保持的紫红色成熟叶形成对比。遮阴条件下，叶片会转为古铜绿色。秋色为非常鲜艳的猩红色。另有资料所述叶片长约 6 厘米、宽约 7 厘米；各裂片为长圆状卵形，分裂深度达叶基约三分之二，先端渐尖。裂片边缘具锯齿，有时略不规则并轻微反卷。叶柄色深，长 3-4 厘米。春叶带红色，至盛夏转为偏绿的红色。其白色斑纹从不明显到非常醒目不等，有时还带粉色调；斑纹明显时，浅色部分会切入并占据裂片的大面积区域。这些斑纹在生长季中期转为黄白色。秋色则主要转为深红色调。'Kara ori nishiki' 不是大型生长型品种，成熟后为高大灌木，高可达 4 米。该品种长势不强，生长较慢。

descriptions.preferred: The most outstanding feature of this cultivar is its new growth which is mostly a bright, light pink. Some leaves are entirely white with pink shading, while others are almost completely pink, but with tiny flecks of bright green or white, or both. The petioles and shoots are also pink. While the plant compares to such cultivars as 'Oridono nishiki' and 'Asahi zuru', the new growth is more spectacular. Older foliage also has streaks or flecks of pink in the white areas. Sometimes the mottling consists only of pale green areas on the base of darker green. Other leaves have rather large, bold inserts of light colors. In the fall coloration, the white and light green areas become bright rose in contrast with the base color of darker green. The leaves vary from 3 to 7 cm long and wide, but they are rarely large on older wood. The mature leaves are basically five lobed. The lobes are elongate-ovate, terminating in a slender, tapered point. However, when a deep variegation occurs, that portion is sickle shaped while the rest of the lobe is normal. The margins are double serrated. The growth habit is narrow and upright, somewhat twiggy, but it broadens with age. Older plants rarely exceed 4 m high. This maple is not a vigorous grower and is somewhat tender. It should have a protected spot in the garden and also have protection from strong sun. Al- -variegated The foliage of this cultivar has one of the most unusual color combinations found in this group. The principal color is brick red, but it varies somewhat, whether in full sun or shade, and depending on the age of the leaf. The tone is very distinctive from other red-leaved cultivars. This unique red is shaded into an undertone of green on the sides of the lobes, blending the two colors. In addition, the veins are of a different tone. The main veins are dark red, almost black, while the side veins are distinct but lighter in tone. This contrast diminishes during the course of the season. The seven lobes radiate outward, with the two basal lobes almost closing over the petiole. The middle three lobes are larger than the other four. Each lobe is openly separated almost to the leaf base, and is elongate-ovate with a long, tapering, sharp point. The margins are very finely but sharply serrated. The leaf measures 6-7 cm the spring.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 该品种最突出的特征是新梢和新叶大多呈明亮的浅粉色。有些叶片几乎全白，仅带粉色晕染；另一些则几乎完全为粉色，但点缀极细小的亮绿色或白色斑点，或两者兼有。叶柄和新梢也为粉色。虽然该品种可与 'Oridono nishiki' 和 'Asahi zuru' 等品种相比，但其新叶表现更为惊艳。成熟叶片在白色区域中也常带有粉色条纹或斑点。有时斑驳仅表现为深绿色底上的淡绿色区块；另一些叶片则会出现较大、醒目的浅色嵌斑。秋季变色时，白色和浅绿色部分会转为鲜艳的玫瑰色，与深绿色底色形成对比。叶片长宽约 3-7 厘米，但在老枝上很少长得很大。成熟叶通常为 5 裂，裂片细长卵形，先端细长渐尖。不过当某一部分斑锦较深时，该部分往往呈镰刀形，而裂片其余部分仍保持正常形态。叶缘为重锯齿。株型狭窄直立，枝条略细密杂乱，随着年龄增长会逐渐开展。老株通常不超过 4 米高。该枫生长势不强，且稍欠耐性，宜栽植于园中避护位置，并避免强烈日照。 另有一段资料显示：该品种叶色组合在这一类群中极为少见。主色调为砖红色，但在全日照或半阴条件下，以及随叶龄变化，会略有不同。其色调与其他红叶品种明显不同。这种独特的红色在裂片两侧过渡为绿色底调，使两种颜色相互融合。此外，叶脉颜色也与叶面不同：主脉为深红近黑色，侧脉则较浅且清晰可见。随着生长季推进，这种对比会逐渐减弱。叶片通常 7 裂，向外放射展开，最基部两裂片几乎向叶柄合拢。中间 3 枚裂片大于其余 4 枚。各裂片分离较开，几乎裂至叶基，形为细长卵形，具长而渐尖的锐尖，叶缘细密而锐利地锯齿。叶片大小约 6-7 厘米。

Fall color is a fantastic orange color. 10 Year Size: Height: 8-10 feet Width: 4-6 feet

descriptions.preferred: The leaves of this unusual cultivar have a unique brick-red color varying during the season and with the growing conditions. Leaf margins and veins are tinged dark greenish red to almost black. The changing color in the spring is very exciting. Bright red fruits complement the leaf colors. The medium-sized leaves have seven very deeply divided lobes radiating evenly outwards like a star. Each lobe is long-ovate with a long, sharp tapering point and finely but sharply toothed margins. The red leafstalks are short and stiff. This cultivar forms an opencrowned shrub or small tree up to 23 ft. (7 m) tall. The name means "overhanging mountain."

sources.title: 笠置山 Acer Palmatum 'Kasagi Yama'
sources.description: 最早 1978年J.D.Vertrees出版的『JAPANESE MAPLES』中开始介绍笠置山，在日本于1983年在『自然と盆栽』八月刊中岸田绿溪先生收集到的100种枫树种提到笠置山，同年在『1983秋の園芸』中开始正式销售此品种，日笠山属于大红叶系的脉斑叶品种，以7叶裂为主，春天初芽为深红色，初芽和叶柄都有白色绒毛，春叶为荧光红色并有暗红色的脉纹，春夏之际，叶子从边缘逐渐变绿，夏叶为黄绿色，秋天变为橙红色。生长健壮，午后需要遮阴，成年株可达3米左右高度。

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这一不同寻常的品种，叶片具有独特的砖红色，并会随季节变化及生长环境不同而有所变动。叶缘与叶脉带深绿红色至近黑色调。春季叶色的变化尤为精彩。鲜红色的果实与叶色相映成趣。中等大小的叶片具 7 个深裂裂片，均匀向外放射，呈星状；每个裂片为长卵形，先端渐尖而细长，边缘具细密而锐利的锯齿。红色叶柄短而坚硬。该品种形成开张树冠的灌木或小乔木，高可达 23 英尺（7 米）。其名称意为“悬垂的山”。

attributes.hort_group_description: 此 matsumurae 组的槭树，叶片深裂约达叶片的四分之三，叶缘具粗齿，裂片狭长且先端尖。

care.cultivation: 宜栽于保水且排水良好的土壤中，并选择避风位置。半阴环境下叶色表现最佳；若土壤湿度稳定，也可耐全日照。土壤缺水或暴露过度都可能导致叶片焦边。参见 Japanese maples cultivation。
care.pruning: 修剪组 1，仅限晚秋至仲冬期间修剪。
care.propagation: 可通过嫩枝扦插、压条或嫁接繁殖。实生苗通常难以保持品种性状，但仍可能具有园艺观赏价值。

resistance.disease: 可能易感黄萎病、槭叶焦枯病和蜜环菌病

rhs_zh.description: 小型落叶乔木，高约 5-6 米，栽培中较少见。叶片 7 裂，叶缘具锐利锯齿，叶色不同寻常，为砖红色并带明显的深色叶脉；叶色会因日照或遮阴条件以及叶龄不同而有所变化，秋季转为粉红色和酒红色。

Early spring it has a bright pink foliage, turning to brick red in the summer. It also has dark red veins in the leaf. This is a rare and very unusual cultivar and it is quite exciting to watch the new foliage. They reach about 12 feet high, and 12 ft wide.

descriptions.preferred: New foliage in the spring is often a surprising pink red or light orange red, which soon matures into variegated greens. Variegation is quite subtle, not bright or garish as in 'Oridono nishiki'. There are irregular and indiscriminate sections of white or cream on many leaves, and these portions are usually sickle shaped. Most leaves have a very light or pastel shading. Speckling and dotting of white, cream, or occasionally whitish green make up the variegation. The coloration is a very soft tone, shading throughout the foliage. It is quite different from most variegated cultivars. The medium-sized leaves range up to 5 cm long and 6 cm broad. Occasionally, vigorous new fall growth produces leaves which are larger than this. Most foliage on hardy cultivar and well worth its place in the garden landscape. It has also been known under the name 'Hana izumi nishiki'.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 春季新叶常呈令人惊喜的粉红偏红或浅橙红色，随后很快成熟为带斑锦的绿色。其斑锦较为含蓄，不像 'Oridono nishiki' 那样鲜亮张扬。许多叶片上分布着不规则且无固定模式的白色或奶油色区块，这些部位通常呈镰刀形。大多数叶片带有很浅的、近粉彩感的色彩晕染。白色、奶油色，偶尔略带白绿色的细点和斑驳共同构成其斑锦。整体色调非常柔和，均匀过渡于整株叶丛之中，与大多数斑叶品种明显不同。中等大小的叶片最长约 5 厘米、最宽约 6 厘米；偶尔在秋季强旺新梢上会抽生更大的叶片。大多数叶片着生于较短枝条上。该品种耐寒性好，很值得在园林景观中占有一席之地。它也曾以 'Hana izumi nishiki' 之名流传。

products.title: Acer palmatum 'Kasen nishiki' Variegated Japanese Maple
products.description_text: Acer palmatum 'Kasen nishiki' Rare Pink Variegated Kasen nishiki Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 Acer palmatum 'Kasen nishiki' is white streaks of variegation on green leaves with a milky white pastel variegation throughout the leaf. The variegation on 'Kasen nishiki' is one of the milkiest variegations of any Japanese maple. Each leaf is variegated differently and is quite unique. Fall color on 'Kasen nishiki' can range from yellow to red. 'Kasen nishiki' may reach 8-10 ft in height in 10 years. Limited Quantities Available !! As we have over a thousand cultivars of Japanese maples, we often do not have many of each cultivar. descriptions.preferred: This very dwarf form is widely used for bonsai. The tiny rich green leaves are five lobed, with the center lobe the Corvallis Corvallis and 1-2 cm long. As they open, the new leaves are a very light yellow green, with margins a brick or rust color, thus making the new growth very noticeable. Fall colors are mostly in the yellow tones. This plant is a very shrubby grower as are all the maples in the Dwarf Group. The size at maturity depends upon fertility and culture, but can reach up to 2 m tall and spread. It can be forced in the landscape or retarded in container culture or bonsai. I've seen an approximately 20-year-old specimen that was more than 1 m high, but have grown the same cultivar in a container for 10 years and it only reached 40 cm tall and wide. 'Kashima' lends itself very well to rock garden culture. It takes well to shaping and pruning, as do other dwarf forms. It is hardy and sturdy, and tolerates some drought when reduced growth is desired. 'Chiba', 'Chiba yatsubusa', and 'Kashima yatsubusa' are very similar to this cultivar.

rhs.description: A very small, slow-growing deciduous shrub eventually reaching 1m or more in height, with tiny rich green, palmate, 5-lobed leaves 2-3cm long and wide, the new spring leaves yellow green, margined red, turning shades of yellow and orange in autumn; ideal for bonsai training

rhs_zh.description: 极小型、缓慢生长的落叶灌木，最终株高可达 1 米或以上。叶片极小，浓绿色，掌状 5 裂，长宽约 2-3 厘米；春季新叶黄绿色，叶缘带红，秋季转为黄色和橙色层次。非常适合制作盆景。

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这一极矮生类型广泛用于盆景。其叶片极小、浓绿色，通常为 5 裂，长度约 1-2 厘米。新叶展开时呈很浅的黄绿色，叶缘带砖红色或锈色，因此新梢格外显眼。秋色多为黄色调。与所有 Dwarf Group 中的枫树一样，该品种生长成灌木状。成熟株大小受土壤肥力和栽培方式影响较大，但可达约 2 米高，冠幅亦相近。地栽时可促进其生长，而在容器栽培或盆景状态下则可控制其生长。我曾见过一株约 20 年生的植株，高度超过 1 米；但同一品种在容器中栽培 10 年，仅长到约 40 厘米高和宽。'Kashima' 非常适合岩石园栽培，也和其他矮生品种一样，十分适合整形和修剪。其耐寒、健壮，在希望控制生长量时，也能耐受一定程度的干旱。'Chiba'、'Chiba yatsubusa' 和 'Kashima yatsubusa' 与该品种非常相似。

products.title: Acer palmatum 'Kashima' Dwarf Japanese Maple
products.description_text: Acer palmatum 'Kashima' Rare Kashima yatsubusa Dwarf Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 ‘Kashima’ is small, rounded mushroom shape Japanese maple with yellow-green tones to the leaf in the early spring, with a pink toned margin to the new growth. The leaves on ‘Kashima’ mature to a lighter green than many other “hime” types. The branching on ‘Kashima’ is vigorous and grows horizontally with a very dense habit. Fall color on ‘Kashima’ is typically orange to red. ‘Kashima’ is often known as ‘Kashima yatsubusa’, the latter term simply stating the dwarf habit of this tree. ‘Kashima’ May reach 3-4 ft in height by 4-5 ft in width in 10 years. ‘Kashima’ is a great small tree for containers or bonsai. Limited Quantities Available !! As we have over a thousand cultivars of Japanese maples, we often do not have many of each cultivar. descriptions.preferred: This delightful form is quite striking in its spring growth. As the leaves develop, they are a pale yellow orange. The margins shade into a brighter orange. The color is difficult to describe accurately, but it is rather lobes are ovate-lanceolate, tapering to a long point, and separated three-quarters of the way to the leaf base. The sides of the lobes are shallowly toothed. The center lobe is always longer, and the leaves tend to turn downwards, giving a distinct appearance to the plant. The petioles are 1-1.5 cm long. 'Katsura' seems to be a small growing form in North America, with the leaf nodes and twigs quite close together so that the foliage is dense. The upright growth quickly broadens with side branching. In Europe, this cultivar seems to grow taller, reaching more than 8 m high. Repeated pruning makes it a more compact plant. It adapts well to bonsai culture. The name 'Katsura' means a "wig" and the plant has been known as 'Katsura yatsubusa'. are 6-7 cm long and 8-9 cm wide. They lie flat and are attached with short petioles about 1-2 cm long. Fall coloration develops into a distinct yellow gold with rosy tones. It becomes blended with light orange and reds. The fall color is quite unique. The sturdy branches angle out, thus developing a well-rounded, short tree or tall bush up to 6 m high. The bark is a strong green with an overtone of bluish gray. White streaking is prominent, especially as the bark ages. This good, hardy, sturdy cultivar adds a "different" appearance for landscaping. The name means "from Hachijo Island" and has also been spelled 'Kihatsijo'.

sources.description: 金贵又名卡苏和桂，春天新叶呈黄色，边缘部分是更亮的橙色。随着季节的推移，叶子会逐渐变成黄绿色。秋天的颜色是亮黄色和橙色的。叶子通常为 5裂，叶边缘带有锯齿，叶柄较短。金贵长势好、抗性佳，成年树高约为6米， 在欧美苗圃有广泛的种植。 曾荣获 英国皇家园艺学会 (RHS) 花园优异奖 。

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这一迷人的品种在春季萌发时尤为醒目。叶片展开时呈淡黄橙色，叶缘过渡为更明亮的橙色，这种色彩较难准确描述，但颇具特色。其裂片呈卵状披针形，渐尖成细长先端，分裂深度达叶基约四分之三；裂片边缘具浅锯齿。中央裂片总是更长，叶片整体常略向下垂，使植株呈现鲜明的独特姿态。叶柄长约 1-1.5 厘米。'Katsura' 在北美似乎属于小型生长型，叶节与小枝间距很近，因此叶幕致密；直立生长后很快因侧枝展开而变宽。在欧洲，该品种往往长得更高，可超过 8 米。反复修剪可使株形更紧凑，也很适合盆景栽培。'Katsura' 一名意为“假发”，该品种也曾被称为 'Katsura yatsubusa'。另有资料所述其叶长 6-7 厘米、宽 8-9 厘米，平展着生，叶柄较短，约 1-2 厘米。秋色发展为鲜明的黄金币色并带玫瑰色调，同时混有浅橙色与红色，秋色十分独特。枝条强健并向外斜伸，因此形成圆整的小乔木或高大灌木，高可达 6 米。树皮浓绿色，覆有蓝灰色调，随着树龄增长会出现明显的白色条纹。该品种健壮、耐寒、枝干结实，可为景观栽植增添不同的观赏效果。其名称意为“来自八丈岛”，也曾写作 'Kihatsijo'。

products.title: Acer shirasawanum 'Kawaii' Full Moon Japanese Maple
products.description_text: Acer shirasawanum 'Kawaii' Full Moon Maple Zone 5 Acer shirasawanum 'Kawaii' is an attractive deciduous dwarf shrub with a low-mounding habit. Its spring and summer foliage is a beautiful orange-plum-red color and is more delicate than most dissectums. This maple is sure to draw attention with its dramatic fall colors of brilliant red and deep orange. Hardy to -20 degrees and preferring sun or partial shade in well-drained soil, the 'Kawasuzumi' Japanese Maple only grows to 1 foot tall and 2 feet wide in 10 years, making it an ideal choice for small gardens or containers. Discovered and introduced by the Flora Wonder ™ Collection of Buchholz Nursery, its name means "cute" in Japanese.

sources.title: 黄八丈Acer Palmatum 'Kihachijo'
sources.description: 日系品种，名字来源于位于日本伊豆群岛的八丈岛。春 叶为黄绿色或者嫩绿色，结种率高，夏季返绿，但是新 叶为黄色并有红色的色斑，秋季为橙红色或者黄色。生 长速度中等，可全日照，成年株可达 4 米左右高度。

rhs.description: Small, rounded, shrubby tree to about 6m tall, with distinctive, double-serrated, flat, bright green leaves about 7cm long and 9cm wide, that turn yellow-gold, flushed rose-pink, then light orange and red in autumn. The bark is dark green overlaid with bluish-grey, then white streaking. Inconspicuous red-purple flowers in spring may be followed by winged, purple fruits

attributes.suggested_uses: Cottage/Informal Garden
attributes.hort_group_description: Acers in this matsumurae group are deeply divided to around three quarters of the leaf with coarsely-toothed edges and narrow, pointed lobes

care.cultivation: Grow in any moisture-retentive, well-drained soil in a sheltered position. Leaf colour is best in partial shade, although full sun can be tolerated if soil is reliably moist. Leaf scorch can be caused by lack of soil moisture or excessive exposure. See Japanese maples cultivation
care.pruning: Pruning group 1 from late autumn to midwinter only
care.propagation: Propagate by layering in autumn, grafting in late winter or softwood cuttings

resistance.pest: May be susceptible to Acer gall mite, aphids , caterpillars and horse chestnut scale
resistance.disease: May be susceptible to Verticillium wilt , acer leaf scorch and honey fungus

descriptions_zh.preferred: 大型叶片具 7 至 9 裂，呈鲜绿色；裂片为长卵形，边缘有醒目而深的锯齿。每个裂片极狭的尖端形成鲜明特色。秋色独特，为明显的金黄色，并混合浅橙色与红色。树皮为浓绿色，带白色条纹，并覆有一层蓝灰色调。该品种健壮、耐性好、长势稳健，可发育成圆整的矮乔木或高大灌木，高可达 20 英尺（6 米），在园林中能带来与众不同的观感。其名称意为“来自八丈岛”。后续原文夹杂了 'Kingsville Variegated'、'Kinran'、'Kinshi' 等多个品种的 OCR 混杂内容；可辨识部分包括：'Kingsville Variegated' 为介于 'Kagiri nishiki' 与 'Butterfly' 之间的斑叶类型，底色为深绿或蓝绿色，斑锦多为白色并常带粉色；'Kinran' 为红叶类型，春夏叶色深古铜红，叶脉黄绿色，对比明显，夏季转深绿带暗红，秋季呈金黄与绯红；'Kinshi' 为细叶（线裂）类型，秋色以亮橙色见长，株形紧凑直立，适合容器栽培。

attributes.hort_group_description: 此 matsumurae 组的槭树，叶片深裂约达叶片的四分之三，叶缘具粗齿，裂片狭长且先端尖。
attributes.suggested_uses: 适用于乡村风或自然式花园。

care.cultivation: 宜栽于保水且排水良好的土壤中，并选择避风位置。半阴环境下叶色表现最佳；若土壤湿度稳定，也可耐全日照。土壤缺水或暴露过度都可能导致叶片焦边。参见 Japanese maples cultivation。
care.pruning: 修剪第 1 组：仅限在晚秋至仲冬期间进行。
care.propagation: 可于秋季行压条繁殖，于晚冬进行嫁接，或采用软枝扦插繁殖。

resistance.pest: 可能易受槭瘿螨、蚜虫、毛虫和七叶树介壳虫危害
resistance.disease: 可能易感 Verticillium wilt、槭树叶灼病和蜜环菌。

rhs_zh.description: 小型、圆整、灌木状的小乔木，高约 6 米。叶片平展，具显著的重锯齿，鲜绿色，长约 7 厘米、宽约 9 厘米；秋季转为黄金币色，并染玫瑰粉，随后呈浅橙色和红色。树皮深绿色，上覆蓝灰色，之后出现白色条纹。春季开不显眼的红紫色小花，之后可能结带翅的紫色果实。

products.name: Acer palmatum 'Ki hachijo' Green Japanese Maple
products.description_text: Acer palmatum 'Ki hachijo' starts out in spring with bright green foliage that darkens in summer. Forming a beautiful round topped tree with age, usually wider than tall older specimens of 15 feet or more are not rare but this tree is slow growing when young. Fall color is orange, gold and wonderful. The Japanese name means from Hachijo island, a small subtropical island 175 miles south of Tokyo. 10 Year size: Height: 8-10 Feet Width: 8-10 Feet

descriptions.preferred: This cultivar was selected by Henry Hohman of Kingsville, Maryland. He was a very observant plantsman and selected outstanding clones of several genera of plants. 'Kingsville Red' is an Acer palmatum f. atropurpureum selection which is vigorous, hardy, and upright, and grows to about 8 m. The bright red-purple tone holds well in the Pacific Northwest climate into the late summer. It does not seem to sunburn as do some other reds. The large leaves are seven lobed, separated almost three-quarters of the way to the leaf base. The leaves are 6-7 cm long and up to 10 cm wide. The lobes are oblong, tapering to a slender tip. The smaller basal lobes of the pal- 'Kingsville Variegated' is another of Henry Hohman's selections which is worthy of a place in Japanese maple collections. It is assumed that this could be a seedling selection of 'Kagiri nishiki' or 'Butterfly', both of which Hohman had as stock plants. The character is somewhere between the two. However, he did not indicate the parentage. The basic leaf color is a deep green or blue green. Variations of color patterns are irregular, and the variegation is mostly white. However, there is a noticeable amount of pink, and occasionally on young leaves the pink markings cover almost the entire leaf. The leaf margins are quite different from those of either 'Butterfly' or 'Kagiri nishiki'. Fall color changes the white portions to a brilliant rose tone. The leaves are five lobed and irregular. Each lobe is long and narrow with very irregular dentate margins. The leaves range from 2.5 cm long on some older wood to as much as 5 cm on vigorous young shoots. The petioles are 1-2 cm long. The growth rate and performance of the Maplewood stock plants indicated mature plants would be like 'Kagiri nishiki'. This has turned out to be the case. The habit is somewhat twiggy on older wood. It is a delightful companion to some of the other variegated forms. In Europe it shows very little variegation, possibly because it is grown in conditions which are too rich (van Gelderen et al. 1994). It would seem possible that 'Hohman's Variegated' is the same cultivar.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 该品种由马里兰州 Kingsville 的 Henry Hohman 选育。他是一位极具观察力的植物家，从多个植物属中选出了许多优良无性系。'Kingsville Red' 是 Acer palmatum f. atropurpureum 的一个选育品种，长势强健、耐寒、株形直立，可长至约 8 米。在美国太平洋西北地区气候下，其鲜亮的红紫色可一直保持到夏末，不像某些其他红叶品种那样容易日灼。叶片较大，通常 7 裂，分裂深度接近叶基的四分之三；叶长 6-7 厘米，宽可达 10 厘米。裂片呈长圆形，先端渐尖而细长。'Kingsville Variegated' 也是 Henry Hohman 的选育品种之一，值得在日本枫收藏中占有一席之地。一般推测它可能是 'Kagiri nishiki' 或 'Butterfly' 的实生选株，因为 Hohman 曾以这两个品种作母本材料，但他并未注明亲本来源。其性状介于两者之间。叶片底色为深绿色或蓝绿色。斑纹变化不规则，以白色为主，但也有明显的粉色，幼叶上有时粉色斑几乎覆盖整片叶。叶缘形态与 'Butterfly' 和 'Kagiri nishiki' 都明显不同。秋季时，白色部分会转为鲜艳的玫瑰色。叶片为 5 裂，形态不规则；各裂片细长，叶缘具非常不规则的牙齿状锯齿。叶片长度从老枝上的约 2.5 厘米，到强壮新梢上的 5 厘米不等。叶柄长 1-2 厘米。Maplewood 的母株在生长速度和整体表现上显示，其成熟植株应与 'Kagiri nishiki' 类似，后续也证明确实如此。老枝上的株形略显细枝密生。它是其他一些斑叶品种的优良搭配品种。在欧洲，该品种的斑纹表现很弱，可能是因为栽培条件过于肥沃（van Gelderen et al. 1994）。看起来 'Hohman's Variegated' 也有可能与其为同一品种。

descriptions.preferred: The leaves of this cultivar are divided deeply, with the seven lobes separated almost to the leaf base. The leaf base is usually truncate. Although occasionally, on new shoots of very vigorous plants, the leaves are up to 9 cm long, they are usually about 5-6 cm long and 6-7 cm wide. Each lobe is long-ovate, broadest in the middle— about 15 mm wide—and narrowing to about 4 mm at the lobe junctions. The tip comes to a long, narrow point. The leaves have an open, lacy appearance. The margins are deeply double toothed. The spring and early summer coloration is a deep, rich bronze red. The midvein in each lobe is a contrast- 10-15 years. It does, however, broaden out and form more of a round-topped, large bush. It is sturdy and quite hardy, and responds very well to pruning and shaping. It is quite satisfactory grown as a container plant. It can be slowed in its growth to a fine specimen or adapted to a larger bonsai type. This cultivar is not widely known.

rhs.description: A small, spreading, deciduous tree to around 4m tall with deeply divided, seven-loned leaves that emerge a rich bronze-red in spring with bright green veining. In summer the leaves are reddish with green veining and the autumn foliage is bright gold with crimson-red tints

rhs_zh.description: 小型、开展的落叶乔木，高约 4 米。叶片深裂，通常为七裂，春季萌发时呈浓郁的铜红色，并带鲜绿色叶脉。夏季叶片呈带红色调，叶脉仍为绿色；秋叶则转为明亮的金色，并带深红色晕染。

descriptions_zh.preferred: 该品种叶片分裂很深，7 枚裂片几乎一直分离到叶基。叶基通常为截形。虽然在生长特别旺盛植株的新梢上，叶片偶可长达 9 厘米，但通常长约 5-6 厘米、宽约 6-7 厘米。每个裂片均为长卵形，中部最宽，约 15 毫米，在裂片连接处收窄至约 4 毫米，先端延伸为细长尖头。叶片整体显得开张而细致，颇具蕾丝感。叶缘为深重锯齿。春季和初夏叶色为深而浓郁的铜红色。每个裂片的中脉形成鲜明对比。植株在 10-15 年内保持良好形态；不过随着年龄增长，它会逐渐开展，形成更偏圆头状的大型灌木。该品种健壮且相当耐寒，对修剪和整形反应良好。作为容器植物栽培也很理想。可通过控长培养成精致标本株，也可塑造成较大的盆景类型。该品种尚不广为人知。

descriptions.preferred: This semidwarf strap-leaved cultivar comes from Japan. Its name, which means "with golden threads," aptly describes the wonderful orange-yellow color of the leaves in the fall. The fiveor seven-lobed medium to dark green spicuously toothed. The slender green petioles vary in length from 1 to 4 cm. 'Kinshi' forms a tidy, compact, upright, semidwarf tree, attaining a height of 2.5 m. It would be at home in most garden landscapes whatever their size, and is perfectly suited for containers. The name has been misspelled 'Ginshi'.

sources.title: 金线 Acer Palmatum 'Kinshi'
sources.description: 这种半矮化的细叶品种来自于日本，它的名字涵义是 "带有金线"，完美地展示了秋天 树叶美妙的橙黄色。 叶子为 5到7裂，叶裂深至基部，叶子非常的细且长。春天叶子是鲜亮的浅绿色，夏天绿色会加深，秋季叶子会变成明亮的橙色。它的名字曾被错误的拼成 "Ginshi"。 金线紧凑、直立、半矮化的特性，非常适合盆栽和庭院的装饰。成年树高约为 2到3米。

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这是一个来自日本的半矮生细带叶品种。其名称意为“带金色丝线”，十分贴切地描述了其叶片在秋季呈现的美丽橙黄色。叶片中等至深绿色，具 5 或 7 个裂片，边缘有明显锯齿。细长的绿色叶柄长 1 至 4 厘米不等。'Kinshi' 形成整洁、紧凑、直立的半矮生小乔木，高可达 2.5 米。无论园地大小，都很适合应用于多数庭园景观中，也非常适合盆栽容器栽培。其名称曾被误拼作 'Ginshi'。

descriptions.preferred: Most dissectums appear delicate in foliage, but 'Kiri nishiki' looks more substantial yet not coarse. The nine lobes are not as doubly incised as most dissectums. Each lobe is more regularly incised pinnately, and each pinna is less delicately incised. The leaves vary from 5 to 8 cm long and from 6 to 9 cm wide. The petioles are 2-3 cm long. The basic foliage color is a bright, light green. This strong color stands full sun rather well. In the fall, the intense gold color is excellent, and occasionally it is suffused with crimson and scarlet on the tips. This full, cascading cultivar is fairly strong growing and hardy. As with other closely allied forms, such as 'Sekimori', it should be planted on a bank or grafted high to realize the full effect of the beautifully cascading display of branches. It reaches 3 m high and wide. 'Kiri nishiki' is listed in maple reference books back to the early 1700s. 'Kire nishiki' may be a misspelling of the name. wide. Each leaf is five lobed, with the center lobe noticeably longer. The lobes are ovate-lanceolate, tapering back from the widest point to where all the lobes join, threequarters of the way to the leaf base. The lobes point sharply and tend to turn downward, making a slightly falcate form. The margins are toothed. The petioles are a rich green tinged pink and 1-2 cm long. Early spring leaves are beautiful. The edges are tinged with an orange red, which is lightly and delicately shaded into the center of the light green leaf. The rich green foliage dominates the spring season. Fall colors run into the yellow-orange range, following a summer of rich green. 'Kiyohime' is a sturdy, vigorous plant. Of the several dwarf types, it probably grows more vigorously than other forms. Yet in containers and bonsai culture, it dwarfs down as well as the others. Side-branching ability is good on the shoots, especially with some pinching back of spring growth. For landscaping it is valuable as a dwarf with a little more size and vigor than some others. It is possible to obtain a bush 2 m high in about 10 years. The plant grows densely and forms a roundish bush. Rarely does it put up a strong central leader, but rather it branches and rebranches. This cultivar has also been known as 'Kiyohime yatsubusa'. Corvallis lobes are long-ovate with acuminate points, and are separated two-thirds of the way to the leaf base. The edges are very lightly toothed. The early spring foliage tends to have yellow tips as the leaves emerge and then change to a strong green color. The fall colors are a bright golden display. This strongly growing tree probably reaches 10 m in 20 years. It makes a good base plant for landscapes, and the golden fall color can work as a contrast to other plantings. Full sunlight is best. This cultivar has been known as 'Kogane sunago'.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 多数裂叶型日本枫的叶片看起来较为纤细，但 'Kiri nishiki' 显得更有质感而不过于粗重。其叶通常为九裂，不像多数裂叶型那样呈明显的二次深裂。每个裂片更规则地作羽状深裂，而每个小裂片的再裂又较不细碎。叶长 5-8 厘米，宽 6-9 厘米；叶柄长 2-3 厘米。叶色底色为明亮的浅绿色，这种较强的色泽在全日照下表现也相当不错。秋季叶色为浓艳的金黄色，叶尖有时会染上深红与猩红色。这一丰满、枝条下垂的品种生长较健壮，耐寒性也较好。与其他近似类型如 'Sekimori' 一样，宜栽植于坡地，或高接嫁接，才能充分展现其枝条优美下垂的观赏效果。植株高、幅均可达 3 米。'Kiri nishiki' 在槭树参考书中最早可追溯至 18 世纪初；'Kire nishiki' 可能是其名称的误写。叶片各叶五裂，中裂片明显较长。裂片为卵状披针形，自最宽处向后渐狭，至距叶基约四分之三处与其他裂片相连。裂片先端锐尖，且常向下弯，略呈镰刀形。叶缘具锯齿。叶柄浓绿色并带粉色，长 1-2 厘米。早春新叶十分美丽，叶缘染橙红色，并轻柔渐晕入浅绿色叶心。春季以浓绿色叶色为主。经过夏季的浓绿后，秋色转为黄橙色。'Kiyohime' 是一个结实、长势旺盛的品种。在数个矮生类型中，它的长势可能比其他类型更强；但用于容器栽培和盆景时，也能像其他品种一样保持矮化。其枝条侧向分枝能力良好，尤其在春梢适度摘心后更明显。用于景观时，它作为矮生品种较有价值，因为其体量和长势略强于某些同类。约 10 年可长成高约 2 米的灌丛。植株生长紧密，形成近圆形灌丛，很少抽生强壮主干，而是不断分枝再分枝。该品种亦曾以 'Kiyohime yatsubusa' 之名流传。Corvallis 的裂片呈长卵形，先端渐尖，分裂深达叶基约三分之二。叶缘仅有极浅的锯齿。早春展叶时叶尖偏黄，随后转为浓绿色；秋色呈鲜亮的金黄色。此品种生长势较强，20 年后树高可能达 10 米。适合作景观中的基调树种，其金黄色秋叶可与其他栽植形成对比。以全日照环境最佳。该品种亦曾以 'Kogane sunago' 为名。

sources.description: 'Kiyohime' Japanese maple is a dwarf, spreading maple cultivar in the maple family (Sapindaceae). It is known for its interesting leaf coloring. Japanese maples are native to southeast Korea and central and south Japan. Acer is Latin for sharp and palmatum means shaped like a hand, referring to the leaves. It will reach only 2 to 3 feet in height but grows twice as wide. It prefers humus-rich, well-drained soil, moderate water and full to partial sun. It is very tolerant of hot summers. In the early spring, its leaves have a distinctive red-purple border. The leaves are green in summer and then change to yellows and red or orange in fall. Plant it in small spaces, a container, or in Asian gardens. It is often used in bonsai. Insects, Diseases, and Other Plant Problems: Aphids, scale, maple worms, leafrollers, and leafhoppers are occasional pests. Anthracnose, leaf scorch, and frost damage, especially from late frosts, can occur. It self-seeds easily so can spread and become weedy in the landscape. See potential insect and disease problem fact sheets to the left. The Clemson Cooperative Extension Home and Garden Information Center has a factsheet on common maple diseases and insect pests.

descriptions.preferred: This cultivar is one of many red-leaved forms in the Matsumurae Group. The leaves are deeply divided at least three-quarters of the way to the leaf base. The points of the lobes radiate outward. The lobes are ovate and come to a sharp point. The edges show a marked, sharp, double serration. The medium-sized leaves are 6-7 cm long and wide and seem to extend laterally from the twigs in most growth and attempt to lie on the same plane. The coloration is a deep purplish red, hence the name which means "deep purple." The color holds well in the summer heat. Along the center of the lobes, the color shades into a deep greenish red, thus making a contrast to the solid coloration. The fall foliage color is a strong crimson. This hardy, small tree grows about as broad as tall. It probably attains 3-4 m tall and wide after 15 or more years. The cultivar has been known under the names 'Koi murasaki' and 'Noshi'.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 该品种是 Matsumurae Group 众多红叶类型之一。叶片深裂，至少达叶基的四分之三处。各裂片先端向外放射展开。裂片呈卵形，先端锐尖。叶缘具明显而锐利的重锯齿。中等大小的叶片长宽约 6-7 厘米，在多数生长状态下似乎自枝条侧向伸展，并力求处于同一平面。叶色为深紫红色，因此得名，意为“深紫”。这种颜色在夏季高温中保持性良好。裂片中央沿主脉处色泽会过渡为较深的带绿红色，从而与整体均一叶色形成对比。秋叶为鲜明的深红色。该品种耐寒，为小型乔木，冠幅与高度大致相当。15 年或更久后，推测可达高、幅 3-4 米。该品种也曾以 'Koi murasaki' 和 'Noshi' 之名流传。

descriptions_zh.preferred: 'Kogane nishiki' 是一个生长势强的树形品种，适合作背景树或上层栽植。中等大小的叶片为五至七裂，叶色深而浓绿。裂片呈长卵形，先端渐尖，裂片间分离较深。叶缘有浅锯齿。春叶叶尖带黄色，随后转为适合夏季观赏的浓绿色；秋色为明亮的金黄色。20 年可长至 10 米。该树种适合作景观中的基调树，其金黄色秋叶可与其他栽植形成对比。以全日照位置最佳。其名意为“金色锦缎”。 'Kogane sakae' 为 Amoenum Group 的绿色矮生类型，是一个颇为特别的品种，以枝皮颜色著称。极嫩的新梢及较老枝条呈浅绿色，并带黄绿色条纹及不规则斑纹。叶片中到大型，七裂，分裂深达叶基的一半；裂片呈卵形，在中部最宽。叶缘细锯齿。春季叶色鲜绿，叶尖带红；秋色为淡橙至黄色。该品种树形强健而直立，高度可达 10-13 米。其名意为“金色繁荣”。 'Komachi hime' 属绿色类型，是一个十分可爱的极慢生美国选育品种，叶形和株型与较知名的 'Kiyohime' 相似。小型五裂叶浅绿色，春季叶尖和叶缘鲜红，夏季转为中绿色并带较深红色。裂片先端锐尖，向外放射，使叶片呈星状外观。其名意为“美丽的小女孩”。 'Komon nishiki' 属斑叶类型。小叶片较深裂，为五至七个卵形裂片，逐渐收尖。叶缘具锯齿。叶柄短、细、浅绿色。春叶边缘带玫瑰色至粉色，并几乎向叶心渐晕。晚春时，鲜浅绿色叶面上会散布极细小的黄色或白色斑点，斑锦细腻而优美。秋色鲜红。'Komon nishiki' 可长至约 3 米，也适合盆景与容器栽培。其名意为“锦上的小纹样”。

The young shoots and older branches are light green with definite areas of a yellowish tone. These are in striations and irregular streaks running lengthwise on the branches. The variegation carries well into the older trunk, although 'Komon nishiki'. University Archives, Corvallis gins. The foliage is a bright green in spring, with reddish tips on the lobes. Fall colors range from pale orange to yellow. This strong, upright-growing tree is of good stature, reaching 10-13 m at maturity. It is a good collector's item.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 'Kogane sakae' 意为“golden prosperity（金色繁荣）”，是一种较为罕见的树形品种，以枝干色彩尤其引人注目。嫩梢和较老枝条为浅绿色，并带有明显的黄绿色区块，这些色斑常以纵向条纹和不规则长条状分布于枝条上。这种斑纹在较老的主干上也能延续。春季叶色鲜绿，裂片先端带红色。秋色从淡橙色到黄色不等。该品种生长强健，树姿直立，成熟后可达 10 至 13 米，是很值得收藏的品种。

descriptions.preferred: This variegated form has fiveor seven-lobed leaves about 3-5 cm long and 4-5 cm wide. The leaves on older wood tend to be even smaller. The lobes join more than two-thirds of the way to the leaf base, are ovate-acuminate, widest in the lower third, and gradually taper to a point. The margins are toothed. The petioles are short, thin, and light green, and 1-2 cm long. The basic color of the foliage is a bright, pale green, but in the spring the new leaves have a rose-tinted edging which blends almost to the center of the lobes. Occasionally, the new tones are almost pink. As the leaves exthe name which means "small figures on brocade." The leaves take on bright crimson tones in the fall. Neither a large-growing plant nor a dwarf, 'Komon nishiki' can attain up to 3 m when planted in a good location in a rock garden. Container-grown, it makes a fine-leaved small plant, and lends itself to bonsai culture. 'Aureo-variegatum' has been considered a synonym of 'Komon nishiki' (van Gelderen et al. 1994). The former, however, appears to grow twice as tall to 6 m, and has leaves with deeper divisions and variegation that is not as marked or attractive.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这一斑叶类型的叶片为五裂或七裂，长约 3-5 厘米，宽约 4-5 厘米。着生于老枝上的叶片往往更小。裂片在超过叶基三分之二处相连，呈卵状渐尖形，在下部三分之一处最宽，随后逐渐收尖。叶缘具锯齿。叶柄短、细、浅绿色，长 1-2 厘米。叶片底色为明亮的浅绿色，但春季新叶边缘带玫瑰色晕染，并几乎渐晕至裂片中央；有时新叶色调几近粉色。叶片展开后，会呈现与其名称“锦上的小纹样”相呼应的观赏效果。秋季叶色转为鲜亮的深红色。'Komon nishiki' 既不属于大型生长型，也不是极矮生型；若栽植于条件良好的岩石园中，可高达 3 米。容器栽培时，它可形成叶片细致的小型植株，也适合盆景栽培。'Aureo-variegatum' 曾被视为 'Komon nishiki' 的异名（van Gelderen et al. 1994）。但前者似乎可长到其两倍高度，即达 6 米，且叶片分裂更深，斑锦也不如后者明显和美观。

descriptions.preferred: This maple was described in earlier editions of this book under the natural variety Acer palmatum var. koreanum, and in Maples of the World under 'Koreanum'. Acer palmatum var. coreanum was the name given by Takenoshin Nakai in 1914 to this natural form indigenous to South Korea and adjacent islands. However, it was based on an abnormal specimen with petal-less flowers. Thus the name was illegitimate under the 1959 Botanical Code and was later absorbed into A. palmatum subsp. palmatum by variable, naturally occurring population with the same name, and because Latin names have been banned for cultivars since 1959, the Hillier clone has been renamed 'Korean Gem'. This excellent green palmatum has brilliant fall colors ranging from yellows to oranges and occasionally blended with red. The twig coloration is dark red, especially in the fall and winter. The leaves are a bright, light green. The margins have a very narrow and faint red marking in the spring. The fiveor seven-lobed leaves, 6-10 cm long and wide, are separated two-thirds of the way to the leaf base, and radiate outward. The lobes are ovate and taper to a sharp point, with the margins finely double serrated. The petioles are red and up to 4 cm long. 'Korean Gem' is strong growing and hardy and forms an upright, round-headed, medium-sized to large tree up to 7 m high. With proper pruning, it can also be made to form a round-headed, short tree.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 本书早期版本曾将这株枫树归于自然变种 Acer palmatum var. koreanum，《Maples of the World》中则列于 'Koreanum' 名下。Acer palmatum var. coreanum 是 Takenoshin Nakai 于 1914 年赋予这一原产韩国及邻近岛屿自然类型的名称。但该名称所依据的是一个花瓣缺失的异常标本，因此按 1959 年《植物命名法规》属于非法名称，后来被并入 A. palmatum subsp. palmatum。由于同名自然群体变异较大，且自 1959 年起栽培品种不再允许使用拉丁名，这个 Hillier 克隆后来改名为 'Korean Gem'。这一优秀的绿色 palmatum 品种秋色极为出色，从黄色到橙色不等，有时还会混有红色。嫩枝呈深红色，尤其在秋冬季更为明显。叶片鲜亮浅绿，春季叶缘有极窄且很淡的红色镶边。叶 5 或 7 裂，长宽 6-10 厘米，裂片约分离至叶基的三分之二处，并向外辐射展开。裂片呈卵形，先端渐尖，边缘具细密重锯齿。叶柄为红色，长可达 4 厘米。'Korean Gem' 生长健旺且耐寒，可形成直立、圆头状的中型至大型乔木，高可达 7 米。经过适当修剪，也可培养成圆头状的矮生小乔木。

descriptions.preferred: The basic color of this variegated cultivar is light, bright green. The new leaves are edged with orange and red. The sunago fu (sand-dusted) form of variegation consists of Corvallis from the center, giving a definite palmate appearance. Occasionally, they are irregularly curved. Shoots are crimson. Fall colors graduate through the yellows into the orange tones. The leaves vary from 2 to 2.5 cm long and 3 cm wide on mature foliage of older wood. Some leaves are as much as 5 cm long and 6 cm wide on vigorous young shoots. This short shrub is of twiggy, slightly cascading habit and makes a dense but lacy plant. It is a cultivar of almost dwarf structure, with small foliage and, for best appearance, should not be overfertilized. It probably reaches 2.5 m or a little more at maturity. It is a desirable small landscape plant and also adapts very well to container culture.

descriptions.preferred: other The foliage, fall coloration, and bunchy habit of the old twigs, among other features, are very similar to those of 'Hagoromo'. The leaf shape is basically the same (see 'Hagoromo' for a full description). The two cultivars could be synonymous. However, Japanese nurseries list 'Hagoromo' as slow-growing, rarely reaching 1 m high. I have received material from various sources and 'Hagoromo' never grows as vigorously as 'Koshimino'. The Maplewood stock plants of the latter have reached a height of 5 m very quickly. A 10-year-old tree is about 6 m tall and is slender. Another of the same age is only about 3 m tall but multistemmed and quite broad. The Maplewood plants of 'Hagoromo' show no tendency to be so vigorous. This difference lends weight to the assumption that they are different cultivars. Other authors indicate that they may be synonymous, but comparing plants grown side by side suggests that they are separate cultivars. Another name which has been used for 'Koshimino' is 'Decompositum'.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 其叶色、秋季叶色以及老枝簇生的习性等特征，与 'Hagoromo' 非常相似。叶形基本相同（详见 'Hagoromo' 的完整描述）。这两个品种可能是同物异名。然而，日本苗圃将 'Hagoromo' 列为生长缓慢，极少超过 1 米高。我从不同来源获得过材料，'Hagoromo' 的生长势始终不如 'Koshimino'。后者在 Maplewood 的母株很快就长到 5 米高。一株 10 年生植株约 6 米高，树形较纤细；另一株同龄植株仅约 3 米高，但为多主干，且冠幅较宽。Maplewood 的 'Hagoromo' 植株并未表现出如此强的长势。这个差异增强了它们是不同品种这一推测。其他作者认为二者可能为同物异名，但将植株并排比较栽培后，显示它们应是两个独立品种。'Koshimino' 还曾使用过另一个名称，即 'Decompositum'。

descriptions.preferred: This dwarf, whose name means "little harp," has one of the smallest leaf forms of Acer palmatum cultivars. On mature wood, many leaves are only 1-1.5 cm long and wide. On newer wood, they may reach 3 cm. These leaves have five lobes, although much of the time they appear Corvallis Corvallis often down to 2 mm. The new leaves often come out a bright rose or orange red. This color is heaviest on the edges of the leaves and shades into the light green of the center. Mature foliage is bright, light green. Fall colors are the light tones of yellow blended with orange. 'Kotohime' is a sturdy little plant for its type. It tends to grow upright with much side branching which rounds out the shape. Each branch sends out further side branches in profusion, so that the plant becomes quite dense. The leaf nodes are spaced very close together, thus giving a dense cover of leaves. This maple is useful planted with other dwarf forms in such special places as alpine gardens. It is also popular with bonsai specialists and can be trained into a very tight bun shape. In bonsai containers, it has a profusion of delightfully small leaves. Other names which have been used for this cultivar are 'Kotohime yatsubusa' and 'Tokyo yatsubusa'. 'Chichibu' and 'Chichibu yatsubusa' are similar if not the same.

care.cultivation: Grow in moisture-retentive, well-drained soil in a sheltered position. Leaf colour is best in partial shade, although full sun can be tolerated if soil is reliably moist. Acer leaf scorch can be caused by lack of soil moisture or excessive exposure. Suits container cultivation but attention to watering is needed in dry spells during the growing season. Suits bonsai cultivation . See Japanese maple cultivation

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这个矮生品种的名字意为“小竖琴”，在 Acer palmatum 栽培品种中属于叶形最小者之一。成熟枝上的许多叶片仅长宽 1-1.5 厘米；在较新的枝条上，叶片可达 3 厘米。这些叶通常为 5 裂，不过很多时候裂片极狭，宽度常仅约 2 毫米。新叶常呈鲜亮的玫瑰色或橙红色，这种色彩在叶缘最浓，并逐渐过渡到中央的浅绿色。成熟叶为鲜亮浅绿色。秋色为浅调的黄色，并混有橙色。'Kotohime' 以其类型而言是一个结实健壮的小型品种。其生长趋于直立，侧枝丰富，使株形圆整。每根枝条又会大量抽生侧枝，因此植株变得非常致密。叶节间距很短，因此叶幕极为紧密。这一枫树适合与其他矮生型一起栽植于高山花园等特殊位置，也深受盆景爱好者欢迎，可训练成非常紧凑的团状树形。在盆景盆中，它能生出大量十分讨喜的小叶。这个品种还曾使用过 'Kotohime yatsubusa' 和 'Tokyo yatsubusa' 两个名称。'Chichibu' 和 'Chichibu yatsubusa' 与其相似，甚至可能就是同一品种。

rhs_zh.description: 矮生、直立、灌木状小乔木，高约 1.2 至 1.5 米。叶片极小，5 裂，排列紧密。春季新叶鲜玫瑰粉色或橙红色，向叶片中央渐变为浅绿色；夏季成熟后转为明亮浅绿色；秋季呈黄色并混有橙色。适合制作盆景。

descriptions.preferred: Of the many thousands of seedlings produced at Maplewood Nursery, including those by hand hybridization, this one is the most unusual. The plant is extremely dwarf. The original was a chance seedling which remained very tiny for the first three years. It was not until the tiny tips were grafted onto vigorous understock that it began to get any size at all. The most growth that it has been possible to force on any one graft in a season was about 15 cm. Most grafts make an annual growth of 5-6 cm. The shoots are sturdy for the size, and the leaf nodes are very close together—often only a few millimeters apart—thus making the foliage quite dense. The leaves usually have five extremely long, narrow lobes, but many have only three lobes. The margins are not toothed but slightly wavy. Each lobe is only 1 mm at the widest point, and narrows to half that at the base, little more than the width of the midrib. In length each lobe is about 5 cm, and the lobes join at the leaf base. The total spread across the leaves is 11 cm. The leaves do not lie in the same plane, and each one has a different curl to the lobes. The petiole, which is quite fine, is 1.5-2 cm long. scion wood is measured only in millimeters or, at the most, 2 cm. I was pleased to have Hideo Suzuki of Japan view this plant and suggest the name which we have assigned to it. While he visited Maplewood Nursery, he suggested the name 'Koto ito komachi' which can be interpreted as "old harp string" or "beautiful little girl." The leaves are like harp strings, and this cultivar is Maplewood's "beautiful little girl." The word komachi is also a horticultural term for "dwarf."

descriptions_zh.preferred: 在 Maplewood Nursery 培育出的数以千计的实生苗中，包括人工杂交所得者，这一株是最不寻常的。植株极为矮小。原株是一株偶然获得的实生苗，在最初三年一直非常微小。直到将其细小枝梢嫁接到长势旺盛的砧木上后，才开始稍有生长。迄今能够促成单个嫁接株在一个生长季内达到的最大生长量约为 15 厘米，而多数嫁接株每年仅生长 5-6 厘米。枝条就其尺寸而言相当结实，叶节间距极短，常仅数毫米，因此叶幕十分致密。叶片通常具五个极长而狭窄的裂片，但也有不少仅三裂。叶缘无锯齿，仅略呈波状。每个裂片在最宽处仅约 1 毫米，向基部收窄至其一半，几乎只比中脉略宽。各裂片长度约 5 厘米，并在叶基处相连；全叶展开宽度约 11 厘米。叶片并不处于同一平面，每片叶的裂片卷曲姿态也各不相同。叶柄十分纤细，长 1.5-2 厘米。接穗木的长度通常仅以毫米计，最多也不过 2 厘米。我很高兴日本的铃木秀夫先生曾亲自查看这株植物，并建议采用我们后来赋予它的名称。在他访问 Maplewood Nursery 期间，提出名称 'Koto ito komachi'，可解释为“古琴弦”或“美丽的小女孩”。其叶片细如琴弦，而这一品种正是 Maplewood 的“美丽小女孩”。在园艺语境中，komachi 也有“矮生”之意。

products.name: Acer palmatum 'Koto ito komachi' Thread Leaf Japanese Maple
products.description_text: Acer palmatum ‘Koto ito Komachi’ is a small linearlobum found as a chance seedling and introduced by J.D. Vertrees. Most leaves have 5 lobes some have only 3. Young vigorous plants may have course foliage but older plants display the characteristic very fine almost hairlike foliage. Very rare in the nursery trade as their are many plants sold under this name that are not the same cultivar. The Japanese name means old 5 string harp. Komachi can also be a horticultural term for dwarf. Fall color is yellow to orange. 10 year size: Height: 4-6 Feet Width: 3-4 Feet

descriptions.preferred: This lovely dwarf is the green equivalent of 'Beni hime', being similar in leaf shape and size and growth rate. New foliage is yellow, with bronzed edges and tips, before turning dark green. The yellow-bronze new growth overlying the dark green older foliage continues throughout the growing season. The small five-lobed leaves, 2-2.5 cm long and 2.5-3 cm wide, are divided up to two-thirds of the way to the leaf base. Each lobe is broadly ovate, irregular with triangular or bluntly pointed tip, and with toothed margins. As is typical of witches'-brooms, the center lobe is often truncated and occasionally absent. sources.description: 日系品种，意为 " 圆形竖琴 " ，最早于 1977 年日本出版的《盆栽世界》别册中出现记载，属于大红叶矮生品种。一般为 5 裂叶，叶裂深，每个叶裂都是宽阔的卵形，叶缘较平滑，无明显锯齿，叶小，中央小叶或前 3 小叶会出现缩指的现象，叶柄短，大约 1cm 。春天初芽时为嫩绿色或黄色并带有红棕色的爪斑，夏季叶色转绿，但是琴丸有非常强的分支能力以及二次稍的生长能力，二次稍为黄色小叶并有红色爪斑，形成二次观赏期，秋天为橙红色或者橙黄色。生长健壮，枝叶浓密，自然形成一个紧凑密集的球状，成年株可达 1.5m 左右高度。

products.description_text: Acer palmatum ‘Koto maru’ is a fast growing dwarf Japanese maple. ‘Koto maru’ has very small, rounded leaves that emerge in the spring yellow with a red-oranges border. The coloring of the leaves really puts on a show in the spring. The leaves then fade to a light green throughout the summer. Fall color is then orange to red. ‘Koto maru’ will have long shoots of new growth while it is young, but it will develop into a dense, shrubby tree at maturity. 10 Year Size: Height: 3-5 feet Width: 3-5 feet

care.propagation: 可于冬末采用嫁接繁殖，或以软枝扦插繁殖。

resistance.pest: 可能易受槭瘿螨、蚜虫、毛虫和七叶树介壳虫危害
resistance.disease: 可能易感黄萎病、槭叶焦枯病和蜜环菌病

rhs_zh.description: 生长缓慢的品种，最终形成圆整灌木，株高可达 3 米。下垂的鲜绿色叶由 5 至 7 枚细长裂片组成，裂片先端渐尖，秋季转为橙黄色。

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这一线叶槭品种的裂片比常见的 linearilobum 类型略宽，并夹杂一些细丝状裂片。叶片通常有 5 至 7 个狭长裂片，浓绿色，逐渐延伸至细长而明显尖锐的先端，叶缘近乎平滑。春季新叶展开时带深红色调，入夏后转绿。秋色以不同层次的黄色和橙色为主，颇为醒目。虽为直立生长型，'Koto-no-ito' 通常不超过 10 英尺（3 米）高。树皮鲜绿色，植株耐寒。其名称意为“琴弦”。 另一个绿色品种叶片具光泽，呈铜绿色掌状，通常 5 裂，裂片狭卵形，分裂较深，叶缘具较大而粗的锯齿。新叶呈铜红色，叶中脉为黄色，整个夏季与较老叶片的铜绿色背景形成悦目的对比。植株形成小型、致密、直立的灌木。其名称意为“野山”或“土丘”。 还有一种绿色品种叶片中等大小，7 裂，深裂至基部。中央裂片宽卵形，侧裂片略窄，叶缘具尖锐锯齿。新生叶呈红褐色，随后于生长季转为深浓绿色，秋季变为黄色、橙色和深红色，观赏性很强。该品种生长势旺盛。

descriptions.preferred: This little-known cultivar is worthy of more attention. The leaves are seven lobed and separated to the leaf base. Each lobe is long-ovate with the side lobes noticeably narrower. The edges are quite sharply toothed. The leaves are 5-6 cm long and about 6 cm wide. They have a good texture and feel thick to the touch. Spring growth has a reddish brown or deep rusty appearance. As summer develops, the colors change to a deep, rich green. Fall colors appear in yellow, orange, and crimson tones, which makes this a very conspicuous plant in the garden. Not a tall upright tree, it reaches 4 m high and wide, -green This delightful cultivar has small deep green leaves with the edge of each lobe tightly rolled upward and inward. The undersides are gray green. The leaf almost appears star shaped. There are seven lobes, but the two basal lobes cup upwards, making the leaf appear five lobed. Each lobe is long and gradually pointed, and gives the appearance of a pointed tube as the rolled edges almost meet in the center. Edges of the lobes are toothed, but this feature is lost because they roll inward. The tips are extremely sharp and often hooked. The lobes join about Corvallis Corvallis from the green stems of 'Okushimo'. 'Kurui jishi' is more dwarf than 'Okushimo'. It is a slow, upright grower to 2 m high. The leaf nodes are quite close together and make for a very bunchy growth habit with a dense cover of leaves. Side shoots develop frequently for a tight growth habit. Normal growth is up to 15 cm per year. This cultivar is a delightful plant for alpine gardens or areas in gardens calling for small to medium-sized upright plants. It can be pruned with excellent results. Japanese gardeners report it as slightly tender. The name has been misspelled 'Korui jishi' in the past. 'Kurui jishi' can be interpreted as "a confused lion."

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这个鲜为人知的品种值得获得更多关注。其叶片七裂，裂至叶基；每个裂片为长卵形，两侧裂片明显较窄，叶缘锯齿较锐。叶长 5 至 6 厘米、宽约 6 厘米，质地良好，触感较厚。春梢呈红褐色或深锈色，入夏后转为浓深的绿色。秋色可呈黄色、橙色与深红色调，因此在庭园中十分醒目。植株并非高大的直立乔木，株高和冠幅约可达 4 米。另有一种深绿色叶型，叶片较小而色深，每个裂片边缘紧密向上并向内卷曲，叶背灰绿色，整叶近似星形。叶虽为七裂，但基部两裂片向上杯卷，因而视觉上近似五裂。各裂片细长、渐尖，由于边缘内卷几乎在中央相接，整体看起来像尖细的小管。裂片边缘原有锯齿，但因内卷而不明显；叶尖极锐，且常带钩。该类型与 'Okushimo' 同属卷叶系统，但 'Kurui jishi' 比 'Okushimo' 更矮小。其生长缓慢而直立，株高约 2 米。节间较短，因而株形十分紧密丛生，叶幕浓密；侧枝萌发频繁，使株形更加紧凑。年生长量通常约 15 厘米。此品种非常适合高山园或庭园中需要小至中型直立植物的区域，也可通过修剪取得很好的效果。日本栽培者认为其耐寒性略弱。过去曾误拼作 'Korui jishi'。'Kurui jishi' 可解释为“迷乱的狮子”。

care.cultivation: Grow in any moisture-retentive, well-drained soil in a sheltered position. Leaf colour is best in partial shade, although full sun can be tolerated if soil is reliably moist. Leaf scorch can be caused by lack of soil moisture or excessive exposure. Ideal for container cultivation and small gardens. See Japanese maples cultivation
care.pruning: Pruning group 1 , only from late autumn to mid-winter
care.propagation: Propagate by softwood cuttings, layering or by grafting . Plants grown from seed are unlikely to come true, but may still be garden worthy

resistance.pest: May be susceptible to aphids and scale insects , including horse chestnut scale
resistance.disease: May be susceptible to Verticillium wilt , Acer leaf scorch and honey fungus

attributes.hort_group_description: 这一矮生类群的 Acer 株形紧凑、生长缓慢，因此非常适合盆栽和容器栽培。
attributes.suggested_uses: 城市庭院花园、庭院式花园、乡村/自然式花园、露台/容器栽培、岩石园、花境与花坛

care.pruning: 修剪组 1，仅限晚秋至仲冬期间修剪。
care.propagation: 可通过嫩枝扦插、压条或嫁接繁殖。实生苗通常难以保持品种性状，但仍可能具有园艺观赏价值。
care.cultivation: 宜栽于保湿性好且排水良好的土壤中，并选择避风庇护的位置。叶色在半阴环境下表现最佳；若土壤湿度稳定，全日照也可耐受。土壤缺水或暴晒过度都可能引起叶焦。非常适合容器栽培和小型花园。参见 Japanese maples cultivation。

resistance.pest: 可能易受蚜虫和介壳虫侵害，包括七叶树介壳虫。

rhs_zh.description: 一种落叶矮生槭树，高约 1.5 米，株型致密紧凑。深绿色叶片五至七裂，叶柄为红色；春季新叶鲜亮粉红红色，秋季转为橙红色。

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这个矮生品种在春季会呈现万花筒般的色彩变化。其典型的小型掌状叶为 5 至 7 裂，新叶萌发时呈鲜亮的粉红红色，随后叶缘带褐红色晕染，再转为夏季的中绿色至深绿色。秋色为鲜红色。'Kuro hime' 形成致密、紧凑的小型灌木，非常适合小庭园及容器栽培。'Lemon Lime Lace' 属于 Dissectum Group，叶色为绿色。这个颇具趣味的双色羽裂品种，新叶展开时为非常浅的柠檬黄色，夏季转为青柠绿色，自初夏起即可形成优美的双色效果。秋色为橙色。其叶片的大小和形状与右述品种相近。

descriptions.preferred: This interesting two-toned dissectum originated as a chance seedling in 1979, was propagated and introduced by Del's Japanese Maple Nursery of Eugene, Oregon, in 1992 and registered in 1996. The very apt name describes the changing colors of the leaves. They emerge a very light lemon yellow, becoming lime green as they mature. This creates a lovely two-tone effect from early summer onwards. The color changes to orange in the fall. The size and shape of the leaves is similar to 'Green Mist', perhaps a shade more finely cut. The fiveor seven-lobed deeply dissected leaves are 9- 10 cm long and 10-11 cm wide. The lobes are themselves dissected almost to the midrib, each lobe narrowing to the width of the midrib for the last 1 cm down to the dome shaped as most dissectums.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这一有趣的双色 dissectum 类型起源于 1979 年的一株偶发实生苗，后由美国俄勒冈州尤金的 Del's Japanese Maple Nursery 繁殖并于 1992 年推出，1996 年完成登记。其名称非常贴切地描述了叶色变化：新叶展开时呈极浅的柠檬黄色，成熟后转为酸橙绿色，自初夏起形成美丽的双色效果，秋季则转橙色。叶片大小与形态与 'Green Mist' 相近，但裂得可能更细一些。叶片通常为五裂或七裂，深裂，长 9 至 10 厘米、宽 10 至 11 厘米；各裂片本身又进一步深裂，几乎达到中脉，每一小裂片在末端约 1 厘米处逐渐收窄至近中脉宽度。整体株形呈圆顶状，与多数 dissectum 品种相似。

products.description_text: Acer pseudoplatanus 'Leopoldii' Rare Variegated Leopoldii Sycamore Maple Zones 5-8 'Leopoldii' is gorgeous large variegated upright Sycamore maple. It is one of the largest growing variegated Acer pseudoplatanus. It leafs out with bright pink variegation uniquely splotched over the green leaf. For best coloration give 'Leopoldii' protection from the hot afternoon sun. Fall colors bright yellows to oranges. Limited Quantities Available !! descriptions.preferred: Acer palmatum 'Lileeane's Jewel' Rare Red Variegated Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 Acer palmatum 'Lileeane's Jewel' is a brand new introduction with a rare variegation of pink and white on a bright cherry red and heavily divided leaf. Mid-summer colors are a green-red with pink and white variegation. It is estimated to get about 10-12 ft in 15 years. Fall colors are crimson reds infused with hot pink variegation. This selection is fairly heat tolerant as it has handled the sun of Simpsonville, SC, without burn to the variegation. The variegation appears fairly stable. However, since this is a new cultivar, we suggest avoiding heavy fertilizers. Any branches not showing variegation should be trimmed out. This rare Japanese maple was found as a chance seedling by our friend, Johnathon Savelich, and named after his daughter, Lileeane. Limited Quantities Available !! descriptions.preferred: Acer palmatum 'Lily Pad' Rare Dwarf Japanese Maple Tree Zones 5-9 Excellent for Bonsai We are really happy to offer this exciting new variegated form of ‘Mikawa yatsubusa’. Acer palmatum ‘Lily Pad’ was a sport found on ‘Mikawa yatsubusa’ and retains that nice dense habit that makes it so popular. Tight dense foliage makes for a perfect platform for this swirling variegation. We have found ‘Lily Pad’ to be extremely stable in its variegation. ‘Lily Pad’ was found at Don Schmidt Nursery and named for its low flat shape. The overall habit is rounded, like a lily pad. We estimate ‘Lily Pad’ to reach around 3 ft in height by 4 ft in width in 10 years making this an awesome dwarf selection. When I first got this tree, I was really blown away by how elongated and swirling the foliage is. The leaf shape gives ‘Lily Pad’ a very unique, regal and elegant quality to it. It’s a mikawa with a ruffle and stable variegation! It makes my heart skip a beat! I think you will really enjoy this new dwarf Japanese maple in your garden. If you are an experienced collector who enjoys the "Mikawa Family Collection" or a novice just getting into gardening this new tree is going to be a must! Whether it’s in the ground or a pot this one is going to be a show stopper in your collection!

descriptions_zh.preferred: Acer palmatum 'Lily Pad' 稀有矮生日本枫，适生区 5-9，极适合盆景。我们非常高兴推出这一令人兴奋的 ‘Mikawa yatsubusa’ 新斑叶变异。Acer palmatum ‘Lily Pad’ 是从 ‘Mikawa yatsubusa’ 上发现的芽变，保留了其广受欢迎的致密株型。紧密浓密的叶层为其旋涡状斑锦提供了完美展示。我们观察到 ‘Lily Pad’ 的斑叶性状非常稳定。‘Lily Pad’ 发现于 Don Schmidt Nursery，因其低矮扁平的树形而得名，整体株形圆整，如睡莲叶一般。我们估计 ‘Lily Pad’ 在 10 年内可长至约 3 英尺高、4 英尺宽，是极佳的矮生品种。我第一次见到这棵树时，就被它叶片修长且带旋动感的形态深深吸引。独特的叶形赋予 ‘Lily Pad’ 非常独到、华贵而优雅的气质。它兼具 mikawa 系的褶皱感与稳定斑叶，令人怦然心动！相信无论在庭园中种植，还是作为收藏，你都会非常喜欢这款新的矮生日本枫。无论你是钟爱 “Mikawa Family Collection” 的资深藏家，还是刚开始接触园艺的新手，这个新品种都会是不容错过之选。无论地栽还是盆栽，它都会成为藏品中的焦点。

descriptions.preferred: This unique upright red dissectum introduced by Duncan and Davies Nursery of New Zealand can be described as the red counterpart to the ever-popular upright green dissectum 'Seiryu'\. In spring its foliage is similar in color to that of 'Crimson Queen', and it retains this purple red well into the summer, becoming bronzed with green undertones in early fall. It turns a deep crimson in the fall. The seven-lobed leaves are dissected to the leaf base, and are 7-9 cm long and 9-11 cm wide. The lobes themselves are deeply incised and, with the sublobes, are 1-2 cm wide at the broadest point, narrowing sharply in the lower quarter to no more than the width of the midribs for a distance of 1-1.5 cm to the leaf base. The margins have coarse but narrow, finely pointed double teeth. The red petioles are 1.5-3 cm long with expanded bases. When young the attractive deep red bark is covered in very close-packed vertical glaucous striations. 'Lionheart' is a vigorous small tree, reaching 2.5 m tall in 10 years, and probably attaining a height of 3.5-4 m at maturity. In habit, it is similar to 'Seiryu\' when young, growing upright at first. It becomes more spreading with age, the branches growing horizontally with pendulous tips to give an attractive layered and arching effect. This cultivar's name has been misspelled 'Lions Heart'.

rhs.description: Upright then spreading small tree to about 2.5-3.5m tall, with dissected, 7-lobed purple-red leaves maturing to bronze-green in summer then turning deep crimson in autumn. Inconspicuous red-purple flowers in spring may be followed by winged, purple fruits. When young the deep red bark is vertically stiped pale grey-white

attributes.suggested_uses: City/Courtyard Gardens, Cottage/Informal Garden, Patio/Container Plants
attributes.hort_group_description: Acers in this dissectum group have fine, feathery, deeply divided leaves with finely serrated edges

care.cultivation: Grow in any moisture-retentive, well-drained soil in a sheltered position. Leaf colour is best in partial shade, although full sun can be tolerated if soil is reliably moist. Leaf scorch can be caused by lack of soil moisture or excessive exposure. Suits container cultivation but attention to watering is needed in dry spells during the growing season. See Japanese maples cultivation
care.pruning: Pruning group 1 from late autumn to midwinter only
care.propagation: Propagate by layering in autumn, grafting in late winter or softwood cuttings

resistance.pest: May be susceptible to Acer gall mite, aphids , caterpillars and horse chestnut scale
resistance.disease: May be susceptible to Verticillium wilt , acer leaf scorch and honey fungus

attributes.hort_group_description: dissectum 组的槭树具有细致、羽毛状、深裂的叶片，叶缘具细锯齿。

care.pruning: 修剪第 1 组：仅限在晚秋至仲冬期间进行。
care.propagation: 可于秋季行压条繁殖，于晚冬进行嫁接，或采用软枝扦插繁殖。
care.cultivation: 宜栽培于保水性好且排水良好的土壤中，选择避风庇护的位置。叶色在半阴环境下表现最佳；若土壤湿度稳定充足，也可耐全日照。土壤缺水或暴露过度易导致叶缘焦枯。适合容器栽培，但生长季遇干旱天气时需特别注意浇水。另见 Japanese maples cultivation。

resistance.pest: 可能易受槭瘿螨、蚜虫、毛虫和七叶树介壳虫危害
resistance.disease: 可能易感 Verticillium wilt、槭树叶灼病和蜜环菌。

rhs_zh.description: 先直立后开展的小型乔木，高约 2.5-3.5 米。叶深裂，7 裂，初为紫红色，夏季成熟后转为铜绿色，秋季再变为深绯红色。春季开不显眼的红紫色小花，之后可能结带翅的紫色翅果。幼树时，深红色树皮具纵向浅灰白色条纹。

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这一独特的直立型红叶细裂品种由新西兰 Duncan and Davies Nursery 引种，可视为广受欢迎的直立型绿叶细裂品种 'Seiryu' 的红叶对应品种。春季叶色与 'Crimson Queen' 相近，并能较好地保持这种紫红色直到夏季，初秋时转为带绿色底调的古铜色，秋季则变为深绯红色。叶片 7 裂，深裂至叶基，长 7 至 9 厘米，宽 9 至 11 厘米。各裂片本身深裂，连同次级裂片在最宽处宽 1 至 2 厘米，在下部四分之一处迅速收窄，至距叶基 1 至 1.5 厘米处宽度几乎仅与中脉相当。叶缘具较粗但狭窄、先端细尖的重锯齿。红色叶柄长 1.5 至 3 厘米，基部膨大。幼年时，其迷人的深红色树皮密布紧密排列的纵向粉白色条纹。'Lionheart' 生长势旺，为小型乔木，10 年生可达 2.5 米高，成熟后推测可达 3.5 至 4 米。株形在幼年时与 'Seiryu' 相似，先直立生长；随树龄增长，树冠逐渐开展，枝条横向伸展，枝梢下垂，形成优美的层叠拱垂效果。该品种名有时被误拼为 'Lions Heart'。

products.title: Acer palmatum 'Lionheart' Japanese Maple
products.description_text: Acer palmatum dissectum 'Lionheart' Large Red Laceleaf Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 'Lionheart' is a superb red laceleaf selection of Japanese maple. 'Lionheart' leafs out in the spring as a pink-red to bright red turning maroon for a big part of year. During late summer, 'Lionheart' may turn to shades of bronze, before turning orange to crimson red in the fall. The most unique thing about 'Lionheart' is its habit, often reaching upward at early age, growing with a bit of vigor. As 'Lionheart' begins to age it does begin weep. This habit creates a layering effect with quite a bit of arching. 'Lionheart' may reach 8-10 ft in height and width in 15 years. Limited Quantities Available !! As we have over a thousand cultivars of Japanese maples, we often do not have many of each cultivar. We recommend that you buy the Japanese maples you want immediately as we often sell out of certain selections.

descriptions.preferred: The main features of this cultivar are the bright rosy-red new leaves produced all summer on the background of mahogany-red older leaves, and the stunning scarlet autumn color. The leaves tend to become bronzegreen in shade. They are medium-sized with five to seven deeply divided ovate-triangular lobes. Each lobe has a tail-like tip and distinctly, evenly toothed margins. The short slender leafstalks are also purple. 'Lozita' forms a bushy upright tree, eventually reaching 13-16 ft. (4-5 m) tall. It is an ideal plant for containers which tend to keep it more compact.

descriptions.preferred: The leaves of this cultivar are of the larger type in the Amoenum Group and are seven lobed. They range from 6 to 9 cm long and up to 10 cm wide, and are divided about halfway to the leaf base. The lobes are ovate but taper to a sharp point and have a toothed margin. The petioles are 4-5 cm long. The new spring growth is yellowish green, which soon changes to a rich green. The leaves are of good substance and are durable. The real glory is the fall coloration, which becomes a very rich yellow or gold. This medium-sized upright tree matures at 7 m or more. It is a good companion for other orange to crimson forms in a larger planting. The cultivar has been known under the name 'Luteum'. decidedly non-uniform. They vary from 3 to 5 cm long and 3-7 cm wide. Some lobes are quite narrow, not more than 4 mm wide, but are up to 4 cm long, with margins deeply and irregularly toothed, even lobulate. Some leaves have this type of lobe combined with the more typically triangular-ovate shape which tapers to an elongate, blunt tip. A few leaves have a typical palmatum shape but with very deeply toothed margins. All these variations can occur on the same plant. The cultivar is similar to 'Mama', but the foliage is smaller and even more irregular. The red petioles are stiff and 2 cm long. The plant makes an upright shrub up to 3 m tall. After the vigorous growth of the early years, it will broaden and become multibranched as it matures. Propagating material labeled 'Maoka' and 'Maioka' from different sources was grown side by side with 'Maiko' for comparison, and the three appear identical. The names are examples of how misnomers can be created by carelessness in writing labels. 'Maiko' means "dancing doll."

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这个品种的叶片在 Amoenum Group 中属于较大型，通常为 7 裂。叶长 6-9 厘米，宽可达 10 厘米，裂片约分离至叶基的一半。裂片呈卵形，先端渐尖，边缘具齿。叶柄长 4-5 厘米。春季新叶初展时为黄绿色，很快转为浓绿色。叶片质地良好，较耐久。其真正的观赏高峰在秋季，此时叶色转为非常浓丽的黄色或金黄色。这是一株中等大小、直立生长的乔木，成熟时可达 7 米或更高。在较大的配置中，它可作为其他橙色至绯红色品种的良好配植。该品种曾以 'Luteum' 之名流通。其叶形明显不整齐，变化很大，叶长 3-5 厘米，宽 3-7 厘米。有些裂片非常狭窄，宽不超过 4 毫米，但可长达 4 厘米，边缘深裂且不规则具齿，甚至再分裂成小裂片。有些叶片则同时具有这种狭长裂片和更典型的三角状卵形裂片，后者渐尖为延长而钝的叶端。少数叶片则呈典型 palmatum 叶形，但边缘具极深的齿裂。所有这些变化都可能出现在同一株植株上。该品种与 'Mama' 相似，但叶片更小且不规则程度更高。红色叶柄坚挺，长约 2 厘米。植株生长为直立灌木，高可达 3 米。早年生长较旺，成熟后会逐渐展宽并形成多分枝。来自不同来源、分别标注为 'Maoka' 和 'Maioka' 的繁殖材料曾与 'Maiko' 并排栽培比较，三者看起来完全相同。这些名称说明，标签书写疏忽很容易造成误名。'Maiko' 的含义是“舞娃娃”。

descriptions.preferred: 魔幻春天是由Andre van Nijnatten于1997年在Acer campestre 'Royal Ruby'皇家红宝石上发现的突变品种。魔幻春天叶子颜色随着时间的推移会发生不寻常的变化：幼叶呈深红色，然后逐渐变为橙色，最后呈现出大理石花纹。最好的观赏期为春末夏初，那时有成熟的锦叶和色彩鲜艳的嫩芽，与浅绿的底色形成鲜明对比。秋天呈现出温暖的橙色。它长得不是很快，很少超过3m的高度。可耐受低至-27°。

descriptions_zh.preferred: 魔幻春天是由Andre van Nijnatten于1997年在Acer campestre 'Royal Ruby'皇家红宝石上发现的突变品种。魔幻春天叶子颜色随着时间的推移会发生不寻常的变化：幼叶呈深红色，然后逐渐变为橙色，最后呈现出大理石花纹。最好的观赏期为春末夏初，那时有成熟的锦叶和色彩鲜艳的嫩芽，与浅绿的底色形成鲜明对比。秋天呈现出温暖的橙色。它长得不是很快，很少超过3m的高度。可耐受低至-27°。

descriptions.preferred: 这是一款以其卓越品质获得皇家园艺学会颁发的花园优异奖(RHS)的品种，最早记录可追溯到1882年出版的《械品便览》。 和Acer Japonicum 'Aconitifolium'—爱看德妃为异名同木的品种。具有迷人的叶子和令人惊叹的秋季色彩。叶片呈掌状，7-11深裂叶。春天嫩叶覆盖有白色线毛呈现鲜绿色，夏天深绿，这个品种最令人着迷的特征就是在秋季叶片会呈现出鲜艳的猩红色和略带紫色的胭脂红色调，而且这种色彩会在叶片上存在很长时间。成年树高2.5米-3米。

rhs.description: A large bushy deciduous shrub or small tree. Leaves rounded, with 7-11 deeply cut main lobes, turning crimson in autumn. Flowers red, hanging beneath the shoots in spring

attributes.suggested_uses: Architectural, Low Maintenance

care.cultivation: Grow in a moist but well-drained soil. Water in summer if necessary. Leaf colour is best in partial shade, although full sun can be tolerated. Leaf scorch can be caused by lack of soil moisture or excessive exposure
care.pruning: Pruning group 1
care.propagation: Propagate by grafting or softwood cuttings

resistance.pest: May be susceptible to Acer gall mite, aphids , caterpillars and horse chestnut scale
resistance.disease: May be susceptible to Verticillium wilt , Acer leaf scorch and honey fungus

descriptions.preferred: Imported from Japan, this cultivar is an interesting addition to the 'Butterfly' group of variegated palmatums. The leaves are similar in shape to 'Butterfly' but slightly larger with broader lobes. The variegation is light cream to yellow on medium green to dark gray green and ocusually more or less straight, at least when five lobed. The lobes are ovate, 7-10 mm wide, with tapered tips, and divided up to three-quarter of the way to the leaf base. The margins are distinctly and regularly double toothed. On vigorous juvenile shoots the leaves are larger, up to 6 cm long and 7 cm wide, more regularly palmate and without variegation. The slender petioles vary from 1 to 4.5 cm long. This plant forms a compact densely branched small tree, more or less as wide as tall. If the soil is too fertile, 'Mai mori' loses its variegation, as do several other variegates.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 该品种自日本引入，是斑叶掌状枫 ‘Butterfly’ 类群中颇具特色的一个补充品种。叶形与 ‘Butterfly’ 相似，但略大，裂片更宽。斑锦为浅奶油色至黄色，分布在中绿色至深灰绿色底色上；叶片在五裂时通常大体较为平直。裂片卵形，宽 7-10 毫米，先端渐尖，自叶基向上分裂达约四分之三。叶缘具明显而规则的重锯齿。生长旺盛的幼年枝条上，叶片更大，可达长 6 厘米、宽 7 厘米，掌状更规则，且不具斑锦。细长叶柄长 1-4.5 厘米。植株形成紧凑、分枝密集的小乔木，冠幅与株高大致相近。若土壤肥力过高，‘Mai mori’ 会像其他一些斑叶品种一样失去斑锦。

descriptions.preferred: The foliage of this interesting small cultivar is a yellowish green to a bright green. Fall colors are pleasing yellows of different intensities. The small to medium-sized leaves are five-lobed but decidedly non-uniform. Some lobes are narrow with deeply and irregularly toothed, even lobulate, margins. A few leaves are the typical palmate shape but with very deeply toothed margins. These extremes, plus all variations between, can occur on the same plant. The red leafstalks are short and stiff. 'Maiko' makes an upright shrub up to 10 ft. (3 m) tall. After vigorous early growth, it broadens as it matures. The name means "dancing doll."

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这一有趣的小型品种，叶色从黄绿色到鲜绿色不等。秋季呈现不同深浅层次的黄色，观赏效果佳。叶片小到中等，5 裂，但形态明显不整齐。有些裂片狭长，叶缘深且不规则具锯齿，甚至呈浅裂状；也有少数叶片接近典型掌状，但叶缘具极深锯齿。这些极端形态及其中间过渡类型，常可同时出现在同一株植株上。红色叶柄短而硬挺。'Maiko' 生长为直立灌木，高可达 10 英尺（3 米）。幼年生长较旺，成熟后逐渐开展。其名称意为“舞姬”或“舞动的人偶”。

products.description_text: Acer palmatum 'Maiko' Dwarf Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 In traditional Japanese culture, "maiko" were young apprentices to geisha girls. Their main jobs consisted of singing songs, performing dances, and serving drinks. Being this Japanese maple is extremely beautiful and dwarf in nature, this name is quite fitting. 'Maiko' forms a mid-size dwarf tree reaching 6-8ft in 15 years. In the early training of "maiko" they are taught to how to gracefully serve green tea. In the early spring, Acer palmatum 'Maiko' gracefully serves a spring display of bright green palmate leaves. Some leaves may appear non-uniform and twisted in habit, giving the appearance that the leaves are dancing. You will be dancing too when you see the amazing fall colors of yellow and orange. Choose this 'Maiko' Japanese maple to entertain you and all those who visit your garden. Limited Quantities Available !! descriptions.preferred: Acer platanoides 'Maltese Cross' Rare Norway Maple Zones 4-7 Acer platanoides ‘Maltese Cross’ is a broadleaf deciduous maple with green foliage and a rounded canopy, providing shade and seasonal interest. It thrives in full sun to dappled shade, tolerates drought once established, and adapts to a wide range of soils, including acidic, alkaline, clay, and well-drained types. This versatile tree is heat, humidity, pollution, and seaside/salt tolerant, making it suitable for urban and coastal landscapes. It attracts beneficial insects and birds, supports biodiversity, and is low-maintenance, reaching a 10 year height of 15-25 ft. Acer platanoides does not ship to CT, ME, MA, and NH. descriptions_zh.preferred: Acer platanoides 'Maltese Cross' 稀有挪威槭，适生区 4-7。Acer platanoides ‘Maltese Cross’ 是一款阔叶落叶槭树，具绿色叶片和圆整树冠，可提供遮荫并带来季节观赏性。适合全日照至疏荫环境，成树后具一定耐旱性，并能适应多种土壤类型，包括酸性土、碱性土、黏土及排水良好的土壤。该品种适应性强，耐热、耐湿、耐污染，也耐海滨环境和盐分，适用于城市及沿海景观。可吸引有益昆虫和鸟类，有助于提升生物多样性，且养护要求较低。10 年可长至 15-25 英尺。Acer platanoides 不配送至 CT、ME、MA 和 NH。数量有限。

descriptions.preferred: Describing the leaf of this cultivar is very difficult because no two leaves are alike. The translation of 'Mama' is "any which way" or "doing as one pleases." In today's vernacular this could mean "doing your own thing." The foliage does just this. The bright green leaves are classed as five lobed. There the uniformity stops. Some leaves have seven lobes, or as few as three lobes. The leaves have the following shapes: five long, narrow lobes separated entirely to the leaf base with margins irregularly toothed, and appearing wind-tattered; three broad lobes separated shallowly plus two lobes long, narrow, completely separated, and with very "tattered" margins. Other leaves have all these combinations or any variation conceivable. Each leaf is beautifulblendof yellow-orangecombinationsinthefall. This plant is usually well branched, even twiggy. Occasionally,strongshootsdevelop.Theplantmaturesat3-4 m as a tall bush form. It is still rather rare in nurseries.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这个品种的叶片极难描述，因为几乎没有两片叶是完全相同的。'Mama' 可译作“随意”或“任性而为”；用今天的话说，大致相当于“按自己的方式来”。它的叶片确实如此。鲜绿色叶通常归为 5 裂型，但一致性也仅止于此。有些叶为 7 裂，有些则仅 3 裂。叶形变化包括：5 条狭长裂片，完全分离至叶基，边缘不规则具齿，看起来仿佛被风撕裂；也有叶片为 3 个较宽的浅裂裂片，加上 2 个狭长裂片，后者完全分离且边缘极为“破碎”。其他叶片则可能呈现上述各种组合，或几乎任何可以想见的变异。每一片叶在秋季都呈现美丽的黄橙色混合色调。该品种通常分枝良好，甚至枝条细密成丛；偶尔也会抽生强旺枝。植株成熟后为高大灌木形，高约 3-4 米。在苗圃中仍相当少见。

descriptions.preferred: This desirable green dwarf is very like the popular 'Kiyohime' with similar growth habit, leaves, and coloring. It is considered by some references to be synonymous with 'Little Princess', a dwarf introduction attributed to the late Jim Russell at Castle Howard in Northumberland, England. The small palmatum-type leaves are a lovely light yellow green edged with pink orange when they first appear in the spring, becoming light to medium green with a darker bronze-red edging which sometimes persists through the summer. The color changes to orange red in the fall. The five-lobed leaves are 3.5-4 cm long and 4-4.5 cm wide. They are divided to about three-quarters of the way to the leaf base, with the lobes spread out like a star. Each lobe is ovate with a tail-like tip and with clearly double-serrated margins. The short, slender pink-red petioles are 1-1.5 cm long. This plant forms a small, round densely branched shrub, estimated to reach about 2 m tall and wide when fully grown. It is becoming popular in Europe and is readily available in the trade. Unfortunately, it has not yet been possible to trace its origins, or the true relationships, if any, between 'Chiyo hime', 'Kiyohime', 'Little Princess',and'Mapi-no-machihime'.Curiously,thename 'Chiyo hime' means "little princess."

rhs.description: A small, dense, compact, shrub-like tree to about 1.2m in height and spread. The leaves are light green, edged with red when young, turning orange and red in autumn

rhs_zh.description: 小型、致密、紧凑、近灌木状的小乔木，高和冠幅约 1.2 米。叶片浅绿色，幼叶边缘带红色，秋季转为橙色和红色。

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这一优良的绿色矮生品种与常见的 'Kiyohime' 十分相似，生长习性、叶形及叶色都接近。部分资料认为它与 'Little Princess' 为同物异名；后者是一种矮生品种，据称由英国诺森伯兰郡 Castle Howard 的已故 Jim Russell 引入。其小型 palmatum 型叶片在春季初展时呈优美的浅黄绿色，边缘带粉橙色，随后转为浅至中绿色，并具较深的古铜红色镶边，这种边色有时可持续整个夏季。秋季叶色转为橙红色。叶片 5 裂，长 3.5 至 4 厘米，宽 4 至 4.5 厘米，分裂深达叶基约四分之三，裂片呈星状展开。每个裂片为卵形，先端有尾状延伸，叶缘具清晰的重锯齿。粉红红色叶柄短而纤细，长 1 至 1.5 厘米。植株形成小型、圆整、分枝密集的灌木，估计完全成熟后高和冠幅均约 2 米。该品种在欧洲日益流行，苗木市场上也较易购得。遗憾的是，目前仍无法追溯其确切起源，也无法厘清 'Chiyo hime'、'Kiyohime'、'Little Princess' 与 'Mapi-no-machihime' 之间是否存在真实关系及其具体关系。值得一提的是，'Chiyo hime' 这一名称本身就有“小公主”之意。

descriptions.preferred: The new leaves on this cultivar show a bright pinkish or light orange coloration, shading from the margins toward the center of the lobes. The basic leaf color is pale green. It is made even lighter by the great profusion of extremely fine dots of white or cream which are sometimes so thick that they merge, forming almost a solid area. A translucent effect results from the very dense, fine stippling of the thin leaves. Fall colors range into yellows and light gold. Because it is not very vigorous, 'Marakumo' forms an upright bush of 3 m rather than a tree. It is somewhat tender and needs at least afternoon shade. It is not easily propagated. Although a very desirable variegated form, it is not widely known. The name has also been spelled 'Maragumo'.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 该品种的新叶呈鲜明的粉红色或浅橙色，自叶缘向裂片中央渐变，叶片底色为淡绿色。其上密布极细的白色或奶油色小点，使叶色显得更浅；这些斑点有时密集到彼此融合，几乎形成整片实色区域。由于薄叶表面具有极为致密细腻的点斑，整体会呈现一种半透明效果。秋色为黄色至浅金色。因生长势不强，‘Marakumo’ 通常形成直立灌木，高约 3 米，而非乔木。其抗性略弱，至少需要下午遮阴。该品种不易繁殖。虽然是非常优良的斑叶类型，但流通并不广。其名称也曾写作 ‘Maragumo’。

descriptions.preferred: This purple-red cultivar is considered an improvement on 'Bloodgood', and similar in leaf and growth to 'Fireglow' but not as outstanding. It has slightly larger leaves than 'Fireglow' with the lower ends of each lobe narrower, like the neck of a bottle. The large fiveor sevenlobed widespreading bright purple-red leaves are deeply divided three-quarters of the way to the leaf base. They measure up to 8-9 cm long and 9-12 cm wide. The broadly ovate lobes with long slender pointed tips are 2-2.5 cm wide in the middle but narrow markedly to 0.5-1 cm at the lobe junctions. The slender purple petioles are 2.5-5 cm long. This plant forms a narrow, upright tree, eventually attaining a height of 5-6 m. It is sometimes found in catalogs as 'Margaret B'. Corvallis deeply, almost to the leaf base. They vary from 5 to 7 cm long and from 5 to 9 cm wide. Each lobe is elongateovate with the tip extended to a very sharp point. The margins are prominently double toothed. The new foliage is crimson when first appearing, occasionally showing strong pink tones. These colors lessen, but the reddish shades persist along the margins into late spring. The mature leaves are a basic green color but are often so heavily marked as to appear almost Corvallis makes a tall shrub 4 m high. The name of this cultivar is sometimes misspelled 'Musa kagami'.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这一紫红叶品种通常被认为是对 ‘Bloodgood’ 的改良，在叶形和生长习性上与 ‘Fireglow’ 相似，但表现不及后者突出。其叶片比 ‘Fireglow’ 略大，每个裂片基部较窄，形似瓶颈。大型五裂或七裂叶开展，色泽鲜亮紫红，深裂至接近叶基四分之三处。叶片长可达 8-9 厘米，宽 9-12 厘米。裂片宽卵形，先端细长尖锐，中部宽 2-2.5 厘米，但在裂片连接处会明显收窄至 0.5-1 厘米。细长的紫色叶柄长 2.5-5 厘米。植株形成狭窄直立的乔木，最终可高达 5-6 米。有时在目录中也见作 ‘Margaret B’。后半段原文存在明显 OCR 混乱，内容大意应为另一品种描述：叶片深裂，几乎达叶基，长 5-7 厘米、宽 5-9 厘米；各裂片为长卵形，先端延伸成极尖锐的尖头，叶缘具显著重锯齿。新叶初展时呈深红色，偶尔带强烈粉色调，随后色泽减淡，但至晚春叶缘仍保留红色。成熟叶以绿色为底，但常有密集斑纹，以至几乎呈现另一种综合色效果。植株可形成高约 4 米的大型灌木。该品种名有时误拼为 ‘Musa kagami’。
