descriptions.preferred: The leaves are a bright shiny green, with a dominant long, bluntly tipped central lobe and short blunt side lobes in the outer third of the leaf. Fall color is a brilliant orange-red. This hardy cultivar forms an upright, round-topped small tree up to 30 ft. (9 m) tall.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 叶片鲜亮有光泽的绿色，中裂片明显较长，先端钝，外侧三分之一处具短而钝的侧裂片。秋色为明艳的橙红色。该品种耐寒性好，生长为直立、圆头状小乔木，高可达 30 英尺（9 米）。

descriptions.preferred: One of the most interesting of the subtly variegated maples, 'Masu kagami' has large leaves with five to seven lobes that are separated openly and deeply. Each lobe is elongate-ovate with the tip extended to a very sharp point. The margins are prominently toothed. Early spring foliage is crimson, occasionally showing strong pink tones. These colors lessen, but the reddish shades persist along the margins into late spring. The summer leaves are green but often so heavily marked as to appear almost whitish green. The extremely fine dots of white and yellow often merge to form more solid areas of light color. This cultivar does best with light shade protection. It is a hardy, mediumgrowing plant which eventually makes a tall shrub 13 ft. (4 m) high.

rhs.description: A deciduous maple about 2-3m tall with variegated foliage. The sharply pointed, 5 to 7-lobed leaves, 5 to 7cm long, open crimson or strong pink in spring, maturing to green but heavily marked and stippled with white and yellow, some leaf areas appearing one solid colour, then turning pinkish red in autumn .

rhs_zh.description: 落叶槭树，株高约 2-3 米，叶具斑锦。叶片先端锐尖，5 至 7 裂，长 5-7 厘米，春季初展时呈深红色或浓粉色，后转为绿色，但密布白色和黄色斑驳及细点，部分叶面区域看起来近乎整块实色，秋季转为粉红红色。

descriptions_zh.preferred: 在细腻斑锦类槭树中，'Masu kagami' 是最有趣的品种之一。其叶片较大，具五至七裂，裂片分离开张且较深。每个裂片呈长卵形，先端延伸成极尖的尖头，叶缘具明显锯齿。早春叶色为深红色，偶尔带有明显粉红调。随后这些颜色会减淡，但至晚春叶缘仍保留红色调。夏季叶片转绿，但常因白色与黄色极细密的斑点而显得近乎灰白绿色，这些细点常融合成较完整的浅色斑块。该品种在有轻度遮阴保护的环境下表现最佳。植株耐寒，生长势中等，最终形成高大灌木，高约 13 英尺（4 米）。

products.title: Acer palmatum 'Masu kagami' Rare Japanese Maple
products.description_text: Acer palmatum 'Masu kagami' Rare Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 'Masu kagami' leafs out in the spring as a bright salmon to pink-red. The leaves of this Japanese maple are tightly layered on the branching creating a very full look. By early summer it fades chartreuse green before the secondary flush of new growth returns as a pink-red. Fall colors are bright crimsons to rich scarlets. This Japanese maple selection can reach 12 ft in height in 20 years. The name 'Masu kagami' translates as "mirror of the drinking glass". Limited Quantities Available !! As we have over a thousand cultivars of Japanese maples, we often do not have many of each cultivar. We recommend that you buy the Japanese maples you want immediately as we often sell out of certain selections.

descriptions.preferred: This very intense red cultivar shows best when in full sun. The red does not have the green undertone of many similar cultivars, but shades more toward purple. The color is difficult to describe adequately. When grown close to similar cultivars, its unique color is apparent. In full shade, the leaves have almost a black-red tone with deep green shading in the center of the lobes. The petioles and veins are also bright red. The leaf has seven lobes separating two-thirds of the way to the leaf base. The leaf is 5-7 cm long and 6-8 cm wide. Each lobe is ovate-acuminate but with an elongated tip. The margins are double serrated. The petioles are 1-2 cm long. This vigorous upright plant grows to about 7 m high eventually. The name is sometimes misspelled 'Matsumurae saki' and 'Musa murasaki'.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这个红色极为浓烈的栽培品种，在全日照条件下表现最佳。它的红色不像许多相似品种那样带绿色底调，而是更偏向紫色。这种色彩很难准确描述；若与近似品种并植，其独特色泽便十分明显。全阴环境下，叶片几乎呈黑红色，裂片中央带深绿色阴影。叶柄和叶脉也为鲜红色。叶片具七裂，裂深达叶基约三分之二。叶长 5-7 厘米，宽 6-8 厘米。各裂片为渐尖卵形，但先端更为延长。叶缘为重锯齿。叶柄长 1-2 厘米。该品种生长健旺、株形直立，最终可长至约 7 米高。其名称有时被误写为 'Matsumurae saki' 或 'Musa murasaki'。

products.description_text: Acer palmatum 'Masu murasaki' Bright Red 'Masu murasaki' Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 'Masu murasaki' leafs out as a bright red Japanese maple from years of old. 'Masu murasaki' is an old Japanese literature dating back to 1704. During the summer 'Masu murasaki' matures to almost black- purple red. 'Masu murasaki' shows best color in full sun. 'Masu murasaki' turns to a bright fiery red in the fall. 'Masu murasaki' may reach about 20 ft in height in 15 years. Limited Quantities Available !! descriptions.preferred: This variegate is one of the older cultivars and a very satisfactory landscape plant. Basic leaf color is a deep green, almost a bluish green. The variegation is of several types —fukurin fu (along the edges of the lobes), fukurin kuzure (irregular), or hoso fukurin (shallow margins). The markings are white or cream, but in the spring are overlaid or blended with a deep rose. The colors lessen somewhat in the late summer, but the fall intensifies the deep rose color in all the variegated areas. The leaves are very irregular, each leaf being slightly different from the next. They are basically five lobed and 3-4 cm long, with a spread across the lobes of 4 cm. The long, narrow lobes are separated about three-quarters of the way to the leaf base, slightly wider halfway to the apex, and terminating in a slender point. Each lobe is 5-10 mm at its widest point. The lobes are sometimes sickle shaped, especially where there is heavy variegation. Occasionally, individual lobes are broad, almost elongate-ovate. The edges are deeply and non-uniformly notched, toothed, or a combination of the two forms. of color in 'Matsugae'. It is a little more open and less twiggy than 'Butterfly'. 'Matsugae' grows up to 3-4 m tall.Itisahardyplant,cantakefullsun,andrespondswell to shaping. The name 'Matsugae' means "pine branch." This cultivar has also been known under the names 'Albo-marginatum', 'Argenteo-marginatum', and 'Fichtenast'.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这一斑叶类型是较早的老品种之一，也是非常令人满意的园林景观植物。叶片底色为深绿，近乎蓝绿色。斑锦有数种类型，包括 fukurin fu（沿裂片边缘）、fukurin kuzure（不规则斑锦）或 hoso fukurin（窄边斑）。斑纹为白色或乳白色，但春季会覆上或混入深玫红色。到夏末，这些颜色会略有减弱，但秋季会使所有斑锦部位的深玫红色更加鲜明。叶片极不规则，几乎每一片都略有不同。基本为五裂，叶长 3-4 厘米，横向展开约 4 厘米。狭长裂片分裂约达叶基的四分之三处，在通往先端的中部略宽，末端收为纤细尖端。每个裂片最宽处为 5-10 毫米。裂片有时呈镰刀形，尤其在斑锦较重时更明显。偶尔单个裂片会较宽，近长卵形。叶缘深裂且不均匀，具缺刻、锯齿，或两者兼有。'Matsugae' 的色彩更为浓郁。其株形比 'Butterfly' 略为疏朗，枝条也不那么密集。'Matsugae' 高可达 3-4 米。该品种耐寒，可耐全日照，并且对整形修剪反应良好。'Matsugae' 一名意为“松枝”。该品种也曾以 'Albo-marginatum'、'Argenteo-marginatum' 和 'Fichtenast' 之名流通。

products.name: Acer palmatum 'Matsugae' Variegated Japanese Maple
products.description_text: We find 'Matsugae' to be a very dependable variegated cultivar in the southeast. In spring it opens with cream and rose markings along its irregular shaped medium green leaves. In summer the rose color fades away and the cream turns pure white leaving beautifully contrasting variegation all summer long. Red petioles also add to the overall appearance of 'Matsugae'. This is a very old cultivar with a name that means 'the pine branch' which is hard to understand for a variegated cultivar. This plant is similar to 'Kagiri nishiki' but is faster growing and has better variegation. Fall color is usually orange. 10 year size: Height: 8-10 Feet Width: 10-12 Feet

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这一深裂品种是极具观赏价值的园林树种。春叶色彩十分醒目，为铜红色至紫红色，鲜绿色叶脉增添了特殊的观赏效果。夏季叶色转为浓绿色，秋季再转为浓郁的洋红色和深红色。叶长 7-8 厘米，深裂，具 7 个细长、狭窄的椭圆状卵形裂片，裂片渐尖成长而纤细的尖端。各裂片往往彼此靠拢而非向外放射，因此整叶展开宽度仅 8-9 厘米。裂片在距叶基约 5 毫米处相连。叶缘具重锯齿。叶柄细长，长约 4-5 厘米。该品种生长势旺盛，在快速生长的幼株上，部分新梢可长 0.5-1 米，而老枝上的生长则短得多。‘Matsukaze’ 一名意为“松风”，是日本 12 至 13 世纪著名能剧之一的标题。由于其株型近似 dissectum 类型，且叶片极狭、深裂，‘Matsukaze’ 也曾以 ‘Dissectum Matsukaze’、‘Machi kaze’ 和 ‘Pendulum Matsukaze’ 等名称流通。其名称也曾被误拼为 ‘Matsukase’。

descriptions.preferred: This medium-sized tree has unusual foliage. The leaves emerge as a pale yellowish green, turning to a light, bright green as they mature. They do not form a flat plane as most forms do, but the lobes bend up or down slightly, or some lobes twist slightly. Some leaves hang down, some flat, some on edge, creating a foliage cover toothing between the notches. This shorter type of tree tends to grow rather broad and not strongly upright, reaching 3-4 m high. The total foliage appearance is rather feathery. Another name by which this cultivar has been known is 'Machiyou'. It has also been sold as 'Myoi' by mistake.

rhs.description: Small, broad, bushy tree, slow-growing to about 3m tall with slightly pendulous branches and feathery, leaves that hang, lay flat or twist - appearing slightly 'wind blown'. Leaves open yellow-green in spring, maturing to bright green, then turning orange and yellow in autumn. Inconspicuous hanging clusters of small, red-purple flowers in spring may be followed by winged purple fruits

rhs_zh.description: 小型、宽展、丛生状小乔木，生长缓慢，高约 3 米，枝条略下垂。叶片轻盈细致，可下垂、平展或轻微扭曲，整体呈现些许“被风吹拂”的效果。春季展叶为黄绿色，后转为鲜绿色，秋季变为橙色和黄色。春季开不显眼的小型红紫色花，成下垂簇状，随后可能结带翅的紫色翅果。

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这一中等大小的乔木具有不同寻常的叶姿。叶片初展时为淡黄绿色，成熟后转为浅亮绿色。与多数品种叶片形成较平展叶面的状态不同，本品种的裂片会略向上或向下弯曲，有些还会轻微扭转。有的叶片下垂，有的平展，有的侧立，从而形成层次丰富的叶幕效果。叶缘在裂刻之间具锯齿。该品种树形较矮，通常横向开展较宽，直立性不强，高约 3-4 米。整体叶幕外观较为轻盈、羽毛状。该品种也曾以 ‘Machiyou’ 为名流通，并曾被误作 ‘Myoi’ 出售。

products.description_text: Acer buergerianum ‘Michael Steinhardt’ is a golden trident maple with exceptional yellow color. This yellow color is brightest in the spring but holds very well throughout the summer. descriptions.preferred: The small rounded leaves are cupped at the attachment to the leaf- The basal lobes overlap and, with the upturn of the leaf, form a shallow cup. The red leafstalks are sturdy. Leaf color is dark green, becoming bright blends of reds and yellows in the fall. The growth seems less vigorous than that of the species, but the plant forms a small tree to 20 ft. (6 m) tall. It appears to be a sturdy and hardy form. The name means "small-leaved."

descriptions_zh.preferred: 小型圆叶在叶柄着生处呈杯状内凹。基部裂片彼此重叠，再加上叶片上翘，形成浅浅的杯状。红色叶柄结实有力。叶色为深绿，秋季转为鲜艳的红黄综合色。其长势似乎不如原种旺盛，但可形成一株高达 20 英尺（6 米）的小乔木。看起来是一个强健且耐寒的类型。其名称意为“小叶的”。

products.title: Acer shirasawanum 'Microphyllum' Full Moon Japanese Maple
products.description_text: Acer shirasawanum 'Microphyllum' Rare Full Moon Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 'Microphyllum' is a great selection of Acer shirasawanum that was introduced by Esveld Nursery from a clone in the Coimbre Botanic Garden in Portugal. The rounded foliage cups slightly upward, creating that classic full moon leaf shape. The dark green foliage turns to a nice shade yellow infused with orange in the fall. 'Microphyllum' may reach 6-8 ft in height in 10 years. This hardy, versatile maple is a great choice for any landscape, withstanding temperatures as low as -30°F. It will quickly become an integral part of your garden with its reliable and stunning seasonal colors. Limited Quantities Available!! As we have over a thousand cultivars of Japanese maples, we often do not have many of each cultivar. We recommend that you buy the Japanese maples you want immediately as we often sell out of certain selections.

descriptions.preferred: Kobayashi （ 1975 ）在仔细研究了芽鳞、叶片和枝干上的毛以及其他特征之后，认为它应该属于 Sieboldianum （小叶羽团扇）。叶子的轮廓是圆形的， 7-9 裂，叶裂深至叶基部的一半，叶边缘锯齿较为尖锐。新叶褶皱状，浅绿色和淡黄色边缘的短毛覆盖在整个叶面上。夏季的时候，叶片上的毛会消失，但 2-3cm 的叶柄上还覆盖着毛。秋季是金色的，也会带有深红色。平均叶子长 4-7cm ，宽 4-7cm ，但也会有较大的叶子。成年树高约 3-4 米。

products.name: Acer palmatum 'Mikawa Kaen' Dwarf Japanese Maple
products.description_text: Acer palmatum 'Mikawa kaen' is the Golden Mikawa Dwarf Japanese Maple Acer palmatum 'Mikawa kaen' is a dwarf Japanese maple that is a relative to the ever popular 'Mikawa yatsubusa'. 'Mikawa kaen' is slow growing with closely arranged leaves that create a wonderful stubby upright tree. The defining characteristic of 'Mikawa kaen' is the short inter nodal lengths and closely growing buds that create a stacked shingle like appearance of the leaves. 'Mikawa kaen' stays a little bit smaller than 'Mikawa yatsubusa' 'Mikawa kaen' has broad leaves that lay flat and close together. While the leaf shape and structure is quite similar to 'Mikawa yatsubusa', 'Mikawa kaen' has some differences in leaf color. The leaf color of this interested dwarf Japanese maple tree is gold to bronze in the spring. The leaves then change to green for most of the summer. 'Mikawa kaen' has incredible fall color ranging from orange to red. While it may be slow growing, 'Mikawa kaen' is still a hardy tree and can be grown in many different climates across the country. 'Mikawa kaen' can be comfortably grown in zones 5 through 9. 'Mikawa kaen' can be grown in full sun in some climates, but will prefer some afternoon shade in the hotter locations. 'Mikawa kaen' needs a little bit of morning sun at the minimum to produce the best spring colors. Examples of the current sizes are included in the pictures. descriptions.preferred: 由日本爱知县于 1990 年培育的品种，具体育种人不详， 非常独特的一款悬浮脉叶品种。外文资料显示为矮生品 种，但是浙江本地嫁接当年可达 1.5 米，并有明显冠幅， 生长较强健，春叶为黄绿色的基色调，叶边为淡红色， 特征叶有明显的绿色脉纹，粉红色的斑悬浮于绿色脉纹 两边，特征一般位于叶面中部区域，叶尖为常规色，偶 有整叶特征，随着季节推移，粉色逐渐变为奶白色，绿 色部分逐渐加深，秋季为橙色或者红色。可全日照度夏， 午后适当遮阴为佳，成年株可达 3 米左右高度。

products.title: Acer palmatum 'Mikawa nishiki' Variegated Japanese Maple
products.description_text: Acer palmatum 'Mikawa nishiki' Pink Reticulated Variegated Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 'Mikawa nishiki' is a special dwarf reticulated Japanese maple with bright red to deep maroon variegation with bright chartreuse green veins. 'Mikawa nishiki' has leaves that are long and shaped like that of 'Mikawa yatsubusa'. The spacing between the internodes is not as tight, but this tree does make an excellent dwarf reaching 5 ft in 10 years. Fall colors are oranges to reds. This style of variegation on 'Mikawa nishiki' does not revert but is conditional to the environment. Spring weather that is cold and keeps maples leafing out slowly produces the best variegated leaves. Protection from the hot afternoon sun is recommended for best color. Limited Quantities Available !! As we have over a thousand cultivars of Japanese maples, we often do not have many of each cultivar. We recommend that you buy the Japanese maples you want immediately as we often sell out of certain selections.

descriptions.preferred: The leaves, which overlap each other like shingles on a roof, are a light yel- YATSUBUSA' low-green in the spring and bunched up at the shoot tips, becoming a medium green in the summer. The outer leaves have very bright red tips on the fine red serrations of the margins. The leaves, slightly longer than those of other dwarf forms, have five to seven moderately deeply divided lobes. Each lobe is oblong-ovate, with a long, tapering pointed tip. The margins are finely toothed. The leaf base is straight or shallowly heart-shaped, with all the lobes pointing forward. The growth is multibranched, resulting in a very dense compact little plant. The name can be translated as "a small cluster of three rivers."

sources.title: 三河八房Acer Palmatum 'Mikawa Yatsubusa'
sources.description: 日系品种，源于位于太平洋沿岸日本本州岛的中部 位置的爱知县，最早始于 1972 年的 Sakata Shubyo 目 录中开始有记载。三河八房是非常经典的矮生品种， 枝叶繁密，树形奇特。是矢野非常推荐的经典盆栽 品种，在欧美几乎每家苗圃都有种植，春天为茶绿色， 夏季转为深绿色，秋季为橙红或者橙黄色。生长速 度较慢，可全日照耐热，夏季午后适当遮阴为佳， 成年树可达 3 米左右高度。

rhs.description: Compact, multi-branched, small tree, growing slowly to about 1-1.2m tall. Dense, tightly overlapping 5 or 7 lobed leaves give a bunched, layered effect. Leaves open pale yellow-green in spring, maturing to bright green, then turning orange, gold and red in autumn. Inconspicuous hanging clusters of small, green flowers are followed by red-flushed, winged seeds. Green bark adds winter colour

attributes.suggested_uses: City/Courtyard Gardens, Cottage/Informal Garden, Patio/Container Plants
attributes.hort_group_description: Acers in this dwarf group are compact and slow-growing, making them ideal for pots and containers

care.cultivation: Grow in moisture-retentive, well-drained soil in a sheltered position. Leaf colour is best in partial shade, although full sun can be tolerated if soil is reliably moist. Acer leaf scorch can be caused by lack of soil moisture or excessive exposure. Suits container cultivation but attention to watering is needed in dry spells during the growing season. Good for bonsai cultivation . See Japanese maple cultivation
care.pruning: Pruning group 1 from late autumn to midwinter only
care.propagation: Propagate by layering in autumn, grafting in late winter or softwood cuttings

resistance.pest: May be susceptible to Acer gall mite, aphids , caterpillars and horse chestnut scale
resistance.disease: May be susceptible to Verticillium wilt , Acer leaf scorch and honey fungus

descriptions_zh.preferred: 叶片彼此重叠，如屋顶瓦片一般，春季呈浅黄绿色，并簇生于枝梢顶部；夏季转为中绿色。外围叶片在细密的红色锯齿状叶缘上带有非常鲜亮的红色尖端。叶片较其他矮生型略长，具五至七个中等深裂的裂片。每个裂片呈长圆卵形，先端细长渐尖。叶缘细锯齿。叶基平直或浅心形，所有裂片都向前伸展。植株多分枝，因而形成极为致密紧凑的小型株丛。其名称可译为“三川小丛”。

attributes.suggested_uses: 城市/庭院花园、乡村/自然式花园、露台/容器栽培
attributes.hort_group_description: 这一矮生类群的 Acer 株形紧凑、生长缓慢，因此非常适合盆栽和容器栽培。

care.pruning: 修剪第 1 组：仅限在晚秋至仲冬期间进行。
care.propagation: 可于秋季行压条繁殖，于晚冬进行嫁接，或采用软枝扦插繁殖。
care.cultivation: 宜栽培于保水性好且排水良好的土壤中，并选择避风庇护的位置。叶色在半阴环境下表现最佳；若土壤湿度稳定，也可耐全日照。槭树叶焦常因土壤缺水或暴露过度所致。适合容器栽培，但生长季遇干旱时需特别注意浇水。亦适于制作盆景。另见 Japanese maple cultivation。

resistance.pest: 可能易受槭瘿螨、蚜虫、毛虫和七叶树介壳虫危害
resistance.disease: 可能易感黄萎病、槭叶焦枯病和蜜环菌病

rhs_zh.description: 紧凑、多分枝的小乔木，生长缓慢，株高约 1-1.2 米。致密且紧密重叠的五裂或七裂叶营造出簇生、层叠的效果。春季展叶时为淡黄绿色，成熟后转为鲜绿色，秋季再变为橙色、金色和红色。下垂成串的小型绿色花并不显眼，之后结出带红晕的翅果。绿色树皮也为冬季增添观赏性。

products.title: Acer palmatum 'Mikawa yatsubusa' Lollipop Dwarf Japanese Maple
products.description_text: Acer palmatum 'Mikawa yatsubusa' Lollipop Rare Grafted Dwarf Japanese Maple Tree Zones 5-9 Excellent for Bonsai 2015 Maple of the Year When we go visit nurseries, we often ask the nurserymen and women, "What is your favorite Japanese maple? 'Mikawa yatsubusa' is definitely the most popular answer. When the North American Branch of the Maple Society started the Maple of the Year Program, 'Mikawa yatsubusa' won the first award. 'Mikawa yatsubusa' is a tightly layering dwarf green Japanese maple. In the spring, the leaves are bright chartreuse green with a red sheath to the petiole. This makes this dwarf with a layering shingle-like habit extremely beautiful. 'Mikawa yatsubusa' is extremely slow growing and difficult to propagate. Fall color on 'Mikawa yatsubusa' is a bright fiery red in the fall color. 'Mikawa yatsubusa' may reach 4-5 ft in 15 years. 'Mikawa yatsubusa' is extremely heat tolerant and overall a very hardy tree. 'Mikawa yatsubusa' is great for container plants, small places in the garden, fairy gardens, and conifer troughs. We have an extremely old 'Mikawa yatsubusa' at my uncle's home at Hill Stone Arboretum which serves as one of our display gardens. It is one of the largest 'Mikawa yatsubusa' that I know of. 1 gallon high grafted ‘Mikawa yatsubusa’ create a lollipop effect , with a straight stalk and the same grafted dwarf starting at a higher point. Most of these lollipop style ‘Mikawa yatsubusa’ are grafted around 12 inches creating a unique way to have ‘Mikawa yatsubusa’ in your garden. The photos on this page without a MrMaple logo were taken by Talon Buchholz and cannot be used without expressed written consent from the owner. Limited Quantities Available !! care.propagation: 可于秋季行压条繁殖，于晚冬进行嫁接，或采用软枝扦插繁殖。
care.cultivation: 宜栽培于保水性好且排水良好的土壤中，选择避风庇护的位置。叶色在半阴环境下表现最佳；若土壤湿度稳定充足，也可耐全日照。土壤缺水或暴露过度易导致叶缘焦枯。适合容器栽培，但生长季遇干旱天气时需特别注意浇水。另见 Japanese maples cultivation。

resistance.pest: 可能易受槭瘿螨、蚜虫、毛虫和七叶树介壳虫危害
resistance.disease: 可能易感 Verticillium wilt、槭树叶灼病和蜜环菌。

rhs_zh.description: 直立、丛生的落叶灌木状小乔木，高约 3 米。叶片深裂，由细长裂片组成，春季初展时呈鲜粉色并带绿色叶脉，夏季转为淡绿色、叶脉较深，秋季则变为鲜橙色并保留绿色叶脉。春季开不显眼的小型紫红色花，下垂成簇，之后结带红晕的翅果。

descriptions.preferred: This semidwarf small-leaved palmatum arose from a chance seedling selected and named by Richard P. Wolff of Red Maple Nursery, Media, Pennsylvania. He originally named it 'Tiny Leaf' but years later changed it to 'Mini Mondo', meaning "small world." The change of name may be because there seems to be a quite different cultivar named 'Tiny Leaf' whose leaf shape is similar to that of 'Og| i nagashi'. The origins of this latter 'Tiny Leaf' have not yet been traced. The tiny green fiveor sevenlobed leaves, 2-3 cm long and wide, turn a deep red in the fall. The leaves are similar in shape and size to those of the dwarf 'Hanami nishiki'. However, it grows twice as tall, reaching 2 m high in 10 years, and forms a small compact but upright shrub. Archives, Corvallis olive-green by early summer and turn bronze green in late summer and early fall, with lighter green undersides. The fall color is orange yellow. The current shoots are covered in a gray bloom for most of the summer. The large sevenor nine-lobed leaves are 7-10 cm long and 7.5-11 cm wide. The lobes are deeply incised to more than two-thirds of the way to the leaf base, and are ovate with tail-like pointed tips. Each lobe is 5.5-6.5 cm long and 1.5-2 cm wide at the broadest point in the middle, narrowing slightly to almost 1 cm at the lobe junctions, 2-3 cm from the leaf base. The margins have conspicuous, sharply pointed, hooked teeth. The two small basal lobes are almost at right angles to the petiole. Each petiole is stiff and 3-4 cm long. This strong-growing upright cultivar reaches up to 8 m tall at maturity and about as wide. It was noticed in a group of seedlings at Firma C. Esveld, Boskoop, Netherlands, in the mid-1980s, and named after one of D. M. van Gelderen's granddaughters.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这个半矮生、小叶型的 Acer palmatum 源自一株偶然实生苗，由宾夕法尼亚州 Media 的 Red Maple Nursery 的 Richard P. Wolff 选育并命名。他最初将其命名为 'Tiny Leaf'，多年后改名为 'Mini Mondo'，意为“小世界”。改名可能是因为另有一个名为 'Tiny Leaf' 的不同品种，其叶形与 'Ogi nagashi' 较为相似，而这一后者的来源尚未查明。该品种叶片微小，为绿色，五至七裂，长宽约 2 至 3 厘米，秋季转深红色。叶形与矮生品种 'Hanami nishiki' 相似，但植株高度约为其两倍，10 年可长至 2 米，形成紧凑而直立的小型灌木。后文另混入了其他品种信息：叶片至初夏转橄榄绿，晚夏至初秋呈古铜绿色，叶背较浅；秋色为橙黄色。当年生枝夏季大部分时间覆有灰白色粉霜。叶大，七至九裂，长 7 至 10 厘米、宽 7.5 至 11 厘米；裂片深裂超过叶基的三分之二，呈卵形，先端具尾状尖头，叶缘具明显、尖锐且略呈钩状的锯齿。两枚基部小裂片与叶柄几近成直角。叶柄坚硬，长 3 至 4 厘米。该品种生长势强，姿态直立，成熟时高可达 8 米，冠幅近似。它于 1980 年代中期在荷兰 Boskoop 的 Firma C. Esveld 一批实生苗中被发现，并以 D. M. van Gelderen 的一位外孙女命名。

descriptions.preferred: The unusual, unmaple-like leaves are three-lobed and the long narrow central lobe has a sharply pointed tip and irregularly notched margins which tend to turn up to form a trough. The short stubby side lobes are near the base and radiate outwards from the leafstalk. The shiny rich green leaves turn brilliant scarlet and orange in the fall. This hardy cultivar forms a dense, rounded small shrub.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 其叶形不寻常，不似典型槭树叶，为三裂。中央裂片狭长，先端尖锐，叶缘具不规则缺刻，且常向上卷起形成槽状；两侧裂片短而粗钝，靠近叶基，并自叶柄处向两侧展开。叶片浓绿而有光泽，秋季转为鲜艳的猩红色与橙色。该品种耐寒，形成致密、圆整的小型灌木。

descriptions.preferred: Spring leaves are mid chocolate-brown with light green veining and covered with a soft pubescence. They become an unusual dark olive-green by early summer and then turn bronze-green. Fall color is orange-yellow. The current shoots are covered in a gray bloom. The large leaves have seven to nine deeply incised ovate lobes with tail-like pointed tips. The margins have conspicuous, sharply pointed, hooked teeth. This strong-growing upright cultivar reaches up to 26 ft. (8 m) tall and wide. It was named after a granddaughter of Dutch nurseryman D. M. van Gelderen.

sources.title: 墨特 Acer Shirasawanum 'Mirte'
sources.description: 由荷兰 Firma C. Esveld 苗圃的苗圃主 Cor Van Geldern 在偶然的机会下发现的，以苗圃主女儿的名字 Mirte Yasemin 命名。和 Acer Shirasawanum 'Yasemin' 叶诗敏一样，属于姐妹品种。 新芽为红色，并有白色绒毛，春叶为巧克力棕红色，并有黄绿色脉纹，叶大且圆，一般为 7-9 叶裂，小叶裂呈胖圆状，锯齿分布均匀，夏季变为橄榄绿色并带有荧光效果，光照及养护状态良好的情况下，夏季会有棕黄色的效果，秋天为黄色或者橘黄色。生长速度较快，夏季午后适当遮阴，成年株可达 5-6 米左右高度。

rhs.description: A tall, relatively fast-growing, deciduous maple about 6-8m in height, with large, deeply lobed leaves, emerging chocolate brown with light green veining and softly hairy, aging to dark olive then bronze green in summer, turning orange-yellow in autumn

attributes.suggested_uses: City/Courtyard Gardens, Cottage/Informal Garden
attributes.hort_group_description: Acers in this matsumurae group are deeply divided to around three quarters of the leaf with coarsely-toothed edges and narrow, pointed lobes

care.cultivation: Grow in any moisture-retentive, well-drained soil in a sheltered position. Leaf colour is best in partial shade, although full sun can be tolerated if soil is reliably moist. Leaf scorch can be caused by lack of soil moisture or excessive exposure. See Japanese maples cultivation
care.pruning: Pruning group 1 , only from late autumn to mid-winter
care.propagation: Propagate by softwood cuttings, layering or by grafting . Plants grown from seed are unlikely to come true, but may still be garden worthy

resistance.pest: May be susceptible to aphids and scale insects , including horse chestnut scale
resistance.disease: May be susceptible to Verticillium wilt , Acer leaf scorch and honey fungus

descriptions_zh.preferred: 春叶呈中等巧克力褐色，带浅绿色叶脉，表面覆盖柔和茸毛。至初夏转为少见的深橄榄绿色，随后又变为青铜绿色。秋色为橙黄色。当年新梢覆有灰白色蜡粉。大型叶片具七至九个深裂的卵形裂片，先端呈尾状尖。叶缘具显著、尖锐且略呈钩状的锯齿。该品种生长强健、株形直立，高和冠幅均可达 26 英尺（8 米）。其名称取自荷兰苗圃人 D. M. van Gelderen 的一位孙女。

attributes.suggested_uses: 城市或庭院花园、乡村风或自然式花园
attributes.hort_group_description: 此 matsumurae 组的槭树，叶片深裂约达叶片的四分之三，叶缘具粗齿，裂片狭长且先端尖。

care.cultivation: 宜栽于保水且排水良好的土壤中，并选择避风位置。半阴环境下叶色表现最佳；若土壤湿度稳定，也可耐全日照。土壤缺水或暴露过度都可能导致叶片焦边。参见 Japanese maples cultivation。
care.pruning: 修剪组 1，仅限晚秋至仲冬期间修剪。
care.propagation: 可通过嫩枝扦插、压条或嫁接繁殖。实生苗通常难以保持品种性状，但仍可能具有园艺观赏价值。

resistance.pest: 可能易受蚜虫和介壳虫侵害，包括七叶树介壳虫。
resistance.disease: 可能易感黄萎病、槭叶焦枯病和蜜环菌病

rhs_zh.description: 高大、长势相对较快的落叶槭树，高约 6-8 米。叶片大而深裂，初展时呈巧克力褐色，带浅绿色叶脉并覆有柔毛，随后转为深橄榄色，夏季呈古铜绿色，秋季转为橙黄色。

descriptions.preferred: Fall color is the outstanding feature of this cultivar which turns a crimson color flecked with gold or orange. The green leaf holds good color all summer and is pleasing in the garden landscape. The seven-lobed leaves are petioles are slender and about 3 cm long. This medium strong-growing plant becomes a wide, tall bush up to 4 m tall, rather than a strongly upright tree.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 秋色是该品种最突出的观赏特征，叶片会转为深红色，并点缀金色或橙色斑驳。绿色叶片整个夏季都能保持良好叶色，在园林景观中表现悦目。七裂叶片具细长叶柄，叶柄长约 3 厘米。这一中等偏强生长的品种最终会形成高可达 4 米、开展较宽的大型灌木，而非明显直立的乔木。

descriptions.preferred: Acer buergerianum 'Miyasama yatsubusa' Dwarf Trident Maple Zones 5-9 This 'Miyasama yatsubusa' dwarf trident leafs out with salmon to deep red foliage fading to green by mid-summer. The small, rounded leaves show this yatsubusa trident is actually the subspecies Acer buergerianum ssp. formosanum. It has a tight dense habit, almost 'Mikawa yatsubusa-like' in its tightly layered shingle-like appearance. The secondary flush of growth returns to the salmon to deep red but this time the leaves are smaller. 'Miyasama yatsubusa' turns to bright golden yellows infused with oranges. This fall color display on 'Miyasama yatsubusa' is prolonged compared to most Japanese maples, providing a display that lasts typically 2 weeks longer than most Japanese maples. In 15 years, this dwarf trident may reach 5-6 ft in height. The name 'Miyasama' translates as "Prince" and 'yatsubusa' translates as dwarf because of the presence this small maple can make in the landscape. Because of this miniature compact habit, the beauty of 'Miyasama yatsubusa', the smaller second flush of leaves, and its indeterminate growth rate, this maple is ideal for bonsai. 'Miyasama yatsubusa’ is a unique and hardy trident maple that also fits well in most landscapes bringing a beauty that is sure to grab your attention. Limited Quantities Available !! descriptions_zh.preferred: Acer buergerianum 'Miyasama yatsubusa' 矮生三角枫，适生区 5-9。‘Miyasama yatsubusa’ 春季萌叶时呈鲑红至深红色，至仲夏转为绿色。小而圆整的叶片显示，这个 yatsubusa 型三角枫实际上属于 Acer buergerianum ssp. formosanum。其株型紧密致密，层层叠叠，几乎有些类似 ‘Mikawa yatsubusa’ 那种瓦片状紧密排列的外观。第二次抽梢时，新叶会再次呈现鲑红至深红色，但此时叶片更小。‘Miyasama yatsubusa’ 秋季转为明亮的金黄色，并融入橙色调。与多数日本枫相比，其秋色持续时间更长，通常可多维持约 2 周。15 年后，这一矮生三角枫可达 5-6 英尺高。‘Miyasama’ 可译作“Prince”，而 ‘yatsubusa’ 则表示矮生，体现了这株小型枫树在景观中的存在感。由于其微型紧凑的习性、‘Miyasama yatsubusa’ 本身的美感、更小的第二次抽生叶片以及不定式生长特性，这个品种非常适合制作盆景。‘Miyasama yatsubusa’ 是一款独特且强健的三角枫，也很适合大多数园林配置，具备极强的观赏吸引力。数量有限！！由于我们拥有上千个日本枫品种，单个品种通常库存不多。建议您在看到心仪品种时及时购买，因为部分选育品种经常很快售罄。

descriptions.preferred: This very attractive addition to the 'Katsura' group of cultivars has colorful orange-yellow spring foliage. The leaves have a dark pink edging which merges into the orange-yellow background. The fiveor seven-lobed medium green leaves are fairly uniform in shape and color. They are characterized by the large coarse, almost sublobulate, triangular-pointed double teeth around the margins. Each leaf is divided up to three-quarters of the way to the leaf base, with the lobes well separated. The leaves measure 4.5-5.5 cm long 'Mizuho beni' is similar to 'Katsura' in leaf shape, size, and color, and in growth habit and vigor, except for the much more conspicuous serrations. However, the important difference is that it comes into leaf at the normal time, some two to three weeks after 'Katsura', and so is less likely to be damaged by early spring frosts and cold winds. This introduction has sometimes been misspelled 'Mitsuho beni'. Mizuho is a Japanese girl's name.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这是 ‘Katsura’ 类群中一个非常迷人的品种，春叶呈色彩鲜明的橙黄色。叶缘带深粉色镶边，并逐渐融入橙黄色底色中。五裂或七裂叶为中绿色，叶形与叶色相当整齐一致。其显著特征是叶缘具大型、粗重、近似浅裂状的三角尖头重锯齿。每片叶自叶基向上分裂达约四分之三，裂片彼此分离明显。叶片长 4.5-5.5 厘米。‘Mizuho beni’ 在叶形、大小、色彩以及生长习性和长势方面与 ‘Katsura’ 相似，但锯齿明显得多。不过，更重要的区别在于它萌叶时间正常，比 ‘Katsura’ 晚约两到三周，因此较不易受早春霜冻和寒风损伤。该引种名有时被误拼为 ‘Mitsuho beni’。Mizuho 是日本女性名字。

descriptions.preferred: other The leaves of this cultivar look very much like 'Hagoromo', but the lobes are not deeply incised. Also, 'Momenshide' is a smaller plant. The leaves have practically no petioles (only a few millimeters long) and are attached almost directly to the twig. They are five lobed, occasionally three lobed, and 3-5 cm long including 1-1.5 cm of bare "petiole-like" base. Each lobe is oblong-ovate, tapering to a blunt point. The lobe base tapers abruptly for the last 1 cm to the width of the main vein, so that it appears to have its own petiole. The lobes do not lie flat but twist slightly on different planes. Each lobe is from 1.5 to 2 cm wide at the broadest point but, with lobes overlapping, the leaves may appear to be only 4-5 cm wide. The entire effect is feathery foliage. The margins are only slightly toothed and irregular. The foliage is reddish in the spring, but soon changes to a deep, rich green. The veins are somewhat prominent and give a slight textured look to the surface. In the fall, the bright yellow colors add to the beauty of the garden. This cultivar assumes an upright bush shape and will probably not reach more than 3-4 m at maturity. It Corvallis is 'Yu\shide'.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 其他：该品种的叶片外观与 'Hagoromo' 非常相似，但裂片切入不深。另外，'Momenshide' 株型更小。叶片几乎无叶柄（仅数毫米长），几乎直接着生于枝条上。叶为五裂，偶有三裂，连同 1-1.5 厘米裸露的“似叶柄”基部在内，叶长 3-5 厘米。每一裂片为长椭圆状卵形，先端渐尖但较钝。裂片基部最后约 1 厘米处突然收窄至主脉宽度，因此看起来像各自带有小叶柄。各裂片并不平展，而是在不同平面上略有扭转。每裂片最宽处为 1.5-2 厘米，但由于裂片彼此重叠，整叶看起来可能仅宽 4-5 厘米。整体效果呈羽毛状叶姿。叶缘仅略具不规则浅齿。春季叶色带红，随后很快转为深而浓的绿色。叶脉略为隆起，使叶面略带质感。秋季明亮的黄色更增园中观赏性。该品种呈直立灌木状，成熟时可能不会超过 3-4 米。它在 Corvallis 记载为 'Yu\shide'。

sources.title: 粉色高野山Acer Palmatum 'Momoiro Koyasan'
sources.description: Momoiro在日语里是粉红色的意思，而Koyasan是位于日本和歌山县的高野山。由荷兰的Dick van der Maat选育并命名的，叶型小巧，椭圆形的叶片顶端较为尖锐，5叶裂，叶边缘有不规则锯齿，株型紧凑。整个生长季节如万花筒般变幻莫测，春天新叶呈鲜艳的桃色，迅速变为橙红色，然后是红色和粉红色；随着温度升高变成绿色，叶边缘会有青铜红色。秋天的颜色是鲜红色。成年树高大约2米。

rhs.description: Upright small, shrubby tree about 2m tall, with palmate, 5-7 lobed leaves, bright peach coloured when young, becoming orange-red gradually changing to bronze-green by late summer when some leaves have light variegation, then turning red in autumn. Inconspicuous red-purple flowers in spring may be followed by winged, red fruits

descriptions.preferred: This cultivar is another of the green-leaved forms of the Palmatum Group. The leaf color is a bright, pleasant green of lighter value. Early in the season it is a light yellow green with reddish hues, and sometimes the veins show a faint red. This soon changes to a solid green. The texture of the leaf is firm but not thick. Fall colors are brilliant orange reds. The leaf is an open palmate shape with five radiating lobes. Occasionally, the basal lobe produces a small spur lobe. The leaves are 7 cm long and spread about 8 cm. Each lobe is a smooth ovate form, tapering to an elongated tip. The lobes unite two-thirds of the way to the leaf base. The margins are very finely serrated. The stiff petioles are 2-3 cm long. This rather vigorous, hardy plant reaches a height of 5 m.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 该品种是 Palmatum Group 中另一类绿叶型品种。叶色为明亮悦目的浅绿色。生长季初期呈淡黄绿色并带红色调，叶脉有时也隐约带红，随后很快转为均匀的绿色。叶质较坚实，但不厚重。秋色为鲜艳的橙红色。叶片呈开张的掌状，具五枚向外放射的裂片，偶尔基部裂片会再生出一个小副裂片。叶长约 7 厘米，展开宽约 8 厘米。每一裂片为平滑的卵形，渐尖并延伸成细长尖端。裂片分离至距叶基约三分之二处。叶缘具极细的锯齿。叶柄挺硬，长 2-3 厘米。该品种长势较强，耐寒性好，株高可达 5 米。

products.description_text: Acer palmatum 'Mon zukushi' Rich Fall Color 'Mon zukushi' Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 'Mon zukushi’ leafs out in the spring with red tips on a green leaf. This quickly turns to bright vibrant green leaves for most of spring and summer. The summer flush on ‘Monzukushi’ may be more peach before transforming to the vibrant green. In autumn, ‘Mon zukushi’ turns to bright orange to red. ‘Mon zukushi’ may reach 8-10 ft in height in 10 years. ‘Mon zukushi’ is a cultivar that was listed in Japan as early as 1704 and its name translates as “one of the sacred treasures”. Plant this ancient treasure from Japan and it is sure not to dissapoint. Nearly everyone who gets this tree brags on it because it develops into such a nice tree with great colors. descriptions.preferred: 这一独特的变型由著名的育种家泰隆巴克霍茨培育，其叶片大小与寻常的白泽槭无异，但是其他方面却无一相同。其叶裂7-9裂，分裂位置低于叶片的一半，裂叶狭长呈三角状，叶尖向外延伸，叶缘内卷，长长的叶尖同样向右下方卷曲。此外位于中间的裂叶较短，表明这一品种一部分血缘来自女巫扫帚型枫树(wiches'-broom)。它的第三个特征是叶片、叶柄、枝条都是明亮的绿色。此外它所结的翅果也非常多。(有资料显示Mr.sun是白泽槭的金隐和鸡爪槭特朋宝的杂交后代。具体有待考证)

descriptions_zh.preferred: 梦化属于日系中较古老的品种，在市面上较少见，春叶为茶绿色，夏季转为深绿色并会出现黄色的晒斑，出现晒斑后要及时遮荫，秋季为黄色或橙红色。生长健壮，春日可全日照，夏季午后适当遮阴，成年株可达 2.5米左右高度。

descriptions.preferred: This cultivar is an outstanding red-leaved form in the Palmatum Group. The palmate leaves are usually seven lobed and divided almost three-quarters of the way to the leaf base. The leaf has a good texture and measures about 7 cm long and 8 cm wide. The ovate-elongate lobes are wide in the center and come to a strong point. The basal lobes are quite small. The edges are finely double serrated. The petioles are reddish and 2-3 cm long. The early spring color as the leaves unfold is almost crimson and soon becomes a very good, deep purple red. The leaf veins are also red and noticeable. Fall colors range into the good crimson shades. This upright cultivar is quite hardy and reaches about 6 m tall at maturity. It is valuable in the garden landscape because it retains the red colors well into late summer. The name probably means "a cluster of clouds." An alternative spelling of this cultivar is 'Murakumo'. It has been misspelled 'Muraguma, 'Murakama', and 'Murakuma'.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 该品种是 Palmatum Group 中非常出色的红叶型。掌状叶通常 7 裂，裂片深达叶基近四分之三。叶质感良好，长约 7 厘米、宽约 8 厘米。裂片呈卵状长椭圆形，中部较宽，先端锐尖。基部裂片很小。叶缘具细密重锯齿。叶柄带红色，长 2 至 3 厘米。早春展叶时颜色近深红色，随后很快转为优良而浓郁的紫红色。叶脉亦为红色，较为显著。秋色为优美的深红色系。该品种株形直立，耐寒性较好，成熟时高约 6 米。其在园林中很有价值，因为红色叶色可良好保持至夏末。其名称大概意为“云丛”。该品种的另一种拼写为 'Murakumo'。也曾被误拼为 'Muraguma'、'Murakama' 和 'Murakuma'。

descriptions.preferred: As the name implies (murasaki means "purple" and hime means "dwarf"), this cultivar is a purple-leaved dwarf. It purple becomes green red inside the plant where the leaves are shaded. Color tones vary within the plant. This cultivar seems a little delicate and not vigorous. The name has been misspelled 'Murasaka hime'.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 顾名思义（murasaki 意为“紫色”，hime 意为“矮性”），该品种是一个紫叶矮生类型。植株内部受遮阴的叶片，紫色会转偏绿红色，因此同一株上的色调会有所变化。该品种看起来稍显娇弱，生长势也不强。其名称曾被误拼为 ‘Murasaka hime’。

descriptions.preferred: Another of the dwarf cultivars, this plant is most desirable but not widely known. The leaves are divided into five lobes which radiate openly from the center. The leaf base is almost truncate. Mature leaves measure 3-5 cm long and 4-5 cm wide. The leaves are often smaller than this, especially in container culture. Each lobe is ovatelanceolate, tapering to an elongated, sharp tip. The lobes separate three-quarters of the way to the leaf base. The center lobe is very prominent, especially in the new leaves where it is often dominant. The margins are toothed on the outer half of the length and smooth on the inner half. The new foliage is a very light yellow green but heavily marked around the margins with a broad area of bright purple red. This purple-red coloring is heaviest on the edges, shading gradually into the leaf blade. As the leaves mature, they become a solid green. Often there is a very light speckling of minute white markings Archives, Corvallis to be upright, reaching heights of 1 m as it gets older.

rhs.description: A spreading, dwarf shrub to 1.2m tall and 1.5m wide. Green-yellow leaves emerge in spring, tipped and edged with red, maturing to a glossy, dark green colour again with purple-red margins. Autumn leaf colours include yellow, orange and bronze. Small reddish-purple flowers in spring are followed by red, winged fruits

rhs_zh.description: 开展性的矮生灌木，高约 1.2 米，冠幅约 1.5 米。春季新叶黄绿色，叶尖和叶缘带红色，成熟后转为有光泽的深绿色，叶缘仍带紫红色。秋叶颜色包括黄色、橙色和青铜色。春季开小型红紫色花，随后结红色翅果。

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这也是一个矮生品种，观赏价值很高，但并不广为人知。叶片分为五裂，自中心开张放射。叶基近截形。成熟叶长 3-5 厘米，宽 4-5 厘米；在容器栽培条件下叶片往往更小。每一裂片为卵状披针形，渐尖并延伸成锐尖先端。裂片分离至距叶基约四分之三处。中央裂片非常突出，尤其在新叶上常更为明显。叶缘外半部具齿，内半部平滑。新叶呈非常浅的黄绿色，但叶缘周围重度着生一圈鲜亮的紫红色宽边。这种紫红色在边缘最浓，逐渐向叶片内部过渡。叶片成熟后转为纯绿色。叶面常可见极淡的细小白色斑点。Archives, Corvallis 记载其株型为直立，随株龄增长可达约 1 米高。

descriptions.preferred: The leaves of this cultivar are deeply divided into seven lobes which are narrow, elongate-lanceolate, and taper to a long, slender point. Leaf size is about 4-5 cm long and 5-6 cm wide. The lobes separate almost to the leaf base and radiate sharply outward. The edges of each lobe are slightly curved up or trough shaped and prominently double serrated. The reddish petioles are 2-3 cm long. The basic leaf color is light green. Margins of new leaves are tinted with a bright brick red. In the fall, yellow to crimson blends appear. This medium-strong grower forms an upright plant up to 5 m tall. It is quite vigorous and hardy. One Japanese writer described the leaf shape as "like a crystal of snow" and unique. The little-known 'Mure hibari', which means "flock of skylarks," is indeed a beautiful cultivar.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 该品种的叶片深裂为 7 裂，裂片狭长，呈长披针形，先端渐尖成细长尖头。叶片约长 4-5 厘米、宽 5-6 厘米。裂片几乎分离至叶基，并明显向外放射展开。各裂片边缘略向上卷起或呈浅槽状，且具明显重锯齿。红色叶柄长 2-3 厘米。叶片基础色为浅绿色，新叶叶缘带鲜亮的砖红色。秋季叶色呈黄色至深红色的综合色彩。该品种长势中等偏强，树形直立，高可达 5 米，生长旺盛且耐寒性好。日本有作者将其叶形形容为“如雪之结晶”，十分独特。较少见的 'Mure hibari'，意为“云雀群”，确是一款优美的品种。

products.title: Acer palmatum 'Mure hibari' Japanese Maple
products.description_text: ACER PALMATUM 'MURE HIBARI' FLOCK OF SKYLARKS 'MURE HIBARI' JAPANESE MAPLE ZONES 5-9 'Mure hibari' is an old cultivar of Japanese maple listing in Japanese literature as early as 1882. The leaves are deeply cut for an upright tree with a strong growth habit. 'Mure hibari' leafs out in the spring with a red to bronze edging on the deeply cut green leaves. During the summer the leaves are green, turning to a bright red in the fall. 'Mure hibari' may reach 15 ft in 10 years. 'Mure hibari' is a fairly heat tolerant selection handling full sun easily in Zone 8. 'Mure hibari' is sometimes spelled 'Mure hibare'. Our 'Mure hibari' was grafted off a tree that was imported in from Kobayashi Momiji En in Japan in December of 1976. 'Mure hibari' translates as "flock of skylarks". Limited Quantities Available !! As we have over a thousand cultivars of Japanese maples, we often do not have many of each cultivar. We recommend that you buy Japanese maples you want immediately as we often sell out of certain selections.

descriptions.preferred: This strong cultivar brings a lot of color to the garden landscape. The spring and early summer coloration is a striking orange red, which shades from light to dark Corvallis with a spread of 10 cm. The lobes are long-ovate, tapering to a slender point, and divided two-thirds of the way to the leaf base. The edges have a definite double serration which is sometimes a little deep. The green petioles are long, slender, and about 4 cm long. 'Muro gawa' is hardy and a fairly vigorous grower but not totally upright. With age, the side branches become somewhat pendulous and the top slows its rate of growth. The mature tree is round-topped with pendulous outer branches. Old trees grow to 6 m tall and, if not trimmed, spread to 3-4 m.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这个强健品种能为庭园带来丰富色彩。春季至初夏，叶色为醒目的橙红色，与绿色叶脉形成鲜明对比。随着季节推进，色调转为锈绿色，至夏末则变为深古铜绿色。秋色为橙红至深红。叶片较大、中度深裂，具 7 至 9 裂，裂片长卵形，各裂片先端渐尖成细尖，叶缘具锯齿。绿色叶柄细长。'Muro gawa' 耐寒且长势较强，成年后树冠顶部圆整，外围枝条下垂，高可达 20 英尺（6 米），冠幅 10-13 英尺（3-4 米）。其名称源自日本中部的室生川。

products.description_text: In early spring the palmate leaves emerge pinkish red with green veins giving the entire round topped small tree a stately appearance. As spring progresses the leaves change from that pink cast to bright red, then orange red all the time putting on a show. In cooler climates the colors last well into the summer before eventually turning first bronze and then green this happens quite early if you live in a hotter climate. In fall the show begins again with wonderful shades of red, orange and sometimes even yellow. The name comes from the Muro river in Japan. 10 Tear size: Height: 8-10 Feet Width: 8-10 Feet

This is a fast growing upright maple with older specimens reaching 25 feet or more becoming more round topped with age. Fall brings on special appreciation as Musashino takes on a life of it on with brilliant cherry red color. 10 Year Size: Height 10-12 Feet Width 6-8 Feet

descriptions.preferred: Acer oliverianum x 'Mystic Jewel' HEAT TOLERANT JAPANESE MAPLE Zones 7-9 (untested) PPAF This selection is marketed in Europe under the species Acer palmatum, but it is clearly a hybrid. We believe ‘Mystic Jewel’ to be Acer oliverianum. 'Mystic Jewel' leafs out in the spring with a special mystical hue. This color can be a purple to red-purple. Yellows to olive green come into the center of the leaf, creating a nice contrast. By mid-summer the leaves mature to a nice darker green. New growth during the summer is a coral pink. In autumn ‘Mystic Jewel’ turns to yellow highlighted with orange. ‘Mystic Jewel’ is a fast grower at a young age reaching 12-14 ft in height in 10 years. The zone hardiness of ‘Mystic Jewel’ has not been tested. We believe it will do well in Zones 7-9, but this is an educated guess as this selection is brand new to the US market. This Japanese maple is renowned for its striking contrast of colors that show off its unique beauty throughout all four seasons, making it the ideal choice for any landscape.

descriptions.preferred: The leaves are divided into seven, or sometimes five, lobes which separate two-thirds to three-quarters of the way to the leaf base. When young, they are very deeply divided, filling out as they develop. They measure 5-7 cm long and about 8 cm wide. The lobes are ovate and terminate in a long, narrow sharp point. The basal lobes point outward, forming a truncate base to the leaf. The margins are finely double toothed. The petioles are about 2 cm long. This cultivar reaches 4 m tall at maturity and becomes nearly as wide, growing as a tall, spreading bush. The spring foliage opens with a crimson color which soon changes to purplish red. In early summer, as the green tones begin to develop, the veins turn a contrasting green. By midsummer the entire leaf is greenish. This tree is bright crimson in the fall. It is believed to be named after the Nanase River, the location of which remains a mystery. Corvallis the palmate-type leaves are described as first unfolding with a light green color. As the leaves mature, a faint creamy white shading or variegation appears. This upright-growing plant is not fast growing. It tends to form a round-headed tree or shrub up to 3 m high. 'Naruo nishiki' has been misspelled 'Narvo nishiki'.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 叶片分为七裂，偶有五裂，裂片分离至距叶基约三分之二至四分之三处。幼叶时裂得很深，随着叶片发育会逐渐展开丰满。叶长 5-7 厘米，宽约 8 厘米。裂片为卵形，先端延伸成细长锐尖。基部裂片向外伸展，使叶基呈截形。叶缘具细密的重锯齿。叶柄长约 2 厘米。该品种成熟时高可达 4 米，冠幅也几乎相当，生长成高大而开展的灌木状。春季新叶展开时为深红色，随后很快转为紫红色。初夏开始出现绿色调时，叶脉会转为对比鲜明的绿色。至仲夏，整叶趋于绿化。秋季则转为鲜艳的深红色。据认为其名称源于 Nanase River，但其具体所在仍不明确。Corvallis 记载其掌状叶初展时为浅绿色，叶片成熟后会出现淡淡的乳白色晕染或斑锦。该品种生长直立，但速度不快，倾向形成圆头状小乔木或灌木，高可达 3 米。'Naruo nishiki' 曾被误拼为 'Narvo nishiki'。

products.title: Acer palmatum 'Nanase gawa' Japanese Maple
products.description_text: Acer palmatum 'Nanase gawa' Exceptional Fall Color Semi-Pendulous Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 'Nanase gawa' is a classic Japanese maple fr om the Sekihin Binran list from the 1800's. This maple is extremely rare to find in the nursery trade, and even more rare to find correct. According to the book Japanese maples, and the original Japanese listing from the 1800's, this a green amoenum, however the book Japanese maples shows a photo of a red Japanese maple. This red Japanese maple got mixed up with 'Nanase gawa' in the nursery trade and is likely 'Muro gawa'. We are offering the correct green form as seen in the photos here. 'Nanase gawa' is green Japanese maple with finger like leaves and small stature with a semi-pendulous habit. New growth during the summer may be bronze-green. 'Nanase gawa' may reach 5-6 ft in height by 6-7 ft in width in 10 years. Fall color can range from yellow to orange. 'Nanase gawa' translates as "River of Seven Currents". My guess this relates to the semi-pendulous habit and different color changes this maple goes throughout the season. Limited Quantities Available !! As we have over a thousand cultivars of Japanese maples, we often do not have many of each cultivar. descriptions.preferred: The unusual leaves are divided into small long, narrow, sharply pointed lobes which are held like an upside-down T. The lobes have Acer untoothed rolled margins to almost form tubes. The upper leaf surface is a deep rich green and shallow the lower surface a soft gray-blue, so the rolledtoothed. up margins create a two-tone effect. Fall colors hornbeamlike are a rich gold and red. 'Naruto' forms a tall curious dense sturdy plant up to 13 ft. (4 m) tall. vein

descriptions_zh.preferred: 其不寻常的叶片分裂成细小而狭长、先端尖锐的裂片，展开姿态如倒置的 T 字。裂片叶缘无齿并向内卷曲，几乎形成管状。叶面上部为深浓绿色，叶背为柔和的灰蓝色，因此卷起的叶缘形成明显的双色效果。秋色为浓金色和红色。'Naruto' 形成高大而奇特、致密且强健的植株，高可达 13 英尺（4 米）。

descriptions.preferred: Acer palmatum 'Nebula' 'Nebula' Reticulated Variegated Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 'Nebula' is a brand new selection of reticulated Japanese maple with an extraordinary reticulated variegation to the leaves. This ghost-like Japanese maple has pink new growth that radiates with lime green, while also displaying the veins of the leaf in a very prominent way. The foliage turns to bright green with darker veins. Fall color is a bright red to maroon red. 'Nebula' is a brand new selection by our friends at Buchholz Nursery. 'Nebula' is expected to reach 8 ft in 10 years. Give 'Nebula' protection from the hot afternoon sun for best colors. descriptions.preferred: The best feature of this cultivar is its fall color. Spring foliage is a good red, slightly purplish. A deep, rich green color develops during the summer and is followed by the golden yellow to beautiful crimson of the fall. Theleavesaresevenlobedandvaryfrom6to8cmlong andfrom7to8cmwide.However,theleaf appearslonger because the middle three lobes are especially long and narrow. Each lobe is elongate-ovate with a fine point, and narrowed at the base. The lobes join together about 1 cm from the leaf base. The margins are double serrated with sharp points. The petioles are red and about 3 cm long. 'Nicholsonii' is a medium-strong grower that reaches 5mhighandwide,andbecomesmultibranched.FritzK. A. von Schwerin first described this fairly hardy cultivar in 1893. It has been known under the names 'Atrodissectum' and 'Digitatum Atropurpureum'. Corvallis cence on the very young leaves as they unfold. Late summer tones change into brown-green mixed with dull yellow or bronze. Fall colors come as bright reds and crimsons. The seven-lobed leaves range from 5 to 7 cm long and wide, although size is variable. The lobes are ovate-acuminate, ending with a sharp tip, and the margins are double serrated. The petioles are sturdy and about 3 cm long. This cultivar is a moderate grower and does not grow as large as 'Bloodgood'. It grows rapidly when young but later slows and thickens, reaching 4-5 m high at maturity.

rhs.description: Deciduous multi-branched, spreading tree to about 5m tall, with 7-lobed, long narrow, sharply serrated and pointed leaves, 6-8 cm long and wide, with purplish-red spring foliage becoming rich green in summer then golden yellow to crimson in autumn

attributes.hort_group_description: Acers in this matsumurae group are deeply divided to around three quarters of the leaf with coarsely-toothed edges and narrow, pointed lobes

care.cultivation: Grow in any moisture-retentive, well-drained soil in a sheltered position. Leaf colour is best in partial shade, although full sun can be tolerated if soil is reliably moist. Leaf scorch can be caused by lack of soil moisture or excessive exposure. See Japanese maples cultivation
care.pruning: Pruning group 1 from late autumn to midwinter only
care.propagation: Propagate by layering in autumn, grafting in late winter or softwood cuttings

resistance.pest: May be susceptible to Acer gall mite, aphids , caterpillars and horse chestnut scale
resistance.disease: May be susceptible to Verticillium wilt , Acer leaf scorch and honey fungus

attributes.hort_group_description: 此 matsumurae 组的槭树，叶片深裂约达叶片的四分之三，叶缘具粗齿，裂片狭长且先端尖。

care.cultivation: 宜栽于保水且排水良好的土壤中，并选择避风位置。半阴环境下叶色表现最佳；若土壤湿度稳定，也可耐全日照。土壤缺水或暴露过度都可能导致叶片焦边。参见 Japanese maples cultivation。
care.pruning: 修剪第 1 组：仅限在晚秋至仲冬期间进行。
care.propagation: 可于秋季行压条繁殖，于晚冬进行嫁接，或采用软枝扦插繁殖。

resistance.pest: 可能易受槭瘿螨、蚜虫、毛虫和七叶树介壳虫危害
resistance.disease: 可能易感黄萎病、槭叶焦枯病和蜜环菌病

rhs_zh.description: 落叶性、多分枝、开展型小乔木，高约 5 米；叶 7 裂，裂片细长狭窄，边缘具锐锯齿，先端尖，叶长宽均为 6-8 厘米。春季叶色紫红，夏季转为浓绿色，秋季变为金黄色至深红色。

descriptions_zh.preferred: 该品种最突出的特征是其秋色。春叶为良好的红色，略带紫调；夏季转为深浓绿色，随后在秋季呈现金黄色至艳丽的深红色。叶片具七裂，通常长 6-8 厘米、宽 7-8 厘米；不过由于中间三个裂片特别狭长，整体观感会显得更长。各裂片为长卵形，先端细尖，基部渐狭；裂片在距叶基约 1 厘米处相连。叶缘为尖锐的重锯齿。叶柄红色，长约 3 厘米。'Nicholsonii' 生长势中等偏强，可长至约 5 米高、5 米宽，并逐渐形成多分枝。Fritz K. A. von Schwerin 于 1893 年首次描述这一较为耐寒的品种。它也曾以 'Atrodissectum' 和 'Digitatum Atropurpureum' 之名流通。极嫩的新叶展开时表面可见一层蜡粉。至夏末，叶色转为褐绿色，夹杂暗黄色或青铜色调。秋色则为鲜红色至猩红色。叶片七裂，长宽多在 5-7 厘米之间，但大小变化较大。裂片为渐尖卵形，先端尖锐，叶缘为重锯齿。叶柄较粗壮，长约 3 厘米。该品种生长速度中等，成株体量不及 'Bloodgood'。幼年期生长较快，后期速度减缓并逐渐变得厚实，成熟时高约 4-5 米。

descriptions.preferred: The foliage is a rich purple-red to almost black-red. Young leaves have a characteristic fine silvery white pubescence . The leaf color becomes brown-green in late summer. Fall colors are bright red and crimson. The medium-sized leaves have seven ovate-acuminate lobes, each ending with a sharp tip, and with toothed margins. This cultivar grows rapidly when young, later slows down to reach 13-16 ft. (4-5 m) tall. The name means "black," referring to the leaf color.

attributes.hort_group_description: 此 amoenum 类群中的 Acer 品种具有大型掌状叶，叶缘具细锯齿。

descriptions_zh.preferred: 叶色为浓郁紫红至近黑红色。幼叶带有其特征性的细密银白色柔毛。至夏末，叶色转为褐绿色。秋季叶色鲜红至深红。中等大小的叶片具 7 个卵形渐尖裂片，各裂片先端锐尖，叶缘具锯齿。该品种幼年期生长较快，后期生长放缓，最终高达 13-16 英尺（4-5 米）。其名称意为“黑”，指其叶色。

descriptions.preferred: 最早于1980 年开始有记载的品种，春天叶色为深红色， 夏季进行遮阴处理后会适当返绿， 秋天会变成亮红色或者火红色。 成熟叶一般为 7 裂叶，叶裂中度分裂， 分裂到叶基部的三分之二 处，属于大红叶群。 枝干 纤细 ，叶型 细长独特，长势较慢 。

rhs_zh.description: 生长缓慢、株形紧凑、耐寒的落叶小乔木，高约 2.5 米。深裂叶春季萌发时鲜绿色，随后转为深紫红色，与绿色枝条形成对比，秋季最终转为橙色、黄色和红色。

descriptions.preferred: The pattern of variegation is very different from that found in other variegated cultivars. It is the hoshi fu (starlike) type. The deep green leaf is speckled and flecked with gold. In most cases the spots occur in varying amounts and concentrate along the margins. Some markings are tiny and separate, while others merge to form blotches. Occasionally, the variegation occupies almost the entire leaf. When they first unfold, the heavily variegated new leaves have an apricot color shading from the edges into the center. This tone soon fades into the clear gold color of the mature leaf. The palmate leaves have seven, or sometimes five, ovate-acuminate lobes, terminating in a long, slender Corvallis This upright-growing tall shrub or small tree matures up to 3 m high. The growth is vigorous at first but slows considerably after the first few years, and the plant begins to thicken and become twiggy. As with many variegated cultivars, 'Nishiki gasane' especially needs protection from hot afternoon sun to prevent severe burning of the gold variegations. The cultivar 'Sagara nishiki' is almost identical. The name 'Nishiki gasane' means "overlapping variegations." This cultivar has also been known as 'Saintpaulianum'.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 其斑锦类型与其他斑叶品种明显不同，属于 hoshi fu（星点状）类型。深绿色叶片上散布金色斑点和斑驳纹理。多数情况下，这些斑点数量不一，并集中于叶缘；有些斑纹细小而彼此分离，有些则相互融合形成大片斑块。偶尔斑锦几乎覆盖整片叶。新叶初展时，斑锦较重的叶片从叶缘向叶心带有杏色晕染，这种色调很快会褪去，转为成熟叶片上清晰的金色。掌状叶具 7 枚、有时 5 枚卵状渐尖裂片，先端延伸为细长尖尾。该品种为直立生长的高大灌木或小乔木，成熟后高可达 3 米。初期长势旺盛，但数年后生长会明显放缓，植株逐渐变得更为稠密且多细枝。与许多斑叶品种一样，'Nishiki gasane' 尤其需要避免午后烈日，以防金色斑锦发生严重焦枯。品种 'Sagara nishiki' 与其几乎相同。'Nishiki gasane' 的名称意为“重叠的斑锦”。该品种也曾以 'Saintpaulianum' 之名流通。

descriptions.preferred: The rough pinelike bark is the outstanding feature of this maple which is also known by the name 'Pine Bark Maple'. It has been likened to the bark of the Japanese black pine, Pinus thunbergii. The older the plant, the rougher the bark. It becomes quite corky with coarse, longitudinal, irregular creases in the thickened bark. This feature does not appear in young propagates but begins to develop in two to three years. In an old plant, the bark becomes very thick and convoluted. This rough bark is much more pronounced than in the cultivar 'Arakawa' (synonym 'Rough Bark Maple'). The normal palmate leaf usually has seven lobes. The two basal lobes are very small. The elongate-ovate lobes taper to a long point and separate two-thirds of the way to the leaf base. The margins are strongly toothed for a small leaf such as this which is 4-5 cm long and wide. The spring colors are light green edged with a light shading of red. Mature leaves assume a bright green color and turn to a strong yellow in the fall. This plant is upright but bushy and matures as a bushy tree up to 6 m tall. It has become popular in Japan for bonsai training and lends itself well to frequent pruning and shaping.

rhs_zh.description: 丛生、直立的落叶小乔木，高约 6 米，以其粗糙如松的树皮著称；树龄增长后，树皮增厚并呈栓皮状。掌状 7 裂叶长 4 至 5 厘米，春季萌发时浅绿色，边缘带淡淡红晕，夏季转为鲜绿色，秋季则变为浓黄色。

descriptions_zh.preferred: 本品种最突出的特征是粗糙如松树的树皮，因此也被称为 'Pine Bark Maple'。其树皮常被比作日本黑松 Pinus thunbergii 的树皮。植株越老，树皮越粗糙，逐渐变得非常栓皮化，厚实的树皮上形成粗大的纵向不规则裂纹。这一特征在幼年繁殖株上并不明显，通常在 2 至 3 年后开始形成。老株的树皮会变得很厚并呈扭曲状。其粗皮特征比品种 'Arakawa'（异名 'Rough Bark Maple'）更加显著。正常掌状叶通常 7 裂，其中基部两个裂片很小。长卵形裂片渐尖，分裂深达叶基约三分之二。对这样的小叶而言，叶缘锯齿相当明显，叶片长宽约 4 至 5 厘米。春叶浅绿色，边缘带淡红晕；成熟叶转为鲜绿色，秋季变为明亮的黄色。株形直立但较丛生，成熟后为丛生状小乔木，高可达 6 米。在日本已广泛用于盆景培养，且非常适合频繁修剪与整形。

products.name: Acer palmatum 'Nishiki gawa' Rough Bark Japanese Maple
products.description_text: Acer palmatum ‘Nishiki gawa’ is an upright growing Japanese maple with green leaves. The most remarkable thing about ‘Nishiki gawa’ is the rough, pine bark the tree develops with age. This is a very unique look compared to the majority of Japanese maples that have smooth bark. ‘Nishiki gawa’ has a vibrant orange fall color. 10 Year Size: Height: 10-12 feet Width: 6-8 feet

descriptions.preferred: The spring leaves unfold with a pinkish or orange-red tone which persists along the margins as the leaves mature and turn to light green. Fall color is an especially brilliant display of crimson to fire-red. The medium-sized leaves have five to seven moderately deeply divided long, slender, lanceolate lobes gradually tapering to sharp points. The margins are double-toothed. This upright maple with a spreading crown grows to a height of up to 16 ft. (5 m).

descriptions_zh.preferred: 春叶展开时带粉红色或橙红色调，随着叶片成熟并转为浅绿色，这种色泽仍会沿叶缘保留。秋色尤为出众，呈鲜艳的深红至火红色。中等大小的叶片具 5 至 7 枚中度较深分裂的细长披针形裂片，逐渐收尖成锐尖，叶缘为重锯齿。该品种为直立生长、树冠开展的槭树，高可达 16 英尺（5 米）。

products.description_text: Acer palmatum 'Nishiki yamato' is a fast growing Japanese maple that develops rough rough bark similar to a pine tree as it ages. 'Nishiki yamato' has bright green leaves in the spring that darken to a solid green in the summer. These leaves then turn to a bright orange to red in the fall. 'Nishiki yamato' is a very fast growing tree and develops its rough bark quicker than many other rough bark Japanese maples as well. 10 Year Size: Height: 8-10 feet Width: 4-6 feet

descriptions.preferred: 尼泽提是一款非常稀少的欧亚槭品种，非常的耐寒。春天的新叶是鲑鱼粉的底色夹杂着黄绿色，成熟叶是绿色混着奶油白的一个颜色，叶子非常独特，因为每一片的叶子花纹都不相同。夏季奶油白部分会变成一个浅黄绿色，需要及时遮阴，避免出现日灼现象。秋天的颜色是黄色和橙红色的。由法国 Makoy Nurseries 于 1887 年引入。

descriptions.preferred: This old deep purple-red cultivar is probably a selection from Acer palmatum f. atropurpureum. It is very similar to 'Musashino' in leaf size and color all through the growing season, including the light-colored pubescence on emerging leaves, and in the vigor, size, and habit of its growth. In the first edition of this book, 'Nomura' was treated as a synonym of 'Musashino'. In Maples of the World, 'Musashino' is treated as a synonym of 'Nomura'. However, the leaves of 'Nomura' seem to be mainly five lobed, not seven lobed, with slightly broader ovate, less deeply divided lobes. Several cultivars, such as 'Beni kagami' and 'Hiug\ a yama', are said to originate as seedlings of 'Nomura', and both 'Nomura' and 'Musashino' are 'Novum'. Photo University Archives, Corvallis matsumurae -red The notable feature of this cultivar is the fall coloration. The combinations of orange and red are very bright and pleasing. In the spring, the leaves unfold a bright red, suffused and shaded with green undertones. As the leaves mature, they become more bronze green. They have five or seven lobes, widely separated almost to the center, and measure 5-6 cm long and wide. The lobes are elongate-ovate with a tapering point. The margins are faintly serrated. The strong petioles are 4 cm long. A 25year-old tree in Oregon, which came from Henry Hohman, has reached 4 m high.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这个古老的深紫红叶品种很可能是从 Acer palmatum f. atropurpureum 中选出的一个类型。它在整个生长季的叶片大小与色泽上都与 'Musashino' 十分相似，包括新叶上较浅色的柔毛，以及生长势、植株大小和树形习性。在本书第一版中，'Nomura' 曾被作为 'Musashino' 的异名处理；而在《Maples of the World》中，'Musashino' 又被作为 'Nomura' 的异名处理。不过，'Nomura' 的叶片似乎主要为 5 裂而非 7 裂，裂片略宽，呈卵形，分裂程度也较浅。若干品种如 'Beni kagami' 和 'Hiuga yama'，据称都源自 'Nomura' 的实生苗，而 'Nomura' 与 'Musashino' 也都被列为 'Novum'。该品种的显著特征是秋色，橙色与红色的组合十分鲜艳悦目。春季叶片展开时为鲜红色，并带有绿色底色的晕染与阴影感；随着叶片成熟，逐渐转为偏古铜的绿色。叶片具 5 或 7 裂，裂片宽阔，几乎分离至叶片中央，叶长宽均约 5-6 厘米。裂片为长卵形，先端渐尖，叶缘具浅锯齿。粗壮叶柄长约 4 厘米。俄勒冈一株来自 Henry Hohman、树龄 25 年的植株，已长到 4 米高。

descriptions.preferred: This excellent purple cultivar, whose name means "wet heron," has leaves with five or seven lobes which radiate strongly outward. The leaves look like widely spreading fingers and measure 8-9 cm long and 9-12 cm wide. Each lobe is oblong-ovate, terminating in a long, slender tip. The lobes separate to within 1 cm of the leaf base. The foliage appears quite lacy. The bright red petioles are stiff and 2-3 cm long. The deep, rich black-purple-red tones are unusual. In spring and early summer they appear to have an opalescence, even a bluish overtone, in certain light. The leaves retain the dark purple-red tones into late summer, but occasionally become suffused with a slight, deep green mottling. The veins are a strong red at this time and a noticeable feature. The bark of the twigs and branches is a deep maroon color, but quite overshadowed with a grayish tone. There are fine whitish vertical striations Corvallis

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这一优良的紫叶品种，其名意为“湿鹭”，叶片具五裂或七裂，裂片强烈向外放射。叶片看起来如同张开的手指，长 8-9 厘米，宽 9-12 厘米。每一裂片为长椭圆状卵形，先端细长渐尖。裂片分离至距叶基约 1 厘米处。整体叶姿显得相当细致如 lace。鲜红色叶柄挺硬，长 2-3 厘米。其深沉浓厚的黑紫红色调非常独特。春季和初夏在某些光线下会显现出虹彩般的光泽，甚至带一点蓝色调。叶片至夏末仍能保持深紫红色，但偶尔会混入少量深绿色斑驳。此时叶脉呈鲜明红色，也十分醒目。嫩枝和枝条的树皮为深栗红色，但表面笼罩一层灰调，并具细微的白色纵向条纹。Corvallis 有相关记载。

descriptions.preferred: The vigorous long new shoots or "tentacles" of this attractive red dissectum arch outward and downward to give it the name 'Octopus'. The new leaves are pink red with a narrow greenish band down the middle of each lobe, becoming a darker plum red, then a coppery red with a greenish tinge along the midrib as the leaf develops in early summer. The color turns to a bright crimson-red in the fall. The deeply dissected medium-sized leaves vary from 7 to 8 cm long and from 8 to 11 cm broad. The lobes are 1-2 cm wide and are themselves deeply dissected and conspicuously toothed. The teeth have many sharppointed tips. The slender orange-red petioles are 1.5-3 cm long. Like most dissectums, this strong-growing plant grows into a broad dome with pendulous shoots and foliage, reaching about 2-5 m high and 3-3.5 m wide as it matures. However, because of the uneven growth of the current shoots, varying between 1 and almost 2 m long, the outer circumference is more irregular.

descriptions.preferred: New leaves are light yellow with a rose tint along the margins. Summer foliage is light green with indistinct subdued flecks of lighter green scattered over the leaves and occasional pale cream or white spots. Fall colors are yellow and deep gold. The mediumsized leaves have five ovate-acuminate moderately deeply separated lobes which radiate outward. Margins are toothed and feathery. This strong-growing small tree is delicate looking but hardy. It may reach 16 ft. (5 m) or more high. The name means "fan stream," possibly referring to the Kyoto festival in which members of the ruling class tossed beautiful fans into a stream which were then collected by commoners.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 新叶浅黄色，叶缘带玫瑰色晕染。夏季叶色为浅绿色，叶面散布不明显、较柔和的浅绿色斑点，偶见淡奶油色或白色斑。秋色为黄色至深金色。中等大小的叶片具 5 个卵形渐尖裂片，分裂中等偏深，向外放射展开。叶缘具锯齿并带羽毛状质感。该品种生长较强，为小乔木，外观秀雅但耐寒，高可达 5 米或更高。其名称意为“扇溪”，可能指京都的一项节庆活动：统治阶层成员将精美的扇子投向溪流，再由平民捞取。

descriptions.preferred: The color combination and leaf shape identify this interesting plant. Spring leaves are brick-red brushed over a deep green background, with contrasting light green midribs. Each leaf varies in intensity. In late summer, the leaves become a bronze-green. Fall colors are bright orange and crimson. Each mediumsized leaf is deeply divided into seven elongateelliptical lobes which gradually taper to narrow SARASA' - points. The lobe sides are curved upward, creating a shallow trough. This plant forms a tall shrub up to 23 ft. (7 m) tall and 10 ft. (3 m) wide. The name means "gold calico cloth." -

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这种有趣的植株可通过其叶形与叶色组合加以识别。春叶为砖红色，底色为深绿色，并带有对比鲜明的浅绿色中脉；每片叶的色彩强度略有差异。至夏末，叶片转为古铜绿色。秋色为鲜橙色与深红色。每片中等大小的叶片深裂为 7 个长椭圆形裂片，逐渐收尖成狭长尖端。裂片两侧向上弯曲，形成浅槽状。该品种形成高大灌木，高可达 7 米，宽约 3 米。其名称意为“金色印花布”。

descriptions.preferred: The brilliant display of rich orange and scarlet blends in the fall makes this a favorite medium-sized maple. Spring foliage is a light yellow-green, changing to green with a silvery overcast due to a covering of extremely fine hairs. The hairs disappear in midsummer. 'Ogura yama' is similar to 'Microphyllum' in appearance and leaf but is slower growing, reaching about 13 ft. (4 m) tall. It makes a sturdy, hardy plant. The name means "Mount Ogura."

descriptions_zh.preferred: 秋季丰富的橙色与猩红色交织出的绚丽色彩，使其成为备受喜爱的中型槭树。春叶浅黄绿色，随后转绿，并因覆盖极细茸毛而带有银灰色雾感；这些茸毛在盛夏时消失。'Ogura yama' 在外观和叶片上与 'Microphyllum' 相似，但生长较慢，高约 4 米。其植株健壮、耐寒。名称意为“Mount Ogura”。

products.description_text: Acer sieboldianum 'Ogurayama' Great Fall Color - Cold Tolerant Japanese Maple Zones 4b-9 Acer sieboldianum 'Ogurayama’ is an extremely cold tolerant Japanese maple that is a strong grower and has a great fall color. ’Ogurayama’ leafs out in the spring with medium-sizes olive green foliage that are heavily pubescent. The shape of the tree is upright, reaching 10-12 ft in height in 15 years. Fall color is fairly reliable and can range from yellow to orange to red. No matter which color, it is always incredible! ‘Ogurayama’ is sometimes listed as Acer shirasawanum or Acer japonicum, but we believe is Acer sieboldianum when you pay attention to many of the little details. Sometimes this tree is labeled ‘Ogure yama’. Limited Quantities Available !! As we have over a thousand cultivars of Japanese maples, we often do not have many of each cultivar. We recommend that you buy the Japanese maples you want immediately as we often sell out of certain selections.

descriptions.preferred: - 'Ojishi', meaning "male lion," is smaller and more compact than 'Mejishi', meaning "female lion," which is better known as the popular 'Shishigashira'. It has similar but larger, bright green, less crinkly leaves which turn a bright gold in the fall. The leaves are more closely arranged on the stem. The rate of growth is slow, making a very dwarf, multibranched, little shrub which grows up to 61⁄2 ft. (2 m) high.

Very good for Bonsai.

descriptions.preferred: This cultivar is one of the semidwarf tree forms with highly variegated foliage, resembling a smaller compact form of the better-known 'Butterfly'. The leaves are quite variable in shape and strongly variegated. The whitish or cream portions are often curved or smaller than the other lobes. Colors are white to cream on a base of powdery green. The new small leaves may have a tinge of pink on the edges. Often entire leaves of the newest growth are white or cream tones. Fall color appears as rose pink on the whitish areas. The leaf is basically five lobed, 4 cm long and 2.5-3 cm wide, with very thin petioles up to 2.5 cm long. The foliage is rather dense along the twigs. The tree or tall shrub grows in an upright manner, dense and twiggy. Twigs die out as the plant attains size, which is a self-pruning process. The branches are thin but not brittle. It is not a strong-growing plant or aggressive. It blends in nicely as a companion plant, since This very desirable cultivar has three outstanding features—odd-shaped leaves, sweeping upright growth habit, and beautiful gold fall color. The foliage is a rich green color. The fiveor sevenlobed leaves are 4-5 cm long and 3-4 cm wide. The lobes are separated at least two-thirds of the way to the leaf base and radiate stiffly outward. Each lobe is lanceolate and tapers to a sharp stiff point. The most noticeable feature is that the margins of each lobe roll upward, almost forming a tapering tube. It makes the leaf look as though it has five or seven round segments for lobes. The margins of the inrolled lobes are slightly and bluntly notched. The ends of each lobe bend inward and upward. The stiff pink red petioles are 3-4 cm long. The shoots are green. The shape of the tree is unusual—stiffly upright and vase shaped, not the round-headed or umbrella-form of so many other palmatums. It is sturdy, erect, and vigorous, and often reaches 8 m or more at maturity. In young plants, new growth can shoot up 1 m or more in a season. However, it readily fills in with multibranched small shoots which are only 5-6 cm long. It forms compact bunches of leaves and fine twigs. This quality adapts it to Corvallis den. This cultivar is very desirable for landscaping and is popular in the United States. While it can become a larger-sized plant with adequate space, it can also be kept confined to smaller plantings with pruning and shaping. It is unfortunate that some confusion has been created in the nursery trade by applying alternative names. This beautiful tree has been recorded since the early 1700s. As it was introduced into other countries, the Japanese name was not always used. The old taxonomic descriptions placed it as Acer palmatum subvar. crispum and included the Japanese name 'Okushimo'. Unfortunately, the names 'Crispum' and 'Crispa' were used indiscrimi- Corvallis plant, well known for its brilliant spring foliage color. 'Okushimo' has also been misspelled 'Okishima'.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 该品种属于半矮生树形、叶色高度斑锦的类型，外观类似更常见的 'Butterfly' 的较小而紧凑型。叶形变化较大，斑锦十分明显。白色或乳白色部分常呈弯曲状，或比其他裂片更小。叶色为粉绿色底上带白色至乳白色斑锦。新生小叶边缘可能带一点粉色，最新抽生的整片叶有时会呈白色或乳白色调。秋季时，白色区域会显现玫瑰粉色。叶片基本为五裂，长 4 厘米、宽 2.5 至 3 厘米，叶柄极细，长可达 2.5 厘米。枝条上的叶片着生较密。植株可长成小乔木或高大灌木，姿态直立，枝叶稠密且多细枝。随着植株长大，部分细枝会自然枯去，属于自我疏枝过程。枝条纤细但不脆弱。其生长势不强，也不具侵略性，作为陪衬植物很容易与其他植物协调搭配。 该优良品种另有三个突出的观赏特点：叶形奇特、向上舒展的直立树姿，以及美丽的金黄色秋色。叶色浓绿。叶片 5 或 7 裂，长 4 至 5 厘米，宽 3 至 4 厘米。裂片至少分离至接近叶基的三分之二处，并僵直地向外放射。每一裂片均为披针形，渐尖为硬挺锐尖。最显著的特征是每个裂片边缘都向上卷起，几乎形成渐尖的小管状，使叶片看起来像由 5 或 7 个圆筒状片段组成。内卷裂片的边缘具轻微而钝的缺刻，各裂片先端向内并向上弯曲。坚挺的粉红红色叶柄长 3 至 4 厘米；新梢为绿色。树形也十分特别，直立而呈花瓶状，不同于许多其他 Acer palmatum 常见的圆头形或伞形树冠。该品种健壮、直立且长势旺盛，成熟时常可达 8 米或以上。幼株每季新梢可抽长 1 米以上，但也容易形成大量仅 5 至 6 厘米长的多分枝短梢，从而形成紧凑的叶簇和细枝团。这一特性使其适于较致密的景观配置。该品种极适合园林栽植，在美国很受欢迎。若空间充足，它可长成较大型植株；也可通过修剪整形控制在较小规格。遗憾的是，苗圃贸易中曾因使用替代名称而造成一些混乱。此美丽品种自 18 世纪初即有记载。传入其他国家后，并不总是沿用日文名称。旧分类描述曾将其列为 Acer palmatum subvar. crispum，并纳入日文名 'Okushimo'。不幸的是，名称 'Crispum' 与 'Crispa' 曾被混用。'Okushimo' 也是著名的春季叶色鲜明品种，并曾被误拼为 'Okishima'。

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这种槭树最突出的羽状特征包括形态奇特的叶片、舒展而直立的树形，以及极为美丽的金色秋叶，某些时候几乎带有荧光感。夏季叶色为浓绿色。较小的叶片有 5 至 7 裂，裂片中度至较深分裂，并僵直地向外放射。每个裂片呈披针形，渐尖为类似 'Omato' 的尖锐硬质叶尖。耐人寻味的是，略带钝缺刻的裂缘向上卷起，几乎形成渐细的管状，裂片顶端也向上翘起。坚硬的叶柄呈粉红红色，新梢为绿色。这种挺直直立、花瓶状树形的树势强健，常可长到 26 英尺（8 米）或更高，适于园林种植，紧凑的株形也适合盆景。'Kurui jishi' 与 'Okushimo' 相似，但叶片和树形更小，仅高约 6 1/2 英尺（2 米）；其名称可解释为“狂狮”。 Group—green。类似 'Osakazuki'，其叶片较大。叶有 5 至 7 个宽卵形裂片，渐尖为锐尖，叶缘具明显锯齿。春叶可能略带橙红色，随后很快转为浓绿色，并且较耐日灼。秋色为浓红色。这是一种生长强健、树冠圆整的品种，可高达 26 英尺（8 米），冠幅几乎相当。其名称意为“大靶”，指其叶片。 'Omure yama' 属 Matsumurae Group—green。随着这一优良垂枝品种不断长高，其下垂枝条会愈发柔长，在外围形成如帘幕般的姿态。中等大小、深裂的叶片有 7 个细长裂片，裂缘深具锯齿。春叶为绿色，叶缘鲜橙色，很快转为整齐鲜亮的绿色。秋叶则呈壮观的金色与猩红色。幼株生长旺盛且较直立，随后逐渐显现下垂特性，并围绕长长的垂枝侧枝展开。树高可达 16 英尺（5 米），冠幅 13 至 16 英尺（4 至 5 米）。其名取自大牟礼山（Mount Omure）。 'Orange Dream' 属 Palmatum Group—green。该优美品种因其清新的春色叶而被选育。新叶呈深橙色，很快转为柠檬黄色，叶缘与叶尖带橙色晕染。'Orange Dream' 与常见的 'Katsura' 相似，但萌叶较晚，因此不易受早春低温侵害，而且其鲜黄叶色保持时间更长，夏季才缓慢转为浅绿色。秋色为黄至金黄。小至中型叶片中度深裂为 7 裂，裂片略宽于长，呈卵形，具短尾状尖端，边缘为粗锯齿。带红晕的叶柄较硬挺。该品种株形直立而繁密，最终可长至 10 至 13 英尺（3 至 4 米）高。与多数浅色叶品种一样，半阴环境下表现最佳。

products.title: Acer palmatum 'Okushimo' Japanese Maple
products.description_text: Acer palmatum 'Okushimo' Unique Okushimo Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 Okushimo is a very unusual upright green Japanese maple. This Japanese maple tree has a light green leaf and the edges curl upright creating a unique look. The growth habit is upright and forms a great vase shape that can be very useful in the landscape. The fall color ranges from yellow to deep orange. The tree is vigorous and grows well in sun or shade. Typically reaches 15–20 ft tall and about 10–15 ft wide in 10–15 years. The height can reach up to 20 ft over time and even at maturity retains the great narrow vase-like shape. The name ‘Okushimo’ means “salt and pepper”. This is a very old Japanese maple cultivar that is under used because people are not informed about it. The unusual leaf structure and great color make ‘Okushimo’ a very complimentary addition when planted next to other cultivars or used as focal point planting. Plant this Japanese maple in your landscape for that beautiful conversation piece all your garden visitors will be talking about. Limited Quantities Available !! As we have over a thousand cultivars of Japanese maples, we often do not have many of each cultivar. We recommend that you buy the Japanese maples you want immediately as we often sell out of certain selections.

descriptions.preferred: 草莓精灵， 按照音译名字为 ： 奥尔森的冰冻草莓，因其叶色为草莓色并有银白色的霜冻底色而得名， 所以也称为：糖霜草莓。由 美国的哈里 · 奥尔森选育命名并推广， 是 赤鸭立泽的种子培育而来 。 春叶为红色 或 粉色的草莓色调 ， 并 带 有紫红色的脉纹， 多晒会带有白色，出现白色需要遮阴，以免灼伤。 夏季以白色和绿色为主，但新叶 为粉红色 ，秋天的颜色变亮为红色和铁锈橙色。生长速度较慢，枝软，矮生，午后需要遮阴，成年株可达1.5 m 左右高度。 草莓精灵属于 精灵 系列 ，此系列还有以下品种点击查看

products.description_text: Harry Olsen discovered this selection as a seedling from Aka shigitatsu sawa. This is one of the brightest of the reticulated varieties. The pink colors in spring are unmatched but will become muted in summer especially in hot climates where it should be provided protection from afternoon sun. Fall color is orange. Deeply divided serrated leaves add to the appeal. The habit is upright and spreading. 10 year size: Height: 5-7 Feet Width: 4-6 Feet

descriptions.preferred: 'Omure yama' is an excellent example of the cascading or weeping type of cultivar. As the plant attains the height of a tall shrub or small tree, the pendulous branches become willowy and form a long curtain around the perimeter. This habit is not to be confused with the cascading form of the Dissectum Group which is always a low, spreading shrub. The leaf consists of seven long, slender lobes which are held closely together. It is 7-8 cm long and 7 cm across. The leaves tend to hang down, and the closed slender lobes emphasize the pendulous effect of the branches. The lobes are lanceolate or elongate-elliptic, tapering to a slender point. They separate almost to the leaf base. The lobes are less than 1 cm wide at the lobe junctions, which makes the leaf appear open near the base. The margins are deeply toothed with fine serrations between. The long, slender petioles are 5-6 cm long. The new, unfolding foliage has a bright orange cast to the leaf edges, but the leaves soon become a uniform brilliant green. Fall colors are quite spectacular gold and crimson combinations. Young plants are vigorous and upright. Later they show the true pendulous character. The long willowy cultivar has been known under the name 'Pendulum Omureyama'. The name has been misspelled 'Omara yama' and 'Omurayama'.

rhs_zh.description: 落叶小乔木，树姿下垂或呈瀑布状，高可达 8 米。下垂枝条形成如帘幕般的叶层；每片叶具 7 枚细长裂片，自然下悬。春季幼叶绿色，叶缘鲜橙色，夏季成熟为亮绿色，秋季转为金色与红色。春季开不显眼的红紫色小花，随后可能结有带翅的紫色翅果。

descriptions_zh.preferred: 'Omure yama' 是垂枝或下垂型品种中的优秀代表。随着植株长成高大灌木或小乔木，其下垂枝条会变得如柳枝般柔长，并在外围形成长长的帘幕状树形。这种习性不应与 Dissectum Group 的下垂型混淆，后者始终是低矮开展的灌木。叶片由 7 个细长裂片组成，彼此靠拢，叶长 7 至 8 厘米、宽约 7 厘米。叶片常自然下垂，而狭长且较为闭合的裂片进一步强化了枝条的垂枝效果。裂片呈披针形或长椭圆形，渐尖成细长尖端，分裂几乎达到叶基。裂片在连接处宽不足 1 厘米，因此叶基附近显得较为空开。叶缘具深锯齿，其间还有细密小锯齿。细长叶柄长 5 至 6 厘米。新叶展开时，叶缘带有鲜亮的橙色调，但很快转为均一而明亮的绿色。秋色极为出色，为金色与深红色的组合。幼株长势强健且较直立，之后才逐渐显现真正的下垂特性。这个枝条柔长下垂的品种也曾以 'Pendulum Omureyama' 之名流通。其名称还曾被误拼为 'Omara yama' 和 'Omurayama'。

products.description_text: Acer palmatum 'Omure yama' Exceptional Fall Color Semi-Pendulous Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 ‘Omure yama’ is a semi-pendulous upright green Japanese maple. This classic Japanese maple tree is known for its shape similar to that of a weeping cherry tree, without the invasive root system. Because of this habit, it is a favorite among gardeners and maple enthusiasts. The fall color ranges from a golden orange to red. ‘Omure yama’ is very unique in its shape for a Japanese maple and can reach 12 ft in height over time. The tree that is the main photo is in a patio container and is not the 1 gallon size. It is shown to show the overall shape of 'Omureyama'. Limited Quantities Available !! descriptions.preferred: This lovely cultivar, introduced in the late 1980s by the Fratelli Gilardelli Nursery, near Milan, Italy, is one of the growing band of palmatums selected for their refreshing spring-colored foliage. Its young leaves emerge a fresh orange, quickly becoming a lemon-yellow color with orange-tinged margins and tips. It is similar to the popular 'Katsura', but the leaves do not appear as early, so are less likely to be damaged by cold spells in early spring. Also, the leaves retain their bright yellow color for much longer, changing slowly to yellow green until late into the summer, often still with a slight reddish edging to the leaves. They become a bright yellow gold in the fall. The slender shoots are an attractive red to light green with only faint striations. The seven-lobed leaves are slightly broader than long, 4-7 cm long and 4.5-8 cm broad, and are divided twothirds to three-quarters of the way to the leaf base. The ovate lobes with short tail-like pointed tips are 3.5-5.5 cm long and 2-2.5 cm wide in the middle, narrowing of Oregon State University Archives, Corvallis years. It is estimated it will eventually reach 3-4 m at maturity. Like most cultivars with light-colored leaves, it is best in partial shade and should not be allowed to dry out as the leaves may shrivel. However, it has proven to be less susceptible to drought than 'Katsura', but seems more difficult to propagate.

rhs_zh.description: 中等大小、丛生状落叶灌木，高可达 3 米；叶色随季节变化，春季黄色，夏季带绿色，秋季橙黄色。树皮鲜绿色，夏季开红紫色花，之后可能结红色果实。

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这个优美的品种由意大利米兰附近的 Fratelli Gilardelli 苗圃于 20 世纪 80 年代后期引入，是近年一批因清新春叶色而被选育的 Acer palmatum 品种之一。其新叶萌发时呈清新的橙色，很快转为柠檬黄色，叶缘与叶尖带橙色晕染。它与广受欢迎的 'Katsura' 相似，但展叶不那么早，因此较不易遭受早春寒潮伤害。此外，其叶片鲜黄色保持时间更久，直到夏末仍缓慢转为黄绿色，叶缘往往还略带淡红色。秋季则转为明亮的金黄色。 细长的新梢颜色由悦目的红色到浅绿色不等，仅有淡淡的条纹。七裂叶略宽于长，长 4 至 7 厘米、宽 4.5 至 8 厘米，裂片分裂深度达叶基的约 2/3 至 3/4。卵形裂片具短尾状尖端，长 3.5 至 5.5 厘米，中部宽 2 至 2.5 厘米，向先端渐狭。估计成熟后株高可达 3 至 4 米。与大多数浅色叶品种一样，以半阴环境栽培最佳，且不宜失水干旱，否则叶片可能皱缩。不过，它已被证明比 'Katsura' 更耐旱一些，但繁殖似乎更困难。

products.description_text: Acer palmatum 'Orange Dream' Orange Dream Yellow Japanese Maple Tree Zones 5-9 'Orange Dream' is a beautiful Japanese maple with exceptional color. The leaves of 'Orange Dream' leaf out in the early spring with bright golden leaves that are outlined in bright orange red. This color contrast is striking. 'Orange Dream' is excellent as a focal point planting or when planted in combination with deep maroon Japanese maples. 'Orange Dream' can also be used to brighten dark spots in the garden. In hotter climates, we recommend giving 'Orange Dream' protection from the hot afternoon sun for best color. Fall colors are bright oranges to red. 'Orange Dream' is an Italian introduction from Gilardelli Nursery. 'Orange Dream' may reach 10 ft in 15 years becoming denser and more shrub-like with time. Limited Quantities Available !! rhs.description: 'Orangeola' is a mound-forming, deciduous shrub or small tree to around 3m tall. Its arching branches bear finely-cut leaves that emerge orange-red in spring, darkening to a reddish-green in summer before turning a brighter orange-red in autumn. Small red flowers may be followed by winged fruits in autumn

rhs_zh.description: 'Orangeola' 为丛生拱垂型落叶灌木或小乔木，高约 3 米。其弓形枝条着生细裂叶，春季展叶为橙红色，夏季加深为带红调的绿色，秋季再转为更鲜亮的橙红色。小型红花之后，秋季可能结翅果。

descriptions_zh.preferred: 'Orangeola' 以春季鲜亮的橙红色新叶而著称。叶片在整个夏季会转为浓郁的红绿色，但仍带有橙色晕染；盛夏还会再抽生一轮橙红色新叶，入秋前先变为深红，随后在秋季转成火焰般的橘红色。其大型叶片通常为 5 至 7 裂，深裂近基部，每个裂片又进一步深刻。红色叶柄短而纤细。虽生长势较强，但该品种在 Dissectum 类群中仍属较小型，完全成熟时高度仅略超过 10 英尺（3 米）。株形呈优美的垂枝堆丘状，通常高大于宽。 'Oregon Sunset' 属 Matsumurae Group，红叶品种。该品种叶姿优雅、色彩丰富，形成小型、整齐、紧凑的圆头灌木状树形，春秋叶色尤为出众。新叶柔和红色，很快转为李子红；秋季则变为鲜艳的晚霞红。叶片较大，通常深裂为 5 至 7 个狭长卵形裂片，每个裂片具细长尖端。叶缘具许多细密、尖狭的锯齿，裂片尖端略向下弯，如舒展下垂的手指。'Oregon Sunset' 很适合作为空间有限环境中的小型树木，无论用于小型园景还是容器栽培都很合适。 'Oridono nishiki' 属 Palmatum Group，斑叶品种。中等大小的叶片中度至较深裂，分成 5 至 7 个彼此分离的裂片；每个裂片具长尖端和具齿的叶缘。叶柄粉红且纤细。叶片底色为浓深绿色，且能维持到秋季。其斑锦色可呈鲜粉、白色、乳白色，或这些颜色的组合，形成大小不一的斑块；有时新叶甚至可全白或全粉。斑色较强的叶片部分有时会呈镰刀状。新梢常带粉色或粉色条纹，这是其区别于相似品种 'Asahi zuru' 的特征。其斑锦表现较许多斑叶槭品种更为稳定。'Oridono nishiki' 树势健壮，生长旺盛，15 至 20 年可形成高 16 至 20 英尺（5 至 6 米）的直立圆头小乔木，是该类群中较优秀的品种之一。其名称意为“师匠的锦织物”。 'Karasu gawa' 与 'Oridono nishiki' 相似，但浅亮粉色的新梢更为明显，且部分叶片在整个夏季的白色斑锦中仍保留粉色条纹。株形狭窄直立，随树龄增长逐渐开展，最终高度约 13 英尺（4 米）。该枫树生长势不强，宜种植于园中有遮护的位置，并避免强烈日照。其名称意为“乌鸦河”.

descriptions.preferred: 俄勒冈之翅是一款大叶羽团扇的羽毛枫品种，是由 JD VERTREES（编写了日本枫树第一版至第三版） 选育并注册的一个品种。 俄勒冈之翅色彩在春天属于嫩绿色，夏季深绿色，秋 季色彩会异常丰富，有黄色，橙黄色，橙红色，甚至 会出现紫色。俄勒冈之翅的叶子相对于绿色瀑布会更 厚实一点 看上去会更有质感。和一般的羽毛枫一样， 俄勒冈之翅的叶子叶裂极深，几乎到叶基部，叶子边 缘还会有大大小小的褶皱，结合三季色彩，具有极强 的观赏性。国外枫友甚至形容俄勒冈之翅像万花筒一 样五彩缤纷。这个品种的成年身高和冠幅大概在 2 米 左右，但其实冠幅可以靠自己拉伸，具有无限的可能 性。

descriptions.preferred: This cultivar has graceful and colorful red foliage and forms a small neat, compact, rounded bush, making it The elongate-ovate lobes have long, slender tail-like tips and are 12-15 mm wide at the broadest point in the middle, narrowing to 3-5 mm at the lobe junctions which are within 10 mm of the leaf base. The margins are regularlyserratedwithnumerousfinenarrow-pointedteeth. The short red petioles are 1-3.5 cm long. The lobe tips tend to curve downwards slightly like, as the Greer Gardens (Eugene, Oregon) catalog so aptly puts it, "a relaxed hand." 'Oregon Sunset' is a good small tree for limited space.

sources.title: 俄勒冈日落 Acer Palmatum 'Oregon Sunset'
sources.description: 俄勒冈日落具有 非常 出色的春季和秋季色彩 ，春天是 叶子呈柔和的红色，很快变成 紫 红色 。夏季会适当返绿， 到了秋天变成 日落光辉般的橙红橙黄色调 。 叶子中等大小，具有 5-7裂，叶边缘有锯齿。叶片呈 长卵状披针形 ，叶尖微微向下弯曲。生长紧凑、圆润，是盆景造型和小型花园的理想选择， 成年树高约2米。
