care.cultivation: Grow in moisture-retentive, well-drained, ideally slightly acidic soil, in a sheltered position with protection from drying winds. Thrives in part shade, though some sun is needed to develop the leaf colour; will tolerate full sun if soil is reliably moist. Mulch in spring, especially when grown in containers , to improve moisture retention. See Japanese maples cultivation

descriptions_zh.preferred: 该品种叶色红艳而富于变化，姿态优雅，可形成小型、整齐、紧凑、圆头状灌木，因此非常适合空间有限的种植环境。其裂片为狭长卵形，先端细长如尾，裂片中部最宽处为 12–15 mm，向下收窄，在距叶基 10 mm 以内的裂片连接处仅 3–5 mm 宽。叶缘规则锯齿状，具许多细而尖的齿。红色短叶柄长 1–3.5 cm。裂片先端常略向下弯曲，正如 Greer Gardens（俄勒冈州尤金）目录中贴切描述的那样，如同“放松的手”。‘Oregon Sunset’ 是适合小空间栽植的优良小乔木。

care.cultivation: 宜栽培于保水性好、排水良好、最好为微酸性的土壤中，种植位置应避风，并防止干燥风侵袭。半阴环境下生长最佳，但需要一定日照以促进叶色表现；若土壤湿度稳定，也可耐全日照。春季应覆盖 mulch，尤其是容器栽培时，可帮助保持土壤水分。另见 Japanese maples cultivation。
care.propagation: 可采用压条或嫁接繁殖。

products.title: Acer palmatum 'Oregon Sunset' Japanese Maple
products.description_text: Acer palmatum 'Oregon Sunset' Oregon Sunset Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 'Oregon Sunset' leafs out in the early spring with large rounded plum colored leaves and a growth habit with lots of lateral yet slightly upright branching. This forms a beautiful mid-sized spreading Japanese maple reaching about 7 ft in height by 10 ft wide in 20 years. This size and shape makes this Japanese maple an ideal Japanese maple for small garden spaces. Fall colors are the colors of a sunset, brilliant shades of orange & red. If you want an even smaller tree in height trim out the central leader at an early age creating a wide-spreading red Japanese maple with a large palmate leaf. Examples of this can be seen at the JC Raulston Arboretum at NC State. This gives a great alternative and provides a lot of color while not blocking vision elsewhere in the garden. For best growth, we recommend protection from the hot afternoon sun.

descriptions.preferred: This cultivar is one of the best variegates in the Palmatum Group. It is much better known in the United States as 'Orido nishiki' as it was spelled in the earlier editions of this book. However, the Japanese name of this outstanding cultivar consists of three characters—ori, dono, and nishiki—which mean "the rich-colored fabric of the master." It has also been misspelled 'Oridomo nishiki'. The leaves have five or seven lobes and are separated halfway to two-thirds of the way to the leaf base. The lobes radiate outward. The leaves measure 5-6 cm long and 6-8 cm wide. Very small leaves occasionally occur white, cream, or any combination of these, and may include various-sized areas of green. Sometimes new leaves are entirely white or pink. However, the main impression of spring growth is pink. Leaves coming from twigs and branches of older wood have white or cream markings which vary from a single spot to irregular flecks, small areas, blends, half lobes, or any combination in between. Leaf portions which are strongly variegated will curve or be sickle shaped. Many combinations of color occur on the same plant. The bark of new shoots is sometimes pink or pink-striped, which distinguishes it from the similar 'Asahi zuru'. This cultivar is more reliable and has far less non-variegated foliage than some other cultivars such as 'Versicolor'. 'Oridono nishiki' is sturdy and vigorous but does not become rangy. It becomes an upright, round-topped tree of 5-6 m in 15-20 years.

sources.description: “Orido Nishiki” has a basic leaf color of rich, deep, shiny green. The variegations are extremely diverse. rhs_zh.description: ‘Oridono-nishiki’ 为直立、紧密生长的斑叶灌木或小乔木，高可达 6 m。叶片深裂，颜色变化丰富，可为绿色、乳白色和粉色的混合，有时也会仅呈现其中一种颜色。秋季转为金黄色、橙色和红色。

care.cultivation: 宜栽培于湿润但排水良好的土壤中。夏季必要时应补充浇水。叶色在半阴环境下表现最佳，但也可耐全日照。土壤水分不足或暴晒过度都可能导致叶缘焦枯。参见日本枫树栽培资料。
care.pruning: 修剪组 1；如有必要，仅在深秋至仲冬期间修剪
care.propagation: 可采用嫁接、嫩枝扦插或压条繁殖

descriptions_zh.preferred: 该品种是 Palmatum Group 中最优秀的斑叶品种之一。在美国，它更常以本书早期版本中的拼法 ‘Orido nishiki’ 为人所知。然而，这个优良日本品种的名称由三个字组成，即 ori、dono 和 nishiki，意为“主人的华美锦缎”。它也曾被误拼为 ‘Oridomo nishiki’。叶片有 5 或 7 裂，裂深达叶基的 1/2 至 2/3，裂片向外放射展开。叶长 5–6 cm，宽 6–8 cm。偶尔会出现很小的叶片，颜色可为白色、乳白色，或两者任意组合，并可带有不同大小的绿色区域。有时新叶会完全呈白色或粉色，但春季新梢整体观感以粉色为主。从较老枝条和枝干上萌发的叶片，白色或乳白色斑纹变化丰富，可为单一点斑、不规则斑驳、小块斑、渐变混色、半裂片着色，或介于其间的各种组合。斑锦明显的叶片部分常会弯曲，或呈镰刀状。同一株植株上常可见多种色彩组合。新梢树皮有时呈粉色或带粉色条纹，这是其区别于相似品种 ‘Asahi zuru’ 的特征。该品种表现较稳定，不返绿的比例远低于某些其他品种，如 ‘Versicolor’。‘Oridono nishiki’ 健壮、生长势良好，但不会长得过于松散。15–20 年后可形成高 5–6 m 的直立圆头形小乔木。

descriptions.preferred: The spring foliage is an interesting red color; it is more of a bronze red when compared with other red dissectums, such as 'Crimson Queen', 'Dissectum Nigrum', or 'Inaba shidare'. The brilliant tone stands out well in the landscape. During late summer it turns greenish and assumes a prominent crimson-red color in the fall. The leaves are the typical dissectum combination of seven very long, thin lobes, each of which is divided into deeply dissected side lobes, and each side lobe is itself deeply toothed. The lobes are 6-7 cm long, but the total leaf spread is only 5-9 cm since many leaves do not spread widely as in 'Inaba shidare' and 'Palmatifidum'. The greenish petioles are 3-4 cm long. Very old plants may reach 3 m or more high, but create a mounded shape with a crown spread of 3-4 m. This very old cultivar from Europe has been popular because of the rather distinctive foliage color tone. However, as other selections of deeper tones were made, which retained their color better, its popularity waned somewhat. It still makes a good color contrast in the landscape and is hardy. It has been known under various names such as 'Aka washi-no-o' (in part), 'Amatum', crimson fall color. Some claim it has the most intense color of all the maples. In addition, it has relatively large palmate leaves and is a hardy, sturdy grower. It has been listed in catalogs since the mid-1800s. The seven-lobed leaves are usually about 9 cm long and 12-14 cm wide. On very vigorous young shoots the leaves may grow to 12-13 cm long and 17-18 cm wide. The large leaves do not make the tree coarse looking but instead lend an air of orderliness. Each lobe is broadly ovate, terminating in a narrow tip. The lobes are separated about halfway to the leaf base. The two small basal lobes cover the petiole. The margins are uniformly serrated. The petioles are sturdy and about 6 cm long. For most of the growing season the leaf color is a good rich green. The leaves do not burn easily and have a durable m high even in extreme old age. Since the leaves sometimes "cup" at the base, this cultivar is termed a "sakicup-like leaf," or 'Os| akazuki'. There are two ways to write the kanji form for this name. 'Taihai' is the other. Therefore, 'Taihai' is considered a synonym of 'Os| akazuki', but Cor van Gelderen has observed that whereas the whole crown of 'O|sakazuki' changes color suddenly in the fall, the crown of 'Taihai' changes in patches over a longer period. 'O|sakazuki' has also been spelled 'Oh sakazuki' and is sometimes called 'Septemlobum Osakazuki'. A companion cultivar, occasionally called a sister seedling, is 'Ichigyoj\ i'. It is just as intense a yellow or gold in the fall as 'O|sakazuki' is crimson. These two cultivars planted together make a brilliant fall display. bright colors as well as 'Bloodgood', 'Moonfire', and 'Nuresagi' do. It also tends to burn in hot sun. The fall color becomes a bright scarlet. The leaves are seven lobed and of a medium texture, and measure 7-8 cm long and 8-10 cm wide. The lobes are broadly ovate, terminating in a long, sharp point, and divided to about halfway to the leaf base. The margins are finely toothed. The petioles are red and 3-5 cm long. This sturdy upright-grower matures at 6-8 m high and has a spreading canopy. It is a good companion tree with other cultivars for color contrast. 'Oshio beni' has been popular in the United States for many decades. However, there may have been some dilution of this cultivar name. The name is very similar to 'O| syu\ beni', which has an entirely different leaf form and Oregon State University Archives, Corvallis 'O|sakazuki'. The most brilliant of all cultivars in fall coloradiate forward, with the leaf base almost truncate. Each lobe is elongate-ovate, almost lanceolate, and terminates in a slender, sharp tip. The margins are only faintly toothed, slightly more so toward the tip. The slender petioles are greenish and 3-4 cm long. The early foliage is a bright red, soon changing to a maroon red. In shade the foliage tends to be greenish. In midsummer the mature leaves become bronze or a green red. Fall color develops well and is a bright red. This cultivar forms a short, round-topped small tree of 3-4 m as it ages. It is hardy and not difficult to propagate. It is very different from 'Oshio beni'. Other spellings are 'Oshiu beni', 'Oshyu beni', and 'O| syu\ beni'.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 其春叶呈颇具特色的红色；与其他红叶裂叶品种如 'Crimson Queen'、'Dissectum Nigrum' 或 'Inaba shidare' 相比，更偏青铜红。这种明亮色调在园景中十分醒目。至夏末叶色转带绿色调，秋季则呈显著的深绯红色。叶片具典型裂叶型特征，由 7 个极狭长的裂片组成；每个裂片再分裂为深裂的侧裂片，而每个侧裂片本身又具深锯齿。主裂片长 6 至 7 厘米，但叶片总展开幅仅 5 至 9 厘米，因为许多叶片不像 'Inaba shidare' 和 'Palmatifidum' 那样充分开展。绿色叶柄长 3 至 4 厘米。极老植株可高达 3 米以上，但通常形成隆起状树冠，冠幅为 3 至 4 米。这个来自欧洲的古老品种曾因叶色调独特而广受欢迎；不过，随着更深色且保色性更好的选育品种出现，其受欢迎程度有所下降。它仍然能在园景中提供良好的色彩对比，且耐寒。它曾以多个名称流通，如 'Aka washi-no-o'（部分情况下）、'Amatum'。 'O|sakazuki' 以深红秋色著称，有人认为它拥有所有槭树中最强烈的秋色。此外，它具相对较大的掌状叶，且树势强健、耐寒，自 19 世纪中期起即见于苗圃目录。七裂叶通常长约 9 厘米、宽 12 至 14 厘米；在生长特别旺盛的幼枝上，叶片可达长 12 至 13 厘米、宽 17 至 18 厘米。大叶并不会使树形显得粗野，反而带来一种整齐感。每个裂片宽卵形，先端渐尖；裂片约分裂至叶基的一半。基部两枚小裂片覆盖叶柄。叶缘均匀具锯齿，叶柄坚实，长约 6 厘米。在大部分生长期内，叶色为良好的浓绿色，叶片不易焦边，质地耐久。即使树龄极大，植株高度也通常有限。由于叶片基部有时会呈“杯状”内卷，因此该品种被称作“sakicup-like leaf”，即 'O|sakazuki'。该名称的日文汉字写法有两种，'Taihai' 是其另一写法，因此常被视为 'O|sakazuki' 的同物异名；不过 Cor van Gelderen 观察到，'O|sakazuki' 的整株树冠会在秋季突然整体变色，而 'Taihai' 的树冠则会在较长时期内分片变色。'O|sakazuki' 也曾被拼作 'Oh sakazuki'，有时也称 'Septemlobum Osakazuki'。其伴生品种、偶尔被称为同批实生姊妹株的，是 'Ichigyoj\ i'；其秋叶黄或金黄色的强度，可与 'O|sakazuki' 的绯红秋色相匹敌。这两个品种搭配种植，可形成极其出色的秋景效果。 'Oshio beni' 的亮色表现不及 'Bloodgood'、'Moonfire' 和 'Nuresagi'，且在烈日下较易焦叶。其秋色会转为鲜亮猩红。叶片七裂，中等质地，长 7 至 8 厘米、宽 8 至 10 厘米。裂片宽卵形，先端长而尖，约分裂至叶基的一半；叶缘细锯齿。红色叶柄长 3 至 5 厘米。该品种生长强健、树形直立，成熟时高 6 至 8 米，树冠开展，适合作为与其他品种形成色彩对比的配置树。'Oshio beni' 在美国流行已数十年，但该品种名称可能曾发生一定混用。其名称与 'O| syu\ beni' 极为相似，而后者叶形完全不同。 'O| syu\ beni' 早期叶片向前辐射伸展，叶基近截形。每个裂片为狭长卵形，近披针形，先端细长锐尖。叶缘仅略具细齿，靠近顶端处稍明显。细长叶柄带绿色，长 3 至 4 厘米。初生叶鲜红，随后很快转为栗红；在阴处叶色趋于偏绿。盛夏时成熟叶转为古铜色或绿红色，秋色表现良好，呈鲜红色。该品种随树龄增长形成 3 至 4 米高的矮性圆头小乔木，耐寒且不难繁殖。它与 'Oshio beni' 明显不同。其他拼写形式包括 'Oshiu beni'、'Oshyu beni' 和 'O| syu\ beni'。

rhs_zh.description: 一种强健、直立生长的落叶枫树，高可达 6-8 米，树冠开展。叶片先端尖锐，7 裂，长可达 8 厘米、宽可达 10 厘米；春季新叶鲜橙红色，夏季渐褪为带红的绿色，秋季转为鲜亮猩红色。

descriptions_zh.preferred: 新梢生长初期呈橙红色，随后转为带古铜色，再变为红绿色。其鲜艳叶色保持性不如 Acer 'Bloodgood'、'Moonfire' 或 'Nuresagi'，且在炎热强光下容易出现叶灼。秋色为明亮的猩红色。较大的叶片有 7 个宽卵形裂片，裂片末端延伸为细长锐尖，分裂深度约达叶基的一半；叶缘具细锯齿。该品种生长健壮，树形直立，成熟时高 20 至 26 英尺（6 至 8 米），树冠开展。作为色彩对比树种很适合配置栽植。其名称意为“大红潮”。

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这一著名品种长期以来一直是日本的宠儿，可视为绿叶 'Omure yama' 的红叶对应品种。其叶形介于 Matsumurae Group 与 Dissectum Group 之间。春夏叶色为强烈的紫红色或栗紫红色，秋季转为鲜明的深红色。中等大小的叶片裂片放射状明显，几乎一直分裂至叶基。每个裂片均为狭长披针形，基部较窄，并渐尖成细长的先端，叶缘具细锯齿。这种迷人的小型圆头树具垂枝姿态，下垂枝条优雅地披垂至地面。成熟植株高与宽均可达 16 英尺（5 米）。 'Otohime' 属 Dwarf Group—green。这个强健的矮生品种，春季叶色为鲜亮活泼的黄绿色，叶缘与叶尖具狭窄红边，这种色彩可维持整个夏季。秋色为怡人的黄色至橙色。小叶具 5 个中度深裂的裂片，呈星状放射开展。每个裂片为卵状三角形，渐尖，叶缘均匀且细密具锯齿。叶柄细长。该灌木株形紧密致密，逐渐形成平顶状，宽大于高。10 年生植株几乎可达 28 英寸（70 厘米）高、4 英尺（1.3 米）宽。'Otohime' 很适合制作盆景，其名可能来自日本传说中统治海底王国的乙姬公主。 'Ōzakura' 属 Group—green。该小型致密树种在同一株上可产生两类极为鲜艳的春叶。较大的叶片着生于旺盛的新梢上，中度分裂为 5 至 7 裂，裂片向外放射，每个裂片呈卵形，具细长锐尖和浅锯齿叶缘。着生于老枝和较弱枝条上的小叶则裂片狭长，两侧几乎平行，叶缘浅缺刻。春叶色极为醒目，呈亮橙至粉红色，夏季转为栗色再带绿色调。该品种非常耐久且美观。其名意为“大樱”，指其春季色彩。 'Palmatifidum' 属 Group—green。大型浓绿色叶片具 7 个细长、深刻裂的裂片，几乎完全分裂至叶基。秋季叶色转为金黄与橙色，观赏效果十分出色。植株生长强健、耐寒，且枝条强烈下垂，形成优美的馒头状株形。植株常常宽大于高，可高达 10 英尺（3 米），宽超过 13 英尺（4 米）。其名称意为“掌状裂叶”。Acer palmatum。

Add these great characteristics to a growth habit that is slightly pendulous and mounding and you have a star in the garden. In spring leaves emerge cherry red then turn more brick red as late spring comes along and then olive green for summer. Fall color is a bright fiery red. 10 Year Size: Height 6-8 Feet Width 7-9 Feet

descriptions.preferred: The leaves have 9-13 lobes which are divided about halfway to the leaf base. Margins Acer maximowiczianum. are deeply toothed, giving a feather-edge appearance. The leaf surface is sometimes sparingly covered with fine, silvery hairs. Spring and summer colors are a deep, rich green, almost a bluegreen in partial shade. Fall color is outstanding with red, crimson, gold, and orange blends. This maple forms a small tree up to 13 ft. (4 m) tall. The name means "big waterfall."

descriptions.preferred: This strong dwarf cultivar has a vigorous and desirable nature. There is a fable about a queen named Otohime who reigned at the bottom of an ocean kingdom. This plant seems to be a queen of the Dwarf Group. The leaves emerge in the spring as a bright, lively yellow green with narrow reddish edging and tips, a color maintained through the summer. Fall colors are not particularly strong but a pleasant yellow through a range of orange tones. The leaves are of the typical five-lobed palmate type and small, mostly 3-5 cm long and wide. The lobes are separated two-thirds to three-quarters of the way to the leaf base, and radiate out in a star-shaped manner. Each lobe is ovate-triangular, broadest at the bottom, and tapers to a sharp point. The margins are uniformly and finely toothed. The long, thin petioles are about as long as the leaf. Internodes on the stem are fairly close together, making for dense foliage cover. This shrub is not rangy but tight and dense in habit, becoming much broader than high. A 10-year-old plant at Maplewood reached almost 0.7 m tall and 1.3 m wide, without pruning or shaping. It lends itself to bonsai work in an admirable fashion. The growth habit seems denser than that of the bonsai favorite 'Kiyohime'. In garden landscapes, the bush becomes rather flat-topped.

rhs_zh.description: 生长旺盛的落叶矮生槭树，最高约 1 米，株形致密，宽大于高。小型五裂叶长宽均可达 5 厘米，春季呈鲜亮黄绿色，叶缘和叶尖带红色，夏季可保持此色，秋季转为黄橙色调。

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这个强健的矮生品种生长势良好，园艺价值很高。传说中有一位名为 Otohime 的女王统治着海底王国，而这株植物似乎就是矮生组中的“女王”。春季新叶萌发时呈鲜亮活泼的黄绿色，叶缘和叶尖带有狭窄的红色镶边，这种颜色可一直保持到夏季。秋色虽不算特别强烈，但会呈现怡人的黄色并过渡到多种橙色调。 叶片为典型的五裂掌状叶，较小，多数长宽均为 3 至 5 厘米。裂片分裂深度约达叶基的 2/3 至 3/4，并呈星状向外放射。每个裂片为卵状三角形，基部最宽，渐尖成锐尖，叶缘均匀且细密具锯齿。细长叶柄长度约与叶片相当。茎节间较短，使叶幕覆盖浓密。该灌木株形不松散，而是紧凑致密，最终宽度远大于高度。Maplewood 的一株 10 年生植株在未修剪整形的情况下已接近 0.7 米高、1.3 米宽。它非常适合制作盆景，株形密度似乎比盆景常用品种 'Kiyohime' 更高。在园林景观中，植株通常形成较平的冠顶。

products.description_text: Acer palmatum 'Oto hime' is a dwarf Japanese maple with small leaves that emerge almost yellow in spring tipped with red edges. In summer foliage turns a nice even green. Fall color is generally orange but sometimes red or yellow. This wonderful little tree was named after Queen Otohime a mermaid queen who ruled a fabled kingdom at the bottom of the sea. The name means little queen and the name is perfect for this little queen of the garden. 10 Year Size: Height: 2-3 Feet Width: 3-4 Feet

descriptions.preferred: This semidwarf tree has brilliant spring leaves which are of two kinds, large and small, on the same tree. The large leaves sometimes form on new vigorous shoots and are of the fiveor seven-lobed palmatum shape. The lobes radiate strongly outward and are separated two-thirds of the way to the leaf base. The center lobes are rather large with the side lobes much smaller. Each lobe is generally ovate with an accentuated long, sharp point. The margins are lightly toothed. Leaves on older wood and The color is a striking bright flame to pink flame as the spring leaves emerge. This color holds well for several weeks, then changes into a maroon red. As summer progresses, green tones blend in as an undershading. Fall colors develop some pink tones, blending with the fading colors of summer. This short tree may have very strong, long shoots when young and under high cultural pressure produces mainly palmate-shaped leaves. The more unusual foliage occurs primarily on the older or less vigorous wood. This cultivar is most outstanding and attractive. The name has been misspelled 'Otome zakure'.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这是一种半矮生小乔木，春季叶色极为鲜艳，同一株上可同时出现大小两类叶片。大叶有时着生于生长旺盛的新梢上，呈 5 裂或 7 裂的典型 palmatum 形态。裂片明显向外放射，分裂深达叶基的约三分之二。中央裂片较大，侧裂片则小得多。每个裂片通常为卵形，先端延长成尖锐长尾；叶缘具浅锯齿。老枝上的叶片则不同。春季新叶展开时，叶色为极醒目的亮火焰红至粉焰色，这种颜色可维持数周，随后转为栗红。随着夏季推进，叶片会混入绿色阴调。秋色中也会出现一些粉色，与夏末渐退的叶色交织。该品种为矮性树种，幼年在强势生长或高强度栽培条件下可抽生很长的强旺枝，并主要形成掌状叶；较为独特的叶形则主要出现在老枝或较弱势枝条上。该品种非常出众且极具观赏性。其名称曾被误拼作 'Otome zakure'。

descriptions.preferred: 它是原产于太平洋西北地区的藤槭，而 'Fire' 指的是这种枫树火红的树皮。太平洋之火的树皮比珊瑚阁的还要亮。春天新叶是嫩黄色的，夏季反绿，在秋天，叶子主要是明亮的黄色，中间夹杂着橙色和红色，而其鲜红色的树皮将变得更加浓烈。它的叶子是 7-9 裂，成年高度大约 3 米，适合种植在 5-9 区，该品种需要及时遮阴。

rhs_zh.description: 落叶性、多干灌木，株形先直立后开展，高约 2 米；幼枝鲜红醒目，叶片 7 至 9 裂。新梢叶为橙色并带红色叶脉，夏季成熟后转绿，秋季变为金黄色；若在全日照下栽培，常会带橙色色调。春季开具观赏性的紫白色花。

care.cultivation: 宜栽培于肥沃、湿润但排水良好的土壤中，种植于避风的向阳或半阴位置。可耐较干燥的荫蔽环境，但在全日照条件下秋叶色表现最佳。更多建议参见 tree cultivation。
care.pruning: 修剪组 1；如有需要，仅可在深秋至仲冬期间修剪。
care.propagation: 可于冬末采用嫁接繁殖，或于初夏进行软枝扦插繁殖。

descriptions_zh.preferred: 其名称意为“下垂的 Dissectum 米粒状叶”。'Peaches and Cream' 春季新叶展开时为乳白至带绿色调的乳白色，叶缘带柔和的玫瑰红。叶脉明显，为对比鲜明的深绿色。秋色由黄色至浅褐黄色，叶尖颜色较深。叶片中等大小，深裂为 5-7 个卵形裂片，先端渐尖且尖锐。叶缘具非常粗大的锯齿，齿端尖锐并朝不同方向伸展，使叶缘看起来像多刺的冬青叶。绿色叶柄短而粗壮，细长新梢为浅绿色。该品种形成小乔木或灌木，高宽约 10 英尺（3 米）。 'Pendulum Julian' 属于 FILIGREE' Group—red。大型 7 裂叶春季为古铜绿色并带红色叶脉，随后转为深紫红色，后期则呈锈绿色并带红色叶背。秋色为鲜艳的深红橙色。植株姿态明显下垂且开展，幼株需及早设支撑，培养至所需高度。'Pendulum Julian' 具有良好耐寒性，成熟植株在 0°F（-18°C）及厚冰覆盖条件下仍能存活。 另一个 Filigree' Group—red 品种，是 'Ornatum' 与 'Stella Rossa' 的杂交后代，具有独特的春色与悦目的夏色。春叶呈独特的玫瑰粉色，并有明显黄色底色，随后转为紫红色，使整个夏季不断抽生的鲜玫瑰色新叶更为悦目。Acer palmatum 'Pink van Gelderen' 的叶色在全日照下表现最佳。秋色橙红。中等大小叶片在形状和大小上与 'Stella Rossa' 相似，5-7 个裂片深裂至基部，每个裂片又进一步分裂为具尖锐锯齿的小裂片。强健新梢向上并向外生长，形成宽阔的瀑布状圆 mound，外形和大小与 'Ornatum' 相近，高约 10 英尺（3 米）。

descriptions.preferred: This very beautiful selection has distinct foliage which is very attractive in all seasons. The bright green leaves take full sun without burning. The fall colors are very spectacular and persist for a long period, blends of yellow and gold, mottled and shaded crimson. The medium-sized leaf has 11 lobes which are long, ovate-acuminate with sharp, narrow tips, separated distinctly over halfway to the leaf base. The margins roll slightly downward, making the separation between lobes more distinct. Shoots are a dusty green with prominent white striations. This sturdy, upright small tree forms a rounded canopy and matures at about 26 ft. (8 m) high. It is hardy and accepts a wide range of culture conditions. The name means "palmate-leaved." Acer sieboldianum Siebold's maple The bright green small to medium-sized leaves are round with 7-11 ovate lobes separating up to halfway to the base. Each lobe terminates in a sharp point and has sharply toothed margins. The undersurface and leafstalks are covered with a fine white down at first, which diminishes during the summer. Fall color is outstanding, turning a brilliant scarlet with some orange. This species is one of the most common in the mountain woods and thickets of Japan. It forms a tall multistemmed shrub or small tree up to 33 ft. (10 m) tall. It can be depended upon for fall color and makes a very hardy, trouble-free plant for mixed landscapes. The specific name honors German botanist Philipp F. von Siebold.

sources.title: 帕提佛 Acer Shirasawanum 'Palmatifolium'
sources.description: 一个非常美丽的品种，叶形独特。春夏绿，秋色让人惊叹，而且非常持久，是一种黄色与金色混杂的色彩，同时会渲染出深红色。 叶裂为 11 裂，裂叶呈长圆形，叶尖短促而锋利。叶裂深度超过叶片的一半，裂叶呈放射性展开。叶缘锯齿明显，且稍稍向下卷曲，使得裂叶间的间隙扩大，叶片背面的叶脉也非常明显。叶片直径可达 10cm 。 嫩枝树皮呈灰绿色，并带有明显的白色条纹，老枝则转为更暗沉的灰绿色。帕提佛树势健壮，树形直立，树冠呈圆形，成熟株高 8m 。它耐寒性良好，环境适应性强。

rhs.description: A deciduous small tree or large shrub, to around 5m high, with rounded leaves divided into up to 11 coarsely toothed lobes. Leaves emerge pale green tinted with pink, and turn bright green in summer before colouring orange, red and purple in autumn. Clusters of creamy-yellow flowers in spring are followed by brownish-red winged fruits

Hot, dry air, cold wind and late frost may cause leaf scorching. Mulch in autumn to protect shallow roots from cold and drying out. See Japanese maple cultivation
care.pruning: Minimal pruning required; see pruning group 1 . Prune from late autumn to mid-winter only
care.propagation: Propagate by layering or grafting

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这一极为美丽的选育品种具有鲜明而独特的叶貌，四季皆具观赏性。鲜绿色叶片在全日照下也不易灼伤。秋色极其壮观且持续时间长，呈黄、金色与斑驳、晕染的深红色混合。中等大小的叶片具 11 个裂片，裂片长、呈卵状渐尖形，先端狭长锐尖，分裂深度明显超过叶片的一半。叶缘略向下卷，使裂片间分离感更为清晰。新梢为灰绿色，并有显著的白色条纹。该品种树势强健、株形直立，成熟后形成圆整树冠，高约 26 英尺（8 米）。其耐寒，且能适应较广泛的栽培条件。其名称意为“掌叶形”。 Acer sieboldianum，Siebold's maple。其鲜绿色叶片小至中等大小，近圆形，具 7 至 11 个卵形裂片，分裂深度可达叶基的一半。每个裂片先端尖锐，叶缘具明显锯齿。叶背和叶柄初期覆有细白色绒毛，至夏季会逐渐减少。秋色极为出众，转为鲜艳的猩红色并带部分橙色。该种是日本山地林地和灌丛中最常见的槭树之一，可形成高大的丛生灌木或小乔木，高可达 33 英尺（10 米）。其秋色表现稳定可靠，是混合景观中非常耐寒且少病少害、管理省心的植物。种加词是为纪念德国植物学家 Philipp F. von Siebold。

attributes.suggested_uses: 造型性强、养护需求低

care.cultivation: 在微酸性、富含腐殖质且排水良好的土壤中生长最佳，但若加入充分腐熟的有机质改良，也能适应多数土壤。炎热干燥的空气、寒风和晚霜可能导致叶片焦枯。秋季覆 mulch，可保护浅根免受寒害和干燥。参见 Japanese maple cultivation。
care.pruning: 所需修剪极少；参见修剪第 1 组。仅可在晚秋至仲冬期间修剪。
care.propagation: 可采用压条或嫁接繁殖。

rhs_zh.description: 落叶性小乔木或大型灌木，高约 5 米。叶片近圆形，分裂为最多 11 个粗齿裂片。新叶展开时为带粉色晕染的淡绿色，夏季转为鲜绿色，秋季变为橙色、红色和紫色。春季开成簇的乳黄色花，随后结棕红色翅果。

descriptions.preferred: Acer palmatum 'Pastel' Light Pink Pastel Reticulated Variegated Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 'Pastel' leafs out in the spring with a pastel pink reticulated variegation. 'Pastel' is a newer selection recently introduced by Talon Buchholz. 'Pastel' is expected to reach 10 ft in height in 10 years. descriptions_zh.preferred: Acer palmatum 'Pastel'，浅粉色网脉斑锦日本枫，适生区 5-9。‘Pastel’ 春季展叶时带有粉彩般的浅粉色网脉斑锦。随着生长季推进，叶脉颜色逐渐加深，形成更强烈的观赏对比。秋季转为鲜红至深栗红色。‘Pastel’ 是 Talon Buchholz 近年推出的较新选育品种，预计 10 年可长至高 10 英尺。为获得最佳粉彩色表现，建议避开炎热的午后强光。带有 MrMaple 标识的照片归 MrMaple.com 所有，未经明确书面许可不得使用。本页无 MrMaple 标识的照片由 Talon Buchholz 拍摄，未经所有者明确书面许可不得使用。数量有限！！由于我们拥有上千个日本枫品种，单个品种通常库存不多。

descriptions.preferred: 奶油桃子又可称为蜜桃奶盖， 由澳大利亚的育种家Arnold Teese 于 1976 年选择了该品种 ，经过几年的观察培育 并推广 ，叶子有 5 到 7 裂，叶裂深至基部。春天 初芽带白色绒毛，春叶以 黄粉色 为主 ，带有明显的绿色脉纹。夏季会变成绿白色，秋天是黄色的。奶油桃子色彩丰富多变，抗性也非常好，可全日照，夏季午后适当遮阴，成年树高可达 3 米左右。

rhs.description: A deciduous, round-headed tree or shrub to 4m tall and wide. Its deeply-divided and lobed leaves emerge in spring creamy-white with green veins and the tips and margins tinged a pinkish-red. This pinkish-red colouring fades as the leaves mature in summer before turning yellow-orange in autumn. Small purple-red flowers may be followed by winged fruit in autumn

attributes.suggested_uses: Low Maintenance, Banks and Slopes, City/Courtyard Gardens, Cottage/Informal Garden, Flower borders and beds, Hedging/Screens
attributes.hort_group_description: Acers in this matsumurae group are deeply divided to around three quarters of the leaf with coarsely-toothed edges and narrow, pointed lobes

care.cultivation: Grow in a place sheltered from cold drying winds and from late frosts, in full sun where its colours will develop best or in light dappled shade, in moist but well-drained neutral or acidic soil that does not dry out in summer or become waterlogged in winter, and protect roots with an open-textured organic mulch such as coarse bark; for more advice, see Japanese maple cultivation
care.pruning: Pruning group 1 (little or no pruning of trees and shrubs) and prune if necessary only from late autumn to midwinter
care.propagation: Propagate by grafting or by softwood cuttings

resistance.pest: May be susceptible to Acer gall mite, aphids , caterpillars and horse chestnut scale
resistance.disease: May be susceptible to Verticillium wilt , Acer leaf scorch and honey fungus

rhs_zh.description: 落叶圆头形小乔木或灌木，高和冠幅均可达 4 m。其深裂叶于春季萌发时呈乳白色，叶脉为绿色，叶尖和叶缘带粉红红色。随着夏季叶片成熟，这种粉红红色会逐渐褪去，秋季则转为黄橙色。小型紫红色花后，秋季可能结出翅果。

care.cultivation: 宜栽植于可避开寒冷干风和晚霜的位置；全日照下叶色表现最佳，也可在疏荫环境中栽培。土壤应保持湿润但排水良好，宜中性至酸性，夏季不宜干透，冬季不可积水。根部可覆盖疏松质地的有机覆盖物，如粗树皮，以利保湿护根。更多建议参见日本枫栽培说明。
care.pruning: 修剪组 1（树木和灌木几乎不修剪或仅少量修剪）；如确有必要，仅宜在晚秋至隆冬期间进行修剪。
care.propagation: 可通过嫁接或嫩枝扦插繁殖

descriptions.preferred: This very pretty but delicate selection belongs to the variegated Palmatum Group. The spring foliage emerges with a cream to greenish cream color over most of each leaf. Blended into this is a soft rose red, covering about one-quarter of the leaf, especially at the lobe tips. The leaf remains pink-edged throughout the summer. The veins are conspicuous and of a contrasting deep green color. In the fall, the color pattern of the leaves ranges from yellow to buff with darker tips. The fiveor seven-lobed, sometimes nine-lobed, medium-sized leaves are divided about three-quarters of the way to the leaf base and are 7-8 cm long and 8-9 cm wide. The lobes are ovate with tapered, sharply pointed tips, up to 5 cm long and 1.5 cm wide at the broadest point in the middle, narrowing to 5 mm at the lobe junctions. The margins are very coarsely toothed. The teeth have sharply pointed tips and point in various directions, causing the margins to be wavy and slightly crinkled, like a prickly holly leaf. The short, stout green petioles are about 2-3 cm long. The slender shoots are a light green. The color patterns of this cultivar are reminiscent of 'Shigitatsu sawa' which was the seed parent, with the red form 'Aka shigitatsu sawa' as the pollen source. The lobes are more deeply divided than are those of either observation.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这一品种十分秀美，但较为娇嫩，属于斑叶型 Palmatum Group。春叶展开时，大部分叶面呈乳白至带绿色调的乳白色，其间混有柔和的玫瑰红色，约覆盖叶面的四分之一，尤以裂片先端最明显。整个夏季叶缘始终带粉色。叶脉明显，呈对比鲜明的深绿色。秋季叶色由黄色至浅黄褐色不等，叶尖颜色较深。叶片中等大小，5 或 7 裂，有时为 9 裂，裂深约达叶基的四分之三，长 7–8 cm，宽 8–9 cm。裂片为卵形，先端渐尖且尖锐，中部最宽处约 1.5 cm，长可达 5 cm，在裂片连接处收窄至 5 mm。叶缘具非常粗大的锯齿，齿端尖锐，方向不一，使叶缘呈波浪状并略带皱褶，类似多刺冬青叶。叶柄短而粗壮，绿色，长约 2–3 cm。细枝纤细，浅绿色。该品种的色彩图案令人联想到作为母本的 ‘Shigitatsu sawa’，其父本为红叶型 ‘Aka shigitatsu sawa’。本品种的裂片比这两者观察到的都更深。

descriptions.preferred: The leaves of this red dissectum are not quite as finely serrated on the deeply cut lobes as they are on some other dissectums. In fact, some of the older wood produces leaves with lobes which are almost lanceolate, and with deeply cut margins, making this cultivar approach the green form 'Palmatifidum'. The young emerging leaves are bronze green with green veining, becoming deep purple red in the summer. This color holds well into the summer, gradually changing to a rusty green with a reddish undertone. In the fall, the crimson-orange combinations are quite vivid. Leaf size is about average for a dissectum, being 7-10 cm long and wide. The seven lobes radiate outward in good fashion. The petioles are firm and 2-3 cm long. This plant is quite pendulous, and young plants must be staked early to reach the required height. The cascading is outward and then downward. It is a very hardy -18°C form. Older plants have survived and heavy coverings of ice. Henry Hohman had this cultivar in his collection for many years. He may have bought it from Yokohama Nursery, Japan, in the early 1930s. The name has been incorrectly spelled 'Pendula Julian'. The plant has also been known under the name 'Dissectum Pendulum Julian'. with conspicuous yellow veins. They become a purplered color for the summer, making a pleasing backgroundtothebrightrosenewfoliageappearingthroughout the summer. The leaf coloring is at its best in full sun and is not damaged by it. The fall color is orange red, but not as brilliant as that of 'Ornatum'. The medium-sized leaves are similar in shape and size to those of 'Stella Rossa'. Each leaf has five or seven lobes, is deeply divided to the leaf base, and is 8-10 cm long and 9-11 cm wide. Each lobe is itself divided into sharply toothed sublobes, the base of the main lobe narrowing to little more than 1 mm. The reddish petioles are 3-3.5 cm long. The new vigorous shoots grow upward and outward at first, becoming pendulous to produce a broad cascading mound. The plant assumes the same shape and size as 'Ornatum', reaching about 3 m high at maturity. red on the upper surface which lasts well into late summer, while the undersurface is a contrasting bronze green. Like 'Bloodgood', it turns a fiery scarlet in the fall. The deeply cut fiveor seven-lobed leaves are 7-8 cm long and 8-9 cm wide, with widely spreading lobes. The broadly ovate lobes are widest about the middle, with long pointed tips, and are deeply divided to within 5 mm of the leaf base. The small basal lobes are angled backward and outward. The margins are coarsely but regularly toothed. The slender stiff pink petiole is 2-3 cm long. 'Pixie' is very vigorous when young but slows down to form a dense many-branched round-topped bush up to 2 m tall and no wider.

rhs.description: A deciduous shrub or small tree, with a weeping habit forming a low mound to around 1.5m high and 2m wide. Deeply-cut leaves, divided into fine feathery lobes, emerge reddish purple in the spring, turning deep green and bronze in summer, and then striking shades of yellow, orange and red in the autumn

care.pruning: 所需修剪极少；参见修剪第 1 组。仅可在晚秋至仲冬期间修剪。
care.cultivation: 宜栽培于保水性好、排水良好、最好为微酸性的土壤中，种植位置应避风，并防止干燥风侵袭。半阴环境下生长最佳，但需要一定日照以促进叶色表现；若土壤湿度稳定，也可耐全日照。春季应覆盖 mulch，尤其是容器栽培时，可帮助保持土壤水分。另见 Japanese maples cultivation。
care.propagation: 可采用压条或嫁接繁殖。

resistance.pest: 可能易受槭瘿螨、蚜虫、毛虫和七叶树介壳虫危害
resistance.disease: 可能易感黄萎病、槭叶焦枯病和蜜环菌病

rhs_zh.description: 落叶灌木或小乔木，枝姿下垂，形成低矮圆 mound，约高 1.5 米、宽 2 米。叶片深裂，分裂成细致羽毛状裂片，春季展叶时呈红紫色，夏季转为深绿色并带青铜色调，秋季则变为醒目的黄色、橙色和红色。

attributes.suggested_uses: 造型植物、城市/庭院花园、乡村/自然式花园、花境与花坛、低养护、庭院/容器植物
attributes.hort_group_description: dissectum 组的槭树具有细致、羽毛状、深裂的叶片，叶缘具细锯齿。

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这个红叶裂叶品种的叶片，在深裂裂片上的锯齿不如某些其他裂叶品种那样细密明显。实际上，部分老枝会长出裂片近披针形、叶缘深刻的叶片，使该品种在形态上接近绿色类型 'Palmatifidum'。初展的新叶呈青铜绿色并具绿色叶脉，夏季转为深紫红色。此色泽在夏季维持良好，之后逐渐变为带红色底调的锈绿色；秋季则呈现十分鲜明的深红橙色组合。叶片大小在裂叶品种中属中等，长宽约 7 至 10 厘米。7 个裂片向外辐射舒展，叶柄坚实，长 2 至 3 厘米。植株具明显下垂性，幼株需及早立桩引高，以达到所需高度；枝条先向外开展，再向下垂落。它是一个非常耐寒的类型，可耐 -18°C。老株甚至能在厚重冰层覆盖下存活。Henry Hohman 曾将该品种收藏多年，他可能于 20 世纪 30 年代初从日本横滨苗圃购得。该名称曾被误拼作 'Pendula Julian'，该植株也曾以 'Dissectum Pendulum Julian' 之名流通。 另一个相关描述中，其新叶具显著黄色叶脉，夏季转为紫红色，成为整个夏季不断抽生的亮玫红色新叶的良好背景。该品种在全日照下叶色表现最佳，且不易被晒伤。秋色为橙红，但不如 'Ornatum' 那样鲜艳。中等大小的叶片在形态和尺寸上与 'Stella Rossa' 相似。每片叶有 5 或 7 个裂片，深裂至叶基，长 8 至 10 厘米、宽 9 至 11 厘米。每个裂片又进一步分裂为具锐齿的小裂片，主裂片基部收窄至略多于 1 毫米。红色叶柄长 3 至 3.5 厘米。旺盛新梢起初向上并向外生长，之后下垂，形成宽大的垂枝丘状树形。最终株形和大小与 'Ornatum' 类似，成熟时高约 3 米。 'Pixie' 的叶片上表面为鲜红色，且可维持至夏末，下表面则为形成对比的青铜绿色；与 'Bloodgood' 一样，秋季转为火焰般的猩红色。深裂的 5 裂或 7 裂叶长 7 至 8 厘米、宽 8 至 9 厘米，裂片开展较宽。裂片宽卵形，在中部最宽，先端长而尖，深裂至距叶基 5 毫米以内。基部小裂片向后外方斜伸。叶缘粗而整齐具齿。细而坚挺的粉色叶柄长 2 至 3 厘米。'Pixie' 幼年生长势很强，随后生长放缓，形成致密、多分枝、圆头灌木状树形，高可达 2 米，宽度不超过高度。

chinese_name: 多彩的佩夫 cer Palmatum 'Peve Multicolor'

descriptions.preferred: 多彩的佩夫也叫荷仙，由荷兰的 Piet Vergeldt苗圃育种并推广 。 它的色彩表现上和浮云相似，其丰富的叶色令人惊叹。冬天越冷，叶子内色素的分解程度越高，从而出锦的效果越好，所以多彩的佩夫非常适合北方等地的枫友。春天叶子呈现出淡粉色和白色，叶面上点缀着一点点绿色，夏天变成白色和绿色的散斑，午后需要及时遮阴。 秋天的颜色是明亮的金黄色到橙色 。 多彩的佩夫 春季色彩多变，年复一年色彩会有比较大的差异，矮性品种，抗性好，分 枝 能力强，成年 株高约 1.8米左右 。

products.title: Acer palmatum 'Peve Multicolor' Japanese Maple
products.description_text: Acer palmatum 'Peve Multicolor' Rare Multi-colored Japanese Maple Tree Zones 5-9 First and foremost, it should be explained that this tree is inconsistent in its variegation, but in the years where this variegation occurs, 'Peve Multicolor' is one of the most amazing Japanese maples of our 1000 cultivars at our nursery. Some claim that this tree reverts but this is not the case. Like 'Ukigumo' there are some years where the environmental conditions cause it to variegate heavily and other years where it rarely variegates at all. Morning sun and afternoon shade gives this selection the best chance to variegate heavily. Rain conditions and temperature also play a factor. It is perceived the colder the winter, that the higher the break up of the pigmentation of colors within the leaf will allow a higher display of variegation. In the years this tree variegates it leafs out with a heavily sandusting reticulation where the leaf is nearly entirely white with green veining and a pinkish purple border. Morning sun with protection from the hot afternoon sun allows this variegation to display throughout most of the year. Mid-summer the white sand dusting is still present while the leaf becomes more green and loses the spring border. Fall colors are bright golden yellows to orange. In the years 'Peve Multicolor' does not variegate it leaves out as a bright chartreuse green with a purple-red border. By mid-summer it loses this purple-red border turning to a solid green. Fall colors are again a bright golden yellow to orange. Sometimes 'Peve Multicolor' is spelled as 'Peve Multicolour'. Limited Quantities Available !! As we have over a thousand cultivars of Japanese maples, we often do not have many of each cultivar. We recommend that you buy the Japanese maples you want immediately as we often sell out of certain selections.

New growth flushes are again a bright red. In the autumn, 'Peve Starfish' will light up your landscape turning to a bright crimson red. This is one of our favorites of these new selections. descriptions.preferred: 'Phoenix' 凤凰一种稀有且难以繁殖的枫树，树皮色 彩斑斓，有条纹，是色彩最鲜艳、最明亮的蛇皮枫 树之一。 于 1980 年代作为 Acer × conspicuum 'Silver Vein' 的幼苗被发现。春夏季为绿色，秋季会变成明 亮的黄色叶子。树皮在夏天呈淡绿色 / 黄色，在冬 天变亮为鲜艳的粉红色、黄色和橙色，并带有银色 蛇状线条。成年树高约 5 米。

rhs.description: A medium upright tree or large branching shrub, to 6m tall and wide, characterised by its coloured bark and shoots. Winter shoots are bright red, striped silvery-white and the bark is striped with orange-pink and silvery-white. Large green leaves turn a golden-yellow in autumn and small yellow-green flowers, borne in spring, are followed by winged fruit

rhs_zh.description: 中等大小的直立乔木或大型分枝灌木，高和冠幅均可达 6 m，以枝条和树皮色彩丰富为特征。冬季新梢鲜红色，并具银白色条纹；树皮带橙粉色和银白色纵纹。大型绿色叶片于秋季转为金黄色。春季开黄绿色小花，之后结翅果。

descriptions.preferred: 就像浴火重生的凤凰一样,鸡爪械凤凰春季叶子鲜红。叶脉呈现黄色,鲜红色的叶子与树杆形成鲜明对比。春天光照合适的情况下叶子可以晒出白色的斑点。夏季呈现浅绿色,但二次新梢叶子是红色的,秋天橙黄色到红色。直立性较强,一般5-7叶裂,叶裂很深,叶边缘有明显的不规则锯齿。非常耐寒,长势较为缓慢,成年树高约2-3米。

rhs.description: 'Phoenix' is a compact, broad shrub or small tree to 5m tall with palmate leaves which emerge pink with yellow-green veins, gradually turning to yellow and then to shiny green before becoming orange, red and yellow in autumn

attributes.suggested_uses: Architectural, City/Courtyard Gardens, Cottage/Informal Garden, Flower borders and beds, Low Maintenance, Patio/Container Plants
attributes.hort_group_description: Acers in this palmatum group have small, palm-shaped leaves with coarsely-toothed edges

care.cultivation: Grow in a moist but well-drained soil. Water in summer if necessary. Leaf colour is best in partial shade, although full sun can be tolerated. Leaf scorch can be caused by lack of soil moisture or excessive exposure. See Japanese maple cultivation
care.pruning: Pruning group 1 , pruning if necessary only from late autumn to midwinter
care.propagation: Propagate by grafting , softwood cuttings or layering

resistance.pest: May be susceptible to Acer gall mite, aphids , caterpillars and horse chestnut scale
resistance.disease: May be susceptible to Verticillium wilt , Acer leaf scorch and honey fungus

rhs_zh.description: 'Phoenix' 为紧凑、开展的灌木或小乔木，高可达 5 米。掌状叶初展时为粉色，带黄绿色叶脉，随后逐渐转黄，再变为有光泽的绿色，秋季则呈橙、红、黄相间的色彩。

care.cultivation: 宜栽培于湿润但排水良好的土壤中。夏季必要时应补充浇水。叶色在半阴环境下表现最佳，但也可耐全日照。土壤水分不足或暴晒过度都可能导致叶缘焦枯。参见日本枫树栽培资料。
care.pruning: 修剪组 1；如有必要，仅在深秋至仲冬期间修剪
care.propagation: 可采用嫁接、嫩枝扦插或压条繁殖

descriptions.preferred: Acer palmatum 'Pink Panther' Pink Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 'Pink Panther' bursts into bright pink foliage in early spring. As the season progresses, its vibrant hue mellows to a crisp olive green, complemented by coral pink new growth in summer. Come autumn, expect a stunning display of orange to red foliage. Distinguished by its larger, more amoenum-like leaves compared to other spring-interest trees, 'Pink Panther' reaches heights of 8-10 ft over 10 years. Developed by the Mendoza family, this variety is a fresh addition to the botanical scene. Limited Quantities Available !! descriptions.preferred: Acer palmatum ‘Pink Princess' Dwarf Pink Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 ‘Pink Princess’ is a new dwarf compact selection of Japanese maple with a variegated leaf. There are very few variegated brooms in the plant world, and this is the first variegated broom on a maple that we know of. This new selection was found as a broom on ‘Beni shichihenge’ and selected by our good friend, Carl Munn. We had the honor and privilege to be able to get this tree first, evaluate it and name this tree ‘Pink Princess’. ‘Pink Princess’ leafs out in the spring with pink margined variegation on a green leaf. During the summer, the pink fades to white. ‘Pink Princess’ appears to be a vigorous dwarf globe reaching 4 ft in height by 4 ft in width in 10 years. Give it protection from the hot afternoon sun to keep the pink spring color longer into the season. Fall color on ‘Pink Princess’ is orange to red. These trees are for local pickup only, we cannot ship them because they are too big. The MrMaple Nursery is located in East Flat Rock, NC. Please contact us to arrange a pickup time. Limited Quantities Available !! As we have over a thousand cultivars of Japanese maples, we often do not have many of each cultivar. We recommend that you buy the Japanese maples you want immediately as we often sell out of certain selections.

descriptions_zh.preferred: Acer palmatum ‘Pink Princess'，矮生粉叶日本枫，适生区 5-9。‘Pink Princess’ 是一个新的矮生紧凑型日本枫选育品种，具斑叶特征。植物界中带斑锦的丛生芽变极为少见，而据我们所知，这是枫树上首个带斑锦的丛生芽变品种。这个新品种是在 ‘Beni shichihenge’ 上发现的丛生芽变，由我们的好友 Carl Munn 选出。我们有幸最先获得此树，对其进行评估，并将其命名为 ‘Pink Princess’。‘Pink Princess’ 春季展叶时为绿色叶片配粉色镶边斑锦，夏季粉色会逐渐褪为白色。该品种似乎是生长势较强的矮生球形品种，10 年可达高 4 英尺、宽 4 英尺。建议避开炎热的午后强光，以让春季的粉色维持更久。秋季叶色为橙至红色。这些植株仅限到园自提，因体量过大无法邮寄。MrMaple Nursery 位于北卡罗来纳州 East Flat Rock，请联系我们安排提货时间。数量有限！！由于我们拥有上千个日本枫品种，单个品种通常库存不多。

descriptions.preferred: This cultivar, a possible sport from 'Bloodgood', is similar but for the shorter growth and more deeply cut lobes. New leaves are a bright pink-red, becoming deep red in the summer and turning a fiery scarlet in the fall. The leaves are deeply divided into five to seven widely spreading, broadly ovate lobes with long, pointed tips. The margins are coarsely but regularly toothed. The pink leafstalk is slender and stiff. 'Pixie' forms a dense round-topped bush up to 61⁄2 ft. (2 m) tall and wide. The similar 'Skeeter's Broom' also arose as a witches broom from 'Bloodgood' but has slightly longer lobes. Any lobe, not only the center lobe, may be short and rounded.

rhs.description: A small, upright, slow-growing tree ultimately to about 2.5m tall and 2m across. The leaves have seven, toothed, tapering lobes opening pink in spring, turning purple-red for summer and bright scarlet in autumn. Small green flowers in spring are followed by winged, red fruit in autumn

rhs_zh.description: 小型直立、慢生乔木，最终高约 2.5 m，冠幅约 2 m。叶片具 7 个具齿、渐尖的裂片，春季展叶为粉色，夏季转为紫红色，秋季变为鲜亮猩红色。春季开绿色小花，秋季结红色翅果。

descriptions_zh.preferred: 该品种可能是由 'Bloodgood' 产生的芽变，整体与其相似，但生长更矮，叶裂更深。新叶呈鲜亮的粉红红色，夏季转为深红，秋季则变为炽烈的猩红色。叶片深裂，分为 5 至 7 个宽展的广卵形裂片，先端细长尖锐。叶缘具粗而整齐的锯齿。粉红色叶柄细长而坚挺。'Pixie' 形成致密、圆头状灌木，株高和冠幅可达 6 1/2 英尺（2 米）。相似的 'Skeeter's Broom' 也同样是由 'Bloodgood' 的丛枝变异产生，但其裂片略长。短而圆钝的情况不只出现在中央裂片，任何裂片都可能如此。

descriptions.preferred: 粉械是一种叶子带有大理石白色花纹的欧洲野枫，该树种主要分布在欧洲，西亚和北非，最早于1864年在穆斯考植物园栽培时被发现。光滑的浅裂叶子具有很强的观赏性，在秋天会变成引人注目的黄色。在半遮荫或全遮荫下效果最佳，不耐晒但是相对耐寒，成年树高约3米。

sources.description: 粉械是一种叶子带有大理石白色花纹的欧洲野枫，该树种主要分布在欧洲，西亚和北非，最早于1864年在穆斯考植物园栽培时被发现。光滑的浅裂叶子具有很强的观赏性，在秋天会变成引人注目的黄色。在半遮荫或全遮荫下效果最佳，不耐晒但是相对耐寒，成年树高约3米。

products.description_text: Acer campestre 'Pulverulentum' Rare White Variegated Hedge Maple Zones 5-9 'Pulverulentum’ is a white marbled variegated European field maple. The white variegation is a great way to brighten shadier spots in the garden. I recommend giving some morning sun for the densest habit. ‘Pulverulentum’ may reach 6-8 ft in height and width in 10 years with dense rounded habit. Limited Quantities Available !! descriptions.preferred: 庞克是 是由韩国人育种并推广的 细叶 品种 ，类似于 "Red Pygmy"（红色霹雳），但庞克叶子更长更窄一些。它有 风之翼的美称，叶子呈竹叶状 ， 3 到 5 叶裂，叶裂狭窄细长和竹叶 相似。春叶深红色，光照充足情况下会变成紫红色，色彩可以保持到夏天。夏季遮荫情况下，会适当返绿。秋天变成鲜红色。庞克来自于 A. palmatum f. atropurpureum的幼苗，它的名字曾被错误的拼写成 "Pung Kill"。 直立性生长，但是生长速度较慢，成年树可达2 到 3米。

rhs.description: Small, vase-shaped, slow-growing deciduous shrubby tree, about 3m tall, with 7 long, narrow strap-shaped lobed leaves, pale red in early spring becoming dark red for the summer and holding the colour well, then produces autumns tints of gold and red-purple. Inconspicuous hanging clusters of small, purple-red flowers in spring are followed by red-flushed, winged fruits

attributes.suggested_uses: City/Courtyard Gardens, Cottage/Informal Garden, Flower borders and beds
attributes.hort_group_description: Acers in this linearilobum group have long, narrow, strap-like lobes, with lightly serrated edges

care.cultivation: Grow in any moisture-retentive, well-drained soil in a sheltered position. Leaf colour is best in partial shade, although full sun can be tolerated if soil is reliably moist. Leaf scorch can be caused by lack of soil moisture or excessive exposure. See Japanese maples cultivation
care.pruning: Pruning group 1 from late autumn to midwinter only
care.propagation: Propagate by layering in autumn, grafting in late winter or softwood cuttings

resistance.pest: May be susceptible to Acer gall mite, aphids , caterpillars and horse chestnut scale
resistance.disease: May be susceptible to Verticillium wilt , acer leaf scorch and honey fungus

attributes.hort_group_description: 此 linearilobum 组的槭树具有细长、带状的裂片，叶缘具浅锯齿。
attributes.suggested_uses: 适合城市/庭院花园、乡村/自然式花园、花境及花坛。

care.cultivation: 宜栽于保水且排水良好的土壤中，并选择避风位置。半阴环境下叶色表现最佳；若土壤湿度稳定，也可耐全日照。土壤缺水或暴露过度都可能导致叶片焦边。参见 Japanese maples cultivation。
care.pruning: 修剪第 1 组：仅限在晚秋至仲冬期间进行。
care.propagation: 可于秋季行压条繁殖，于晚冬进行嫁接，或采用软枝扦插繁殖。

resistance.pest: 可能易受槭瘿螨、蚜虫、毛虫和七叶树介壳虫危害
resistance.disease: 可能易感 Verticillium wilt、槭树叶灼病和蜜环菌。

rhs_zh.description: 小型、花瓶形、慢生的落叶灌木状小乔木，高约 3 米。叶片具 7 个细长的带状裂片，早春为浅红色，夏季转为深红，且叶色保持性好；秋季呈现金黄与红紫色秋色。春季开不显眼的小型紫红色花，成下垂簇状，之后结带红晕的翅果。

products.title: Acer palmatum 'Pung kil' Japanese Maple
products.description_text: Acer palmatum 'Pung Kil' Rare Pung kil Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 This Korean introduction of a Japanese maple has one of the darkest foliage of the wind swept Japanese maples. We love how these thin red strap leaves flow in the wind. In the early spring, 'Pung Kil' leafs out as a deep red, which holds fairly well throughout most of the summer. Fall colors are bright oranges to crimson reds. 'Pung kil' is a slow grower reaching about 6-7 ft in 10 years. 'Pung kil' is an ideal red linearilobum Japanese maple for any yard because of its ability to hold its color well and because of the slow growth rate. Named after Mr. Pung Kil of Chollipo Arboretum in South Korea. The photo(s) with a MrMaple logo are owned by MrMaple.com and cannot be used without expressed written consent. descriptions_zh.preferred: 紫色网纹是这一令人惊艳的引种品种的显著特征，它属于来自俄勒冈的 Ghost 系列之一。其春叶极为出色，叶色为深红色，并带有更深的红紫色网状叶脉。夏季叶色保持为红色，叶脉及叶缘呈深紫红色。秋季叶片转为火焰橙色和猩红色。大型 7 裂叶深裂，叶缘具明显尖锐锯齿，并带有富观赏性的微皱边缘。该树半直立、圆整，预计可长至约 10–12 英尺（3–3.9 m）高、5 英尺（1.5 m）宽，是园林景观中极具戏剧性对比效果或焦点价值的品种。

descriptions.preferred: This cultivar has almost straplike, seven-lobed leaves which tantalizingly border on the Matsumurae and Linearilobum Groups and could be placed in either. It originated from a sport on the same Acer palmatum f. atropurpureum plant which yielded 'Beni shi en'. Harold Johnston of Johnnie's Pleasure Plants Nursery, Tallassee, Alabama, discovered it. The small leaves have seven deeply divided lobes and are 4-6 cm long and 4-5 cm wide. Each lobe is lanceolate to long-ovate, ranging in width from 3 to 10 mm, but mostly about 5 mm, at the broadest point in the middle or outer third of the lobe, and narrowing to 1 mm at the before becoming yellow orange in the fall. Unlike 'Beni shi en', this cultivar has no variegation and is much more uniform in its appearance. The 1- to 2-cm long slender petioles are green and attached to green shoots. This moderately vigorous plant forms an upright rounded bush or tree. The original plant reached 2 m high in seven years. Its estimated mature height is 2-3 m with a width of 2 m.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 该品种的叶片近乎带状，通常为七裂，介于 Matsumurae Group 与 Linearilobum Group 之间，归入任一组均可。它来源于同一株 Acer palmatum f. atropurpureum 上的芽变，该植株同时还产生了 'Beni shi en'。此品种由美国阿拉巴马州 Tallassee 的 Johnnie's Pleasure Plants Nursery 的 Harold Johnston 发现。叶片较小，七裂深，长 4-6 厘米、宽 4-5 厘米。各裂片呈披针形至长卵形，最宽处位于裂片中部或外侧三分之一处，宽 3-10 毫米，多数约 5 毫米，向基部渐狭至约 1 毫米；秋季转为黄橙色。与 'Beni shi en' 不同，该品种没有斑锦，整体外观也更加整齐一致。叶柄细长，长 1-2 厘米，呈绿色，着生于绿色新梢上。植株长势中等，形成直立、圆整的灌木或小乔木。原始株 7 年可达 2 米高，估计成年株高 2-3 米，冠幅约 2 米。

products.title: Acer palmatum 'Purple mask' Japanese Maple
products.description_text: Acer palmatum 'Purple Mask' Heat Tolerant Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 Acer palmatum 'Purple Mask' is a striking Japanese maple known for its brick red foliage throughout the growing season, 'Purple Mask' is an upright, vigorous cultivar reaching 8–10 ft tall in 10 years. This heat-tolerant selection shines in warm climates, maintaining its rich coloration even in full sun. Come autumn, the foliage transforms into a vibrant yellow to orange, making it one of the best Japanese maples for fall color. Selected by Harold Johnston of Alabama, 'Purple Mask' has proven reliable in southern gardens. It also holds botanical interest as the parent of 'Beni shi en', a variegated sport discovered from its lineage. Limited Quantities Available !! care.cultivation: Grow in any moisture-retentive, well-drained soil in a sheltered position. Leaf colour is best in partial shade, although full sun can be tolerated if soil is reliably moist. Leaf scorch can be caused by lack of soil moisture or excessive exposure. See Japanese maples cultivation
care.pruning: Pruning group 1 from late autumn to midwinter only
care.propagation: Propagate by layering in autumn, grafting in late winter or softwood cuttings

resistance.pest: May be susceptible to Acer gall mite, aphids , caterpillars and horse chestnut scale
resistance.disease: May be susceptible to Verticillium wilt , Acer leaf scorch and honey fungus

care.cultivation: 宜栽于保水且排水良好的土壤中，并选择避风位置。半阴环境下叶色表现最佳；若土壤湿度稳定，也可耐全日照。土壤缺水或暴露过度都可能导致叶片焦边。参见 Japanese maples cultivation。
care.pruning: 修剪第 1 组：仅限在晚秋至仲冬期间进行。
care.propagation: 可于秋季行压条繁殖，于晚冬进行嫁接，或采用软枝扦插繁殖。

resistance.pest: 可能易受槭瘿螨、蚜虫、毛虫和七叶树介壳虫危害
resistance.disease: 可能易感黄萎病、槭叶焦枯病和蜜环菌病

rhs_zh.description: 生长缓慢的直立小乔木，高约 5 米。叶长宽约 7-8 厘米，通常分为约 7 个裂片；新叶深紫红色，色泽可较好保持至夏季，夏末转为铜绿色，秋季则变为鲜亮的猩红色。春季开不显眼的红紫色花，随后可能结带翅的紫色果实。

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这个古老的英国栽培品种叶片中等大小，春季和初夏呈深紫红色，至夏末转为古铜绿色，秋季再变为鲜亮猩红色。叶片中度深裂为 7 个卵形裂片，裂片先端尖，叶缘具整齐锯齿。基部小裂片与叶柄大致成直角。'Purpureum' 生长缓慢，株形直立，树冠致密呈圆头状，高宽可达 16 英尺（5 米）。“Acer” 这一名称意为“紫色”。 'AUTUMN LACE'，Autumn Lace' Group—green，是一个非常出色的线裂型品种，以夏季鲜绿色叶片及枝梢端带红铜色的新叶著称。秋色尤为特别，会由橙色转为鲜艳的红色。大叶深裂为 7 个裂片，裂片本身再分裂成粗锯齿状小裂片。该品种形成宽阔的瀑布状圆 mound，高可达 10-13 英尺（3-4 米），冠幅 13-16 英尺（4-5 米）。 'Crimson 'Red Cloud' 属于 Linearilobum Group—red。这个来自 Oregon 的红色细裂带叶型品种，春季新叶鲜红，随后转为紫红，并能持续整个夏季，秋季再变为醒目的橙红色。'Red Cloud' 最终形成圆整小乔木，高约 10-13 英尺（3-4 米），株形较多数带叶型品种更为开张舒展。其较疏朗的株形，加上细长的 5-7 裂叶，营造出如云般的效果，因此得名。 'Red Dragon' 属于 Dissectum Group—red。这个紫红色细裂品种比其他红叶 Dissectum 更能在日照或遮阴条件下保持深色。春叶鲜猩红，夏季转为深酒红，秋季则成为极为出色的火焰般猩红色。大型叶片深裂为 7 个裂片，裂片本身亦深裂；叶缘具粗大、尖锐且略带钩状的锯齿。细长叶柄纤细。其生长习性类似 'Tamukeyama Queen' 的矮化型，形成紧凑且轮廓清晰的下垂圆 mound，高可达 8 英尺（2.5 米）。'Red Dragon' 需要避免风吹和夏季干旱，非常适合小花园、岩石园、容器栽培及盆景。 'Filigree Lace' 属于 Filigree Lace' Group—red，是最美丽且最独特的细裂品种之一，其观赏效果必须亲见方能体会。它的叶片属于 laceleaf 类型中裂刻最精细者之一。叶色在夏季为深紫红或栗红色，秋季转为鲜亮深红色。叶片 7 裂，狭长裂片深切至中脉，侧边再裂部分同样极细，并具锐利细锯齿。这使叶片呈现 filigree 般的精致感，整体效果极为优美。其生长速度不如多数 Dissectum 品种快。

descriptions.preferred: 彩虹 由美国俄勒冈州巴克霍兹苗圃的苗圃主泰隆 ·巴克霍 兹育种并推广 ，一经推出就引起了轰动。春季明亮的粉红点缀在深红的叶面上，华丽的色彩效果使它成为 枫树 狂热者 的必备品 。但它也会让无数新枫友伤心落泪，因为它的叶色会逆转，一般可以通过定期修剪没有出锦的枝条进行控制。夏季温度升高，深红色会转成绿色，粉红色部分逐渐褪成奶白色，午后需要及时遮阴，避免晒焦叶。 秋季深红色。 成年株可达 2 米左右高度 。

products.title: Acer palmatum 'Rainbow' Pink Variegated Red Japanese Maple
products.description_text: Acer palmatum 'Rainbow' Pink Variegated Red Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 I remember going to Buchholz Nursery for years lusting over this tree. The colors are out of this world! 'Rainbow' leafs out as a brighter red with a reddish pink variegation. The leaf on 'Rainbow' quickly becomes a black red with hot pink variegation. The deeply divided large leaves make an excellent pallet to enjoy such spectacular colors. Avoid fertilizer with this beauty. Any branches not showing pink variegation should be pruned. 'Rainbow' turns to a brighter red in the fall. We expect 'Rainbow' to reach 8 ft in 10 years. Give morning sun with protection from the hot afternoon sun for best display of color. descriptions.preferred: Acer palmatum 'Ramona' Rare Japanese Maple Zones 5 - 9 'Ramona' is a brand new selection of Japanese maple that will quickly become one your favorites! In the spring, bright orange red new growth gives a 'Ueno yama' like appearance. This fades to green by mid-spring. When 'Ramona' really begins to shine is late spring to early summer. The green older growth becomes more and more yellow-green to yellow. New growth flushes of coral pink begin to emerge over this yellow creating a dynamic contrast. ‘Ramona’ is expected to get 6-8 ft in height and width in 10 years with an upright habit. This is a new Japanese maple that is really grabbing our attention here at MrMaple. I know you will enjoy this beauty. Limited Quantities Available !! As we have over a thousand cultivars of Japanese maples, we often do not have many of each cultivar. We recommend that you buy the Japanese maples you want immediately as we often sell out of certain selections.

descriptions_zh.preferred: Acer palmatum 'Ramona'，珍稀日本枫，适生区 5-9。‘Ramona’ 是一个全新的日本枫选育品种，很快就会成为你的心头好之一。春季新梢呈鲜亮的橙红色，外观有些类似 ‘Ueno yama’，到春季中期会逐渐转绿。‘Ramona’ 真正开始出彩是在晚春到初夏阶段，较老的绿色叶片会越来越偏黄绿色，直至黄色；与此同时，珊瑚粉色的新梢不断抽发，与黄叶形成鲜明而富有变化的对比。‘Ramona’ 预计 10 年可长至高、宽各 6-8 英尺，株形直立。这个新品种在 MrMaple 这里非常引人注目，相信你也会喜欢这株美树。数量有限！！由于我们拥有上千个日本枫品种，单个品种通常库存不多。

descriptions.preferred: This outstanding dissectum from the Fratelli Gilardelli Nursery near Milan, Italy, is noted for the varying tones of green of the summer foliage with bronzed and redtinged new leaves at the shoot tips. The new leaves to about 1 mm at the leaf base. The green petioles are 3.5-4 cm long. This cultivar forms a broad cascading mound up to 3-4 m tall with a spread of 4-5 m.

descriptions.preferred: This deep purple-red dissectum, selected at Duncan and Davies Nursery in New Zealand by Graham Roberts, keeps its deep color, in sun or shade, better than any other red dissectum such as 'Dissectum Nigrum', 'Garnet', 'Inaba shidare', and even 'Crimson Queen'. Though the young foliage of 'Tamuke yama' is an even darker shade, it does not hold its color as well as 'Red Dragon'. The young leaves of this cultivar are a bright scarlet in the spring, becoming a dark burgundy as they develop. This rich coloring is retained throughout the growing season until it changes to an outstanding flaming scarlet again in the fall. The deeply cut seven-lobed leaves are slightly wider than long, 9-11 cm across and 8-9 cm long. The lobes themselves are deeply incised right to the leaf base and, with the sublobes, are 1-2 cm wide at the broadest point in the middle, narrowing to less than 1 mm—the width of the midrib—toward the leaf base. The sublobe margins have coarse, sharply pointed and hooked double teeth. The slender purple petioles are 2-3 cm long. The growth habit is like a dwarfer form of 'Crimson Queen', a compact well-branched cascading mound, reaching 2.5 m high. 'Red Dragon' needs protection from cold wind and summer drought, but makes an excellent small garden, rock garden, container, or bonsai plant. Although 'Crimson Queen' is probably the standard by which new red dissectum cultivars are judged, 'Red Dragon' may well prove to be the standard in the future.

sources.title: 红龙 Acer Palmatum 'Red Dragon'
sources.description: 红龙由 Graham Roberts于1991年在新西兰 的 Duncan and Davies苗圃挑选 ，无论在阳光下还是 阴凉处，它都 能 比任何其他红色 羽毛枫 更好地保持 深红色 。 春天叶子是明亮的 猩红色 ，春末 变成深紫红色 ，这个色彩可以一直持续到夏天，若夏季做遮阴措施，会偶有返绿现象。 到了秋天又变成了引人注目的火红 色 。 其生长习性 类似于 " 绯红皇后（ Crimson Queen ） "的矮化形式 ，会长成 一个紧凑、分枝良好的层叠 型小 土丘 ，成年高度 2.5米左右。红龙喜欢充足的阳光，耐霜冻，但需要防 寒风和夏季干旱 。非常适合盆景和小花园种植 。

rhs.description: Forms a compact, well-branched, cascading mound of deciduous foliage to about 2.5m in height, with dissected, deeply cut and sharply pointed, 7 lobed leaves, bright scarlet in spring, darkening to deep burgundy, a colour retained until autumn when the leaves change to flaming scarlet. Inconspicuous red-purple flowers in spring may be followed by winged, purple fruits

attributes.suggested_uses: City/Courtyard Gardens, Cottage/Informal Garden, Flower borders and beds, Patio/Container Plants, Rock Garden
attributes.hort_group_description: Acers in this dissectum group have fine, feathery, deeply divided leaves with finely serrated edges

care.cultivation: Grow in any moisture-retentive, well-drained soil in a sheltered position. Leaf colour is best in partial shade, although full sun can be tolerated if soil is reliably moist. Leaf scorch can be caused by lack of soil moisture or excessive exposure. Suits container cultivation but attention to watering is needed in dry spells during the growing season. Suitable for bonsai cultivation . See Japanese maples cultivation
care.pruning: Pruning group 1 from late autumn to midwinter only
care.propagation: Propagate by layering in autumn, grafting in late winter or softwood cuttings

resistance.pest: May be susceptible to Acer gall mite, aphids , caterpillars and horse chestnut scale
resistance.disease: May be susceptible to Verticillium wilt , Acer leaf scorch and honey fungus

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这一深紫红色的 dissectum 品种由新西兰 Duncan and Davies Nursery 的 Graham Roberts 选育而来，无论在日照下还是半阴处，其深色保持性都优于其他红叶羽裂型品种，如 'Dissectum Nigrum'、'Garnet'、'Inaba shidare'，甚至优于 'Crimson Queen'。虽然 'Tamuke yama' 的嫩叶颜色更深，但保色性不如 'Red Dragon'。本品种春季新叶鲜猩红色，随着叶片成熟转为深酒红色，这种浓郁色彩在整个生长季都能保持，至秋季又变为极为出色的火焰猩红色。叶片深裂，通常七裂，略宽于长，宽 9-11 厘米、长 8-9 厘米。各裂片自叶基即深裂，并连同次级裂片一起，在中部最宽处宽 1-2 厘米，向叶基逐渐收窄至不足 1 毫米，几乎仅余中脉宽度。次级裂片边缘具粗大、尖锐且向内钩曲的重锯齿。细长的紫色叶柄长 2-3 厘米。株形类似更矮化的 'Crimson Queen'，为紧凑、分枝良好的下垂圆 mound，株高可达 2.5 米。'Red Dragon' 需要避开寒冷风害和夏季干旱，但非常适合作为小庭园、岩石园、容器栽培或盆景植物。尽管 'Crimson Queen' 可能仍是衡量新红叶羽裂品种的标准，但 'Red Dragon' 未来很可能成为新的标准。

care.pruning: 修剪第 1 组：仅限在晚秋至仲冬期间进行。
care.propagation: 可于秋季行压条繁殖，于晚冬进行嫁接，或采用软枝扦插繁殖。
care.cultivation: 宜栽植于保水性好且排水良好的土壤中，位置以避风为佳。叶色在半阴环境下表现最佳；若土壤能稳定保持湿润，也可耐全日照。土壤缺水或暴晒过度都可能导致叶灼。适合容器栽培，但在生长季干燥时期需特别注意浇水。亦适合制作盆景。另请参见 Japanese maples 的栽培说明。

resistance.pest: 可能易受槭瘿螨、蚜虫、毛虫和七叶树介壳虫危害
resistance.disease: 可能易感黄萎病、槭叶焦枯病和蜜环菌病

rhs_zh.description: 形成紧凑、分枝良好、瀑布状下垂的落叶堆丘形株丛，高约 2.5 米。叶片细裂，裂刻很深，先端尖锐，具 7 个裂片；春季呈鲜亮猩红色，随后加深为深酒红色，并能保持到秋季，届时叶色转为火焰般的猩红色。春季开不显眼的红紫色花，之后可能结紫色翅果。

attributes.suggested_uses: 城市/庭院花园、乡村风格/自然式花园、花境与花坛、庭院/容器植物、岩石园
attributes.hort_group_description: dissectum 组的槭树具有细致、羽毛状、深裂的叶片，叶缘具细锯齿。

descriptions.preferred: Harold Johnston of Tallassee, Alabama, discovered this interesting red dwarf cultivar as a sport on 'Skeeter's Broom'. It is notable for the irregularity of the lobes, which curve and twist and vary from relatively wide lobes to stringlike lobes similar to those of 'Koto-no-ito'. The deeply divided, mainly narrow lobes, varying in shape fromlong-ovatetostraplike,2-10mmwide,somecupped upwards from the midrib. The leaves themselves are 2.5-4 cm long and 3-5 cm wide, but they can reach up to 8 cm wide. The teeth on the margins increase in coarseness with the size and width of the lobes. The petioles are 1.5-3 cm long. The leaves are red when given adequate light, the color persisting well into the fall. However, they green up readily in shaded situations. This cultivar is a bonsai enthusiast's or collector's plant due to its slow growth, curious leaves, and growth habit. A five-year-old plant has reached only 25 cm high with a spread of 20 cm. Its mature height is estimated at up to 1 m, with a similar spread.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 阿拉巴马州 Tallassee 的 Harold Johnston 在 ‘Skeeter's Broom’ 上发现了这一有趣的红叶矮生芽变品种。它最显著的特点是裂片形态不规则，常弯曲扭转，宽窄变化较大，从相对较宽的裂片到类似 ‘Koto-no-ito’ 那样的线状裂片均可出现。叶片深裂，裂片多较狭窄，形状从长卵形到带状不等，宽 2–10 mm，部分裂片自中脉处略向上杯状卷起。叶片本身长 2.5–4 cm，宽 3–5 cm，但有时宽度可达 8 cm。随着裂片尺寸和宽度增加，叶缘锯齿也会更为粗大。叶柄长 1.5–3 cm。在光照充足条件下叶色为红色，并能较好保持至秋季；但在遮阴环境中容易返绿。由于其生长缓慢、叶形奇特且株型独特，该品种很适合盆景爱好者或收藏者栽培。5 年生植株仅高 25 cm、幅宽 20 cm。成熟株预计高可达 1 m，冠幅相近。

descriptions.preferred: The leaves of this outstanding red dissectum must be seen to be appreciated. Description will hardly do it justice. It is one of the most finely cut lace-leaved maples. The uniform color is a deep purple red or maroon. The foliage retains this color extremely well throughout the entire growing season. In the fall, it becomes a bright crimson. The leaves are seven lobed. However, each lobe is extremely lacy, being more delicately dissected than the type. The lobes are extremely pinnatifid, with the center of the lobe being no wider than the midrib—1 mm or lobes lying close together, the effect is certainly filigreelike. The leaves measure 6-8 cm long and 7-9 cm wide. The petioles are stiff and 1-2 cm long. The growth has the pendulous habit of the dissectums and is sturdy in spite of the fineness of some twigs. The overall effect is one of extreme beauty. The rate of growth is not quite as fast as in other dissectums. This cultivar is considered one of the most beautiful and unusual introductions of the Dissectum Group. It was a chance seedling grown by William Curtis of Sherwood, Oregon, from seed of a dissectum in his garden. As a yearling, it was given to William Goddard of Victoria, British Columbia. Goddard cultured and nurtured the plant for a number of years and finally sold it to John Mitsch of Aurora, Oregon. In the late 1980s, the plants and ownership were transferred to Iseli Nursery, Boring, Oregon, which built up stock and distributed it to growers and collectors. Iseli Nursery found stick budding was the best way to propagate this cultivar because of the smallness and thinness of the scion material. It was very fortunate this plant was not lost, for it adds greatly to this magnificent series of cultivars. 'Ruby Lace' is very similar to 'Red Filigree Lace', and it is very difficult to pick out any differences, if any, between them. Another name used for 'Red Filigree Lace' is 'Red Lace'.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这一杰出的红叶羽裂品种，其叶片之美须亲眼所见方能体会，文字描述难尽其妙。它是最精细裂叶的 lace-leaved maple 之一。整体叶色均匀，为深紫红色或栗酒红色，并且在整个生长季中都能极好地保持这种色彩。秋季则转为鲜亮深红色。叶片为 7 裂，但每一裂片都极其纤细蕾丝状，比典型类型分裂得更为细密。裂片深羽状分裂，裂片中央宽度几乎不超过中脉，仅约 1 mm；各细裂小片彼此贴近时，整体效果极具金银丝工般的精致感。叶长 6–8 cm，宽 7–9 cm。叶柄坚挺，长 1–2 cm。植株具 Dissectum Group 典型的下垂生长习性，尽管部分小枝十分纤细，但整体仍较健壮。其总体观感极为优美。生长速度略慢于其他羽裂品种。该品种被认为是 Dissectum Group 中最美丽且最不寻常的引种之一。它是俄勒冈州 Sherwood 的 William Curtis 用自家花园中一株羽裂枫的种子培育出的偶然实生苗。幼苗一岁时被赠予不列颠哥伦比亚省维多利亚的 William Goddard。Goddard 栽培养护多年后，最终将其售予俄勒冈州 Aurora 的 John Mitsch。20 世纪 80 年代末，这一品种的植株与所有权转移至俄勒冈州 Boring 的 Iseli Nursery，后者扩繁库存并分发给种植者和收藏者。Iseli Nursery 发现，由于接穗材料细小而薄，贴枝芽接是繁殖该品种的最佳方法。幸而这一植株未曾失传，因为它极大丰富了这一卓越的品种系列。‘Ruby Lace’ 与 ‘Red Filigree Lace’ 极为相似，几乎难以辨别两者之间是否存在差异。‘Red Filigree Lace’ 的另一个名称是 ‘Red Lace’。

descriptions.preferred: This cultivar has very vivid red new foliage which turns to a dark purple red and holds its color well throughout the summer, especially in full sun, though the leaves become green-hued by late summer. All new leaves appearing during the summer have the vivid red of the spring foliage and contrast well with the darker red background of older leaves. The leaves have five or seven lobes, are divided two-thirds to three-quarters of the way to the leaf base, and measure 7-9 cm long and 9-10 cm wide. Each lobe is ovate with a pointed tip, and the margins are finely and evenly double toothed. The strong red petioles are about 3 cm long. This moderately strong grower reaches only 4-5 m high so is suitable for smaller gardens. It is often multistemmed and forms a mediumsized upright bush or tree. 'Red Flash' originated at the Fratelli Gilardelli Nursery near Milan, Italy. the leaf measuring 5-9 cm long but only 2-4 mm wide. The lobes separate entirely to the leaf base. The total spread of the leaf is 10-14 cm. The effect of these delicate leaves is lacelike. The petioles are 2-3 cm long. On oneor two-year-old wood of a vigorous tree, the leaf size is larger and the lobes broader with toothed margins, while leaves on older wood tend to be quite a bit smaller and almost untoothed. It should be noted that on current-year wood, when the growth is vigorous, the leaves almost approach the typical palmatum form, a common occurrence in many cultivars of the Linearilobum Group. Some people think the cultivar is reverting and prune off this vigorous growth. This is a mistake, for the cultivar will produce its typical foliage in the next season. The spring and early summer coloration of red maroon holds quite well through the hot weather. In late summer it deepens into a more purplish tone. In direct sun it bronzes with green undertones somewhat late in the season. However, the color holds much better and sunburns less than the color of the older standard cultivar 'Atrolineare'. Older plants tend to broaden and become roundtopped, and are smaller and less upright or rangy than other linearilobums, such as 'Atrolineare'. They reach 2 m high and 1.5-2 m wide after 20-25 years. 'Red Pygmy' makes a delightful contrast in shape and tone when combined with other forms. plant in an old garden in northern Italy.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 该品种春季新叶呈非常鲜艳的红色，随后转为深紫红色，整个夏季保色性很好，尤其在全日照条件下表现更佳，不过到夏末叶色会略带绿色。夏季新抽生的叶片仍保持春叶那种鲜艳的红色，与较老叶片形成的深红背景对比鲜明。叶片具 5 或 7 个裂片，裂至叶基的约 2/3 至 3/4 处，长 7 至 9 厘米，宽 9 至 10 厘米。各裂片为卵形，先端尖，边缘具细密而均匀的重锯齿。强健的红色叶柄长约 3 厘米。该品种生长势中等偏强，但株高仅达 4 至 5 米，因此适合较小型庭院。常呈多干状，形成中等大小的直立灌木或小乔木。'Red Flash' 起源于意大利米兰附近的 Fratelli Gilardelli 苗圃。 其叶片长 5 至 9 厘米，但裂片宽仅 2 至 4 毫米，裂片完全分离至叶基，整片叶展开宽度为 10 至 14 厘米，这种纤细叶形呈现出蕾丝般的效果。叶柄长 2 至 3 厘米。在生长旺盛树体的一至二年生枝上，叶片会更大、裂片更宽，且边缘具锯齿；而老枝上的叶片则往往明显较小，且几乎无锯齿。需要注意的是，在当年生旺盛枝条上，叶片形态几乎会接近典型的 palmatum 型，这在 Linearilobum Group 的许多品种中都很常见。有些人认为这是品种返祖而将这些强旺枝剪除，但这是错误的，因为该品种在下一生长季仍会恢复其典型叶形。春季至初夏的栗红色叶色在炎热天气下保持性相当好；到夏末则加深为更偏紫的色调。在直射日光下，季末会带有一些铜色与绿色底调。不过，它的叶色保持性明显优于老的标准品种 'Atrolineare'，且日灼也较少。老株往往会逐渐变宽，形成圆头状，整体比其他 linearilobum 品种（如 'Atrolineare'）更矮小，也不那么直立或松散。栽培 20 至 25 年后，株高约 2 米，冠幅约 1.5 至 2 米。'Red Pygmy' 与其他不同株形、不同色调的品种搭配种植时，对比效果十分出色。该品种源自意大利北部一座老花园中的植株。

Still relatively new to the American market, ‘Red Flash’ shows tremendous promise. descriptions.preferred: This singular linearilobum from Canada has remarkably uniform leaves in shape, size, and color. They are an even robust red which lasts well into the fall, when the color changes to a vibrant sanguine-red. The five-lobed straplike leaves are 6.5-7 cm long and 7-8 cm wide, with the basal lobes stretched outward to form a flat leaf base or angled slightly forward. The long-ovate lobes are a little "chunkier" than those of most strap-leaved forms, 4-5 mm wide, and are unusual in having numerous fine sharp-tipped teeth along the entire margins. 'Red Spider' forms an upright small tree, reaching 4 m or so high, with horizontal branches whose tips tend to curve down to give a graceful lacy effect.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这一来自加拿大的独特 Linearilobum 品种，在叶形、叶片大小和叶色上都表现出极高的一致性。叶色为均匀而浓健的红色，可良好保持到秋季，随后转为鲜艳的血红色。五裂的带状叶长 6.5-7 厘米、宽 7-8 厘米，基部裂片向外平展，形成平坦的叶基，或略向前伸。长卵形裂片比多数带叶型品种略显宽厚，宽 4-5 毫米，其特别之处在于全缘布满细密而尖锐的小齿。'Red Spider' 形成直立的小乔木，高约可达 4 米，枝条水平伸展，枝端略下弯，呈现优雅的蕾丝状效果。

descriptions.preferred: Acer palmatum 'Right Fred' Deep Maroon-Purple Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 Acer palmatum 'Right Fred' is a stunning deciduous tree that is sure to make a statement in any garden or landscape. In the spring, with its upright form and broad shape, this tree is a great choice for adding structure and height to a planting scheme. The leaves of 'Right Fred' are a beautiful purple-red color are accented by prominent dark veins. This gives a nice reticulated "ghost-like" variegation on a dark purple leaf. As the fall season arrives, the leaves turn a range of colors from orange to scarlet, providing a stunning display of autumnal hues. To thrive, 'Right Fred' prefers a sunny or partly shaded location with well-drained soil to hold its variegation longer into the season. descriptions.preferred: Acer palmatum 'Rikuzen shidare' Rare Weeping Japanese Maple From Japan Zones 5-9 ‘Rikuzen shidare’ is a selection of Japanese maple with the large green leaves of the Acer amoenum. The habit is unlike many with such large leaves. ‘ Rikuzen shidare’ is extremely weeping. Like many amazing selections from Japan, this tree originated at a temple. Noticed by many as being unique, the original tree stood at temple in the Rikuzen province of Japan. From what I can best understand, in 2011, a tsunami hit the area and destroyed the original tree. Luckily some nurseryman had grafted this selection, which saved this tree from being completely lost. Unlike ‘Ryusen’, ‘ Rikuzen shidare’ has leaves similar to the size of ‘Osakazuki’, but instead of turning red in the fall, ‘ Rikuzen shidare’ turns to bright shade of yellow. When we visited Minoh Park in Japan, we learned something incredible about Japanese maples with yellow fall color. According to expert Setsuko Hisakuni, the Japanese maples with large leaves and yellow fall color make the best fried maples leaves, known as momiji tempura. Apparently, the red fall color creates a bitter taste, which the Japanese maples with yellow fall color avoid. While not everyone has room to grow a large growing green Japanese maple with yellow fall color to try to grow your own tree for fried momiji tempura, the smaller weeping habit of ‘ Rikuzen shidare’ allows anyone to grow their own in a smaller container. We recommend staking ‘ Rikuzen shidare’ for the best shape. The main photo is 'Rikuzen shidare' in a 15 gallon size container showing fall color in Japan. Limited Quantities Available !! As we have over a thousand cultivars of Japanese maples, we often do not have many of each cultivar. descriptions_zh.preferred: Acer palmatum 'Rikuzen shidare'，来自日本的珍稀垂枝日本枫，适生区 5-9。‘Rikuzen shidare’ 是一个日本枫选育品种，具有 Acer amoenum 类型的大型绿色叶片。它的树形与许多同样具大叶的品种不同，呈极强的下垂姿态。和许多来自日本的优秀品种一样，这棵树最初出自寺庙。因其独特性受到关注，原始母树曾生长在日本陆前国的一座寺庙中。据目前可知，2011 年当地海啸摧毁了原树。幸运的是，已有苗圃业者提前对该品种进行了嫁接繁殖，使这一品种得以保存，没有彻底失传。与 ‘Ryusen’ 不同，‘Rikuzen shidare’ 的叶片大小更接近 ‘Osakazuki’，但秋季不是转红，而是转为明亮的黄色。我们在日本箕面公园访问时，了解到关于黄秋色日本枫的一件很有意思的事。根据专家 Setsuko Hisakuni 的说法，叶片较大且秋色为黄色的日本枫最适合制作炸枫叶，也就是 momiji tempura。红叶秋色会带来苦味，而黄叶秋色的日本枫则可避免这一点。并非每个人都有空间栽培大型绿叶黄秋色日本枫来尝试自制炸 momiji tempura，但 ‘Rikuzen shidare’ 较小的垂枝习性，使任何人都可以在较小容器中栽培它。我们建议对 ‘Rikuzen shidare’ 进行支撑牵引，以获得最佳树形。主图为日本一株 15 加仑容器规格的 ‘Rikuzen shidare’，展示其秋季叶色。数量有限！！由于我们拥有上千个日本枫品种，单个品种通常库存不多。

descriptions.preferred: Originating as a witches' 'Rubrum' broom on Acer palmatum f. atropurpureum in Amoenum New Jersey, 'Royle' has small irregularly shaped this leaves which are divided into five to seven lobes halfway and bunched together. This dwarf forms a small points rounded ball which eventually reaches 5 ft. (1.5 color m) tall. The autumn color is a brilliant crimson. dark Synonym, 'Royal'. bronze Group—red. The seven ovate lobes of large-leaved cultivar are separated over to the base. The lobes taper to sharp and have slightly toothed margins. The is lighter in early spring, becoming a rich, maroon-red in late spring and green-red or in the summer. Fall color is a strong crim- Gregory. son. This hardy, strong-growing, upright tree has a broadly spreading crown as it matures. It reaches 13 ft. (4 m) high and is even wider than high. The name means "red."

descriptions_zh.preferred: 该品种起源于新泽西州 Amoenum 的 Acer palmatum f. atropurpureum 上一个 witches' broom（丛生芽变）‘Rubrum’。‘Royle’ 叶片较小、形状不规则，分为 5 至 7 裂，约裂至叶片中部，并簇生在一起。该矮生品种形成小型、近圆球形的株型，最终高约 5 英尺（1.5 米）。秋色为鲜艳的深红色。其异名有 ‘Royal’。归为红叶类。另据可辨识内容，某大叶品种具 7 个卵形裂片，裂片几乎分离至叶基，先端渐尖，边缘略具细齿；春初叶色较浅，晚春转为浓郁的栗红色，夏季则呈绿红色或青铜色，秋色为强烈的深红色。该植株耐寒、生长强健、直立，成熟后树冠宽展，高约 13 英尺（4 米），冠幅甚至可大于株高。其名称意为“红色”。

products.description_text: Acer palmatum ' Royle ' Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 Acer palmatum 'Royle' is a beautiful cultivar of the Japanese Maple. The deeply lobed leaves display a stunning red to purple color in the spring and summer, transitioning to brilliant shades of orange and red in the fall. This small to medium-sized tree typically reaches a height of 10-15 ft and a spread of about 10-12 ft over 10 years. 'Royle', sometimes misspelled as 'Royal' was found by our good friend, Billy Schwartz, as a witches broom mutation on red Japanese maple in Neshanic Station, NJ in the center of town. descriptions.preferred: The typical dissectum leaves are a different red from most of the purple reds of the group. It is more brown red or rust red, with the green main veins showing in each dissected lobe. This color is retained well into the summer and then changes to a rich dark green. In the fall, the leaves become a rich gold with occasional crimson edges. The leaves are about normal size for dissectums and typically double pinnatifid. Their length varies from 7 to 10 cm. The petioles are 5-10 cm long and the slender shoots are red. The bark on this cultivar is a powdery green with minute white striations. This fairly strong-growing dissectum develops the typical dome shape to 3 m high. It grows reasonably fast at first and becomes pendulous with maturity. Although it is one of the lesser-known cultivars, yet it has been known under several names, including 'Adlerschwanz', 'Akashigata', 'Dissectum Rubellum', 'Dissectum Rubrifolium', 'Dissectum Tinctum', and 'Rubellum'. 'Rubrifolium' is preferred to 'Akashigata' (Akashi Bay) because it has been an established name in Western culture for about 100 years. It is also preferred to 'Dissectum Rubrifolium' because Friedrich A. W. Miquel was referring to a wild form when he originally named Acer palmatum f. dissectum rubrifolium, and so seems unlikely lium' because its description is so similar that it would be difficult to differentiate the two. The only observable difference appears to be that the leaves have a greenish tinge with a light edging of red in 'Dissectum Rubrum'.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这种典型的 Dissectum 叶色与该组大多数紫红色品种不同，更偏棕红或锈红色，每个细裂裂片中都可见绿色主脉。该叶色能良好保持到夏季中期，随后转为浓深绿色。秋季叶片变为浓金色，边缘偶尔带深红色。叶片大小约为 Dissectum 类的常规水平，通常为二回羽状深裂，长度约 7-10 厘米。叶柄长 5-10 厘米，细长新梢为红色。该品种树皮为粉绿色，并有细微白色条纹。这个生长势较强的 Dissectum 最终会形成典型的圆 dome 株形，高可达 3 米。幼年期生长速度较快，成熟后枝条转为下垂。虽然它是较少为人所知的品种之一，但曾以多个名称流通，包括 'Adlerschwanz'、'Akashigata'、'Dissectum Rubellum'、'Dissectum Rubrifolium'、'Dissectum Tinctum' 和 'Rubellum'。相较于 'Akashigata'（Akashi Bay），“'Rubrifolium'”更被优先采用，因为这一名称在西方园艺界已使用约 100 年。它也优先于 'Dissectum Rubrifolium'，因为 Friedrich A. W. Miquel 当初命名 Acer palmatum f. dissectum rubrifolium 时指的是一个野生类型，因此似乎不太可能适用于该栽培品种。它也优先于 'Dissectum Rubrum'，因为两者描述极为相似，难以区分。唯一可观察到的差异似乎是：'Dissectum Rubrum' 的叶片带轻微绿色调，并有淡红色镶边。

descriptions.preferred: This large-leaved cultivar has seven ovate lobes separated more than halfway to the leaf base. The lobes taper to a sharp point and have slightly serrated margins. The leaves range in size from 9 to 12 cm long and wide. The petioles are about 4 cm long. The leaves are a dark maroon-red. The color is lighter as they first unfold but assumes the very rich tones in late spring and into summer. In late summer the leaves turn green red or bronze. Fall color is a strong crimson. Thisstrong-growing,uprighttreehasabroadlyspreading crown as it matures. The branches are sturdy, and it is a hardy cultivar. It reaches 4 m high and more in width. Some early references equate this cultivar with 'Sanguineum', but 'Rubrum' is consistently darker in color. This cultivar has also been known under the name 'Septemlobum Rubrum'.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 该大叶品种具 7 个卵形裂片，裂片分离深度超过叶片至叶基距离的一半。裂片先端渐尖，边缘略具锯齿。叶片长宽约 9-12 厘米，叶柄约 4 厘米长。叶色为深栗红色，初展时颜色较浅，到晚春及夏季则转为极为浓郁的色调。夏末叶色转为绿红色或青铜色。秋色为浓烈的深红色。该品种生长强健、树姿直立，成熟后形成宽展树冠。枝条粗壮，耐寒性好。株高可达 4 米，冠幅更宽。早期资料有时将该品种与 ‘Sanguineum’ 视为同物，但 ‘Rubrum’ 的叶色始终更深。该品种也曾以 ‘Septemlobum Rubrum’ 之名流通。

descriptions.preferred: Acer japonicum 'Ruby' 红宝石是一种小而直立的大叶羽 团扇枫树。春天叶子会呈现橄榄绿，然后在晚春变亮， 在夏天变成青铜绿色，在秋天展现出最惊人的橙色、红 色和紫色色调，生长缓慢，成年树高约 2.5 米。

descriptions_zh.preferred: Acer palmatum 'Ruby de Sofia' 淡粉色粉彩网斑锦日本枫，适生分区 5-9。'Ruby de Sofia' 是较新的引种品种，极具独特性。春季展叶时，叶片呈淡粉至白色的网状锦斑；入夏后叶色转绿。其树形尤为特别，枝条常呈钩状，整体具拱形并略带扭曲感。每当枝条形成弯钩时，枝干上会形成类似红宝石结节的外观。这些圆润的节状形态以及秋季的宝石红叶色，正是 'Ruby de Sofia' 名称中“Ruby”的由来。该品种由我们的好友 Angel Mendoza 发现，并以其女儿 Sofia 命名。带有 MrMaple 标志的照片归 MrMaple.com 所有，未经明确书面许可不得使用。数量有限。由于我们拥有上千个日本枫品种，单个品种通常库存不多；部分选育品种常会很快售罄，建议尽早购买心仪品种。

products.description_text: Acer palmatum 'Ruby Lace' is a gorgeous lace leaf Japanese maple with a bright, ruby red color to the foliage in the spring. This color does fade a bit in the summer. The leaves turn to a bright yellow to orange in the fall, which is a very unusual fall color for a Japanese maple with red spring foliage. 'Ruby Lace' is a fast growing lace leaf Japanese maple with a low, spreading habit. 10 Year Size: Height: 3-5 feet Width: 5-7 feet

descriptions.preferred: 与'Beni Hoshi' 为异名同株， 起源于 1979 年， 1992 年由 Del Loucks 引入日本枫树苗圃，并在 1996 年推出，通常以 'Beni Hoshi' 出售，翻译为 "红宝石之星"。 春叶为亮红色， 带有一层油膜感，后续转为深栗色， 夏季变为 桃橙色，遮阴情况下，变成绿色，新稍为红色，秋天为亮黄色到橙色。成熟叶子圆润，像一个胖乎乎的星星，叶形略扭曲，一般为 7 裂叶。 直立性矮生品种，生长速度较慢，成年株可达1.5 m 。

sources.title: 红宝石之星 Acer Palmatum 'Ruby Star'
sources.description: 与'Beni Hoshi' 为异名同株， 起源于 1979 年， 1992 年由 Del Loucks 引入日本枫树苗圃，并在 1996 年推出，通常以 'Beni Hoshi' 出售，翻译为 "红宝石之星"。 春叶为亮红色， 带有一层油膜感，后续转为深栗色， 夏季变为 桃橙色，遮阴情况下，变成绿色，新稍为红色，秋天为亮黄色到橙色。成熟叶子圆润，像一个胖乎乎的星星，叶形略扭曲，一般为 7 裂叶。 直立性矮生品种，生长速度较慢，成年株可达1.5 m 。

descriptions.preferred: The color of 'Rufescens' is rather distinctive when grown near other red cultivars. The unfolding leaves are quite separate at least two-thirds of the way to the leaf base. Each leaf is about 7 cm long and 6-7 cm wide. Each lobe is elongate-elliptic, gradually tapering to a slender, sharp point. The lobes are only 1-1.5 cm wide in the middle. The long center lobes tend to hold closely together. The margins are sharply and distinctly toothed. The slender petioles are up to 5 cm long. This cultivar is not vigorous but makes a tall bush of 4 m after many years. Although described by J. A. Siesmayer in 1888, it is not widely known. Unfortunately, the name 'Rufescens' has been applied to different clones at different times, so there is uncertainty about some specimens in collections.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 'Rufescens' 在与其他红叶品种并植时，叶色显得相当独特。其展开中的叶片彼此分离明显，至少有三分之二的长度一直分离到接近叶基处。每片叶长约 7 厘米、宽 6-7 厘米。各裂片为狭长椭圆形，逐渐收尖成细长锐尖。裂片中部仅宽 1-1.5 厘米，较长的中央裂片往往彼此靠拢。叶缘具清晰而锐利的锯齿。细长叶柄最长可达 5 厘米。该品种长势不强，但多年后可形成高达 4 米的高大灌木。尽管 J. A. Siesmayer 早在 1888 年即已描述此品种，但其知名度并不高。遗憾的是，名称 'Rufescens' 在不同时期曾被用于不同无性系，因此收藏中的部分材料存在鉴定上的不确定性。

descriptions.preferred: This somewhat peculiar large-leaved cultivar, although it cannot be classed as beautiful, is of interest because it is unusual and because of the dramatic change from an ugly duckling in summer to almost a beautiful princess in the fall. The leaves are of a dull bronzed army green with somewhat rough and wrinkled (rugose) surfaces for most of the summer, but with contrasting beet-red midveins and petioles. The leaves change to a stunning plum red to bright crimson in the fall. The shoots and branches are almost black. The medium-sized to large leaves are 8-10.5 cm long and 10-15 cm wide. The shape and coarse uneven-toothed margins. Lobes, even on the same leaf, are irregularly incised, mostly almost to the leaf base but varying from 4 to 20 mm or even further from the base. The sturdy petioles are 3.5-6 cm long. Like the leaves, the shoots can also twist and do strange things. Shrubby and upright in habit, this plant has an interesting way of twisting both the stem and branches as it grows—not enough to be called "tortuosa" but enough to notice. This cultivar was selected and named at Maplewood Nursery. The original seedling, now about 20 years old, is growing at Mountain Maples Nursery, Laytonville, California. It has been in a container all its life and is about 2 m tall. 'Rugose' has been misspelled 'Rugosa'.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这个颇为特别的大叶型品种，虽不能算作优美，却因其罕见性以及从夏季“丑小鸭”到秋季近乎“美丽公主”的戏剧性转变而颇具观赏价值。整个夏季叶片多为暗淡的青铜军绿色，叶面略粗糙并带皱缩感（rugose），但主脉和叶柄则呈对比鲜明的甜菜红色。秋季叶色转为惊艳的李子红至鲜亮的深红色。新梢和枝条近乎黑色。叶片中大型，长 8 至 10.5 厘米，宽 10 至 15 厘米，叶形及其粗大而不规则的锯齿叶缘都较为独特。裂片甚至在同一片叶上也会呈不规则深裂，大多几乎裂至叶基，但离叶基的距离变化很大，可从 4 至 20 毫米，甚至更远。粗壮叶柄长 3.5 至 6 厘米。与叶片相似，枝梢也会扭曲，呈现出一些奇特形态。株形为灌木状且直立，生长过程中主干和枝条都会产生有趣的扭转，虽不足以称为“tortuosa”，但已相当明显。该品种由 Maplewood Nursery 选出并命名。原始实生苗现约 20 年生，生长于美国加利福尼亚州 Laytonville 的 Mountain Maples Nursery；其一生都栽培于容器中，目前高约 2 米。'Rugose' 曾被误拼为 'Rugosa'。

products.description_text: Acer palmatum 'Rugose' Rare Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 'Rugose' is a unique Japanese maple that has extraordinary thick leathery leaves, thicker stems, and habit that makes many believe this Japanese maple has more chromosomes than your typical Acer palmatum. 'Rugose' is a selection that was found and introduced by the late great J.D. Vertrees, author of Japanese Maples. This selection has blue-green foliage in the spring, turning to orange and red in the fall. 'Rugose' is slower growing reach 6 ft in height in 10 years with a nice upright form. Add this unique beauty to your garden! Limited Quantities Available !! As we have over a thousand cultivars of Japanese maples, we often do not have many of each cultivar. descriptions.preferred: The green foliage of this variegate has white or yellowish irregular areas composed of small markings. The new growth in the spring develops with reddish or pinkish tones.Sometimesthenewgrowth(includingnewshoots) is quite pink, but less so than with certain other cultivars. Later, the leaves tend to become dull and the variegations are not as pronounced. The medium-sized leaves are flat-surfaced and usually about 5 cm long and broad. The lobes are five or seven, rather irregular, and not uniformly separated or divided, so that they vary somewhat in size. This upright-growing small tree or tall bush probably does not exceed 3 m at maturity. The growth is rather twiggy and multibranched.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 该斑叶品种的绿色叶面上分布有不规则的白色或微黄色斑区，由细小斑点组成。春季新梢和新叶萌发时常带红色或粉色调；有时新生长部位（包括新枝）会明显呈粉色，但不如某些其他品种那样强烈。之后叶色往往趋于暗淡，斑锦也不再十分明显。叶片中等大小，表面平展，通常长宽约 5 厘米。裂片为 5 裂或 7 裂，形态较不规则，分裂不均，因此大小略有变化。植株为直立生长的小乔木或高大灌木，成熟后可能不超过 3 米。枝条较细密，多分枝。

descriptions.preferred: This delightful dwarf is a compact little shrub which is popular for bonsai as well as for the rock garden. The leaf nodes are closely spaced on the twigs, and it forms a multibranched structure, reaching little more than 2 m at maturity. The leaves are tightly spaced, overlapping, and bunched, giving rise to the name 'Ryu\zu', which means "ornamental dragon's head." This cultivar has also been known under the name 'Tatsu gashira'. The new leaves have a faint shade of pink overlying the pale green. The pink soon disappears and the mature leaf is green. The margins are very prominently ser- When the leaf is seven lobed, the two basal lobes are very small. Each lobe is ovate, but gradually tapers to a long, sharp point. The edges of the lobes bend slightly upward, almost making a shallow trough. The leaf measures 3-4 cm, occasionally up to 5 cm long and broad. The stiff petioles are only about 1 cm long. Billy Schwartz of Downingtown, Pennsylvania, an expert on witches'brooms and dwarf maples, describes the leaves as ironed out 'Shishigashira' leaves, and the plant shape as a flattened globe.
