rhs.description: A compact shrubby tree forming a flattened globe of deciduous foliage to 2m tall, with tightly-spaced leaves composed of radiating 5-7 lobes, with prominently serrated margins, pale green flushed pale pink in spring, maturing to green in summer, turning warm orange-yellow in autumn

attributes.suggested_uses: City/Courtyard Gardens, Cottage/Informal Garden, Flower borders and beds, Patio/Container Plants, Rock Garden
attributes.hort_group_description: Acers in this dwarf group are compact and slow-growing, making them ideal for pots and containers

care.cultivation: Grow in any moisture-retentive, well-drained soil in a sheltered position. Leaf colour is best in partial shade, although full sun can be tolerated if soil is reliably moist. Leaf scorch can be caused by lack of soil moisture or excessive exposure. Suits container cultivation but attention to watering is needed in dry spells during the growing season. Suitable for bonsai cultivation . See Japanese maples cultivation
care.pruning: Pruning group 1 from late autumn to midwinter only
care.propagation: Propagate by layering in autumn, grafting in late winter or softwood cuttings

resistance.pest: May be susceptible to Acer gall mite, aphids , caterpillars and horse chestnut scale
resistance.disease: May be susceptible to Verticillium wilt , Acer leaf scorch and honey fungus

attributes.hort_group_description: 这一矮生类群的 Acer 株形紧凑、生长缓慢，因此非常适合盆栽和容器栽培。
attributes.suggested_uses: 城市/庭院花园、乡村风格/自然式花园、花境与花坛、庭院/容器植物、岩石园

care.pruning: 修剪第 1 组：仅限在晚秋至仲冬期间进行。
care.propagation: 可于秋季行压条繁殖，于晚冬进行嫁接，或采用软枝扦插繁殖。
care.cultivation: 宜栽植于保水性好且排水良好的土壤中，位置以避风为佳。叶色在半阴环境下表现最佳；若土壤能稳定保持湿润，也可耐全日照。土壤缺水或暴晒过度都可能导致叶灼。适合容器栽培，但在生长季干燥时期需特别注意浇水。亦适合制作盆景。另请参见 Japanese maples 的栽培说明。

resistance.pest: 可能易受槭瘿螨、蚜虫、毛虫和七叶树介壳虫危害
resistance.disease: 可能易感黄萎病、槭叶焦枯病和蜜环菌病

rhs_zh.description: 一类紧凑的灌木状小乔木，形成扁圆球形落叶树冠，高可达 2 米。叶片排列紧密，由向外放射的 5-7 裂片组成，叶缘具明显锯齿；春季为淡绿泛浅粉色，夏季转绿，秋季变为温暖的橙黄色。

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这一迷人的矮生品种为紧凑的小型灌木，既适合盆景，也深受岩石园爱好者欢迎。枝条上的叶节间很短，植株形成多分枝结构，成熟时高度通常仅略超过 2 米。叶片排列紧密、彼此重叠并簇生，因此得名 'Ryu\zu'，意为“装饰性的龙头”。该品种也曾以 'Tatsu gashira' 之名流通。新叶为淡绿色，上覆一层浅浅的粉色，粉色很快消退，成熟叶转为绿色。叶缘具非常明显的锯齿。叶片通常七裂时，基部两裂很小。各裂片呈卵形，并逐渐收为细长尖端；裂片边缘略向上卷，几乎形成浅槽。叶片长宽约 3-4 厘米，偶可达 5 厘米。坚挺的叶柄仅约 1 厘米长。宾夕法尼亚州 Downingtown 的女巫扫帚和矮生槭树专家 Billy Schwartz 形容其叶片像被熨平的 'Shishigashira' 叶，而株形则像扁平的球体。

descriptions.preferred: 日系小叶品种，春天叶子上有粉红色和白色的斑点，出 锦稳定，夏季绿色，秋天橙红橙黄色。耐寒，直立性较 强，长势缓慢，每年的生长高度在 1 米内，成年树约 1.5 米左右，适合小花园种植。

rhs.description: A small, slow-growing, weeping tree that can ultimately reach 2m tall and 1m across, with vertically hanging branches. The leaves are five-lobed, bright green, turning red, yellow and orange in autumn. Inconspicuous green flowers in spring are followed by red, winged fruit in autumn

attributes.suggested_uses: City/Courtyard Gardens, Cottage/Informal Garden, Patio/Container Plants

care.cultivation: Grows best in slightly acidic, humus-rich, well-drained soil, but tolerates most soils if improved with well-rotted organic matter . Hot, dry air, cold wind and late frost may cause leaf scorching. Mulch in autumn to protect shallow roots from cold and drying out. See Japanese maple cultivation
care.pruning: Pruning group 1
care.propagation: Propagate by semi-hardwood cuttings or by layering

resistance.pest: May be susceptible to Acer gall mite, aphids , caterpillars and horse chestnut scale
resistance.disease: May be susceptible to Verticillium wilt , Acer leaf scorch and honey fungus

care.cultivation: 在微酸性、富含腐殖质且排水良好的土壤中生长最佳，但若加入充分腐熟的有机质改良，也能适应多数土壤。炎热干燥的空气、寒风和晚霜可能导致叶片焦枯。秋季覆 mulch，可保护浅根免受寒害和干燥。参见 Japanese maple cultivation。

care.propagation: 可采用半成熟枝扦插或压条繁殖。

resistance.disease: 可能易感黄萎病、槭叶焦枯病和蜜环菌病

rhs_zh.description: 小型、缓慢生长的垂枝树形，最终可达高 2 米、宽 1 米，枝条向下垂挂。叶片 5 裂，鲜绿色，秋季转为红、黄、橙相间。春季开不显眼的绿色小花，秋季结红色翅果。

products.title: Acer palmatum 'Ryusen' Japanese Maple
products.description_text: Acer palmatum 'Ryusen' PP#18,501 Rare Weeping Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 Acer palmatum ‘Ryusen’ is an exciting new pendulous Japanese maple with palmate foliage and an amazing shape. A recent introduction from Kobayashi Nursery in Japan, this small, elegant tree adds a unique form with an exotic appeal to the landscape. This weeping Japanese maple was originally named 'Ryu sei', which translates as "dragon spirit". In early spring, ‘Ryusen’ displays bright shades of chartreuse green. The beautiful chartreuse green new growth accents older growth with smooth dark green foliage throughout the summer months. An amazing fall color change highlights this weeping maple form. The ‘Ryusen’ Japanese maple has autumn leaves that reach shades of bright reds to deep oranges. This amazing small form of weeping Japanese maple is extremely pendulous. This unique shape makes it extremely malleable to the creativity of the gardener. By growing ‘Ryusen’ will grow to its typical form and this tree reaches around 5-6 ft in 15 years. Staking a central leader can greatly change the form by adding height and unique branching. Your gardening creativity with ‘Ryusen’ can be as big (or small) as your imagination allows. We have even seen ‘Ryusen’ grown upside down from a hanging basket to add a new unique perspective to weeping Japanese maples. The weeping ‘Ryusen’ Japanese maple is very heat tolerant and durable. This elegant tree can handle full sun up to zone 8 and makes an excellent addition for zones 5-9. Yes, this vigorous tree does great with shade as well and brings amazing shape, color and texture. ‘Ryusen’ is great for: container patio planting, bonsai and small garden areas. As a staked tree, ‘Ryusen’ make a great focal point plants in the landscape. Add ‘Ryusen’ to a bank to provide a unique cascading beauty or near a water feature to accentuate its graceful pendulous form. This is a great choice for a durable and elegant tree that brings an exceptional unique form. The versatility of this Japanese maple truly gives the gardener a new way to explore creative options. If you are looking for a striking pendulous tree that brings big fall color, select the weeping ‘Ryusen’ Japanese maple for your garden today!

descriptions_zh.preferred: 裂片宽卵形，先端渐尖并具细长尖头，叶缘为重锯齿，叶柄长约 4-5 厘米。‘Sagara nishiki’ 形成紧凑的灌木或小乔木，高可达 2-3 米。夏季需半阴环境，以保护其美丽的斑锦，因叶片在强光下容易灼伤。该品种与 ‘Nishiki gasane’ 非常相似，但其斑锦颜色更浅，叶基较平截，裂片也更宽卵形。植株大小、株型和生长速度基本相同。‘Sagara nishiki’ 也曾以 ‘Yamato nishiki’ 之名流通。

descriptions.preferred: The large leaves of 'Samidare', whose name means "early summer rain," are of heavy texture and firm to the touch. When first unfolding in early spring, the tiny leaves are almost pink. Quite soon they turn a rich green with margins a light reddish tone. During summer the deep green holds well without burning, even in full sun. In the fall, a gold-green center develops, with the lobes turning purplish. Other combinations of gold and crimson blend in different leaves. The leaves have seven lobes, occasionally five lobes, and measure 6-8 cm long and 8-12 cm wide. The lobes radiate sharply outward and are strongly ovate, terminating in a blunt tip. They join less than halfway to the leaf base, making a large palm-shaped leaf. The margins are very finely toothed, almost smooth, with the outer third slightly larger toothed. The petioles are slender, firm, and 3.5-7 cm long. This hardy cultivar has thick and stiff twigs and young branches. It grows rapidly and upright at first but soon makes a short, broad tree as it slows down. It eventually reaches up to 6 m high and broad. It is a very durable garden plant which adds good color.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 'Samidare' 的叶片较大，名称意为“初夏之雨”，叶质厚实，触感坚挺。早春初展时，幼叶几乎呈粉色；不久即转为浓绿色，叶缘带浅红色调。夏季深绿色保持良好，即使全日照下也不易灼伤。秋季叶中心发展出金绿色，裂片则转为带紫色；不同叶片上还会交织出金色与深红色等其他色彩组合。叶片通常七裂，偶为五裂，长 6-8 厘米、宽 8-12 厘米。裂片明显向外辐射，呈强烈卵形，端部较钝；裂片连接处不到叶片长度的一半，因此形成宽大的掌状叶。叶缘锯齿极细，近乎平滑，仅外侧三分之一处的锯齿略明显。叶柄细长而坚实，长 3.5-7 厘米。该品种耐性好，嫩枝和幼枝粗壮而坚硬。初期生长迅速且直立，随后生长放缓，逐渐形成矮而宽的小乔木，最终可达高宽各 6 米。它是极为耐久的园艺品种，能为庭园提供良好的色彩表现。

products.title: Acer palmatum 'Samidare' Japanese Maple
products.description_text: Acer palmatum ' Samidare ' Exceptional Fall Color Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 'Samidare' is perhaps one of the closest selections to Acer amoenum in the wild in Japan. On my many trips to Japan in the fall, many of the larger leaf Japanese maples, which are primarily Acer amoenum, are a nice shade of green turning to yellow and orange in the fall. 'Samidare' does just that with grace and sophistication. This makes 'Samidare' a great tree for the garden, but also an excellent specimen for traditional Japanese gardening. It is often the green upright Japanese maples that give that nice summery fill in the landscape, that announce the changing of the seasons with phenomenal autumn color, that are used in traditional Japanese landscaping. 'Samidare' may reach 8-10 ft in 10 years making a great mid-size tree for any garden. It's durability and resilience make it an ideal selection for a variety of landscapes - from traditional Japanese gardening to modern gardens. Plus, it's easy to grow and provides outstanding autumn color, making it the perfect way to create a stunning seasonal backdrop. Limited Quantities Available !! descriptions.preferred: The brilliant coral color of the bark is the outstanding feature of this maple and gives it its name which means "coral tower." At times the color becomes almost fluorescent. The younger the wood, the stronger the color. It has long been a popular cultivar in the nursery trade, and wide. The margins are double serrated. On the strongest-growing new shoots, the leaves are at least 1 cm larger in each dimension. Leaf color is a bright tone of green. The edges of the new leaves have a strong reddish tinge which fades as the Archives, Corvallis ferred to this cultivar as dull during the fall season, but in the Pacific Northwest and in Europe it is quite showy almost every fall. This upright-growing tree gradually spreads at the top as it ages. It tends to become quite twiggy inside, but 'Sango kaku'. The winter bark coloration is an attractive feature of this cultivar. Archives, Corvallis Young plants grow quite fast for the first few years and then take on a multibranching and thickening habit of growth. Planted near the contrasting green-barked cultivar 'Aoyagi', the red-barked 'Sango kaku' makes a striking color combination for winter accent. This cultivar used to be well known by the name 'Senkaki' which is a synonym of 'Sango kaku'. It has also been known under the names 'Cinnabarinum', 'Cinnabar Wood Maple', and 'Coral Bark Maple'. In some areas the name 'Corallinum' has been applied to this maple because of the bark color. This is unfortunate and should be dropped because the name 'Corallinum' rightfully belongs to an entirely different cultivar noted for its brilliant pink-red spring foliage.

sources.title: 珊瑚阁 Acer Palmatum 'Sango Kaku'
sources.description: 树皮绚丽的珊瑚色是珊瑚阁的显著特征，它也因此得名。典型的 掌状 叶有 5到7裂，春天浅黄色的叶子带有红色的叶边缘，随着夏季临近，树叶变成明亮的绿色。 秋天， 叶子 颜色变成黄金色，混合着杏色和浅红色。 落叶后会露出树干， 枝上明亮的珊瑚红色树皮，为冬季景观增添一抹 亮丽的 色彩。 该品种曾经以 "Senkaki"这个名字而闻名，现在它已成为同义词 。 "Ebi-no-hige"是该品种的日语同义词。它也 曾 被称为 " Cinnabarinum " , " Cinnabar Wood Maple "和" Coral Bark Maple "。珊瑚阁 荣获英国皇家园艺学会(RHS) 花园优异奖 。成年树高可达 8米，非常适合当作庭院景观，与绿色和橙色树皮的枫树搭配种植。

descriptions_zh.preferred: 本品种最突出的特征是树皮鲜艳的珊瑚色，这也是其名称“coral tower（珊瑚塔）”的由来；有时其色泽甚至近乎荧光。枝条越幼嫩，色彩越强烈。它长期以来一直是苗圃业中很受欢迎的品种。叶缘为重锯齿。在生长最旺的新梢上，叶片各方向通常都至少大 1 厘米。叶色为明亮的绿色，新叶边缘带有明显的红色晕染，随后逐渐褪去。文中夹杂的档案/OCR 内容显示其秋色曾被描述为较暗淡，但在太平洋西北地区和欧洲，它几乎每年秋季都颇具观赏性。该树初期直立生长，随着树龄增加，顶部逐渐开展。树冠内部常会变得枝条细密。'Sango kaku' 的冬季枝皮着色尤具观赏价值。幼株在最初几年生长较快，随后形成多分枝并逐渐增粗的生长习性。若与绿皮品种 'Aoyagi' 混植，红皮的 'Sango kaku' 可构成醒目的冬季观枝色彩对比。该品种过去常以 'Senkaki' 之名流通，这是 'Sango kaku' 的异名。它还曾被称为 'Cinnabarinum'、'Cinnabar Wood Maple' 和 'Coral Bark Maple'。在一些地区，因树皮颜色也曾被称作 'Corallinum'，但这种用法并不恰当，应停止使用，因为 'Corallinum' 本应专指另一个以春季鲜亮粉红至红色叶著称的完全不同品种。

products.title: Acer palmatum 'Sango kaku' Coral Bark Japanese Maple
products.description_text: Acer palmatum 'Sango kaku' Coral Bark Sango kaku Japanese Maple Zones 6-9 ‘Sango kaku’ is a beautiful large coral bark Japanese maple. This Japanese maple tree has a spectacular bright red bark that stands out in any time of the year! The leaf of 'Sango kaku' in the early spring is a vibrant lush green and new growth often has light flushing of red on the edging. The fall color of ‘Sango kaku’ is a beautiful bright gold-yellow with hints of red splashed in. The golden-yellow contrast magnificently with the coral bark. ‘Sango kaku’ grows best in sun to filtered light. Heavy shade tends to wash out the bark color on some coral barks. ‘Sango kaku’ can reach up to 20-25 ft over time. It may surprise you to find out that we enjoy ‘Sango kaku’ the most after the leaves had dropped. The cool temperatures brighten the coral bark Japanese maple as it adds amazing color even late in winter after all the other garden colors are gone. The bright warm colors of the red bark stand out so nicely accompanied by snowfall and this is one of our personal favorite times to view the beauty of ‘Sango kaku’. This amazing coral bark Japanese maple tree is sure to add year-round color to your garden and become one of favorites to photograph in any season. Limited Quantities Available !! As we have over a thousand cultivars of Japanese maples, we often do not have many of each cultivar. We recommend that you buy the Japanese maples you want immediately as we often sell out of certain selections.

descriptions.preferred: This name has been applied so variously by authors during the nomenclatural history that its proper use is clouded and impossible to unravel. Primarily, it has been applied to a selection of Acer palmatum f. purpureum with blood-red or orange-red spring color rather than the darker or maroon-red tones. Since Charles Lemaire described it in 1867 as a "blood-red selection," some commercial nurseries have apparently propagated different forms, for variations under the name 'Sanguineum' are found in collections. Hence, the name should no longer be used, especially as there are several excellent red palmatum cultivars available. This cultivar has been known as 'Latifolium Purpureum', 'Rubro-latifolium', and 'Septemlobum Sanguineum'.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 在命名史上，不同作者对这一名称的使用极为混乱，其正确用法已难以厘清。它主要曾被用于指称 Acer palmatum f. purpureum 的一个选株，其春叶为血红色或橙红色，而非较深的暗红或栗红色调。Charles Lemaire 于 1867 年将其描述为“血红色选株”后，一些商业苗圃显然繁殖了不同类型，因此在各收藏中可见以 'Sanguineum' 为名的不同变异。故此名称现已不宜继续使用，尤其是在已有多个优良红叶掌状槭品种可供选择的情况下。该品种还曾以 'Latifolium Purpureum'、'Rubro-latifolium' 和 'Septemlobum Sanguineum' 之名流通。

products.title: Acer palmatum 'Sanguineum' Japanese Maple
products.description_text: Acer palmatum 'Sanguineum' Sanguineum Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 'Sanguineum' leafs out in the early spring as a bright orange-red on medium-sized rounded leaves. This Japanese maple is quite different, as most upright reds leaf out as a deeper maroon. As the summer approaches shades of chartreuse green begin to show up through a deeper red leaf. Fall colors are bright oranges to intense reds. 'Sanguinum' forms a great mid-sized upright Japanese maple that will reach 10 ft in 15 years. 'Sanguineum' is a beautiful Japanese maple selection that is often mislabeled. In fact, this tree was grafted from the National Arboretum where two maples share this name. One is a green, the other is a red. The name 'Sanguineum' translates as "blood-red" or "orange-red" which describes this selection's brilliant spring color. The tree in this auction was grafted from the red selection that was donated from Henry Hohman of Kingsville Nursery in 1969 (call # NA 31631). Hohman is known and respected for his knowledge of maples. He is one of the "key founding fathers of maples" that helped bring Japanese maples into popularity in America. We believe this to be the one true 'Sanguineum'. Limited Quantities Available !! As we have over a thousand cultivars of Japanese maples, we often do not have many of each cultivar. We recommend that you buy the Japanese maples you want immediately as we often sell out of certain selections.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 照片由 Peter Gregory 提供。'Beni kawa' 的新梢在冬季呈鲑红色。该品种比 'Sango kaku' 晚约两周展叶，生长速度稍慢，10 年后仅约高 10 英尺（3 米）。'Fjellheim' 源自 'Sango kaku' 上的丛枝变异（witches'-broom），保留了其著名亲本的全部特征，包括美丽的珊瑚红色新枝、五裂叶的叶形及叶色。显著区别在于它更加丛生且更矮，形成紧凑灌丛。分组：green。星形绿色叶片平展展开，形成层叠效果。新叶鲜黄色，裂片尖端带红色或胭脂红，夏季转为均一的浅绿色，并随着季节推进而逐渐加深。秋色为醒目的金黄色。中等大小、裂刻中等偏深的叶片具五至七个卵形裂片，裂尖锐。叶缘轻微锯齿。该植株可长成高大而繁茂的灌木，高宽均约 10 英尺（3 米）。老枝树皮鲜绿色。其名称意为“雄性日本鹿”。

products.name: Acer palmatum 'Saoshika' Green Japanese Maple
products.description_text: Acer palmatum ‘Saoshika’ is an elegant upright Japanese maple known for its wide, graceful growth habit and beautiful seasonal color changes. In spring, the star-shaped leaves emerge a fresh, bright yellow-green that glows in the landscape. As the season progresses into late spring and early summer, the foliage deepens to green with soft orange overtones before settling into a rich green for the remainder of summer. Come fall, ‘Saoshika’ lights up again with a brilliant display of bright yellow, adding warmth and contrast to the autumn garden. Its refined structure and shifting colors make this variety an excellent choice for specimen planting or adding interest to mixed landscapes.

descriptions.preferred: This small-leaved cultivar forms a semidwarf bushshaped plant, maturing at 2.5-3 m tall. The leaves are a pale yellow green with a rather thin texture and a slight hint of rusty red on the extreme edges. They measure about 4 cm long and 4-5 cm across. Each leaf is divided three-quarters of the way to the leaf base into five lanceolate lobes which terminate in long, slender, sharp tips. The two basal lobes often have tiny spur lobes. The lobe edges bend slightly upwards, and the margins are irregularly toothed. The name 'Saotome' means "rice-planting girl."

descriptions.preferred: The sharp-pointed leaves create the unusual impression of this plant. The leaves are seven lobed and rather small, 3-4 cm long and wide. The lobes are separated threequarters or more to the leaf base which is truncate. The margins are distinctly and sharply toothed. The petioles are 1.5 cm long. The spring color is an interesting light orange red, with the center veins a contrasting very light green. The color becomes a rich green during late summer. Fall colors are strong gold blends. This rather slow-growing but hardy cultivar forms a large, compact bush, eventually reaching 5-6 m tall and half as wide. 'Sazanami', whose name means "ruffles," is not common in collections but is a charming plant be- Corvallis The brilliant scarlet foliage in the spring is the most attractive feature of this cultivar. The leaves are palmate and five lobed or sometimes seven lobed. Each lobe narrows rapidly to a sharp point, and the margins are toothed. The small leaves are mostly 5 cm long and 4 cm wide. In older, twiggier growth, the leaves are at least 1 cm smaller. The lobes divide two-thirds of the way to the leaf base. The buds open with a brilliant show of bright crimson. This color remains for about a month. During early summer, the leaves change to a bronze tone and continue into the green of late summer. Bright colors become prominent again in the flame-red tones of the fall season. This hardy cultivar eventually makes a small upright tree or large shrub up to 4 m tall. It occasionally puts out strong, upright shoots when in good culture. The predominant growth, however, is multibranched with short internodes. Because of its tendency to produce short, twiggy growth, this cultivar is quite popular for bonsai. It tends to be difficult to propagate. 'Seigai' is identical to 'Akaji nishiki' and is listed under both names in early literature. It was recorded as early as 1710 by Ito\ in Zoh\ o Chikinsho.\ Because 'Akaji nishiki' is 'Crispa', 'Crispum', 'Cristata', 'Cristatum', 'Okushimo', and 'Sanguineum Seigai'. This cultivar is better known in the United States as 'Bonfire'. The very similar name 'Seigen' represents a separate cultivar, which is dwarfer with daintier leaves turning yellow in the fall.

rhs.description: A compact, upright, deciduous, shrubby tree about 5-6m in height, with small, sharp-pointed 7 lobed leaves 3-4cm wide and long, with pale green-veined orange-red spring foliage becoming rich green later in summer then blends of strong gold in autumn

rhs_zh.description: 紧凑、直立、落叶性的灌木状小乔木，高约 5-6 米。叶片较小，先端尖锐，7 裂，长宽约 3-4 厘米；春季新叶呈橙红色，叶脉浅绿色，至夏末转为浓绿色，秋季则呈浓郁的金色调。

descriptions_zh.preferred: 其尖锐的叶先端赋予该品种独特观感。叶片 7 裂，较小，长宽约 3-4 厘米。裂片分裂深达叶基的四分之三或更深，叶基平截。叶缘具明显而锐利的锯齿，叶柄长约 1.5 厘米。春季叶色为颇具特色的浅橙红色，中央叶脉则形成对比鲜明的极浅绿色。至夏末转为浓绿色，秋季呈强烈的金色混合色。该品种生长较慢但耐寒，形成大型而紧凑的灌木，最终高约 5-6 米，冠幅约为其一半。‘Sazanami’ 之名意为“波纹”，在栽培收集中并不常见，但颇具风致。另据后段可辨识内容，某品种春季鲜亮猩红色叶为其最显著特征。叶片掌状，5 裂，有时 7 裂；各裂片迅速渐尖，叶缘具齿。叶片较小，多为长 5 厘米、宽 4 厘米；老熟且细密枝条上的叶更小，至少小 1 厘米。裂片分裂约达叶基的三分之二。芽开放时呈极鲜艳的绯红色，此色可维持约一个月；初夏叶色转为青铜调，夏末渐绿，秋季再现火焰红色。该品种耐寒，最终成为高达 4 米的小型直立乔木或大型灌木；栽培条件良好时偶尔会抽生强健直立枝，但整体多为短节间、多分枝生长。由于容易形成短而细密的枝条，该品种很受盆景爱好者欢迎，但繁殖较困难。‘Seigai’ 与 ‘Akaji nishiki’ 为同一品种，早期文献中两名并见；在美国更常以 ‘Bonfire’ 之名流通。名称相近的 ‘Seigen’ 则是另一独立品种，其植株更矮小，叶片更秀气，秋季转黄。

descriptions.preferred: The brilliant scarlet spring foliage is the most attractive feature. The small moderately deeply divided leaves have five to seven lobes narrowing rapidly to sharp points. Margins are toothed. Spring color is bright crimson, lasting about a month, before the leaves Acer change to a bronze-green to blue-green and then the green of late summer, becoming flame-red in the fall. This hardy cultivar eventually makes a small upright tree or large shrub up to 13 ft. (4 m) tall. It is quite popular for bonsai. The name means "a blue cliff."

descriptions_zh.preferred: 其最迷人的特征是春季鲜艳的猩红色新叶。叶片较小，中等偏深裂，具 5-7 裂，裂片迅速渐尖成锐尖，叶缘具齿。春叶为鲜亮的深红色，可维持约一个月，之后叶色转为铜绿色至蓝绿色，再于夏末变绿，秋季则转为火焰红。本品种耐寒，最终可形成高达 13 英尺（4 米）的小型直立乔木或大型灌木，也非常适合制作盆景。其名称意为“蓝色的崖壁”。

descriptions.preferred: 'Seigen' is among the most popular cultivars of the group which develops bright crimson foliage in the spring. The new leaves range into the bright fire-red tones which last for several weeks and are reminiscent of the popular 'Corallinum'. They then develop a light green color for summer turning yellow to persimmon in fall. This cultivar is one of the first in the 'Corallinum' group to leaf; hence it is susceptible to cold winds and spring frosts. The small five-lobed leaves appear dainty, are 3-5 cm long and wide, and are held close together on the short branches. The lobes are divided more than halfway to the leaf base, and the margins are lightly toothed. The tips are not acutely sharp. The petioles are stiff and 2-3 cm long. This dwarf plant is similar to 'Tama hime' and 'Kiyohime'. It forms a small, rounded bush up to 2 m high. 'Seigen' is very popular for bonsai in Japan because it is dissectum -green It is unusual to see an upright-growing form in the Dissectum Group. Almost all other dissectum cultivars are of the cascading or weeping form. This green lace-leaved maple offers a pleasing contrast when planted in the company of other, more conventional dissectum forms. The foliage is a pleasing bright green. Each leaf is lightly tipped with reddish tones as it unfolds in the spring. The color soon changes to a uniform light green, though later in the summer on exposed leaves, the reddish tones reappear on the margins. Fall colors are quite spectacular and range from strong gold to light yellows with a suffusion of crimson in most leaves. The leaves are slightly smaller than are those of most other green dissectums. They range from 4 to 5 cm long and are slightly wider. The seven lobes are pinnately dissected into sublobes. The lobes are not as finely cut as those of typical dissectums, but more so than the lobes of 'Palmatifidum'. The short stiff petioles are 1.5-2 cm long. The bark is a dark brown-green. The upright growth is quite strong but not overly vigorous. The new shoots are stiff, not willowy, and grow as much as 50 cm per year. Young vigorous plants exceed this rate. A more mature tree becomes multibranched and gradually thickens without becoming excessively twiggy. Older plants may reach 5-7 m tall and 3-4 m The leaf shape and color set this cultivar apart. Also, the bark is a delightful green which lasts quite well on the older branches and limbs. The green has a faint whitish dusting and distinct lengthwise, white striations. The fall color is one of the best bright yellow-gold combinations of the green dissectums. The deep green leaves have seven or nine lobes and are of medium size, 7-9 cm long. They tend to hang down slightly and fold together, so the leaf spread is only 8-9 cm. Each of the lobes is deeply but uniformly pinnatifid, but not as finely or unevenly cut as those of the typical dissectum. This feature gives the leaf an appearance of more substance. It does not have the coarse cut of 'Palmatifidum'. The basal quarter of each lobe is little more than the width of the midrib. The lobe develops the dissected portion on the outer three-quarters of the way to the leaf base. The lobes look more feathery, while other green dissectums look lacier. The petioles are 5 cm long. 'Sekimori' is a strong, hardy plant. Growth on young plants can be vigorous, forming a nicely shaped bush in a short time. It reaches a height of 3-4 m and a width of 4-5 m at maturity. The cascading branches go out and down. The top shoots can be trained to give the plant more height from which to cascade more beautifully. Planting this cultivar on a slope enhances its beauty. Corvallis lobes. The five lobes are long-ovate with gradually tapering tips, 3-4.5 cm long and 1-1.2 cm wide at the broadest point in the lower third. The lobes are separated to within 1 cm of the leaf base. The margins are very lightly serrated, and the tiny tip of each serration turns slightly upward, giving the lobe edges a slightly crinkled appearance. Sometimes the two basal lobes are so small that the leaves appear only three lobed. The red petioles are slender and 1-3 cm long. The leaves have a shiny, deep green color. The new growth is edged with a rust color. This small plant takes full sun quite well. The fall colors range into the yellow tones and have been reported to last for up to six weeks. The leaf nodes are close together and the foliage is rather bunched. New growth is fine but not willowy, short, and multibranched. The plant reaches 3 m when mature. It is hardy and offers the choice of another small shrub for rock gardens, bonsai, and small plantings. A strange feature is that many of its leading shoots are flattened (van Gelderen et al. 1994). 'Sekka yatsubusa' is not widely known or easily propagated. It has also been known with the name reversed, 'Yatsubusa sekka'.

rhs.description: A small, rounded, deciduous Japanese maple, multibranched, eventually reaching about 1.5m in height, with small 5-lobed leaves to 5cm long on short branches. The leaves emerge bright red when young, turning light green in summer then with orange and gold tints in autumn; suited to bonsai training

descriptions_zh.preferred: 'Seigen' 是这一类春季抽生鲜亮深红叶品种中最受欢迎的品种之一。新叶可呈鲜明的火红色调，并持续数周，使人联想到广受欢迎的 'Corallinum'；随后夏季转为浅绿色，秋季变为黄色至柿子色。本品种在 'Corallinum' 类群中萌叶较早，因此容易受冷风和春霜危害。叶片较小、5 裂，秀致轻盈，长宽约 3-5 厘米，密生于短枝上。裂片深达叶基一半以上，叶缘轻微具齿，裂片尖端不特别锐利。叶柄硬挺，长 2-3 厘米。该矮生品种与 'Tama hime' 和 'Kiyohime' 相似，可形成高约 2 米的小型圆头灌丛。'Seigen' 在日本很受盆景爱好者欢迎。 另有一类直立生长的绿色羽裂型品种，在 Dissectum Group 中较为少见；绝大多数其他 dissectum 品种多为下垂或垂枝形。此绿色细裂叶枫与其他更典型的垂枝 dissectum 品种混植时，可形成悦目的对比。叶色为清新的亮绿色，春季展开时每片叶轻带红色尖端，随后很快转为均匀浅绿色；夏季后期，受光较强的叶缘又会重新出现红晕。秋色颇为壮观，从鲜金色到浅黄色，并在大多数叶片上带有绯红晕染。叶片略小于大多数其他绿色 dissectum 品种，长约 4-5 厘米，宽略大于长度。7 个裂片呈羽状深裂形成次裂片，其精细程度不如典型 dissectum 那样纤细，但又比 'Palmatifidum' 更细裂。短而硬的叶柄长 1.5-2 厘米。树皮呈深褐绿色。植株直立性较强，但不过分旺盛；新梢硬挺，不呈柳枝状，每年可生长约 50 厘米，幼年健壮植株可超过这一速度。较成熟的树体会形成多分枝结构，逐渐增粗而不过于细密。老株可高达 5-7 米，冠幅 3-4 米。 该品种的叶形与叶色极具辨识度，枝干亦保持悦目的绿色，老枝和主枝上这种绿色仍能持续较久，并带有轻微白粉及明显的纵向白色条纹。其秋色是绿色 dissectum 品种中最优秀的鲜黄至金黄组合之一。深绿色叶片具 7 或 9 裂，中等大小，长 7-9 厘米，略微下垂并常稍向内合拢，因此展开宽度仅约 8-9 厘米。每个裂片都深而均匀地羽状分裂，但不像典型 dissectum 那样切裂得极细或不规则，因此叶片显得更有质感；同时也不具 'Palmatifidum' 那种粗裂感。每个裂片基部约四分之一处宽度仅略宽于中脉，外侧约四分之三部分才发展出细裂结构。其裂片较具羽毛感，而其他绿色 dissectum 则更像蕾丝。叶柄长约 5 厘米。'Sekimori' 生长健壮且耐性强。幼株生长可相当旺盛，较短时间内即可形成优美株形；成熟时高约 3-4 米，宽约 4-5 米。枝条向外并下垂延展，顶部新梢可通过整枝牵引增加高度，从而形成更优雅的垂枝效果。栽植于斜坡地可进一步增强其观赏性。 另一个相关品种叶片裂片狭长，通常 5 裂；裂片为长卵形，尖端渐尖，长 3-4.5 厘米，在下部三分之一最宽处宽 1-1.2 厘米。裂片间分离至距叶基约 1 厘米处。叶缘仅极轻微具锯齿，且每个小齿尖端略向上翘，使裂片边缘呈现轻微皱褶感。有时两个基部裂片极小，使叶片看起来仅有 3 裂。红色叶柄纤细，长 1-3 厘米。叶片有光泽，深绿色；新梢叶缘带锈色。该小型植株对全日照适应良好。秋色偏黄色，据报道可持续长达 6 周。节间较短，叶片略显簇生。新梢细而不柔垂，短而多分枝；成熟时植株高约 3 米。其耐寒，可作为岩石园、盆景及小型栽植空间的另一种小灌木选择。一个特殊特征是许多主梢呈扁平状（van Gelderen 等，1994）。'Sekka yatsubusa' 并不广为人知，也不易繁殖；它还曾以倒置名称 'Yatsubusa sekka' 流通。

descriptions.preferred: One of the few upright dissectums, this green laceleaf offers a pleasant contrast when planted with conventional dissectums. Each attractive bright green leaf is lightly tipped with reddish tones in the spring, changing to light green in the summer. In hot sun, the reddish tones may reappear on the margins. Fall colors are spectacular, ranging from strong gold to light yellows with a suffusion of crimson. The seven-lobed leaves are slightly smaller and not as finely cut as in most dissectums. The bark is a dark brown-green. The upright growth is quite strong with stiff, not willowy, new shoots. This desirable plant may reach 16-23 ft. (5-7 m) tall and 10-13 ft. (3-4 m) wide. The name means "blue-green dragon."

sources.title: 青龙 Acer Palmatum 'Seiryu'
sources.description: 青龙是落叶小乔木，高度可达 10 米或更高，该品种 1965年由荷兰鹿特丹的J.R.Pn Hoey Smith培育成功。 1984 年得到英国皇家园艺协会"提名荣誉"奖。被 欧美园艺界公论为近几十年来杰出的新品种。此品 种虽然有着秀丽的叶形，属于羽毛枫类，但却直立 生长、不下垂。叶色春季嫩绿，会出现红色的爪边， 夏季亮绿，秋季转为鲜艳的红铜色，夏季焦叶现象 也不多，叶子为 7-11 裂，叶裂深至基部，裂片狭长。 生长长势强，速度快，适生于华北及南地区。

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这是少数直立型羽裂品种之一，作为绿色细裂叶型，与常见羽裂品种混植时能形成令人愉悦的对比。每片鲜绿色叶片在春季叶尖略带红晕，夏季转为浅绿色；在炎热强光下，叶缘可能再次泛现红色调。秋色极为出色，从浓金色到浅黄色，并带有一层深红色晕染。叶片 7 裂，略小于多数羽裂品种，且裂刻没有那么细密。树皮为深棕绿色。植株直立生长势强，新梢坚挺而不下垂。该优良品种可达高 16-23 英尺（5-7 米）、宽 10-13 英尺（3-4 米）。其名称意为“青绿龙”。

descriptions.preferred: This upright flattopped shrub, growing up to 10 ft. (3 m) tall, resembles a vigorous form of 'Mikawa yatsubusa'. Its small to medium-sized leaves are very similar, having long-ovate lobes with long, narrow, pointed tips. The central lobe is the longest. Margins are conspicuously coarsely toothed. As with 'Mikawa yatsubusa', the leaves overlap like the shingles on a roof. They are small and a deep green, turning a splendid red in the fall. The name may be translated as "palace in the blue cloud."

descriptions_zh.preferred: 该品种为直立、平顶状灌木，高可达 10 英尺（3 米），外形类似生长更旺盛的 ‘Mikawa yatsubusa’。其叶片小至中等大小，形态也很相似，裂片为长卵形，先端细长尖锐，其中中央裂片最长。叶缘具显著而粗大的锯齿。与 ‘Mikawa yatsubusa’ 一样，叶片彼此重叠，如屋瓦覆叠。叶色深绿，秋季转为极美的红色。其名称可译作“青云之宫”。

products.description_text: Acer palmatum ‘Seiun kaku’ is a Japanese cultivar has bright green leaves and red petioles. Similar to 'Mikawa yatsubusa' in that the leaves are layered one over the other like tiles on a roof but 'Seuin kaku' is much faster growing developing into a small more open and airy tree. 'Seiun kaku' finishes most years with a very nice deep red fall color. The Japanese name means blue-green tower or palace in the clouds. 10 year size: Height: 5-6 Feet Width: 2-3 Feet

descriptions.preferred: 于1970 年在福岛县被发现，是一株小叶羽团扇的实生苗，但是直到 2008 年才正式开始商业化销售推广。 Seki 是 KAZOU SEKI 先生的姓，是他最早发现了关之华严， Kegon 来自于日本非常著名的瀑布华严瀑布，关之华严的名字由此而得。关之华严是目前世界上唯一的小叶羽团扇枝垂品种，春季春芽为黄绿色，而后转绿，夏季为绿色，新稍为黄色，秋季为橙黄色或红色，生长速度中等，半枝垂性，耐寒，成年株可达 3 米左右高度。

sources.description: 于1970 年在福岛县被发现，是一株小叶羽团扇的实生苗，但是直到 2008 年才正式开始商业化销售推广。 Seki 是 KAZOU SEKI 先生的姓，是他最早发现了关之华严， Kegon 来自于日本非常著名的瀑布华严瀑布，关之华严的名字由此而得。关之华严是目前世界上唯一的小叶羽团扇枝垂品种，春季春芽为黄绿色，而后转绿，夏季为绿色，新稍为黄色，秋季为橙黄色或红色，生长速度中等，半枝垂性，耐寒，成年株可达 3 米左右高度。

descriptions.preferred: The leaf shape and color set this cultivar apart, as does the delightful green bark with a faint whitish dusting and distinct white striations. Fall color is one of the best bright yellow-golds of the green dissectums. The medium-sized deep green leaves have five to seven lobes which are deeply but not finely cut to the midrib. The lobes look more feathery, while most green dissectums look lacier. 'Sekimori' is a strong, hardy plant, reaching 10-13 ft. (3-4 m) high and 13-16 ft. (4-5 m) wide. Planting it on a Vertrees. slope enhances its beauty. Oddly, the name means "a border guard post."

descriptions_zh.preferred: 该品种因叶形与叶色而独具特色，同时其树皮呈悦目的绿色，带有淡淡的白粉感，并有明显的白色条纹。秋色是绿色羽裂类品种中极佳的鲜亮金黄色之一。叶片中等大小，深绿色，具 5 至 7 裂，裂刻很深但不细碎，可达中肋；裂片外观更具羽毛感，而多数绿色羽裂品种则更显蕾丝状。‘Sekimori’ 生长强健、耐寒，株高可达 10-13 英尺（3-4 米），冠幅 13-16 英尺（4-5 米）。栽植于坡地上更能展现其美态。其名称颇为特别，意为“边关守卫所”。

products.description_text: Acer palmatum dissectum 'Sekimori' Green Laceleaf Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 'Sekimori' is a very flashy, weeping, green Japanese maple. This green Japanese maple tree is cascading but grows with a very arching habit that exposes the trunk for an appealing look. The early spring color of 'Sekimori' is a vibrant bright green that jumps out of the landscape. During the summer, the color maintains a bright, showy, lush green. From a distance, this weeping Japanese maple almost glows with shades of neon green at dusk. The color of 'Sekimori' transforms in the fall into one of the greatest bright golden-yellows of any green dissectum. The growth habit of this weeping green Japanese maple is slightly wider than it is tall and around 8-10 ft over time. 'Sekimori' is an amazing tree that grows well in shade or sun and lends itself well to container growing. 'Sekimori' is a hard-to-find Japanese maple and is a great compliment to any landscape, heavily sought after by maple collectors. Limited Quantities Available !! As we have over a thousand cultivars of Japanese maples, we often do not have many of each cultivar. We recommend that you buy the Japanese maples you want immediately as we often sell out of certain selections.

rhs_zh.description: 一类致密、多分枝的落叶槭树，最终高约 3 米。其芽体常簇生，形成带有扭曲感和簇状层叠叶丛的独特株形。叶片有光泽，深绿色，幼叶边缘带红色，秋季转为黄色至金色调；非常适合盆景造型。

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这种矮生灌木与其他矮生品种不同之处，在于叶裂片更狭。叶片小而有光泽，深绿色，深裂为 5 枚长卵形裂片，先端渐尖。叶缘仅有极浅的锯齿，细小齿端微微上翘，使叶缘呈现轻微起皱的外观。红色叶柄细长，新叶边缘带锈色，秋色为黄色。叶节间短，叶簇生。‘Sekka yatsubusa’ 可长至 10 英尺（3 米）高，耐寒，且较能适应全日照。该品种适合用于假山园、盆景和小型种植。其名称意为“会转红的矮生株”，应是指春季叶色。 ‘Shaina’：Palmatum Group，红叶类。该紧凑直立型品种，圆形叶片密集着生于短枝上成簇。春季鲜红，夏季转为深紫红，且能较好保持叶色，至秋季再转亮绯红。叶 5 裂，裂片深裂，狭长卵形，先端尖。许多中央裂片缩短，顶端圆钝，这是由巫枝变异而来的植株常见特征。‘Shaina’ 最终形成致密的球形灌木，高可达 10 英尺（3 米）或更高，适合容器栽培和假山园。 ‘Sharp’s Pygmy’：Pygmy Group，绿叶类。其小型绿色叶片秋季转深橙至猩红。叶片明显长于宽，5 枚狭长、深裂的裂片呈带状，裂尖常下垂。中央裂片始终明显长于其余裂片，而小型基部裂片与叶柄成较大角度展开。叶缘具较宽锯齿。短而细的叶柄及新梢为绿色。‘Sharp’s Pygmy’ 形成叶幕紧密、紧凑而低矮开展的小乔木，高约 3 英尺（1 米）。几乎无需修剪或整形，便可呈现盆景般姿态，是十分出色的矮生品种。‘Akita yatsubusa’ 在叶形和株形上与 ‘Sharp’s Pygmy’ 相似，但枝条为深褐色。

descriptions.preferred: This vigorous tree of medium size and spreading habit has large and variable foliage. The leaves on young wood Archives, Corvallis and are long-ovate with a long, tapering tip. Each distinctly separated lobe is double toothed on the margins to give a delicate edging. The leaf color is a strong, light green. New growth has an overblushing of rusty red which is quite variable, depending on the degree of exposure to full sun. In shade, the green takes on a yellowish cast. In midsummer a darker green predominates. Fall colors are strong and vary from yellow to burnt orange. Although it becomes an upright tree, 'Semi-no-hane' has a tendency to spread and become a broad, mediumsized plant. It is a vigorous but not an aggressive tree. The texture is pleasant in the landscape and gives a different effect. The name has been misspelled 'Seme-nohane'. leaves emerge a bright red in the spring, become a dark purple red for the summer, and turn bright crimson in the fall. It holds its deep color well throughout the summer and early fall. The five-lobed leaves are deeply divided to within 1 cm of the leaf base, into narrow longovate lobes with pointed tips, except many of the center lobes are shortened with rounded tips—a characteristic of many cultivars originating from witches'-brooms. The shoots are vigorous in young plants, but become shorter and thicker when established. The side shoots average 1-2 cm long and terminal shoots no more than 5-10 cm. The plant eventually forms a dense, globeshaped shrub up to 3 m or more and is ideal for container culture and rock gardens. 'Shaina' originated as a witches'-broom which was reputed to come from 'Bloodgood', although the leaves are 'Sharp's Pygmy' dwarf -green This outstanding dwarf must be one of the smallest palmatum cultivars possible. Jimmy Sharp first noticed it as a chance seedling in the early 1980s and propagated it at his nursery in Oregon. The green leaves turn a deep orange to scarlet in the fall. The small five-lobed leaves are 3-4.5 cm long and 2-3.5 cm wide on older plants, though they may reach up to 6 cm long and 4.5 cm wide on young vigorous shoots. The narrow lobes, almost straplike, are deeply divided to within 5-7 mm of the leaf base, broadest in the lower third. The margins have coarse broad teeth. The center lobe is always much longer than the others. The three middle lobes are close together and point forward, while the small basal lobes are held more or less at right angles to the petiole, so that the leaf is distinctly longer than wide. The lobe tips tend to turn down. The slender green petioles are 1.5-2.5 cm long. The shoots are also green. 'Sharp's Pygmy' forms a densely foliaged, compact, low-spreading tree which is unlikely to reach 1 m high. It needs no pruning or training to give it a bonsai-like appearance. It is a truly remarkable dwarf.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这是一种生长旺盛的中型树，株型开展，叶片大且变化较多。幼枝上的叶片呈长卵形，具细长渐尖的叶先端。各裂片分离明显，叶缘具重锯齿，呈现精致的边饰感。叶色为鲜明的浅绿色。新梢常带锈红色晕染，其程度随全日照暴露强弱而变化；在荫处时，绿色会偏黄。盛夏时则以较深的绿色为主。秋色鲜明，从黄色到焦橙色不等。虽然最终会长成直立小乔木，但 'Semi-no-hane' 也有向外开展的倾向，形成宽幅的中型植株。其生长旺盛但不过分强横，园景中的叶理质感宜人，效果别具一格。该名称曾被误拼为 'Seme-nohane'。 其叶片春季萌发时为鲜红色，夏季转为深紫红色，秋季再转为明亮的深红色。整个夏季至初秋都能较好保持深色。5 裂叶深裂至距叶基约 1 厘米处，裂为狭长卵形裂片，先端尖锐，但许多中央裂片较短且先端圆钝，这是许多源自丛枝变异（witches'-brooms）品种的特征。幼株枝条生长旺盛，但定植后枝条会变短并增粗。侧枝平均长 1-2 厘米，顶枝通常不超过 5-10 厘米。植株最终形成致密的球形灌木，高可达 3 米或以上，非常适合容器栽培和岩石园。'Shaina' 源自一株丛枝变异，据称来自 'Bloodgood'，不过其叶片特征有所不同。 'Sharp's Pygmy' 为矮生绿色品种。这一杰出的矮性品种可能是 Acer palmatum 中体型最小者之一。Jimmy Sharp 于 20 世纪 80 年代初首次注意到它是一株偶发实生苗，并在其位于俄勒冈的苗圃中进行繁殖。绿色叶片在秋季转为深橙色至猩红色。老株叶片较小，5 裂，长 3-4.5 厘米，宽 2-3.5 厘米；幼年旺盛枝条上的叶片可达长 6 厘米、宽 4.5 厘米。狭窄裂片几乎呈带状，深裂至距叶基 5-7 毫米处，在下部三分之一处最宽。叶缘具粗而宽的锯齿。中央裂片始终明显长于其他裂片。中间三枚裂片彼此靠近并向前伸展，而较小的基部裂片则大致与叶柄成直角展开，因此叶片明显长于宽。裂片先端倾向下垂。细长绿色叶柄长 1.5-2.5 厘米，枝条亦为绿色。'Sharp's Pygmy' 形成枝叶致密、紧凑、低矮开展的小乔木，通常不太可能长到 1 米高。无需修剪或整形即可呈现类似盆景的姿态，是一个极为出色的矮性品种。

descriptions.preferred: The beautiful leaves of this cultivar are a rich reddish purple color approaching burgundy. The color remains very strong until the end of the summer, fading but very little to the red-green tones. It holds its color better than most similar cultivars of the Matsumurae Group. The leaves are seven lobed and measure 7-8 cm long and about 8 cm wide. The lobes are divided almost to the leaf base and tend to hold together slightly so that the leaf appears longer than wide. The lobes are elongate-ovate, quite narrow at the lobe junctions, with the outer end tapering to a very long, sharp point. The margins are deeply and regularly toothed. The petioles are red and 4 cm long. This vigorous, small tree makes a pleasant roundtopped form and reaches 4-5 m tall at maturity and up Lace', but has slightly smaller leaves and the deep color does not fade or turn greenish brown or bronze in midsummer. By midsummer the contrast is quite noticeable in the large specimens of each cultivar growing side by side at Wil-Chris Acres, Sherwood, Oregon. It was here that William Curtis selected and developed 'Sherwood Flame', reportedly a seedling selection of 'Burgundy Lace'. 'Sherwood Flame' has been mislabeled 'Sheerwater Flame'.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 该品种叶色优美，为浓郁的红紫色，接近酒红色。其色彩可一直较强烈地保持到夏末，仅略微褪为带红的绿色调。与 Matsumurae Group 中多数相近品种相比，它的持色性更佳。叶片 7 裂，长 7-8 厘米、宽约 8 厘米。裂片几乎深达叶基，并略微彼此靠拢，因此叶形看上去长于宽。裂片为狭长卵形，在裂片连接处较窄，外端渐尖成很长的锐尖；叶缘深且规则具锯齿。叶柄红色，长 4 厘米。该品种生长势强，为小乔木，成年后形成悦目的圆头树形，高约 4-5 米。它与 ‘Burgundy Lace’ 相似，但叶片稍小，且深色在盛夏不会褪色，也不会转为偏绿褐色或古铜色。到仲夏时，在俄勒冈州 Sherwood 的 Wil-Chris Acres 并排栽培的两者大型植株之间，这种差异十分明显。William Curtis 正是在此选育出 ‘Sherwood Flame’，据称它是 ‘Burgundy Lace’ 的实生选拔。‘Sherwood Flame’ 也曾被误标为 ‘Sheerwater Flame’。

descriptions.preferred: This red cultivar is almost identical to 'Musashino' which is propagated more often. The color of the foliage is a deep purple red and is especially bright as the leaves unfold. The color keeps well into the summer, but gradually fades into a deep green-red tone. Fall colors are various shades of red. The seven lobes are strongly ovate, separated threequarters of the way to the leaf base. They are held more closely together than in 'Musashino', almost overlapping at the base, and terminate in a long, sharp point. The two basal lobes extend almost at right angles to the petiole. The margins are serrated. The leaves are about 8 cm long and 11 cm wide, with petioles 4-5 cm long. This strong-growing, upright tree matures as a round- Archives, Corvallis used for this cultivar.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这一红叶品种与更常被繁殖的 'Musashino' 几乎相同。叶色为深紫红色，尤其在新叶展开时最为鲜亮；色泽可较好地保持到夏季，但随后逐渐转为深绿带红调。秋色为不同层次的红色。叶片 7 裂，裂片明显呈卵形，分裂深度达叶基的四分之三。与 'Musashino' 相比，其裂片排列更为紧密，基部几乎彼此重叠，并以长而锐的尖端收尾。两个基部裂片几乎与叶柄成直角伸展。叶缘具锯齿。叶片长约 8 厘米、宽约 11 厘米，叶柄长 4-5 厘米。该品种生长势强、树形直立，成熟后形成圆头树冠。文末部分显然有 OCR 残缺，原文品种名信息不完整。

descriptions.preferred: This highly desirable dwarf was discovered as a witches'broom on the well-known 'Aoyagi' and was propagated and named by Raraflora Nursery, Berry, New South Wales, Australia. It is a miniature replica of its parent, with bright yellow-green leaves contrasting with the peagreen bark. The five-lobed palmatum-type leaves are divided more than two-thirds of the way to the leaf base and are slightly smaller than those of 'Aoyagi', 4 cm long and up to 5 cm wide. Otherwise, the leaf shape, toothed margins, and coloring through the seasons is the same. Also, it has the same upright growth of 'Aoyagi' but shorter and more compact. One of the original plants reached 1.8 m tall and 1.2 m wide in seven years under Australian conditions. However, as John Emery of Raraflora Nursery rightly points out, the growth of Japanese maples in New South Wales is probably much faster than that in many parts of Europe and North America. Hence, 'Shidava Gold' is unlikely to reach 2 m tall under most conditions. The name has been misspelled 'Shidaba Gold'.

sources.title: 希达瓦金Acer Palmatum 'Shidava Gold'
sources.description: 澳大利亚人 Raraflora Nursery 在Acer Palmatum'Aoyagi' 青柳上发现的枝变品种，希达瓦金继承了母树的所 有特征，但树形更小更紧凑。春色嫩绿，夏天绿色， 秋天从浅黄色到金黄色。枝干绿色，在冬季可以和 观枝品种搭配，形成独特的景观。成年树可达到 2 米左右。在冬天，这棵树深绿色的树杆照亮了原本 灰暗的日子，也使这棵树成为其他观枝品种的趣味 好伙伴，有些人甚至经常将它们并排种植，这样它 们的树杆形成了鲜明的对比，增加观赏性。

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这一极受欢迎的矮生品种最初是在著名的 ‘Aoyagi’ 上发现的一枝巫枝变异，由澳大利亚新南威尔士州 Berry 的 Raraflora Nursery 繁殖并命名。它可视为亲本的微型复制品，亮黄绿色叶片与豆绿色树皮形成鲜明对比。其掌状叶为 5 裂，裂片深达叶基的三分之二以上，尺寸略小于 ‘Aoyagi’，长约 4 厘米、宽可达 5 厘米。除此之外，叶形、锯齿叶缘以及四季中的叶色变化均与亲本相同。株形也保留了 ‘Aoyagi’ 的直立生长习性，但更短小、更紧凑。在澳大利亚条件下，原始植株之一 7 年可长到高 1.8 米、宽 1.2 米。不过，Raraflora Nursery 的 John Emery 正确指出，新南威尔士州的日本枫生长速度可能比欧洲和北美许多地区快得多。因此，在大多数环境下，‘Shidava Gold’ 不太可能长到 2 米高。该名称也曾被误拼为 ‘Shidaba Gold’。

descriptions.preferred: The name of this cultivar means "posts in a river or stream to which boats are tied." The spring foliage is a bright green, with the tips of the lobes a light purple which shades a short distance back along each margin. The contrast is quite noticeable. As the leaf matures, the outer half of each lobe becomes purple. Later, in summer, the leaf becomes solid green. Fall colors are rich yellow and orange suffused with red. The seven-lobed leaves are 4-6 cm long and 6-8 cm wide. The lobes radiate stiffly outward, with the two very small basal lobes angled back along the petiole. Each lobe separates two-thirds of the way to the leaf base and has a long-ovate shape with almost parallel sides in the lower part, tapering gradually to a sharp tip. The sides of the lobes tend to turn upwards from the midrib, forming a slight trough. The margins are almost smooth with the horizontal branches give it a layered appearance. After many years it reaches a height of 4 m. The close similarity of 'Shigarami' to 'Tana' has created a slight confusion between the two cultivars. The narrower, parallel-sided lobes and deeper divisions in the leaves of 'Shigarami' distinguish it from 'Tana' which has broader triangular lobes and divisions to about halfway. This cultivar has also been known under the name 'Saku' which may not be synonymous.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 该品种名称意为“河流或溪流中系船的桩柱”。春叶鲜绿色，裂片尖端带浅紫色，并沿每个裂片边缘向后延伸一小段，色彩对比相当明显。叶片成熟后，每个裂片的外半部会变为紫色。到夏季后期，叶片转为纯绿色。秋色为浓艳的黄色和橙色，并带红晕。七裂叶长 4 至 6 厘米，宽 6 至 8 厘米。裂片硬挺地向外放射展开，两个很小的基部裂片向后斜指叶柄方向。每个裂片裂至叶基约三分之二处，形状为长卵形，下半部两侧近乎平行，向上逐渐收尖。裂片两侧常自中脉处向上翻卷，形成浅浅的槽状。叶缘近乎平滑。水平展开的枝条使其具有层叠感。多年后株高可达 4 米。'Shigarami' 与 'Tana' 非常相似，因此两者之间曾有些混淆。'Shigarami' 的裂片更狭、两侧更平行，且叶裂更深；而 'Tana' 的裂片较宽、呈三角形，裂刻约达一半。该品种也曾以 'Saku' 之名流传，但两者未必为同物异名。

products.description_text: Acer palmatum 'Shigi no hoshi' Rare Japanese Maple Tree Zones 5-9 'Shigi no hoshi' leafs out in the spring with white reticulated variegation and dark green veins. The leaves are 'Shigi no hoshi' are fairly serrated on the edges, especially on mature growth. In autumn, 'Shigi no hoshi' turns to a bright yellow. rhs_zh.description: 落叶乔木，初期直立，后形成圆整树冠，高约 5 米。叶片具 7-9 裂，长 6-10 厘米、宽可达 14 厘米，裂片渐尖，叶缘具齿。春叶为奶油黄绿色，并具深绿色叶脉网纹；夏季转深绿色，叶脉则呈更深的绿色或红色；秋季变为鲜红色。

descriptions_zh.preferred: 叶片底色为浅黄色至黄绿色，其上具明显的绿色网状叶脉。夏季叶色加深，黄色成分更趋绿色，网状叶脉则转为更深的绿色，有时主脉带红色。到秋季，叶片转为独特的红色，或红绿交融的浓丽色调。大型叶片略向上杯卷，7 至 9 枚宽卵形裂片向外大幅舒展，约在叶片基部一半处相连，并渐尖为细长锐尖。叶缘具整齐而锐利的锯齿。这个非常古老、相当健壮的品种在最炎热的日照条件下适合适度遮护。其生长为中型直立株，高约 16 英尺（5 米），开展可达 13 英尺（4 米）。名称可能意为“从沼泽中惊起、呱呱鸣叫的沙锥”，也可能指某个古地名。 'Shigure bato' 属 Matsumurae Group，绿色类。其小型直立叶片极为优美，通常 7 裂且深裂，细小的基部裂片向后张开，使叶形呈现迷人的羽毛状效果。每个狭长裂片逐渐延伸成细长先端，且往往略向下弯。叶缘深且不规则具锯齿。春叶鲜红，夏季转绿，但叶尖及较大裂片仍保留红晕。秋色为金红色。'Shigure bato' 形成直立灌木，高可达 10 英尺（3 米），较为娇嫩。其名称意为“深秋细雨”。 'Shigure zome' 属 Palmatum Group，绿色类。这一非常古老的日本品种具中等大小叶片，通常 7 裂且中度深裂。各裂片为卵形，具长渐尖尖端，叶缘轻微具齿。春季叶色为紫红至褐红色，夏季转绿，叶柄带红色，秋季转为鲜亮的红橙色。'Shigure zome' 可形成直立小乔木，高约 13 英尺（4 米）。 'Ori nishiki' 属 Group，红色类。春叶为紫色，夏季转为褐红色，夏末变为带绿色调的褐色，秋季转橙色。叶片深裂为 5 至 7 枚长卵形裂片，裂片先端细长，叶缘深具锯齿。短而硬的叶柄为红色。该品种较耐寒，形成宽幅灌木，高可达 13 英尺（4 米）。

descriptions.preferred: The beautiful leaves of this cultivar are seven lobed, with the two basal lobes very small and angled backward to- Corvallis and irregularly double toothed. The lobe shape approaches that of the green dissectum 'Palmatifidum'. Although the leaf is of the Matsumurae Group, it aspires to be a dissectum, but does not quite make it! The leaf has a lovely feathery appearance and is 4-6 cm long and 5-6 cm wide. The slender petioles are 2-4 cm long. The new foliage emerges with a brilliant red tone which lasts into late spring. During the early summer the leaves turn green, but the tips and edges remain tinged red. The green is lighter under shade. Fall colors range from gold to crimson. 'Shigure bato' is not a rapid-growing cultivar. Although it forms an upright bush, it only attains up to 3 m high at maturity, spreading its branches outward so that it may be as wide as tall. It is tender and not easily propagated. The name 'Shigure bato' means "late fall rain."

descriptions_zh.preferred: 该品种叶片秀美，具七裂，其中两个基部裂片很小并向后反折，叶缘不规则重锯齿。裂片形态接近绿色羽裂型 dissectum 品种 'Palmatifidum'。尽管其叶片归入 Matsumurae Group，但它颇有 dissectum 的风姿，只是还未完全达到那种程度。叶片具有优美的羽毛状观感，长 4 至 6 厘米，宽 5 至 6 厘米。细长叶柄长 2 至 4 厘米。新叶展开时呈艳丽红色，可持续至晚春。初夏时叶片转绿，但叶尖与叶缘仍保留红色晕染。遮阴条件下叶色更浅。秋色从金黄到深红不等。'Shigure bato' 生长速度不快。虽形成直立灌丛，但成熟时通常仅高达 3 米，同时枝条向外伸展，因此株幅可与株高相当。该品种较娇嫩，繁殖也不容易。'Shigure bato' 名称意为“深秋之雨”。

It has also been known under the name 'Shigure zono'. The medium-sized leaves are seven lobed, separated to within 1 cm of the leaf base, and are 4-5 cm long and 6 cm wide. Each lobe is strongly ovate but ends with a long taper to a sharp tip. The margins Corvallis plant forms an upright tree, reaching up to 4 m tall at maturity.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 该品种自 18 世纪早期起即有记载，但并不广为人知。不过，它在日本仍有繁殖栽培。它也曾以 'Shigure zono' 这一名称流传。叶片中等大小，7 裂，裂片深达距叶基 1 厘米以内，叶长 4-5 厘米、宽 6 厘米。每个裂片均为明显卵形，并渐尖成细长锐尖。叶缘……Corvallis 的植株形态为直立小乔木，成熟时可达 4 米高。

descriptions.preferred: The purple-red leaves have a brownish overtone which helps distinguish this cultivar. The indistinct brown tones are often suppressed by the purple red in new foliage, then later become apparent, although never strong. The brown tones become a dull brownish green color in late summer, changing to orange in the fall. The leaves are seven lobed, occasionally five lobed, but the two basal lobes are very small and sometimes lacking. Each lobe is oblong-ovate and terminates in a long slender point. The lobes are divided about three-quarters of the way to the leaf base. The upper half of the lobe has deeply serrated margins, while the lower half is almost untoothed. The leaf is 7-8 cm long and 9-10 cm wide. The red petioles are 3 cm long. This cultivar is fairly hardy and strong growing, and matures as a broad bush up to 4-5 m tall. It is not widely known. 'Shikage ori nishiki' has been known since the early eighteenth century, though Gen'ichi Koidzumi later used the name 'Kageori nishiki'. The latter name has been confused with 'Kagiri nishiki', a quite different variegated cultivar.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 该品种的紫红色叶片带有褐色底调，这是其识别特征之一。新叶期这种不太明显的褐色常被紫红色所掩盖，之后才逐渐显现，但始终不会很强烈。到夏末，这种褐色调会变为暗淡的褐绿色，秋季再转橙色。叶片七裂，偶有五裂，但两个基部裂片很小，有时甚至缺失。每个裂片均为长椭圆状卵形，末端延伸为细长尖头。裂片深达叶基约四分之三。裂片上半部叶缘深锯齿，下半部则几乎无齿。叶片长 7 至 8 厘米，宽 9 至 10 厘米。红色叶柄长约 3 厘米。该品种较耐寒，生长势较强，成熟后形成开展型灌丛，高约 4 至 5 米。其知名度并不高。'Shikage ori nishiki' 自 18 世纪早期起即有记载，不过 Gen'ichi Koidzumi 后来使用了 'Kageori nishiki' 这一名称。后者又曾与完全不同的斑叶品种 'Kagiri nishiki' 相混淆。

descriptions.preferred: The long lobes of this cultivar are deep red or purple red in the spring and early summer. They gradually turn a reddish green or bronze green. Crimson color tones dominate in the fall. The leaves do not hold their red color as well as those of 'Atrolineare'. They have mostly five lobes, occasionally three or seven lobes, and are 5-7 cm long and about 6 cm wide. Each lobe is up to 6 mm wide and has slightly serrated margins. The petioles are about 3 cm long. This cultivar grows more slowly than 'Atrolineare' does and has slightly broader lobes. The Japanese state that 'Shime-no-uchi' rarely exceeds 1 m high, but it has been found to reach 2.5-3 m high in the West. It has an upright but twiggy growth habit. In the past the name of Shin means "new," indicating that this cultivar is a later improved selection of the well-known 'Desho\jo\'. In spring it is one of the most brilliant foliage plants in the Maplewood collection or anywhere else. Some refer to the leaf color as fire-engine red. Flaming scarlet or crimson scarlet is a better description. The leaf color is considered by many to be brighter than that found in similar spring foliage plants, such as 'Chishio', 'Deshoj\ o'\, and 'Seigai'. The new foliage retains this color during the first month or more of spring. As midsummer arrives, the color turns to a pleasant reddish green. Occasionally, leaves are found with minute flecking of light cream or white. However, it is not strongly marked. In the fall, the colors become blends of reds and oranges. The small fiveor seven-lobed leaves are in the Palmatum Group and have very small basal lobes. They are 3-5 cm long and wide in older wood, and up to 6 cm long and 7 cm wide on vigorous newer growth. The lobes unite two-thirds of the way or more to the leaf base. They are strongly ovate, tapering to a point. The margins are serrated, the teeth having sharp tips. The slender petioles are red brown to purple red and 2-4 cm long. The young shoots are also reddish brown to dark purple red. This maple is not a tall cultivar but forms a shrub up to 3 m high and 2 m wide as it matures. Young plants produce vigorous new shoots, but in later years the Corvallis

descriptions_zh.preferred: 该品种细长的裂片在春季和初夏呈深红色或紫红色，随后逐渐转为带红调的绿色或古铜绿色。秋季以绯红色调为主。其叶色的持红性不如 'Atrolineare'。叶片多为 5 裂，偶见 3 裂或 7 裂，长 5-7 厘米，宽约 6 厘米。每个裂片宽可达 6 毫米，叶缘略具锯齿。叶柄长约 3 厘米。该品种生长速度较 'Atrolineare' 慢，裂片也略宽。日本方面记载 'Shime-no-uchi' 很少超过 1 米高，但在西方栽培中可达 2.5-3 米高。其株形直立，但小枝较细密。过去其名中的 Shin 有“新”之意，表明该品种是著名 'Desho\jo\' 的较晚期改良选拔。在春季，它是 Maplewood 收集区乃至其他地方最为耀眼的观叶品种之一。有人将其叶色形容为消防车红，但用火焰猩红或深绯红来描述更为贴切。许多人认为，其叶色比 'Chishio'、'Deshoj\ o'\' 和 'Seigai' 等类似春叶品种更为明亮。新叶在春季最初一个月甚至更久都能保持这种色彩。至盛夏时，叶色转为悦目的带红绿色。偶尔可见叶片带有极细小的浅奶油色或白色斑点，但斑锦并不明显。秋季则转为红色与橙色的混合。小型的 5 裂或 7 裂叶属于 Palmatum Group，基部裂片很小。老枝上的叶片长宽均为 3-5 厘米，生长旺盛的新枝上叶片可达长 6 厘米、宽 7 厘米。裂片结合深度达叶基的三分之二以上。裂片明显卵形，先端渐尖。叶缘具锯齿，齿尖锐利。细长叶柄呈红褐色至紫红色，长 2-4 厘米。幼枝也为红褐色至深紫红色。该枫并非高大型品种，成熟后形成高约 3 米、宽约 2 米的灌木。幼株会抽生强健新梢，但随着年限增加，Corvallis

descriptions.preferred: The extremely brilliant spring foliage turns a good green in the summer. The small leaves have five to seven moderately deeply divided ovate lobes tapering to well-defined tips. The margins are coarsely and sharply toothed. This multibranched, vigorous shrub grows up to 16 ft. (5 m) tall. It is among the best of the cultivars with bright pink-red spring color. It adapts well to container growing for patio display and for bonsai culture. It is known and sold mainly under the name 'Chishio Improved', which is illegitimate per the international cultivar code and should not be used. The name means "new Chishio," indicating its connection to a previously named cultivar.

rhs.description: Deciduous, multi-branched, shrubby tree about 5m tall, bearing red young shoots, and small, 5-7 lobed leaves 3-6cm long, with coarsely-toothed margins. Young leaves are bright pinkish-red, the colour lasting into summer when they mature to green, then orange-red tones of varying intensity in autumn.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 春季叶色极为鲜艳，入夏后转为优美的绿色。叶片较小，具 5 至 7 枚中度深裂的卵形裂片，裂片渐尖，先端清晰。叶缘具粗而锐利的锯齿。该品种为多分枝、长势旺盛的灌木，高可达 16 英尺（5 米）。在春季呈亮粉红至红色的品种中，它属于表现最佳者之一。很适合容器栽培，用于露台陈设，也适于盆景培养。它主要以 'Chishio Improved' 这一名称被认知和销售，但依据国际栽培品种命名法规，该名称并不合法，不应使用。其名称意为“新的 Chishio”，表明其与先前命名的一个品种存在关联。

descriptions.preferred: Spring leaves are a brilliant scarlet or crimson-scarlet which lasts a month or more before becoming a pleasant reddish green, then turning red and orange in the fall. The small leaves are moderately deeply divided into five to seven strongly ovate lobes with pointed tips. The margins have sharp teeth. The slender leafstalks and young shoots are redbrown to dark purple-red. This cultivar forms a shrub up to 10 ft. (3 m) high and 61⁄2 ft. (2 m) wide. It is an excellent container plant for patio display and is popular as a bonsai plant. Shin means "new," implying that the plant is an improved selection of the well-known 'Desho¯jo¯'.

products.title: Acer palmatum 'Shin hikasa' Dwarf Variegated Japanese Maple
products.description_text: Acer palmatum 'Shin hikasa' Dwarf Reticulated Variegated Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 Think of a tightly layered Japanese maple with shingle-like leaves that are variegated like 'Higasayama'. That crazy dwarf Japanese maple exists. It is 'Shin hikasa'. Like all "Higasayama-types", they do not variegate well for us in the cold frame or greenhouse. When you plant the Shin hikasa tree outside, you will see the variegation come through, more than likely the following spring. 'Shin hikasa' leafs out in the early spring with bright pink variegation overtop of green reticulated veins. As the summer approaches, the leaves of Shin hikasa turn to cream, and then to white. Fall colors are oranges to reds. 'Shin hikasa' will get 4 to 5 ft in 15 years in a dense tightly layered habit. Shin hikasa is extremely rare and hard to find and is a great addition to any garden. descriptions.preferred: The leaves are shaped in the long, slender form of the Linearilobum Group. They have mostly five lobes, sometimes three or seven lobes, and are 6-9 cm long and up to 8 cm wide. Each lobe is straplike and not more than 5-10 mm wide. The lobes tend to hang down, giving a cascading appearance. The margins may be smooth or lightly toothed. Juvenile leaves have ovate broader toothed lobes of the deeply divided matsumurae type. The petioles are 2-4 cm long. The bright but dark green foliage holds its color well all season. As fall approaches, State University Archives, Corvallis used in bonsai culture. Synonyms, alternative names and spellings, and misspellings are numerous and include 'Fingerlobe', 'Lineare', 'Linearifolium', 'Scolopendrifolium', 'Scolopendrifolium Viride', and 'Sinobuga oka'. 'Ao shichigosan' and 'Ao meshime-no-uchi' are so similar to 'Shinobuga oka' that they are also included here with their alternative and misspellings—'Ao hichi gosan', 'Aome-no-uchi', 'Aono-hichi gosan', 'Ao-no-shichi gosan', and 'Ao shime-nouchi'—although these cultivars have pink fruits, according to Cor van Gelderen (pers. comm.), as does 'Linearilobum'. 'Linearilobum' might be identical to 'Shinobuga oka' (van Gelderen et al. 1994). Thus, to avoid confusion with the group name and the cultivar name, it seems best to include the cultivar under 'Shinobuga oka'.

rhs.description: A deciduous, upright Japanese maple, about 3-4m tall, of twiggy growth, with long slender usually 5-lobed bright but dark green leaves, sometimes 3 or 7 lobes to 9cm long, holds its colour through spring and summer then turns yellow in autumn; suited to bonsai training

attributes.suggested_uses: City/Courtyard Gardens, Cottage/Informal Garden, Flower borders and beds, Patio/Container Plants
attributes.hort_group_description: Acers in this linearilobum group have long, narrow, strap-like lobes, with lightly serrated edges

care.cultivation: Grow in any moisture-retentive, well-drained soil in a sheltered position. Leaf colour is best in partial shade, although full sun can be tolerated if soil is reliably moist. Leaf scorch can be caused by lack of soil moisture or excessive exposure. See Japanese maples cultivation
care.pruning: Pruning group 1 , only from late autumn to mid-winter
care.propagation: Propagate by softwood cuttings, layering or by grafting . Plants grown from seed are unlikely to come true, but may still be garden worthy

resistance.pest: May be susceptible to aphids and scale insects , including horse chestnut scale
resistance.disease: May be susceptible to Verticillium wilt , Acer leaf scorch and honey fungus

rhs_zh.description: 落叶性、直立型日本枫，株高约 3–4 米，枝条细密。叶片细长，通常为 5 裂，色泽明亮而偏深绿，有时为 3 裂或 7 裂，叶长可达 9 厘米；春夏季能较好保持叶色，秋季转黄。适合做盆景培养。

attributes.suggested_uses: 城市庭院花园、乡村风或自然式花园、花境与花坛、庭院容器栽培
attributes.hort_group_description: 此 linearilobum 组的槭树具有细长、带状的裂片，叶缘具浅锯齿。

care.cultivation: 宜栽于保水且排水良好的土壤中，并选择避风位置。半阴环境下叶色表现最佳；若土壤湿度稳定，也可耐全日照。土壤缺水或暴露过度都可能导致叶片焦边。参见 Japanese maples cultivation。
care.pruning: 修剪组 1，仅限晚秋至仲冬期间修剪。
care.propagation: 可通过嫩枝扦插、压条或嫁接繁殖。实生苗通常难以保持品种性状，但仍可能具有园艺观赏价值。

resistance.pest: 可能易受蚜虫和介壳虫侵害，包括七叶树介壳虫。
resistance.disease: 可能易感黄萎病、槭叶焦枯病和蜜环菌病

descriptions_zh.preferred: 叶片呈 Linearilobum Group 特有的细长狭带状外形。多为 5 裂，有时为 3 裂或 7 裂，长 6-9 厘米，宽可达 8 厘米。每个裂片呈带状，宽不超过 5-10 毫米。裂片常下垂，整体呈现下泻感。叶缘可为全缘，或略具细齿。幼年叶则为深裂 matsumurae 型，裂片较宽，呈卵形并具齿。叶柄长 2-4 厘米。叶色鲜明而较深的绿色，整个生长季持色性良好。随着秋季临近，State University Archives, Corvallis 也将其用于盆景栽培。其同物异名、别名、不同拼写及误拼很多，包括 'Fingerlobe'、'Lineare'、'Linearifolium'、'Scolopendrifolium'、'Scolopendrifolium Viride' 和 'Sinobuga oka'。'Ao shichigosan' 与 'Ao meshime-no-uchi' 与 'Shinobuga oka' 极为相似，因此此处也一并归入，并包括其别名及误拼：'Ao hichi gosan'、'Aome-no-uchi'、'Aono-hichi gosan'、'Ao-no-shichi gosan' 和 'Ao shime-nouchi'。不过据 Cor van Gelderen（私人通信）称，这些品种结粉红色果实，'Linearilobum' 亦然。'Linearilobum' 可能与 'Shinobuga oka' 为同一品种（van Gelderen et al. 1994）。因此，为避免组名与品种名混淆，似乎最好将该品种归于 'Shinobuga oka' 名下。

products.title: Acer palmatum 'Ao shime-no-uchi shidare' Green Linearilobum Japanese Maple
products.description_text: Acer palmatum 'Ao shime-no-uchi shidare' Rare Green Linearilobum Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 ‘Ao shime-no-uchi shidare' is a shorter more multi-stemmed linearilobum. While "shidare" often translates as weeping, it appears that it means refers to the spreading habit of this green strapleaf Japanese maple. While other similar selections have a taller and narrow habit, 'Ao shime-no-uchi shidare' has a shorter and wider habit, which is quite unique. 'Ao shime-no-uchi shidare' may reach 6-8 ft tall and equally as wide in 10 years. Fall color on this selection ranges from yellow to orange. descriptions.preferred: The spring foliage of this cultivar is a bright orange red and turns a deeper red as it matures. These are very noticeable color tones when compared with other red cultivars. Later in the summer, the leaves become green with a deep red overtone. This pattern accentuates the green of the midribs. The pink to orange-red second growth contrasts well with the bronze green of late summer. The seven-lobed leaves are 5-7 cm long and 7-9 cm wide, and deeply divided at least three-quarters of the way to the leaf base. The lobes are elongate-ovate, broad- Corvallis long. The young branches of this upright plant grow vigorously, with the leaf nodes spaced well apart. With age, the shoots become shorter and more branched. 'Shinonome' has an open habit of growth and reaches up to 4 m high. It is not a well-known cultivar but offers a nice contrast when used in large plantings. Well-grown container plants make a fine display. The name has been misspelled 'Shioname'.

rhs.description: 'Shinonome' is a small tree up to 4m high with an open, arching habit, medium-sized, deeply divided, seven-lobed leaves, toothed on the outer two-thirds, the young leaves emerging bright orange-red in spring, ageing to deeper red and then green with a deep red overtone and green veins in late summer, and turning orange-red again in autumn, and tiny, purple-red flowers in small, pendent corymbs in spring followed by red-winged fruit in late summer

attributes.suggested_uses: Hedging/Screens, Low Maintenance, Banks and Slopes, City/Courtyard Gardens, Cottage/Informal Garden, Flower borders and beds
attributes.hort_group_description: Acers in this matsumurae group are deeply divided to around three quarters of the leaf with coarsely-toothed edges and narrow, pointed lobes

care.cultivation: Grow in a place sheltered from cold drying winds and from late frosts, in full sun where its colours will develop best or in light dappled shade, in moist but well-drained neutral or acidic soil that does not dry out in summer or become waterlogged in winter, and protect roots with an open-textured organic mulch such as coarse bark; for more advice, see Japanese maple cultivation
care.pruning: Pruning group 1 (little or no pruning of trees and shrubs) and prune if necessary only from late autumn to midwinter
care.propagation: Propagate by grafting in late winter, or by budding in summer; semi-ripe cuttings, hardwood cuttings, or layering may also be successful

resistance.pest: May be susceptible to Acer gall mite, aphids , caterpillars and horse chestnut scale
resistance.disease: May be susceptible to Verticillium wilt , Acer leaf scorch and honey fungus

attributes.suggested_uses: 适合作绿篱/屏障、低维护种植、护坡与斜坡绿化、城市/庭院花园、乡村风/自然式花园，以及花境与花坛。

rhs_zh.description: 'Shinonome' 为小型乔木，高可达 4 米，株型开张并略呈拱垂。叶片中等大小，深裂，7 裂，外侧三分之二具锯齿。春季幼叶鲜橙红色，随后加深为更浓的红色，至夏末转为带深红色晕染和绿色叶脉的绿色；秋季再次转为橙红色。春季开极小的紫红色花，成下垂小伞房花序，晚夏结红色翅果。

care.cultivation: 宜栽植于可避开寒冷干风和晚霜的位置；全日照下叶色表现最佳，也可在疏荫环境中栽培。土壤应保持湿润但排水良好，宜中性至酸性，夏季不宜干透，冬季不可积水。根部可覆盖疏松质地的有机覆盖物，如粗树皮，以利保湿护根。更多建议参见日本枫栽培说明。
care.pruning: 修剪组 1（树木和灌木几乎不修剪或仅少量修剪）；如确有必要，仅宜在晚秋至隆冬期间进行修剪。
care.propagation: 可于冬末进行嫁接繁殖，或于夏季芽接；半成熟枝扦插、硬枝扦插或压条繁殖有时也能成功。

descriptions_zh.preferred: 该品种春季新叶呈鲜亮的橙红色，成熟后转为更深的红色。与其他红叶品种相比，这种色调十分醒目。到夏季后期，叶片转绿，但仍覆盖一层深红色晕染，这种色彩变化更凸显中脉的绿色。粉红至橙红色的二次萌发新梢，与夏末的古铜绿色叶片形成良好对比。叶片 7 裂，长 5-7 厘米、宽 7-9 厘米，至少深裂至叶基的四分之三。裂片狭长卵形。该直立型植株幼枝生长旺盛，叶节间距较大；随树龄增长，枝条会变短且分枝更多。‘Shinonome’ 株形开展通透，高可达 4 米。它并不是广为人知的品种，但用于大型种植时能形成良好对比；生长良好的容器苗观赏效果也很出色。其名称也曾被误拼为 ‘Shioname’。

descriptions.preferred: Although this cultivar is mentioned as far back as 1710, it is not well known or widely distributed. The mediumsized leaves have five or seven lobes and are deeply divided to less than 1 cm from the leaf base. The leaf is 7-8 cm long and about the same wide, with the lobes radiating outward. Each lobe is elongate-ovate, narrowing at the base, and with the outer end tapering to an elongated point. The margin in the lower half of each lobe is almost smooth, while the upper half is sharply toothed. Each lobe has a slight longitudinal upward roll from the midrib. The petioles are 1.5-2 cm long. Spring foliage is bright red with green undertones, gradually changing to green during the summer. The fall colors are tones of yellow. 'Shiraname' is not a rangygrowing plant but forms a tall bush with lateral branch- Corvallis The name means "lion's head" or "lion's mane," referring to the mythical lion of Japanese drama, and was given to this cultivar because of the shape of the bunched-up, heavily curled leaves at the end of short, stout shoots. There are two forms of this cultivar in Japanese horticulture. 'Mejishi', which means "female lion," is the designation of the more widely distributed form better known as 'Shishigashira'. 'O|jishi', meaning "male lion," is a dwarfer cultivar with slightly larger leaves. The compact growth of this cultivar makes it very popular for small gardens, container culture, and bonsai. The outstanding feature is the close-packed arrangement of the leaves on the twigs, and the close arrangement of the twigs. The bright green foliage is quite crinkled, which adds to the stubby growth effect. The small leaf is 3-5 cm long and almost as wide. Each leaf has five or seven lobes with the two basal lobes much smaller. The lobes divide up to three-quarters of the way to the leaf base. Each lobe is ovate and tapers to a point. The sides are curled upward, occasionally convoluted, and in most cases forming a V-shaped trough. In addition, most leaves are further crinkled along the edges of the lobes. The margins are coarsely but irregularly toothed. Most of the crinkled leaves display the veins prominently, providing an almost rugose-appearing surface. However, some leaves do retain a smooth appearance. The petioles are short and stiff and 1.5-3 cm long. The deep green foliage is of a heavy substance and firm to the touch. Color is maintained very well during summer, even in hot sun. There is very little sunburn on vigorous plants. The fall coloration is a striking combination of gold suffused with rose and crimson tones. The entire plant takes on a different appearance during the seasonal change, making it quite prominent. Usuallyaslow-growingplant,'Shishigashira'caneventually reach 5 m or more in height. The size of the tree can easily be controlled by the amount of fertility available. It should always have enough nutrients to keep the good green tones in the foliage. However, it stays quite short and dense if not overfertilized. Training and pruning this cultivar to accentuate the shrubby tufts of growth on the branches can emphasize the plant's character. The effect is outstanding. cifolium', and 'Ribesifolium'.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 该品种早在 1710 年即有记载，但并不著名，流通也不广。叶片中等大小，5 裂或 7 裂，深裂至距叶基不足 1 厘米处。叶长 7-8 厘米，宽度大致相同，裂片向外放射展开。每个裂片为狭长卵形，基部渐窄，外端渐尖成长尖。裂片下半部叶缘近乎全缘，上半部则具锐利锯齿。每个裂片自中脉起略向上纵向卷曲。叶柄长 1.5-2 厘米。春叶鲜红，带有绿色底调，夏季逐渐转绿。秋色为黄色调。'Shiraname' 并非枝条松散外张的类型，而是形成高大灌丛，侧枝开展。Corvallis 记载其名意为“狮子头”或“狮鬃”，指日本戏剧中神话狮子的形象，因此得名，因其短而粗壮枝条顶端簇生、强烈卷曲的叶片形似狮鬃。日本园艺中该品种有两个类型。'Mejishi'，意为“母狮”，是流通更广、通常更为人熟知的类型，即 'Shishigashira'；'O|jishi'，意为“公狮”，则是更矮化的品种，叶片略大。该品种株形紧凑，因此非常适合小型庭院、容器栽培和盆景。其最突出的特征是叶片在枝条上排列极为紧密，枝条本身也排列紧凑。鲜绿色叶片强烈皱缩，进一步增强了短粗紧凑的观感。小叶长 3-5 厘米，宽几乎相同。每叶 5 裂或 7 裂，其中两枚基部裂片明显较小。裂片深达叶基约四分之三。每个裂片呈卵形，先端渐尖。叶片两侧向上卷起，偶有扭曲，多形成 V 形槽。此外，多数叶片在裂片边缘还进一步皱褶。叶缘具粗大但不规则的锯齿。大多数皱缩叶片叶脉突出，使叶面近似皱革状；不过，也有少数叶片仍较平滑。叶柄短而硬，长 1.5-3 厘米。深绿色叶片质地厚实，触感坚挺。夏季持色性极佳，即使在烈日下亦然。生长健壮的植株几乎不发生日灼。秋季叶色为金色中晕染玫瑰色和绯红色的醒目组合。整株在季节变色时呈现出完全不同的观感，十分突出。'Shishigashira' 通常生长缓慢，但最终可达 5 米或更高。树体大小可通过肥力水平轻松控制。应保持充足养分，以维持叶片良好的绿色调；但若不过度施肥，则可保持较矮且致密。通过整枝和修剪，强调枝上灌丛状的簇生生长，可进一步凸显其品种特色，效果非常出色。cifolium'，以及 'Ribesifolium'。

descriptions.preferred: This cultivar is one of the excellent dwarf shrubs with dense foliage. The five lobes radiate out and are separated to about halfway to the truncate leaf base. The lobes do not radiate in a star-shaped manner as strongly as do those of some other similar dwarf cultivars, such as which holds well during the entire season and does not seem too prone to sunburn. Fall colors range through the yellow tones. 'Shishi yatsubusa' is a strong but stubby-growing shrub which develops an angular limb structure with age. It is reported to be popular with bonsai hobbyists and is of fairly easy culture. However, propagating wood is always limited, which is understandable with the small annual growth produced. The name means "a small lion or lion cub." Other names under which this cultivar has been known are 'Chishi yatsubusa' and 'Dwarf Shishi'.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 该品种是叶幕浓密的优良矮生灌木之一。5 枚裂片向外放射，分离至近截形叶基约一半处。与某些其他相似矮生品种相比，其裂片放射状不那么强烈，不呈特别明显的星形展开。叶色为良好的深绿色，整个生长季保持稳定，似乎也不太容易发生日灼。秋色主要为黄色系。‘Shishi yatsubusa’ 生长强健但较短粗，随着树龄增长会形成棱角分明的枝干结构。据称它很受盆景爱好者欢迎，且较易栽培。不过，由于其年生长量有限，可供繁殖的枝条一直不多，这也在情理之中。其名称意为“小狮子”或“幼狮”。该品种还曾以 ‘Chishi yatsubusa’ 和 ‘Dwarf Shishi’ 的名称流传。

This small dwarf maple is sure to be an eye-catching addition to your landscape. With its reliable, showy foliage and fall colors, it is an excellent choice for adding that one-of-a kind interest to any outdoor space.

sources.description: At Herter Nursery, we proudly offer the rare and distinctive Shishigashira Japanese Maple for sale. Also known as “Lion’s Head,” this compact, upright variety is prized for its dense, curled foliage that resembles a lion’s mane, offering a striking presence in any garden or landscape. Ideal for any landscape or container, the Shishigashira maple grows slowly and offers year-round visual interest. In spring and summer, the leaves of the Shishigashira are a rich green, but it’s in autumn when this maple truly shines. As cooler temperatures arrive, its foliage bursts into brilliant shades of fiery orange and red, transforming any space into a stunning display of fall color. Perfect for small spaces, containers, or as a focal point in your garden, the Shishigashira Japanese maple available for sale at our nursery is slow-growing and incredibly hardy, making it easy to maintain. Reaching a mature height of 8 to 10 feet, it thrives in well-draining soil and partial shade, ensuring a long-lasting, low-maintenance addition to your landscape. Shishigashira’s upright form is perfect for adding structure and visual interest, particularly in Japanese gardens. Order now from Herter Nursery and enjoy personal care from our family-run business. With over 100 varieties of Japanese maples, we are here to help you find the perfect match for your garden or landscape.

care.cultivation: 宜种植于湿润但排水良好的土壤中。夏季如有需要应浇水。叶色在半阴环境下表现最佳，但也可耐全日照。土壤水分不足或暴露过度都可能导致叶片焦枯。

care.propagation: 可采用嫁接或软枝扦插繁殖

rhs_zh.description: 'Shish geshira' 为枝叶致密的灌木，具独特的直立生长习性，着生大量小型深绿色裂叶，秋季转为柔和的橙色。

descriptions_zh.preferred: 该品种以短而粗壮枝条顶端簇生、强烈卷曲的叶片著称，形似狮鬃。小型叶片为 5-7 裂，裂片深裂，呈卵形并渐尖成锐尖；两侧向上卷曲，偶有扭转，常形成 V 形槽，叶缘多呈皱褶状，具粗大但不规则的锯齿。叶柄短而硬。深绿色叶片在秋季转为金色中晕染玫瑰色与绯红色的惊艳组合。该品种通常生长缓慢，但最终可长至 20 英尺（6 米）以上。其紧凑株形使其非常适合小型庭院、容器栽培和盆景。这一独特品种总能吸引注意。其名称意为“狮子头”，指叶簇形态酷似日本戏剧中神话狮子 Shishi。'Shishio hime' 植株属 Dwarf Group，叶色为绿色，春季叶缘及叶尖带红，夏季转为中绿色，秋季变为明亮的黄色至金色。小型 5 裂叶向外放射展开，中度深裂。每个裂片呈卵形，先端尖，叶缘具深而整齐的锯齿。细长叶柄十分纤细。其生长习性与 'Murasaki kiyohime' 相似，但更小，形成低矮、紧凑、开展的矮灌木，高宽约 3 1/2 英尺（1.2 米）。非常适合容器栽培和盆景。'SHO¯ JO¯' 属 Amoenum Group，叶色为红色。极深的紫红近黑红叶色在整个夏季都能良好保持，秋色为深红色。中等大小叶片 5-7 裂，深裂，裂片狭长卵形，先端细长。叶缘规则且略具细齿。细长叶柄为红褐色。该品种最终形成宽大、直立的小乔木，高至少 13 英尺（4 米）。其名称取自日本戏剧中的红脸猴 Sho¯jo¯，指的正是其叶色。

products.title: Acer palmatum 'Shishigashira' Lion's Head Japanese Maple
products.description_text: Acer palmatum 'Shishigashira ' 'Shishigashira' Lion's Head Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 10 Gallons Available to be Shipped! ‘Shishigashira’ is a very unique upright green Japanese maple cultivar. The deep green leaves are crinkled with compact branching that adds to the amazing architectural shape of the tree. The growth habit is very dense branching with a widening effect midway up on mature trees. The color of this Japanese maple in early spring is a deep green and it holds this color very well throughout the entire summer. In the autumn ‘Shishigashira’ puts on an amazing show of deep yellows and golden shades with hints of red and orange. This cultivar is often referred to as Lion’s Head in America but a more literal translation refers to the head of a specific female lion character in Japanese drama. When witnessing the amazing fall spectrum on this Japanese maple it is easy to see how this majestic look has become associated with a lion’s mane. ‘Shishigashira’ grows well in sun or shade though we have noticed the tree consistently grows larger in filtered light. The height of Lionshead can reach 8-12 ft over time. The Lion's Head is a favorite in the bonsai trade for its unique growth habit and is also an excellent Japanese maple tree for container growing for a porch or patio. 'Shishigashira' makes a great addition for anyone looking for something a little interesting, unique, and outside the box. **10 GALLON TREE SHIPS WITHOUT POT DUE TO BOX SIZE CONSTRAINTS** Please note that your 10-gallon tree will arrive without a container. It ships immediately unless you request to hold. Be prepared for your 10 gallon tree without a container. Limited Quantities Available !! As we have over a thousand cultivars of Japanese maples, we often do not have many of each cultivar. We recommend that you buy the Japanese maples you want immediately as we often sell out of certain selections.

products.name: Shishigashira “Lions Head’ Japanese Maple
products.description_text: At Herter Nursery, we proudly offer the rare and distinctive Shishigashira Japanese Maple for sale. Also known as “Lion’s Head,” this compact, upright variety is prized for its dense, curled foliage that resembles a lion’s mane, offering a striking presence in any garden or landscape. Ideal for any landscape or container, the Shishigashira maple grows slowly and offers year-round visual interest. In spring and summer, the leaves of the Shishigashira are a rich green, but it’s in autumn when this maple truly shines. As cooler temperatures arrive, its foliage bursts into brilliant shades of fiery orange and red, transforming any space into a stunning display of fall color. Perfect for small spaces, containers, or as a focal point in your garden, the Shishigashira Japanese maple available for sale at our nursery is slow-growing and incredibly hardy, making it easy to maintain. Reaching a mature height of 8 to 10 feet, it thrives in well-draining soil and partial shade, ensuring a long-lasting, low-maintenance addition to your landscape. Shishigashira’s upright form is perfect for adding structure and visual interest, particularly in Japanese gardens. Order now from Herter Nursery and enjoy personal care from our family-run business. With over 100 varieties of Japanese maples, we are here to help you find the perfect match for your garden or landscape.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 小型直立日本枫，株形圆整。叶片多为 7 裂，春季展叶时呈红色，夏季转绿，秋季再转红色；红色花与翅果也具有一定观赏性，适合小庭院与需要四季变化的种植场景。

descriptions.preferred: This dwarf shrub has small leaves of the palmatum type which have red edges and tips when young, becoming an 'Shishigashira' lengthens the color season in fall. Photo courtesy of Oregon State University Archives, Corvallis narrowing to 5-8 mm at the lobe junctions. The margins are deeply and evenly double toothed. The long, very slender petioles are 1.5-3.5 cm long. The growth habit is similar to that of 'Murasaki kiyohime' but smaller, forming a low, dwarf-spreading shrub. It is densely foliaged and slow growing at first, reaching 0.8 m tall and 1.2 m wide in 10 years, although young juvenile shoots may be 10-12 cm long in the early years, but become much shorter with age. It eventually becomes one of the more vigorous dwarfs. It is an excellent plant for container culture and bonsai. There is some doubt about the correctness of the name 'Shishio hime' and whether it should be spelled 'Shishi hime' or 'Chishio hime'. It does not appear to be of Japanese origin. This maple is widely available in northwestern North America as 'Shishio hime'.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 该矮生灌木具 palmatum 型小叶，幼叶时叶缘和叶尖带红色，从而延长了秋季观色期。叶片在裂片连接处收窄至 5-8 毫米。叶缘深且均匀地呈重锯齿。细长叶柄长 1.5-3.5 厘米。其生长习性与 'Murasaki kiyohime' 相似，但体型更小，形成低矮、开展的矮生灌木。初期枝叶致密、生长缓慢，10 年后约高 0.8 米、宽 1.2 米；不过在早年阶段，幼年枝条可长达 10-12 厘米，随植株老化则明显缩短。最终它会成为较为强健的矮生品种之一。非常适合容器栽培和盆景。关于名称 'Shishio hime' 的正确性仍有一些疑问，也不确定是否应拼作 'Shishi hime' 或 'Chishio hime'。它似乎并非源自日本。在北美西北部，该枫树通常以 'Shishio hime' 之名流通。

products.name: Acer palmatum 'Shishio hime' Dwarf Japanese Maple
products.description_text: Acer palmatum ‘Shishio hime’ is a very nice, small Japanese maple that will grow much wider than tall, forming a low mound with age. 'Shishio hime' emerges in spring with Red tips to the leaves before turning green for the summer. The leaves become smaller each year as the plant matures. Older specimens have some of the smallest leaves of any Acer palmatum. The foliage is also extremely dense. Fall color ranges from red and yellow to orange. 10 year size: Height: 1-3 Feet Width: 4-6 Feet

descriptions.preferred: This deep colored cultivar has very deep purple-red foliage, almost black red. The color holds well into late summer, especially if the plant is given afternoon shade. In the fall, crimson tones dominate. The fiveor seven-lobed leaves are 7-8 cm long and 8-9 cm wide, with the lobes spreading openly. The leaves are rather thin in texture. The lobes are elongate-ovate, terminating in a slender point, and they divide to within 1 cm of the leaf base. The margins are regularly and lightly serrated. The slender red-brown petioles are 4 cm long. The leaves are spaced openly along the shoots, giving the appearance of less foliage than normal. The growth tivars to signify the color red. This cultivar has also been known under the names 'Syoiou' and 'Syojo'.

rhs.description: A deciduous, upright Japanese maple about 3m tall, with strongly radiating 7-lobed leaves, each lobe tapering to a sharp tip. The leaves emerge light bronze-red to purple-red in spring, becoming green tinged bright orange-red in summer, then bright scarlet tones in autumn; the name means "beautiful red-faced monkey"

care.cultivation: Grow in any moisture-retentive, well-drained soil in a sheltered position. Leaf colour is best in partial shade, although full sun can be tolerated if soil is reliably moist. Leaf scorch can be caused by lack of soil moisture or excessive exposure. See Japanese maples cultivation
care.pruning: Pruning group 1 , only from late autumn to mid-winter
care.propagation: Propagate by softwood cuttings, layering or by grafting . Plants grown from seed are unlikely to come true, but may still be garden worthy

resistance.pest: May be susceptible to aphids and scale insects , including horse chestnut scale
resistance.disease: May be susceptible to Verticillium wilt , Acer leaf scorch and honey fungus

care.cultivation: 宜栽于保水且排水良好的土壤中，并选择避风位置。半阴环境下叶色表现最佳；若土壤湿度稳定，也可耐全日照。土壤缺水或暴露过度都可能导致叶片焦边。参见 Japanese maples cultivation。
care.pruning: 修剪组 1，仅限晚秋至仲冬期间修剪。
care.propagation: 可通过嫩枝扦插、压条或嫁接繁殖。实生苗通常难以保持品种性状，但仍可能具有园艺观赏价值。

resistance.pest: 可能易受蚜虫和介壳虫侵害，包括七叶树介壳虫。
resistance.disease: 可能易感黄萎病、槭叶焦枯病和蜜环菌病

rhs_zh.description: 一种落叶、直立型日本枫，高约 3 米。叶片强烈放射状展开，7 裂，每裂片渐尖至锐尖。春季新叶呈浅古铜红至紫红色，夏季转为带鲜橙红晕的绿色，秋季则变为鲜猩红色；其名称意为“美丽的红脸猴”.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 春季新叶呈浅‘Sho¯ red’，夏季转为鲜明的亮红色，秋季变为猩红色。中等大小的叶片有 7 个向外放射、几乎裂至叶基的裂片。每个裂片均为长卵形，渐尖成细长锐尖，边缘具细锯齿。短叶柄与新梢带红色并略染褐色。‘Sho¯jo¯ nomura’ 形成不规则的直立圆头小乔木，高可达 16 英尺（5 米）。其名意为“美丽的红脸猴”。 ‘Sho¯ jo¯ shidare’ 属于 Beni Dissectum Group，红叶型。春叶为栗紫红色，叶脉带深绿色晕染；夏季叶色加深为深栗红色，与短叶柄和新梢的颜色相呼应。叶片深裂为 7 至 9 个裂片，边缘不规则具齿。该品种耐寒性略弱，形成高大的垂枝型树形，高可达 10 英尺（3 米）。其名意为“红脸猴”。 ‘jo¯-no-mai’ 属于 variegated Group。‘Sho¯jo¯-no-mai’ 是斑叶 palmatum 中较优秀的品种之一，叶色鲜明。叶片底色为中等至浅绿色，配以迷人的深粉色叶缘；这种斑锦常使裂片尖端向外反卷，呈现悦目的迎风姿态。小型叶片形态优美，深裂成长卵形裂片，裂片尖端常弯曲且具尖头，边缘有明显粗齿。该品种在生长势、树形和叶片方面与 ‘shichihenge’ 很相似，但不同之处在于其春季叶片具有纯粉色斑锦。其名意为“起舞的红脸猴”。
