descriptions.preferred: The basic color of the leaf is a deep maroon, brightest in the new foliage and darkening as the leaf matures. A dark, rich green tone is suffused down the center of each lobe and sublobe. The two-tone color combination gives this plant a unique appearance. The petioles are deep maroon, as are the young twigs and branches. The leaves have seven or nine lobes and are pinnately dissected with irregular toothing on the sublobes. Some sublobes are long and slender. The leaves are 4-7 cm long and 5-7 cm wide. On leaves of new wood, the lobes are occasionally restricted between the sublobes to only the width of the midrib. The sublobes, in turn, have minute extensions for 1-3 mm. The petioles are slender but firm and are 2-3 cm long. This cultivar has the cascading form typical of dissectums and forms a tall dome up to 3 m high. To see the beauty of the cascading form, it should be grafted high or staked up for a few years. It is very beautiful but little known, possibly because it is a little tender and not easily propagated. 'Sho\jo\ shidare' has also been known under the name 'Nomura shidare', which may be synonymous. It has been misspelled 'Syojo shidare'. 'Skeeter's Broom' dwarf -red This maple originated from a witches'-broom on 'Bloodgood' and was found and named by Edward Rodd of Raraflora Nursery, Kinterfield, Pennsylvania. It is similar to several other dwarf red cultivars derived from witches'brooms on 'Bloodgood' but has longer leaves than most. Whereas these often have the central lobe truncated, 'Skeeter's Broom' may have any of the other lobes short and rounded. Occasionally, the central lobe can be almost absent. The seven-lobed, occasionally five-lobed leaves are doubly divided to within 7 mm of the leaf base, well separated, and spread out. They are 3.5-5.5 cm long and 4.5-7.5 cm wide. Each lobe is ovate with a long, pointed parent, 'Skeeter's Broom' holds its color very well. It forms a narrow, upright dwarf shrub, reaching about 2 m high when fully grown.

rhs.description: A low-growing spreading shrub, to around 2.5m height and width, with pendulous branches bearing deeply-cut leaves. The leaves emerge deep purple with dark green colouring down the centre of each lobe giving them a two-tone effect. In autumn, the foliage turns a brilliant scarlet-red. Red flowers borne in spring may be followed by winged fruits in autumn

care.cultivation: Grow in a moist but well-drained soil. Water in summer if necessary. Leaf colour is best in partial shade, although full sun can be tolerated. Leaf scorch can be caused by lack of soil moisture, drying winds or late spring frost. See Japanese maple cultivation

resistance.pest: May be susceptible to Acer gall mite, aphids , caterpillars and horse chestnut scale
resistance.disease: May be susceptible to Verticillium wilt , Acer leaf scorch and honey fungus

rhs_zh.description: 一种低矮、开展的灌木，高和冠幅均可达约 2.5 米，枝条下垂，着生深裂叶。新叶初展时为深紫色，每个裂片中央带深绿色，形成双色效果。秋季叶色转为明艳的猩红色。春季开红花，秋季其后可结翅果。

attributes.suggested_uses: 城市/庭院花园、露台/容器植物、岩石园、结构性观赏、乡村/自然式花园、低维护
attributes.hort_group_description: dissectum 组的槭树具有细致、羽毛状、深裂的叶片，叶缘具细锯齿。

descriptions_zh.preferred: 叶片的基础色为深栗红色，新叶时最为鲜艳，随叶片成熟而逐渐加深。每个主裂片和次裂片的中央都晕染着深而浓的绿色，形成独特的双色效果。叶柄为深栗红色，幼枝和小枝亦然。叶片具七或九裂，羽状深裂，次裂片边缘具不规则锯齿，部分次裂片细长。叶长 4-7 厘米，宽 5-7 厘米。新梢上的叶片，其裂片在次裂片之间有时狭窄到仅剩中脉宽度；而次裂片本身还可再延伸出 1-3 毫米的极细小裂尖。叶柄细而坚韧，长 2-3 厘米。该品种具有典型 dissectum 类群的垂枝下垂树形，可形成高达 3 米的高拱形树冠。若要充分展现其垂枝之美，宜高接，或在前几年加以支撑牵引。该品种非常优美，但知名度不高，可能因为稍欠耐寒，且不易繁殖。'Sho\jo\ shidare' 亦曾以 'Nomura shidare' 之名流通，二者可能为同物异名。其名也曾被误写作 'Syojo shidare'。 'Skeeter's Broom' 为一矮生红叶品种，源自 'Bloodgood' 上的丛枝变异（witches'-broom），由宾夕法尼亚州 Kinterfield 的 Raraflora Nursery 的 Edward Rodd 发现并命名。它与其他数个同样源自 'Bloodgood' 丛枝变异的矮生红叶品种相似，但叶片通常较长。这类品种常见中央裂片截短，而 'Skeeter's Broom' 则可能是其他任一裂片较短且呈圆钝状；有时中央裂片甚至几乎缺失。叶片通常七裂，偶为五裂，二回分裂至距叶基 7 毫米处，裂片分离明显并向外展开。叶长 3.5-5.5 厘米，宽 4.5-7.5 厘米。各裂片呈卵形，具长而尖的先端。与其亲本相比，'Skeeter's Broom' 持色性很好。成熟后形成狭窄、直立的矮生灌木，高约 2 米。

descriptions.preferred: 'Sho\jo\-no-mai', whose name means the "dancing redfaced monkey," is one of the best of the 'Beni shichihenge' spring-color group of variegated palmatums. The basic leaf color is medium green to gray green with attractive deep pink edging and tips, sometimes extending more than halfway toward the leaf base. The variegation causes the lobe tips to bend outward, creating a delightful windblown effect. The mainly five-lobed irregular-shaped small leaves divide three-quarters of the way to the leaf base and measure 3.5-4.5 cm long and 4-5 cm wide. The longovate lobes often have curved sharp-pointed tips. The margins are distinctly coarse toothed. The petioles are short and slender, up to 2 cm long. This cultivar is very similar to 'Beni shichihenge' in all aspects of growth, habit, and leaf. 'Beni shichihenge' differs in having brownish tones in the pink variegation, whereas 'Sho\jo\-no-mai' is a pure pink, even deeper and more intense than the pink 'Beni shichihenge', especially in the spring. This cultivar was found and named by Edward Rodd of Raraflora Nursery, Kinterfield, Pennsylvania.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 'Sho\jo\-no-mai'，其名称意为“起舞的红脸猴”，是 'Beni shichihenge' 春色斑叶 palmatum 类群中表现最优秀的品种之一。叶片基色为中绿色至灰绿色，叶缘与叶尖带有迷人的深粉色，斑色有时可向叶基延伸超过一半。斑锦使裂片尖端向外翻卷，形成悦目的迎风效果。叶片多为 5 裂，形状不规则，较小，裂深达叶基的四分之三，长 3.5-4.5 厘米，宽 4-5 厘米。狭长卵形裂片常具弯曲的锐尖。叶缘具明显的粗锯齿。叶柄短而细，长可达 2 厘米。该品种在生长势、株形和叶态等各方面都与 'Beni shichihenge' 非常相似。不同之处在于，'Beni shichihenge' 的粉色斑带棕色调，而 'Sho\jo\-no-mai' 的粉色更纯净，且比粉色型 'Beni shichihenge' 更深、更浓，尤其在春季表现尤为明显。该品种由宾夕法尼亚州 Kinterfield 的 Raraflora Nursery 的 Edward Rodd 发现并命名。

products.title: Acer palmatum 'Shojo no mai' Variegated Japanese Maple
products.description_text: Acer palmatum ‘Shojo no mai' Shojo no mai Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 'Shojo no mai’ is a beautiful pink variegated Japanese maple. The marginal variegation may even appear as a bright red pink in the early spring. The pink-red color on ‘Shojo no mai’ is fairly intense, making this tree add a lot of color contrast in the garden and landscape. 'Shojo no mai' may reach 8-10 ft in 15 years. Fall color is a bright orange. "Shojo" is a term often associated with a red-faced monkey like an orangutan. The term "no mai" refers to dancing. It is often speculated that this literally could be translated as "dancing red-faced monkey". Limited Quantities Available !! descriptions.preferred: 由 Karan Junker 从嘉年华的幼苗中发现的，叶子和嘉年华有点相似，比嘉年华会更耐晒一些，夏季仍需要适当遮阴。如果说嘉年华适合众众赏共评，那么银色庆典更适合独自寻味，嘉年华从远处看一树雪白，犹如亭亭少女，而银色庆典造物主挥毫描绘出它细致的纹理，需要靠近才能看到它的锦叶。春天，新芽和嫩叶略带粉红色，随着时间的推移逐渐褪色，变成绿底边缘乳白色的叶子，白色边缘较窄。 5 裂叶，成年树高约 6m ，长势很好，通常枝条长得很浓密。

Bears clusters of green flowers in spring followed by greenish winged fruits that age to red in autumn

descriptions.preferred: 西蒙路易斯属于欧亚槭，春叶呈现出漂亮的粉红色，成熟叶会变成绿色和白色的杂色。秋天是黄色到橙红色的。夏季需要及时遮阴，避免出现日灼现象。它是由法国 Simon Louis Frères 苗圃于 1881 年培育和引进的，北美洲最早于1896年在加拿大有记录，1955年由阿诺德植物园引入美国。生长相对缓慢，但西蒙路易斯可以达到显著的高度，2009 年测量的最大的英国记录标本高19m，生长在北安普敦郡科比的迪恩公园。

descriptions.preferred: Like other members of the Ghost series, this worthwhile Oregon selection has netted leaves. The medium-large leaves have seven deeply divided narrow curved lobes, with large sharply hooked teeth on the margins, and long tail-like tips. The leaves have a conspicuous network of green veins on a whitishcream background, and look quite ghostly in a shady background. It is estimated this small bushy tree will eventually reach 13 ft. (4 m) tall. It needs some protection from the afternoon sun.

sources.description: 姐妹精灵又称为女精灵、姐妹鬼或女鬼，是由巴克霍兹选育和推广的鬼系品种，也是经典的脉叶品种之一。叶子上带有明显的脉络，一般为 7裂，叶裂深至基部，叶边缘呈锯齿状。女精灵春天叶片为明亮的黄绿色，夏季是奶油绿，秋天是金黄色的，也会出现橙红色。因长势好，抗性强，脉纹清晰，色彩丰富多变等优势深受枫友喜爱。成年树高约为4米，夏季午后需要适当遮阴。 姐妹精灵属于 精灵 系列 ，此系列还有以下品种点击查看

descriptions.preferred: This dwarf cultivar has the smallest leaves of any form of the species. The foliage is a bright, light green which holds well through the summer. Fall colors are mainly bright yellow with red tones. The seven to nine lobes radiate evenly outward and are separated at least halfway to the leaf base. This attractive little plant tends to form a rounded bush, making it popular for bonsai in Japan as it requires little pruning. It fits well into many types of planting, particularly in alpine gardens and in containers on patios. Acer tataricum subsp. ginnala Amur maple The Amur maple is one of the hardiest small maples. It forms a multistemmed, dome-shaped large bush or small tree, reaching 26 ft. (8 m) or so high. The tree is quite trouble-free and adapts to most cultural conditions. The three-lobed small to medium-sized leaves have an oblong-triangular center lobe which is much more prominent and longer than the two short side lobes. The lobe tips are pointed, and the margins are coarsely toothed. The foliage is bright green all season, durable, and withstands full sun. Fall color is a spectacular display of bright scarlet. A bonus is the copious production of bunches of bright red fruits beginning in early summer. The Amur maple grows wild in northeastern China, Manchuria, North Korea, and the islands of Japan. The subspecific name ginnala is also a local name for this maple.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这个矮生栽培品种拥有该种各类型中最小的叶片。叶色鲜亮浅绿，整个夏季保持良好。秋色以明亮的黄色为主，并带红色色调。叶片有 7 至 9 个裂片，均匀向外放射，至少裂至叶基的一半。该品种株形优美，通常形成圆整灌丛，在日本很受盆景爱好者欢迎，因为几乎无需修剪。它适合多种栽植方式，尤其适用于高山园和庭院容器栽培。 Acer tataricum subsp. ginnala Amur maple 东北槭是最耐寒的小型槭树之一。其通常形成多干、穹顶状的大灌木或小乔木，高可达约 26 英尺（8 米）。该树种栽培上较少出问题，且能适应大多数生长条件。其小至中等大小的叶片为 3 裂，中间裂片呈长圆三角形，明显比两侧短裂片更突出且更长。裂片先端尖，叶缘具粗齿。生长季叶色始终鲜绿，质地耐久，并能耐全日照。秋色极为壮观，呈鲜猩红色。另一个优点是从初夏开始会大量结成串的鲜红色果实。东北槭原产于中国东北、满洲、朝鲜北部及日本列岛。亚种名 ginnala 同时也是这种槭树的地方名称。

descriptions.preferred: A chance dissectum seedling with 'Viridis' as a possible parent, this cultivar is very pretty in the spring as the young leaves appear. Its emerging light green leaves are attractively edged in red, a color combination which lasts through spring and into early summer. In all other redissectum -red 'Stella Rossa' is one of the earliest selections of the Fratelli Gilardelli Nursery, near Milan, Italy, from the late 1960s. It has very attractive pink-red young foliage, becoming a dark purple red which lasts very well throughout the summer and early fall, before turning a bright red in the fall. The foliage coloring is similar to that of 'Dissectum Nigrum', but the deep red color is retained even longer. The seven-lobed deeply and finely dissected leaves are 9-12 cm long and wide. Each lobe narrows markedly to the base, the lower 1-1.5 cm consisting only of the midrib. The upper three-quarters of the lobes are themselves deeply divided into relatively broad, flat sublobes with delicate fine saw-toothed margins. The petioles are red This large-leaved cultivar is one of the best of the red Matsumurae Group. The seven-lobed leaves (two extra very tiny lobes sometimes appear on the largest leaves) are 7-9 cm long and 9-12 cm wide, and deeply divided almost to the leaf base. The lobes are elongate-ovate, 1- 1.5 cm wide at the broadest point in the middle, narrowing to 2-5 mm at the lobe junctions. The outer end tapers gradually to a thin, sharp point. The lobes are well separated. The outer margins are double toothed, the teeth with sharp, hooked tips; the inner margins are smooth. The petioles are red and 2.5-4 cm long. The spring color is a bright purple red. In early summer, the leaves darken to become almost black red or very deep maroon. From midsummer to fall, the color gradually changes to a deep green red or brown red. The dissectum -green 'Sunset' is a dissectum of typical mounded shape, but with non-typical leaves and colors. It possesses the same cascading growth habit of most dissectums and grows at the usual rate. The leaves have a neat appearance since they are held on a common plane and do not twist as is typical of many dissectums. The lobes are distinct in that they are dissected only once, ranging both sides of each midrib, and are not doubly dissected as in more widely known dissectums. This gives a saw-tooth effect to the foliage. The leaves are mostly a uniform 6 cm long and 8 cm wide, with a fairly short petiole of 2 cm. The color is the second outstanding feature after the saw-tooth appearance. The base color is a bright green, rather light, but with an overall tinting of rust on mature leaves. Those leaves in full sun show a very marked rusty to burnt orange tinting, while those in more shade have the tinting only on the edges or tips. Young foliage and some of the full-grown leaves in full exposure lack green and are predominately yellow in color. This cultivar stands out in the landscape as quite different in both the leaf texture and the dominant rusty appearance.

sources.description: 由美国俄勒冈州巴克霍兹苗圃的苗圃主泰隆·巴克霍兹 培育并推广，翠绿枝垂的种子实生苗选育而来，春天新 叶为黄色并有粉红色的叶尖，黄色持续时间略短，快速 变为绿色，五月新稍为棕黄色或者棕红色，和绿色的老 叶形成鲜明的对比，秋季为橙黄色或者纯黄色，生长强 劲，叶型略大，可全日照，成年株可达 1.8 米。

Leaves have 7 to 9-lobes, are finely dissected and very narrow, emerging pale green edged red, in spring, becoming bright green in summer, then turning gold with an occasional splash of crimson in autumn

care.cultivation: Grow in any moisture-retentive, well-drained soil in a sheltered position. Leaf colour is best in partial shade, although full sun can be tolerated if soil is reliably moist. Leaf scorch can be caused by lack of soil moisture or excessive exposure. See Japanese maples cultivation
care.pruning: Pruning group 1 , only from late autumn to mid-winter
care.propagation: Propagate by softwood cuttings, layering or by grafting . Plants grown from seed are unlikely to come true, but may still be garden worthy

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这是一个偶然获得的 dissectum 实生苗，可能以 'Viridis' 为亲本。春季新叶展开时尤为美丽。初生叶片为浅绿色，叶缘带红，色彩搭配十分悦目，这种效果可持续整个春季并延续至初夏。 在所有红叶重裂类型中，'Stella Rossa' 是意大利米兰附近 Fratelli Gilardelli 苗圃于 20 世纪 60 年代后期选育出的较早品种之一。其幼叶呈极具观赏性的粉红红色，随后转为深紫红色，并能很好地保持整个夏季及初秋，秋季再转为鲜红色。其叶色与 'Dissectum Nigrum' 相似，但深红色保持时间更长。叶片 7 裂，深裂且细裂，长宽均为 9-12 厘米。每个裂片向基部明显变窄，最下部 1-1.5 厘米仅剩中脉。裂片上部约四分之三处分裂为较宽、较平展的小裂片，边缘具精细锯齿。叶柄为红色。 这一大叶型栽培品种是红叶 Matsumurae Group 中的优良品种之一。叶片 7 裂（最大的叶片有时会出现额外 2 个极小裂片），长 7-9 厘米，宽 9-12 厘米，深裂几近叶基。裂片为长卵形，在中部最宽处宽 1-1.5 厘米，在裂片结合处缩窄至 2-5 毫米。裂片外端逐渐收尖成细长锐尖。各裂片分离明显。外侧边缘具重锯齿，齿端尖且略呈钩状；内侧边缘平滑。叶柄红色，长 2.5-4 厘米。春季叶色为鲜紫红色。初夏时叶片加深，近黑红或极深栗紫色。仲夏至秋季，颜色逐渐转为深绿红或褐红色。 绿色重裂型 'Sunset' 具有典型的拱 mound 状株形，但叶形和叶色并不典型。它与多数 dissectum 一样具瀑布式下垂生长习性，生长速度也属常规。叶片外观整齐，因其大多位于同一平面，不像许多 dissectum 那样常有扭曲。其裂片的特点是仅沿每条中脉两侧单次分裂，而不像常见 dissectum 那样再作二次细裂，因此叶缘呈现锯齿状效果。叶片大多长 6 厘米、宽 8 厘米，叶柄较短，约 2 厘米。继锯齿状外观之后，叶色是其第二个突出特征。底色为较浅的鲜绿色，但成熟叶整体带有锈色晕染。全日照下的叶片会显现十分明显的锈色至焦橙色调，而较荫蔽处叶片的这种色调通常仅出现在边缘或叶尖。新叶以及部分全日照下的成熟叶绿色较少，整体以黄色为主。该品种在景观中十分醒目，无论叶片质感还是主导性的锈色外观都很独特。

attributes.suggested_uses: 城市庭院花园、乡村风或自然式花园、花境与花坛、庭院容器栽培
attributes.hort_group_description: dissectum 组的槭树具有细致、羽毛状、深裂的叶片，叶缘具细锯齿。

care.cultivation: 宜栽于保水且排水良好的土壤中，并选择避风位置。半阴环境下叶色表现最佳；若土壤湿度稳定，也可耐全日照。土壤缺水或暴露过度都可能导致叶片焦边。参见 Japanese maples cultivation。
care.pruning: 修剪组 1，仅限晚秋至仲冬期间修剪。
care.propagation: 可通过嫩枝扦插、压条或嫁接繁殖。实生苗通常难以保持品种性状，但仍可能具有园艺观赏价值。

resistance.pest: 可能易受蚜虫和介壳虫侵害，包括七叶树介壳虫。
resistance.disease: 可能易感黄萎病、槭叶焦枯病和蜜环菌病

rhs_zh.description: 生长缓慢的落叶性日本枫，株高约 2.5 米，枝姿强烈下垂，成熟时形成圆拱形树冠。叶片 7 至 9 裂，深裂且裂片极狭长；春季新叶淡绿，边缘带红；夏季转为鲜绿色；秋季变为金黄色，间或染有深红色。

descriptions.preferred: The very attractive pinkred spring foliage becomes a dark purple-red which lasts all summer before turning a bright red in the fall. The coloring is similar to that of 'Dissectum Nigrum', but the deep red is retained even longer. The large seven-lobed leaves are very deeply and finely dissected. The lobes themselves are deeply divided into relatively broad, flat sublobes with delicate fine saw-toothed margins. This vigorous pendulous dissectum from Italy forms a mushroom-shaped shrub up to 10 ft. (3 m) tall and 13 ft. (4 m) wide.

rhs.description: A vigorous, pendulous, mushroom-shaped tree to about 3m tall and 4m wide at maturity. The 7-lobed, deeply and finely dissected leaves are 9cm long, with delicate, fine toothed margins, the emerging young leaves pinkish-red in spring, becoming dark purple-red through summer then bright red in autumn

attributes.suggested_uses: City/Courtyard Gardens, Cottage/Informal Garden, Flower borders and beds, Patio/Container Plants
attributes.hort_group_description: Acers in this dissectum group have fine, feathery, deeply divided leaves with finely serrated edges

care.cultivation: Grow in any moisture-retentive, well-drained soil in a sheltered position. Leaf colour is best in partial shade, although full sun can be tolerated if soil is reliably moist. Leaf scorch can be caused by lack of soil moisture or excessive exposure. See Japanese maples cultivation
care.pruning: Pruning group 1 , only from late autumn to mid-winter
care.propagation: Propagate by softwood cuttings, layering or by grafting . Plants grown from seed are unlikely to come true, but may still be garden worthy

resistance.pest: May be susceptible to aphids and scale insects , including horse chestnut scale
resistance.disease: May be susceptible to Verticillium wilt , Acer leaf scorch and honey fungus

attributes.suggested_uses: 城市庭院花园、乡村风或自然式花园、花境与花坛、庭院容器栽培
attributes.hort_group_description: dissectum 组的槭树具有细致、羽毛状、深裂的叶片，叶缘具细锯齿。

care.cultivation: 宜栽于保水且排水良好的土壤中，并选择避风位置。半阴环境下叶色表现最佳；若土壤湿度稳定，也可耐全日照。土壤缺水或暴露过度都可能导致叶片焦边。参见 Japanese maples cultivation。
care.pruning: 修剪组 1，仅限晚秋至仲冬期间修剪。
care.propagation: 可通过嫩枝扦插、压条或嫁接繁殖。实生苗通常难以保持品种性状，但仍可能具有园艺观赏价值。

resistance.pest: 可能易受蚜虫和介壳虫侵害，包括七叶树介壳虫。
resistance.disease: 可能易感黄萎病、槭叶焦枯病和蜜环菌病

rhs_zh.description: 一种生长强健、枝条下垂、成熟后呈蘑菇状的树木，高约 3 米，宽约 4 米。叶片 7 裂，深裂且细裂，长约 9 厘米，叶缘具细密精致的锯齿；春季新叶初展时呈粉红红色，夏季转为深紫红色，秋季则为鲜红色。

descriptions_zh.preferred: 极具吸引力的粉红红色春叶会转为深紫红色，整个夏季都能保持，秋季再变成鲜红色。其着色与 'Dissectum Nigrum' 相似，但深红色保持时间更长。大型 7 裂叶深裂且细裂，裂片本身又深度分开成较宽、较平展的小裂片，边缘具精致细密的锯齿。这一来自意大利、生长强健的下垂型 dissectum，成熟后形成蘑菇状灌木，高可达 10 英尺（3 米），宽可达 13 英尺（4 米）。

products.name: Acer palmatum 'Stella Rossa' Red Dwarf Japanese Maple
products.description_text: 'Stella Rossa' translates to Red Star. The habit of this cultivar is decidedly weeping, delicate and graceful. While it tolerates full sun, 'Stella Rossa' would like to have a little shade in hotter climates. The foliage of 'Stella Rossa' emerges bright red in early spring holding the bright red color well into summer before turning darker red and eventually burgundy. In very hot climates it turns bronze by September but never totally green like most other red maples in our nursery. While it may be a little slower growing than many of the dissectums it holds its bright red color in the Southeast better than almost every other cultivar. Fall color is bright red with orange undertones and spectacular. 10 year size: Height: 3-5 feet Width: 5-7 feet Spring Color: Red Summer Color: Burgundy Fall Color: Red Sun Tolerance: Partial Planting: Elevated, Well Drained Soil

descriptions.preferred: Acer palmatum 'Strawberry Spring' Pink Reticulated Variegated Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 ‘Strawberry Spring’ leafs out in the spring with one of the prettiest spring pinks of any Japanese maple. The dark green veins etch through the pink reticulated leaves. As the leaves mature, the strawberry effect begins to fade to a creamy green, then to a green, with pink new growth again during the summer. In the fall, ‘Strawberry Spring’ puts on a display of oranges and reds. ‘Strawberry Spring’ is a relatively new introduction, but we expect it to reach 6-8 ft in height in 10 years in an upright manner. ‘Strawberry Spring’ was found and selected as a seedling from 'Amber Ghost’ by Talon Buchholz. descriptions_zh.preferred: Acer palmatum 'Strawberry Spring' 粉色网斑锦日本枫，适生分区 5-9。'Strawberry Spring' 春季展叶时呈现日本枫中极为出色的春粉色之一，深绿色叶脉清晰勾勒在粉色网斑叶面上。随着叶片成熟，这种“草莓色”效果会逐渐褪为奶油绿色，随后转为绿色，而夏季新梢又会再次抽生粉色新叶。秋季时，'Strawberry Spring' 展现橙色与红色交织的秋叶表现。该品种属于较新的引种，但预计以直立姿态生长，10 年可达 6-8 英尺高。'Strawberry Spring' 由 Talon Buchholz 从 'Amber Ghost' 的实生苗中发现并选出。带有 MrMaple 标志的照片归 MrMaple.com 所有，未经明确书面许可不得使用。本页未带 MrMaple 标志的照片由 Talon Buchholz 拍摄，未经所有者明确书面许可不得使用。数量有限。由于我们拥有上千个日本枫品种，单个品种通常库存不多；部分选育品种常会很快售罄，建议尽早购买心仪品种。

descriptions.preferred: This slow-growing Japanese dissectum is similar in leaf and variegation to the well-known 'Filigree'. Spring color is yellow-green. In the summer, the leaves are green with dense streaks of pale cream and specks of yellow on each side of the green ROSSA' centers, this variegation gradually becoming pale 'Sunset' green. Fall color is yellow to gold. The medium- Dissectum sized deeply incised leaves have large sharply typical hooked and pointed teeth on the margins. 'Suitinct sei' slowly forms a broad irregular mound up to 8 along ft. (2.5 m) tall. tooth base 'Sumi nagashi' all Matsumurae Group—red. 'Sumi nagashi' is one rusty of the best large-leaved red cultivars in its group. leaves The deeply divided leaves have seven elongatepredominately ovate lobes tapering gradually to thin, sharp cascading points. The outer margins are double-toothed, sectums. the teeth with sharp, hooked tips. Spring color is bright purple-red, darkening to become almost 'Taiyo black-red or very deep maroon. From midsummer, Palmatum the color gradually changes to a deep green-red the or brown-red. It greens up very readily in shade. having Fall color is crimson. This vigorous, strong-growlarger-than-normal ing, semiupright cultivar reaches 20 ft. (6 m) tall. mainly It is an excellent tree for the garden landscape. flushed NISHIKI' Group—green. This cultivar has nondissectum leaf texture and color. The dislobes are dissected only once and range both sides of the midribs, giving a saweffect. Although they have a bright green color, mature leaves have a distinctive overtinting of rust, and leaves in full sun show a to burnt orange tinting. The medium-sized are held on fairly short leafstalks and are yellow-colored in the spring. The mounded habit is typical of most disnishiki' Group—variegated. This sport from popular 'Asahi zuru' differs from its parent in yellow, not cream-white, variegation. The leaves are deeply divided and five-lobed. New leaves emerge with pinkpale and deep yellow variegations on a green background, becoming cream-colored to yellow on medium green for the summer. Fall colors are spectacular oranges and reds. This slowgrowing cultivar eventually forms an attractive small tree. The name means "big-leaved brocade."

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这种生长缓慢的日本鸡爪槭 Dissectum 品种，在叶形和斑锦方面与著名的 ‘Filigree’ 相似。春叶黄绿色；夏季叶片转绿，叶片两侧密布淡奶油色条纹及黄色斑点，随后这种斑锦会逐渐淡化为浅绿色。秋色为黄色至金黄色。中等大小的叶片深裂，边缘具较大的锐钩状尖齿。‘Suitinct sei’ 逐渐形成宽展而不规则的圆丘形，株高可达 8 英尺（2.5 米）。 ‘Sumi nagashi’ 属于 Matsumurae Group，红叶型。‘Sumi nagashi’ 是该组中优秀的大叶红叶品种之一。深裂叶有 7 个细长卵形裂片，逐渐收尖成纤细锐尖。外缘为重锯齿，齿端尖锐并略呈钩状。春季叶色鲜亮的紫红色，随后加深，几近黑红色或极深栗红色。仲夏起，叶色逐渐转为深绿红或褐红色；在荫蔽处尤其容易返绿。秋色为深红色。该品种生长强健、树势旺，半直立，成株可达 20 英尺（6 米）高，是园林景观中极佳的树种。 ‘nishiki’ 属于 green Group。该品种的叶质与叶色都颇具特色。叶片并非真正细裂，只裂一次，裂片排列于主脉两侧，形成类似锯状的效果。虽然整体为鲜绿色，但成熟叶带有明显的锈色晕染；在全日照下，叶片会显出橙褐至焦橙色调。中等大小的叶片着生于较短的叶柄上，春季叶色偏黄。其圆丘状树形符合多数 Dissectum 类型的典型习性。 ‘nishiki’ 属于 variegated Group。这个由流行品种 ‘Asahi zuru’ 产生的芽变，与原种不同之处在于其斑锦为黄色而非乳白色。叶片深裂，5 裂。新叶在绿色底色上展现粉淡色与深黄色斑锦，夏季则转为中绿色底上的乳黄色至黄色斑纹。秋色极为艳丽，为橙色与红色。该品种生长缓慢，最终形成姿态优美的小型树木。其名意为“大叶锦”。

descriptions.preferred: 夏金，由意大利米兰 的 Fratelli Ghiradelli 哥拉德利苗圃选育并推广，夏金是 鸡爪槭和白泽槭的杂交品种，具有典型的白泽槭特性， 叶圆且种子直立向上，而非鸡爪槭式的下垂式生长， 夏金春叶为明亮的黄色，并有红色的叶边，超级漂亮。 黄叶系列，夏季为黄绿色，目前唯一的夏季黄叶品种， 秋季为橙色或者火红色。生长健壮，可全日照，成年 树可达 3 米左右高度。

sources.description: 夏金，由意大利米兰 的 Fratelli Ghiradelli 哥拉德利苗圃选育并推广，夏金是 鸡爪槭和白泽槭的杂交品种，具有典型的白泽槭特性， 叶圆且种子直立向上，而非鸡爪槭式的下垂式生长， 夏金春叶为明亮的黄色，并有红色的叶边，超级漂亮。 黄叶系列，夏季为黄绿色，目前唯一的夏季黄叶品种， 秋季为橙色或者火红色。生长健壮，可全日照，成年 树可达 3 米左右高度。

rhs.description: A small, slow-growing, upright tree with a rounded crown, ultimately reaching 2m in height and spread. The leaves have seven lobes, open pink in spring, then lime green to yellow with a fine red edge in summer and golden yellow with orange and red shades in autumn. Inconspicuous flowers in spring are followed by red, winged fruit held above the foliage in autumn

attributes.suggested_uses: City/Courtyard Gardens, Cottage/Informal Garden, Patio/Container Plants
attributes.hort_group_description: Acers in this palmatum group have small, palm-shaped leaves with coarsely-toothed edges

care.cultivation: Grows best in slightly acidic, humus-rich, well-drained soil, but tolerates most soils if improved with well-rotted organic matter . Hot, dry air, cold wind and late frost may cause leaf scorching. Mulch in autumn to protect shallow roots from cold and drying out. See Japanese maple cultivation
care.pruning: Pruning group 1
care.propagation: Propagate by semi-hardwood cuttings or by layering

resistance.pest: May be susceptible to Acer gall mite, aphids , caterpillars and horse chestnut scale
resistance.disease: May be susceptible to Verticillium wilt , Acer leaf scorch and honey fungus

care.cultivation: 在微酸性、富含腐殖质且排水良好的土壤中生长最佳，但若加入充分腐熟的有机质改良，也能适应多数土壤。炎热干燥的空气、寒风和晚霜可能导致叶片焦枯。秋季覆 mulch，可保护浅根免受寒害和干燥。参见 Japanese maple cultivation。
care.pruning: 修剪第 1 组
care.propagation: 可采用半成熟枝扦插或压条繁殖。

resistance.disease: 可能易感黄萎病、槭叶焦枯病和蜜环菌病

rhs_zh.description: 小型、缓慢生长的直立树种，树冠圆整，最终高和冠幅均可达 2 米。叶片 7 裂，春季展叶时为粉色，夏季转为青柠绿至黄色并带细窄红边，秋季则呈金黄色并带橙色和红色晕染。春季开不显眼的小花，秋季在叶幕上方可见红色翅果。

products.description_text: Acer palmatum 'Summer Gold' Golden Yellow - Heat Tolerant Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 'Summer Gold' leafs out as bright chartreuse to yellow green with a red border. The leaf on 'Summer Gold' brightens to gold as the summer progresses providing a dynamic contrast with both red and green maples. This may be one the most heat tolerant selections of the golden leaf types as this maple does not show any burn when grown in full sun in the mountains of North Carolina. Fall color is a deep bright orange to fiery red. This Italian selection by Ghiradelli Nursery is a summer delight in the garden. 'Summer Gold' will reach 6-8 ft in 10 years making it the perfect mid-sized golden tree for your garden or landscape. These 10 gallon trees are for local pickup only, we cannot ship them because they are too big. The MrMaple Nursery is located in East Flat Rock, NC. Please contact us to arrange a pickup time. sources.title: 晚霞 Acer Circinatum 'Sunglow'
sources.description: 晚霞的叶子小且圆润，在春天的时候非常漂亮，新叶会出现桃色、杏色、橙色，然后逐渐变成金黄色。夏季会变成黄绿色，叶脉会带有些许橙色。秋季，颜色是梅红色、紫色和深红色的。生长较缓慢，成年树高约为 1.5米。它首先由俄勒冈州的Floyd McMullen发现，并由俄勒冈州的巴克霍兹苗圃繁殖和引入。

rhs.description: A deciduous, dwarf tree about 2m tall, the small, rounded, shallowly 7-9-lobed leaves emerge in spring displaying tones of apricot and peach, fading to pale green with orange veins in summer then plum-red, purple and crimson in autumn. Bears pendent clusters of small purple and white spring flowers followed by brownish winged fruits

attributes.suggested_uses: City/Courtyard Gardens, Cottage/Informal Garden, Flower borders and beds, Patio/Container Plants

care.cultivation: Grow in any moisture-retentive, well-drained soil in a sheltered position. Leaf colour is best in partial shade, although full sun can be tolerated if soil is reliably moist. Leaf scorch can be caused by lack of soil moisture or excessive exposure. Suits container cultivation but attention to watering is needed in dry spells during the growing season. See Japanese maples cultivation
care.pruning: Pruning group 1 , if necessary, from late autumn to midwinter only
care.propagation: Propagate by grafting in late winter or softwood cuttings

resistance.pest: May be susceptible to Acer gall mite, aphids , caterpillars and horse chestnut scale
resistance.disease: May be susceptible to Verticillium wilt , acer leaf scorch and honey fungus

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这一段原文存在严重 OCR 错乱与多条目串接，难以可靠还原。可保守整理出的内容为：该品种体型小而独特，叶片极小、近圆形，春季萌发时呈桃色至浅橙杏色，此色可持续约 4 至 6 周，夏季转为中绿色，秋季则转为李红、紫红与猩红色。叶通常为 7 裂，裂刻较浅；各裂片宽卵形，先端短尖，边缘具不规则锯齿。植株生长缓慢，株形丛生，10 年可长至略高于 3 英尺（约 1 米）。与许多矮生品种一样，较易受白粉病侵染。其余内容因混入其他 Acer 物种/品种描述且文本残缺，未作强行补译。

rhs_zh.description: 落叶矮生小乔木，成株高约 2 米。叶片较小、近圆形，浅裂为 7-9 裂；春季萌发时呈杏色与桃色调，夏季逐渐转为淡绿色并具橙色叶脉，秋季则变为李子红、紫色与深红色。春季开小型紫白色花，成下垂簇生；随后结褐色翅果。

care.cultivation: 宜栽培于保水性好且排水良好的土壤中，选择避风庇护的位置。叶色在半阴环境下表现最佳；若土壤湿度稳定充足，也可耐全日照。土壤缺水或暴露过度易导致叶缘焦枯。适合容器栽培，但生长季遇干旱天气时需特别注意浇水。另见 Japanese maples cultivation。
care.pruning: 修剪组 1；如有需要，仅可在深秋至仲冬期间修剪。
care.propagation: 可于冬末采用嫁接繁殖，或以软枝扦插繁殖。

products.description_text: Acer circinatum 'Sunglow' Rare Vine Maple Japanese Maple Zones 6-9 Morning Sun to Afternoon Shade Acer circinatum 'Sunglow' is quite a unique hybrid vine maple. The smaller leaves appear in the spring with apricot to peach to orange color. These rich colors fade to golden yellow to chartreuse infused with orange throughout the veins of the leaf. This makes this plant especially showy. 'Sunglow' turns to bright red to deep purple red in the fall. 'Sunglow' may reach 6 ft in height and width in 10 years creating a dense ball-like shape. Make sure to give 'Sunglow' morning sun with protection from the hot afternoon sun for best growth and health of the plant. ‘Sunglow’ was introduced by Buchholz Nursery of Oregon. descriptions.preferred: Acer shirasawanum 'Sunny' New Golden Full Moon Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 Introducing Acer shirasawanum ‘Sunny’, a beautiful golden Japanese maple that offers vibrant yellow color throughout the spring and summer. The fall colors of 'Sunny' will range from orange to red. Be one of the first to get this fun new golden yellow maple and enjoy its beauty for years to come. The 2 quart square size is comparable to a typical nursery trade 1 gallon. The Large 2 Quart square would be comparable to a large 1 gallon.

products.description_text: Acer shirasawanum 'Sunny' New Golden Full Moon Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 Introducing Acer shirasawanum ‘Sunny’, a beautiful golden Japanese maple that offers vibrant yellow color throughout the spring and summer. This unique variety of Acer shirasawanum was introduced as a chance seedling by the same nurseryman who found and introduced ‘Mystic Mikawa’, ‘Fragrant Fountain’ and ‘Sir Damon’. ‘Sunny’ will reach 6-8 ft in 10 years if provided with adequate protection from the hot afternoon sun. The fall colors of 'Sunny' will range from orange to red. Be one of the first to get this fun new golden yellow maple and enjoy its beauty for years to come. The 2 quart square size is comparable to a typical nursery trade 1 gallon. The Large 2 Quart square would be comparable to a large 1 gallon.

rhs.description: An upright, small, deciduous shrubby tree about 2m in height, a sister seedling of 'Sunglow'. Shallow, 7-9 lobed leaves to 13cm long emerge in spring in shades of apricot which slowly change to light green in summer then bright yellow to orange in autumn. Pendent clusters of wine-red and white early spring flowers are followed by brown winged fruits in late summer

care.cultivation: Grow in fertile, moist but well-drained soil in full sun or partial shade. See tree cultivation for further advice
care.pruning: Pruning group 1 , if necessary, from late autumn to midwinter only
care.propagation: Propagate by grafting in late winter or softwood cuttings in early summer

resistance.pest: May be susceptible to Acer gall mite, aphids , caterpillars and horse chestnut scale
resistance.disease: May be susceptible to Verticillium wilt , Acer leaf scorch and honey fungus

care.propagation: 可于冬末采用嫁接繁殖，或于初夏进行软枝扦插繁殖。

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这一红叶品种在日本自很早时期即已为人所知。显然，它并非特别突出的品种，后来被视为同物异名处理。

descriptions.preferred: This red-variegated form has medium-sized leaves 6-7 cm long and slightly wider. The five or seven lobes are shallowly separated to about halfway to the leaf base, and are ovate-acuminate with the margins slightly serrated. The red petioles are 2-3 cm long. There are different descriptions of this cultivar in old Japanese literature. One has the new foliage unfolding a bright red color. Then, as the leaves mature, pink variegations appear which gradually change to brick-red markings. Another description gives the color as dark purple when the leaves open in the spring, with vermilion spots appearing and no green areas. Still another writer mentions the variegation turning brown on a reddish background. Young plants in the Maplewood collection did not go through any of these changes. Instead, they remained solid colors of purple red. Other variegated clones sometimes take a few seasons for the markings to become evident. 'Taimin nishiki' appears to be variegated in Japanese collections; it is unknown if any plants in the West are variegated. Also, old references indicate that the variegation tends to disappear when plants are grown with too much fertility. This is true of other variegates which rare in nurseries. It originated from an old red-leaved cultivar 'Taimin', which seems to have almost disappeared from cultivation, and in itself is not worth perpetuating. Earlier editions of this book indicated 'Daimyo\ nishiki' was a synonym of this cultivar. However, different Japanese characters have been used in a list from Japan since then, and a photograph shows the former is very different. It has smaller more deeply divided leaves of the Matsumurae Group.

sources.title: 大明锦 Acer Palmatum 'Taimin Nishiki'
sources.description: 大明锦是非常稀有的锦叶品种之一，最早记载于 1882 年。大明锦的扩繁非常的困难， 如果要长期保持这种锦叶需要一定的栽培经验 。它起源于 一种古老的红叶 " Daimyo "。但大明锦的叶子相对小一点，叶 裂更深 。 " Taimin Nishiki "这个名字的意思是明朝的锦缎。 春天的叶子是鲜红色的 ，会出现部分或整叶的粉色锦。夏季会返绿，粉色区域会变成浅一点的绿白色。秋天是猩红色的。成年树高约为 2 到 3 米。

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这一红斑型品种的叶片中等大小，长 6 至 7 厘米，宽度略大于长度。5 或 7 个裂片仅浅裂至约叶基的一半，裂片为卵形渐尖，边缘略具细锯齿。红色叶柄长 2 至 3 厘米。日本早期文献对该品种有不同描述：一种说法认为新叶展开时为鲜红色，随后随着叶片成熟出现粉色斑锦，并逐渐转为砖红色斑纹；另一种说法称春季展叶时叶色为深紫色，其上出现朱红色斑点而无绿色区域；还有作者提到其斑锦会在红色底上转为褐色。Maplewood 收藏中的幼株并未呈现上述任何变化，而是始终保持均一的紫红色。有些斑叶克隆往往需要数个生长季后斑纹才会明显。‘Taimin nishiki’ 在日本收藏中似乎确为斑叶型；至于西方栽培的植株是否具斑锦，目前尚不清楚。此外，旧资料指出，若栽培条件过于肥沃，斑锦往往会消失；这一点对其他在苗圃中较少见的斑叶品种也同样适用。它源自古老的红叶品种 ‘Taimin’，而后者在栽培中几乎已经消失，本身也并不值得继续保留。本书早期版本曾将 ‘Daimyo\ nishiki’ 视为该品种的异名；但此后来自日本的一份名单使用了不同的汉字，并且照片显示前者与本品种差异很大。前者叶片更小、裂得更深，属于 Matsumurae Group。

descriptions.preferred: 大勇于 1923 年由 Tozuka momiji En 发现。叶裂长卵形， 开裂至叶片一半的位置，顶端边缘有锯齿状凹陷。叶 柄短而粗壮。新叶呈明亮的黄绿色，且叶裂外侧的色 泽尤为明丽。老叶浓绿色，抗晒能力强，可保持至秋季。 叶柄和新叶表面布满纤细的银色毫毛。秋色是张扬的 混合色调，有红色、黄色夹杂着鲜艳的绯红色。这个 强健的品种有着圆形的树顶，大小中等，成熟株高可 达 8m，甚至更高。

descriptions.preferred: This ancient cultivar has references going back to 1690 and 1710. The species Acer palmatum was called takao momiji in Japanese. The plants with especially beautiful leaves were called takao. This cultivar has also been known as 'Oh momiji', 'Takao momiji', and 'Takawo momiji' and has been misspelled 'Tokao'. Old literature describes it as being a green-leaved, seven-lobed form, with the leaves 6-6.5 cm long and a little wider. The leaves of plants imported from Japan into the Netherlands are reported to be five lobed. The lobes are oblong-lanceolate with the ends tapering to a long, sharp tip. The margins are toothed. 'Takao' is known for its bright yellow to gold fall colors. It forms a vigorous upright roundtopped tree, growing up to 9 m high at maturity.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这一古老品种的记载可追溯至 1690 年和 1710 年。Acer palmatum 在日语中曾被称作 takao momiji，而叶形格外优美的植株则被称为 takao。该品种也曾以 'Oh momiji'、'Takao momiji' 和 'Takawo momiji' 之名流传，并曾被误拼为 'Tokao'。早期文献将其描述为绿叶、7 裂型，叶长 6 至 6.5 厘米，宽度略大于长度。自日本引入荷兰的植株则据称为 5 裂。裂片为长圆状披针形，先端渐尖成细长锐尖，叶缘具锯齿。'Takao' 以鲜黄至金黄的秋色闻名。植株长势强健，树形直立、圆头，成熟时可高达 9 米。

descriptions.preferred: This cultivar is mentioned in several early references, including some with clear illustrations. It is a fairly hardy plant which makes a round-headed tall shrub, up to 5 m high at maturity. The colors of the seven-lobed leaves are distinct. The new foliage has a bright brick-red or rust color as a strong overtone on the light green leaf. This color develops best in the sun. The foliage of heavily shaded plants remains a light green. The foliage color stands out in contrast with other cultivars. During the summer the intensity diminishes. In the fall, the colors take on a mottled pattern, and the reds become stronger. The leaves are 7 cm long and 8-9 cm wide, and extend horizontally instead of hanging down. The leaf base is dwarf -green 'Tama hime' is a good dwarf for fall color. The tiny leaves are a light green as they unfold, soon becoming a rich, shiny green. This color holds well into the fall, when red, crimson, and some yellow leaves appear. The five-lobed leaves are 3-4 cm long and wide, and of thin texture. The lobes are ovate, terminate in a short tip, and are separated to about two-thirds of the way to the leaf base. The margins are prominently toothed. The red petioles are quite short—1-2 cm long. This compact-growing, upright, vase-shaped, multibranched dwarf is strong growing when young but does not exceed 2 m high or width. It is popular for bonsai. The leaves can be reduced to less than 1 cm with repeated pinching and other bonsai cultural techniques. The name 'Tama hime' means "a small globe." Another name by which this cultivar has been known is 'Yatsubusa tamahime'.

descriptions.preferred: The bright green foliage is marked with white or yellow combinations in irregular and varied patterns known as the sunago fu (dust) type of variegation. These are not Corvallis there is no variegation. The lobes are long elliptic and narrow, ending in a long, sharp point. Each lobe is irregular in shape where the variegations are strong and becomes sickle shaped or curved in these areas. The margins are serrated. The short petioles are 1-2 cm long. This slightly delicate, upright shrub reaches 2-3 m high. It is a little-known cultivar, not widely distributed, but mentioned in Japanese catalogs from 1930 into the 1960s.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 鲜绿色叶片上分布有白色或黄色的组合斑纹，呈不规则且多变的图案，属于 sunago fu（砂子斑、尘点状）类型的锦斑。裂片狭长，近长椭圆形，先端延伸为细长锐尖。斑纹较强的部位会使裂片形态不规则，并常在这些区域呈镰刀形或弯曲状，叶缘具锯齿。叶柄较短，长 1 至 2 厘米。该品种株姿直立，略显纤弱，可长至 2 至 3 米高。它是一个较少见的品种，流通不广，但在日本目录中自 1930 年代至 1960 年代均有记载。

descriptions.preferred: This medium-sized tree has leaves basically of the variegated Palmatum Group with five strong lobes. They radiate outward and are separated to about two-thirds of the way to the leaf base. Each lobe is ovate with a long, tapering point and toothed edges. The leaves vary from 5 to 7 cm long and wide. The basic color is a clear green. When variegation occurs, it is in sectional portions of the lobe or leaf. The white or cream color predominates with occasional pink tones occurring, never very strong. Often the portions of the leaf containing the white sections are curved or sometimes stunted. Not all leaves are variegated, and the balance between variegated and unvariegated leaves varies from year to year. Fall colors produce orange and red tones on the unvariegated foliage, while the variegated sections turn to a pale rose. This maple seems to be a twiggy but not very strong grower. It becomes a medium-sized tree as it matures. Like so many variegated cultivars, it too is affected by overfertilization, which results in too rapid growth and causes an increase in the non-variegated green proportion of the foliage.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这是一种中型乔木，叶片基本属于有锦斑的 Palmatum Group 类型，具 5 个明显裂片。裂片向外放射，分裂深度约达叶基的三分之二。每一裂片呈卵形，先端长渐尖，边缘具锯齿。叶片长宽均约 5 至 7 厘米。底色为清绿色。出现锦斑时，通常表现为裂片或整叶上的分区斑块，以白色或乳白色为主，偶带粉色，但粉色通常不强。叶片上具白斑的部位常发生弯曲，有时甚至发育不良。并非所有叶片都有斑，斑叶与绿叶的比例每年也会变化。秋季时，无斑叶会转为橙色和红色调，而斑锦部分则转为淡玫瑰色。该枫树枝条较密，但长势不算很强，成熟后成为中型乔木。与许多锦叶品种一样，它也易受过量施肥影响，导致生长过快，并使叶片中返绿的无斑绿色部分增加。

descriptions.preferred: This cultivar has the multidissected leaves of the Dissectum Group, but the pinnatifid cuts are not as deep as they are in such forms as 'Crimson Queen' and 'Dissectum Nigrum'. The center of the lobe is a little wider, making each lobed appear slightly bolder. The seven or nine lobes radiate outward, terminating in an extremely other cultivar does. Growers in the eastern United States report that it holds up extremely well in the combination of high heat and humidity. Fall color is a bright scarlet. The bark of the twigs and young branches is a deep maroon red, overcast with a whitish tone. This hardy plant is strongly cascading. It is an old cultivar, having been listed as early as 1710. The Japanese record plants 50-100 years old reaching up to 4 m tall. The leaf shape, coloration, and growth habit of a plant called 'Takiniyama', growing in the Maplewood collection, were identical to those of 'Tamuke yama'. As it matured, its characteristics indicated it was the same as 'Tamuke yama'. No records have been found of 'Takiniyama'. Other names under which 'Tamuke yama' has been known are 'Chirimen kaede', 'Chirimen momiji', and 'Dissectum Tamuke yama'.

The beautiful foliage is a light to yellowish green. Each lobe is tipped in a distinct purplish red, similar to that of 'Shigarami' but not as deep a color. This color shades back from the tip and down along the mar- Corvallis scape. Themedium-sizedleaveshavefiveorsevenlobeswhich radiate sharply outward. They measure 4-6 cm long and 6-8 cm wide, but leaves on vigorous juvenile shoots are much larger. The lobes are separated up to halfway to the leaf base, and are broadly ovate, tapering to a sharp point. The margins are very lightly serrated and curl slightly upwards. The stiff petioles are 4 cm long. The leaves and the new shoots are held horizontally, and the branches grow laterally, thus forming the characteristic layered effect of this plant. 'Tana' is a stronggrowing, upright cultivar which reaches 6 m high in only a few years. There is little further upward growth; instead it becomes round-topped with a broad canopy. The similarity of the purple-tipped leaves and growth habit of 'Tana' with 'Shigarami' has caused some confusion. Both cultivars form a single-stemmed tree. However, the much deeper divisions of the leaf easily distinguish 'Shigarami'. The similarity of name has also caused confusion between 'Tana' and 'Tanabata', which is a redleaved cultivar with the leaves deeply divided almost to the leaf base.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 'Tana' 这一名称意为“层架”，指的是该品种枝条与叶片所呈现出的层层叠叠效果。其叶色优美，为浅绿至黄绿色。每个裂片顶端都带有明显的紫红色，类似 'Shigarami'，但色泽没有那么深。该颜色会自裂片顶端向后并沿叶缘延伸。中等大小的叶片具 5 或 7 个裂片，明显向外放射。叶长 4-6 厘米，宽 6-8 厘米，但生长旺盛的幼年枝条上的叶片会大得多。裂片裂至叶基约一半，呈宽卵形，渐尖。叶缘仅有极浅的锯齿，并略向上卷。坚挺的叶柄长 4 厘米。叶片和新梢多呈水平展开，枝条横向生长，因此形成该品种特有的层状效果。 'Tana' 生长势强，为直立型品种，几年内即可长到 6 米高。其后向上生长不多，转而形成圆顶状、树冠开展的株形。'Tana' 与 'Shigarami' 在紫红色叶尖和生长习性上相似，因此常引起混淆。两者都能形成单干树形，不过 'Shigarami' 的叶片裂刻更深，较易区分。名称相近也使 'Tana' 与 'Tanabata' 常被混淆，后者是红叶品种，叶片深裂几近叶基。

descriptions_zh.preferred: 外形近似于矮化的 'Naruto'，这是一种非常致密、近圆形的灌木，具有同样迷人的内卷双色叶。春季新叶呈带青铜感的红色，生长季中上表面转为浓绿色，秋季则变为橙色并带红晕。 Acer capillipes（mountain maple，Hair-foot maple）是一种姿态醒目的美丽蛇皮枫，在栽培条件下通常可长成大型乔木，成熟时高约 39-50 英尺（12-15 米）。其树皮观赏性强，绿色底上具浅灰色纵向条纹，随树龄增长颜色加深并略现裂纹。中等大小的绿色叶通常具 3-5 裂，特征是中央裂片宽大呈三角形，先端狭长而尖，两侧裂片较小而细长。叶缘具不规则锯齿。显著的中央裂片、众多平行侧脉，以及叶背脉腋处细小浅色桥状或栓状结构，使该枫树较易辨认。叶柄和嫩梢自春季萌发起直至整个生长季均呈粉红红至猩红色。秋季色彩丰富，从黄色到猩红色，常可在同一株树上同时出现。该树原产日本，但主要集中分布于东京周边地区。种加词意为“毛状的”。 Acer carpinifolium（Hornbeam maple）的叶片在枫属中十分特殊，中等大小的绿色叶酷似鹅耳枥属 Carpinus。叶面同样粗糙，呈卵状长圆形，具尾状尖端，侧脉平行而明显，幼叶边缘粗锯齿明显。该种为大型多枝灌木或小乔木，成熟时高 26-39 英尺（8-12 米），形成宽展的穹顶蘑菇状树冠。其性强健、耐久，是园林中非常出色的孤植观赏树种。原产日本，常见于海拔 660-4290 英尺（200-1300 米）的温带落叶林湿润土壤中。种加词意为“叶似 Carpinus（鹅耳枥）”。 Acer caudatum subsp. ukurunduense 为生长形态多变的类群，可形成高 23-33 英尺（7-10 米）的大灌木或小乔木，常为多干丛生。较老枝干的浅灰褐色树皮会剥落成小而薄的片状。嫩枝带红色，并被短柔毛，随后转为黄褐色。叶片上面呈灰绿色，下面被暗淡黄白色短柔毛。通常具五裂，裂片为卵状三角形，先端较短；叶缘具锐锯齿。虽然原种分布于喜马拉雅、印度北部和中国西部，但 subsp. ukurunduense 更多分布于日本、千岛群岛、东西伯利亚东南部及满洲地区。 Acer circinatum（vine maple）虽非日本原产，但与日本枫 A. palmatum 和 A. japonicum 亲缘很近，并可与之杂交。原产北美太平洋西北地区，可形成高达 26 英尺（8 米）的小乔木，更常见为开展的多干灌木，具蛇形、藤本状细枝。其最受重视的是绚丽的秋色，鲜猩红中晕染橙色和黄色。春季时，中等大小的圆形叶为明亮绿色，具 7-9 个浅裂，叶缘有明显但较浅的锯齿。该种是在园林中极为省心的小型观赏树，适合与多种宿根植物和灌木搭配。其完全耐寒，对土壤、日照或遮阴，以及干旱或湿润条件均有较强适应性。

descriptions.preferred: This medium-sized shrub of upright, twiggy habit eventually reaches about 4-5 m high. Its chief attraction is the unusual, lightly variegated foliage. The small leaves are 5 cm long and 3-4 cm wide. The lobes are extremely narrow, broadest in the middle, and they are separated up to three-quarters of the way to the leaf base. The edges are wavy with the outer half very finely toothed. The base color is a strong green with the variegation a cream or light cream green. The markings are almost entirely confined to a fine edging entirely around each lobe, with light tones reaching up to a quarter of the area of the lobe. With the occasional stronger color break, the garden landscape. With age, it becomes more densely covered on the outside and self-prunes on the inside. The overall texture makes it appear delicate, and it blends in well with a background of heavier foliage. It grows well in full sun where the variegation has pink tones. 'Tennyo-no-hoshi' was selected and registered by Maplewood Nursery. 'Ao kanzashi', a later cultivar imported from Japan, appears to be very similar in habit, leaf shape, and variegation. The name 'Tennyo-no-hoshi' means "angel's star." This cultivar has been known under the names 'Tanyo-no-hoshi' and 'Teyono hoshi'.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这种中型灌木株形直立、枝条细密，最终可长至约 4-5 米高。其最主要的观赏点是不同寻常、带轻度斑锦的叶色。叶片较小，长 5 厘米，宽 3-4 厘米。裂片极狭，中部最宽，自叶基向上约四分之三处分裂。叶缘呈波状，外半部具极细锯齿。底色为浓绿色，斑锦为乳白色或浅乳绿色。斑纹几乎全部局限于每个裂片周缘的一圈细窄镶边，浅色部分可延伸至裂片面积的四分之一。偶尔会出现更明显的色块变化，在园林景观中颇具特色。树龄增长后，植株外层枝叶会变得更为浓密，内部则会自行疏枝。整体质感显得纤细柔和，与质地较厚重的背景叶丛搭配良好。全日照下生长良好，此时斑锦会带有粉色调。'Tennyo-no-hoshi' 由 Maplewood Nursery 选育并注册。后来从日本引入的品种 'Ao kanzashi' 在株形、叶形和斑锦表现上似乎非常相近。名称 'Tennyo-no-hoshi' 意为“天使之星”。该品种也曾以 'Tanyo-no-hoshi' 和 'Teyono hoshi' 之名流通。

descriptions.preferred: This maple is one of the late Henry Hohman's selections. Hohman's ability to select outstanding plants for propagation was one of his well-known attributes. 'The Bishop' has seven-lobed, fairly deeply divided purple-red leaves balancing between the Palmatum and Matsumurae Groups. The leaves measure 6-7 cm long and 7-8 cm wide, with slender petioles 4-5 cm long. The lobes extend outward and are divided about three-quarters of the way to the leaf base. Each lobe is oblong-ovate, gradually tapering to a long slender point. The margins are uniformly and finely serrated. The purple red is bright in the spring and does not bronze until late summer. The fall color is an excellent crimson. This upright-growing tree is vigorous and hardy, and reaches 4 m at maturity.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 该品种在秋季会因鲜艳的猩红色而格外出彩。叶片较小，深裂为 5 个卵形裂片，裂片先端呈尾状延伸，叶缘具明显锯齿。红色叶柄坚挺而细长。'Tobiosho' 最终长成一株直立、树冠宽阔的中型乔木。其名称来自选育出它的那位苗圃经营者。 'Toyama nishiki'：Dissectum Group，斑叶型。叶片底色为紫红至偏绿的红色。有些叶片几乎不见斑锦，有些叶片在春季初展时则几乎全粉。多数斑锦表现为裂片上的粉色或白色区块，或与叶面底色交融，变化极为丰富。由于叶片容易日灼，栽植于半阴处时，色彩通常更浓且保持性更好。中等大小的叶片有 7 至 9 个裂片，二回深裂，深达中脉，质感细致如蕾丝。这个较娇嫩、并不十分强健的槭树品种需要较多照料。其名称可译作“富山锦”。 'Trompenburg'：Matsumurae Group，红叶型。这一出色的荷兰品种在栽培地都很受欢迎。大型叶片有 7 至 9 个深裂裂片，形态仿佛手掌伸出的手指。每个裂片为长卵形，边缘向下卷曲，几乎形成管状，叶缘深具锯齿。整片叶子因此呈现独特而悦目的效果。叶柄坚挺并呈红色，叶色为浓郁的紫红色，并可良好保持至夏末。叶片在全日照下也不易灼伤。秋色转为深红色。该品种树形直立，可长至 20-26 英尺（6-8 米）高、13-16 英尺（4-5 米）宽，长期以来一直是园林应用中的优良品种。其名称取自荷兰鹿特丹的 Trompenburg arboretum。 'Tsuchigumo'：Palmatum Group，绿叶型。'Tsuchigumo' 为一矮性至半矮性品种，叶片较小。春叶呈锈红色，不久转为鲜绿色，并可在整个夏季保持良好。叶片在全日照下不易灼伤。秋色为明亮金黄色，并带有深红色镶边。叶片颇具特色，有 5 至 7 个裂片，几乎深裂至叶基；每个裂片为狭长卵形，先端渐尖。裂片边缘略向上翻，且具显著锯齿，部分裂片先端又略向下卷。其叶形与 'Shishigashira' 相似，但没有那么卷曲。该优良小乔木可长至约 13 英尺（4 米）高。其名称意为“地蜘蛛”。

descriptions.preferred: The basic leaf color is purple red to greenish red, variegated to a greater or lesser degree. Some leaves lack variegation; others are completely pink as they first open in the spring. Most markings are pink or white and insert into portions of the lobes or blend into the leaf in endless variation. Each leaf has a different pattern. When the plant is grown in shade, its colors are more intense occur at or near the variegated areas. The leaves are 6-8 cm long and wide, and the petioles are 3-4 cm long. This rather tender and not very robust maple needs considerable care and attention. It should be grafted high or staked when young to get more height. It is difficult to propagate and is not common in collections. The following are also considered synonyms, alternate spellings, or misspellings of this cultivar—'Sotoyama nishiki', 'Toya nishiki', and 'Yamato nishiki'.

rhs.description: A small, rounded, bushy tree growing slowly to about 1.5m in height. The 7 or 9 lobed, very dissected, lacy leaves have a basic leaf colour of purple-red to greenish red, variegated and streaked randomly pink or white, more intensely coloured when grown in shade, turning orange and yellow in autumn. Inconspicuous hanging clusters of small, green flowers are followed by red-flushed, winged seeds

attributes.suggested_uses: City/Courtyard Gardens, Cottage/Informal Garden, Flower borders and beds, Patio/Container Plants
attributes.hort_group_description: Acers in this dwarf group are compact and slow-growing, making them ideal for pots and containers

care.cultivation: Grow in any moisture-retentive, well-drained soil in a sheltered position. Leaf colour is best in partial shade, although full sun can be tolerated if soil is reliably moist. Leaf scorch can be caused by lack of soil moisture or excessive exposure. Suits container cultivation but attention to watering is needed in dry spells during the growing season. Suitable for bonsai cultivation . See Japanese maple cultivation
care.pruning: Very little to no pruning required. If necessary Pruning group 1 from late autumn to midwinter only
care.propagation: Propagate by layering in autumn, grafting in late winter or softwood cuttings

care.cultivation: 宜栽培于保水性好且排水良好的土壤中，种植位置应避风。叶色在半阴环境下表现最佳；若土壤湿度稳定充足，也可耐全日照。土壤缺水或暴晒过度会导致叶片焦枯。适合盆栽，但在生长季干旱时段需特别注意浇水。也适合制作盆景。参见 Japanese maple 栽培说明。

rhs_zh.description: 小型、圆整、丛生的灌木状小乔木，生长缓慢，株高约可达 1.5 米。叶 7 或 9 裂，裂刻极深、质感纤细如蕾丝，基本叶色为紫红至带绿色调的红色，并随机分布粉色或白色条斑；在半阴环境下色彩更为浓艳，秋季转为橙色和黄色。花小而不显著，绿色，成下垂簇生，随后结带红晕的翅果。

descriptions_zh.preferred: 叶片基础色为紫红至带绿色调的红色，并带有程度不一的斑锦。有些叶片没有斑纹；另一些在春季初展时则几乎全为粉色。大多数斑纹呈粉色或白色，嵌入裂片部分区域，或以无穷变化的形式融入整片叶中。每一片叶的花纹都不同。植株在阴处栽培时，其色彩会更为浓艳。焦边常发生在斑锦区域或其附近。叶片长宽均为 6-8 厘米，叶柄长 3-4 厘米。这个品种较为娇嫩，生长势也不算强健，需要相当细致的养护。幼株宜高接，或在幼年期立桩扶正，以获得更高的株形。其繁殖较困难，在收藏中并不常见。以下名称也被视为该品种的异名、替代拼写或误拼：'Sotoyama nishiki'、'Toya nishiki' 和 'Yamato nishiki'。

products.description_text: This is a very rare grafted japanese maple with variegated lace leaves! Very nice colors on this maple make if very unusual. Each leaf can have pinks, yellows, greens, purples, all on the same tree! This is the most unusual variegated japanese maple that i grow.

descriptions.preferred: This outstanding cultivar was a chance seedling selected by J. R. P. van Hoey Smith at the Trompenburg Arboretum, Rotterdam, Netherlands, and introduced by Firma C. Esveld, Boskoop, Netherlands. It is popular wherever it is grown. The unusual leaves have seven or nine lobes and are 6-8cmlongand9-12cmacross.Thelobesseparatedeeply to within 1 cm of the leaf base. They radiate laterally and evenly, giving the appearance of fingers extended from a hand. Each lobe is oblong-ovate. However, the edges roll down for three-quarters of the way, almost forming atube. The remaining quarter flattens todisplay the deeply serrated margins. The tips of the lobes turn slightly down on mature leaves. This extraordinary leaf Corvallis coloration of crimson completes a colorful year. This upright-growing cultivar—strong but not unruly —reaches 6-8 m high and 4-5 m wide. The parent plant at the Trompenburg Arboretum shows a tendency to broaden as it grows older. The branches begin to extend laterally, with the fingerlike leaves reaching outward and down. This cultivar has become a favorite for landscaping.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这一杰出品种是 J. R. P. van Hoey Smith 在荷兰鹿特丹 Trompenburg Arboretum 从实生苗中偶然选出的，并由荷兰 Boskoop 的 Firma C. Esveld 引入。凡有栽培之处，皆颇受欢迎。其叶形独特，叶片具 7 或 9 个裂片，长 6-8 厘米、宽 9-12 厘米。裂片深裂，距叶基仅约 1 厘米，向两侧均匀放射展开，形如手掌伸出的手指。每个裂片为长卵形，但其边缘有约四分之三向下卷曲，几乎形成管状；其余四分之一则平展，从而显露出深锯齿状叶缘。成熟叶的裂片先端会略向下弯。这样非凡的叶形，再加上秋季转为深绯红色，使其全年观赏性极强。该品种生长直立，长势强健但不过分散乱，可达 6-8 米高、4-5 米宽。Trompenburg Arboretum 的母株随着树龄增加会逐渐开展，枝条开始向侧方伸展，手指状叶片则向外并略向下展开。该品种已成为园林绿化中的经典选择。

products.description_text: Acer palmatum 'Trompenburg' Red Trompenburg Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 ‘Trompenburg’ is an upright red Japanese maple that has a very unique leaf structure. Many even consider this a hybrid with Acer shirasawanum. The large leaf curls under creating a sharp hand-like effect. The curling leaf is very different and adds a very different look to an upright red. The early spring color is a very deep burgundy-red. ‘Trompenburg’ holds its deep red color extremely well though the entire summer even in full sun. The fall color of this Japanese maple is a scarlet red. ‘Trompenburg’ is a very vigorous Japanese maple tree and can grow 9 to 10 inches a year. The height can reach 15-22 ft over time and the mature shape is vase-like in structure. This amazing cultivar adds a very exotic new look to any location. If you are looking for an upright red that has a lot of character, then ‘Trompenburg’ is a great choice for you. Limited Quantities Available !! descriptions.preferred: The name means "ground spider." This delightful semidwarf cultivar has small leaves of the Palmatum Group. When the new growth first unfolds, the leaves are a rust red, soon changing to bright green. This color holds well all summer and does not burn in full sun. Fall color is bright gold, with crimson edging blending into the gold tones. The interesting leaves are have five or seven lobes separated to about 1 cm from the leaf base. The leaves are 2-4 cm long and wide on old wood, to 5 cm long and wide on vigorous new growth. On old plants the twigs are closely spaced. The lobes are elongate-ovate, tapering gradually to a sharp point, and they radiate outward. The Corvallis rity. It grows slightly faster than 'Shishigashira' at first but does not grow as tall and, although the stems are sturdy, they are not as stubby or thick. One Japanese reference claims that "this cultivar is not seen in Japan in these days." Apparently it is one of those lost when horticulture was interrupted during World War II, but has now been reintroduced.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 其名称意为“地蜘蛛”。这是一个迷人的半矮生品种，具 Palmatum Group 的小型叶片。新梢初展时叶色为锈红，随后很快转为鲜绿色。该叶色整个夏季保持良好，在全日照下也不易焦叶。秋色为明亮的金黄色，边缘带深红色，并与金色调自然交融。其有趣的叶片具五裂或七裂，自叶基以上约 1 厘米处分开。老枝上的叶片长宽为 2-4 厘米，生长旺盛的新梢上则可达 5 厘米。老株枝条节间短、排列紧密。裂片呈狭长卵形，渐尖成锐尖，向外辐射展开。该品种在 Corvallis 一带颇受重视。其初期生长速度略快于 'Shishigashira'，但最终不会长得那么高；虽枝条坚实，但不像后者那样短粗。日本一份资料称“如今在日本已见不到这个品种”。显然它属于二战期间园艺中断时失传的品种之一，但现已重新引入。

descriptions.preferred: Acer palmatum 'Tsukasa Silhouette' Rare Tsukasa Silhouette Columnar Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 Acer palmatum ‘Tsukasa Silhouette’ is an exciting new columnar Japanese maple that brings big fall colors to even small garden spaces. Tsukasa Silhouette was introduced in Japan by Yutaka Tanaka. In 2008, our good friend and nurserymen legend, Don Shadow named this selection in the United States. The first word of the name (Tsukasa) for the nursery of its origin and second word (Silhouette) describing the amazing slender shape. ‘Tsukasa Silhouette’ leafs out in the early spring with a bright chartreuse green display. By mid-summer, this heat tolerant Japanese maple selection has rich deep green foliage. This slim and slender columnar Tsukasa Silhouette Japanese maple tree has excellent autumn colors with ranges of orange to bright red. ‘Tsukasa Silhouette’ is most famous for its great shape. This form can reach 15-20 ft by only 6-7 ft in width in 20 years. This column of color and foliage is ideal for gardens with small spaces but it works equally as well in large gardens as an interesting accent plant. Add ‘Tsukasa Silhouette’ to your garden for a great heat tolerant Japanese maple that makes a brilliant fall display with a unique narrow form. Limited Quantities Available !! descriptions_zh.preferred: Acer palmatum 'Tsukasa Silhouette' 稀有柱形日本枫，适生分区 5-9。Acer palmatum 'Tsukasa Silhouette' 是一个令人兴奋的新型柱形日本枫，即使在小型庭园空间中也能带来强烈的秋色表现。'Tsukasa Silhouette' 由 Yutaka Tanaka 在日本推出。2008 年，我们的好友、苗圃界传奇人物 Don Shadow 在美国为该品种命名。名称第一部分“Tsukasa”取自其原始育成苗圃，第二部分“Silhouette”则描述其惊人的狭长树形。该品种早春展叶时呈明亮的黄绿色；至仲夏，这一耐热的日本枫品种叶色转为浓深绿色。其纤细修长的柱形树姿在秋季具有极佳的叶色表现，可由橙色转为鲜红色。'Tsukasa Silhouette' 最著名之处在于其优异的树形。20 年可达 15-20 英尺高，而冠幅仅 6-7 英尺。这种色彩与叶幕形成的“柱体”非常适合小空间庭园，在大型花园中也同样适合作为富有趣味的点景植物。若想为庭园增添一个耐热、秋色绚丽且株形狭窄独特的日本枫品种，'Tsukasa Silhouette' 是很好的选择。数量有限。由于我们拥有上千个日本枫品种，单个品种通常库存不多；部分选育品种常会很快售罄，建议尽早购买心仪品种。

products.title: Acer palmatum 'Tsukasa Silhouette' Columnar Japanese Maple
products.description_text: Acer palmatum 'Tsukasa Silhouette' Rare Tsukasa Silhouette Columnar Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 Acer palmatum ‘Tsukasa Silhouette’ is an exciting new columnar Japanese maple that brings big fall colors to even small garden spaces. Tsukasa Silhouette was introduced in Japan by Yutaka Tanaka. In 2008, our good friend and nurserymen legend, Don Shadow named this selection in the United States. The first word of the name (Tsukasa) for the nursery of its origin and second word (Silhouette) describing the amazing slender shape. ‘Tsukasa Silhouette’ leafs out in the early spring with a bright chartreuse green display. By mid-summer, this heat tolerant Japanese maple selection has rich deep green foliage. This slim and slender columnar Tsukasa Silhouette Japanese maple tree has excellent autumn colors with ranges of orange to bright red. ‘Tsukasa Silhouette’ is most famous for its great shape. This form can reach 15-20 ft by only 6-7 ft in width in 20 years. This column of color and foliage is ideal for gardens with small spaces but it works equally as well in large gardens as an interesting accent plant. Add ‘Tsukasa Silhouette’ to your garden for a great heat tolerant Japanese maple that makes a brilliant fall display with a unique narrow form. Limited Quantities Available !! As we have over a thousand cultivars of Japanese maples, we often do not have many of each cultivar. We recommend that you buy the Japanese maples you want immediately as we often sell out of certain selections.

descriptions.preferred: This delightful dwarf is stubby and upright. Even young plants grow only 5-10 cm per year, while the leading shoot of older plants grows 5 cm or less. The leaf placement is very thick since the buds are closely arranged on the shoots. It is multibranched and makes a dense, dwarf mound reaching 1-1.5 m high and wide. The stems are very stiff and upright. The new leaves unfold a bright, rusty red. As the leaves develop, they become a light red green, maturing to a rich, deep green. This effect is quite beautiful as the shoots develop and all these color phases appear from the top of each shoot to the base. In the fall, the yellowgold colors are very strong. The bright green leaves are five lobed, some with very Corvallis and conspicuous. The entire leaf tends to stick out stiffly sideways. The stiff, green petioles are 1-2 cm long. This very choice and delightful dwarf, unlike most of the Dwarf Group, tends to grow upright. It is extremely difficult to propagate, and new grafts grow very slowly. The name has been misspelled 'Tsukumo'.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这是一个可爱的矮生品种，株形短壮而直立。即使幼株每年也仅生长 5-10 厘米，老株主枝年生长量则只有 5 厘米或更少。由于芽在枝条上排列紧密，叶片着生非常密。植株分枝多，最终形成高宽各约 1-1.5 米的致密矮生团丛。枝条非常坚挺且直立。新叶展开时呈鲜亮锈红色，随后转为浅红绿色，成熟后则为浓郁深绿色。随着新梢伸长，从梢顶到基部可同时看到这些不同的色相变化，观赏效果十分优美。秋季则呈现非常强烈的金黄色。鲜绿色叶片具 5 个裂片，部分叶片裂片较明显。整片叶子往往僵挺地向侧方伸出。坚硬的绿色叶柄长 1-2 厘米。这个极为珍贵而讨喜的矮生品种不同于多数 Dwarf Group 品种，习性偏直立。其繁殖极为困难，新嫁接苗生长也非常缓慢。其名称曾被误写为 'Tsukumo'。

descriptions.preferred: The red leaves of this cultivar have seven lobes which are divided two-thirds or more of the way to the leaf base. In the center, the lobes hold close together but radiate at the ends. The leaves range from 4 to 8 cm long and from 5 to 9 cm wide. The vigorous growth of newer shoots can produce even larger leaves. The thin leaves are almost translucent, and the leaf base is mostly truncate. The lobes are broadly ovate and taper to a long, slender point. The edges are regularly and delicately serrated. The petioles are 3-4 cm long. The spring foliage is light red with a green cast to the center of each lobe. This color quickly changes to a deeper brick-red tone, maturing as a deep greenish red. The green midveins are quite prominent. By late summer the leaves are a rich green with a slight tinge of dark red. Fall color is a brilliant orange crimson. Corvallis

descriptions_zh.preferred: 该品种的红叶具 7 枚裂片，裂深达叶基的三分之二以上。裂片在中部靠拢，末端则向外放射展开。叶片长 4-8 厘米，宽 5-9 厘米；新梢生长旺盛时可形成更大的叶片。叶质较薄，近半透明，叶基多为截形。裂片宽卵形，渐尖成细长尖端。叶缘具规则而细致的锯齿。叶柄长 3-4 厘米。春季新叶为浅红色，每枚裂片中央带绿色调；随后很快转为更深的砖红色，成熟后呈深绿带红。绿色主脉非常显眼。至夏末，叶片转为浓绿色，并略带深红色晕。秋色为鲜艳的橙红至深红色。Corvallis

products.name: Acer palmatum 'Tsukubane' Green Japanese Maple
products.description_text: In early spring leaves emerge red with green center in sunny locations. In more shade the leaves are green with red tint on the lobes. Either way they are totally green in a matter of days. However, the reason to grow this tree is for the wonderful bright red fall color. 'Tsukubane' is fast growing and becomes a large round topped specimen with age. Older trees regularly achieve heights of more than 25 feet. The Japanese name means ridge on Mount Tsukuba. 10 Year Size: Height: 12-15 Feet Width: 8-10 feet Our 1 Gallon and 3 Gallon sizes are available for shipping and in store pickup. Our larger sizes (7 Gallon and bigger) are only available for in store pickup.

descriptions.preferred: This tree attracts attention in any garden. The rich purple-red or black-red leaves are spectacular and hold their color quite well all season, so this remains a dark-foliage tree. However, on the shaded sides and leaf undersides, a green cast develops under the dark tones. The midveins of each lobe are a noticeable green contrast. The beautiful fruits are almost a chartreuse color and seem to sparkle among the deep-toned foliage. The seven-lobed large leaves are 7-9 cm long and 8-10 cm wide. They appear much longer than broad, however, because the center lobes are predominant. The lobes radiate stiffly and are divided to about halfway to the leaf base. They are broadly ovate, tapering to a sharp point. The appearance is almost star shaped. The light yellowpink petioles are 4 cm long. This strong-growing plant forms a medium-sized round-topped spreading tree of 4 m or more tall and almost as wide. It is one of the better dark-toned cultivars but not widely known. The difficulty in translating the first syllable accounts for the numerous spellings of this name—'Chikishi gata', 'Chikushi gata', 'Shikishigata', and 'Shikushigata'. The cultivar is named for a bay on the Japanese island of Kyu\shu\. Corvallis the purple red blending into the light green of the leaf center. This color combination continues well into early summer, then gradually diminishes and matures into a shiny, darker green. Red colors dominate in the fall. The leaves have five or seven lobes which are separated one-third to halfway to the leaf base. They are 5-8 cm long and slightly broader. Each lobe is ovate, terminating in a narrow tip. The margins are lightly and regularly serrated. The reddish green petioles are 2-3 cm long. This maple is not a fast-growing plant but more of a rounded bush, reaching up to 3 m tall at maturity and almost as wide. It becomes twiggy and rebranches, is somewhat tender, and is not easy to propagate. The spring foliage always attracts attention. It makes a very pleasant companion plant for dissectums and other shrubs.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这是一株在任何花园中都很吸睛的树。其浓郁的紫红色或近黑红色叶片极为出色，整个生长季持色性相当好，因此始终保持深色叶效果。不过，在背阴面及叶背，深色调下会透出一些绿色感；每个裂片的中脉也呈明显的绿色对比。其果实十分美丽，近黄绿色，在深色叶丛中仿佛闪闪发光。大型叶片通常七裂，长 7-9 厘米、宽 8-10 厘米。由于中央裂片特别突出，视觉上显得长于宽。裂片硬挺地向外放射，分裂约达叶基的一半，呈宽卵形，渐尖，整体几近星形。浅黄粉色叶柄长约 4 厘米。该品种生长势强，形成中等大小、圆顶开展的乔木，高约 4 米或更高，冠幅近似相当。它是较优秀的深色叶品种之一，但并不广为人知。由于其名称首音节较难转写，故出现了多种拼写形式，如 'Chikishi gata'、'Chikushi gata'、'Shikishigata' 和 'Shikushigata'。该品种以日本九州岛上的一处海湾命名。 Corvallis 的春叶色彩尤为引人注目，紫红色与叶片中央的浅绿色相互交融。这种综合色可持续到初夏，随后逐渐减弱，成熟为有光泽的较深绿色。秋季则以红色调为主。叶片具五或七裂，裂片分离达叶基的三分之一至二分之一。叶长 5-8 厘米，宽度略大于长度。每个裂片呈卵形，末端具狭尖；叶缘具轻微而规则的锯齿。红绿色叶柄长 2-3 厘米。该品种生长速度不快，更像圆形灌木，成熟时高可达 3 米，冠幅近似相当。其枝条细密、分枝性强，稍欠耐寒，且不易繁殖。春季叶色总是格外引人注目。与 dissectum 类品种及其他灌木搭配栽植时效果十分宜人。

products.description_text: Acer palmatum 'Tsukushigata' Deep Red Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 'Tsukushigata' is a unique Japanese maple with large star shaped leaves that are brick red in color in the early spring becoming more chocolate red as they mature. This tree is especially beautiful and under-utilized. I think it might get more mainstream if it had a name like “Chocolate Stars”. ‘Tsukushigata’ has a great rich chocolate color to the leaves and also has nice lime green stemming that creates a winning contrasting combination. During the summer the lime green veins become more prominent in the leaf. ‘Tsukushigata’ may turn from yellow to fiery orange red in the fall. ‘Tsukushigata’ may reach 10-12 ft in height in 10 years. descriptions.preferred: As the leaves unfold, they tend to droop, adding a softness to the plant's general appearance. Spring color is a soft yellow-green. The lobe tips are shaded with persimmon-red to light purple-red blends. Summer color is deep green, and fall color is crimson. The mediumsized leaves have five ovate lobes tapering to slender tips and separated halfway to the base. The margins are evenly and lightly toothed. This maple forms a rounded plant up to 10 ft. (3 m) tall and wide.

attributes.hort_group_description: Acers in this amoenum group have large, palm-shaped leaves with finely-toothed edges

care.cultivation: Grow in a moist but well-drained soil. Water in summer if necessary. Leaf colour is best in partial shade, although full sun can be tolerated. Leaf scorch can be caused by lack of soil moisture or excessive exposure. See Japanese maple cultivation
care.pruning: Pruning group 1 , pruning if necessary only from late autumn to midwinter
care.propagation: Propagate by grafting , softwood cuttings or layering

resistance.pest: May be susceptible to Acer gall mite, aphids , caterpillars and horse chestnut scale
resistance.disease: May be susceptible to Verticillium wilt , Acer leaf scorch and honey fungus

descriptions_zh.preferred: 叶片展开时常略向下垂，使整株外观更显柔和。春季叶色为柔和的黄绿色。裂片尖端带有柿红至浅紫红的混合色调。夏季转为深绿色，秋季则呈深红色。中等大小的叶片具五个卵形裂片，渐尖成细长尖端，自叶基向上约一半处分裂。叶缘均匀、轻微具齿。该枫树形成圆整株形，高和冠幅均可达 10 英尺（3 米）。

resistance.pest: 可能易受槭瘿螨、蚜虫、毛虫和七叶树介壳虫危害
resistance.disease: 可能易感黄萎病、槭叶焦枯病和蜜环菌病

rhs_zh.description: 生长缓慢，株形紧凑圆整，可形成灌木或小乔木。掌状叶具 5-7 个椭圆形裂片，春季展叶时为黄绿色，裂片尖端带红紫色，夏季转为较深的绿色，秋季变红。

attributes.suggested_uses: 城市/庭院花园、乡村/自然式花园、花境与花坛、低维护、露台/容器植物、结构型植物
attributes.hort_group_description: 此 amoenum 类群中的 Acer 品种具有大型掌状叶，叶缘具细锯齿。

care.cultivation: 宜栽培于湿润但排水良好的土壤中。夏季必要时应补充浇水。叶色在半阴环境下表现最佳，但也可耐全日照。土壤水分不足或暴晒过度都可能导致叶缘焦枯。参见日本枫树栽培资料。
care.pruning: 修剪组 1；如有必要，仅在深秋至仲冬期间修剪
care.propagation: 可采用嫁接、嫩枝扦插或压条繁殖

descriptions.preferred: This cultivar closely resembles 'Tsuma beni', with which it is often confused. The spring color phase is quite similar. As the foliage unfolds, it tends to droop from the petiole, adding a softness to the general appearance of the plant. The color at this time is a very soft yellow green. The tips of the lobes are shaded with a blend of tones which are difficult to describe. Colors range from Corvallis about halfway to the leaf base. The margins are evenly and lightly serrated. This maple is not a tall-growing cultivar but forms a round-shaped plant up to 3 m tall and wide. Because of the similarity in name, leaf, and form, 'Tsuma gaki' and 'Tsuma beni' may be confused, but they are distinct cultivars. 'Tsuma gaki' has been misspelled 'Tsuma gari'.

rhs.description: A slow-growing, compact, rounded shrub or small tree with palmate leaves with 5-7 oval lobes, emerging yellow-green with red-purple tips to the lobes, turning darker green in summer and red in autumn

attributes.suggested_uses: City/Courtyard Gardens, Cottage/Informal Garden, Flower borders and beds, Low Maintenance, Patio/Container Plants, Architectural
attributes.hort_group_description: Acers in this amoenum group have large, palm-shaped leaves with finely-toothed edges

care.cultivation: Grow in a moist but well-drained soil. Water in summer if necessary. Leaf colour is best in partial shade, although full sun can be tolerated. Leaf scorch can be caused by lack of soil moisture or excessive exposure. See Japanese maple cultivation
care.pruning: Pruning group 1 , pruning if necessary only from late autumn to midwinter
care.propagation: Propagate by grafting , softwood cuttings or layering

resistance.pest: May be susceptible to Acer gall mite, aphids , caterpillars and horse chestnut scale
resistance.disease: May be susceptible to Verticillium wilt , Acer leaf scorch and honey fungus

descriptions_zh.preferred: 该品种与 'Tsuma beni' 极为相似，常与之混淆。其春季叶色阶段十分接近。叶片展开时常自叶柄处略微下垂，使整株外观显得更柔和。此时叶色为非常柔和的黄绿色。裂片尖端带有一种难以准确描述的综合色调。颜色范围从 Corvallis 处原文残缺可推测，应描述其尖端着色变化。叶片自叶基向上约一半处分裂。叶缘均匀且轻微具锯齿。该枫树不是高大型品种，而是形成圆整株形，高和冠幅均可达 3 米。由于名称、叶形和株形相近，'Tsuma gaki' 与 'Tsuma beni' 容易混淆，但它们是两个不同的品种。'Tsuma gaki' 也曾被误拼为 'Tsuma gari'。

resistance.pest: 可能易受槭瘿螨、蚜虫、毛虫和七叶树介壳虫危害
resistance.disease: 可能易感黄萎病、槭叶焦枯病和蜜环菌病

rhs_zh.description: 生长缓慢，株形紧凑圆整，可形成灌木或小乔木。掌状叶具 5-7 个椭圆形裂片，春季展叶时为黄绿色，裂片尖端带红紫色，夏季转为较深的绿色，秋季变红。

attributes.suggested_uses: 城市/庭院花园、乡村/自然式花园、花境与花坛、低维护、露台/容器植物、结构型植物
attributes.hort_group_description: 此 amoenum 类群中的 Acer 品种具有大型掌状叶，叶缘具细锯齿。

care.cultivation: 宜栽培于湿润但排水良好的土壤中。夏季必要时应补充浇水。叶色在半阴环境下表现最佳，但也可耐全日照。土壤水分不足或暴晒过度都可能导致叶缘焦枯。参见日本枫树栽培资料。
care.pruning: 修剪组 1；如有必要，仅在深秋至仲冬期间修剪
care.propagation: 可采用嫁接、嫩枝扦插或压条繁殖

descriptions.preferred: Acer palmatum 'Tsuma type' Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 Acer palmatum ‘Tsuma Type’ is an upright, deciduous Japanese maple with a graceful, medium-sized canopy. In spring, the light green leaves emerge tipped with deep purple-red along the lobes, creating a striking contrast. As summer progresses, the foliage softens to green before turning brilliant yellow in autumn. Best grown in morning sun with afternoon shade and well-drained soil. A slow to moderate grower, reaching about 8 ft tall and 4 ft wide in 10 years. Limited Quantities Available !! descriptions.preferred: The interesting leaves usually have seven lobes, occasionally five or nine lobes, varying widely in size from 7 to 12 cm long and from 6 to 11 cm wide. The lobes are widely separated more than three-quarters of the way to the leaf base. They spread slightly and are sometimes twisted at various angles. The lobes are narrow, almost Corvallis to a sturdy, medium-sized tree up to 5 m tall. A different transliteration system from Japanese to English gives this cultivar the slightly different name of 'Furu nishiki'. Other names under which this cultivar was known are 'Amelopsifolium', 'Ampelopsifolium', 'Laciniatum', and 'Septemlobum'.

descriptions.preferred: This cultivar is an intriguing and strikingly unique green plant. It was discovered, propagated, and named by Harold Johnston as a chance seedling at Johnnie's Pleasure Plants Nursery, Tallassee, Alabama. The name 'Twisted Spider' aptly describes many of the narrow-lobed, sometimes almost spiral leaves of this unusual plant. It has a combination of fine, narrow and coarse widelobed leaves, with most leaves having five, or sometimes seven, deeply cut, almost linear lobes with uneven teeth. These lobes are irregularly twisted and curved. The leaves are 3-5 cm long and wide. Each lobe is 4-8 mm wide at the broadest point at the lower end. The larger coarser leaves are fewer in number but are more broadly ovate and with much coarser irregular toothing. These leaves are 6-8 cm long and 4-6 cm wide. Each lobe is 1.5-2.5 cm wide at the broadest point in the middle. Though the leaves are mostly five lobed, occasionally one or three of the lobes may be absent. The short, slender petioles are 1-2 cm long. The foliage is medium to dark green and turns a yellow orange in the fall. The petiole and shoots are green. 'Twisted Spider' is vigorous with an upright, slightly pendulous habit. It has reached 2 m high in six years, and its estimated mature height is 3-4 m with a spread of about 2 m.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 该品种是一株引人注目且极具个性的绿色品种。它由 Harold Johnston 在美国阿拉巴马州 Tallassee 的 Johnnie's Pleasure Plants Nursery 从一株偶然出现的实生苗中发现、繁殖并命名。名称 'Twisted Spider' 十分贴切地描述了这种植物许多狭裂、且有时几乎呈螺旋状的叶片。它同时具有细窄裂片与较粗宽裂片两类叶形，但大多数叶片具 5 个、偶尔 7 个深裂、近线形的裂片，裂片边缘具不规则锯齿。这些裂片常不规则扭曲、弯折。此类叶片长宽约 3-5 厘米，每个裂片在靠近下部最宽处宽 4-8 毫米。数量较少的大型粗质叶片则更宽卵形，叶缘锯齿更粗且不规则；这类叶片长 6-8 厘米、宽 4-6 厘米，每个裂片在中部最宽处宽 1.5-2.5 厘米。虽然叶片多为 5 裂，但偶尔会缺少其中 1 个或 3 个裂片。短而细的叶柄长 1-2 厘米。叶色为中绿至深绿，秋季转为黄橙色。叶柄和新梢均为绿色。'Twisted Spider' 生长势较强，株形直立而稍带下垂。6 年可长至 2 米高，估计成熟株高 3-4 米，冠幅约 2 米。

descriptions.preferred: Acer palmatum 'Twombly's Red Sentinel' Red Sentinel Columnar Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 In the late 1970’s, Ken Twombly of Twombly’s Nursery in CT, found a compact growth shaped mutation on a red bloodgood-type of a Japanese maple at a church in eastern Connecticut. When this broom-like mutation was propagated it had a very unusual form. The name of ‘Twombly’s Red Sentinel’ which Ken chose describes this Japanese maple perfectly. These grafted trees remain tall and upright, yet fairly narrow, making it a great mid-sized flag-pole-like tree of color for small spaces. ‘Twombly’s Red Sentinel’ leafs out in the early spring as a bright red, maturing to a deeper maroon by summer. In autumn, the electric red fall color will grab your attention in the landscape. It will reach 8-10 ft in height by 3 ft wide in 15 years. Because of this shape, Ken recommends using this maple as a high class hedge. 1 gallon 'Twombly's Red Sentinel' are about 12-14 inches in height. Trees were potted up to 1 gallons in the spring and may not have completely filled out their pots. The photo(s) with a MrMaple logo are owned by MrMaple.com and cannot be used without expressed written consent. Limited Quantities Available !! As we have over a thousand cultivars of Japanese maples, we often do not have many of each cultivar. descriptions_zh.preferred: Acer palmatum 'Twombly's Red Sentinel' 红叶柱形日本枫，适生分区 5-9。20 世纪 70 年代末，康涅狄格州 Twombly's Nursery 的 Ken Twombly 在康州东部一座教堂里的一株红叶 Bloodgood 类型日本枫上发现了一个生长紧凑、形态异常的芽变。将这一 broom-like（扫帚状）变异繁殖后，得到了一种极不寻常的树形。Ken 为其命名为 'Twombly's Red Sentinel'，这个名字非常贴切地描述了该日本枫。嫁接后的植株保持高耸直立，但相当狭窄，因此非常适合作为小空间中的中型彩叶“旗杆状”树种。'Twombly's Red Sentinel' 早春展叶鲜红，至夏季成熟为更深的栗紫色；秋季则呈现醒目的亮电红色秋叶，在景观中极具吸引力。预计 15 年可达 8-10 英尺高、约 3 英尺宽。由于其特殊株形，Ken 建议可将其用作高品质绿篱。1 加仑盆的 'Twombly's Red Sentinel' 植株高度约为 12-14 英寸。这些植株于春季换入 1 加仑盆，根系可能尚未完全长满盆土。带有 MrMaple 标志的照片归 MrMaple.com 所有，未经明确书面许可不得使用。数量有限。由于我们拥有上千个日本枫品种，单个品种通常库存不多；部分选育品种常会很快售罄，建议尽早购买心仪品种。

descriptions.preferred: The small leaves are deeply divided into five lobes, each lobe elongate-ovate with a long slender tip. The margins are conspicuously toothed, giving the foliage a feathery appearance. One of the eye-catching maples with orange-yellow spring color, 'Ueno homare' is also one of the earliest to come into leaf. The spring leaves are deep yellow with orange-red edging, gradually changing to yellow- HOMARE' green, then bright green in the summer, and turning a bright orange to red in the fall. This excellent, fairly vigorous small upright tree reaches 16 ft. (5 m) or so tall. It provides early spring color in the landscape. The name means "glorious Ueno," after a mountain in the Tokyo area with a park famous for its flowering cherries and flowerviewing parties.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 叶片较小，深裂为五裂，每裂片均为长卵形，先端细长。叶缘具明显锯齿，使叶姿呈现羽毛状。‘Ueno homare’ 是春季叶色橙黄色、极为抢眼的槭树品种之一，也是在春季最早展叶的品种之一。春叶为深黄色，边缘带橙红色，随后渐转为黄绿色，夏季鲜绿色，秋季则转为亮橙色至红色。该品种为优良的小型直立树，长势较强，可高达约 16 英尺（5 米）。适合作为景观中的早春色彩植物。其名称意为“光荣的 Ueno”，得名于东京地区的 Ueno 山，该地公园以樱花和赏花聚会闻名。

'Ueno homare' is a strong, hardy tree that can handle sun in most areas. 10 Year Size: Height: 10-12 feet Width: 4-6 feet

descriptions.preferred: This medium-sized, upright tree has outstanding colored foliage in the spring. It is one of the 'Katsura' group of spring-color maples, but deeper and brighter orange than 'Katsura'. The medium-sized leaves are five lobed and 5-7 cm long and wide. The lobes are deeply separated to almost three-quarters of the way to the leaf base, and radiate outward in typical palmatum fashion. 'Ueno yama' is one of the first cultivars to leaf out in the spring. The intense orange color dominates the landscape for several weeks and makes quite a splash. As spring progresses, the tones gradually shade into the greens which have quietly blended with the orange. Summer shows a good bright green. The fall colors return to the yellow-orange series. This good, vigorous tree is hardy and of upstanding habit, although long side branches broaden it with age. It is an excellent accent plant for medium-tall landscape needs and for early spring color.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这是一株中型直立乔木，春季叶色极为出众。它属于 'Katsura' 系春色槭之一，但橙色比 'Katsura' 更深、更鲜艳。中等大小的叶片具 5 个裂片，长宽约 5-7 厘米。裂片深裂，接近叶基的四分之三处，呈典型的掌状向外放射。'Ueno yama' 是春季较早展叶的品种之一。强烈的橙色可在景观中持续主导数周，视觉冲击力很强。随着春季推进，橙色逐渐过渡并融合进绿色之中。夏季叶色为明快而漂亮的绿色。秋季又回到黄橙色系。该品种生长良好、长势强健、耐寒，树形挺拔，虽然随着树龄增长，长侧枝会使树冠逐渐开展。它非常适合作为中等偏高景观层次中的点景树，也非常适合提供早春叶色。

products.name: Acer palmatum 'Ueno yama' Yellow Japanese Maple
products.description_text: Acer palmatum 'Ueno Yama' Japanese Maple is a visually captivating, upright tree that brings vibrant color to the landscape throughout the seasons. In spring, its foliage emerges with a striking orange hue and red-edged leaves, creating a brilliant display that often gives the entire tree a glowing orange appearance. The leaves are deeply lobed and finely toothed, with each lobe reaching out on different planes, giving the tree a delicate, feathery texture. As the season progresses, the spring color transitions to a bright yellow-green, eventually maturing to a soft medium green for the summer months. In fall, 'Ueno Yama' puts on a spectacular show of yellow, orange, and red, providing stunning autumn interest. This medium-sized tree typically reaches 8 to 12 feet in height over the course of 10 years. It thrives in partial sun to partial shade and is perfect for adding a touch of spring-like brilliance to any garden. Its dynamic foliage and striking color changes throughout the year make 'Ueno Yama' a standout accent tree. Ideal for those seeking a tree that offers both early spring excitement and year-round beauty, 'Ueno Yama' is a wonderful addition to any landscape

descriptions.preferred: The name means "floating clouds" and refers to the subtle variegation of the leaves which gave rise to the exof very minute dots. Most leaves are marked in varying degrees by white or pink spots, sometimes merging into large areas. Other leaves are totally white or light pink. None of the coloration is garish—it is soft. The five-lobed leaves measure 4-6 cm long and wide. The lobes radiate openly and separate three-quarters of the way to the leaf base. They are long-ovate ending in a sharp tip. The lobes that are highly colored do not lie flat but may curl downwards or sideways. Often they are twisted and undulate. The margins are finely and regularly toothed. This plant is not a rapid grower. The twigs are rather short and slightly multibranched, forming a semidense plant. 'Ukigumo' becomes a tall shrub, probably reaching 3 m after many years.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 其名称意为“浮云”，指叶片上细腻的斑锦变化，仿佛由极其细小的斑点构成。多数叶片会以不同程度分布白色或粉色斑点，有时会融合成较大的色块；也有些叶片几乎全白或浅粉。整体色彩并不艳俗，而是十分柔和。五裂叶长宽均为 4-6 厘米。裂片向外舒展，分裂至叶基约四分之三处，裂片为长卵形，先端锐尖。着色较重的裂片往往不平展，可能向下或向侧面卷曲，且常有扭转和波浪状起伏。叶缘细密且规则具锯齿。该品种生长不快，枝条较短，且略多分枝，形成半致密株形。‘Ukigumo’ 最终可长成高大灌木，许多年后高度约可达 3 米。

rhs_zh.description: 落叶性、丛生型小至中型灌木，最终高度约 3 米。叶片 5 裂，略有扭曲，春季萌发时以白色为主，叶尖及局部带粉色晕染；成熟后转为绿色，并带有大量白色与粉色斑驳及镶边。

care.cultivation: 宜栽植于保水性良好且排水通畅的土壤中，并选择避风环境。叶色在半阴条件下表现最佳；若土壤湿度稳定充足，也可耐受全日照。土壤缺水或暴露过度都可能导致叶片焦枯。更多日本枫树栽培建议。
care.pruning: 修剪第 1 组：晚秋至隆冬期间进行
care.propagation: 可于冬末采用嫁接繁殖，或以软枝扦插繁殖。

descriptions.preferred: This small-leaved form has leaves 4-5 cm long and slightly wider, and a truncate leaf base. The seven lobes are separated about halfway to the leaf base and radiate outward uniformly. They are ovate with a tapered, slender point, and fold slightly upward from the midribs. The margins are lightly serrated. The stiff green petioles are 1-1.5 cm long. New foliage emerges a bright brick red which soon turns into a bright purplish red. The main veins are a prominent contrasting green. Plants grown in full sun have bright red coloration, while those grown in shade Corvallis spreading, and forms a round-topped bush that may reach 5 m at maturity. 'Umegae' has been around for more than 100 years and can be found on maple lists of the late 1800s. The name has also been transliterated from Japanese to English as 'Umegai'.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这一小叶类型的叶片长 4-5 厘米，宽度略大于长度，叶基平截。7 个裂片裂至叶基约一半，并均匀向外放射。裂片为卵形，先端渐尖且细长，自中脉处略向上折。叶缘具浅锯齿。坚挺的绿色叶柄长 1-1.5 厘米。新叶展开时为鲜亮的砖红色，随后很快转为明亮的紫红色，主脉则呈显著的对比性绿色。全日照条件下栽培的植株叶色更鲜红，而在半阴处栽培的植株色调会有所不同。该品种生长缓慢，株形直立而开展，形成圆头状灌丛，成熟时可达 5 米高。'Umegae' 已有 100 多年栽培历史，在 19 世纪末的槭树品种名录中即可见到。其名称也曾从日文音译为英文写作 'Umegai'。
