descriptions.preferred: One of the Oregon Ghost series, this cultivar is similar in leaf shape and size to its parent, the well-known 'Beni shigitatsu sawa', but with a network of green veins on a paler whitish green background. It is especially noteworthy in the spring and early summer when the young leaves are pink-flushed from the outer margins. It is estimated to form a broad shrubby tree up to 10 ft. (3 m) tall and needs some protection from the afternoon sun.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这是 Oregon Ghost 系列品种之一，叶形和叶片大小与其著名亲本 'Beni shigitatsu sawa' 相似，但叶面为较浅的灰白绿色底，上覆绿色叶脉网络。它在春季和初夏尤为出色，此时嫩叶自外缘带有粉色晕染。据估计可形成开展的灌木状小乔木，高可达 10 英尺（3 米），需要在午后阳光下给予一定遮护。

products.name: Acer palmatum 'Uncle Ghost' Reticulated Japanese Maple
products.description_text: Acer palmatum ‘Uncle Ghost’ is a very rare and fantastic reticulated variety of Japanese maple. Displaying dark veins on top of pink foliage, ‘Uncle Ghost’ really stands out in the spring. As temperatures rise, the leaves of ‘Uncle Ghost’ turns from peachy to light green. The leaves then turn orange-red in the fall. Acer palmatum ‘Uncle Ghost’ is a shorter growing upright Japanese maple that will only reach about 6 feet tall at maturity. 10 Year Size: Height: 6-8 feet Width: 4-6 feet

The "fabric" appears to be stretched between the sharp-pointed end and the prominent main vein in each lobe. Each lobe is broadly triangular and terminates in a sharp point. The green leaves are thickly speckled with very fine white dots, making the leaf appear whitish green. A narrow, almost pure white strip runs along each side of the strong green main vein of each lobe. Spring leaves are an unusually pale pink-yellow before becoming whitish green for summer. This upright slow-growing maple reaches 10-13 ft. (3-4 m) high. descriptions_zh.preferred: 这种极为少见的叶形常被比作蝙蝠的翅膀。不过，这种大型七至九裂叶的美感远胜于这一比喻所暗示的程度。每个裂片中，尖锐的先端与突出的主脉之间仿佛有一层“薄膜”被拉展开来。各裂片呈宽三角形，末端收于尖点。绿色叶片上密布极细小的白色斑点，使整片叶子显得灰白绿色。每个裂片强健的绿色主脉两侧各有一道狭窄、近乎纯白的条纹。春叶呈异常浅的粉黄色，夏季转为灰白绿色。这种直立、缓慢生长的槭树可长至 10-13 英尺（3-4 米）高。 Acer pycnanthum 日本红枫 原产日本，本种生长于山麓较低处潮湿的沼泽地带，与北美红槭或沼生槭 Acer rubrum 关系密切。叶片形状不规则，近圆形至三角形，通常具三个浅而不明显的裂片，叶缘具不规则的钝齿。新叶上表面呈迷人的古铜色至深红色，夏季转绿；叶背为美丽的蓝灰色，微风吹动时尤为醒目。Acer pycnanthum 可长至 80 英尺（24.5 米）以上，适合作为混合景观中的上层乔木。种加词意为“花成密集簇生”。 Acer rufinerve 红脉槭 这是一种生长健壮、株形直立的树种，可高达 39-50 英尺（12-15 米）。它是颇具观赏性的蛇皮槭之一，亮绿色树皮表面沿纵向分布着深色、狭长的灰色条纹；随树龄增长，这些条纹会变得更灰。该种最不同寻常的特征，是新梢表面覆有柔和的蓝灰色粉霜。中等大小的叶片具五裂，基部一对小裂片与中间三个裂片均向前伸展，其中中央裂片最为显著，呈三角形。叶缘具齿。叶面中绿色至深绿色，叶背较浅，叶脉上密生锈褐色茸毛，至生长季后期则仅在脉腋处残留毛簇。秋色浓丽，为富于深红晕染的金黄与亮黄色。在日本，本种生长于山地森林坡地中上部，海拔可达 6600 英尺（2000 米）。在庭园中适应性良好，耐干燥也耐湿润环境，但更偏好阳光充足且湿润的条件。种加词意为“红褐色”。

descriptions.preferred: The margins of light green spring leaves are tinted purple or red. Later, the green becomes darker for the summer, turning crimson and purple in the fall. The large leaves have seven lobes divided halfway to the base. The broadly ovate lobes taper to short points and have finely toothed margins. This hardy cultivar forms a short, round-topped tree, reaching 13 ft. (4 m) tall and wide. It makes a fine landscape plant and adds contrasting spring leaf texture and excellent fall color. The name means "grasshopper skin," presumably referring to the shiny, bright green of the broad bold leaves.

descriptions.preferred: This cultivar, which can also be found under its former name of 'Christy Ann', has deep purple-red foliage similar in color to 'Bloodgood', but the leaf lobes are narrower, more serrated, more deeply divided and feathery. It holds its color very well throughout the summer until changing to deep orange and vivid red in the fall. The medium-sized to large seven-lobed leaves, measuring 7.5-9 cm long and 9-11 cm wide, are very deeply divided to less than 1 cm from the leaf base. The lobes are long-ovate with long tail-like tips, 1-1.5 cm wide at the broadest point in the middle and narrowing markedly to only 2 mm at the lobe junctions. The margins are distinctly double serrated with numerous sharp-pointed teeth. The slender red petioles are 2.5-4 cm long. This vigorous plant forms an upright wide round-headed medium-sized tree up to 6 m high. It is wider spreading than 'Bloodgood' but not as tall.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 该品种旧名亦作 'Christy Ann'，其深紫红色叶片与 'Bloodgood' 颜色相似，但裂片更狭窄、锯齿更细密，分裂更深，整体更具羽状感。整个夏季持色性都很好，直到秋季转为深橙色和鲜艳的红色。中大型七裂叶长 7.5-9 厘米、宽 9-11 厘米，深裂至距叶基不足 1 厘米处。裂片为长卵形，具长尾状尖端，在中部最宽处宽 1-1.5 厘米，到裂片连接处明显收窄，仅约 2 毫米。叶缘具明显的重锯齿，齿端锐尖且数量较多。细长的红色叶柄长 2.5-4 厘米。植株生长旺盛，形成直立、开展、圆头的中型乔木，高可达 6 米。其冠幅比 'Bloodgood' 更开展，但高度略逊。

descriptions.preferred: The seven-lobed leaf, typical of the Amoenum Group, is 9-11 cm long and 10-12 cm wide. The lobes are well separated to about halfway to the leaf base. They are ovate, tapering to a strong prominent point. The strong petioles are up to 6 cm long. This upright-growing plant attains the stature of a small tree. Early sources described crimson variegation in the purple-red leaves. I have seen this cultivar in several places and was never strongly impressed with the leaf coloration most of the year. The fall coloring does redeem it somewhat, with scarlet and crimson variegations, more correctly described as mottling. The plants in the Maplewood collection, received from two different sources, show basically a reddish green leaf during most of the year, followed by the good fall tones. petuating. It has also been known under the name 'Atropurpureum Variegatum'.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 该叶片为 Amoenum Group 的典型形态，具七裂，长 9-11 厘米、宽 10-12 厘米。裂片彼此分离明显，约裂至叶基的一半。裂片呈卵形，先端渐尖，形成明显而有力的尖头。叶柄粗壮，长可达 6 厘米。植株生长直立，可达小乔木体量。早期资料记载其紫红色叶片上带有绯红色斑锦。我曾在多个地点见过该品种，但一年中大部分时间的叶色并未给我留下深刻印象。其秋色多少为其挽回一些观赏价值，带有猩红与深红色的斑驳，更准确地说应描述为杂色斑驳。Maplewood 收藏中的植株来自两个不同来源，全年大部分时间基本呈带红调的绿色叶色，随后才显现较好的秋季色彩。它也曾以 'Atropurpureum Variegatum' 之名流通。

descriptions.preferred: The leaves of this selection are the usual shape and size for the species—triangularovate, tapering to a slender tip—but with spectacular variegations. The base color is blue-green. The white to cream and gray-green markings appear on the leaf as specks, flecks, or "cut-in" sections, or sometimes completely covering the leaf. Pink flecks or streaks are often intermixed with the white. Some leaves are entirely white, while others have no variegation. In the fall, the white portions become rose-pink to scarlet. This cultivar forms a tall dense shrub or small tree, reaching 20 ft. (6 m) high. It is named after a famous British nursery which introduced many plants into cultivation. Acer diabolicum Devil maple, horned maple This species is distinguished by curious hornlike stigmas which persist at the inner junction of the fruit nutlets, resembling the horns of the devil. The large, five-lobed, thick-textured leaves are up to 6 in. (15 cm) long. The lobes are divided to about halfway to the leaf base. The middle three lobes are broadly lanceolate-ovate, with short acuminate tips. The two basal lobes are short and small. The margins are irregularly, coarsely, and bluntly toothed. Leaf color is medium to deep green. This strong, medium-sized, sturdy tree reaches 33-50 ft. (10-15 m) tall with a fairly broad, rounded canopy. It can be one of the most spectacular maples in flower, particularly when the bunches of large red male flowers appear. A flowering tree has been described as "looking like the smoldering embers of a gigantic bonfire." This maple is native to Japan, common in the north, less frequent in the south. It is found in open areas on sunny lower mountain slopes from 1320 to 4290 ft. (400-1300 m) above sea level. rhs.description: A large shrub or small, bushy tree to 10m tall and wide with green and white streaked branches and bark. The small, pointed, variegatedleaves are dark green with white and pink mottling in spring and summer and turn pink and purple in autumn. Pale yellow flowers are borne in slender racemes in spring

rhs_zh.description: 大型灌木或小型、丛生状乔木，高和冠幅均可达 10 米。枝条和树皮具绿色与白色条纹。叶片较小、先端尖，具斑锦；春夏季为深绿色，并带白色和粉色斑驳，秋季转为粉色和紫色。春季开淡黄色花，着生于细长总状花序上。

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这一选育品种的叶片形状与大小基本符合本种常态，为三角状卵形，先端渐尖成细长尖头，但具极为醒目的斑锦。底色为蓝绿色。白色至乳白色及灰绿色斑纹可表现为细点、斑块、“切入”状区块，或有时几乎覆盖整片叶。粉色斑点或条纹也常夹杂在白色斑纹之中。有些叶片通体白色，而另一些则完全无斑。秋季时，白色部分会转为玫瑰粉至猩红色。该品种可形成高大而致密的灌木或小乔木，高达 20 英尺（6 米）。其名称取自一家著名的英国苗圃，该苗圃曾将许多植物引入栽培。 Acer diabolicum Devil maple, horned maple 该种可凭借果实小坚果内侧结合处持续宿存的奇特角状柱头而辨认，形似魔鬼之角，因此得名。叶片大型、五裂、质地较厚，长可达 6 英寸（15 厘米）。裂片约分裂至叶基一半处。中间三个裂片为宽披针状卵形，先端短渐尖；基部两裂较短且较小。叶缘具不规则、粗大且钝的锯齿。叶色为中绿至深绿。该树种生长强健，为中等大小且树体结实的乔木，高可达 33-50 英尺（10-15 米），树冠较宽、近圆形。其花期时可成为极为壮观的槭树之一，尤其是大型红色雄花成簇开放时。曾有人形容其开花景象“仿佛一堆巨大篝火尚未熄灭的炽热余烬”。该种原产日本，北部较常见，南部较少见，生于海拔 1320-4290 英尺（400-1300 米）的向阳低山坡开阔地。 Acer distylum 通常称作 Lime-leaved maple。 这一稀有日本种具有极具特征的未裂、心形叶，因此获得这一俗名。分布于本州中北部山区，生于海拔 2275-5200 英尺（700-1600 米）的湿润土壤中。春叶为迷人的浅灰色，并带有浓重的砂色或粉色调，随后夏季转为中绿至深绿，秋季则变为清亮鲜黄。Acer distylum 可长成中等大小乔木，高达 33-49 英尺（10-15 米），是很有观赏价值的园林树种。 Acer japonicum Fullmoon maple 本种的重要特征之一是其绚丽的秋色，黄色、橙色与红色兼具，因此极具园林应用价值。多数类型树势强健，适应多数庭园环境。叶片大型、浓绿色、近圆形，具 9-11 裂。每个裂片较浅，并迅速渐尖。叶缘具浅至粗的锯齿。Acer japonicum 是极具观赏价值的小至中型乔木，高可达 33 英尺（10 米）。原产日本。

descriptions.preferred: Acer palmatum 'Verkade's Wintergold' Yellow Green Bark Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 Introduced by the famous Verkade's Nursery, 'Verkade's Winter Gold' leafs out in the early spring with large matsumurae leafs that are bright green and heavily divided. The overall shape of the tree is upright but in a semi-pendulous habit reaching 8 ft tall by 10 ft wide in 15 years. Mid-summer flushes are a brighter reddish orange which makes a great display over the rich green. Fall colors are a bright golden yellow to orange. The bark itself is brighter chartreuse green on the new growth which provides a winter interest and is where this selection gets its name. 'Verkade's Winter Gold' is a rare and unique Japanese maple that deserves a place in your landscape or garden. Sometimes this selection is known as just 'Wintergold', not to be confused with the snakebark selection with a similar name. Limited Quantities Available !! descriptions.preferred: This plant was one of the more widely distributed cultivars of commercial nurseries in the United States. It is a strong-growing, hardy form and makes an upright tree exceeding 7 m in 25-40 years. The top forms a broadened canopy typical of Acer palmatum. Young wood has a bright green bark which darkens as the tree matures, and the new growth progressively becomes more multibranched. The leaves are typical of the Palmatum Group, deep green in color with a varied pattern and amount of marking. The white portions consist of streaks, flecks, and blotches and are quite prominent on some leaves. Where variegations are large, that portion of the lobe is sickle shaped and curved laterally. Occasionally, pink colors are noticeable, but not in the profusion characteristic of some other cultivars, such as 'Oridono nishiki'. The leaves have five or seven lobes which are 4-6 cm long and 5-8 cm wide and which are attached to long, thin petioles 4-6 cm in length. The lobes are ovate-acuminate with elongated tips. The margins are double serrated, in most cases quite shallowly. Many nursery professionals believe this cultivar reverts to normal unvariegated palmatum as it matures. However, there are 40-year-old trees which have not reverted and have held their variegation well. There are also young trees with most of the foliage unmarked. High rates of fertility may cause lack of variegation. Culture factors which encourage extremely fast growth possible to perpetuate the best form of the cultivar. 'Versicolor' has also been known under the names 'Albo-variegatum', 'Aokii', 'Argenteo-maculatum', 'Argenteo-variegatum', 'Argenteum', 'Discolor Versicolo', 'Roseo-maculatum', 'Roseo-variegatum', and 'Roseum'.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 该植物曾是美国商业苗圃中分布较广的品种之一。其生长势强、较耐寒，25-40 年可长成超过 7 米的直立乔木。树冠形成 Acer palmatum 典型的宽展伞形。幼枝树皮鲜绿色，随树龄增长而逐渐加深，新生枝条也会逐步变得更加多分枝。叶片属于 Palmatum Group 的典型类型，底色深绿，斑锦的分布形式和面积变化较大。白色部分由条纹、斑点和斑块组成，在部分叶片上非常醒目。若斑锦面积较大，该裂片相应部分常呈镰刀形并向侧面弯曲。偶尔也可见粉色，但不像某些其他品种，如 'Oridono nishiki'，那样粉色丰富。叶片具 5 或 7 枚裂片，长 4-6 厘米，宽 5-8 厘米；叶柄细长，长 4-6 厘米。裂片为卵状渐尖形，先端延长。叶缘为重锯齿，但多数情况下锯齿较浅。许多苗圃业内人士认为该品种随着成熟会返祖为普通无斑的 palmatum 类型。然而，也有 40 年生植株并未返祖，且斑锦保持良好；同时也可见一些年轻植株大部分叶片几乎无斑。施肥过多可能导致斑锦减弱。促进极快生长的栽培条件也可能使斑锦不稳定，因此通常需要通过嫁接来保存该品种的最佳性状。'Versicolor' 还曾以 'Albo-variegatum'、'Aokii'、'Argenteo-maculatum'、'Argenteo-variegatum'、'Argenteum'、'Discolor Versicolo'、'Roseo-maculatum'、'Roseo-variegatum' 和 'Roseum' 等名称流通。

descriptions.preferred: This interesting Australian dissectum is of unknown origin. However, its characteristics suggest it may have been a seedling from 'Palmatifidum', as the leaf shape is identical though the size is smaller—8-10 cm wide compared to 12-14 cm. Like the lobes of 'Palmatifidum', the lobes of 'Vic Pink' are sturdy and not deeply dissected but are strongly and coarsely toothed. The great asset of this plant is the brilliant scarlet color in the fall compared to the orange gold of 'Palmatifidum'. It also comes into leaf several weeks later than its formidable parent and has beautiful dark red fruits. In all other respects—vigor, growth, habit, and summer color—the two cultivars are very alike.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这一有趣的澳大利亚 Dissectum 类型品种来源不详。不过，从其性状判断，它很可能是 'Palmatifidum' 的实生后代，因为两者叶形一致，只是本品种叶片较小，宽 8-10 厘米，而 'Palmatifidum' 为 12-14 厘米。与 'Palmatifidum' 一样，'Vic Pink' 的裂片结实，不是那种极深细裂的类型，但边缘具强烈且粗重的锯齿。该品种最大的优点在于秋季呈鲜艳猩红色，而 'Palmatifidum' 则为橙金色。它的展叶期也比这位强势的“亲本”晚数周，并结有美丽的深红色果实。除此之外，无论是长势、生长习性还是夏季叶色，这两个品种都非常相似。

descriptions.preferred: This excellent cultivar is from the Villa Taranto, Pallanza, Italy. It was propagated and introduced by the Firma C. Esveld, of Boskoop, Netherlands. The leaves are usually five lobed, measuring 7-9 cm long and 8-10 cm wide. Each lobe is long, narrow, and parallel sided, as is typical of the Linearilobum Group. The lobes are rarely more than 5 mm wide, except for foliage on fast-growing new shoots. The center lobes are longest and create a lacy effect. The margins of the lobes are smooth. The stiff petioles are 2-3 cm long. The leaves emerge as orange crimson, soon becoming green with a light reddish overtone, creating an unusual color effect. The older stock plants in the Netherlands were most impressive for this pattern. The color is unique and is a compromise between green and purple forms. However, all leaves, young and old, are green when grown in shade. In the fall, the leaves turn a pleasing yellow to gold. This hardy cultivar forms a dome-shaped plant of 3 m sectum, just as atropurpureum encompasses all the red forms. In old literature, the original Latin description was folia viridia, from whence came the general term viridis. There may have been a form or cultivar specifically named 'Viridis', but now the name has been applied to many good forms of green dissectum, in the same way the name 'Dissectum' is applied. The foliage is the "type" for dissectums with usually seven or nine lobes. Each lobe separates entirely to the petiole attachment. The lobes are multidissected or strongly pinnate, and extremely narrow with the deeply cut side separations again re-cut. Some descriptions refer to this as "deeply and doubly serrated in pinnate form." Leaves range from 6 cm long and 7 cm wide on older wood to 10 cm long and 12 cm wide on younger wood. While these dimensions are large, the leaf is not "gross" but has the delicate tracery of the typical dissectum form. The petioles are usually about 4 cm long. The bright green foliage holds color well through the summer. In extremely hot sun, the tips of the leaves may burn. Partial shade keeps the foliage bright all season. In the fall, delightful gold colors dominate with occasional splashes of crimson. This strongly cascading maple has long, drooping branchlets that form a dome-shaped plant at maturity. It needs to be grafted high on a standard, or staked durbe dropped as it has become so diluted as to be meaningless.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这一优良品种来自意大利 Pallanza 的 Villa Taranto，由荷兰 Boskoop 的 Firma C. Esveld 繁殖并引入。叶片通常为五裂，长 7-9 厘米，宽 8-10 厘米。每个裂片都狭长且两侧近平行，这是 Linearilobum Group 的典型特征。除旺盛新梢上的叶片外，裂片宽度通常很少超过 5 毫米。中央裂片最长，整体形成精致的蕾丝状效果。裂片边缘平滑无锯齿。叶柄坚挺，长 2-3 厘米。新叶初展时呈橙红绯色，不久转为绿色并带浅红色覆晕，形成不同寻常的色彩效果。荷兰较老的母株在这种色彩表现上尤为出色。其叶色十分独特，可视作绿色型与紫红型之间的折中。不过在遮阴条件下栽培时，无论新叶老叶皆为绿色。秋季叶色转为悦目的黄色至金黄色。该耐寒品种形成圆顶状株形，高约 3 米。 ‘Viridis’ 一词之于绿色羽裂型，正如 atropurpureum 一词涵盖所有红色型 sectum。在早期文献中，原始拉丁描述为 folia viridia，因此演化出通称 viridis。或许曾有某个类型或品种专名即为 ‘Viridis’，但如今这一名称已被广泛用于许多优良的绿色 dissectum 类型，正如名称 ‘Dissectum’ 也被广泛套用一样。其叶形可视作羽裂型的“标准型”，通常具七裂或九裂。每个裂片都完全裂至叶柄着生处。裂片进一步多次深裂，或呈强烈羽状分裂，且极为狭窄，深切的侧裂又再次分裂。有些描述将其称为“深裂且二重锯齿的羽状形”。老枝上的叶片约长 6 厘米、宽 7 厘米；幼枝上的叶片可达长 10 厘米、宽 12 厘米。虽然尺寸较大，但叶片并不显粗重，而仍保有典型 dissectum 型那种细致纤巧的线条感。叶柄通常长约 4 厘米。鲜绿色叶色在夏季保持良好；在极炎热的强光下，叶尖可能灼伤，半阴环境可使叶色整个生长季都保持鲜亮。秋季以迷人的金黄色为主，并偶尔夹有绯红色。该品种枝条细长下垂，具强烈的瀑布状姿态，成熟后形成圆顶状株形。宜高接于标准砧木上，或支撑培育。后文疑有 OCR 缺失，原句残缺，未作扩展补写。

descriptions.preferred: 塔兰托庄园 是 以意大利著名花园Villa Taruato命名的竹叶品种 ， 由荷兰Firma C. Esveld繁殖和引进 。叶子通常为 5裂，每个叶片都非常的细长且狭窄。优雅的竹状叶在春天呈现漂亮的紫红色，随后红色会逐渐褪去，形成红到绿的色彩渐变效果。夏季是绿色的， 随着秋季凉爽气温的到来，树叶 会 呈现出真正壮观的金色和橙 红的 色调 。生长习性和 "Red Pygmy"（红色霹雳）相似，相对较慢，成年株高约为3米。

descriptions.preferred: Several green-leaved dissectums of good form are sold under this cultivar name. All of them have deeply dissected green foliage and form vigorous, strongly cascading shrubs of typical broadly mounded shape, Acer reaching up to 13 ft. (4 m) tall. The green summer color turns to gold, often red, in the fall. The name means "green."

sources.title: 翠绿枝垂 Acer Palmatum 'Viridis'
sources.description: 翠绿枝垂枝条柔软，分支能力强。 春天是明亮的黄绿色，夏季是一种成熟的浓绿色，秋季色彩呈现金色橙色或者深红色。 叶裂一般呈现 7-9 裂，每个叶裂都靠基部连接。生长较为缓慢，成年 树高 1.5m，冠幅 1.5 米左右 ， 非常适合种植在庭院和池塘边，营造静谧的氛围感。

sources.description: Green lace leaf maple, canopies, size gets to about 9-12 ft tall and wide. Very nice gold fall colors. Viridis is a very hardy grower , one of the fastest lace leaf maples. It has one of the broadest canopies of all Japanese maples. This is the favorite of someone looking for a green, lacy, japanese maple. The fall colors are the icing on the cake for this maple. Viridis Japanese Maple can withstand full sun, and can keep its bright color throughout the summer season. Please email us at jherter@twave.net with any questions, and thanks for looking.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 市场上有数个叶形优良的绿叶羽裂类品种以此名称出售。它们都具深裂的绿色叶片，形成生长旺盛、强烈下垂的灌木，树形为典型的宽圆拱丘状，高可达 13 英尺（4 米）。夏季绿色叶色至秋季转为金黄色，且常带红色。其名称意为“绿色”。

rhs_zh.description: 植株姿态低矮开展，常为多主干。叶片裂得极深，几乎呈撕裂状。春夏季保持绿色，但秋色表现良好。春季开的红色花虽不张扬，却别具观赏性；随后结成本属典型的翅果。

products.title: Acer palmatum 'Viridis' Japanese Maple
products.description_text: Acer palmatum dissectum 'Viridis' Weeping Green Viridis Laceleaf Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 'Viridis' is a classic dwarf green Japanese maple selection with a cascading form. The 'Viridis' Japanese maple can reach 5-6 ft tall by 5-6 ft wide in 10 years. This 'Viridis' laceleaf Japanese maple leafs out as a bright chartreuse green that holds until the leaves mature to a rich green by mid-summer. In autumn, the 'Viridis' Japanese maple tree turns to a bright golden yellow to orange. This classic 'Viridis' Japanese maple tree is excellent to provide contrast against red Japanese maples. You can use 'Viridis' as a background plant or as a focal point planting. Because of the dwarf cascading habit of 'Viridis', this Japanese maple makes an excellent tree for small space in the landscape or even for container planting. This can allow you to expand your garden with the beauty of a weeping green laceleaf Japanese maple. After years of observation, we believe ‘Waterfall’ and ‘Viridis’ to now be the exact same cultivar in the nursery trade today. The original ‘Waterfall’ was likely a ‘Viridis’ that happened to be at waterfall at a state park in New Jersey. We still sell both cultivars as both are popular names people know this selection by. **10 GALLON TREE SHIPS WITHOUT POT DUE TO BOX SIZE CONSTRAINTS** Please note that your 10-gallon tree will arrive without a container. It ships immediately unless you request to hold. Be prepared for your 10 gallon tree without a container. Limited Quantities Available !! As we have over a thousand cultivars of Japanese maples, we often do not have many of each cultivar. We recommend that you buy the Japanese maples you want immediately as we often sell out of certain selections.

products.description_text: Acer palmatum dissectum 'Viridis' Weeping Green Viridis Laceleaf Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 'Viridis' is a classic dwarf green Japanese maple selection with a cascading form. The 'Viridis' Japanese maple can reach 4-5 ft tall by 4-5 ft wide in 10 years. This 'Viridis' laceleaf Japanese maple leafs out as a bright chartreuse green that holds until the leaves mature to a rich green by mid-summer. In autumn, the 'Viridis' Japanese maple tree turns to a bright golden yellow to orange. This classic 'Viridis' Japanese maple tree is excellent to provide contrast against red Japanese maples. You can use 'Viridis' as a background plant or as a focal point planting. Because of the dwarf cascading habit of 'Viridis', this Japanese maple makes an excellent tree for small space in the landscape or even for container planting. This can allow you to expand your garden with the beauty of a weeping green laceleaf Japanese maple. These 10 gallon trees are for local pickup only, we cannot ship them because they are too big. The MrMaple Nursery is located in East Flat Rock, NC. Please contact us to arrange a pickup time.

sources.title: 葡萄叶 Acer Japonicum 'Vitifolium'
sources.description: 葡萄叶的叶片与葡萄（Vitis）很像，故以此命名。葡 萄叶的秋色十分华丽，极具变化之美。变色初期主 要是金色，并交织着深红色和绯红色，然后在落叶 期逐渐转为鲜艳的绯红色。这个品种长势强劲，树 形直立，随着年龄的增大，它的冠幅也会逐渐增大， 形成圆形的树顶。葡萄叶是一个大型的品种，树高 和冠幅至少能达到 10m。它曾获得过英国皇家园艺 协会的花园优秀植物奖（the RHS Award of Garden Merit）。

rhs.description: A large bushy deciduous shrub or small tree with large rounded 9-11 lobed leaves which turn purple, crimson and orange in autumn. Red flowers in clusters beneath the branches

care.propagation: Propagate by grafting or softwood cuttings

resistance.pest: May be susceptible to Acer gall mite, aphids , caterpillars and horse chestnut scale
resistance.disease: May be susceptible to Verticillium wilt , Acer leaf scorch and honey fungus

descriptions_zh.preferred: 大型叶片形似葡萄属 Vitis 的叶，深绿色，具 9-11 枚裂片。每枚裂片与叶基之间的分裂深度近达一半，先端尖锐。主脉以较浅的绿色清晰显现。秋色极为壮观：初为金黄色并染有深红和猩红，随后转为鲜亮猩红色。该品种生长势强，树形直立，后期树冠宽展圆整，至少可达 33 英尺（10 米）高，冠幅亦可相近。 Acer maximowiczianum（Nikko maple）为健壮的中型至大型乔木，树冠宽圆，成熟时高 46-66 英尺（14-20 米）。其最显著特征是全株各部位均密生粗壮茸毛，包括新梢、叶片、叶柄、花梗和果实。中等大小的叶通常由 3 枚较大的小叶组成，近无柄，卵形，边缘不规则钝齿或波状，先端钝尖。叶面为无光泽的中绿至深绿色，叶背具吸引人的蓝灰至灰白色，并密被坚硬灰毛。该树是秋季转色较晚的种类之一，先呈柔和的黄与粉色粉彩调，继而转为橙色和红色，最终成为深烈焰红，且可持续至晚秋。原产日本，也分布至中国，生于低山森林中、海拔 1650-5940 英尺（500-1800 米）处湿润、排水良好而肥沃的谷地土壤。种加词纪念俄罗斯植物学家 Carl Maximowicz。异名为 Acer nikoense。 Acer micranthum（Small-flowered maple）是蛇皮枫类中外观较为秀雅的种类之一，也是其中较小型的一类，但并不脆弱，反而耐寒且适应性强。叶和新梢在春季初展时呈鲜红色，与大量花序形成良好对比。小巧秀致的 5 裂叶具尾状尖端，随后转绿；秋季经历橙、红等多种色调变化，最终成为火焰般的红色。裂片长卵形，具细长尖端，边缘强烈锯齿，中间主裂片最大。细小花朵成串下垂悬挂于叶间，后发育为一串串小而迷人的红晕果实。该种可形成高大灌木或小乔木，高达 37 英尺（11 米）。原产日本，生于中上山坡森林中的开阔向阳地带，海拔 2310-7590 英尺（700-2300 米）。其种名意为“小花”。 Acer miyabei（miyabei maple）为中型至大型健壮乔木，高可达 50-82 英尺（15-25 米），形成宽广树冠。5 裂叶与欧洲三角枫 Acer campestre 相似但更大，两者亲缘关系密切。裂片分开约达叶基一半，形状为长方卵形，先端渐尖、钝尖或圆钝，边缘具不规则浅裂齿。叶柄含乳汁。幼叶两面密被短毛，夏季转为无光泽的橄榄绿色。秋色为金凤花般的黄色。原产日本，分布于本州中北部沿溪流两侧的湿润林地。种加词纪念日本植物学家宫部金吾。 Acer morifolium（Yaku maple）为小型蛇皮枫，可长至 39-49 英尺（12-15 米）高，与 Acer capillipes 关系密切。中等大小的叶具 3-5 枚卵状三角形裂片，裂片具尾状尖端、强锯齿边缘，中央裂片最为显著。新叶呈有光泽的青铜绿色，夏季转为中绿至深绿色并略具光泽，秋季则转为黄色至金黄色，并带红晕。其种名意为“叶似 Morus”，即桑属。 Acer pictum（Painted maple）是一个耐寒且变异很大的种，也常以 Acer mono 之名出现。其生长迅速，为中型至大型乔木，树冠圆整开展，高可达 33-46 英尺（10-14 米）。在多年生植物或灌木群落配置中，是优良的上层遮荫树种。该种分布广泛，自中国中部、东北及满洲，至东西伯利亚、朝鲜，并遍及日本。中等大小的叶通常 5-7 裂，裂深较浅，仅达叶基的四分之一至三分之一。裂片短而宽，为三角状卵形，具尾状锐尖；叶缘无齿。绿色长叶柄含乳汁。叶片春夏季为鲜绿至无光泽绿色，秋季转为鲜艳的金黄色并染有深红色。

care.cultivation: 宜种植于湿润但排水良好的土壤中。夏季如有需要应浇水。叶色在半阴环境下表现最佳，但也可耐全日照。土壤水分不足或暴露过度都可能导致叶片焦枯。

rhs_zh.description: 大型丛生落叶灌木或小乔木，叶片大而近圆形，具 9 至 11 裂，秋季转为紫色、深红色和橙色。花红色，成簇着生于枝条下方。

descriptions.preferred: This cultivar has small, palmate, seven-lobed leaves. The two basal lobes are quite small. The leaf tends to cup upward from the petiole. The leaves vary from 3.5 to 5 cm long and from 4 to 6 cm wide, with thin 2-cm long petioles. Each lobe is triangular-ovate, terminating in a narrow point. The margins have light prominent teeth. The leaf color in the spring is a bright yellow green. The tone is variable but not markedly so. The foliage darkens somewhat during the summer and withstands full sun very well. The fall colors are quite brilliant and range from yellow into rusty rose and on to crimson. The twig color becomes a rusty red. 'Volubile' is very similar to 'Aoyagi' in leaf shape, size, Japanese names, such as 'Aoba fue', 'Aoba fuke', 'Aobano-fue', and 'Aoba-no-fuye'.

rhs.description: A delicately upright, deciduous tree about 6m tall at maturity, with small, palmate, 7-lobed leaves to 6cm wide with prominently toothed margins, the leaves bright yellow-green in spring, darkening in summer then brilliant yellow, rust red and crimson in autumn

attributes.suggested_uses: City/Courtyard Gardens, Cottage/Informal Garden
attributes.hort_group_description: Acers in this palmatum group have small, palm-shaped leaves with coarsely-toothed edges

care.cultivation: Grow in any moisture-retentive, well-drained soil in a sheltered position. Leaf colour is best in partial shade, although full sun can be tolerated if soil is reliably moist. Leaf scorch can be caused by lack of soil moisture or excessive exposure. See Japanese maples cultivation
care.pruning: Pruning group 1 , only from late autumn to mid-winter
care.propagation: Propagate by softwood cuttings, layering or by grafting . Plants grown from seed are unlikely to come true, but may still be garden worthy

resistance.pest: May be susceptible to aphids and scale insects , including horse chestnut scale
resistance.disease: May be susceptible to Verticillium wilt , Acer leaf scorch and honey fungus

attributes.hort_group_description: 本 palmatum 组的槭树叶片较小，呈掌状，边缘具粗锯齿。

care.cultivation: 宜栽于保水且排水良好的土壤中，并选择避风位置。半阴环境下叶色表现最佳；若土壤湿度稳定，也可耐全日照。土壤缺水或暴露过度都可能导致叶片焦边。参见 Japanese maples cultivation。
care.pruning: 修剪组 1，仅限晚秋至仲冬期间修剪。
care.propagation: 可通过嫩枝扦插、压条或嫁接繁殖。实生苗通常难以保持品种性状，但仍可能具有园艺观赏价值。

rhs_zh.description: 一株姿态轻盈、直立生长的落叶乔木，成熟时高约 6 米。叶片较小，掌状七裂，宽可达 6 厘米，叶缘具明显锯齿；春季叶色鲜黄绿色，夏季加深，秋季则转为亮黄色、锈红色和绯红色。

descriptions_zh.preferred: 该品种具小型掌状七裂叶，基部两裂较小。叶片自叶柄处略向上杯状弯曲。叶长 3.5-5 厘米，宽 4-6 厘米，叶柄细，长约 2 厘米。每个裂片为三角状卵形，先端渐尖。叶缘具较浅但明显的锯齿。春季叶色为鲜黄绿色，色调虽有变化，但差异并不十分显著。夏季叶色略微加深，且非常耐全日照。秋色相当鲜艳，可由黄色转为锈玫瑰色，再至绯红色。枝条也会转为锈红色。‘Volubile’ 在叶形、大小以及日文名称上与 ‘Aoyagi’ 十分相似，如 ‘Aoba fue’、‘Aoba fuke’、‘Aobano-fue’ 和 ‘Aoba-no-fuye’。

descriptions.preferred: These very unusual leaves have three or five lobes, each a slightly different shape. When the leaf is three lobed, the two rudimentary lobes remain only as tiny spurs at the leaf base. The leaves vary from 3 to 5 cm long and wide. The lobes, separated almost to the leaf base, are shallowly or deeply toothed. These lobes are smooth or serrated, flat or twisted, slender or broad, short or elongate, or any combination of these. The pattern varies from one side of the lobe to the other, as well as between lobes and leaves. The total effect is a pleasing tattered appearance. The petioles are 1-1.5 cm long. The basic color is green. However, the margins are strongly edged with rose or rusty red, especially on new ago as 1710. The name 'Wabito' means "lonely person" and has been spelled 'Wabibito' in the past.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这种叶片极为不同寻常，具 3 裂或 5 裂，各裂片形状略有差异。当叶为 3 裂时，其余两个退化裂片仅表现为叶基部的小突起。叶片长宽均为 3-5 厘米。裂片彼此分离几乎达叶基，边缘可为浅齿或深齿。这些裂片可以是平滑或具锯齿、平展或扭曲、狭长或宽阔、短或延长，或兼具上述多种特征。同一裂片两侧的形态就可能不同，不同裂片及不同叶片之间的差异也很明显，整体呈现出一种悦目的破碎感。叶柄长 1-1.5 厘米。基本叶色为绿色，但叶缘强烈镶有玫瑰色或锈红色，尤以新叶最为明显。该品种早在 1710 年前后即有记载。名称 'Wabito' 意为“孤独的人”，过去也曾拼作 'Wabibito'。

The lobes radiate outward, but the 3-cm middle lobes appear longer. The margins are lightly serrated. The red petioles are 4 cm long. The foliage has a yellow-green cast. The white variegation may consist of a few flecks to entire portions of Archives, Corvallis Archives, Corvallis ous, upright, medium-sized tree forms a tall roundtopped plant, probably reaching well over 7 m after 25 years.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 在早期文献中找不到对此品种的描述。其叶片属于 Palmatum Group，具 5 或 7 裂。叶长 5 至 6 厘米，宽 5 至 7 厘米，裂片分离程度接近叶基的四分之三。每个裂片均为长椭圆形，末端具细长而明显的尖尾。裂片向外辐射展开，其中中间的裂片长约 3 厘米，显得更长。叶缘具浅锯齿。红色叶柄长 4 厘米。叶色带黄绿色调。白色斑纹可能仅为少量斑点，也可能扩展至叶片的大块区域。该品种植株生长直立，为中等大小乔木，树形高大而圆顶，推测栽培 25 年后高度可远超 7 米。

descriptions.preferred: This large-leaved deeply divided cultivar has greenish leaves which are pink flushed in the spring, becoming greenish bronzed with pink dots and blotched variegation. However, like many maple variegates, the richer the growing conditions, the less the variegation until it disappears altogether. A curious feature of 'Wakehurst Pink' is that, sometimes, on fully developed leaves, the outer lobes are deeply divided to within 5 mm of the leaf base whereas, with the central lobe, the lobe junctions are 1.5-2 cm from the leaf base. The large-lobed leaves are 8.5-9.5 cm long and 10.5- 12 cm wide. They are long-ovate with tail-like pointed tips, and regular sharp-pointed hooked teeth around the margins. The basal lobes tend to spread at right angles to the petioles. The purple-red petioles are 3-4.5 cm long with swollen bases. The upright growth habit is similar to that of 'Nicholsonii', forming an open-branched tree growing up to 4 m tall and nearly as wide in 15 years. The original plant is growing at Wakehurst Place Gardens in Sussex, England, and was noticed by D. M. van Gelderen and named and the green Dissectum Group but otherwise typical. They range from 7 to 12 cm long and from 8 to 12 cm wide. The lobes hold together closely and have a cascading tendency. There are seven or nine multidissected lobes, with each lobe narrowly pinnatifid and re-incised. The distinguishing feature of this cultivar is that the leaves have a longer, more flowing appearance as they cascade down the outside of the mature plants. The petioles range from 3 to 4 cm long. The foliage is a good, bright green which is retained well all season. The plant stands full sun very well. The fall colors are brilliant gold tones suffused with crimson blends. The branch development is strong and sturdy. Branches on top of the plant slowly add height to the cultivar as it matures. However, young plants should be staked or grafted quite high to attain height. The side branches cascade strongly. This cultivar is hardy and beautiful. The original plant at the Willowwood Arboretum, Gladstone, New Jersey, was 3 m high and 4 m wide in the mid-1970s. Benjamin Blackburn (pers. comm.) discussed the origin of this plant, which was a selected seedling named by Henry Hohman in the 1920s. The beautiful cascading character gave this maple value as a separate cultivar. It has been known under the name 'Dissectum Waterfall'. Corvallis surfaces become a bronze red, while the undersurfaces are suffused with green. The fall color is a vivid scarlet. Each fiveor seven-lobed large leaf is up to 9-10 cm long and 10-12 cm wide, and has a heart-shaped to straight base. The lobes are ovate with tail-like tips, divided two-thirds to three-quarters of the way to the leaf base, 6-7 cm long and 1.5-2 cm wide at the broadest point in the middle. The lobes narrow slightly to 1-1.5 cm at the lobe junctions. The margins are coarsely double toothed on young leaves, becoming more regular and even as the leaf develops fully. The strong, dark red petiole is 2.5-4.5 cm long and has a swollen base. 'Whitney Red' is vigorous with a similar growth habit to that of 'Bloodgood', becoming 6-8 m tall as it matures. An American discovery, it was found as a chance seedling at Whitney Gardens, Brinnon, Washington.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这一大叶、深裂的栽培品种，春季叶片为带粉色晕染的绿色，随后转为带古铜感的绿叶，并带有粉色点斑和不规则锦斑。不过，与许多斑叶槭树一样，栽培条件越肥沃，斑纹越不明显，直至完全消失。'Wakehurst Pink' 的一个有趣特征是：有时在完全展开的叶片上，外侧裂片会深裂至距叶基仅 5 毫米处，而中央裂片的裂片连接处则距叶基 1.5 至 2 厘米。大裂片叶长 8.5 至 9.5 厘米，宽 10.5 至 12 厘米。裂片为长卵形，先端具尾状尖头，叶缘具规则的锐尖钩状锯齿。基部裂片常近直角伸向叶柄两侧。紫红色叶柄长 3 至 4.5 厘米，基部膨大。其直立生长习性与 'Nicholsonii' 相似，15 年可形成开张疏枝的小乔木，高约 4 米，冠幅近似。原株生长于英国 Sussex 的 Wakehurst Place Gardens，由 D. M. van Gelderen 注意到并命名。另有一类与绿色 Dissectum Group 相近、但又具有自身特点的材料：叶长 7 至 12 厘米，宽 8 至 12 厘米，裂片紧密相连并具下垂瀑布状姿态。叶片具 7 或 9 个多重深裂裂片，每个裂片又呈狭窄羽状深裂并再次细裂。其显著特征是成熟植株外围下垂叶片显得更修长、更流畅。叶柄长 3 至 4 厘米。叶色鲜亮翠绿，整个生长季保持良好；植株对全日照耐受性较好。秋色为明亮金色，并晕染深红色调。枝条发育强健，顶部枝条会随成熟逐渐增加株高，但幼株需支撑或高位嫁接才能获得更高树形，侧枝则强烈下垂。该品种既耐寒又美观。位于美国新泽西州 Gladstone 的 Willowwood Arboretum 的原株在 20 世纪 70 年代中期高 3 米、宽 4 米。Benjamin Blackburn（私人通讯）曾讨论该植株的来源，认为其为 Henry Hohman 于 1920 年代命名的一株实生选育后代；其优美的瀑布状姿态使之值得作为独立品种。它也曾以 'Dissectum Waterfall' 之名流通。另有材料其叶片上表面转为古铜红色，下表面仍带绿色，秋色鲜猩红。每片大叶具 5 或 7 裂，长可达 9 至 10 厘米，宽 10 至 12 厘米，叶基心形至平截。裂片卵形，具尾状尖端，分裂深度达叶基的三分之二至四分之三；裂片长 6 至 7 厘米，在中部最宽处宽 1.5 至 2 厘米，在裂片连接处略收窄至 1 至 1.5 厘米。幼叶叶缘具粗大的重锯齿，成熟后变得更规则均匀。强健的深红色叶柄长 2.5 至 4.5 厘米，基部膨大。'Whitney Red' 生长旺盛，树形与 'Bloodgood' 相近，成熟后高可达 6 至 8 米。该品种发现于美国华盛顿州 Brinnon 的 Whitney Gardens，为偶然出现的实生苗。

care.cultivation: Grow in any moisture-retentive, well-drained soil in a sheltered position. Leaf colour is best in partial shade, although full sun can be tolerated if soil is reliably moist. Leaf scorch can be caused by lack of soil moisture or excessive exposure. See Japanese maples cultivation
care.pruning: Pruning group 1 , only from late autumn to mid-winter
care.propagation: Propagate by softwood cuttings, layering or by grafting . Plants grown from seed are unlikely to come true, but may still be garden worthy

products.description_text: The leaf of 'Washi-no-o’ is a little more coarse than some dissectums and the margins of each lobe are cut more regularly and less deep than most dissectums giving it a very unique texture. This mounding shrub type maple tolerates more sun than most green lace leafs. I have even grown this cultivar in full sun in Atlanta, Georgia but some shade would be appreciated. descriptions.preferred: The leaves are slightly larger than those of most dissectums, but otherwise typical. products.title: Acer palmatum 'Waterfall' Japanese Maple
products.description_text: Acer palmatum dissectum 'Waterfall' Weeping Green Laceleaf Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 'Waterfall' is a great weeping green laceleaf Japanese maple with a show in the fall. This Japanese maple tree is very heat tolerant and can grow in either sun or shade conditions. 'Waterfall' has very pendulous and its cascading look that gives it its name. The leaf is slightly larger than many other green dissectums. This tree can grow slightly wider than it does tall reaching 5 ft in height by 6 ft in width in 10 years. The ‘Waterfall’ Japanese maple makes an excellent large potted patio tree but can also be used as specimen plant in any landscape. The spring color is a bright almost neon green and the fall color ranges from yellow to gold. After years of observation, we believe ‘Waterfall’ and ‘Viridis’ to now be the exact same cultivar in the nursery trade today. The original ‘Waterfall’ was likely a ‘Viridis’ that happened to be at waterfall at a state park in New Jersey. We still sell both cultivars as both are popular names people know this selection by. **10 GALLON TREE SHIPS WITHOUT POT DUE TO BOX SIZE CONSTRAINTS** Please note that your 10-gallon tree will arrive without a container. It ships immediately unless you request to hold. Be prepared for your 10 gallon tree without a container. Limited Quantities Available !! descriptions.preferred: The medium-sized leaves of this attractive New Jersey laceleaf have the coloring of the better-known red 'Baldsmith' and the finely cut lacy texture of the green 'Chantilly Lace'. New leaves are bright red, becoming salmon-pink before changing to pink-red over green for the summer. Fall colors are brilliant orange to scarlet. New red leaves are produced all summer and make an attractive contrast to the pink-green background of older leaves. The changing colors Acer are more striking in full sun. 'Watnong' forms a Gelderen. Acer palmatum

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这是一株生长旺盛的乔木，叶片中度至深裂，以浓烈的叶色著称。大型 5 至 7 裂叶萌发时为深紫红色，并具红色叶脉，颜色可良好保持至夏末，随后转为古铜红，秋季为鲜猩红色。卵形裂片具尾状尖端，深裂至平截叶基，叶缘具均匀锯齿，强健叶柄颜色较深。'Whitney Red' 生长势强，树形与 'Bloodgood' 相似，成熟后高 20 至 26 英尺（6 至 8 米），得名于美国华盛顿州 Brinnon 的 Whitney Gardens，原株即发现于此。'Wilson's Pink Dwarf' 属 Dwarf Group，绿色系。其叶片极小，通常具 5 个狭长裂片，边缘有齿，春季色彩极为丰富，整株呈明亮浅粉色或粉红偏红色，在景观中非常醒目，可持续数周。夏季叶片转为明亮浅绿色，边缘带粉色至锈红色。这一迷人的矮生直立灌木生长良好，长势旺盛，由加州苗圃人 James Wilson 选育命名。'Coral Pink' 与 'Wilson's Pink Dwarf' 相似，粉色远较 'Corallinum' 更浅、更柔和，即使在很小的花园中也值得栽植，但更适合略有遮阴的位置。'Winter Flame' 属 Palmatum Group，绿色系。它是 'Sango kaku' 的半矮生、紧凑丛生型，冬枝呈鲜珊瑚红，叶片分裂更深。小至中等大小的叶片具 7 裂，其中中间 3 个裂片为卵状三角形，具楔形尾状尖端；小而清晰的基部裂片向后及向外伸展；细长叶柄为红色。春叶为柔和的浅黄绿色，与亮粉红至红色的新枝形成优美对比；夏季叶色转浅绿，秋季变为黄色、橙色、红色及浅深红色。'Winter Flame' 高不超过 10 英尺（3 米），全年都有观赏点，非常适合小型庭园。另有 'nishiki' 绿色系品种，其叶片深裂为 5 至 7 个明显分离的裂片，每个裂片狭长卵形，几乎裂至基部，先端细长，叶缘深齿裂。新叶鲜绿近黄绿色，边缘强烈染有玫瑰色至锈红色；夏季转浅绿色，在高温下仅轻微灼色；秋色鲜深红。其植株直立偏柱形，高约 13 英尺（4 米）。'Yasemin' 属 Matsumurae Group，红叶系，是一个极为出色的品种，具大而深裂、富光泽的深紫红色叶片及红色果实。叶色可保持至夏季，随后转为带古铜感的绿色。叶片分为 7 至 9 个长卵形裂片，展开较宽，几近成圆；先端尖锐，叶缘具粗大锯齿。裂片边缘略向下弯，但不及 'Trompenburg' 明显。与 'Trompenburg' 相比，'Yasemin' 叶色更深，裂片稍更平展、更宽，齿更大。其生长势强，为直立乔木，高可达 33 英尺（10 米），由苗圃人 D. M. van Gelderen 以其孙女 Mirte Yasemin 之名命名。另有 'Yu¯bae' 红叶系品种，春色为浓艳鲜红，夏季色泽加深并转为红古铜色，秋季呈惊艳的深红与猩红。中等大小的 7 裂叶分裂至平截叶基的一半，裂片为渐尖卵形，叶缘细密而均匀，红色叶柄细长。该品种树形直立开展，成熟后高 20 至 23 英尺（6 至 7 米），宽约 13 英尺（4 米），耐寒且枝干健壮。另有 'Yu¯bae' 斑叶型，为高生长型，叶片偶见斑锦，大叶具深裂的卵形裂片。

products.description_text: Acer palmatum 'Whitney Red' Red Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 'Whitney Red' is an upright Japanese maple with a full amoenum leaf that is a good grower with good vivid red fall color. Some online tout its cold resistance in rough years, while others tout is vigor and medium-sized stature. 'Whitney Red'was found as red Japanese maple seedling that was growing at Whitney Gardens in Brinnon, Washington. It held its color well throughout the season, but was selected because it held its leaves later into the season than other red upright Japanese maples, like Bloodgood. While this selection 'Whitney Red' may reach 10 ft in 15 ft years.

descriptions.preferred: Acer palmatum 'Wildfire' Rare Wildfire Coral Bark Winter Interest Japanese Maple Zones 6-9 Perhaps one of the most aptly named maples, 'Wild Fire' is sure to light up the garden. It has small chartreuse green leaves which turn to bright golden yellows to orange in the fall. The real interest in this tree lies in its 'winter interest'. The bark on 'Wild Fire' is noted for having two primary tones. Toward the base of the tree, the bark is bright golden yellow to golden orange. The golden yellows infuse into orange which infuse to colors of bright fiery red on the outer branches. The tree is a spectrum of color of yellows to reds. 'Wild Fire' is a brand new selection that is projected to reach 15 ft in 20 years. 'Wild Fire' was found by one of our good friends, Jason Stevens. Limited Quantities Available !! As we have over a thousand cultivars of Japanese maples, we often do not have many of each cultivar. We recommend that you buy the Japanese maples you want immediately as we often sell out of certain selections.

descriptions_zh.preferred: Acer palmatum 'Wildfire' 稀有珊瑚皮冬季观赏日本枫，适生分区 6-9。'Wild Fire' 或许是名字最贴切的枫树品种之一，足以点亮整个花园。它具有较小的黄绿色叶片，秋季转为明亮的金黄色至橙色。这株树真正的观赏重点在于其“冬季观赏性”。'Wild Fire' 的树皮以具有两种主要色调而著称：靠近树干基部的树皮呈明亮的金黄色至金橙色，而这些金黄色逐渐过渡为橙色，再向外层枝条发展成鲜艳炽烈的红色。整株树在冬季呈现出由黄色到红色的色谱层次。'Wild Fire' 是一个全新选育品种，预计 20 年可达 15 英尺高。'Wild Fire' 由我们的好友之一 Jason Stevens 发现。数量有限。由于我们拥有上千个日本枫品种，单个品种通常库存不多；部分选育品种常会很快售罄，建议尽早购买心仪品种。

descriptions.preferred: This red linearilobum is similar to 'Red Pygmy' in leaf shape and color, growth rate, and habit. The leaf lobes are slightly shorter and the shoots sturdier. The young leaves are bright orange red, soon becoming a deep purple red, a color which lasts well throughout the summer. The five-lobed straplike leaves are 7-9 cm long and 9-11 cm wide. Each lobe is linear to long-ovate, 5 mm wide, with long tapering tips. The margins are sparsely and small tree up to 3 m high, with graceful semipendulous branches and foliage. 'Wilson's Pink Dwarf' dwarf -green This delightful, upright shrub has tiny leaves which are verycolorfulinthespring.Theyareusuallyfivelobedand a bright, light green tone. This is the summer color and the base color of the older foliage. In early spring, however, the entire plant is a light, bright pinkish or pink-red color.Itisbrilliant,quitenoticeableinthelandscape,and this color phase lasts for several weeks. As the summer season advances, the base green leaf color increases with the pink to rusty red tones continuing. Under some growth conditions, there is even some mottling. The new foliage is rather small, 1.5-2.5 cm long and This fine shrub always attracts attention in the spring. It grows well, is vigorous but not rank, and can develop twigginess. It is a welcome addition to the Dwarf Group and was first selected as a seedling by James Wilson of Peters and Wilson Nursery, Millbrae, California.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这一红叶 linearilobum 品种在叶形与叶色、生长速度及株形方面都与 'Red Pygmy' 相似，但其裂片稍短，枝条更为健壮。幼叶鲜橙红色，很快转为深紫红色，并且整个夏季都能较好保持。5 裂带状叶长 7 至 9 厘米，宽 9 至 11 厘米；每个裂片为线形至长卵形，宽约 5 毫米，先端渐尖而细长。叶缘具稀疏锯齿。植株为小乔木，高可达 3 米，枝条与叶片姿态优雅，呈半下垂状。'Wilson's Pink Dwarf' 属矮生绿色系。该品种为迷人的直立灌木，叶片极小，春季色彩十分丰富，通常具 5 裂，夏季基色为明亮浅绿色，这也是老叶的基本颜色。但在早春，整株会呈现浅而鲜亮的粉色或粉红偏红色，极其醒目，这一色相可持续数周。随着夏季推进，绿色底色逐渐增强，同时仍保留粉色至锈红色调；在某些栽培条件下，甚至会出现少量斑驳。新叶较小，长 1.5 至 2.5 厘米。此优美灌木在春季总能吸引注意，生长良好，势头旺但不过分徒长，枝条可发展得较为细密。它是 Dwarf Group 中很受欢迎的补充，最初由加州 Millbrae 的 Peters and Wilson Nursery 的 James Wilson 自实生苗中选出。

descriptions.preferred: This outstanding New Zealand cultivar was introduced by Duncan and Davies Nursery of New Zealand, and is a dwarf, compact bushy form of 'Sango kaku', but with more deeply divided leaves. It has small to medium-sized seven-lobed deeply divided leaves which are 4.5-6.5 cm long and wide. The three middle lobes are ovate-triangular with tail-like pointed tips, 10-15 mm wide at the broadest point in the lower third, narrowing to 3-4 mm at the lobe junctions which are within 5 mm of the leaf base. The small but distinct basal lobes are angled backward and outward. The slender red petioles are 1.5-3.5 cm long. 'Winter Flame', like 'Sango kaku', has lovely soft limegreen spring foliage contrasting beautifully with the pink red shoots. The leaves become light green through the summer, turning an attractive yellow-orange-redmottled color in the fall and becoming a light crimson red. It has the same bright coral-red winter shoots as 'Sango kaku', but differs in remaining compact and bushy, reaching no more than 3 m at maturity. This cultivar is an ideal semidwarf compact maple for the small garden with colorful features year-round.

rhs.description: A rounded, deciduous, small to medium-sized tree or shrub to around 3m tall with coral-red young shoots. Its 5-lobed leaves emerge a lime green in spring, darkening to a mid-green in summer before turning shades of yellow and orange in the autumn. Small red flowers in spring are followed by winged red fruits

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这一出色的新西兰品种由新西兰 Duncan and Davies Nursery 引入，是 'Sango kaku' 的矮生、紧凑、丛生型，但叶片分裂更深。其叶片小至中等大小，具 7 个深裂裂片，长宽均为 4.5 至 6.5 厘米。中间 3 个裂片为卵状三角形，具尾状尖端，在下部三分之一最宽处宽 10 至 15 毫米，于裂片连接处收窄至 3 至 4 毫米，而该连接处距叶基不足 5 毫米。基部裂片虽小但清晰可辨，向后并向外伸展。细长红色叶柄长 1.5 至 3.5 厘米。'Winter Flame' 与 'Sango kaku' 一样，春叶为柔和的浅黄绿色，与粉红至红色新枝形成优美对比；夏季叶色转浅绿，秋季变为黄、橙、红混杂的斑驳色，最终呈浅深红色。它与 'Sango kaku' 一样具有鲜亮的珊瑚红冬枝，但不同之处在于其株形保持紧凑丛生，成熟后高度不超过 3 米。该品种是一种理想的半矮生紧凑型鸡爪槭，适合小型庭园，全年均具观赏性。

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这一值得关注的树木品种以其有趣的新梢著称。夏季新梢为黄绿色，冬季则转为金黄色，极易吸引视线。叶片总体上仍具该种的典型特征，但成株略偏小。该品种若种植在红枝的 Acer palmatum 'Sango kaku' 附近，观赏效果尤为出色。Acer shirasawanum 作为园林树种颇具价值，其叶片的质感与色彩整体效果使其成为灌木丛植中的理想搭配树种。其叶质不同于近缘种，手感如坚挺、薄而近乎半透明的纸张。尽管外观轻薄，叶片耐日晒性却优于大多数槭树。浅色幼叶表面覆有柔毛，随后变得平滑无毛，呈浅黄绿色。秋色为金黄并夹带深红色调。小型近圆形叶片具 9 至 13 个短卵形裂片，裂深仅达叶基的约三分之一。由于沿多条主脉有轻微“褶皱”，叶片略呈碟状。卵形裂片先端短尖，叶缘具明显锯齿。新梢鲜绿色，有时带灰白色粉被。枝条较纤细，栽培条件下成熟树通常不超过 33 英尺（10 米）。本种原产日本中部和南部，生长于海拔 2310 至 5940 英尺（700 至 1800 米）的湿润、排水良好的山谷坡地。种加词是为纪念日本植物学家 Homi Shirasawa。

descriptions.preferred: Acer palmatum 'Winter Orange' Rare Winter Orange Coral Bark Winter Interest Japanese Maple Zones 6-9 'Winter Orange' is a new selection of winter interest Japanese maple that displays bright orange bark during the winter. The small green leaves on 'Winter Orange' turn bright yellow to orange in the fall. 'Winter Orange' is a vigorous grower, putting on quite a bit of growth at an early age. 'Winter Orange' may reach 12-14 ft in 10 years. 'Winter Orange' is a selection from Canada and is rumored to be extremely cold tolerant, as many claim that it was selected from a much colder zone, where many Japanese maples, especially coral bark Japanese maples, would not typically grow. Give 'Winter Orange' protection from the hot afternoon sun, with some morning sunlight to peak the intensity of the color of the orange bark.

descriptions_zh.preferred: Acer palmatum 'Winter Orange' 稀有冬季橙色珊瑚皮日本枫，冬季观赏型，适生区 6-9。'Winter Orange' 是一款较新的冬季观赏型日本枫选育品种，冬季树皮呈鲜亮橙色。其小型绿色叶片在秋季转为明亮的黄色至橙色。'Winter Orange' 生长势强，幼年期生长量较大。10 年内可长至 12-14 英尺。'Winter Orange' 为加拿大选育品种，据称极耐寒，很多人认为它选自更寒冷的地区，而多数日本枫，尤其是珊瑚皮类日本枫，通常难以在那样的区域生长。在炎热地区，建议避开午后烈日，并给予一定的晨光，以增强橙色树皮的显色效果。

descriptions.preferred: The interesting leaves of this cultivar are deeply divided into (five or) seven lobes which are widely separated. The leaves measure 4-6 cm long and 5-6 cm wide. Each lobe is elongate-ovate and separated almost entirely to the center. The leaf base is cuneate. The lobes taper from the center to a long, sharp terminal. The margins are deeply toothed, almost pinnatifid, with light serrations on the larger teeth. The thin reddish petioles are 2 cm long. The new leaves are a bright, almost yellow, green. The edges are strongly tinted with bright rose to rusty red which shades into the leaf. The center of the lobes usu- This upright-growing plant reaches about 4 m high at maturity and tends to be fastigiate, producing many small branches and twigs. It has also been known under the alternative translations 'Nou nishiki' and 'O nishiki'.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 该品种的叶片极具特色，深裂为5裂（或7裂），各裂片之间分离较宽。叶片长4-6厘米、宽5-6厘米。每个裂片为长卵形，几乎一直分裂到叶片中央。叶基楔形。裂片自中部渐尖，末端形成细长锐尖。叶缘深齿裂，近似羽状深裂，较大的齿上还具浅锯齿。细而带红色的叶柄长约2厘米。新叶呈明亮、近黄色的绿色，叶缘强烈染有鲜玫瑰色至锈红色，并向叶面内侧晕染。该植株生长直立，成熟时高约4米，常呈狭柱形，能形成许多细小分枝与小枝。它也曾以其他译名 'Nou nishiki' 和 'O nishiki' 为人所知。

descriptions.preferred: 山锦是一种漂亮的 白绿相间的 悬浮脉斑品种 ，白绿色的纹理呈现出雪峰般的外观，这就是山锦这个名字的由来。令人惊喜的是，树龄越长，白色的锦叶占比最大。春天首先出来的新叶是粉色带有绿色的脉纹，叶形褶皱状，看起来像一个蜘蛛，逐渐粉色就会褪白，白色占比宽阔， 明亮的白色和绿色的纹理给人一种山峰上积雪的感觉 ， 秋天的颜色从橙色到红色。成年树高可达 2-3 m 。

descriptions_zh.preferred: 山锦是一种漂亮的 白绿相间的 悬浮脉斑品种 ，白绿色的纹理呈现出雪峰般的外观，这就是山锦这个名字的由来。令人惊喜的是，树龄越长，白色的锦叶占比最大。春天首先出来的新叶是粉色带有绿色的脉纹，叶形褶皱状，看起来像一个蜘蛛，逐渐粉色就会褪白，白色占比宽阔， 明亮的白色和绿色的纹理给人一种山峰上积雪的感觉 ， 秋天的颜色从橙色到红色。成年树高可达 2-3 m 。

descriptions.preferred: This outstanding cultivar from Firma C. Esveld, Boskoop, Netherlands, has large, deeply cut, shiny, red leaves and, like the similar 'Trompenburg', is thought to be a cross between Acer palmatum and A. shirasawanum. It has very attractive deep red foliage and red fruits. The leaves are a darker color and have slightly flatter and wider lobes with larger teeth than those of 'Trompenburg'. The leaves hold their color well into the summer, slowly becoming a bronze green on the upper surface. The lower surface turns a gray green with light purple bronzing toward the tips in late summer. The bark of the older shoots is a contrasting green. The sevenor nine-lobed leaves are 9-10 cm long and 8-9 cm wide, with lobes well spread out to produce almost circular leaves. The lobes are long-ovate with sharply pointed tips; the width of the broadest point of the lobe in the outer third is about one-third of the lobe length. The lobes are divided to within 5-10 mm of the leaf base. There are large, coarse saw-teeth on the mar- Corvallis high. It originated as a chance seedling in a batch of seedlings, and was noticed by Cor van Gelderen at Firma C. Esveld and named after his daughter Mirte Yasemin. Interestingly, the original plant seems to display the influence of several nearby trees—the color of 'Bloodgood', the habit of 'Trompenburg', and the leaf shape of Acer japonicum 'Aconitifolium'.

sources.title: 叶诗敏 Acer Shirasawawanum 'Yasemin'
sources.description: 由荷兰 Firma C. Esveld 苗圃的苗圃主 Cor Van Geldern 在 偶然的机会下发现的，以苗圃主女儿的字 Mirte Yasemin 命名 . 叶诗敏是血红鸡爪槭血红和 Acer Shirasawanum 白 泽槭的杂交，和 Acer Shirasawanum 'Gloria' - 歌莉娅非 常相似，叶诗敏有血红的叶色，龙爪的生长习性和白泽 槭的叶型。叶诗敏春季新叶为樱桃红色，并有白色绒毛， 夏季变为棕绿色，秋天为紫红色，叶裂较深，生长快速， 并具有非常好的耐寒耐热性，成年树可达 4 米左右高度。

rhs.description: A vigorous, upright-growing tree, up to 10m high, with large, deeply divided, shiny, seven-lobed or nine-lobed leaves, coarsely toothed on the outer half, the young leaves emerging dark red in spring, slowly ageing to bronze-green above and grey-green by late summer, and turning orange-red in autumn, and tiny, purple-red flowers in small, pendent corymbs in spring followed by red-winged fruit in late summer

attributes.suggested_uses: Hedging/Screens, Low Maintenance, Banks and Slopes, City/Courtyard Gardens, Cottage/Informal Garden, Flower borders and beds
attributes.hort_group_description: Acers in this matsumurae group are deeply divided to around three quarters of the leaf with coarsely-toothed edges and narrow, pointed lobes

care.cultivation: Grow in a place sheltered from cold drying winds and from late frosts, in full sun where its colours will develop best or in light dappled shade, in moist but well-drained neutral or acidic soil that does not dry out in summer or become waterlogged in winter, and protect roots with an open-textured organic mulch such as coarse bark; for more advice, see Japanese maple cultivation
care.pruning: Pruning group 1 (little or no pruning of trees and shrubs) and prune if necessary only from late autumn to midwinter
care.propagation: Propagate by grafting in late winter, or by budding in summer; semi-ripe cuttings, hardwood cuttings, or layering may also be successful

resistance.pest: May be susceptible to Acer gall mite, aphids , caterpillars and horse chestnut scale
resistance.disease: May be susceptible to Verticillium wilt , Acer leaf scorch and honey fungus

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这一出色的品种来自荷兰 Boskoop 的 Firma C. Esveld，具大型、深裂、富光泽的红叶，并与相似的 'Trompenburg' 一样，被认为是 Acer palmatum 与 A. shirasawanum 的杂交后代。其深红色叶片和红色果实极具观赏性。与 'Trompenburg' 相比，本品种叶色更深，裂片稍更平展且更宽，锯齿也更大。叶色可较好保持至夏季，叶片上表面随后缓慢转为带古铜感的绿色；夏末叶背则转为灰绿色，并在叶尖附近带有浅紫古铜色晕染。老枝树皮呈对比鲜明的绿色。叶片具 7 或 9 裂，长 9 至 10 厘米，宽 8 至 9 厘米，裂片展开良好，使整叶近圆形。裂片为长卵形，先端尖锐；裂片最宽处位于外侧三分之一处，其宽度约为裂片长度的三分之一。裂片分裂深度至距叶基 5 至 10 毫米处，叶缘具大而粗的锯齿。该品种生长势强，高大。它起源于一批实生苗中的偶然变异，由 Cor van Gelderen 在 Firma C. Esveld 发现，并以其女儿 Mirte Yasemin 命名。有趣的是，原株似乎同时表现出周围多株树木的影响: 具有 'Bloodgood' 的叶色、'Trompenburg' 的株形，以及 Acer japonicum 'Aconitifolium' 的叶形。

attributes.hort_group_description: 此 matsumurae 组的槭树，叶片深裂约达叶片的四分之三，叶缘具粗齿，裂片狭长且先端尖。
attributes.suggested_uses: 适合作绿篱/屏障、低维护种植、护坡与斜坡绿化、城市/庭院花园、乡村风/自然式花园，以及花境与花坛。

resistance.pest: 可能易受槭瘿螨、蚜虫、毛虫和七叶树介壳虫危害
resistance.disease: 可能易感黄萎病、槭叶焦枯病和蜜环菌病

rhs_zh.description: 生长旺盛、株形直立的乔木，高可达 10 米。叶片较大、深裂，有光泽，具七裂或九裂，外半部具粗锯齿。春季新叶萌发时为深红色，随后叶面逐渐老熟为古铜绿色，到夏末则呈灰绿色；秋季转为橙红色。春季开细小的紫红色花，成下垂的小伞房花序，晚夏结红色翅果。

care.cultivation: 宜栽植于可避开寒冷干风和晚霜的位置；全日照下叶色表现最佳，也可在疏荫环境中栽培。土壤应保持湿润但排水良好，宜中性至酸性，夏季不宜干透，冬季不可积水。根部可覆盖疏松质地的有机覆盖物，如粗树皮，以利保湿护根。更多建议参见日本枫栽培说明。
care.pruning: 修剪组 1（树木和灌木几乎不修剪或仅少量修剪）；如确有必要，仅宜在晚秋至隆冬期间进行修剪。
care.propagation: 可于冬末进行嫁接繁殖，或于夏季芽接；半成熟枝扦插、硬枝扦插或压条繁殖有时也能成功。

descriptions.preferred: Yatsubusa is a general term meaning "dwarf" in Japanese. It can be compared with the general term dissectum, embracing all the relations and cultivars of this type. Several plants have been labeled 'Yatsubusa' as a cultivar name in various collections and arboreta. They vary in size of plant, leaves, and rate of growth. Although each is truly a yatsubusa, this term should not be used as a cultivar name. There are many named yatsubusa clones which are correctly designated with cultivar status, such as 'Hime yatsubusa', 'Sekka yatsubusa', and 'Shishi yatsubusa'. The yatsubusas of Acer palmatum may be generally described as having small, palmate leaves with five or seven lobes which are short-ovate and usually separated more than halfway to the leaf base. Each lobe normally terminates in a short point, and the margins are usually distinctly serrated. The leaves measure 2-4 cm long and soon fades out into the solid green of summer. Fall colors are a mixture of yellows or reds, sometimes on the same plant. The yatsubusas all form small, compact, shrublike individuals. Some selections grow more upright, while others tend to grow laterally. All are popular for bonsai, having the dwarf character as well as the ability to produce large numbers of tiny side branches, thus making a dense plant.

descriptions_zh.preferred: Yatsubusa 在日语中是表示“矮生”的通称。它可与通称 dissectum 相比较，后者涵盖了这一类型的全部相关类群与品种。在不同收藏和树木园中，曾有若干植物被直接标注为品种名 'Yatsubusa'。这些植株在株型大小、叶片和生长速度上各有差异。尽管它们都确属 yatsubusa 类型，但这一术语不应作为正式品种名使用。已有许多具正式品种地位的 yatsubusa 命名克隆，例如 'Hime yatsubusa'、'Sekka yatsubusa' 和 'Shishi yatsubusa'。 Acer palmatum 的 yatsubusa 类型通常可概括为：叶片较小，掌状，具五裂或七裂；裂片短卵形，通常分裂超过叶基的一半。每个裂片通常终止于短尖头，叶缘通常具明显锯齿。叶片长 2-4 厘米，且春季色彩很快褪去，转为夏季的纯绿色。秋色为黄色或红色的混合，有时同一株上同时出现。所有 yatsubusa 类型都形成小型、紧凑、近灌木状的植株。有些选育品种生长较为直立，另一些则倾向于横向开展。它们都很受盆景爱好者欢迎，不仅因其矮生特性，也因其能够形成大量细小侧枝，从而构成致密株形。

descriptions.preferred: This brilliant cultivar has a rich, bright reddish purple spring color which becomes deeper as summer advances. In late summer the leaves become red bronze, but in deep shade are greenish. Fall tones are brilliant crimson and scarlet. The seven-lobed leaves are of a firm texture, measuring 5-7 cm long and up to 9 cm wide. The leaf base is roughly truncate. The lobes separate to about halfway to the leaf base. Each lobe is ovate-acuminate, with the end tapering to a sharp point. The margins are evenly and finely serrated. The red petioles are slender but not weak and 3-4 cm long. This upright, widespreading tree reaches 6-7 m high in 25 years. The young plants grow rapidly, then slow Corvallis matsumurae -variegated This tall-growing, red-leaved cultivar has occasional variegation. After observing it at Maplewood for six years, I named and registered it as 'Yub\ ae', which means "evening glow." As the original stock plant matured and young graftswereforced,itappearedtobecomelessandlessvariegated until as a 15-year-old stock plant, the variegation only occurred in small amounts on twiggy wood of older growth. The main foliage is not variegated and seems to increase year by year. Young plants, if forced with fertilizer into rapid growth, very rarely show variegation. ovate with a tapering acuminate tip. The margins are slightly and irregularly toothed. The color is a strong, bold dark red, black red, or maroon red. The more exposed to full light, the darker the tones. Leaves inside or shaded by other trees show a strong undertone of dark green. The variegation, where it occurs, consists of patches and blobs of a lighter pink red on the deeper base red. The foliage is rather pleasant and attractive, even if no variegation is present. 'Yu\bae' makes a good dependable red cultivar, but may be a disappointment if grown as a variegated plant, as the variegation cannot be relied upon. It forms a sturdy medium-sized tree reaching 5-6 m high at maturity.

rhs_zh.description: 落叶日本枫，色彩极为艳丽，初期树形直立，后期渐开展，成熟时高约6-7米。叶片7裂，裂片渐尖，先端锐尖；春季叶色鲜亮红紫，初夏颜色加深，夏末转为红铜色，秋季则呈鲜艳的深红色与猩红色。

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这是一个色彩极为出众的品种，春季叶色为浓艳明亮的红紫色，随着夏季推进颜色逐渐加深。夏末叶片转为红铜色，但在深阴环境下会偏绿。秋色则为鲜丽的深红色和猩红色。叶片通常为7裂，质地较厚实，长5-7厘米，宽可达9厘米。叶基近截形。裂片约分离至叶基的一半处。每个裂片为卵状渐尖形，先端渐尖成锐 point。叶缘细密且均匀具锯齿。红色叶柄细长但不柔弱，长3-4厘米。该树直立开展，25年可达6-7米高。幼株生长迅速，之后转缓。Corvallis matsumurae -variegated 这是一个生长较高、红叶且偶有斑锦的品种。我在 Maplewood 观察其6年后，将其命名并登记为 'Yubae'，意为“晚霞”。随着原始母株成熟，以及幼嫁接苗经促长处理后，它似乎表现出斑锦越来越少；到母株15年生时，斑锦仅偶见于老枝上较细弱的小枝部分。主体叶色并不具斑锦，而且这种无斑锦的叶片似乎逐年增加。幼株若通过施肥被促使快速生长，也极少出现斑锦。叶片为卵形，先端渐尖。叶缘略具不规则齿。叶色为浓重而醒目的深红、黑红或栗红色。光照越充足，色调越深；位于内部或被其他树木遮阴的叶片，则会显现较深绿色的底色。若出现斑锦，通常表现为较浅粉红红色的斑块或团块，分布在较深的底红色之上。即使没有斑锦，这种叶色也相当悦目且富有观赏性。'Yu\bae' 作为稳定可靠的红叶品种表现良好，但若作为斑叶植物栽培，可能会令人失望，因为其斑锦并不稳定。成熟时可形成健壮的中型树，株高约5-6米。

This cultivar can reach 20 feet over time but is slow to reach that height. 'Yezo nishiki' is an excellent tree for anyone looking to add a splash of red color to their landscape. products.description_text: Acer palmatum 'Yugure' Pink Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 'Yugure' is a well-established tree with references dating back over 200 years. This hardy tree's upright form proudly displays deeply lobed medium to large leaves that display its magnificent colors. 'Yugure's' new foliage features crimson to rusty tones with green tones surfacing into the reddish leaves in the summer. In autumn, 'Yugure' turns to a bright gold color of yellow infused with orange. 'Yugure' may reach 10-12 ft in height in 10 years. 'Yugure' is often used as a specimen tree to enhance its vibrant foliage, but it can also be integrated as part of a multi-species landscape that accentuates its beauty. descriptions.preferred: The foliage of this little cultivar, one of the dwarfest, lies closely over the shrub, due to the short annual growth leaf base. They are very narrowly elongate-ovate and terminate in a very long, tapered point. The delicate edges are finely toothed. Long, thin petioles, equal to the length of the leaf blade, allow the leaves to layer down over one another. Leaf color is a fairly strong but light green which holds well during the growing season but does not produce an outstanding fall color. This tiny shrub is difficult to propagate since the amount of annual growth is quite limited. Although it is quite small, it seems very hardy and takes full sun and exposure. When available, it is a gem for miniature landscapes, such as alpine gardens.

descriptions.preferred: 由美国马恩苗圃的苗圃主卡尔·马恩从金隐的种子培 育而来，命名并在美国注册了品种权，在注册品种权 之前卡尔在自己的苗圃中观察了 18 年之久。 月升是一个非常优秀的羽团扇品种。 2016 年获得北美年度最佳槭树称号，生长性比其他黄 叶类羽团扇更强劲，抗性（耐热）更佳，而且色彩极 其丰富。春天新叶粉红色，成熟后变成黄绿色，粉红 色的二次新稍生长，会形成鲜明的色彩对比，极具观 赏性，夏季返绿秋季为橙黄色或者深红色。生长速度 中等，在全日照下会有轻微灼伤，夏季建议午后遮阴， 成年株可达 5 米左右高度。

care.cultivation: Grow in any moisture-retentive, well-drained soil in a sheltered position. Leaf colour is best in partial shade, although full sun can be tolerated if soil is reliably moist. Leaf scorch can be caused by lack of soil moisture or excessive exposure. See Japanese maples cultivation
care.pruning: Pruning group 1 , only from late autumn to mid-winter
care.propagation: Propagate by softwood cuttings, layering or by grafting . Plants grown from seed are unlikely to come true, but may still be garden worthy

resistance.pest: May be susceptible to aphids and scale insects , including horse chestnut scale
resistance.disease: May be susceptible to Verticillium wilt , Acer leaf scorch and honey fungus

care.cultivation: 宜栽于保水且排水良好的土壤中，并选择避风位置。半阴环境下叶色表现最佳；若土壤湿度稳定，也可耐全日照。土壤缺水或暴露过度都可能导致叶片焦边。参见 Japanese maples cultivation。
care.pruning: 修剪组 1，仅限晚秋至仲冬期间修剪。
care.propagation: 可通过嫩枝扦插、压条或嫁接繁殖。实生苗通常难以保持品种性状，但仍可能具有园艺观赏价值。

rhs_zh.description: 生长健壮、树形直立的落叶乔木，高约 4-5 米；植株在栽培 5 年后树皮会形成显著的粗糙木栓质表皮，且随树龄增长愈发明显。叶较小，掌状 5 裂，裂片细裂，绿色，秋季转为金黄色和橙色。

descriptions.preferred: Acer Shirasawanum 'Aureum' - 金隐与Acer Shirasawanum 'Kin Kakure' - 金隐笠为异名同株，金隐被认为是欧洲 的品种，而金隐笠被认为是日本的品种；其实两者是 完全一样的。Acer Shirasawanum 'Kin Kakure' - 金隐 笠曾一度被认为是大叶羽团扇的品种 Acer Japonicum 'Kin Kakure', 在 Japanese Maples 日 本 枫 树 第 二 版 中 J.D.Vertrees 正式改为 Acer Shirasawanum。 金隐叶大且圆，春天新叶为绿色，而后叶色越来越黄， 夏季变为黄绿色，夏季在足够的晨光照射下，会有紫 红色的叶边，秋季为橙红色。团扇系列，生长速度较慢， 不耐晒，高温天午后遮阴，全日照会出现严重的日灼 现象，成年株可达 3 米左右高度。

sources.name: Aureum Full Moon Japanese Maple
sources.description: The Aureum Full Moon Maple, also known as the Full Moon Japanese Maple, is a stunning tree renowned for its unique golden-yellow foliage and graceful, rounded shape. Unlike other maples, its large, palmate leaves create a broad, full canopy, providing a striking contrast to the more finely dissected leaves of other Japanese Maples. The vibrant gold of the Aureum’s leaves adds a touch of brightness to your landscape, especially during the spring and summer months. In autumn, the tree transitions to brilliant shades of yellow and orange, ensuring year-round beauty. Typically reaching heights of 3 to 4 meters, the Aureum Full Moon Maple is perfect for medium to large gardens or as a specimen tree. It thrives in well-drained soil and partial shade, making it an easy-to-care-for addition to your garden. At Herter Nursery, we offer healthy, robust AureumFull Moon Maples for sale to bring a vibrant pop of colour and a unique form to your outdoor space.

descriptions.preferred: Acer tataricum通常称为鞑靼枫树，为一种小而直立的树，树冠密集、圆形，或生长为大型多茎灌木。随着时间的推移，它会长到 5、6米高。在成熟的树上可以找到不裂的、宽卵形的、中等大小的绿色叶子，具有不规则的双锯齿边缘。幼树上的叶子通常是3裂的。叶子在秋天变成黄色和红色。绿白色的花朵一簇簇的在春天绽放，花朵之后是带翅膀的红翅果（长至1英寸），成熟时会变成艳丽的红色。
